reviews.author: Danny M
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Melia Paradisus Palma Real - April 11-18 2025

Booked through Costco Travel with Air Transat Vacations

Flights: Air Transat was amazing and I (6'5") got the emergency exit for both legs (My wife as well). :)

Transfer: Costco includes private transfer and what a treat. To pass a line of 150 people and go directly to a comfortable minivan that whisked us to the resort in 20 minutes. Wow!

Garden view suite Reserved section

Check in: super fast efficient and easy. We never touched our bags and they were delivered to our rooms immediately.

Room service: Called at 11 pm and ordered a burger and Chicken nuggets. The burger was amazing and the nuggets were pure white meat but a bit doughy. Fries were warm. Food arrived in about 20 minutes.

This resort is the closest I have come to a 5 star. Everything seemed classier and we felt like royalty.

I contacted Alvaro Manuel at Reserved Guest Services before arriving and he ensured we had rooms on the second floor, that we were close to our friend who was travelling with us and that our first dinner reservation was made at Santé. He also made sure to come and see us during our stay and make sure we were happy.

Our butler, Harry was superb. He was so refined and personable. He noticed every detail and ensured all our reservations were made, delivered a bucket of ice every evening (usually with a bottle of quite good Chilean Merlot). He was constantly in communication  with us and sent us the reservation confirmation and the activity schedule every day. Such a pleasure. We will request him next time we stay at this resort.

Every single staff member at this resort was amazing. So professional and helpful and there was NEVER and expectation for a tip (although we tried to tip for every meal and service). You get what you give.

The resort is not too big and very walkable. Also very quiet and peaceful and well groomed.

Beach: groomed twice a day with a giant net in the ocean keeping the seaweed out. Plenty of super comfortable beach beds with 8 inch mattresses. Servers will usually follow you to the bed you want and clean it off, than place towels down and ask you for your first drink order. No silly towel rules, just go up to the hut and take what you need. NEVER had a trouble finding a nice comfortable beach bed, even after 10am.

Drinks: Bars are everywhere and getting service is never an issue. Ginger bar in the lobby does amazing coffees and specialty drinks. In the evening at the plaza there is a Mojito cart which does hand crafted specialty mojitos. The resorts frozen Pina Coladas are made with real pineapple and coconut.

Snack and drinks in room: the guys who replenish the room are great. Beer choice is Presidenté, Coors lite, Heiniken and Corona. Pop is Coke, Diet Coke or Sprite. Jus is orange or apple. Lots of still water and Perrier too. Nespresso coffee maker in room. Beach bags are very plush and include flip flops (not big enough for my size 16 feet).

Food: loved every restaurant but our favorite was Flora. Such a chill vibe and the food was amazing. Japanese was fun but the food is nothing special. Since we were Reserve, we went to Santé many times for breakfast and lunch. Both were excellent (omelettes, cappuccinos, fruit smoothies and much more). Lunch seemed to feature seafood like lobster, scallops, shrimp, etc and frequently and amazing beef tenderloin. Taco bar day was my favourite. The buffet was always great food but too noisy and chaotic for me. My tip is to sit outside at Kanna (great tacos and pulled pork) and get whatever food you like from the buffet. Ice cream at the buffet was really good. Friday is Dominican Day and the entire plaza is buzzing with vendors and food and drink.

We attempted to take the free/included catamaran trip but it was cancelled due to crappy weather. They provide towels and a snack BTW.

Workshops: 2 or more every day. We did several and they were free and fun. Go early since they fill up.

Nightly entertainment: Some sort of show every night. Nothing spectacular but always entertaining. Several nights had staff in costume taking pics with guest. Dance party outside the sports bar every night from 9 to 11pm.

Got some bug bites at night. My fault since I brought spray but didn't use it. If you don't bring enough sunscreen, you may have to sell a kidney to buy some at the resort store.

Shopping tip: We went to the downtown mall (Jumbo is amazing) and shopped at the 2 malls there. Uber to the mall was about $15 with tip. It was a fun rainy day activity.

Weather: rain forecasted everyday but really only rained one day. Umbrella in the room. 

Thanks again Harry for making our stay so relaxing. Reserved Section is the way to go, so deluxe.

From the moment we arrived at Paradisus Palma Real, we felt genuinely cared for — and that was entirely thanks to Eriol, our concierge. He went above and beyond every single day to make sure our stay was unforgettable, and he put extraordinary care into making my husband David’s birthday truly special.
Eriol anticipated our needs before we even voiced them, checked in on us with sincerity (never intrusion), and arranged thoughtful surprises that made David feel celebrated from morning to night. His warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail elevated our entire experience.
The resort itself is beautiful, but it’s people like Eriol who make it exceptional. Because of him, this trip became one of our most memorable vacations. We can’t recommend Paradisus Palma Real enough — and if you’re lucky enough to have Eriol as your concierge, you’re in the best hands.

reviews.author: Meander12276169370
reviews.title: Beautiful Property, Great Food, Attentive Service
reviews.text:
I booked through Costco Travel, we stayed at The Reserve Adults Only section. We ate at all 6 reservation restaurants and enjoyed our meals, especially Mina Steakhouse and Blue Agave Mexican. Buffet food was fine, there were plenty of options and most of it was good.

The nightly entertainment was good but not incredible. We stayed at the Adults Only pool and Reserve pools mostly so I can't speak to the activities in the main pool other than the activities are minimal compared to the Sun Palace in Cancun. This was fine with us. 

The beach is beautiful, they do a great job taking care of the entire property. And everything was very easily walkable. The "family fun park" called Fun Republic was indeed fun, two mini golf courses and a bunch of activities for kids.

Occupancy was low during our stay, which made getting chairs by the pool or beach very easy.

I don't think I would get The Reserve again, but our attendant Eriol was incredibly attentive and good at communicating with us. He handled our reservations which was the best part. The "Reserve Only" restaurant "Santé" was good but not worth the added cost in hindsight.

Ari, a bartender at the Adults Only pool was very friendly with my wife and I and made her special fruit smoothies which was incredibly kind.

Some cons, the A/C was broken in our room the final night. Most of the desserts were tasteless and spongy, but some were good. Alcoholic drinks were often watered down compared to the Sun Palace in Cancun.

Overall it was a great and very relaxing trip, we would come here again for the price we paid.

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: 10 days 9 Nights at the Reserve
reviews.text:
This trip was for 10 days, from May 21 - May 30. My wife and I are both in our 50s. From Brooklyn, NY.  We have been to tbis resort about ten times since 2005. 

May is not a super busy time at the resort. The weather overall was mid to upper 80s/ low 90s. 

My wife and I have been Elite Club Melia members since 2011. Normally we use our club options to stay at the Reserve. This time we had to convert option to rewards as the Reserve is no longer a choice for Club Melia. We chose to do this as we love the Reserve and didn’t want a swim up suite on the family side (as we don’t have kids). The club does still have swim up suites available in the non-adults only side. But as I mentioned that’s not what we wanted.   

As a swim up suite, you walk out a sliding glass door and a pool is right there. You have two chairs and an umbrella dedicated to your suite. Plus a patio with two chairs and a table.  The shrubs and greenery mark off each unit making it private. One day someone took our chairs, but moved without any hassle when I pointed out that those were just for our suite. We had a junior suite which is more than enough room for two people. If you have 4 or more people, I would suggest getting a regular size suite. 

Our suite was on the corner, which meant it was closest to the beach. This part of the beach was for Reserve guests only. They do enforce it (they go by the wrist band you have).  

There are 10 restaurants

Sante is for the Reserve members only. It has breakfast, lunch and dinner. 

Mediterranean food 

Mina - the steakhouse. Dinner only 

MasCalzone - Italian. Dinner only 

Blue agave - Mexican. Dinner only 

Lunch box - buffet. Breakfast, lunch and dinner 

Tokimeku - Japanese.  Hibachi or a la carte 
Dinner only 

Kanna - lunch only. 

 Flora - adults only. Dominican. Dinner only 

Olio. - this was a new restaurant. 

Mediterranean.  Dinner only 

We went to the beach and pool every day. Except one day we just did the pool as it was raining part of the day 

We either ate breakfast or lunch, but not both. Just too much food, though we both like to eat. 

If we did breakfast first, we would then do the beach after breakfast. Say around 11.  A few hours at the beach and then the pool around 2

If we didn’t have breakfast. We would go to the beach first.  Have lunch around 2. Then the pool for a few hours. 

Most nights we had dinner at 8:30. The restaurants, kitchen usually closes at 10 and the restaurant closes at 10:30 or 11

There are 4 bars at the restaurants. 

Two close by 11.  They are more bars in between two restaurants. So when the restaurants close they are done soon after. 
The have 6 seats at the bar and tables/ sofas which probably seat another 20 people 

One is Between Bar.  The other is Rum Republic 

Then there is Ginger Bar. It is open until midnight. 10 seats at the bar and at least 100 people can sit on sofas/ chairs 

Kicks is the final bar. It’s open until 1 am. Youngest crowd. Sports game on several TVs. DJ some nights 

There are also entertainment shows every night. From 7 - 10.  We didn’t go to any this trip as we’ve seen them on last trips. You can sit and have drinks in the open area (probably can seat 100 people). 

When you stay at the reserve, a conceirge is assigned to your room.  Eriol was our conceirge. I am not exaggerating when he is the best conceirge we have ever had on any of our Melia trips. Which is two a year since 2011.  So about 30.  He was that attentive, without being on top of you. 

My wife’s birthday was the day after we arrived. I had contacted the resort in advance about her birthday.  On the day we arrived, we had a bottle of wine  and a small cake waiting. I thought this was for her birthday. Nope, that was a welcome gift. On her birthday, he did the room with balloons, filled the tub with a rose petal bubble bath and a bottle of champagne. Plus a larger cake waiting for her at the restaurant that we had dinner at that night. 

Throughout the trip, we had two more bottles of champagne, another bottle of wine. Fruits and chocolates. As club members we usually do get this as a welcome gift and on her birthday (we usually go then). But not five times in a ten day trip. 

He checked in with us every morning (what’s app is what the use). To tell us activities for the day and to see how the night before was. 
And was there anything that needed attention 

On our second day, we did something dumb that we have never done before. We left our safe wide open. Yanely, the housekeeper called security to have them lock it (as she wouldn’t know our code, so she couldn’t close it). Security left a note so we could get it reopen. Everything was as is, nothing was missing or moved. I was most worried about our passports being there. But we also had some jewelry and cash in there.  When I called the front desk and security came they told me there was already a report of what happened on file. I asked our conceirge to find out who the housekeeper was for our day. So we could personally thank her and give her a reward. I appreciated the honest people involved in this 

Beach

Pedro and Martin remembered us from our last two visits (each of the last two years). Pedro would reserve a Bali bed for us every morning.  As it wasn’t that crowded, it was the same one each day. 

Rafael was the beach server we had most often. He would always starts us off with a bucket of champagne and OJ to make mimosas. 

All three of them were very good 

The beach is beautiful. The water while a beautiful color, isn’t always ideal for swimming. There’s a lot of seaweed. That and at times it is too rough to swim. I’m not much of a swimmer. My wife is. 

The pool server weren’t as attentive as the beach servers. There is a pool bar where you can get drinks yourself. Hydro is the name of the bar. The pool bar closes at 6
If you don’t have a swim up suite there are lounge chairs available. The pool was never super packed. Always plenty of room. 

There is a huge pool not far from this one. I’ll call it the main pool.  We didn’t use this as we had the swim up pool.  The main pool of course allows kids and does have activities 

We went to Sante once for dinner. A few times for breakfast or lunch. 

Barnelis is the hostess.  She remembered us from our last two trips. 

Franklin (a waiter) remembered us. 

The food at Sante is always very good. Can get things from shrimp to steak to chicken. 
For breakfast they have a small buffet (if you want a larger one, go to lunchbox restaurant).  They have eggs or omelettes made to order. 

For lunch there is also a buffet or a la carte. 
Dinner is just the menu.  

One day I had an upset stomach (not from all the alcohol, that I’m used to :)).  Gieny had the bartender make me a non alcohol drink which settled it right away. The bartender came over to explain to me what was in it 

Kanna. 

We had lunch here three times. We remember Luis (waiter) from prior trips. He wasn’t there the first day. But when we asked for him, the hostess mentioned it to him the next day as he saw us at a different restaurant when we had dinner. He was our Waiter here the other two times this trip.  He’s very personable, funny and professional 

Flora 

Sterling (waiter) remembered us from prior trips. This was Dominican food. We ate there once and liked it better than last time 

Mascalzone. 

We had dinner there once.  It’s good but as we are from Brooklyn, we do have a lot of Italian food. It is a quicker meal and more casual 

Mina. We had dinner here twice (as it’s our favorite place). It’s the steakhouse. 
Wander was our server both nights. He’s very attentive. 
Tbis was the one time we paid for upgraded wine. Each of the two times we bought a bottle. 

The sides are very good. As are the various steaks.  Appetizers were fine as well 

They did lose our reservation one night. But we got a table right away 

Blue agave. 

Had dinner here once. Luis (the waiter I mentioned at Kanna earlier) was our server as well. 

Typical Mexican fare. As New Yorkers, we do eat Mexican food semi frequently. Very good food. 

Olio 

Lost our reservation. But gave us a table right away anyway. 

Food was good. 

Tokimeku, we had the hibachi dinner 

Daniel was the hibachi chef. More entertaining than the average chef.  Different Version of the usual show/presentation

We went to Ginger bar, five of the nine nights

Luis and Miguel were the two bartenders. They both remembered us from prior trips. 
They are both very good at their jobs. Friendly as well 

Kicks bar.  We went there three times 

There is another Luis.  He is the supervisor of the four bars. He recognized us the first night we were at Kicks. We saw him every night at different places. Would always come over to where we were sitting. 

Luis is a bartender at Kicks. He recognized us from years. 

Felix was another bartender. They had run out of grey goose (my wife’s favorite vodka). Even though it was packed and a half hour to closing, he was able to get another bottle from the back 

Rum republic bar

We went there three times 

Victor was the bartender. 

The day we left. Jose picked up our bags. He waited 15 minutes with us until our ride to the airport came. 

Overall this was a great trip. I highly recommend it

reviews.text: I recently stayed here with my sister to celebrate my 50th birthday.  The resort is gated which made us feel safer and the grounds are beautiful and maintained daily. The food was good, nothing exceptional but good. We were not impressed with the restaurant that was only for the guests staying at the reserve, we both agreed that the other restaurants were better.  The resort is large and we never felt like it was overcrowded. The pools are beautiful and they maintain the beach. It's more of a quieter resort,  so if you are looking for something that has a lot of activities,  this is not the place for you. They do have a few daily activities but not much. Everyone we encountered that worked at the resort was so nice and helpful.  Fernando,  who i believe ia the activities director,  was very fun and personable.  I highly recommend this resort if you are looking for a place to unwind.

reviews.author: A M
reviews.title: Ericson, Gabriel, Jonathan and Stefania!
reviews.text:
We stayed on the Adults Only side of Paradisus Palma Real in April, and it exceeded our expectations in every way.

From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional. Every staff member we encountered was friendly, attentive, and genuinely focused on making our stay memorable. The resort itself has a luxurious, spa-like atmosphere with beautiful modern finishes throughout, creating the perfect balance of elegance and relaxation.

The food was outstanding across the resort’s restaurants, and the overall dining experience was one of the highlights of our trip. The grounds were immaculate, the pools were stunning, and the adults-only section provided a peaceful and sophisticated escape.

A special thank you to several staff members who truly made our vacation unforgettable. Ericson at the restaurants crafted the best Manhattan I’ve ever had and always provided outstanding service. Jonathan at the pool bar kept the drinks flowing and the good vibes going—Go Blue Jays! Estephania, our favourite hostess, greeted us with a warm smile every day and made us feel incredibly welcome. And Gabriel was simply amazing, going above and beyond to ensure our experience was perfect.

It’s the people who make a great resort exceptional, and the team at Paradisus Palma Real did exactly that. We left feeling refreshed, spoiled, and already planning our return visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a luxury adults-only getaway in the Dominican Republic.

I’d rate it 5/5 stars without hesitation

reviews.author: Anny N
reviews.title: Luxurious Vacation
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana exceeded our expectations and became one of our favorite vacations. We stayed in The Reserve section and from arrival, everything felt effortless.

A special thank you to José, our bellman, who was exceptional from arrival to departure and always made us feel welcome. Our concierge, Christopher Rivera (Chris), truly made this vacation unforgettable. He arranged all of our dinner reservations, constantly checked on us, and made sure we had everything we needed. For my birthday, he helped my husband organize a private beach dinner with a special song playing—it honestly felt like a dream.

Special recognition also goes to Arismendi for making my birthday dinner extra special, Dilania at the pool area for always checking on us, Rafael at the beach for constantly going above and beyond, Carlos for my birthday drink, and Gladys for an incredible massage. Every employee made us feel like family.

Our beachfront walkout room was beautiful and fully stocked with everything we needed. The resort itself is luxurious, spacious, spotless, with plenty of beach chairs, pools, and a beautiful beach.

Brutally honest: we travel often and are hard to impress with food, but the buffet had great variety and authentic Dominican breakfast. Kanna Asian hibachi, the steakhouse, and Italian restaurant were our favorites. Drinks were typical all-inclusive drinks. Nightlife is limited after 11 PM, but if relaxation is what you want, this place delivers. We would absolutely return.

reviews.author: Doug S
reviews.title: Outstanding Service and a Stunning Property in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We recently spent 8 nights at Paradisus Palma Real in the Reserve adults-only section (worth the up-charge), and it was easily one of the best vacation experiences we’ve had.

From the moment we arrived, we were impressed. The resort’s open-air design and grand scale are breathtaking. Walking into the lobby for the first time was genuinely overwhelming in its scale. The dedicated Reserve check-in lounge immediately set the tone for the week, with a personalized check-in experience, champagne, and an exclusive atmosphere.  This is not the type of vacation that I am accustomed to and I felt valued from the start. 

Our room was spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed. We especially appreciated the large bathing area that opened into the room and the ample storage space, which made it easy to fully unpack and settle in for our stay. The only minor frustration was the lighting controls, which never seemed particularly intuitive. Aside from that, the room was clean, well-maintained, and exactly what we hoped for.

The resort itself is absolutely beautiful. There were many moments throughout the week when I felt fortunate simply to be there. We visited during shoulder season, so the resort never felt crowded. Finding a quiet corner to relax was easy, and there were plenty of peaceful moments throughout the day.

The food selection was extensive. The buffet offered more choices than I could possibly try in a week. Our only criticism was that some buffet items that sat out for longer periods were served at room temperature rather than being kept warmer. As a result, we generally preferred made-to-order stations and specialty restaurants.

The Josper chicken at Mina Steakhouse. Quite simply, was about the best chicken I’ve ever eaten. Flora, featuring Dominican cuisine, was outstanding and became one of our favorites—we ate there twice during our stay.

The beach was beautiful and felt very safe. The pools were clean, refreshing, and notably free of the strong chlorine smell that often accompanies resort pools.

What truly set Paradisus Palma Real apart was the staff. Every single employee we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and eager to help. From lobby attendants and bartenders to housekeeping staff, waiters, grounds crews, and bussers, the level of service was consistently exceptional.

A special thank-you goes to our concierge, Eriol. He was always available through WhatsApp, helped coordinate dinner reservations, shared daily activities, and was consistently cheerful and helpful. Notably, while we were on an excursion one day he arranged for our room to be decorated for our anniversary. When we returned we found our bed covered in rose petals, there was champagne on ice, chocolate and strawberries, and a hot bubble bath had been drawn. By the end of the trip, running into him around the resort felt less like meeting a staff member and more like bumping into a friend.

If there was one aspect that exceeded expectations, it was the people. The staff made an already beautiful resort feel genuinely warm and welcoming. To sum up my feelings about this week: I felt wealthy being able to experience a vacation like this.

reviews.title: Very Positive Experience
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana exceeded our expectations and delivered an all-around fantastic experience. From the moment we arrived, the property felt like a perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and genuine hospitality.

Our room was comfortable and well-maintained, providing a solid home base for the trip. While it wasn’t overly luxurious, it had everything we needed and was consistently clean and functional. We stayed on the adults-only side, which really elevated the overall experience. This offered a quieter, more relaxed atmosphere that made it easy to unwind and enjoy the resort without the busier energy of the family-oriented areas.

Another thing we loved was how conveniently the Melia properties are situated. Having multiple properties close together made it easy to explore different areas and amenities without feeling confined to just one resort space. It added a bit of variety and flexibility to the trip.

A hidden gem that more people should take advantage of is the complimentary access to the Fun Republic amusement park. It’s easy to overlook, but it was a fun and unique perk that added an extra layer of entertainment to our stay... especially if you’re looking to mix things up beyond the beach and pool.

The food offerings were solid overall, with a wide variety of options that ensured there was always something different to try. From international dishes to local Dominican flavors, the selection stood out more for its range than anything else. While not every meal was exceptional, the overall quality was above par and consistently enjoyable, making dining a dependable part of the experience.

However.... What truly made the experience exceptional was the level of service especially from a selected few staff like Adriel and Anthony. Adriel, our concierge, was outstanding. He was proactive in booking dinner reservations, always quick to respond to questions, and made everything feel effortless. It’s rare to find someone so attentive without being intrusive, and he struck that balance perfectly. Anthony, one of the bartenders, also went above and beyond. He remembered our orders after just a short time and consistently delivered friendly, personalized service that made us feel welcomed every time we stopped by.

reviews.title: Off peak season travel - WOW
reviews.text:
We traveled as a family of 6 at the beginning of May which is off-peak season.
This meant way fewer people at the resort, still clear sunny skies, warm days and lots of attention on us. 
It's much quieter at this time - not so much partying or other children - that could be pro/con depending on your situation. 
I was pleasantly surprised by the service levels by many of their staff, bright smiles, eagerness to help, just in general above average services by almost everyone. 
there are varying levels of comfort with English by their staff, but if you speak Spanish communication is fantastic. 
If you need any help while on the resort - seek out Guillermo in Concerige as he helped us with many requests. 
One thing that stood out as odd in some of the rooms - the washroom area is only separated by a sheet curtain - not a door. This was in a room with 2 beds - recommend a door or at minimum blackout level curtains (only 1 room had this feature)

reviews.title: World-Class Resort, Even Better People
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from an incredible stay at the Paradisus Palma Real, and I'll say this plainly: this resort didn't just meet our expectations — it reset them entirely.
From the moment we arrived, the property made an impression. Beautifully maintained grounds, stunning pools, a gorgeous beach, and the kind of attention to detail that tells you management takes pride in what they've built. But what truly elevated this experience wasn't the architecture or the amenities — it was the people.
So let me give credit where it's absolutely due.

Jose Acosta — Concierge
Jose was exceptional from the jump. Knowledgeable, proactive, and genuinely invested in making sure our time was well spent. He didn't just answer questions — he anticipated them. If every concierge operated at this level, the industry would look very different.

Pedro, Raul & Martin — 96 Degrees Beach Bar
This trio had the vibe dialed in perfectly. Cold drinks, great conversation, and a rhythm of service that made beach time feel effortless. They kept things fun and felt like the kind of staff that genuinely enjoy what they do — and it shows.

Antonia — Fahrenheit Pool Bar
Antonia kept the energy up at the pool in the best way possible — always smiling, always attentive, always making sure we had exactly what we needed without us having to ask twice. She made the pool bar our go-to spot every afternoon.

Cristal — Nespresso Café
There's something about a perfect morning coffee that sets the tone for the whole day, and Cristal delivered every single time. Warm, welcoming, and genuinely good at what she does. We looked forward to starting our mornings here.

Evangalista — YHI Spa
I received a 60-minute massage and was was blown away by the spa experience, and Evangalista was the reason why. Professional, skilled, and warm — she created an atmosphere that made the whole experience feel deeply restorative. Truly a gem.

Yanira, Maria & Rosana — Lunchbox Buffet
These three ran a tight, joyful operation. Great food, fast service, and genuine warmth that made every stop feel like more than just grabbing a bite. Consistently excellent.

Alexandra — MasCalzone
Hands down one of the best meals on the property. Alexandra's hospitality matched the food — and that's saying something. She made us feel like regulars from the very first visit.

Roberto — Mina
Roberto understood the assignment. Attentive, polished, and knowledgeable about the menu. Dinner at Mina felt like a proper dining experience — elevated in every way.

Alex & Luis Arias — Brisas
Brisas was a highlight for us, and Alex and Luis were a huge part of why. Aside from the live musical entertainment during dinner, Alex & Luis provided seamless service, great energy, and a pace that felt exactly right. Outstanding.

Tomas & Luis Arias — Tokimeku
We saved Tokimeku for a special evening and were not disappointed. Tomas and Luis brought precision and warmth to what was already a memorable dining experience. The attention to detail was remarkable.

If you're considering Paradisus Palma Real — book it. And when you get there, seek out the people on this list. They aren't just doing their jobs. They're creating moments. My wife and I left feeling genuinely grateful, and that doesn't happen by accident.
We'll be back.

reviews.author: Anna-Leigh B
reviews.title: Amazing and Safe Solo Trip Experience
reviews.text:
I had a really great experience during my stay here. I traveled solo, and as someone doing a solo trip for the first time, I felt very safe and comfortable throughout my entire stay. The staff was attentive, friendly, and almost everyone spoke English very well, which made everything feel much less stressful and easy to navigate.

My room ( reserved adults only swim out suite) was clean, comfortable, and relaxing. The only downside was that the walls seemed fairly thin, so I could hear the couple staying next door at times. Aside from that, the room itself was very nice and comfortable to come back to after long days outside.

The beach was one of my favorite parts of the resort. Even though I only stayed 3 nights, every time I went down to the beach there was always someone there to help lay out towels and check in with me. Even though there were multiple vendors trying to sell you thing, the beach area was beautiful, relaxing, and very well maintained.

I also really enjoyed the restaurants on the property. I ate at Flora, Mina, and Sante during my stay. Sante had the best view, and Mina had the best atmosphere and vibe, but Flora was my favorite overall because the food and service were excellent. The staff at Flora especially stood out to me because they actually came over and made conversation with me, which I really appreciated since I was dining alone. The buffet food personally wasn’t really to my liking, but the room service was great and ended up being my preferred option.

My concierge, Eriol, was amazing throughout my stay. He always responded quickly, answered my questions, and was extremely helpful whenever I needed information or assistance. I also got a massage from Ironelis, who was very friendly and did an excellent job.

The resort also sends out a daily list of events and activities, which I appreciated. My only issue was that I sometimes had trouble figuring out where the activities were located because there weren’t many signs around the resort directing you where to go. Since I visited during a slower time of year, some activities also felt a little empty when I arrived.

Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this resort, especially for solo travelers looking for a safe and relaxing experience.

reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une magnifique semaine au Paradisus Palma, dans la section réservée aux adultes, The Reserve. Un grand merci à Brandy, à la réception, pour son accueil.
Notre adorable concierge Eriol, qui parle très bien français, nous a permis de profiter de soupers dans tous les restaurants à la carte. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié le Flora, avec un grand merci à Ana Iris, Kelvin et Yolandi ; le Mina, merci à Antonio et Yoleidi ; et enfin le Mascalzone, merci à Daniela et Jesús.
Les chambres sont belles, spacieuses et impeccablement propres. Le buffet est excellent et très varié — merci à Rossana et Maria pour leur service exceptionnel.
La plage est magnifique, longue et idéale pour ceux qui aiment marcher. Merci également à Pedro et Raul pour leur gentillesse.
Je dois toutefois préciser que le début de notre séjour n’a pas tout à fait été à la hauteur de nos attentes, en raison de petits incidents avec les bagages ainsi qu’au restaurant Santé. Heureusement, l’intervention de la manager Laura nous a rapidement fait oublier ces désagréments. Un grand merci à elle : son professionnalisme et son attention nous ont donné envie de revenir. Nous espérons te recroiser, que ce soit lors d’un prochain séjour ici ou dans un autre hôtel de Meliá.

Pasamos una semana maravillosa en el Paradisus Palma, en la sección solo para adultos, The Reserve. Muchas gracias a Brandy, en recepción, por su amable bienvenida.
Nuestro encantador concierge Eriol, que habla muy bien francés, nos permitió disfrutar de cenas en todos los restaurantes a la carta. Apreciamos especialmente Flora, con un agradecimiento especial a Ana Iris, Kelvin y Yolandi; Mina, gracias a Antonio y Yoleidi; y por último Mascalzone, gracias a Daniela y Jesús.
Las habitaciones son bonitas, amplias y están impecablemente limpias. El buffet es excelente y muy variado; gracias a Rossana y Maria por su servicio excepcional.
La playa es hermosa, larga e ideal para quienes disfrutan caminar. Gracias también a Pedro y Raul por su amabilidad.
Sin embargo, debo señalar que el inicio de nuestra estancia no estuvo del todo a la altura de nuestras expectativas, debido a pequeños inconvenientes con el equipaje y en el restaurante Santé. Afortunadamente, la intervención de la gerente Laura nos hizo olvidar rápidamente estos contratiempos. Muchísimas gracias a ella: su profesionalismo y su atención nos dieron ganas de volver. Esperamos volver a verte, ya sea en una próxima estancia aquí o en otro hotel de Meliá.

reviews.author: Paradise89522
reviews.title: Inmejorable
reviews.text:
Nuestra estancia en el Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort fue, sencillamente, inolvidable. El entorno es espectacular, con unas instalaciones cuidadas al mínimo detalle que invitan al descanso y al disfrute desde el primer momento. Todo está pensado para ofrecer una experiencia de auténtico lujo en el Caribe.
Sin embargo, lo más destacable vuelve a ser, sin duda, el equipo humano. En el restaurante Blue Agave, Virtudes nos hizo sentir especialmente bienvenidos, con un trato cercano, atento y siempre pendiente de que todo estuviera perfecto. En Olio, Gabriel destacó por su profesionalidad y su excelente atención, haciendo que cada visita fuera un auténtico placer. Y en Flora, Starling nos sorprendió con su dedicación y amabilidad, cuidando cada detalle para que la experiencia fuera redonda.
Queremos hacer también una mención muy especial a Marc, cuya atención y compromiso con los huéspedes marcan realmente la diferencia. Gracias a él, nuestra estancia fue aún más cómoda y memorable.
En resumen, un hotel que lo tiene todo: instalaciones de primer nivel, gastronomía excelente y, sobre todo, un equipo humano que hace que quieras volver.

reviews.author: yoli
reviews.title: 100% recomendable, paraíso puro!
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia en el Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort ha sido simplemente espectacular. Desde el primer momento, el hotel impresiona por sus instalaciones impecables, su entorno paradisíaco y la calidad de todos sus servicios. Es el lugar perfecto para relajarse y disfrutar de unas vacaciones inolvidables.
Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es el trato excepcional de su personal. En el restaurante Blue Agave, queremos destacar especialmente a Virtudes, quien nos atendió con una amabilidad y profesionalidad increíbles, siempre pendiente de cada detalle. En Olio, Gabriel nos brindó un servicio impecable, combinando cercanía y eficiencia de una forma extraordinaria. Y en Flora, Starling hizo que cada momento fuera perfecto gracias a su atención y dedicación.
Por supuesto, no podemos dejar de agradecer a Marc por todo. Su implicación y atención constante hicieron que nuestra estancia fuera aún más especial.
Sin duda, recomendamos este hotel al 100%. Una experiencia de lujo donde, además de las instalaciones, el trato humano es simplemente inmejorable. ¡Volveremos seguro!

reviews.author: Rose A
reviews.title: Friends getaway
reviews.text:
My friend and I had an amazing week. We stayed in the reserve section. I emailed ahead to ask for two beds and that was accommodated. I also was able to have them book the next nights dinner as we arrived very late and I didn't want to look after that next morning. Our butler Basilio was good, He did what was asked of him. No issues, we made contact daily as needed via WhatsApp. Our favorite bartenders was Marcus and Junior, We met at their bar daily around 4:00pm for our start of day drink. No ask was too much. Always a smile. Thank you guys... We loved our pool view room and the rocking chairs on the balcony was a big hit. We loved it in the evening while we laughed and had a couple of drinks before getting ready for dinner. All ala cart restaurants was great, we enjoyed the steak as our best. But all very good. We accidentally left our safe open and there was a polite note stuck in the locked safe that they found it open and locked it and we needed to call to have it open. NOTHING was missing. As for someone writing a review to say someone stole 100.00 out of your safe I find that very hard to believe. I tested this resort with a friend as I am somewhat picky and I loved it. In fact my hubby and I, along with another couple are going to go for 2 weeks in Sept because of the great week I had. 
The beds on the beach is awesome, so comfy. I loved the lounge chairs too so you could go from full sun to shade when required. A couple bars ran out of grey goose vodka a few times which was annoying because I book specialty or reserve for that reason. I don't drink a lot but do expect what I pay for, That would be my only thing to mention, please keep your bars stocked to accommodate what your guests pay for. I look forward to coming back in Sept. I will email prior to coming to let you know when. Thank you Paradisus and thank you also to Odeht to responding to my emails and booking my first dinner reservation. It was appreciated..... See you soon...Rose and Sheri.....

reviews.author: Suzanne C
reviews.title: Great vacation spot, highly recommended
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa resort for 10 days and had a great time. Our concierge Christopher was great. He checked in with us several times a day and made sure we had reservations for dinner each night. He always made sure we had everything we needed. If we had any issues, the staff dealt with it immediately to make sure we were happy.

Junior at the bar next to the pool in the adult only reserve section close to the beach was the best bartender and makes the best banana mammas I ever had.

The staff was nice and friendly, the room was so nice and new and the beach in front of the resort was beautiful.

Most of the food was great. When it wasn't great, it was just not what I expected being from another country, for example tiger shrimp is quite large in Canada, but here, was much smaller and very salty.

We golfed 5 rounds which broke up the trip nicely and we never got bored. Even after being there for 10 days, we didn't want to leave when it was time to go. Usually at the end of 10 days, we're ready to go home but would have been happy to stay a few more days.

It was one of the best vacations we've been on and we will be back!

reviews.author: Giorgia A
reviews.title: Paradise in paradise!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at Paradisus Palma Real. From the very moment we set foot on the property we were well attended to and so impressed by the grounds and hotel aesthetic. We booked on the Reserve side which meant we had a separate reception where we were welcomed with a glass of bubbly, as well as a small buffet for if you’re feeling peckish. We were able to access all the hotel facilities whilst we waited for our room, including the restaurants etc.
I would definitely recommend booking the Reserve side if you are an Adults Only party. The pools and beach area was fabulous, as well as access to Santé (adults only restaurant). However, in general the hotel did not feel overcrowded or too “childish” though there were families. And though it felt exclusive, it did not feel exclusionary which I personally liked. The on the beach location was incredible, I would not want to go without it, the beach itself is gorgeous and well maintained, with plenty of sun loungers and beds.

The food at the hotel in general was of a decent standard, I particularly liked the buffet and à la carte at Santé, as well as Flora. Overall nothing to scream home about but decent enough with decent quality. We also took full advantage of the Nespresso spot and the cafeteria upstairs. Another nice touch was a bbq by the Reserve pools during the day, with freshly grilled meat and even lobster! They would also have live musical entertainment. I was in love with their piña colada slushies and had plenty of those by the hand of Gilberto at the beach bar. In general they are quick with the beverage service which is great. One small note is the bars could be open a little later on the beach/by the pools.  

The entertainment options at the hotel were very varied and unique! Our favourites were the Aerial yoga and the bike ride around the Melia grounds, genuinely loved both! I wish the aerial class could be a bit longer. We also enjoyed the Pole class. Sadly we didn’t get a chance to try the coconut oil making or the coffee making but I know those would be so fun, particularly due to the staff facilitating. We also missed the catamaran tour - they need to do it more often! The nightly entertainment was also cute and fun, it got everyone engaged and dancing. In general there’s a lot of dancing a good vibes throughout the day/evening which we loved. There are so many to name but the staff do an amazing job at keeping good vibes and friendliness throughout the resort, big gracias to Fernando, Johan, Carlos and the rest of the entertainment team, including the boys in blue!

In general the rooms were a very good size and very clean from the start, they have all the amenities you would need. They do a turndown service which was a nice touch. The beds are relatively comfortable and other than hearing the occasional other guest, we felt like it was quiet at night. We did find that the daily cleaning could be more thorough however, it seemed they would dispose of the bins and then do a quick sweep of the place. We understand the cleaning staff work very hard and have a lot of rooms to clean, but a slightly more thorough clean would’ve been appreciated where possible. The general resort however is spotless and smells lovely as soon as you arrive (this includes the pools/beach/restaurants). You can tell they work very hard to maintain it.

We were introduced to our Concierge Eriol at check in, he was very friendly from the start, gave us a tour of the hotel and Reserve area. He gave us his number so we could WhatsApp him with any questions, and quickly asked us to tell him which restaurants we would like to book for the evenings we were there. He also sent us a list of the daily activities going on in the hotel which was very helpful and was always on hand to answer any doubts. Additionally he surprised us with a bottle of wine during our stay to our room. The hotel provide a courtesy room for guests who are leaving on the final day post check out but this was fully booked when we needed it. However, Eriol was able to book us individual courtesy rooms in the spa instead which was extremely helpful. He’s a great concierge, thank you Eriol!

As said, our overall stay was amazing, we did not want to leave! It is a very well set up resort, with great attention to detail, very clean, stunning location with very friendly and helpful staff. Considering the price compared to others, it was definitely worth it. Our own paradise in the paradise that is DR. Thank you again!

P.s. for those complaining about staff not speaking English, you’re in a Spanish speaking country and I guarantee they are trying their best - get over yourselves!

reviews.author: Julie D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort Dominican Republic – March 22 to 29, 2026
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort
Dominican Republic – March 22 to 29, 2026

We stayed at this 4.4-star rated resort and had a very enjoyable overall experience. The property is beautiful, very well maintained, and the service is excellent. The quality of the food is exceptional—probably the best we have had while traveling, both at the buffet and in the à la carte restaurants.

Upon our late arrival on Sunday evening, we were initially given a room with two double beds instead of queen beds, which was uncomfortable for two adults. However, we were able to move to a room with a king bed the next day. It is worth noting that the bed was very firm.

We had access to three à la carte restaurants. We highly recommend booking as early as the morning after your arrival, as reservations are in high demand. We chose the Italian, the steakhouse, and the Japanese restaurant, and the food was excellent. Special mention for the Japanese restaurant: although it is marketed as a “show,” the experience is more of a U-shaped table with a chef in the center. There is no menu choice, but the dish (stir-fry with shrimp, chicken, and steak) is delicious.

A downside concerns the “hospitality room” service at departure. It was poorly organized, with only one room available, to be reserved the same morning. We recommend reserving immediately upon waking. Our time slot was from 5:00 to 5:30 a.m., but we were interrupted several times (by staff and other guests who thought they had the same reservation). Additionally, our luggage was left unattended, which is concerning—especially with the presence of a CPAP device. This situation was frustrating and marred the end of an otherwise very successful stay. We reported the issue to reception.

The facilities (shops, café, restaurants) are grouped in the same covered area, which is very convenient in case of rain—no umbrella needed. Shows take place in the same open-air area, with an indoor option available in case of rain, including bar service. Organization is excellent, and the decoration is tasteful.

The beach is well supervised by hotel security, but less so by local authorities. Vendors are numerous and sometimes persistent, which can reduce comfort. However, it is easy to find a spot without having to reserve early in the morning, and all chairs have umbrellas. The area is also well suited for children.

The main pool is calmer but the water is quite cold. The adults-only pool is heated (around 90°F), clean, and not crowded. However, service there is slower and less attentive.

In summary: an excellent choice for couples and families with young children. Less recommended for families with teenagers. We leave with wonderful memories. Considering the pros and cons, we preferred this resort over Dreams Onyx, which we visited last year.

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones!
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real fue simplemente excepcional de principio a fin. Desde el momento en que llegamos, nos sentimos verdaderamente bienvenidos.

Queremos destacar las hermosas instalaciones, la excelente calidad de la comida y, sobre todo, el increíble equipo humano que hace de este hotel un lugar tan especial. Cada persona con la que interactuamos, camaristas, meseros, bartenders, recepción, botones, nos brindaron siempre una sonrisa, amabilidad y una actitud llena de entusiasmo que realmente marca la diferencia.

Un reconocimiento especial al equipo del Kicks Bar, cuyo carisma y energía hicieron que cada visita fuera memorable, y también a los botones, quienes nos ayudaron con nuestras maletas (¡y vaya que eran pesadas!) siempre con la mejor disposición.
Pero, sin duda, queremos expresar un agradecimiento muy especial a Eduardo Bustamante (Guest Service Manager). Eduardo hizo que nuestra estancia fuera aún más especial: nos recibió con una calidez genuina, tuvo detalles increíbles con nosotros y estuvo siempre atento a ayudarnos a gestionar todo durante nuestra visita. Gracias, Eduardo, por tu acompañamiento y por apoyarnos incluso desde el primer día con la organización de nuestra cena, a pesar de la hora, por cierto, ¡deliciosa!

Nos llevamos la mejor impresión y recuerdos inolvidables de este viaje tan significativo para nosotros. Pedimos una disculpa si no mencionamos todos los nombres, pero nuestro agradecimiento es para cada una de las personas que hicieron posible esta experiencia.

Gracias por su dedicación, su alegría y por hacer de nuestro viaje de aniversario algo verdaderamente excepcional.

¡Muchísimas gracias!

reviews.title: Service 10/10

We mostly ate breakfast and lunch at Sante for their Ala cartes (they also have buffet) but the Lunchbox is great if you want a variety of options (cons: very crowded). The beach was wonderful as well, no problem getting loungers. I wished they would have food service and it would be perfect. We loved the complimentary hydrotherapy experience and the best part of the trip is the destination inclusive, yoga/ catamaran experience. I think this made the trip very worth it.

reviews.author: Ronald and Mich... B
reviews.title: Fantastic visit at a beautiful resort
reviews.text: This was our third visit to Punta Cana (staying at properties that were nothing to write home about.) But as they say, the third time was absolutely the charm. Paradisus is a stunningly gorgeous resort with beautiful updates. We stayed on the Reserve side with an ocean front room. It was well-appointed, well-stocked and quite comfortable. We usually found a spot at the main pool, though the Reserve does have two gorgeous pools that we visited, as well. Be warned that there is a bit of towel jockeying from folks wake early to place towels in beds and chairs that they didn’t even return to until well after noon. That was a bit disappointing but we worked around it. (wry smile) All of the bartenders and pool wait staff were friendly and helpful. We had a fantastic time at the pools. We usually ate breakfast at Sante, the restaurant for Reserve guests. The omelette station is the star there. There’s definitely a much wider breakfast selection at The Lunch Box. But if you want to avoid the crowds, stick with Sante. We had dinner at Mascalzone (Italian - great!) and birthday dinner at Mina (Steakhouse - excellent). Room service was serviceable. When you need a quesadilla at 11:30 pm, it rocks. The only minor con was a lack of towels at ALL of the pools at one point during the stay. But it was quickly remedied. The beaches were beautiful and tended to. No sargassum during our stay. Cristian was our concierge and he was very attentive and helpful in booking reservations. There were nightly shows in the main foyer. Disco night was fantastic. We did venture over to Caribe for the casino, which was very tiny. Getting back to our resort was hit or miss. No one really knew how to call the transport to get us back. We had to flag down a cab.  All in all, I absolutely recommend this resort for a visit to the Dominican Republic. As someone whose previous visits left a bit of a sour taste in my mouth, this resort, the staff, the sights and the accommodations changed my mind. If you are traveling without littles, definitely check out The Reserve. Though there seemed to be a ton of activities for kiddos, as well.

reviews.title: Feels like going home.
reviews.text: As soon as we arrived on the property we were recognized by staff since this was our 3rd stay there. The check in went very smoothly & we were introduced to our concierge Ariel. I must say this man is phenomenal! My husband forgot to get an anniversary card for our trip & asked Ariel to book a taxi to take him to the mall to buy one. Ariel said he would get one for my husband. Ariel would check in with us first thing in the morning & several times during the day to see if we needed anything. He made all dinner reservations for us & booked the spa for me. On a scale of 1 to 10, we would rate Ariel a solid 12!! Our room was cleaned & tidied everyday by the wonderful housekeeping staff & the minibar restocked every day as well. When we told staff we drink a lot of water, they dropped off a case of water for us. I would recommend this resort without hesitation.

reviews.author: Haugtussa85
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at check in and they were really helpful informing us about the hotel and the concierge Jose was very helpful in making reservations for us. The rooms are clean, great and luxurious.  they also have pools outside each building if you want to swim in a more peaceful location. 

The ladies at the kids club were great with our kids and our girls were begging us to go back there. The kids club is only inside, but they do bring the kids outside to do activities if they want. 

The beach chairs were comfortable and the beach area was really a piece of paradise. Also liked that everything is close together. 

The breakfast buffet and lunch buffet has plenty of good offers. Coffee could have been better but the service was good. 

We only tried one à la carte restaurant which was ok, not excellent but still good vibes. 

Overall a great experience and everyone made us feel really welcome

reviews.author: Fave_vacay
reviews.title: A wonderful family vacation (even without the Reserve!)
reviews.text: My husband, 2 kids (5 and 7), and I just wrapped up an amazing vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real. After reading all of the reviews, I was initially a little nervous because it seemed like this property catered, mostly to adults. Prior to arriving, I reached out to the hotel to see if there was an option to have a family concierge, which they do not offer. Despite that, we were pleasantly surprised at how accommodating the resort was for families with kids! Everyone was extremely friendly. The kids club, Kidsdom, was incredible! They took our kids to dinner so we could enjoy dinner alone. They had crafts, a treasure hunt, and tons of fun activities! On two separate occasions, we went to pick up our kids and they didn’t want to leave! That afforded my husband and I time together. They also had nightly live music and various daily activities (a blow up waterslide, water aerobics, etc). The property and beach were gorgeous! Our room (the master swim up suite) was perfect for the 4 of us. The buffet food and most drinks were not the greatest, but we found they specialized in delicious Iced coffee and espresso martinis. The specialty restaurants were delicious, but making a reservation (without a concierge) was stressful. Overall, we loved this resort and our kids are already asking when we can come back!

reviews.author: Solen & David
reviews.title: Une parenthèse hors du temps au Paradis
reviews.text:
Le Paradis porte ici bien plus qu’un nom : c’est une promesse tenue, et même surpassée.

Nous avons choisi cet établissement pour célébrer notre voyage de noces, et chaque instant y a été d’une perfection rare. Dès notre arrivée, nous avons été enveloppés par une atmosphère à la fois élégante, sereine et profondément dépaysante.

Notre logement était irréprochable, les infrastructures sublimes, et la plage privatisée tout simplement idyllique. Mais ce qui distingue véritablement ce lieu, c’est la qualité exceptionnelle de son service : une équipe attentionnée, discrète et d’un professionnalisme remarquable, toujours soucieuse de sublimer chaque moment.

La météo a également été de notre côté, avec un climat idéal ponctué de légères ondées tropicales, aussi brèves qu’agréables.

Pendant 15 jours, le temps s’est comme suspendu. Une parenthèse enchantée où nous avons totalement oublié le reste du monde.

Les expériences proposées sont à la hauteur du cadre : découverte des 5 îles, nage avec les dauphins sauvages, ascension du Morne (à réserver aux plus téméraires), ou encore un survol en hélicoptère absolument spectaculaire. Autant de souvenirs gravés à jamais.

Nous recommandons tout particulièrement Shrivan Adventures pour l’excursion avec les dauphins : une équipe passionnée, respectueuse, et une organisation parfaitement maîtrisée.

Côté gastronomie, chaque table est une invitation au voyage : le buffet, raffiné et varié, le Blue Marlin pour une expérience culinaire d’exception, le Zest avec une mention spéciale pour le sous-chef Souci, et le Ravanne, dont le cadre enchanteur sublime une cuisine authentique et savoureuse.

Aucune fausse note, du premier au dernier jour. Une attention particulière qui nous a touchés : la possibilité de conserver notre chambre jusqu’au soir le jour du départ.

Ce séjour restera, sans conteste, l’un des plus beaux voyages de notre vie.

Un immense merci à toute l’équipe pour cette expérience inoubliable, empreinte d’excellence et d’émotion.

reviews.author: Steff Chandler
reviews.title: Amazing week of relaxation and connection
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at Paradisus Palma Real – Adults Only Reserve.

We were in room 7216.  Not only did we have a view of the 2 adults only Reserve pools but we also had ocean view.  What a lovely surprise!

 The various bartenders were amazing.  The drinks were fresh, delicious and strong.  If you are a wine drinker, I recommend hitting the duty free at the airport before heading to the hotel.  The house wine is just ok.  And if you want a certain wine, it is very expensive through the winery.

 The food was the best food I ever had in DR.  The Adults only reserve restaurant (Santé) was so nice and intimate.  This restaurant is both buffet or a la carte style for breakfast and lunch and is a la carte for dinner.  We had breakfast and lunch here just about every day.  It was a small buffet, but every day was something different.  And there were many options to keep each meal interesting.  The seafood was amazing.   I had a different type of ceviche every day.  The fish and seafood were so fresh, and so delicious.   We had 2 diners here and they were both delicious as well.  Tokimeku was the Sushi restaurant.  The BEST SUSHI WE HAVE EVER HAD.  We had a la carte (however, Hibachi was also an option)  Wonderful Service and great Saki.  The other restaurants were also good but those were our favourites.  We had room service once for breakfast and it was delivered on-time, hot and exactly what we wanted.

 Kicks Sports Bar.  We did not eat here.  However, after 11pm, the music was great – just like a club.  On big game days, it is filled with sports fans and they have big screen TVs.

 There was an exclusive Yoga on the beach that we were able to do.  This was very disappointing.  We were driven on a bus to a low quality resort to board a catamaran.  The catamaran had a toilet with no seat and didn’t flush.  We were supposed to boat out to a beach for yoga.  However, they were unable to moor so we had to do yoga on the boat.  At first, we thought they were joking.  But no.  There was no shade and there was not enough room for everyone to do yoga.  After 20 mins of breathing exercises, we anchored and swam at a sandbar.  We then got back on the catamaran and headed back to where we boarded.  Instead of taking the bus back, we opted to walk the beach back to our resort.   It was such a waste.

 The evening entertainment in the plaza was wonderful.  There were generally 2 acts.  There were violinists and cellists who would play top songs (think Bridgerton style).  There were also vocalists and bands.  All were very talented and entertaining.  The activity staff would generally lead some sort of line dancing. 

The resort grounds were well maintained and beautiful.  

 Our Concierge, Zenovia, was amazing.  She ensured that we got to eat at every restaurant that we wanted to eat at.  There was a large group monopolizing many of the reservations.  Zenovia got us in anyway.  Our air conditioning went down one night, and she was there working with maintenance to ensure it came back quickly well past the end of her shift.  She verified our room service order when we cancelled it by mistake and made sure our room was cleaned when we missed housekeeping.  She sent us the daily activities every morning and arranged for a private transfer to the airport when our return flight was delayed.  She was an absolute delight to have as a concierge.

 We loved our stay at this resort.  We plan to return and maybe book a Reserve Adults only Swim-up room.

reviews.author: Ray M
reviews.title: Relaxing and Breathtaking
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real located in Punta Cana. From the moment we stepped foot off of our plane , we were taken care of. We were escorted to a VIP section of the airport and our luggage, passports, and travel arrangements were all taken care of. When we arrived to our resort we were met with Mr. Eriol. We highly recommend reserving your stay with Mr. Eriol as your concierge attendant—this guy is a magician. Poof! He appears when we need him and ensures that you and your family are having a good time and plans ahead for the next days activities as well as lunch and dinner plans. Uncle Pat and Eriol were able to elevate our stay by reserving dinner reservations, golfing tee times, spa reservations, cabana reservations, as well as any other accommodations that we asked for. He was able to get us not 1 but 2 cabanas without any issues. He also ensured that we were given a welcome pack that included sun screen, hats, personal hand held fans, and outerwear for the activities we would experience. The resort had friendly staff, great child care facilities, clean rooms and facilities, excellent food, live music and entertainment, and most of all clean beaches. We highly recommend that you book your stay at Palma Real, especially with Mr. Eriol as your guide.

reviews.title: EXCELENTE ESTADÍA
reviews.text:
Nuestra estadía en Meliá Palladium Palma Real fue simplemente maravillosa. Desde el primer momento nos sentimos muy bien recibidos y atendidos con un nivel de hospitalidad excepcional.

Queremos destacar especialmente a Junior, nuestro waiter, quien hizo cada comida una experiencia aún más agradable. Siempre atento, amable y con una sonrisa genuina que realmente marca la diferencia.

También queremos agradecer a Dana, del equipo de entretenimiento. Su energía, entusiasmo y dedicación hacen que el ambiente sea divertido y acogedor para todos los huéspedes.

Un reconocimiento muy especial para todo el equipo del Kids Club, quienes hicieron que nuestra hija viviera momentos inolvidables. Su calidez, creatividad y cuidado con los niños es realmente admirable y nos permitió relajarnos sabiendo que ella estaba en excelentes manos.

Todo el hotel ofrece instalaciones hermosas, un servicio impecable y una atmósfera perfecta para disfrutar en familia. Sin duda, una experiencia que recomendamos y que esperamos repetir.

¡Muchas gracias a todo el equipo por hacer de nuestras vacaciones algo tan especial!

⸻
Our stay at Meliá Palladium Palma Real was simply wonderful. From the moment we arrived, we felt warmly welcomed and experienced an exceptional level of hospitality.

We would especially like to recognize Junior, our waiter, who made every meal an even more enjoyable experience. He was always attentive, kind, and welcoming, with a genuine smile that truly makes a difference.

We would also like to thank Dana from the entertainment team. Her energy, enthusiasm, and dedication create such a fun and vibrant atmosphere for all the guests.

A very special recognition goes to the entire Kids Club team, who made our daughter’s experience truly unforgettable. Their warmth, creativity, and care with the children are remarkable, and it allowed us to relax knowing she was in excellent hands.

The hotel offers beautiful facilities, impeccable service, and the perfect atmosphere for a family vacation. We absolutely recommend this resort and hope to return again in the future.

Thank you to the entire team for making our vacation so special!

reviews.author: Caroline K
reviews.title: Luxurious beach front
reviews.text:
I have returned from an eight night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & SPA Resort.  This is a beautiful hotel within a stunning beachfront setting.   

My husband and I booked to stay in one of the Reserve rooms, which was lovely and spacious and felt very luxurious and well worth its 5 stars.  In addition to being adults only, the Reserve also benefits from having its own separate restaurant called Sante, which was our personal favourite (all the other restaurants were also very good).  There were also separate swimming pools, beautiful beach sunbeds/beach bar and to top it off our own private concierge for the duration of our stay which again is for the Reserve guests. 

This was our first time of experiencing a personal concierge and Eriol Alix was truly exceptional ensuring all our needs were met with restaurant bookings, daily activity updates, trips, taxis etc.  He was incredibly knowledgeable, professional and was just committed to ensuring that we were having a lovely holiday from the moment we arrived to even contacting us at the airport to wish us a safe flight home! This service, together with the upgraded amenities and facilities made the hotel feel very luxe and it felt we were in a more boutique section of the hotel being slightly separated from the bigger family side of the hotel.  The main hotel itself was at full capacity but it never felt crowded, chaotic with people scrambling for sunbeds in the mornings (which we have experienced at other hotels) and it also had a lovely relaxed atmosphere with plenty of amenities and restaurants. 

Staying in The Reserve ticked all our boxes, especially having Eriol as our concierge so we have already rebooked to return in February 2027 and of course will be requesting him as our concierge as his service was 10/10 !
