Staying in The Reserve ticked all our boxes, especially having Eriol as our concierge so we have already rebooked to return February 2027 and of course will be requesting Eriol as we would give him 10/10 !

reviews.author: Sylvie V
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: Spent 5 days at this hotel and all of the staff we encountered were excellent. Harry our concierge kept us informed. LeBron and aerial yoga team- thank you, what an amazing experience! And a very big thank you to Pedro at the beach, he made our vacation truly special,  he works so hard and always with a big smile. We really enjoyed the food and service at the Dominican restaurant.

reviews.author: JoAnn R
reviews.title: Amazing resort!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort that takes care of your every need! Our concierge Eriol was very helpful in any arrangements we needed and making our dinner reservations.  Rafael was also great and had a wonderful spot saved on the beach for us every day and also brought us delightful drinks! If you are traveling without children is definitely worth it to upgrade to the reserve side for adult only   rooms, pools and restaurants. There are plenty of great shaded beds to lounge in, the amenities are terrific! Book now, you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: josefr531
reviews.title: Tolles Resort am Bavaro Beach
reviews.text:
Lage   
Das Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort liegt ca. 25 min vom Flughafen Punta Cana entfernt, direkt am Bavaro Strand Abschnitt. Das Resort befindet sich in einem riesengroßen Areal mit mehreren Anlagen der Melia Hotel Gruppe.

Unser Zimmer lag im Gebäude 8 von ,The Reserve" im 1. Obergeschoß mit seitlichem  Meerblick. Leider wurde unser mehrmals deponierter Wunsch - ein Zimmer im 2. OG zu bekommen - nicht erfüllt. 
Und das, obwohl wir mehrere Monate - sowie auch kurz vor der Anreise - diese Bitte kommuniziert haben.
Möchten nicht kleinlich wirken, aber da die Bausubstanz alle Geräusche wie zB Sessel-Rücken, Stöckelschuhe und auch die nächtlichen Gang-Bewegungen wiedergibt, haben wir im Vorfeld um ein Zimmer im obersten Stockwerk ersucht, damit zumindest diese Lärmquelle von oben ausgeschlossen werden kann.
Der Melia Gold-Member Status hat leider nicht geholfen, dieser ist wertlos. Alle "The Reserve" Zimmer befinden sich im Bauteil 8 und 7 der Anlage.

Das Zimmer war modern eingerichtet (2022 renoviert) und natürlich sehr sauber. Es ist alles da, was man braucht und in dieser Kategorie erwartet. Optisch sehr schön u.a. eine freistehende Badewanne, Doppelwaschtisch, Regendusche, etc. Am Balkon gibt es 2 Schaukelstühle und einen kleinen Tisch.
Die Balkon Tür schließt recht gut - von außen dringt kaum Lärm ins Zimmer. Anders sieht das mit der Holz-Zimmertür aus, diese lässt den Gang Lärm ungefiltert durch.
Die Zimmerreinigung funktionierte hervorragend. Die Bettenqualität war sehr gut. Das WLAN im Zimmer war perfekt. Der Kühlschrank ist sehr leise und wird täglich aufgefüllt. Da gibt es nichts zu kritisieren.

Restaurants/Bars - All-In Konzept:
Service top - Danke an alle, Auswahl unglaublich, aber die Reservierungs Abwicklung sehr holprig.

The Lunch Box - Internationales Buffet - Spitzenklasse, extrem umfangreich, diverse Stationen und für ein Buffetrestaurant extrem vielfältig, mit hochwertigen Speisen.
Möbel sind leider alt und unbequem. Bahnhof ähnliches Gefühl kommt auf. Leider lassen Eltern ihren Kindern freien Lauf und das führt unweigerlich dazu, dass viele kleine Hände am Buffet "kosten". Desinfektionsspender würden im Buffetrestaurant bestimmt guten Dienst erweisen.

Sante - Exklusiv für "The Reserve" Gäste, keine Kinder. Frühstücks- und Mittagsbuffet und am Abend a la Carte. Super tolle Zubereitung und eine angenehme Atmosphäre, sowie ein professionelles Service.
Mina - Steakhouse. Sehr große Auswahl. Leider ist es immer sehr kalt und wenn viele Amis im Lokal sind, auch sehr laut.
Mascalzone - Italienisches Restaurant - perfekt. Lecker, umfangreiche Karte. Besser geht die italienische Küche nicht!
Tokimeku - Asiatische Küche - a la Carte und Show Cooking. U.a. Sushi in vielen Varianten - sehr gut. 
Blue Algave - Mexikanische Küche. Ebenfalls eine sehr umfangreiche Karte, authentische Atmosphäre und hervorragendes Service.
Kanna - an manchen Tagen auch am Abend offen - mit einer überschaubaren Speisekarte, aber dennoch sehr lecker und ein Freiluft-Restaurant. 

Flora - Dominikanische Küche - nicht besucht
The Winery - nicht besucht (kostenpflichtige Wein-Bar) 
Brisas - Circle Member only (Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner) - nicht besucht

Mit Ausnahme vom Buffetrestaurant The Lunch Box, ist am Abend eine Reservierung in den Themenrestaurants erforderlich. Diese funktioniert leider nicht gut....
The Reserve Gäste, welche einen Concierge Service mitbezahlen, müssen die Reservierungen via Concierge vornehmen. Ein täglicher Kampf mit Whatsapp-Nachfragen und emotional geführte Reklamationen waren die Folge. Auch eine Reklamation beim Management brachte keine Verbesserung. Warum müssen Gäste, welche für den Concierge Service bezahlen, als Art Bittsteller auftreten, damit die Reservierung in den Restaurants gemacht wird? Warum wird nicht, ein Reservierungs-Terminal - nur für The Reserve Gäste - aufgestellt oder warum kann man diesen Reservierungs-Wahnsinn nicht mit einer App erledigen... als Gast kann man das alles nicht verstehen. Bereits beim letzten Aufenthalt hatten wir Probleme mit diesen Reservierungen - verbessert hat sich leider überhaupt nichts. Negativ anzumerken ist auch, dass unser Concierge (Kelvin) 5 Tage vor unserer Abreise seinen Heimaturlaub angetreten hat, es sich aber kein anderer Concierge als Ersatz gemeldet hat und wir bezüglich Restaurant Reservierungen völlig alleine gelassen wurden. Da hinterfragt man schon die Sinnhaftigkeit des kostenpflichtigen Concierge Service.

Es gibt auch eine Menge an Bars / Lounges und einen Pub. Neu ist eine Nespresso Cafeteria mit verschiedenen Kaffeespezialitäten und kleine Mehlspeisen für zwischendurch. Super Kaffeespezialitäten gab es dort.

Strand
Einer der schönsten Strandabschnitte am Bavaro Beach. Weißer und beim Hotel breiter Sandstrand, der durch das vorgelagerte Riff vor hohen Wellen geschützt ist

Es gibt je nach Zimmerkategorie verschiedene Abschnitte am Strand mit unterschiedlichen Liegen bzw. Strandbetten. 

The Reserve Beach - Adults Only
Ein eigener Bereich, exklusiv für The Reserve Gäste - mit eigner Strandbar und Bar-Service. 
Liegen mit richtig dicken und sehr bequemen Auflagen sowie großen Schirmen sind ausreichend vorhanden, ebenso reichlich gibt es große Badetücher. Reservierungen werden leider oftmals von den Beachboys gegen kleine Scheine gemacht. Daher früh da sein und eine Liege sichern oder dann beim Trinkgeld großzügig sein, um einen schönen Platz zu bekommen. 
Das Bar Service ist ausgezeichnet.
Das WLAN am dortigen Strandbereich funktionierte viele Tage nicht gut. Für ein Resort dieser Kategorie sollten diese Probleme nicht auftreten. Gegen Ende unseres Aufenthalts und nach viel Kritik verbesserte sich die WLAN Verfügbarkeit.

Für die 6 Gebäude-Teile mit "Solo Adults" gibt es genau so einen eigenen Beach-Bereich, wie für Familien und für Circle Member. Tolle Abtrennung, am sehr weitläufigen Strandabschnitt.

Karibik ohne Seegras am Strand gibt es immer seltener. Punta Cana ist nicht verschont - einmal mehr, dann fast keines. Die Windrichtung und Strömung bestimmt die Menge an Seegras.
Im Hotelbereich der Melia Hotels, aber auch in den beiden Nachbarhotel wird sehr viel unternommen, damit das angeschwemmte Seegras schnell vom Strand entfernt wird. Das funktioniert mM hervorragend. Danke dafür für diese Leistung. Wir hatten Glück, Seegras gab es sehr wenig am Hotelstrand.

Problematisch sind jene Strandabschnitte, wo sich kein Hotel zuständig fühlt. Dort türmen sich an manchen Tagen Seegrasberge. Schaut schrecklich aus und riecht grauslich. Solange die lokalen Behörden hier nichts unternehmen, wird das von Jahr zu Jahr schlimmer. Die Frage ist, wann es den Touristen zu viel wird. Schnell ein Loch graben, wie es einige tun, Seegras rein und Sand drüber, hilft nur bis zur nächsten Flut. Dafür kann zwar Melia nichts, aber als sehr großer Arbeitgeber und auch Abgabenzahler, sollte der Druck auf die lokalen Behörden für eine schnellere Strandreinigung erhöht werden.

Positiv muss angemerkt werden, dass am Strandbereich von "The Reserve" (und der Beach Bar) keine laute Musik gespielt wird. Auch wurden die "Privat-Musik-Boxen" der Gäste verboten. Deshalb herrscht eine angenehme Atmosphäre und man kann das Rauschen der Wellen voll genießen.

Am Strand nerven die vielen Strandverkäufer. Ob Sonnenbrillen, Zigarren, Schmuck, Massagen, Ausflüge oder div. Souvenirs - irgendwer läuft immer an den Strandliegen vorbei und will etwas verkaufen. Handy & Co lässt man beim Sprung in die Wellen nur ungern auf der Liege zurück. Ich habe natürlich Verständnis, dass viele vom Verkauf div. Waren und Leistungen ihre Familien ernähren. 

Pools
Neben einem riesengroßen Hauptpool, gibt es einen großen Pool für Solo-Adults, Kinder-Pools und die beiden The Reserve Pools. Darüber hinaus gibt eine Reihe an Pools (Swim-Out) bei den Familien-Häusern (u.a. ein 100m Becken)
  
The Reserve Pools
Sowohl beim Gebäude 7, als auch bei 8, gibt es grosse Adults-only Pools, exklusiv für The Reserve Gäste, sowie ausreichend Liegen. Eine große Bar hilft den Durst zu löschen und die Amis können mit vollen Gläser Zeit im Pool verbringen.... ohne Glas in der Hand, gehen vermutlich die Amis nicht ins Wasser (bringen auch Getränke aufs WC und zum Strand mit...)

Auch an der Pool-Bar von The Reserve wird nur mit gemäßigter Lautstärke Musik gespielt (karibische Klänge). Wunderbar so.

Am Hauptpool wird man an grundlegenden Renovierungsarbeiten nicht herumkommen - hier sieht man die Jahre.... 
Die beiden Pools bei The Reserve und die Swim-Out Pools sind neu und wunderschön.

Kritisiert werden muss, dass die Toiletten beim neuen ,The Reserve" Pool extrem grauslich sind und viel zu selten gereinigt werden. Ein echter Schandfleck, unwürdig für dieses Resort. Natürlich tragen die männlichen Gäste wesentlich dazu bei, dass diese Toilette so extrem verdreckt wird.

Sport
Das GYM hat 24/7 offen - eine Verbesserung zu früher, als erst um 6 Uhr geöffnet wurde. Gut gemacht - Danke
Die Geräte sind leider schon sehr alt.

Bei den täglichen Aktivitäten gibt es u.a. um 9.30 Yoga. Leider wird Yoga am Strandbereich unter der Sonne abgehalten (nicht optimal, weil es überhaupt keinen Schatten gibt). 

Etwas unglücklich fanden wir den Zeitpunkt vom Wasser-GYM. 12:30 Uhr, also mit Beginn des Mittagessen. Dazu kommt, dass diese Aktivitäten in der unmittelbaren Nähe des "Sante" Restaurant stattfanden und dort manch musikbegeisterte Vorturner für unnötigen Lärm beim Mittagessen sorgte. Wenn das Wasser-GYM etwas früher beginnen würde, würden mehr Teilnehmer motiviert werden und die Gäste können im Sante Restaurant in Ruhe Mittagessen.

Unterhaltung
Am zentralen Plaza Colonial gibt es täglich am Abend Live Musik. Dort ist immer was los... Ebenfalls Live Musik gibt es in der Ginger Bar, wo es auch sehr leckere Cocktails gibt. Vermisst haben wir Shows - zB den kleinen Faschingsumzug, diesen gab es früher. Anzumerken möchte ich an dieser Stelle, dass während unseres Aufenthalts immer große Firmenevents stattgefunden haben, daher vermutlich das Live Angebot etwas eingeschränkt wurde (zu wenig Zuschauer..)

Das YHI SPA haben wir nicht besucht - fanden wir extrem hochpreisig.

reviews.author: MATIAS MARTIN A... F
reviews.title: Descanso y relax en Paradisus
reviews.text: Excelente hotel para relajarse y descansar. Muy buenas instalaciones, deliciosa comida y un trato muy especial de todo su personal.

reviews.author: Patrick C
reviews.title: Excellent Trip
reviews.text:
My family and I just spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real and had a great experience overall.
The rooms were excellent—spacious, well laid out, and comfortable, with a separate bedroom and living area. The main pool is large and lively, but there are also several smaller pools if you’re looking for something quieter. The beach was beautiful and active, and the all‑inclusive setup was a real bonus. Service throughout the resort was consistently good.
Breakfast and lunch were mostly buffet‑based, and after a day or two you quickly find a rhythm that works. Dinner is a bit different: there are several restaurants, but reservations are required and they fill up fast. Our concierge, Rosmery de Jesus, was fantastic and made a huge difference. One tip is to download WhatsApp and exchange numbers—it made communication much easier. Rosmery was able to secure dinner reservations for us, which was no small feat, and every restaurant we visited was excellent and a lot of fun.
You can take a golf cart to the Rafa Nadal Tennis Center, which is a brand‑new and excellent addition. We played at night under the lights and also did morning drills with a pro. There’s also an off‑campus spa that’s easily accessible by golf cart.
All in all, it was a great experience and I would definitely go back. Being so well taken care of by Rosmery made the trip even better.

reviews.author: Connector733291
reviews.title: Muy Agradable
reviews.text: limpio , bonito , agradable. atencion super personal muy atento habitacion muy comodasen general fue una buena esperiencia

reviews.author: romeunetonr
reviews.title: Noivado
reviews.text: O resort foi perfeito desde a hora da chegada ate o momento da saida, me sentir totalmente em casa com toda a recepção e atendimento de todos q trabalhando no hotel, otimos profissionais desde do mais baixo ate o mais de cima, em especial o professor de dança Fernando, que ensinou eu e minha noiva a dancar de um modo muito facil, e todas as duvidas de lugares ou algo que precisamos sempre muito prestativo para qualquer coisa mesmo nao sendo a area dele.

reviews.author: Damaris p
reviews.title: Cabana at kanna beach club
reviews.text: Kanna beach club is amazing. The service I received from Enrique was legendary, he catered to my every need. I appreciate the attentiveness suggestions. If you come to Palma REAL..RENT A CANBANA and ask for Enrique.  You will not be disappointed

reviews.author: Nico R
reviews.title: SATISFACCION TOTAL
reviews.text: El hotel fue un gran lugar para descsanar y aprovechar de todos los servivios que incluye, el trato del personal fue bueno y resolvian todas las inquietudes.

reviews.author: Joli A
reviews.title: Wonderful Trip for Couples!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Royale. We stayed in a Reserve reservation for adults only and had Christopher as our personal concierge. Christopher was professional, kind, and available for anything we needed inclusive of dinner reservations, check in and checkout processes, and just general questions as needed! 

We’d love to stay again and would love to have Chris as our “spiritual guide” once again!

reviews.author: MS
reviews.title: Domican Republic doesn't disappoint!
reviews.text: What a great first visit to the Dominican Republic! Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is a beautiful resort with tons of included activities.  To name a few we did: exercises on the beach or in the pool, dance lessons, wine tasting, rum tasting, mamajuana tasting (!!!!!), local art and craft activities/history lessons (statue painting, hat painting, Larimar polishing).  Our room had a bit of a leak under the tub but they fixed it relatively swiftly and thanked us for our inconvenience with a bottle of champagne and a tray of sweet treats in our room.  We paid for messages at the spa which are def a bit high priced but a nice way to spend time. The best upgrade we made to our trip however was splurging on the concierge.   Adriel was a great host and kept us updated on all the activities on the resort as well as booking all of our dinners at the restaurants.  If we wanted anything or had any questions he was just a message away.  We also celebrated my birthday while we were there and Adriel set up with the restaurant we at at that evening to make me a cake and sing to me.  It was very special and such a sweet gesture.   We had a great time and hope we can come back soon!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations!
reviews.text: Paradisus Punta Cana is an amazing all inclusive resort. The accommodations are top notch.  All the staff are friendly and super helpful. We were lucky enough to have Jaleidi Sims for our concierge. She was very attentive and able to get our family into their restaurants each night we were there. We were celebrating an occasion and Yaleidi made sure to recognize it with decorating our room.  The resort is beautiful and feels first class.   The restaurant service, food, and ambience all felt upscale. The pools, and pool side service were great. The beach and the set up with the thatch umbrellas were perfect too. We plan to go back next year.

reviews.author: alejaurrego15
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text: Me llama la atención que hallan comentarios malos de este hotel, ha sido de las mejores experiencias de mi vida, las habitaciones, la atención, la comida, los servicios, todo fue de una experiencia de alto nivel. Fuimos muy felices

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text: Great experience with great service. Our concierge Eriol was super helpful!

reviews.author: robsapp18
reviews.title: 25th anniversary
reviews.text: Alam was fantastic. The pool bartenders and beach bartenders (especially Gilberto) are amazing. We want to come back in November.

reviews.author: Paola B
reviews.title: Excelente fin de semana en familia
reviews.text:
Fuimos de fin de semana largo con la familia, nuestra estadía definitivamente quedó marcada como memorable por las excelentes atenciones de Juan Peña de Guest Services, quien hizo que nosotros como nuestros hijos sintiéramos disfrutáramos de la mejor experiencia dentro de nuestro propio país. 
Las instalaciones del hotel están en excelentes condiciones y las áreas son bastante amplias, pudimos disfrutar del parque de agua para los niños y del parque de atracciones Fun Republic algo muy distinto a lo que normalmente se acostumbra.
Sin duda regresaríamos.

reviews.author: Sarah2345636
reviews.title: Gracias Gilberto!
reviews.text: Gilberto at the beach bar is the absolute best. We will be coming back just for him!! Gracias Gilberto

reviews.author: DrShelley
reviews.title: Punta Cana Virgins!
reviews.text: Absolutely loved our experience. Our first time to Punta Cana. The staff was fabulous. The food fantastic. The beach beautiful and ocean warm. Loved the yoga/stretch classes on the beach. Our VIP concierge Christopher was awesome. Super helpful and friendly. Loved the fresh coconuts and pina coladas at the Beach bar Fahrenheit too and the morning coffee/cappuccino at the coffee shop. The gym was great and entertainment was good too. Overall a wonderful first time experience for us.

reviews.author: laledermeier
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Everything was great once we understood the restaurant reservations. That was not explained to us.  The check in process could have gone smoother.

reviews.author: Caroline C
reviews.title: Outstanding Resort
reviews.text: The name truly describes this hotel… an absolute paradise. Gorgeous beaches, amazing food choices(6 restaurants) professional, courteous staff, beautiful grounds, and great entertainment every night.

reviews.author: Olivia W
reviews.title: We would come back in heartbeat!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time & would go back in a heart beat!! We stayed on the reserve side(adults only). From a smooth check in process to not having to think about any dinner plans, to a stress free checkout our concierge Yaleidi Sims made our trip one to remember!! We went for our honeymoon and it was the perfect resort for a relaxing time together. The resort was very clean, the staff were all very friendly, and pools & beach were breathtaking. Would highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: brooks7100
reviews.title: Highly Recommend for your next vacation destination
reviews.text:
We had an amazing girls trip at the Paradisus Palma Real. It was beautiful & very clean & spacious. Adriel, our concierge, was top notch!
He was so attentive & helped us with anything we needed. He went above & beyond & was very friendly. He even decorated our friend's room for her birthday making it extra special. Raphael, our beach concierge, had our beach chairs set up every morning with fresh towels. He waited on us throughout the day. Cooper & Fernando with activities were so much fun. They taught us how to dance & were very personable & friendly. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND this for your next vacation destination.

reviews.author: Jan Vincent
reviews.title: AN AMAZING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: The resort is outstanding and our dedicated concierge Point of Contact Ana Azcona did an amazing job of keeping us informed of ongoing and upcoming events, restaurant reservations, and answered all of our questions.

reviews.author: lunalondra
reviews.title: Perfect week at Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and immaculate. The beach is beautiful and the restaurants were all very good. Our concierge Anayely took care of all our needs to perfection. She booked all our reservations and kept us up to date on all the activities available. On the beach we met a lovely young lady by the name of Yasmailin who went above and beyond every day to bring us drinks. When we arrived every day she brought us a bucket of water without us even asking and kept refilling it with ice. She always had a smile and was a pleasure to talk to. She works very hard on the beach but always has a smile. All the people here are very friendly. Can’t wait to return next year!

reviews.author: Keri B
reviews.title: Exceptional Service and Unforgettable Memories
reviews.text:
Our girls’ group stayed in The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real, and the ocean views were absolutely gorgeous. Our concierge, Adriel, was attentive to every detail of our stay and truly went above and beyond to make our trip memorable. He also surprised us with thoughtful, special touches throughout our stay that made the experience feel extra special and unforgettable.

The entire staff was warm, helpful, and accommodating, and even the other guests were kind and friendly, which added to the welcoming atmosphere. We especially looked forward to learning fun dances each day from Cooper and Fernando — they brought so much energy and joy to our experience!

We also took the catamaran tour offered by the resort, and it was amazing. When I realized I had forgotten my shoes, Cooper kindly stayed with my friend and me while we walked all the way back to retrieve them. He took excellent care of us and made us feel completely comfortable.

Rafael took wonderful care of our group on the beach every day. He always had our chairs set up and even remembered our favorite drinks, bringing them to us each morning after we arrived. All of these gentlemen made us feel genuinely welcomed and cared for throughout our stay.

This was a girls’ trip, but I would absolutely bring my family back to Paradisus Palma Real. Our experience was outstanding!

reviews.author: Melinda Y
reviews.title: Best girls trip
reviews.text: We had the best girls trip! The resort is absolutely stunning and the staff went above and beyond. Our Concierge was Adriel and he was truly amazing. It felt like we were the only ones he was taking care of, because he was so fast at getting back to us and taking care of request. Our beach concierge was Raphael and he also was amazing. He took such great care of us while we were at the beach. He always had our chairs ready and made sure we were hydrated. 😜 Both men were gentlemen, friendly and also so fun. Cooper from entertainment was a favorite. He made a point to include us in the fun activities. He really went above and beyond as well. Walked back with my friend and I to the catamaran when my friend forgot her shoes to make sure we found them and got back to the resort safely.

reviews.author: Mayra M
reviews.title: Experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text:
Un saludo especial  para el Chef Hugo Gómez, Carlos y su equipo que  hicieron nuestra estadía inolvidable.
Soy celiaca y me dieron una atención impecable, siempre atentos, predispuestos a ayudar y cocinándome con conciencia.
100% recomendable

reviews.author: lucero_chirinos
reviews.title: Estados en Paradisus Palma Real Meliá
reviews.text: La experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real fue genial, es la segunda vez que me hospedo aquí y no tengo ninguna queja! La atención de Rosanna en la playa fue increíble, súper amable y muy alegre! Siempre pendiente de nosotros! Fue una experiencia inolvidable! Lo recomiendo al 100%!

reviews.author: Carlos Ramírez
reviews.title: La mejor margarita de mando de Punta Cana
reviews.text: En la playa hay una estación de Margaritas, tienen que pedir la Margarita de Mango, es la mejor de la historia y las chicas que lo hacen son súper amables, me acuerdo de Raysa y Dilenia, son los máximo.

reviews.author: Addie Y
reviews.title: We had a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real!!
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real! From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations.

A huge shoutout to our concierge, Adriel, who truly went above and beyond to make our trip unforgettable. We were celebrating a birthday, and he made it so special with thoughtful surprises and beautiful touches for the birthday girl. He was incredibly attentive, kind, and always made sure we had everything we needed. His attention to detail did not go unnoticed!

Our beach helper, Rafael, was also fantastic. Every day he had our beach chairs perfectly set up and made sure our drinks were always full. He was friendly, attentive, and made relaxing on the beach effortless.

And we can’t forget Cooper and Fernando! They brought so much energy and fun to our stay. Their personalities were infectious, and they truly made the experience even more enjoyable. We looked forward to seeing them every day!

The service, atmosphere, and staff at Paradisus Palma Real made this a trip we will never forget. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Matthew D
reviews.title: Great team out on the beach!

reviews.text: We had an absolutely wonderful time. Zanovia Nova was our personal Concierge. Zanovia saw to it that every detail of our 4 day trip was filled with convenience and professionalism.  We look forward to her being our guide again when we return.

reviews.author: Randy L
reviews.title: Sunshine, sand, surf and beach chairs.  Do you need more?
reviews.text:
After 3 years, my wife and I were finally able to make a winter get-away from the frozen wasteland we live in.  This resort was one of the options in the Costco travel plans.  Once we finally arrived, it was good to feel the breeze and smell the ocean air. The first few days were stromy and the beach was not a good option, but that settled down pretty quickly. Sargassum on the beach was cleained up every day, so getting sand between the toes happened. Our room was well appointed, we were in the adults-only section.  Housekeeping came daily and did a great job keeping things stocked and clean.  Our room was on the opposite side of the building from the pool, so it was generally quiet, which is what we both wanted.  Overall, the price was worth the experience.

I just want to give a huge thumbs-up to Jendry, our concierge.  He met us at our arrival and made it his business to look after any questions or concerns that we might have.  He looked after all the dinner reservations and got us repeat visits to ones we really enjoyed.  I wished I could have stayed longer because of his attention to details.

reviews.author: clara d
reviews.title: 5 stars!
reviews.text: I spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real resort and I loved it! The service was great, the hotel is beautiful and really close to the beach! The restaurants are really good and the resort offers a lot of different activities to do during the day.

reviews.author: MM
reviews.title: Volveremos
reviews.text: En este hotel hemos vivido una de las mejores experiencias vividas en un hotel. Por supuesto, el hotel, sus instalaciones y su ubicación, hacen de esta propiedad, un lugar único. Pero, si pudiera quedarme con algo, sería con el trato recibido por el excelente personal de este hotel. En especial, me gustaría destacar a 2 personas, que fueron más allá del servicio: nuestra destination concierge, Yaleidi, quién dedicó una atención y un nivel de detalle que nunca había visto y; Yuderi, quién fue capaz de sacarnos una sonrisa en cada interacción. Su trabajo y dedicación es síntoma del éxito de este hotel y esperamos que se sepa reconocer tal y como es debido. Otras personas que no podía dejarme sin Pedro, por supuesto, Jimbert, la barista Katherine y Enrique en Kanna. Enhorabuena a todos por su EXCELENTE servicio.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Vacation in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We had such a lovely experience at the resort in Punta Cana, and a big part of that was thanks to Dana, the animateur. She was absolutely fantastic – always smiling, full of energy, and genuinely spreading good mood wherever she went.

Dana has this natural way of making guests feel welcome and included without being pushy. Whether it was activities, casual chats, or just her positive presence around the pool, she really elevated the whole atmosphere of the resort. You can tell she truly enjoys her job and cares about guests having a great time.

It’s people like Dana who make a vacation feel special and memorable. Her enthusiasm, friendliness, and professionalism did not go unnoticed.

Thank you, Dana, for making our stay even more fun and full of great vibes – you’re a real asset to the resort!

reviews.author: Jewell C
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time and will absolutely be back. This is such a great place for kids and families. The food was surprisingly good for an all inclusive resort, with plenty of options for everyone.

What truly made our trip exceptional was our concierge, Zenovia. She handled all of our dinner reservations and went above and beyond for everything we needed. She was attentive, kind, and truly elevated our entire experience. I honestly would only return if they promised to assign her to us again.

I highly recommend this resort, especially for families. One of the highlights of our trip was swimming with the dolphins. It was clean, safe, well organized, and so much fun. It was unforgettable.

We also loved how many activities were available for the kids. There was always something for them to do, which made the trip relaxing and enjoyable for everyone.

We cannot wait to come back.

And the BEST servoce and pina frescas EVER from Julia at the 6012 building and finally the Kanna beach service, drinks and food were perfect 10 all made possible by Yasmeilan. reviews.author: Ben P
reviews.title: We've been to 6 different resorts over the years, and this is our favoriate!
reviews.text:
This is the second time my extended family has come to stay at this resort, and it absolutely will not be our last.  We LOVE it here.  We feel like this resort provides the best value for our money of anywhere we have ever stayed.  It does everything well - the food is great, the beach is awesome, the facilities are nice, and we love being able to go for walks through the neighboring resorts to stretch our legs.  

The entire staff was great, but we have to give credit to some of the folks we talked to the most!
- Kelvin, our concierge, was always very friendly and attentive, without it feeling like he was being over the top and showering us with unnecessary platitudes.  Basically, he was great, and felt like a "real" person and not a robot reciting required lines.  It was great!
- Raphael on the reserve beach was incredible again this year.  He was super friendly, attentive, and did a great job the entire time we were there. 
- Luis at the Flora bar was fun.  I don't think his English was all that great (though I am absolutely not judging him for this... it's the Dominican Republic and I don't speak Spanish so I have no room to talk!!) I asked him what his favorite drink to make was, and he made a couple "special" drinks for my family over a few nights.  They were REALLY good - my favorite even - though I don't know what they were because he just grinned and says "Luis Special!"

I have to do a better job paying remembering names next time - because so many other staff members were great and deserve praise.  For example, the waitress who worked in the sports bar but would serve drinks in the courtyard in the evenings was super great - so friendly to our family.  She always had a huge smile and gave my parents hugs and called my dad "papa!" excitedly.  She was a real gem.  

We will absolutely be back, and really, really appreciate the hard work from the entire staff!!

reviews.author: Katrin P
reviews.title: Flawless experience
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Reserve was absolutely outstanding, and choosing a swim-up room made the experience truly unforgettable. The room was spacious, beautifully designed, spotless, and having direct access to the pool was pure luxury — peaceful, private, and perfect for relaxing at any time of day.

What truly elevated our stay, however, was the concierge service, especially Eriol, who went above and beyond in every possible way. From the very beginning, he was attentive, professional, and incredibly kind. He handled all of our reservations seamlessly, checked in on us regularly, and always made sure every detail of our stay was perfect. His responsiveness and genuine care made us feel truly valued and taken care of.

The resort itself is stunning — lush grounds, excellent restaurants, beautiful pools, and a calm, upscale atmosphere throughout. Everything was well organized, and the staff across the property were consistently friendly and welcoming.

This was a flawless vacation experience, and we would absolutely return — specifically requesting a swim-up room with concierge service again. A special thank you to Eriol for making our stay exceptional and memorable. Highly recommended!

He was wonderful with making recommendations, helped with all of our dinner reservations, even set us up with a personalized excursion. He checked in with us every day and attended to every question or need we had.

You also have to pay court fees at Nadal tennis center for tennis or pickleball.  Despite that, we still have a marvellous experience and will definitely wanted to go back.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: We just got back from a week at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. We stayed on the adults only reserve side which was fantastic. Our concierge Jendry went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. He even decorated our room for our anniversary. Luis at the Ginger bar made us the best martinis. I was impressed with how clean the resort was even the common area bathrooms were tidy. The layout of the hotel made it feel open but everything was just a short walk from our room. The adults only side was quiet and relaxing but if you wanted more activity you could go over to the main pool. There were always chairs available at the pool and the beach so I never felt like I had to get out there at 6 am to reserve spots. I can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Sergi Vilaró
reviews.title: Cuando el servicio lo es todo
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real ha sido, sin duda, la mejor experiencia que hemos vivido jamás en un hotel. Servicio, gastronomía, ubicación e instalaciones… todo estuvo a un nivel impecable.

Llegamos muy tarde la primera noche y Aldo nos atendió con una amabilidad excepcional (y casualmente también nos realizó el check-out el último día). Supo entender perfectamente que estábamos cansados, nos ofreció ayuda con el equipaje y nos propuso opciones de room service por si queríamos cenar algo. Ese tipo de sensibilidad marca la diferencia desde el primer momento.

Al día siguiente conocimos a las dos personas que elevaron nuestra estancia a algo realmente superior. Yaleidi, nuestra Destination Concierge, nos dejó un detalle de bienvenida precioso, nos ofreció un tour completo por el hotel, gestionó todas nuestras reservas y nos dio recomendaciones muy útiles para disfrutar al máximo. El nivel de cuidado, detalle y cariño con el que trata a sus huéspedes es motivo de orgullo para cualquier compañía.

Y Yuderi, en el bar de la playa The Reserve, fue simplemente excepcional. Desde el primer día su cercanía, conversación y constante preocupación por que todos estuvieran bien atendidos hicieron que la playa y ese bar se convirtieran en nuestro lugar favorito. No éramos los únicos: era el espacio del que mejor hablaban otros huéspedes.

También queremos mencionar a Jimbert y Estebani en el buffet principal; Pedro, Rafael y Gilbert en el bar de la playa; Misael en Santé; nuestra barista favorita Katherine; y Jenifer, Franklin y Zenovia, con quienes quizás interactuamos menos, pero cuyo servicio fue siempre excelente.

La gastronomía, en general, fue increíble. Destacaríamos solo dos puntos más flojos: Mascalzone, que nos resultó decepcionante tratándose de algo tan sencillo como pasta y pizza, y el restaurante de sushi, tanto en la experiencia teppanyaki como a la carta. En contraste, el resto de restaurantes, incluido el buffet, ofrecieron una calidad y variedad realmente sobresalientes.

Por último, housekeeping fue impecable. Tanto las zonas comunes como los baños y nuestra habitación estuvieron siempre a la altura de las expectativas.

Volveremos al 100%. Y lo decimos con ilusión, porque más allá de las instalaciones, lo que hace especial a este hotel son las personas que forman parte de él. Ya estamos deseando volver a verlas.

We really liked the servers in all the restaurants and enjoyed being served by them again. We had a very positive experience at this resort and would go back.

reviews.author: PoppyP
reviews.title: The honeymoon of dreams!
reviews.text:
Where to start..my husband and I spent two wonderful weeks here for our honeymoon and made memories to last a lifetime. This resort is incredible. Just arriving in the lobby takes your breath away and this really set the tone for our holiday. We completely switched off and felt at home from day 1. Every inch of the resort is spotlessly clean and so well maintained.

We paid to be part of The Reserve which came with a number of benefits, the main being staying in a more secluded area, where we had an ocean view suite. And ocean view meant just that - I will never forget the view waking up every day - just breathtaking. It was also lovely to be just a stroll from the pool areas and the beach, where there were plenty of sunbeds to choose from. Thank you to our concierge Kelvin, too - who took care of restaurant reservations and was generally on hand to help throughout our stay. 

The food - just wow. The buffet at The Lunch Box had everything you could wish for, so fresh and always full. The fresh fruit at breakfast, crepe and omelette stations were amazing. Our favourite time to eat there was lunch. The variety and quality of the food served is just incredible. During the busier spots, there could be a few more servers making sure water is being served as a couple of times we had to wait a while to be noticed. The restaurants are also great, we especially enjoyed the Mina steakhouse.

Other highlights included - the spa.. we paid extra but the aromatherapy massage was so worth it. 
The hydrotherapy facilities at Melia Zel - this was amazing. The facilities were first class, from steam room, sauna, jacuzzi, hot stones. A real treat.
Boat trip/yoga - although we unfortunately were not able to dock to do yoga on the beach, the boat trip and natural pool was great.
Parasailing - again a paid extra but a great experience and organised seamlessly through the Otium team.
Evening entertainment/pop-up bars/Kicks sports bar - so nice to get dressed up, have a few cocktails and a dance!

We book an excursion to Santo Domingo through Otium, although this was a little disappointing. A lot more travelling than we were initially told and not much information provided on the tour. We wouldn't recommend this trip.

We have the most special memories from this trip and would recommend Paradisus Palma Real in a heartbeat. Thank you for an incredible stay!

reviews.title: Experiencia fantástica para repetir
reviews.text:
Acabamos de regresar de nuestras vacaciones en el Hotel Palma Real y no podemos estar más satisfechos. Desde las instalaciones a la playa todo ha cumplido con nuestras expectativas, pero si algo ha transformado un "buen viaje" en una experiencia extraordinaria, ha sido sin duda el factor humano.
El corazón del hotel: Dana y Johan (Pollito)
Queremos hacer una mención especial y poner por todo lo alto a dos personas que son auténticos diamantes para este hotel: Dana y Johan (cariñosamente conocido como "Pollito").
 * Dana: Es pura energía y dulzura. Tiene un don especial para conectar con la gente, siempre con una sonrisa genuina y una disposición increíble. Logra que todo el mundo se sienta integrado y con ganas de participar, transmitiendo una alegría que se contagia desde primera hora de la mañana con un carisma que ilumina el hotel.
 * Johan (Pollito): ¡Qué crack! Es el alma del hotel. Su simpatía y sensibilidad no tiene límites y su capacidad para hacernos  disfrutar es digna de admirar. Es un profesional como la copa de un pino, amable, atento y sensible.

Sinceramente, el nivel de profesionalidad y cercanía de ambos es difícil de encontrar. Se nota que aman su trabajo y se desviven porque cada huésped se lo pase en grande. El hotel tiene mucha suerte de contar con ellos; son, sin duda, el motivo principal por el que ya estamos planeando nuestra vuelta.

¡Gracias por todo, volveremos pronto!

reviews.author: Mandy
reviews.title: Truly Exceptional Care
reviews.text:
I was incredibly lucky to have Alan/Alam as my concierge during my stay. From the moment I arrived, he was a steady, warm, and genuinely reassuring presence — the kind of person who makes you feel completely taken care of without ever being intrusive.

Near the end of my trip, there was a brief logistical mix-up, and although it wasn’t the hotel’s or his responsibility, he handled it with such calm professionalism and kindness that it completely diffused any stress. He made everything feel smooth and manageable.

What stood out most was how naturally attentive he was — checking in, anticipating needs, and making me feel genuinely looked after. It felt less like a standard concierge experience and more like having someone you could fully trust to be in your corner. That sense of care made my entire stay better.

The hotel is very lucky to have him. He’s a natural at what he does, and I truly hope to return and have him as my concierge again. A wonderful and memorable part of my trip.
