reviews.author: Gabriel S
reviews.title: A Personalized Luxurious Experience For the Entire Family
reviews.text:
My family and I have been traveling to Punta Cana every January for the past five years. We have stayed at several resorts and experienced many beautiful properties, but Paradisus Palma Real is the one we return to again and again.

From the moment you arrive, you feel that this resort offers something special. The grounds are stunning, elegant, and immaculately maintained. The pools are expansive, the beach is beautiful, and the atmosphere is calm, luxurious, and welcoming. Yet what truly sets Paradisus Palma Real apart is not only the property — it is the extraordinary level of personal service.

Upon arrival, we were assigned a personal guest concierge, Ana Azcona, and she was absolutely exceptional. Ana immediately expedited our room assignment and ensured that our arrival was smooth and stress-free. Although we arrived prior to official check-in time, she arranged for our wristbands right away, had our luggage safely stored, and encouraged us to enjoy lunch and the pool so our vacation could begin immediately.

Once our room was ready, Ana personally followed up to confirm that we were happy with the room location and setup. Shortly afterward, she surprised our family with a generous selection of snacks and drinks delivered directly to our room;  a thoughtful gesture that made our children especially happy and made us feel genuinely welcomed.

Throughout our entire stay, Ana Azcona checked in with us regularly, always making sure that every detail was perfect. She arranged all of our specialty restaurant reservations, coordinated our plans, and provided her personal mobile number so we could reach her at any time by phone or text. Every request was handled quickly, graciously, and with sincere care. Her warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail elevated our vacation into a true luxury experience that felt completely personal.

One of the most meaningful aspects of our stay was how beautifully the resort accommodated our family’s kosher dietary requirements, something that can often be difficult when traveling. We were introduced to the head chef, Chef Pedro, whose dedication and kindness were truly remarkable.

Chef Pedro personally provided me with a brand-new frying pan and utensils, asked me to keep them in our room, and instructed me to bring them with me to each meal and specifically request him. He carefully sourced kosher ingredients for my approval and then prepared our meals fresh in front of me, ensuring full transparency and complete comfort. His professionalism, patience, and genuine desire to make sure our family could dine comfortably allowed us to relax and fully enjoy every meal together.

Because of Chef Pedro, our dietary needs were never a concern — they were treated with respect, dignity, and care.

We choose Punta Cana for our annual family vacation and have many resorts available to us, but we continue to return to Paradisus Palma Real because of people like Ana Azcona and Chef Pedro. From the moment we arrived until the moment we left for the airport, they truly pampered us and made us feel valued and appreciated.

not only is this a beautiful resort; it is a place where hospitality is genuine, service comes from the heart, and families are made to feel at home.

Thank you, Paradisus Palma Real,  and especially Ana Azcona and Chef Pedro,  for creating memories our family will cherish forever.

We are already counting the days until our next visit.

reviews.author: Liliana V
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia por paradisus palma real ha sido increíble
Desde que me levanto y voy al desayuno nos está esperando Luciana, Rocío y jimbert grandes profesionales que gracias a ellos no nos ha faltado ningún detalle.
Si quieres coger la reserva de cena tenemos a floranlly una chica muy risueña y divertida ella me hacía reír todas las mañanas y me facilitaba todo lo que necesitaba.
En nuestra animación encontrarás a unos autenticos bailarines de bachata y salsa donde disfrutaras de cada momentos.
ellos son dana, Joan (el pollito pío), Fernando, Jairo y angery
Si quieres una noche lleno de espectáculo tenemos a nuestros gran asesores Miguelito y guander (la pantera negra) ellos llevan cocobongo te lo gestionan todo.
Información del hotel para el círculo tenemos a Carlos Alberto,Jaime, Rosmery ellos te asesoran muy bien en lo que necesites.
El servicio de habitación siempre muy atento,la habitación muy limpia y no faltaba ningún detalle gracias a esa chica tan trabajadora 😘☺️
Si queréis unos buenos cócteles tenemos a los grandes profesionales a parte de ser buenos profesionales son grandes personas donde esperas para la cena ellos te dan toda la alegría y gran amabilidad ellos son manuela,José, Víctor y Miguel.
Me queda por mencionar a esos cócteleros y camareros de la piscina
Luis, Víctor,Rosanna,dilania,Eddy, Jonathan y jorge gracias por todo
Para la cena hay muy buenos restaurantes está el mina, sushi,tempayaki, mexicano y comida dominicana.
La verdad que todos super ricos y la atención de los restaurantes son espectaculares
En mina que es el de carne quiero mencionar a celia y junio que fueron los que más nos atendieron y la chica de la entrada fue súper amable mi último día me facilito para poder ir a cenar a mina. gracias.
También quiero agradecer la atención a la chica de sushi una chica morenita pelo corto rizadito ella nos atendió el primer día toda una profesional.
Creo que en este hotel todos son profesionales me voy enamorada con cada uno de ellos,me he sentido acogida,arropada.
Gracias por todo , gracias por el gran servicio que dais
Trabajar cara al público no es fácil y dar el cariño que dais y el trato tampoco pero me voy con una nostalgia.
Espero veros pronto.
Gracias a todos que hacéis que unas vacaciones sea algo más que eso.
Besos para todos 😘❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Marla I
reviews.title: Mélia is a trusted name for an amazing vacation!
reviews.text: Overall a really great resort, especially for adults and couples. Quiet, relaxing, great pools, great service and very good food. We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Christine C
reviews.title: Fun time in Punta Cana!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed for a week in mid January. The hotel is absolutely beautiful. We had a junior swim up suite. Loved the fact that we had our own private patio pool side. We stayed in building 50. Perfect location. The pool bar was directly in front of our unit. Jose was our bartender all week. He was awesome. Drinks were delicious and he took care of his customers. The 5 restaurants on site that you need nightly reservations for were all amazing. Food was perfectly proportioned. The buffet you can eat all day long and those food options were never ending. So much to choose from. 

Big thank you to our concierge Ana. She was amazing. Anything we needed plus more she made sure our experience was unforgettable.

reviews.author: Agnes B
reviews.title: Beach getaway
reviews.text: We had great time! Service was very good. Our concierge Alam made all of our dinner reservations and checked-in daily. This made our trip stress free.  Reserve Beach side was beautiful with plenty of beach chairs in shade and sun. Coffee is excellent at the Ginger Bar with very friendly staff. It was a great beach vacation!

reviews.author: Silvina
reviews.title: Excelente estadía !!! Gran hotel !!
reviews.text: Excelente estadía !! Estuvimos alojados en el área The Reserve Habitación 7106. Vale la pena el costo extra. Nuestro consierge Eriol se ocupó muy bien y de manera muy cordial y eficiente de la reserva de los restaurantes y actividades diarias. Los restaurantes son excelentes. La playa también. Las tumbonas de otro nivel!!. El bar de playa la atención no es buena, lo hice saber. Lo demás todo brillante!!. Volveremos !!

reviews.author: ericavarela20
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: The honeymoon was amazing. The place and food is really amazing but the service is exceptional. Thanks to the concierges: Harry M. & Ana Azcon, the bartenders: Luis (pool bar) & Jorge (ginger bar), the buffet servers: Jimbert & Rocio, the therapists: Iro & Alba and the merengue instructor Carlos. They have made our stay even better. We will come back for sure!

reviews.author: Nicolas T
reviews.title: Estadía perfecta
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia en este hotel fue simplemente excelente. Desde el primer momento nos hicieron sentir cuidados y atendidos en cada detalle.
El hotel es realmente de lujo, con instalaciones impecables, habitaciones amplias y cómodas, y un entorno paradisíaco. Todo está pensado para relajarse y disfrutar.
La comida fue riquísima, con muchísima variedad y una calidad sobresaliente, tanto en los restaurantes buffet como en los restaurantes a la carta. Cada comida fue una experiencia distinta y siempre de primer nivel.
Queremos hacer una mención especial para nuestra concierge Ana, que fue absolutamente excepcional. Su amabilidad, profesionalismo, predisposición y calidez marcaron la diferencia en nuestra estadía. Siempre atenta, resolutiva y con una sonrisa, hizo que nuestra experiencia fuera aún mejor. Realmente un lujo contar con alguien así.
Sin dudas, volveríamos y recomendamos este hotel al 100%. Una experiencia inolvidable en Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Roam32449938265
reviews.title: Excelente semana en Palma Real
reviews.text: Excelente semana de vacaciones en Paradisus Palma Real. Atencion excedente de todo el personal, en particular de RossMary que estuvo siempre atenta a nuestras necesidades. Muy buen nivel en comidas, bebidas y animación. Volveremos

reviews.author: jo b
reviews.title: Muy buena experiencia
reviews.text: Muy buena experiencia en el hotel, muy contentos con nuestro conserje Alam y el personal de animación, habitaciones muy bonitas

reviews.author: Larry W
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text:
Very nice resort very nice people we 
had a great time for 5 days 
thanks to Basilio for the wonderful service

reviews.author: Andrea N
reviews.title: Gran atención en el buffet
reviews.text:
Increíble atención de todos los chicos! 
Siempre alegres y con mucha cordialidad, fueron un gran alivio para mí y mi familia y mi hijo Dante disfruto mucho de su amistad.
Gracias Rocio, Rood, Jilbert y Romeris por su paciencia y atención! Mucho cariño desde Perú

reviews.author: nolfa c
reviews.title: Vacaciones de hermanos
reviews.text: Estuvimos  hospedados en paradisus Palma real, vivimos una experiencia  inolvidable.el servicio  en general es excelente.los colabores son muy atento y amable,en especial quiero mencionar a la sra Rosmery de Jesús circle by melia y henler  también  danilea de recepción.felicidades por el equipo con el que cuenta este hotel 10/10

reviews.author: yamileborda
reviews.title: Recomendadisimo!
reviews.text: Excelente instalaciones, variedad de gastronomía y bebidas, un hotel tranquilo en el dia y movido en la noche con su variedad de actividades nocturnas.

reviews.author: Emily L
reviews.title: Our favorite place
reviews.text: Our favorite place.  We love coming here.  The staff is amazing.  I was feeling under the weather and everyone was making sure I was okay.  Thanks D for the vicks vapor rub because that always fixes everything. The Celsius  bar staff Luis, Jonathan,  George. Joel plus Raul. Luis from Kanna, Kelvin, Luis from the plaza kicks bar. All were just amazing.

reviews.author: Kim H
reviews.title: Felt like princesses for a week!
reviews.text: Girls trip and we booked Reserve Adult, upgraded to pool/ocean view room. Our concierge, Yaleidi Sims, took amazing care of us - booked all of our dinners & excursions. She made contact daily to make sure we were happy right up to departure.

reviews.author: Travis F
reviews.title: Beautiful view and better people
reviews.text: The views were spectacular and the people top notch. Our guy Alam was amazing he provided us with everything we asked for!! We will be back and bringing friends with us.

reviews.author: Kevin K
reviews.title: Excellent vacation made possible by Eriol
reviews.text: Resort was very good but our concierge Eriol really made things excellent for us.  He went above and beyond to check in multiple times a day, make sure we had the reservations we needed, fix maintenance issues in our room. He even filled our snacks and minibar when it was missed a couple days.  Eriol was exceptional and ensured our vacation was wonderful

reviews.author: Molly C
reviews.title: Amazing and wonderful time at Paradisus!
reviews.text: My family and I had a wonderful stay at Paradisus. It is clean, the staff is friendly and helpful, and there are plenty of activities to keep anyone entertained!! Special shoutout to Eriol, our concierge, who helped us with anything we needed!

reviews.author: Andrea B
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our three-week stay and had a wonderful, relaxing time. The entire hotel complex was very clean and well-maintained. The service at "The Reserve" completely met our expectations. Not only was the well-stocked minibar replenished daily, but so were the sweets.

The rooms were exactly as described. The beds were not only large but also very comfortable. When the power went out in the room after we used the kettle, the electrician arrived very quickly and fixed the problem immediately.

The various restaurants offered something for everyone. The QR codes for the menus were very convenient. We enjoyed the food every day, and I would especially like to highlight the exceptional New Year's Eve buffet with its huge selection.

The staff was always very friendly and attentive without being intrusive. Special praise goes to our concierge, Eriol. He contributed significantly to this wonderful vacation. He constantly surprised us with thoughtful touches, both large and small. The most beautiful thing about our wedding day was a prepared bubble bath with rose petals, rose petals on the bed, a matching bottle of sparkling wine, and above all, his long, handwritten congratulations on our wedding.

reviews.author: aburfeind
reviews.title: Wir hatten einen sehr schönen und erholsamen Aufenthalt
reviews.text:
Wir haben den gesamten Aufenthalt über 3 Wochen sehr genossen und uns gut erholt. Die gesamte Hotelanlage war sehr sauber und gepflegt. Der Service im „The Reserve“ hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen. Nicht nur die umfangreiche Minibar wurde täglich aufgefüllt - auch die Süßigkeiten. Die Zimmer entsprachen in vollem Umfang der Beschreibung. Die Betten waren nicht nur groß, auch die Matratzen waren sehr bequem. Als einmal im Zimmer nach der Nutzung des Wasserkochers der Strom ausfiel, war der Elektriker wirklich sehr schnell da und hat das Problem umgehend behoben. 
In den verschiedenen Restaurants war für jeden Geschmack etwas zu auf der Karte zu finden. Praktisch hier die QR-Code für die Speisekarten. Das Essen hat uns jeden Tag geschmeckt, wobei ich das außergewöhnliche Silvesterbüffet mit der riesigen Auswahl hervorheben möchte.
Das Personal war stets sehr freundlich und aufmerksam, dabei aber nicht aufdringlich. Ganz besonders hervorheben möchten wir unseren Concierge Eriol. Er hat maßgeblich zu diesem tollen Urlaub beigetragen. Er hat uns immer wieder kleine oder auch größere Überraschungen zuteilwerden lassen. Die Schönste war anlässlich unseres Hochzeitstages ein vorbereitetes Schaumbad mit Rosenblüten, Rosenblüten auf dem Bett, passend dazu eine Flasche Sekt und ganz besonders sein langer handgeschriebener Glückwunsch anlässlich unseres Hochzeitstages.

reviews.author: Antonio L
reviews.title: Viaje de placer y relax acompañado de mi mujer.
reviews.text:
Vacaciones súper relajantes,
Hotel situado en la misma playa con estupendas instalaciones. 
Comida muy buena y mejor servicio.
Como no mencionar al bartender del RunRepublic, Miguel, un excelente profesional muy simpático y agradable.

reviews.author: Anne C
reviews.title: Outstanding service!
reviews.text: Alam gave outstanding service from the minute we arrived until he saw us off at the end of our stay. Excellent service…..

reviews.author: Cheri B
reviews.title: Fantastic resort, wonderful and personal attention by Ana, concierge.
reviews.text: Our first time at a premiere resort.  This property, the food, the entertainment, the luxury were fantastic.  The staff are all friendly and attentive. Our concierge, Ana Azcona was particularly special, she went well above and beyond to make our experience as wonderful as possible! Ana, you are a credit to your company! Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Chantal K
reviews.title: Déjà hâte d’y retourner!
reviews.text: Première fois à cet hôtel mais assurément pas la dernière! Les restos, les spectacles de fin de soirée, tout était Wow! Nous souhaitons remercier chaleureusement Eriol, concierge au Paradisus Real Golf & Spa, pour son aide précieuse tout au long de notre séjour. Sa gentillesse, et sa disponibilité ont fait toute la différence. Grâce à lui, notre voyage s’est déroulé de façon fluide et agréable. Merci Eriol!

reviews.author: Kat-in-Cambridge
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: Recommend swim out bar Julia will take care of you.  We stayed by our swim out , definitely quieter, which was heaven. Main pool more busy. Wine room is exceptional Jonathon, Juan, Francisco know their wine. Go out of there way to accommodate    Jorge from the coffee shop, always greeted happily in the early morning coffee

reviews.author: Zackery T
reviews.title: Wonderful stay, fantastic employees, truly a paradise
reviews.text:
10/10 experience for a birthday trip to the DR. The team at the Paradisus Palma Real made this a truly amazing experience. 

The location is great and the atmosphere all around couldn’t have been better. 

We upgraded to the beach front room which was great, very clean and kept up very well. 

We had a personal concierge from upgrading to the Reserve section of the hotel and Adriel Cabrera took wonderful care of my family. He took care of dinner reservations, transportation, helped booking excursions and was always so kind. He even went above and beyond with getting me a birthday cake at one of the restaurants he reserved for us. 

Another shining star was Rafael in the reserve beach section. He was so kind and helpful during our stay making sure we had towels, drinks and even got us a fresh coconut! Excellent customer service and super friendly. 

Restaurants book early so if you don’t have the concierge to help I’d recommend planning your restaurants out. 

The reserve section was quiet and definitely worth the extra spend. 

Overall we had a great experience and everything exceeded expectations as we already want to come back soon. The hotel is great, staff is fantastic, and the food was a nice touch as well.

reviews.author: Pauline T
reviews.title: Exceptional Service!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. Adriel our Concierge took care of everything for us. Also, Rafael the beach bar tender also quite good care of us.

reviews.author: Erin M
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Loved my stay at paradisus palma real! The hotel and beach were beautiful, staff was incredible, and food was great. Rafael from the reserve beach was amazing and so attentive to us, and Adriel our reserve concierge was the absolute best!!!

reviews.author: Meander10750
reviews.title: Will return.
reviews.text: Extremely well kept facility. The shows are lively. The food is yummy. Our Concierge Adriel Cabrera, was attentive. He handled all of our reservations, cab back to the airport, and gave a wonderful intro to the hotel.

reviews.author: Martha K
reviews.title: Arisleida
reviews.text: Wonderful and friendly service from all but one employee stands out. Her name is Arisleida and she works at 34 degrees. She always has a smile, a kind word and cold drinks. She also has great recommendations and suggestions for us. I enjoy seeing her everyday and will miss her gorgeous smile when we go home.

reviews.author: yemina p
reviews.title: I ♥️ 🇩🇴. Pradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Estuvimos un mes en Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana (sí en la misma hab) y fue una experiencia realmente inolvidable. No fue solo un servicio excelente: nos hicieron sentir acompañados, cuidados y mimados como si fuéramos parte de una familia… porque fue nuestra casa en el Caribe por unos días! (Van menciones y tmb imagenes de ellos que Valen como mencion)

Queremos agradecer especialmente a Paula, en dirección, por coordinar todo con una dedicación increíble. A  Yne y Joy, por organizar las actividades de los niños con tanta energía y cariño. En Guest Service, a Juan y Anthony, atentos a cada situación y a todo lo que se necesitó; además, nos mimaron con kits de regalos, atencion personalizada con amazon assist card etc! Y con Gestos hermosos de sorpresas en la habitacion!

El KidZone merece una mención aparte: cuidaron a los niños como un tesoro, los contuvieron y los hicieron divertirse muchísimo. Gracias a Yne, Joy, Jessica, Suheide,  Alexandra  marianny! Martha! lisbeth, Jesús por su calidez y compromiso. Cuando dejaba a los chicos allí, si llamába por algo, respondían de inmediato, siempre con una actitud amorosa y profesional.

La gastronomía se destaca: de lo mejor que vimos en República Dominicana, con un nivel altísimo. Gracias a Chema por el servicio impecable y los platos increíbles; a Jimbert!!! Tan amable y atento!!! Yuderqui, Brailenny, siempre sonriente y trabajando con tanto amor. También un gracias especial a las chicas de los licuados del desayuno, siempre amables y con la mejor energía. En el bar, Teófilo fue un genio (cocos), acompañado por marcos, Pedro. Y en Kanna, mención para Storming y Luis por su excelente atención.

En la playa y el mar se nota el compromiso de todo el equipo: siempre atentos a ayudar, incluso cuando alguien necesitaba ingresar al mar con silla de ruedas o requería asistencia especial. Los guardias Daniel, Beriguete y David (INCORP) estuvieron presentes y con un trato impecable. Hay que destacar la lucidez con que Angelo notó que huesped quería meterse al mar y no podía—pidió la silla de ruedas acuática y enseguida lo ayudaron para que pudiera disfrutar. ¡Un genio!

Mención especial para Altagracia, housekeeping: cuidó cada detalle de la habitación con muchísimo esmero, y se encargó con mucho cuidado de las camas de los niños. El room service fue muy puntual.

En Fun Republic, la pasamos increíble: gracias a Richard y a todo el equipo por divertirnos tanto, y a Miguel, en la entrada, por su alegría de todos los días. También agradecemos a Cristal y Gabriela en el coffee shop, que siempre nos atendieron con una energía hermosa. Y me alegraba encontrarlas cada dia!

En el ZEL Spa, destacamos a Evelyn y Carina (masaje) por una atención excelente, y a Génesis en recepción por su amabilidad. Imanol y pablo!

También queremos mencionar con cariño a Milton y María.

Y un detalle clave: todos los días pudimos disfrutar del mar; no tuvimos sargazos (solo un día con olas aparecieron algunas algas). Se podía nadar hasta las boyas, la playa impecable, el servicio a la habitación fue muy puntual y el entretenimiento fue siempre sano, educado y familiar.

Seguramente quedan personas sin nombrar (son muchas y todas trabajan increíble), y por eso vamos a subir fotos donde aparecen varios de ellos, porque realmente se merecen el reconocimiento. Y a todos los que estan detras de escena obviamente que tmb un agradecimiento enorme.
Gracias a todo el equipo Meliá por unas vacaciones excelentes. 
Continuará...

reviews.author: Jo Anne M
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
The Fairenheit Bar

Eddy and Raul are absolutely phenomenal.  Extremely attentive to their patrons.  Always making sure you are served when your glass is empty. The music is fabulous and they are entertaining.  The “Nana” drink is fabulous.  Real coconut with rum, pineapple juice and coconut water. Thank you so much for making our experience amazing.

reviews.author: Thoms249
reviews.title: A great week at Paradisus Palma, thanks Eriol.
reviews.text: A lovely 7 days a Paradisus Palma (adults only, the reserve). Nice room, great beach and pools. Thanks to our fantastic concierge Eriol we were able to sample all the restaurants on site. Food was excellent, never a complaint. Only went buffet for breakfast and the occasional lunch and there was a good selection. Bars, drinks throughout (loved those  frozen margaritas, rum & coke and mud slide).  Service always good throughout resort. Our only suggestion to management: more hospitality suites for late departing guests. Resort it reluctant to allow late checkouts, but you can stay and use services, pools, etc., so they provide a hospitality suite to use for showers and changing into travel clothes. Only problem, only 1 hospitality suite for whole resort, gets a bit busy at end of day 🤪. Not to worry though, can’t complain about anything really. Great first class resort. Thanks Eriol for your attentive service and help. You helped make our holiday a great experience.

reviews.author: Paulo B
reviews.title: Great stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus!  When we arrived we were introduced to our concierge, Alam who was fantastic.  He cared for us the entire trip, ensuring we had dinner reservations and that we were getting the best service.  We truly appreciate everything he did to make our vacation amazing.  Hotel is in a great location, beautiful beaches, gorgeous rooms.  There were lots of food options.  The buffet seemed a bit disorganized but the food was good.

reviews.author: Jake T
reviews.title: Paradisus really is paradise
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma real was a fantastic hotel and all-inclusive experience.

The hotel rooms, amenities, beach, and especially service was fantastic. We opted for the reserve (adults only) package and it was well worth it. The pool and beach areas were not crowded, day beds were great and drinks were plenty. The restaurants exceeded our expectations with delicious meals, especially the Mexican restaurant. 

We were assigned a personal concierge Adriel who was fantastic. He always ensured we had restaurant reservations, transportation, and anything else we needed during our stay. He checked in on us regularly and even got the resort to make a cake for my brothers birthday without us asking. He was phenomenal.

On the beach, we had another amazing bartender, Rafael, who ensured we always had a daybed and towels laid out each day. He checked on us regularly and made sure we had drinks water and food at any time. He went out of his way to get us some coconuts as a special request. 

Overall I would highly recommends this resort.

reviews.author: itsrachel
reviews.title: Five-Star Paradise with Five-Star People
reviews.text:
Our stay at this resort was nothing short of incredible from start to finish. The property itself is stunning, but what truly sets it apart is the experience and the people. The activities were plentiful, unique, and so much fun—everything from coffee workshops and clay working to Pilates on the beach and a silent disco. There was always something engaging to do, and it never felt repetitive.

A very special thank you goes to our concierge, Alam, who handled every detail flawlessly. From dinner reservations and spa appointments to cabana rentals and more, Alam made everything seamless and effortless, allowing us to truly relax and enjoy our time.

The entertainment staff, Fernando, Carlos, Pollito (Johan), Dana, and Alfredo brought so much energy and joy to our week. Their enthusiasm and warmth made each day even more memorable. Junior (various restaurants), Yasmailin, Enrique (KANNA), Antonio and his team (ginger bar) made us feel less like guests and more like longtime friends and family, which is something truly special.

The rooms were beautiful across the board. Between my family, we experienced five different room configurations, and every single one was lovely. Our oceanfront suite was absolutely incredible, spacious, serene, and unforgettable.

This resort delivers not only beauty and luxury, but heart. We cannot wait to return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an exceptional, joy-filled getaway. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Nadia D
reviews.title: Honeymoon :)
reviews.text:
We stayed for our honeymoon in The Reserve area. It is a beautiful hotel, very clean, very well organised. There are food options for everyone. The aim of the hotel is to relax, so you don't have a million activities, but you can use the installations of the whole complex. Our concierge, Emmanuel, made everything a 100% better. He was kind and very efficient without being invasive. He really took care of everything!
Points to improve: the rules of the hotel have should be applied, there were people using exclusive ammenities without staying in the area, people occupying beach chairs all day with towels without using them and those sorts of things. Also, they need to hire more staff for busy days, it lowers the quality of the service making it slow, specially at dinner time. 
But overall it was a great experience and we enjoyed our stay very much. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Kelly Z
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and very relaxing enjoyable experience
reviews.text: My husband and I had a phenomenal week here. We were really able to fully relax and just enjoy our time. The breakfast and lunch buffets were great with an extensive variety. The Ginger Cafe was perfect for our morning lattes. It was never a challenge to find a beach chair even when showing up to the beach at 11am. We also really enjoyed the nightly entertainment. We would highly recommend this hotel and plan to return some day!

reviews.author: Richard C
reviews.title: Palma real visit January 10 to 17
reviews.text: This was our second visit to Paradisus Palma real. The property is well kept. We enjoyed our week. The food was excellent with a number of choices buffet verses restaurants. We stayed in the reserve area which I would recommend. our concierge was Eriol and he was excellent. He handles all are needs and was in contact several times a day to make  sure we happy. We got beach chairs thanks to Raphael and he would bring drinks as requested. The reserve bar was great as they had all top shelf alcohol and made any drink you wanted.  Beach was beautiful and well kept. Housekeeping was not up to par this year. The spa was delightful. The entertainment at night was ok but not great. All the staff were pleasant wherever we went. Check-in was easy reservation desk were efficient.

reviews.author: Excursion09013941247
reviews.title: A pleasant, peaceful holiday
reviews.text: Màsodszor voltunk itt, Minden rendben volt, Alam profi mòdon intézte a kéréseinket, mindig rendelkezésre àllt. 5 csillag, nem is kérdés.

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: Amazing as usual
reviews.text:
Location is convenient from the airport.
Atmosphere and the newly renovated rooms and common spaces are warm and inviting.
This is our 5th trip to the Paradisus Reserve and we are never disappointed.
Food is amazing and it’s nice to see some new tastes emerge (Flora is amazing if you are able to eat a wee bit outside the box) and having true local foods are fantastic.The Italian was ok, the steak and the Mexican restaurants were good too. Service was on par with our other experiences and they are quite efficient.
The lobby bar was our nightly pit stop and Luis Yeuri and Yiri are fantastic at whipping up whatever creations clients requested. The bar was able to easily make change which allowed for tipping on the regular.
The Fahrenheit Beach bar and pool crew are amazing and go above and beyond; extra towels & tending to you for the day. Pedro and Marin made sure our needs were met before even asking and the good morning greetings were always welcomed. Marco, Eddy, Teo and Yefry were always there to serve with a smile and a dance. 
Our butler Emmanuel was the best we had of all of our stays. He coordinated all of our meals, golf excursions and checked in often during the day in person. He was sweet and according and made the holiday seamless. I suggest having what’s app installed for all conversations as if there were changes or request for anything from coffee to wine at night,
He was always available.
Another wonderful stay and looking forward to returning again next year.

reviews.author: Catherine P
reviews.title: What's Not to Love?
reviews.text:
Lovely property with a beautiful beach, plenty of activities, and friendly staff! Eriol was our concierge and he was fantastic - super attentive to our needs, friendly, and proactive in making reservations for us for dinner. We'd love to work with him again. 

Also of mention are Victor at the bar next to the steakhouse (truly an artist!), Angelo and Olga at the beach bar, Jonathan at the pool bar, and Evalyn who braids hair at the beach. If you're kind to the staff and at least attempt some Spanish, it goes a long way. I'm a conversational Gringa, and they were all thrilled to practice with me. 

Room was clean and spacious, allows for privacy, and had a lovely view of the ocean. Our favorite restaurants were the steakhouse, Italian, and buffet. Portion sizes at the restaurants are smaller than Americans are used to, but I appreciated that since many people waste food at the buffet. Service is quick enough where you can always order more. 

We would absolutely return.

reviews.author: jjband2026
reviews.title: January 26
reviews.text: Yearly fun trip with friends from all over the USA. By far the best resort we have stayed at. Would definitely go again. Staff was incredible!!!

reviews.author: Fran
reviews.title: Alam was a genuine delight! Courteous, professional and knowledgeable, throughout our stay he was there to assist us!
reviews.text: Alam was a genuine delight! Thorough, professional and knowledgeable, he made our stay even more enjoyable. Truly like “Family!”

reviews.author: WRJM52
reviews.title: Alam excellent Butler service.
reviews.text: Alam was our Butler throughout our stay. He guided us each day through our stay. He made sure that our reservations were made each day and that we knew about all the activities that were offered. He made our stay enjoyable and memorable. Ask for Alam to be your Butler when you stay at this beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Fiorella Zoe L
reviews.title: Real experiencia en Palma Real
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia, como cada vez que venimos a paradisus palma real, fue increíble. El servicio impecable y el acompañamiento de Alam como mayordomo, supremo. 
Amamos este lugar porque todo está pensado para que sean reales vacaciones y generemos los mejores recuerdos.

reviews.author: Rosanna L
reviews.title: The staff makes your trip amazing
reviews.text: Our family vacation was amazing at this resort because of the staff that cares and are genuinely happy to make sure you are taken care of and enjoying your vacation. Our butler (Basilio J) which we had in November and December was nothing short of amazing. He treats you like family and is sure that everything is just right and if not he will be sure to make it right. And if it isn’t something he can fix directly he will be sure to get the right person to handle it. He also listens attentively. One day I had mentioned that I was enjoying the champagne and the next day a bottle was in my room over ice with two glasses. He also makes an effort through out the day to find you on the property to check in and see how you are doing and if you need anything. I can’t say enough about what an asset he is to this resort and making our vacation successful. The activity staff was also amazing. I am not sure they ever go home. They are sure to have a variety of activities and great at making them fun and getting people involved. From pool activities like water aerobics and pole fitness to dancing in the plaza at night they are there to make it fun. Joanna and Alfredo were amazing and appreciated us as clients at the resort. Alfredo had a great personality and made the activities fun. Joanna I can’t thank enough for how well they treated my 27 yr old son with special needs. There was a painting activity for the younger children that was of interest to my son. I realized we had missed the class time  and not even sure they would allow him I visited Kidsdom to inquire about the art piece they painted in the class that day. I was asking if I could just get the piece of art and take it home so that he could paint it. But with no questions asked she invited him into the Kidsdom art area so that he could paint the piece of art there immediately. The staff was so helpful and enjoyed having him there. The restaurant staff was also very helpful in many ways. Romeris is a supervisor that we first met in the Asian restaurant which was amazing!! She was very attentive to detail and service. We also crossed paths at the buffet. Our family was playing it safe and drinking bottle water only to avoid issues I experienced during our November trip. Romeris without us asking made sure we had bottles of water ready for us when we arrived to eat. And Enrique whom we met at Sante and the Kanna Grill had a magnetic personality. He always had a smile and fun to be around. And if you saw him in passing he remembered you and with a smile made his notorious hello sound with a handshake. The staff makes this resort. The amenities are amazing with something to do for all ages. The butlers are there to help 110% and if you have a need or question they have the answer. I talked to many people that had been to DR multiple times and to multiple resorts in DR  and they all said this location was the best one of all they had visited. We definitely enjoyed our visit both in November as we had celebrated our 30th anniversary and returned in December for a family vacation and both times it was amazing. I cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Clara
reviews.title: Family holiday review
reviews.text: Nuestra experiencia en el Paradisus fue muy positiva. Además, Alan, nuestro simpático y amable concierge, organizó nuestras comidas y actividades súper bien. Muchas gracias por todo Alan!

reviews.author: Eric W
reviews.title: Amazing Winter Getaway
reviews.text: Everything was great, was the perfect winter getaway to relax, enjoy the warm weather and have some fun with friends. Emmanuel was a great concierge!

reviews.author: m r
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Only the best vacation of my life. Staff here treated my family like family. Their care and interest in us made for incredible memories. Alam helped us with so many reservations and arrangements- it made things easy. Carlos and his entertainment team (Dana and Fernando) - well, can I just take them all home with me? I will be back - this was such a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Brandon Z
reviews.title: Great winter vacation!
reviews.text: Had a great time. Everything was excellent and well maintained. Staff was friendly and helpful. Our concierge, Emmanuel, helped us with everything we needed!

reviews.author: Gillian H
reviews.title: Third time around - still wonderful
reviews.text:
There’s a reason we keep coming back to Amelia in Punta Cana. The resort is clean, the staff is helpful and friendly, the beach is second to none and the pool is great. The rooms are comfortable and clean, the food was elevated this year as well. The nightly entertainment is both family friendly and enjoyable for the adults. The bartenders are knowledgeable and take the time to get to know you throughout your trip if you hang around. 
Our concierge Christopher was once again top tier. From the warm welcome to troubleshooting a technical system issue that found us enjoying a hibachi dinner at another of the Melia resorts, he was the perfect mix of attentive and around and leaving us be to enjoy the sun. 

We said it last year, we’re saying it again - we’ll be back.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Our stay was fantastic. Our concierge, Christopher, made sure all of our needs were met. He made reservations for us, showed us around the property and checked in with us regularly. He made our stay better than we could have imagined.

reviews.author: Denise G
reviews.title: Too short a time in Paradise
reviews.text:
Stayed in the Reserve part of Paradisus Palma Real. Resort was fabulous and room was as advertised. The bed and pillow were a bit hard for my liking but I like a soft bed and pillow. Christopher our concierge was awesome. We were a large group and he took good care of us. Martin at the Reserve pool made sure our pool time was perfect. Luis was the waiter extraordinaire both at Kanna and the japanese restaurant. He went out of his way to accommodate us every time we saw him!

Overall I would consider returning to this resort again if the opportunity presented itself.

reviews.author: Pam Sangster
reviews.title: Beautiful resort in the gorgeous Caribbean. Stunning sunrises and sunsets!
reviews.text: Amazing resort, mostly due to these staff members Christopher, Dilania, Teofilo, Martin, Marco,Luis,Junior,Betti,Yessica, Leticia, Fauri and Jennifer! These spectacular staff members made our stay remarkable . Gorgeous resort, great food, very clean and well taken care of daily. The sunrises and sunsets are spectacular. We were a large group of 12 and Christopher arranged our dinners seamlessly. We would definitely come back again. The service was outstanding!

reviews.author: Scott S
reviews.title: These folks made our trip…always gracious, always helpful…exceptional service throughout.
reviews.text: Resort great; staff exceptional-particularly Christopher, Marco, Martin, Luis, Junior, Dilania, Teofilo, Betti, Fauri.

reviews.author: Alannah M
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation Resort and Concierge Experience
reviews.text:
What a wonderful resort! We spent a week here with family and it was a fantastic vacation. The resort is very clean with modern and spacious rooms, and expansive pool and beach options during the day.

The buffet serves incredible food, no end of options that suit everyone - young children included. Restaurants also had great variety of options and food to enjoy if you are looking for something more à la carte. 

An absolute highlight of our trip was our personal concierge, Alam. From our check in he came and introduced himself and was available to us for the entire week. Incredibly friendly and helpful, he made everything so seamless for us - managing all of restaurant bookings, activity bookings for golf and tennis, even helping us when we inadvertently got ourselves locked on our room balcony! We had a WhatsApp group chat with him which made communication very easy. He was very responsive and on top of everything we needed, and he came to find us personally every day to check in on how our stay was going. 

The beach itself is expansive for walking, and very clean. If you’re interested in boat trips to snorkel or tour for the day. you can easily coordinate that directly on the beach. 

Would absolutely return to this resort and recommend it for others! Excellent all around.

reviews.author: Chase500
reviews.title: Enjoyable time with friends at five star resort
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. We stayed in the reserve section, which I recommend, it was quite and service was first class. All the staff at the resort were friendly and helpful. Special shout out to Christopher and Louis! 
Food was good and varied. 
For pball players, there are six excellent courts within walking distance, available at an hourly rate.

reviews.author: Lydia S
reviews.title: A wonderful week in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
Great resort!  Food was excellent with a wide selection of options.  Our family concierge, Alam made our stay so much more enjoyable - restaurant reservations, cabana reservations, golf, tennis, you name it!  He even handled us locking ourselves out on the balcony at night! 

We wanted to stay longer and would definitely recommend the resort!

reviews.author: Romina Z
reviews.title: Maravillosa experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
El resort es hermoso y de lujo. Las instalaciones siempre limpias y muy cálidas. Los restaurantes son de alta calidad, disfrutamos mucho cada cena. El buffet podría mejorarse, buscando mantener los platos calientes. 
La atención de nuestra concierge, Ana Azcona, fue de 10/10, ayudándonos en cada momento.

reviews.author: Bryce P
reviews.title: Lovely resort - great concierge
reviews.text:
Spent a week here with family and had a wonderful time. Rain blew through a couple times, but that happens on the ocean. You can make do with the indoor spaces. Rooms are nice and our junior suite had plenty of space for 2. Food was unreal in my opinion. The buffet has no end of really good options and the restaurants have some incredible plates. If you go to the steakhouse, get the cuts you may not be familiar with (picanha, arrachera).

A highlight for us was Alam, our concierge. Warm & friendly immediately, super responsive and helpful, a touch cheeky and funny at the right times. He seemed to have a really good idea of who we were and what we needed. We had a WhatsApp group chat with him for everyone to stay up to speed. It seemed like he was respected and liked among other staff as well, he was the guy who can get things done or connect you with the person who could.

1 downside is ability to snorkel right off the beach, which is something I love to be able to do. Lots of boats, limited swim area. Trade off is that you have MILES of gorgeous beach to walk/run/explore and you can book an outing on those boats very easily. Beach area in front of the resort is wide and wonderful. Note that if there is a calm day and the ocean is pretty flat, take advantage of it. Golf is a short drive across the main road (or long walk), tennis/pickleball/paddleball courts are a relatively short walk. The resort also has a lot of space, though people (us included) seem to gather around the bridge area adjacent to the beach, or on the beach. If you want a quieter spot, you could find it, and not very far from the busy spots.

reviews.author: Dan A
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with wonderful staff. Great long beach and the pools were clean. The Reserve was so enjoyable.
reviews.text: Hotel is awesome and the staff are warm, friendly and fun. Our Concierge was Christopher Rivera and he was terrific. We were also fortunate with the weather and every rain shower was during the evening and night.

reviews.author: rfitzory
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: This is an amazing resort. It's well maintained, pleasant and accommodating staff, good food, beautiful beach and pools, great activities and gorgeous rooms. Jean and Luis from Kanna grill and Mina are not to be missed. They were amazing!! Loved having them serve us and helping us with reservations.

reviews.author: florlongui1997
reviews.title: Hotel de lujo, con excelente servicio y atención
reviews.text:
Tuvimos una experiencia hermosa, con gente amable, con una energía hermosa. Nos hicieron sentir muy cómodos en toda la estadía. 
El hotel un lujo, con servicios excelentes. 
La comida muy rica, nos hubiera gustado repetir más de un restaurante. 
Lo recomendaría 1000 veces

reviews.author: avasilkovski
reviews.title: Best Resort, fun time
reviews.text: The location is great, great beach and close to the airport. The service from beginning to the end was excellent. The entertainment team is fantastic,  Alfredo and Dana are amazing. They will have you dancing from morning till night. I would Definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: aielloHolmdel
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text:
Excellent service. Good was great! Libby entertainment every night. Spacious rooms. A lot for your money. Just fabulous!!!!
Antonio, Angelo, Yefrey, Frankie were all great!!

reviews.author: harleykattan2006
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Excellent service from staff and fun filled activities the service was top notch being our first vacation spot

reviews.author: Journey50839907610
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Me and my wife had a wonderful time in punta Cana at the pardisu Palma real resort the service was outstanding our concierge Gustavo the staff at the beach Rafael Martin and Gilberto were top notch

reviews.author: Navneet K
reviews.title: BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE!
reviews.text:
We are staying at Paradisus Palma Real for our honeymoon and birthday celebration, and even before our arrival the service has been outstanding.

I would like to especially thank Liyary Reynoso, E-Concierge, for the kindness, patience, and excellent communication. Liyary helped us with honeymoon and birthday arrangements and made the entire process very easy and stress-free. The attention to detail and warm approach truly made us feel welcome and valued.

This level of care and professionalism means so much to us and has made us even more excited for our stay. Thank you, Liyary, for going above and beyond. We truly appreciate the wonderful service and support.

Highly recommend this resort and the amazing team behind it.

reviews.author: Jeff B
reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text: Alam was a great help with our needs and when there was a issue he resolved it

reviews.author: Aurelia B
reviews.title: Dominican Republic, Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Alam was very attentive and responded to all our questions and needs. Thank you Alam Molina.

Although our visit started a little rocky, we enjoyed our stay. Beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Dan T
reviews.title: Perfect family vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in the presidential suite with an ocean front view that gave us awesome sunrises to get the day started. Everyone at the resort did all they could to make our stay as enjoyable and memorable as possible.  Christopher and Alam were always there to help us out when we needed it and went above and beyond to make our stay relaxing and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Thielges F
reviews.title: Relaxing carribean destination
reviews.text: Presidential ocean front suite had breathe taking views of sunrise and ocean.  Spacious, clean and elegant accommodations.  Staff were friendly and welcoming.  The Reserve team made our arrival and departure easy and stress free.   Our concierges, Alam and Cristopher were top notch-helpful, responsive, checked in on us daily and genuinely cared about our experience.

reviews.author: sneyder h
reviews.title: Sneyder Higuita Madrid
reviews.text:
Me pareció muy agradable el hotel el mayordomo Alam fue lo mejor muy amable y atento para lo que nosotros necesitábamos nos reservó en 2 restaurantes muy bien todo la
Habitación estuvo perfecta

reviews.author: Noemi D
reviews.title: The Reserve Rocks
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic time at The Reserve.
Christopher our concierge was sooo good! He was always available and went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable. We loved the rooms, and all the restaurants were good.
Drinks were also very good. Looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: FMM
reviews.title: Calidad en gastronomía,ubicación y sevicio
reviews.text:
Hemos disfrutado del hotel una semana y destacar principalmente la ubicación,la alta calidad en piscinas y playa
Decir que la comida es de bastante calidad en todos los restaurantes y el bufett
En cuanto atención no todos los empleados destacan por su simpatía si bien son todos atentos,pero las actividades de animación del hotel no son el punto fuerte la verdad
Pero por su plus de atención y calidad de servicio
Le doy un 5 estrellas a:
Altagracia en el sports bar por su cariño y velocidad
Fernando en animación por su chispa de alegría diferente al resto
Y Dilania en las hamacas y atención de la piscina que ha sido inmejorable y una auténtica suerte tenerla cerca
En conjunto repetiría en el hotel

reviews.author: Kate V
reviews.title: Beautiful resort.
reviews.text: Good amenities and never too crowded. Thank you to our concierge Gustavo and the entire staff for making our trip great.

reviews.author: Dean S
reviews.title: Unforgettable stay
reviews.text: Our fourth year in a row celebrating New Year's at Paradisus. As always, an unforgettable stay--lush grounds, sparkling pools, outstanding beaches and staff that treats you like family. The rooms are spotless, food wonderful and every sunset felt like a postcard. Basilio, our concierge, truly made the stay special--always attentive, knowledgeable and ready with thoughtful touches that turned a great trip into an exceptional one. Anthony at the Ginger Bar is absolutely wonderful! He is warm and welcoming. He went out of his way to remember orders and to introduce us to local customary coffee beverages each morning--a great way to start the day!  We'll be back in December 2026 for another New Year's celebration!

reviews.author: Belen B
reviews.title: genial
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia en Kanna fue excelente, en gran parte gracias al servicio impecable de su equipo. Queremos destacar especialmente a Enrique y Jaz, que nos atendieron con una calidez, predisposición y profesionalismo increíbles. Siempre atentos a cada detalle, con la mejor onda y haciendo que nos sintamos cómodos y súper bien atendidos desde el primer momento.

También queremos felicitar a los mozos de todos los restaurantes, porque en cada espacio donde comimos o tomamos algo el trato fue igual de bueno: rápidos, amables, respetuosos y muy atentos a todo lo que necesitábamos. Eso hace una diferencia enorme y realmente eleva la experiencia.

No solo disfrutamos de la comida y del lugar, sino que el servicio hizo que todo fuera aún mejor. Sin dudas, dan ganas de volver una y otra vez. 

¡Gracias por hacernos pasar momentos tan lindos!

reviews.author: Lupo P
reviews.title: Servicio de Primera!
reviews.text: Paradisus ofrece un paquete que abarca una amplia gama de amenidades de primera categoría y una variedad de actividades.  Este resort se distingue por su excepcional servicio al cliente. Cristopher, nuestro consierge durante nuestra estancia, demostró una atención meticulosa a nuestras necesidades, asegurando que nuestra experiencia fuera extraordinaria.  Aprovecho esta oportunidad para expresar mi más sincero agradecimiento por su invaluable asistencia y disposición.  Sin duda alguna, consideraría regresar a Paradisus en el futuro.

reviews.author: Nadia A
reviews.title: Arisleida Best bartender
reviews.text: The pool - Celsius - had the best bartender. Her name is, Arisleida and she is the best!!!! Go find her and she will give you the best time.

reviews.author: momof3spiders
reviews.title: Great week!
reviews.text: The staff was very accommodating during our stay. The food was excellent and the resort was clean. The dinner experiences at the restaurants were great. Our rooms were close to the beach so it made it convenient to run back and forth. There is a pool for each house unit so it wasn’t crowded at all. We would stay here again.

reviews.author: caroline z
reviews.title: LOVED IT!
reviews.text:
Upgraded to Reserve at check in. I had originally booked the master suite non reserve, but the junior suite reserve room was spacious(and worth the service).
 Very clean rooms. I’m particular when it comes to any moldy smells. House keeping and room service was on point! They consistently stocked lots of water and snacks.
The beaches were kept very clean. There was hardly a smidge of seaweed.
****Service was phenomenal! Both our Concierge **Alam!!, and all the staff at the restaurants and the bars!!!  Super friendly, and they do speak English and a few other languages(way better than my Spanish).
The food has been great, my favorite is definitely the steak house. Tomahawk is the way to go, and don’t be afraid to get a little vino with it(it’s vacation). 
In summation: warm ocean, Powerful 🌞, pool, food and drinks. WIN Melia Paradisus Punta Cana

reviews.author: Bryan S
reviews.title: Exceptional experience at the beautiful Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real was truly an amazing experience from start to finish. The property is beautifully and maintained and well-kept, with groundskeepers and workers constantly working to provide guests with a luxury vacation. 
Our room was spacious, clean, and comfortable. The housekeepers were constantly cleaning to ensure the rooms and hallways met guest standards. 
There was a little hallway noise, but nothing that kept us up at night. 
Our concierge, Alam, was truly accommodating to any of our needs. He booked all of our reservations and ensured that our room was well-stocked with our wine preferences. He was personable and friendly, willing to go above and beyond for his guests. He is a true asset to the Paradisus resort, and we hope to see him again for our future visits.  
Overall, our visit to the Paradisus exceeded expectations and it made going back to the states bittersweet.

reviews.author: Brett C
reviews.title: Amazing couples experience at paradisus palma real
reviews.text: Fantastic location and beautiful area, the hotel was amazing with great service and accommodations. Overall would definitely come back

reviews.author: JNold
reviews.title: Unser Aufenthalt im Paradisius Palma real
reviews.text:
Wir wurden top betreut... der Service war sehr gut und die Mitarbeiter sehr freundlich

Wir würden dieses Resort jederzeit weiter empfehlen.

Ramon war super freundlich am Strand👍

reviews.author: Camden Z
reviews.title: Amazing time and great food
reviews.text: Great service our server melqui, was fantastic he was very nice and made our experience top notch! Drinks were great and he made sure everything was on par

reviews.author: Joe P
reviews.title: Amazing time at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Our stay was superb. The staff went above and beyond, especially Angelo, who took care of us on the beach every single day. He treated us as if we were his only guests, always attentive, always kind, and never with any expectation in return. He truly made our trip.

The beach had the usual Punta Cana seaweed, nothing more than what you’d expect. The hotel itself was clean and well kept. It’s smaller than some of the larger resorts, which we actually loved - it felt more relaxed and easy to navigate.

We also had a lost purse with cash inside, and everything was returned untouched. When my wife needed medical attention, the doctor saw her right away with no wait and no hassle.

Overall, a superb stay. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Wayne H
reviews.title: Howell Honeymoon at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We found the resort through Costco Travel, when we first arrived we knew we had picked a great place. When we got to the location our concierge(Emmanuel) took care of us from the check in desk. It’s full service with bellhops for luggage and servers that come to you. We bounced between buffets for breakfast and lunch. And for dinner we found Flora, Mina, and Blue Agave were our favorites. We were shocked to find that the package came with an excursion which was Yoga on a private beach. We kept more to the pools than the beach but did enjoy several sunsets at the beach. We didn’t have much desire to venture out as the daily events were engaging and fun with the bar tenders keeping you engaged at the bar with their drinks or conversation. The weather was great most days with only two days of sporadic rain or cool weather. We didn’t have a few issues with the room(lock battery low, phone not working, housekeeping missed our room) but all were fixed by our concierge within 30mins.

reviews.author: Alyssa and Luke A
reviews.title: Honeymoon stay at Paradisus Palma Real Resort
reviews.text: We recently completed a stay at the Reserve Adults Only section of Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana  for our honeymoon. This upgraded reservation gave us so many wonderful additions such as our awesome personal concierge Emmanuel.  He was super friendly and able to smoothly coordinate everything from our dinner reservations, spa, catamaran excursion, and having our luggage picked up when leaving. Our room was wonderful and although the room didn’t face the ocean, we did have a side view of the ocean from our balcony. The reserved and adults-only pool areas were quiet and secluded from the main pool.  This allowed for plenty of options for sun loungers without needing to get up early to reserve.  We also loved the private beach area. The restaurants that required a reservation allowed for many unique cuisine experiences while the buffets offered quick and easy meals with decent variety. We would highly recommend visiting Paradisus and had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Harry S
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful trip. Such a fantastic experience. Basillio was the absolute best concierge. He was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed to have a relaxing and enjoyable vacation.

reviews.author: Candace L
reviews.title: Beautiful blessings
reviews.text:
Upon the recommendation of my brother, we chose this resort as the destination for our first ever annual family vacation! What a dream! We stayed in the Reserve, which is the adults only area of the resort. The view is stunning. The rooms and outlets are immaculate, but the people is what really made us fall in love with this beautiful country and resort. Our concierge, Basilio, was extremely attentive. He’d message us every morning to see how dinner was the evening before. He would check on us daily to be sure we had everything we needed. He was extremely helpful and informative and even took care of booking our spa appointments for us. It was almost as though the man could anticipate our needs. Amazing! 

We also loved our morning coffee time in Ginger. Antonio makes the BEST drinks and is so welcoming and friendly. We had our elderly parents with us, and he catered to them with such love and compassion. You can tell how important family is to the Dominican people based on how they valued our parents’ presence. Samaria was also extremely sweet and always helped us with our Spanish. Lord knows we needed it! 😂 She was so patient with us and learned each of our names so she could greet us each morning. 

I’m not done yet … 😂 Miguel and Victor in the bar between hibachi and the steakhouse were so fun! They whipped up tasty cocktails; and no matter how busy they were, they always had a smile on their face and were singing and joking. Such a fun group! 

Junior and Jeison took great care of us at the lunchbox. And Gerardo makes the best omelettes! 

So grateful that my family got to experience this amazing island and resort! Indeed, we are BLESSED! See you next year, Paradisus Palma Real familia!

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: BEST resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: This is BY FAR the best resort in Punta Cana.  We have traveled to the DR since 2015 and Melia Palma Real is consistently the best. This time we had Emmanuel as our concierge and he was amazing!  Gave us space when needed and made sure everything was taken care of.

reviews.author: Ellie K
reviews.title: Had a wonderful time!
reviews.text: We had the best time in Punta Cana at the Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed at The Reserve portion of the resort and loved it. Our room was ocean facing and had beautiful views. It was a king suite and was the perfect amount of space for me and my husband. We were very close to The Reserve pools which were pretty quiet which we enjoyed and getting a chair was never a problem for us. We also loved the beds on the beach, they were so comfortable and again, not hard to get a spot. Again, all of this in The Reserve portion of the resort, which was adults only. The service here was incredible. All of the staff were overly friendly & kind. We tried all but one of the restaurants and enjoyed every meal we had. The overall atmosphere of the resort was great. For one, it’s beautiful and we enjoyed that there was live music almost every night after sunset. It was great having the concierge service as part of The Reserve amenities. Emmanuel was our concierge and he was great. He gave us a tour of the resort, showed us to our room, made all of our dinner reservations, provided us with the daily activities going on at the resort, helped us book an excursion, and answered any questions we had during our stay. He even did something special in our room to celebrate our honeymoon. We felt we paid a great price for everything we got! Couldn’t recommend this resort more!

reviews.title: Great vacation at the Palma Real!
reviews.text:
Just got back from the Palma Real and had a great time. The resort is beautiful, the beach is awesome, and the restaurants are great with the standout being Flora.

A few notes and shoutouts - We stayed in the Reserve, which costs a bit more, but is completely worth it. There are some very helpful perks with the Reserve. The first is a dedicated concierge. Ours was Harry, who was great. We texted back & forth throughout our stay and he helped us with anything we needed and made the whole vacation run smoothly. He must also be able to control the sun because with the exception of a couple hours one afternoon, it was shining the whole time. Next you have access to a dedicated section of the beach. Here Raphael was The Man. We didn't have to wake up a 6am to reserve seats on the beach because Raphael organized it everyday. He also grabbed us towels and drinks. All in all, excellent service from both Harry and Raphael!

Beyond the Reserve - We ate lunch most days at the large buffet, where Luciana was super attentive. We also went for massages at the spa, where Jennifer and Lilate were also great.

All in all, a great trip. This was our second time here and there will be a third!

reviews.title: Amazing trip to Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text:
This was our fourth year staying at Paradisus Palma Real for a family vacation, and each visit continues to exceed expectations.

Juan Peña, Customer Experience Manager, and Christopher Rivera, our concierge, are the best.  They consistently strive to ensure a seamless and welcoming experience. They  and are attentive and exceptional throughout our stay going above and beyond every day! They truly make us feel at home from the moment we arrive, and Meliá is very fortunate to have them.  We look forward to seeing them during our stays.

The resort is absolutely beautiful with well maintained, and comfortable rooms with excellent amenities. The beach and pools are wonderful with plenty of seating and shaded huts if needed. Seaweed from the ocean does get bad at times, but the staff works incredibly hard throughout the day to clear it.

The dining experience continues to improve year after year. The buffet and à la carte restaurants offer something for everyone, and the food is very good and consistent considering the volume of guest and turnout they do daily. There are so many staff members to mention but I will just call out a few that we spent lots of time with that went above and beyond.  Yanira, Rosanna, and Maria Ortiz at the Lunchbox (buffet) treated us like family every day. In the à la carte restaurants, Wander, Yuderque, Franklin, Frank, Jesus, Milton, Laura, Hostet, Kelvin, and Dionys went above and beyond. Coffee at Ginger Bar with Anthony and Jorge was a daily highlight.

We also enjoyed multiple spa treatments that were outstanding thanks to Evangelista, Gladys, Fior, Maria, and Jennifer. The bell staff—Miguel, Jose, Lloelis, and Omar—were always friendly, helpful, and  welcoming.

We had an amazing trip and highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real. We are already looking forward to our next visit!

reviews.author: Brian L
reviews.title: Great week at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
Just returning from a great week at the Paradisus so wanted to share some (hopefully helpful) thoughts on the resort:

Service:  Wanted to mention this first as the service was the absolute standout of the Paradisus. We have been to numerous AI resorts and the service we received at the Paradisus was the best we have ever had….almost every staff member we encountered was very friendly and greeted guests with a smile.  Special thanks to Eriol our butler who made sure we had everything we needed every day. Just amazing service and so responsive to every request (which has not been the case at previous resorts where we had butler service). Also thanks to Raul, Danny, and Vanessa at the pool bar near our room and Angelo took great care of us in the beach. 

Resort/Grounds:  The Paradisus main buildings and grounds are pretty standard for an AI resort of this type but meticulously maintained. Staff members constantly picking up any trash/debris, sweeping walkways of sand, trimming the lush vegetation, etc. This is also a very compact resort that is easily walkable unlike some of the huge AIs…literally 3-4 min from lobby to beach and seemed like all rooms were within a 5 min walk to restaurants, pools, beach etc. 

Speaking of the beach:  This resort has a great beach….wide with several different areas (family, adults only, etc). There were always plenty of loungers and this was one of the few AI resorts we have been to where you didn’t have to wake up early and head to the beach to try to claim some beach chairs so that was a huge huge plus.  There was an onshore wind the entire time we were there which unfortunately brought in the sargassum (which is rare in Dec) so that was a big bummer as it impacted guests wanting to get in the water (not to mention affected the color of the water). Probably the only disappointment of the whole trip was the resort did not rake up the seaweed from the beach until like day 5-6 when it really started to pile up. Again, special thanks to Angelo for taking care of us on the beach…moving chairs for us, bringing us drinks, etc. 

Pools:  We had a swim up room so really just walked thru the common pool areas but like the beach areas there seemed to be plenty of chairs for everyone. Another bonus to this resort is they have Bali beds available for free in the pool areas and they seemed to be readily available. The main pool was huge and had a swim up bar so seemed a bit livelier and there was a smaller pool that was more chill as well. Both pools were right on the beach. 

Food:  As mentioned above, we had a butler who did a great job taking care of all of our reservations so can’t comment on that process but we all thought the food was above average for an AI resort. Breakfast at the buffet was pretty standard for AI resorts. There were 2 main lunch options…the buffet and Kanna and we thought both were quite good for AI. Buffet was pretty standard with 2 notable additions…sushi (which was surprisingly good) and just outside the buffet they had either some sort of grill station or paella station every day. I will say that I was a bit disappointed in the lack of seafood options at the a la carte restaurants but, for the most part, the a la carte restaurants were above average for AI.

Overall, we would say that the Paradisus is the best AI resort we have been to and would highly recommend.

A few wishes:  for pool and beach side food service, bathrooms at the beach and pool could be upgraded, a hot tub, more treadmills at the gym, and softer pillows.
