Empezaré por lo que no me gustó:

* Contraté un servicio externo de transfer aeropuerto - hotel, el vehiculo era modesto, cuando llegamos al hotel nadie del personal saludó ni mucho menos ofrecieron ayudar con el equipaje, cosa que no pasaba cuando llegan vehículos alta gama. 

* Hice mi reserva a través del servicio de Concierge de AMEX, la cotización enviada difería de la confirmación de la reserva en varios items. tuve que preguntar al concierge de AMEX para que validaran con el hotel y así lograr que respetaran lo cotizado.

Ahora lo que me gustó:

* La habitación aunque sencilla muy comoda, el personal revisaba constantemente que el minibar estuviera bien. Me obsequieron una tabla de quesos y un vino, estaba delicioso.

* Las instalaciones impecables, espacios agradables y tranquilos, podía moverme fácilmente entre las diferentes áreas del hotel sin tener que recorrer grandes distancias. 

* La comida deliciosa, el buffet aunque es un poco pequeño, la comida era de buena calidad y de buen gusto, los restaurantes de especialidad son excelentes. Aquí quiero destacar el apoyo del señor Eduardo Bustamante que desde que llegamos nos gestionó las reservas para cada noche.

* El personal 10 de 10, desde el personal de aseo, los bartenders hasta el Concierge, todos muy amables y de un trato excelente. Aquí quiero destacar al concierge Guillermo que todo el tiempo estuvo al pendiente de nosotros.

En resumen, la estadía estuvo genial, pasé una gran semana con mi familia.

reviews.author: Vicki P
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Intro
reviews.text: This was my first all inclusive resort visit and an excellent place to start. The grounds are mature, well maintained and can be fully navigated by foot. The white sand beach is stunning. Not much seaweed at all. The rooms are fully renovated and always clean. The staff provides above average service. I’m pretty sure I didn’t pay for a concierge but still had one. Lloelis was lovely. He helped me book day trips and reserve seating at restaurants. Because I travelled solo the price was high for a one week visit, but that’s common among all inclusives. I fully recommend Palma Real for travellers who wish to relax and who are not interested in partying and tons of activities.

reviews.author: Jenenne T
reviews.title: #1 All Inclusive
reviews.text: This is the best all inclusive resort we have been to by far.  We were lucky enough to be assigned Christopher Rivera as our concierge & he was awesome.  Dinner reservations were always taken care of as well as addressing any questions or concerns we had during our stay.  As a matter of fact when we return we plan on asking for him again.  He even texted after we got home to make sure we made it safely❤️

reviews.author: YASTER DE JESUS S
reviews.title: Lo mejor 🙌🏽🙌🏽
reviews.text:
Muy buena la experiencia, habitaciones muy higiénicas, comida riquísima.

Sobre Kisdom muy buen personal, Lisbet, Alexandra, Martha, Yessica y Janilda excelente 👍👍👍

reviews.author: Camila Alejandra González
reviews.title: Buena Experiencia!
reviews.text:
Recomiendo mucho este hotel, todas las instalaciones estaban funcionando bien, buena vista, harta variedad de comida y la atención amable. Viajamos en familia y había actividades para todos los gustos. Quiero destacar las actividades creativas en las que participé en su mayoría, me voy con grandes recuerdos hechos a mano, las personas a cargo fueron muy amables conmigo recuerdo a “Pollito, Alfredo, Mini Cooper, Tana, etc.” Disfruté mucho, sin duda volvería al hotel. 

Att. Camila Alejandra González

reviews.author: trina s
reviews.title: Excellent care and service
reviews.text: Gustavo took excellent care of us, from the time we arrived, to when we left. He checked in on us throughout the days as well as made reservations and answered any questions. He is a Godsend and a real asset to the Palma Real Resort.

reviews.author: Lisa W
reviews.title: Best first time in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent a week here in December 2025. The resort was absolutely amazing. The swim up room was perfect. Clean and well kept resort. My only complaint with the room were the noisy neighbors. They had a screaming child. We were thankful we had a master suite to be able to shut the door between our living area and bedroom. Beach was beautiful and also well kept. 
The service at our pool was great, exceeded our expectations. 
My second complaint was the buffet food always seemed to be cold. No matter what time I went, and the food was on heaters but still cold. Disappointing but would not keep me from staying here again. Hopefully the resort will be able to change something to keep that from happening. 
Also wanted to mention, the bell boys were the extremely helpful if you wanted to venture off like shopping.

reviews.author: Fernanda X
reviews.title: Ótima experiência!
reviews.text: Fomos de lua de mel e tivemos uma ótima experiência! Fomos pelo The Reserve, o que traz comodidade de área sempre disponível na praia e piscina. Nosso concierge Gustavo sempre solicito, fes nossas reservas nos restaurantes e nos auxiliou sempre que precisamos, deixando nossa viagem mais confortável! O restaurante Sante foi o nosso preferido!

reviews.author: youngeee
reviews.title: Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our vacation at Paradisus Palma Real was great! We stayed with Reserve status, which gave us bigger rooms, butler services, an exclusive restaurant, and a boat excursion. We especially appreciated the hospitality from Alam, who was our butler who helped us starting from checkin to making dinner reservations, informing us of daily activities, and making sure we had any problems addressed. He helped us get instant feedback for room maintenance requests and additional requests we had. The food at the resort overall was ok, but some days certain menus weren't available. We particularly recommend the italian trattoria. The beach in front of the resort was the best too!

reviews.author: B T
reviews.title: Great resort, excellent concierge service!
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a great resort! Wonderful people and great food. I would say our favorite place to eat was Flora (Dominican food). Our concierge, Emmanuel, is the best. He made sure to get us everything we needed throughout our stay. His response was very timely and he even though he wasn’t feeling well he fought through to be here for us. God bless that man. 
The rooms were okay, wish the shower was a bit bigger, but overall it had everything we needed. 
Overall a wonderful place to be for a resort. Emmanuel took the experience over the top. Please him a raise and promotion!

reviews.author: Brian K
reviews.title: Everything was excellent.  The We don’t want to leave.  You have a wonderful and beautiful place here and we would love.
reviews.text: Gustavo.  Everything was wonderful at the resort.  The service, food and hospitality was excellent . Gustavo’s service was wonderful.  We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and look forward to returning in the future.  The pool and beaches we also so clean and maintained.  This was all very excellent.

reviews.author: Jay W
reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Breathtaking 50th Birthday at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
I returned to Paradisus in the Dominican Republic to celebrate my 50th birthday, and after seven years away, I can say it absolutely did not disappoint! From the moment I arrived, the front desk provided an immediate, warm welcome that set the tone for the entire stay.
The highlight of my trip was being paired with the most amazing concierge, Alam. He is truly exceptional. Alam has an incredible spirit and a way of making you feel like his absolute priority, even though he was managing several other guests. He ensured every single one of my needs was taken care of with genuine care.
Alam’s level of service "caused an uproar" in the best way possible—he truly made the experience memorable. Anyone lucky enough to be helped by him will be well taken care of.
The resort itself is beautiful and breathtaking. It was the perfect backdrop to commemorate my 50th birthday. I had a truly amazing time and I will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Anya
reviews.title: Loved our stay!! <3
reviews.text:
Service: The service was incredible, all the staff are amazing. A special thank you to Samuil at the front desk who was incredibly welcoming, offered fantastic recommendations  and made our experience so much better! Also a big thank you to the guy at the omelet station on the far right side of the buffet (did not get his name) but he was soo friendly and greeted us with a smile every day. The eggs were soo perfectly made! :)

Location: Perfect location, our room was in the middle section (per request) and we were super close to everything. The beach and pool are a 2 minute walk from the main building.

Rooms: The rooms were very clean and amazing, we had the basic garden view room with a king size bed and it felt so luxury. Definitely worth the value. 

Noise Level: Quieter resort and not as many beach venders as other places have which was super nice. 

Beach: Super clean beach (they clean seaweed even before sunrise so by the time people wake up in the morning, everything is so perfect). Less vendors on the beach than other resorts and much quieter here. Unlimited towels and no card rules so this was super nice. There were always chairs available so did not need to wake up super early to occupy seats.

reviews.author: Rob D
reviews.title: Our experience was exceptional.
reviews.text:
We just arrived home from our unforgettable three-week stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort, and I wanted to share how thrilled we were to return for our second visit. The warmth and professionalism of everyone at the resort truly made our experience outstanding, and it is the incredible staff who transform a beautiful location into a memorable getaway. I would like to take this opportunity to acknowledge the following individuals and share a few highlights that made our stay so special.

Our Concierge, Alam Molina, was exceptional throughout our visit. Alam consistently checked in to ensure we had everything we needed, and on several occasions, they went out of their way to accommodate special requests that made us feel truly cared for. When we return, we will definitely be requesting Alam to be our concierge again.
At the Ginger Bar, Anthony and Jorge greeted me every morning with a friendly smile and had my coffee orders prepared exactly as I liked, without me even needing to ask. Their attention to detail and welcoming attitude made each morning especially pleasant. In the evenings, Yisauri, our server, provided my wife and me with the same outstanding level of service, always ensuring we felt comfortable and well looked after.

At the Ginger Bar, Anthony and Jorge greeted me every morning with a friendly smile and had my coffee orders prepared exactly as I liked, without me even needing to ask. Their attention to detail and welcoming attitude made each morning especially pleasant. In the evenings, Yisauri, our server, provided my wife and me with the same outstanding level of service, always ensuring we felt comfortable and well looked after.

During breakfast at Lunchbox, hostess Jennifer greeted us with a radiant smile and made us feel genuinely welcome every day. Junior’s exceptional service stood out so much that we always chose to sit in their section whenever possible; their positive energy truly set the tone for our mornings.

We spent most of our time at the Reserve Beach, where the "Dream Team"—Rafael and Yuderi—extended their friendship and made us feel like part of their group. Gilberto also took great care of us by attentively looking after our drink requests and treating us as friends, while Martin consistently provided outstanding customer service throughout our stay.

Finally, I want to recognize Paolo and Diego for listening to my concerns and taking the time to follow up with me, demonstrating true dedication to guest satisfaction.

Thank you again to everyone at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort for making our stay so memorable. Your outstanding hospitality has ensured that we will eagerly look forward to returning for another unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Evan R
reviews.title: Best Hôtel in punta cana
reviews.text:
Super bonne expérience c’était incroyable ! Super bonne équipe très souriante avec Fernando et Juan 
Chambres refaite tout les jours à la perfection

reviews.author: penelopepeni
reviews.title: PARADISUS PALMA REAL
reviews.text: Para ser un cinco estrellas un diamante me esperaba mucho más .La opción que escogí fue un todo incluido solo adultos y fue un tanto decepcionante.

reviews.author: Linda T
reviews.title: Merry Christmas was had by all!!
reviews.text: Our family group ages 17-87 had a great time. There was something for everyone!  Service was excellent in all areas. Our pool attendants Juan and Julia were excellent as was our concierge Alam was superb. He answered a million questions, completed extra accommodations (a scooter rental at the last minute) and made sure all of the inexperienced travelers in our group got to the airport on time. We couldn’t have asked for better service. The resort is large and requires lots of walking so if walking is hampered in anyway you should rent a scooter for a more enjoyable stay. An extra $40/day but worth it!  Alam will take care of the rental.

reviews.author: Jessica D
reviews.title: A Christmas vacation to remember!
reviews.text: We traveled to Paradisus Palma Real with family for a Christmas vacation to remember and this beautiful resort did not disappoint. The property is immaculate and beautiful. From the moment we arrived our concierge Alam made certain we had all we needed with a smile. He arranged dinner reservations, transfers and checked on us several times daily, seeking our group out at the pool and prior to dinners. He also arranged a beautiful birthday cake for my mother’s birthday celebration! Our rooms were cleaned top to bottom daily and minibar restocked. We slept peacefully in comfy beds. We enjoyed the many pools and the white sand beaches with plenty of lounges, towels and impeccable drinks and food service. We highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Alex D
reviews.title: Alam was amazing
reviews.text: Alam made us feel at home. He tended to our every need. I had a wonderful time here at this resort. The food, culture, and overall friendliness of everyone made this trip awesome.

reviews.author: Olivia D
reviews.title: Friendly staff, beautiful resort, yummy drinks
reviews.text: We had a great time. Beautiful beach, friendly and helpful staff. Beautiful resort and so many pools. Flora restaurant is a must-try! Great coffee bar and drinks. Alam, our concierge was super friendly and responsive. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jose A
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Martin en la playa, Kelvin en el concierge y Miranda y José en el Santé nos hiciero pasar una estancia magnifica en Punta Cana. Afortundamente había muy pocas algas en la playa.

reviews.author: Jillian L
reviews.title: Fantastic trip!
reviews.text:
This entire experience was top notch. The facility is beautiful. The service was phenomenal. The beach and pools were clean, safe, with plenty of seating.
Our concierge, Alam, is personable, fun and attentive. He was able to take care of our large family with ease!

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: This is definitely a 5 star resort. The food is amazing the service is exceptional and everyone is so welcoming.
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real was once again perfect!! This was our second trip to the resort. The service is always exceptional. At the beach, Enrique, Amanda, and Yasmalilin went above and beyond every single day—attentive, friendly, and always smiling. Breakfast each morning was a highlight thanks to Rosanna and Yernita at the buffet. Their warm greetings, kindness, and attention to detail set the tone for a perfect day. We are already planning our return trip!!

reviews.author: WilsonDutraSampaio
reviews.title: Amazing Place and nice experiencie!
reviews.text: We loved this hotel and staff, amazing experience, becausd they’ve arranhed our wedding in two days, and it was perfect!

reviews.author: Suzie F
reviews.title: Thank you Gabriel and all 🙏🏾
reviews.text: This entire vacation has been nothing but a breeze. I enjoyed every day. Other than cleanliness, we know that eating is the most important part in the midst of all the activities. And when it came to dining service, help with appointments and waitresses needs. I would like to acknowledge the manager Virtudes and the best most sweetest, caring heart server, Gabriel. Thank you Gabriel for treating us like your own. Helping us with all our questions and having such a pure soul. May God bless you abundantly for having such beautiful heart. I hope to see you again. 🙌🏾🎉THANK YOU!!

reviews.author: TravelingAroundForFun
reviews.title: Fantastic resort!
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After staying at three different resorts, I feel like I actually have a solid point of comparison and this one was by far the best experience overall.

The service was fantastic from start to finish. Every single person I encountered was professional, warm, and genuinely attentive. The property itself feels very peaceful, with greenery everywhere, which made it easy to fully relax.

I upgraded to The Reserve and it was absolutely worth it. Our butler, Yaleidi, was incredible. She checked in on us daily, helped secure dinner reservations, and made sure everything ran smoothly throughout our stay. Compared to other butler experiences I’ve had, she’s a true 10 out of 10.

The gym was excellent, fully stocked with weights, water, and towels. Those things may sound basic, but they are often missing at other resorts and here everything was consistently well maintained. I also never had trouble finding space at the pool or the beach, which made the experience feel calm and unhurried.

In the evenings, there was always something happening, including live bands and relaxing aromatics, which added a nice touch without feeling over the top.

Overall, this was such a fantastic stay. Thoughtful service, beautiful surroundings, and a well run resort. I would absolutely come back and would recommend it without hesitation.

reviews.author: Jasmine Z
reviews.title: Dream vacation, amazing service thanks to Alam.
reviews.text: Our family trip was amazing. Atmosphere was great. Staff was overall attentive. We stayed at the adults only side, beach was clean. The actual beach did not have any rocks, smooth ocean floor. Food was superb. However, what made the vacation amazing was our concierge Alam Molina. He created a group chat for  the family to keep in touch. He even helped us celebrate a very special family event. Top service, this is exactly the vacation we needed.

reviews.author: Adam M
reviews.title: Ask for Alam
reviews.text: Spent an awesome time at Palma Real Reserve for a week vacation. Perfect beautiful weather, good food, cold drinks and awesome beach. Rafael is the man on the beach! The best was our concierge ALAM! He took care of us like family and set up everything we needed/ wanted. Definitely recommend him!

reviews.author: Paul T
reviews.title: Would go again
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Rafael at the beach is your hook up for all your drink needs. Alam the concierge was the best. Would definitely think about coming back again.

reviews.author: David D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real truly exceptional
reviews.text:
Let me start with the most important person who manages our stay and makes sure that our time here is paradise—our concierge, Zenovia. From the days leading up to our arrival until we leave, she takes care of everything for us, ensuring that all our needs and wants are met. This is the third year that Zenovia has been our concierge, and as always, she has proven to be the best concierge on the island.

Next to the beach, the staff at 96° bar are all exceptional. Gilberto is always so friendly and happy, making sure that he has stocked whatever beverages we want. Martin and Yidaris make sure that our favorite spot is saved and set up for us. Rafael checks in on us throughout the day, ensuring our drinks are always full and that we have everything we need for a beachside meal, whether it’s pizza, hamburgers, or nachos.

Our favorite restaurant is Sante, followed by Flora. But the staff at Sante are above all the rest. From the moment you walk in, you are greeted with smiles and laughter, whether for breakfast, lunch, or dinner the menu at Sante has many delicious selections. The waitstaff are all very friendly, especially Misael. We noticed that his smile is contagious; anyone who is served by him also winds up smiling and having a great time. He lights up the restaurant.

The view from our beachfront room is really what makes the vacation worth it, whether it’s the sunrises or the moon shining on the ocean. Housekeeping does a good job of keeping everything clean and stocked with what we need.

This is our fourth stay at Paradisus Palma Real, and we are looking forward to our fifth stay next year.

reviews.author: Sarah T
reviews.title: Would come back!
reviews.text: Alam is great, attentive and responsive! Rafael at the beach bar was fantastic! Would totally recommend coming to this resort!

reviews.author: Francis
reviews.title: An experience to remember 😉
reviews.text: Specially at Santé restaurant, where Juan the manager made a big difference with his attitude and excellent service 👌 the food is excellent, the whole team is A++ er certainly highly recommend this restaurant for breakfast, lunch snd dinner👍

reviews.author: mjimenez2025
reviews.title: Personal
reviews.text: Dalmis, muchas gracias por hacer que todo merezca la pena!!! Mereces reconocimiento! Mención también para Basilio, amable y discreto!!

reviews.author: Farruca Fernández-Couto Maristany
reviews.title: Estancia en the reserve con Jendry como concierge🥰🥰
reviews.text: Me he quedado 7 noches con mi pareja en una habitación en el área de The Reserve. La estancia fue increíble y 100% recomendable para el que dude entre alojarse en The Reserve o quedarse en una habitación normal. Para nosotros, lo mejor de quedarse en una habitación en The Reserve ha sido poder contar con la atención de Jendry como nuestro concierge durante toda nuestra estancia. Desde el primer día estuvo atento a nosotros, primero enseñándonos en el hotel y dándonos los mejores consejos para aprovechar nuestra estancia y disfrutar de todos los restaurantes y actividades que ofrece el hotel. A primera hora de la mañana, Jendry se encargaba de enviarnos la reserva para el restaurante temático que nos interesaba para cenar esa noche, además todos los días nos buscaba para saludarnos y preguntarnos si necesitábamos algo o si estaba todo a nuestro gusto, ofreciendo una atención 5 estrellas. Además, tuvo detalles con nosotros que no habíamos solicitado y que solo podemos agradecerle, desde un detalle romántico en la habitación a facilitarnos un late check-out que nos vino de maravilla para poder aprovechar nuestro último día al máximo. A la atención de Jendry hay que sumarle la zona de playa reservada, piscinas privadas, restaurante privado y una experiencia en catamarán a una playa virgen, lo cual nos lleva a recomendar The Reserve a cualquier persona que tuviese la duda ente reservar una habitación normal o en esta zona.

reviews.author: Alvaro C
reviews.title: Alojamiento en The Reserve
reviews.text: Nos hemos alojado en pareja una semana en una habitación con vistas al mar en The Reserve. Lo primero que debemos destacar es la atención de Jendry, nuestro concierge durante toda nuestra estancia. El primer día nos hizo un tour por el hotel y nos dio las mejores recomendaciones posibles para nuestra estancia, desde que hacer en el hotel hasta qué restaurantes deberíamos probar en base a nuestros gustos, encargándose el de reservarnos todos los días en el restaurante que le indicábamos a primera hora de la mañana. Además, se encargó de hacernos un detalle especial en la habitación sin haberlo solicitado y realizar cualquier tipo de reserva de actividades que se puede hacer tanto en el hotel como en los hoteles de la empresa Meliá que lo rodean, ya que también nos reservó la Hidroterapia en el Hotel Zel, por ejemplo. Sin duda, repetiríamos la experiencia The Reserve en este hotel, y nos encantaría volver a repetir con Jendry como Concierge si fuese posible. Destacar también que la reserva en The Reserve te incluye el acceso a dos piscinas súper tranquilas, con un muy buen servicio, así como una zona reservada en la playa con camas y tumbonas súper cómodas, eso y el restaurante Santé, perfecto para desayunar tranquilamente, hacen que la experiencia en The Reserve sea totalmente recomendable.

reviews.author: CONSTANZA D
reviews.title: Gracias Carlos de actividades, por hacer nuestras vacaciones increíbles e inigualables
reviews.text:
El hotel Paradisus palma real es muy hermoso, siempre tiene diferentes actividades muy divertidas y para todas las edades
El único detalle es que en el desayuno no se toma en consideración la alergia a la lactosa, fuimos a la playa y es hermosa y limpia los chicos siempre están limpiadora me encanta, el restaurante flora y mascalzone son los  dos restaurante que mas me encantaron, pero estas vacaciones no pudieran ser increíbles sin el equipo de animación hemos viajado por muchos hoteles pero este nos a dejado impactados con la calidad del personal nos enamoramos de su país y estamos totalmente de acuerdo en volver a pasar más vacaciones en este hermoso hotel,  gracias a estas personas que hicieron mis vacaciones inolvidable, darles las gracias a Carlos, Alfredo, Johan, porque son un buen equipo de animación en baile, en otra ocasión nos gustaría volver al Hotel Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Alicia A
reviews.title: GRACIS Carlos de actividades
reviews.text:
El hotel es muy lindo,   amplias habitaciones.. piscinas es super grande  muy limpia .. Me encanta la playa la gente es muy amable la comida es muy variada y deliciosa me encanta todo.
La animación de los chicos es muy entretenida y la musica es super buena me gusta mucho..
Carlos..Alfredo..Johan..son muy buenos y tienen muchas energía esos chicos y son muy atentos y entretenidos.  Me encantó el show rock y show latino
En general todo es espectacular!!.
Volveremos de todas maneras.

reviews.author: Audrey C
reviews.title: Would 100% recommend to everyone
reviews.text:
My 14th all inclusive experience. Would 100% recommend this hotel. We upgraded to The Reserve. I’m not sure if it’s worth. The private restaurant is nice for lunch, and the exclusive beach section and pool are nice. We just don’t know if we would recommend paying the upgrade. 
There are many adult private pool sections. I would not come here if I had kids over 1 year old. There are no places for kids. A baby under 1 is fine, but other than that this is not a resort for kids. 

Being a guest at this hotel you have access to Republic Fun which is like 2 minutes away by cart. You ask the bell boys to take you and there is the best mini putt ever and great entertainment. Definitely go!! 

Pros: the food was beyond excellent. (Better than Club Med Cancun). The Asian and Italian restaurants are EXCELLENT. The rooms are so beautiful with snacks and little extras (body lotion, etc). The pools are big. The chairs and sunbeds make the difference!! The beach section was beautiful! We walked further on the beach and the other hotels  did not have a machine to remove algae. This hotel removes algae every morning which makes a difference. The coffee at the Ginger bar is AMAZING. The drinks are AMAZING like I have never seen this. They are amazing at every bar. 

Cons: the animation is not the best. The staff does not really seem to care if you give tip. Overall the staff is nice! There are A LOT of sellers on the beach and they are really annoying. Some of them even go into the resort which is too much. We understand it is their job but each day we were at the beach and the same vendors ask 3-4 times each if you want to buy their things or get a massage. It’s just harassement at this point. Each day we would have at least 30-40 vendors asking us to buy things. 

Special mention to Andres which was so nice to us. Also special mention to Ciari I believe (hope I spell her name right). Also, Anthony every morning at the Ginger Bar for the coffee was so nice.

reviews.author: Trail784650
reviews.title: Great Holiday @ Palma Real
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic time at Palma Real for our Thanksgiving this year! 

The facility is right there on the beach! We had a great swim up suite that was just right for our family. There was a living space and a separate bedroom. This was nice for when our toddler needed his afternoon naps, so an adult could have a space to relax and could even enjoy the patio and pool. 

For beach time, we headed to the cabanas in the “Kanna” section where Enrique and Yaslainin were awesome! They checked in regularly and made sure we were happy and comfortable! 

For other dinner and other things (dinner, spa, golf), Francicso with the circle program was our assigned concierge, and he was super helpful answering questions and getting reservations coordinated, and being our go-to person! 

Overall, we had a wonderful vacation!!

reviews.author: Discover768070
reviews.title: go to this place!
reviews.text: this place is amazing!  the cleanliness is top tier,  the staff is helpful and friendly.  Luis and Luis at Kicks sports bar are amazing!!!!

reviews.author: Anne D
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: Arisleida was wonderful!! She was totally on top of our needs, lovely as she could be, friendly, sweet - we loved her and can’t wait to come back and see her again.  Antonio also super helpful in getting us reservations for dinner.

reviews.author: CLEBOT Marisa d... C
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus maravilloso!!!!!!
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bello, el sector reserve tiene todas las comodidades que realmente figuran en la web. Mencion aparte es a todo el personal del hotel por su maravilloso trato y un apartado muy especial para EMMANUEL nuestro coordinador que realmente es maravilloso por su contacto diario permanente para pasarnos las actividades, reserva en restaurante y demás necesidades

reviews.author: Tusti G
reviews.title: Mis expectativas en un viaje familiar a República Dominicana
reviews.text: Pasamos unos días excelentes en el Meliá Paradisus Palma Real. Actividades muy buenas y para todas las edades. Que haya zona solo de adultos es estupendo. Gracias a nuestro Concergeri Eriol que nos informaba todos los días de las actividades, facilitó las reservas y nos trató con tanto cariño y tubo tantos  detalles con nosotruque nos hizo las vacaciones mucho más agradables.

reviews.author: Shelley M
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma
reviews.text: A very enjoyable week holiday. Great clean resort with attentive staff and great food. Beautiful beach, great weather. DO NOT brush your teeth with the tap water though. Of group of 4, 3 of us had some stomach issues but the 1 who used bottled from the start was fine. Not serious enough to ruin holiday just a note to avoid.

reviews.author: Trail24462739312
reviews.title: Relaxing at the Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Our Concierge Emmanuel at the Melia Palma Real was amazing. Impeccable service and a wonderful person too. We stayed in the Reserve section. Spa and Beach Attendent Martin were great as well.

reviews.author: Griffin O
reviews.title: Relaxation and Great Service

reviews.text:
Wonderful location with a beautiful facility.   The staff was friendly and attentive      Our Concierges, Christopher and Yaleidi , were professional and hard working.    They took care of all of our requests quickly and efficiently.     
   The rooms and the public space were very clean and well kept.     The pools were sparkling. reviews.author: Jim L
reviews.title: Best experience with Melia so far!
reviews.text:
We have been members of the Melia vacation club system since 2006, initially Club Melia members and now Circle this year.  We stayed for many years at the neighboring Melia Caribe-Tropical/Melia Caribe Beach, as well as time in Cozumel, Cancun and the former resort in Costa Rica.  Paradisus Palma Real Nov23-Dec 1, 2025 was the best experience so far!

First if you are Circle member, request Anayely Rivera as your concierge...hands down the best concierge we have had in years!

Best bartender at the swim-up pool bar was hands down Jorge...amazing service, always a smile!

The best service we received in The Lunch Box was from Mary...buffet service can a little crazy, but she was always happy and went above and beyond to make sure we felt like we were special guest amongst the crowd.

Lastly, the best bartender in the resort was Luis at the Ginger Bar...not just a bartender, he was a skilled mixologist who obviously took his craft seriously, adding just enough flair and showmanship when he made drinks to make it fun to watch him work, without being over-the-top/too showy. Every drink was perfectly made!

As for restaurants, Mina steak house was the best meat we had during the week, and for Dominican seafood dishes/presentation, definitely try Flora.

The only minor negative was housekeeping. While the room was always cleaned when we got back from the beach/pool to get ready for dinner, we missed the little flourishes such as towel animals, flowers in the room, or turndown service which we enjoyed at other Melia resorts.

reviews.author: Lili S
reviews.title: Amazing stay and exceptional service from staff!
reviews.text: As someone who has traveled to a variety of places and stayed at many hotels, I was blown away from the service of Paradisus from the moment I arrived to the entrance. The dedication and willingness to help and accommodate from all the staff was something I have never experienced before! we stayed at the reserve side which I would definitely recommend. The reserve has a seperate beach and pool which was amazing, and bars that have higher shelf liquor and an extra restaurant with better food, and a fully inclusive mini bar restocked every day, which was so worth it! We had a small issue with our meal at Sante, and the staff there (Miasel, Melqui) went above and beyond to make up for this, and the chef made us a special dinner with lobster, champagne and more. Christopher was our concierge and he texted us every morning with the actives and found us in person every day to ask if we needed anything. He also decorated the bathtub with a happy birthday sign made out of flower petals! Johan, Alfredo and Fernando from the Entertainment team were great dancers and super fun to be around. Yuderi, Martin, Gilberto, Rafael, who were amazing beach servers and bartenders at the Reserve beach and made our bed/drinks everyday. Maximo who worked at the winery was very knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Pool bartenders, Alberto, Jonathan, and Jorge were amazing as well. Other bartenders and waiters that went above and beyond were, Miguel, Jhojan, Diorgenis, Victor, Jean, Eduardo, Luis, Yefry, Jean, Miguel, Richard, and Manolo. I have never had that much of a positive experience with a resort staff until I came here. I will definitely be back on service alone, but not to mention the amount of space in the room and the size of the pools. Everything was modern, up to date, and we had an amazing time. The food was a hit or miss, but that's expected at an all inclusive. 10/10 stay, thank you to all!

reviews.author: Alejandro S
reviews.title: Amabilidad y calidez humana
reviews.text:
Nuestra estadía fue muy buena, muy lindas instalaciones, la comida muy buena y variada, sin embargo lo mas espectacular fue la amabilidad y profesionalismo de todo el personal, especialmente el de nuestra concierge Zenovia.
Zenovia se encargó de que nuestra estadía fuera inolvidable en todos los aspectos, gracias a su calidez humana y su atención al más mínimo detalle y apoyo con nuestros pedidos. ¡Muchas gracias Zenovia, espero que nos volvamos a cruzar pronto!

Totalmente recomendado.

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.title: Amazing Stay at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, everything about Paradisus Palma Real exceeded our expectations. The resort is stunning, and the rooms were immaculately clean and perfectly maintained—truly a five-star experience. Every detail throughout the property was in order, making it feel both luxurious and welcoming.

A special shout-out to our incredible concierge, Yaleidi! She went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. From helping us secure reservations to organizing travel plans and keeping us informed about all the resort’s events, her attentiveness and professionalism were outstanding. She made everything effortless and stress-free.

The all-inclusive experience was top-notch, with beautiful pools, and plenty of activities to keep everyone entertained. If you’re looking for a relaxing, worry-free getaway in the Dominican Republic, Paradisus Palma Real is the place to be.

reviews.author: pjavier2025
reviews.title: Excelente estadía Palma Real
reviews.text: Recibimos un trato super especial, muchas personas brillantes y un  lugar sumamente acogedor, desde sus habitaciones, restaurantes y área de recreación.

reviews.author: Tour59258534236
reviews.title: Amazing family holiday
reviews.text: We had family of 8 over the Thanksgiving week and the resort was perfect for us.  Alam took care of our every need, scheduling dinner and activities, and greeting us with a smile every morning.  He made sure our checkout was seamless.  The weather was perfect and we enjoyed the entertainment every night.

reviews.author: Jodi S
reviews.title: Great Resort for people of all ages
reviews.text:
This is our second year coming to the Paradisus. Last year we were 11 people and this year we grew to 16, spanning three generations, three sets of grandparents, and teens from 18–21.

First, the rooms are perfect—spacious, comfortable, with great views and a layout that makes it easy to come and go without disturbing anyone. The balcony is lovely.

Second, the spaces around the property are magical. Whether you’re by the pool, at the beach, or wandering the grounds, there are so many beautiful corners to explore.

Third, the coffee bar is my absolute #1 favorite. The staff is wonderful, and Anthony takes unbelievable care of everyone. I wasn’t feeling well and he made me a special tea that truly helped. He was warm, attentive, and brought a huge smile every time we saw him.

We also had a fantastic concierge, Alam, who helped organize restaurants for our large group, arrange taxis, and handle the million requests that come with traveling with a family this size. He was kind, patient, and went all out for my nephew’s 21st birthday with a personalized cake.

It’s a wonderful family resort, and we’ll be back to continue discovering more. of the DR’s magic!

reviews.author: Owen H
reviews.title: Perfect Thanksgiving Break Vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 5 night trip over Thanksgiving with our kids, parents and siblings and had one of our all time great vacations. Starting with the stellar service of our concierge Alam who helped us 24/7 with everything we needed to Juan who made the best omelettes I’ve ever had. The service from everyone was great and ultra friendly, the rooms, pools, ocean and entertainment were also all great and we really liked the food as well. The Thanksgiving buffet in particular was awesome. We had a blast and will be back next year.

reviews.title: Me encantó mi estancia en el hotel. La playa es realmente preciosa, con un ambiente tranquilo que invita a relajarse.

reviews.title: Beautiful! Highly Recommend.
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Paradisus Palma Real for a week from November 8-15.  It couldn't have been better or more beautirful! We stayed in the Reserve with a walk out from our room to the beach.  Our butler, Gustavo, was amazing!  He did an excellent job making sure everything was perfect for our 40th wedding anniversary.  He even left us flowers and champagne in our room! Rafael and Martin took great care of us on the beach. The food was delicious. Truly, this resort is our favorite so far out of our Caribean vacations.  Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Seeing Golf in the Name of the Resort  kind of expected more Golf activities maybe free lessons or free driving range access or very discounted tee times none of that was mentioned other wise excellent

reviews.author: Ashley W
reviews.title: Mother and Daughter Birthday Adventures!
reviews.text: My daughter and I traveled to the DR to Punta Cana and Bávaro Beach. This was my 5th trip to the DR and we had a blast! Both of our Birthdays fall in the month of November. This trip decided on Paradisus Palma Real Resort. This Resort sits on the Sugar White Sands of one of the World’s Best Beach!  It was so soft and did not stick like some sand!  Paradisus Palma Real was beautiful. Our room was spotless and very nice as well as comfortable!  We averaged 9 hours of sleep each night!  From Check In to Check Out 5 days  was the perfect vacation! We meet wonderful people from the US and Canada!  The staff was incredible and made us feel like part of the family!  We had a wonderful young man named Christopher as our Concierge the whole time we were there!  He took care of like family, fulfilling every wish we had! He made reservations for us for every dinner, gave us tour of the whole resort and explained the different levels of reservations! We swam at one of the many Adults Only Pools. It was the closest one to Building 5 where our Room was. We loved our bartenders Alberto and Leticia!  They were fun as well as taking good care of us!  Every Morning started of fabulous with Frank in the buffet taking excellent care of us. He filled my Yeti and my Daughter’s Yeti water bottle with fresh water and ice to help keep us hydrated all day (even though we were drinking Pina Coladas and Mamajuana too)!  On the beach we got excellent service from Yuderi and at the Ginger Bar with Luis!  The Food was great at the all of the restaurants and found my favorites each!  I recommend Paradisus Palma Real and all of my friends (family)! Be sure to ask for Christopher. If he’s not available, it might be because I adopted him as a son!  We had a blast!❤️💙

He took care of all of our dinner and spa reservations and greeted us each morning with his big smile and great attitude. Martin and Gilberto made our beach experience each day perfect! Our Bali beds and chairs were  waiting for us each morning and the drinks were always cold and tasty! As always, I visited Gladys at the Yhi Spa and can honestly say she gives the best massages I’ve ever had. We have come to call the Paradisus our home away from home and can’t wait until our next visit!!

reviews.author: jent1005
reviews.title: Family Group - Palma Real!!!!!
reviews.text: We have been visiting the Palma Real since 2013.  We enjoy returning and seeing familiar faces as well as making new friends.  We are Circle Black members and it would be wonderful if we could streamline the check-in process online ahead of time.  We could and would supply all passport information prior to arrival if this was possible.  I can never seem to get the technology to work ahead of time.  Please give a LOUD shout out to the entire staff at Flora!!!!! We had a simply amazing night/dinner with them and their service and friendly demeanor made the night special.  Thank you to Gustavo each morning at Sante for his service.  Angelo at the Reserve Pool needs to be paid more - he is fantastic and deserves a raise!!!  Gladys at the spa is a special lady and we love her.  But the true winners of our trip are the Activities Crew. In all the years I have been visiting no one has made a bigger impression on me than Carlos.  He works non-stop - all day, all night.  That young man is going places!  His team with Fernando and Jairo made our trip.  These guys are killing it!!!!  Do all you can to keep them :)  See you soon and thank you!!!

reviews.author: Luc B
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Réal The Reserve - Highly recommended for couples seeking an upscale beach escape.
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real – Adults Only “The Reserve” (November 5–14, 2025)

Upon choosing Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, my wife and I were initially hesitant about the resort’s scale. However, staying at The Reserve—the adults-only section—transformed our experience. This area brings the resort down to a human scale, offering a self-contained oasis with everything one could wish for, and then some.

Tennis courts were conveniently located a short walk away at an adjacent property, and the same area hosted the spa’s hydrotherapy pools. That said, excellent spa services were also available directly onsite. Guests can also enjoy a 27-hole golf course or access the renowned Rafael Nadal Tennis Center, both available for an additional fee.

What truly sets the resort apart is its people. Every staff member went out of their way to know us and ensure our comfort. A special mention goes to Martin, the best beach valet we’ve encountered in over 30 years of all-inclusive travel. His personal attention elevated our stay—our favorite beach spot was always ready, with fresh towels, drinks flowing, and everything impeccably clean, even on days we were away on excursions.
We’d also like to recognize Gustavo, Barnelis, and Luz along with the entire crew at Santé, our preferred spot for breakfast and lunch just steps from the beach. Barnelis, the always-smiling hostess, set the tone each morning, while Luz and Gustavo made sure service flowed perfectly throughout our meals. Their warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail made dining there an absolute pleasure.

Evening dining options were varied, including Japanese hibachi, Mexican, Italian, steakhouse, and international buffets. Most dishes were well executed, though not extraordinary—admittedly, our expectations are high as seasoned foodies. The fine dining restaurant, curated by local chef Leandro Díaz, offered refined takes on Dominican specialties and was a pleasant highlight. However, the overall evening dining service fell short of the resort’s otherwise high standards, which slightly impacted our overall rating.

Members of the hotel’s loyalty program enjoy a private area and an extended wine list accessible via points or direct payment. While the table wines (red, rosé, and white) were decent, true wine enthusiasts may prefer to explore the premium options.
Facilities throughout the resort were exceptional: multiple clean and expansive pools, many featuring swim-up bars; a well-equipped gym suited for maintaining fitness routines; and effortless access to non-motorized water sports equipment (with a refundable deposit). The Reserve guests also benefit from dedicated concierge service—ours, Yaleidy, consistently demonstrated care, attention, and professionalism.

Although our late flight arrival delayed initial check-in and the orientation tour, everything was quickly remedied the next morning. The resort also offers hospitality showers for guests with late departures—a thoughtful touch.
The beach itself was spectacular: clean, beautifully maintained each morning, and thoroughly enjoyable throughout the day. Entertainment staff kept things lively with optional activities at both beach and poolside.

In short, Paradisus Palma Real delivers a luxurious and relaxing experience where service excellence stands out, facilities impress, and staff genuinely care. While a few aspects of dining and evening service could improve, the overall experience far exceeded expectations.

Our rating: 4.8 out of 5. Highly recommended for couples seeking tranquility, attentive service, and an upscale beach escape.

reviews.author: Tourist54260
reviews.title: Birthday vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing vacation at Paradisus Palma real resort. We were pampered and treated like royalty. The food was amazing not like your usual all inclusive resort food. Best Dominican cuisine. Eriol was our personal concierge he exceeded all expectations. He scheduled all of our dinners, had special treats and champagne in our room every day. He made my birthday week extra special. One of our best vacations. Marion was amazing at the adult swimming pool. He’s a gem and service with a smile everyday. Roberto at the beach gave us exceptional service.  Top 10 experience.

reviews.author: Rafael T
reviews.title: Excelente hotel en Zona de Bavaro
reviews.text:
Muy buen hotel, excelente las atenciones de Chary, Laeandro, Bioni, Brandy y el staff de maleteros. Instalaciones renovadas, comida y bebida de primera calidad.

La orquesta de la noche realizó un buen espectáculo y el personal de bar Ginger muy amable.

Recomendado.

reviews.author: Ann G
reviews.title: Amazing trip, wish weather was nicer! Will definitely come back.
reviews.text: Angelo  at  the Paradisus was absolutely amazing and we never had to ask for anything he was alway on top of everything. Food was good at certain restaurants, drinks were all pretty tasty.  Had a massage and that was absolutely amazing. The beaches were nice and clean.  By far the best restaurant we had was the Tori, which was absolutely amazing. The garlic ginger sauce was to die for.

reviews.author: likestotravel61
reviews.title: Gustavo is amazing ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.text: We recently spent a week here. It was our second time staying here. It is a lovely resort but the staff make it a truly memorable experience. Gustavo was absolutely amazing. From the moment we arrived he took care of every detail, making dinner reservations, organizing special touches, and even arranging a personalized surprise for my birthday with a cake and special hand written note with warm wishes. He checked in often to see if we needed anything and always greeted us with a warm smile. Gustavo’s friendliness, attentiveness, and genuine caring made our trip truly special. We will be back again and hope to see him next time.

reviews.author: SOPHIE G
reviews.title: Mis vacaciones en Mélia Paradisus Palma Real  fueron maravillosas con las 2 veces que he venido lo he pasado genial ....
reviews.text:
Hotel muy bueno y muy hermoso
Personal muy agradables y serviceable 
Animation muy buena con animadores muy agradables (Fernando Chispa muy buen bailarin y profesional en su trabajo)

reviews.author: Christian H
reviews.title: Muy bueno!
reviews.text: El servicio era perfecto! Rosmery era nuestra concierge, pudo acomodar todo para nosotros sin problema! Vamos a regresar pronto! Esperamos Que Ella nos atienda otra vez. La comida era espectular, los tragos, la gente, el staff todo muy muy bueno. Todos les enseñaron mucho amor a nuestro hijo!

reviews.author: Pioneer36099363279
reviews.title: Très très belle semaine
reviews.text: Nous avons eu une magnifique semaine. Un service exceptionnel. Le resort n’était pas à sa pleine capacité à cause de rénovations à la piscine principale. Ce qui n’a pas empêché d’avoir un excellent service au contraire. Notre concierge Jendry faisait toutes les réservations pour nous et s’assurait que tout était au maximum.

reviews.author: Kimberly H
reviews.title: Fantastic trip!!
reviews.text: We spent the week relaxing, exploring, eating, drinking, making new friends, and losing track of time!! Fantastic trip!

reviews.author: Erick P
reviews.title: Spectacular!!!
reviews.text:
Estupenda estadía. Tuvimos algunos inconvenientes involuntarios al inicio del viaje que se resolvieron rápidamente y otro desafortunado al final de la estadía ajeno al hotel, pero finalmente es el trato cercano y las ganas de hacerte sentir como en casa que tiene el equipo del hotel, que hace que olvides pronto lo sucedido. Extraordinarias instalaciones, imponentes realmente y la playa inigualable. Ya hemos ido varias veces al hotel, conocemos de hecho todos los Melia en Punta Cana, pero este es nuestro lugar preferido, lo recomendamos siempre. También destacamos el trabajo y las atenciones de Freylin, Anderson y Jesús. Realmente sensacionales y desde acá aprovecho para enviarles un cordial saludo. Esperando que podamos volver cuanto antes, me despido.

Erick Portocarrero

reviews.author: Juan Manuel T
reviews.title: Muy buen lugar de vacaciones
reviews.text:
Excelente toda la atención y sobre todo en el lobby del círculo el sr. Lewis muy atento
Y también nuestro conserge muy atento el señor juan 
Todos muy bien

reviews.author: Tasia M
reviews.title: Great celebration in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Grounds were beautiful, room was clean and well kept. Service was lovely, especially from Leticia at the pool bar. Our concierge Jendry was very helpful and brought great energy. Thanks for making our stay enjoyable!

reviews.author: Michael V
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel with a beautiful beach! I suggest this hotel for anyone who want a beautiful experience
reviews.text: Our stay had started a little badly but our DC Christopher really saved our trip. He was available, courteous and helpful. He responded to all our requests quickly and positively. We had a great holiday thanks to him! A big thank you to you Christopher!!!

reviews.author: Passenger33240744935
reviews.title: Best resort i’ve ever been
reviews.text: Amazing experience all around, the Food was good, the staff has an amazing attitude and great service. On top of that our butler Jendry made the experience feel even more special. Thank you a lot jendry and the whole team.

reviews.author: Venture20033854234
reviews.title: Amazing trip to Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Was an amazing trip, and we were blessed with beautful weather.
Our concierge Jendry was amazing, and also fulfilled our requests.
Highly recommend !

reviews.author: Wesley L
reviews.title: Amazing service at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our family trip was amazing.  Eriol, the concierge, helped make an incredible experience for my two kids, my wife and me.  He was very helpful and made wonderful recommendations for restaurants, activities and was able to book us for a water park that my kids absolutely loved.  I would highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real as a destination for families and Eriol as a concierge

reviews.author: bruna a
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Un hotel de lujo con un servicio excepcional. Desde el primer momento, todo fue perfecto: el ambiente, las instalaciones y, sobre todo, la atención del equipo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a Marc, Jendry y Fernando del equipo de animación por su simpatía y profesionalidad — ¡hacen que cada día sea especial!
Recomiendo 100% este hotel, una experiencia verdaderamente inolvidable.

reviews.author: Susan D
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: My Destination Concierge, Eriol, made my stay go so smoothly!! I felt very pampered!! Having the adult only option was very nice. The fresh fruits at breakfast and those sent to my room were amazing!!

reviews.author: Cheryl M
reviews.title: Don't say goodbye, say 'until we meet again'
reviews.text: My husband, myself and our friends, stayed 5 nights at Paradisus Palma Real - 'The Reserve'-Adult- All Inclusive with a swim up suite. The facilities were nice and clean with a lovely view of pool and beach. The bar staff could have been more attentive to us on the room side of the pool  (for future guest benefit). The Resort staff was friendly, helpful, smiling, and generally showed excellence in their willingness to serve. Everyone consistently gave a friendly Hola or hello when passing. Bartolo was one of the first to greet us upon arrival and the last upon leaving. He definitely helped to set the positive vibe for our experience takeaway. Adriel was another with a most pleasant demeanor when ever our paths crossed. Chef Juan in The Sante Restaurant was passionate about his culinary skills and such a joy to watch!  Delicious creations-every time. We really appreciated the fresh mangos chef. Thank you! Our server Misael (at Sante Restaurant) had a great smile and consistently had a willingness to serve. Thank you! Chef Felix Raul Mejia Rodriguez "Mr Miyagi" put on quite the show during our Hibachi dinner while serving up a tasty meal. Thank you for the food and fun. Our server Jeison at Hibachi was one of 'the best'! His interactions and attitude made him pleasantly unforgettable. Yuderqui was one of our servers at The Lunch Box. Yuderqui was beautiful inside and out. Enthusiastic and pleasant she was. Thank you! Gustavo was The Best Concierge to us! He was always only a text away. He would initiate communications daily about events, itineraries, and always made it seem effortless to see that we enjoyed our every day. While there, my husband and I shared our 39th Wedding Anniversary and we want to thank Gustavo for the 'little extras'. They meant a lot!

reviews.author: JP P
reviews.title: Luxurious and extraordinary vacation
reviews.text: It was truly a amazing and luxurious  vacation at Paradisus Palma real! From the inside to outside, everything was beautifully curated! Beach, dining area, pools, room and all facilities including tennis center and even sidewalks, everything was just perfect! Especially, my personal concierge, Aurora and Andres were the best I've ever met. They were so kind and proactive helping my family to experience the best comfort during the stay! I sincerely appreciate them for all the work and professionalism. Shopping area was only 10mins of walk along the beautiful sea shore and we could found all kinds of souvenirs from there. I would definitely recommend this resort for my best friends and any important partners!!

reviews.author: Ruth M
reviews.title: Todo al alcance de nuestra comodidad, bello, tranquilo, divino el trato, jente muy respetuosa, nuestro concierge, excele
reviews.text: ruido aceptable, habitación siempre limpia, Servicio constante, el valor, al alcance de nuestro bolsillo, gran comodidad.

reviews.author: Sonia B
reviews.title: Una estancia para recordar. Trato excelente, ambiente acogedor.
reviews.text:
Pasamos unos días estupendos. Todo el personal fue encantador, sobre todo Basilio que estuvo pendiente de todo lo que necesitáramos. Todos los camareros de cualquier restaurante del hotel pendientes de que todo fuese de nuestro agrado. La comida muy buena y sobre todo los desayunos junto a la piscina que ka atención del camarero Andro fue espectacular. Tbn hubo otros camareros que nos hacían unos cócteles maravillosos pero imposible acordarme de todos sus nombres. Todos encantadores y muy serviciales. La habitación muy cómoda, sobre todo ese colchón jejeje 
Volvería a repetir encantada!! 
Lo recomiendo

reviews.author: Angelo O
reviews.title: Paradises Palma
reviews.text:
Our trip was incredible!!
It was the perfect relaxing vacation we needed. Our concierge, Eriol, made our trip extra special and made sure we had everything we needed or wanted. He was the absolute BEST!!
The beach and pools were right next to our room and the staff always made sure we had a cold drink in our hands. 
Would definitely go back tomorrow!!

reviews.author: kjwalsh320
reviews.title: Luxurious, Relaxing, Delicious
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I loved this resort! We've been to a few all inclusive resorts around the Caribbean, and this one was by far our favorite and the first one we said we need to return to ASAP. Here are a few of our highlights:
-Beautiful rooms with comfortable beds and, most importantly, excellent air conditioning
- The staff were all kind and professional. We especially appreciated our personal concierge, Adriel. He was very helpful getting us scheduled for dining and activities throughout the week. He even gave me his cell number, so he was very easy to reach. The waiter at the pool, Yeffrey, was also amazing. Excellent service and very funny.
- The whole resort was beautiful and felt like real luxury, not a cheap facade of it.
- Last but not least, the food was amazing! I have never been to a resort where the food was better than fine. The food here was excellent. We couldn't wait for the next meal. All of the restaurants and the buffet were all restaurant quality experiences that I would happily pay for back home in Chicago.

Do yourself a favor and come here for your next beach vacation!

reviews.author: Jake F
reviews.title: Amazing stay, great people, great drinks and great memories
reviews.text: We had the most amazing stay as part of our 2 year anniversary and were upgraded to the reserve which was the best experience. Our concierge Christopher really made us feel looked after and helped us with whatever we needed such as restaurant bookings and helped book us onto a boat trip to a private beach to do yoga which was included as part of the reserve! Christopher also organised beautiful decorations for the room on our anniversary which really made the trip feel special.  All of the bar staff by the reserve pool were amazing and always kept us attended to! And in the Rum republic bar the drinks were always exceptional! Miguel and Melvin there really made excellent cocktails. Flora was recommended for us to try by Christopher and it was definitely the best restaurant with its authentic Dominican food which we loved so much we went to 4 times in the end with Cesar there always making us feel welcome. We have visited Punta Cana before but this was by far the best trip we’ve ever had and will definitely look to return in the future. Thank you to all the staff who made this trip so memorable!

reviews.author: Susan O
reviews.title: Vacaciones lindas y relajadas
reviews.text: Todo super bien muy contentos con el servicio y el hotel. Emanuel un súper concierge super atento y servicial lo recomiendo 💯

reviews.author: vigoayastah28
reviews.title: excelencia
reviews.text: todo estuvo muy bonito, se pasaron los dias rapidos , pero nos fuimos contentos por la buena atencion sobretodo de nuestro conserje y guia, el señor Ariel, quien estuvo pendiente desde que llegamos hasta que nos fuimos de todos nosotros

reviews.author: Shalin H
reviews.title: Amazing resort for families
reviews.text: Amazing resort, the staff were attentive and the kids had a great time at the kids club, there were lots of activities and they spent a lot of time in the pool which was great in the hot weather. The restaurants were great, Mina served great steaks and our waiter Manuel took great care of us. Definitely will return again.

reviews.author: Jaime A
reviews.title: Buena experiencia y trabajadores increíbles
reviews.text:
Me ha encantado la semana que he pasado en este hotel, con gente super acogedora, buena comida y bebida a todas horas, las instalaciones y las piscinas muy bonitas. He disfrutado y me he relajado un montón.
Quiero hacer una mención especial a Aurora, la mayordoma que nos ayudó durante toda nuestra estancia, atenta en todo momento, muy agradable y siempre con una sonrisa en la cara...
¡Muchas gracias por todo!

reviews.author: Ana M
reviews.title: Todo estupendo
reviews.text:
El hotel nos gustó mucho, la primera vez que íbamos a un todo incluido. El trato del personal excelente, a resaltar Aurora, nuestra mayordomo dentro del hotel. Nos explicó todo al detalle y nos hizo el viaje y la estancia mucho más fácil y estupendo ñ. ¡Gracias, Aurora! 
Volveremos seguro

reviews.author: Nomad17364769080
reviews.title: Me encantó, Muy buena
reviews.text: La atención demasiada buena por parte de todo el personal, lugar y comida excelente, una experiencia increíble 10/10.

reviews.author: Monika F
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in July and had an unforgettable experience. The resort is absolutely beautiful, super clean, and the staff is outstanding—friendly and helpful at every turn. Our concierge, Cristian, went above and beyond to book restaurants and take care of us. The food was excellent at every restaurant, fresh and delicious (and that’s saying a lot coming from New Yorkers with high standards!). My daughter’s first visit to Punta Cana turned out to be even better than expected, and we all left extremely happy. We can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Jamie O
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!
reviews.text: Amazing! Everything was wonderful! Our concierge Eriol was so kind and helpful! He made sure we had everything we needed and went out of his way to make our anniversary extra special! Rafael on the beach waited on us hand and foot and even made sure to set up our spot on the beach every morning before we got there! Spa was amazing! Gladys is magical! The food was great! 100% recommend!

reviews.author: Jade A
reviews.title: The best hotel in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely amazing. The resort itself is stunning — beautiful grounds, clean beach, and great food options. But what really made the trip special was the incredible service, especially from our concierge, Gustavo.

Gustavo went above and beyond every single day. He was always friendly, professional, and quick to help with anything we needed like our dinner reservations and decorating our room for our anniversary. He made everything so easy and stress-free and cared about making sure we had the best experience possible.

If you’re staying here, definitely ask for Gustavo — he truly made our vacation unforgettable!

reviews.author: Angela H
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our stay was amazing. Room was clean, everyone was pleasant and very accommodating. Our concierge was always very attentive and went above and beyond. The view from our room was breathtaking. I will be coming back really soon.

reviews.author: Maria L
reviews.title: Palma real The reserve
reviews.text: Excelente!!!!!!Gustavo's excellent service made our vacation enjoyable to another level. I recommend Gustavo for your next vacation.

reviews.author: Trek239677
reviews.title: Awesome Stay
reviews.text: We had an absolute blast in The Reserve at Paradisus. Our concierge, Kelvin, was great and met all our needs all week. We will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Agustin P
reviews.title: Imperdible
reviews.text: La comida en el resto doninicano es imperdible. Muy rico todo y muy buen servicio. La atención de César fue genial y nos recomendó los platos tipos del país. Se lo super recomiendo

reviews.author: Ronald M
reviews.title: Nos encantó poder disfrutar del servicio a la habitación para el desayuno, comida y cena; siempre llegaba todo caliente.
reviews.text: Nuestra estancia en el Paradisus Palma Real fue simplemente maravillosa. Desde nuestra llegada nos recibieron con amabilidad y una atención de primer nivel. Las instalaciones son impecables, la comida exquisita y variada, y la playa es sencillamente espectacular. El personal siempre dispuesto a ayudar y con una sonrisa. Es el lugar perfecto para relajarse, disfrutar y desconectarse por completo. ¡Definitivamente volveríamos sin dudarlo!”

reviews.author: christopher v
reviews.title: Amazing experience at blue agave
reviews.text:
Review for Blue Agave . Paradisus Palma Real (Punta Cana)

We had an amazing dinner at Blue Agave! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, but what really stood out was our waitress, Fraimey. She was incredibly warm, attentive, and genuine throughout the entire meal—making sure everything came out just right and checking in at the perfect moments. Her friendly energy made the experience feel extra special. Easily one of the best dining experiences we’ve had at the resort. Highly recommend asking for her if you visit!

reviews.author: dougie79ka
reviews.title: Happy members
reviews.text: A special thank you to the #1 Concierge Francisco, he went above and beyond to make our anniversary celebration a memorable one. We’re so grateful to him. Our best wishes to him and also to all of the waiters who were so kind and helpful to us.

reviews.text:

Muchas gracias:)

reviews.text:
O hotel de maneira geral é muito bom. Os funcionários nos atenderam bem, e a Aurora nossa concierge deixou tudo mais fácil pra nós. 
Tivemos 2 dias sem arrumação no quarto, que fica aqui um ponto negativo, mas não desabona o serviço.

reviews.author: Trent K
reviews.title: Punta Canna on Steroids
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort.  Grounds are immaculately maintained.

Great views of the ocean from our private patio.  Beach was magnificent.  Great night life. Very good restaurants.

Our Reserve room on the Adult side was magnificent. Concierge service was excellent.  

The resort exceeded our expectations.

Truly a 5 star resort.
