reviews.text: Hotel moderno, renovado con amplias habitaciones, modernas, espacios comunes comunes muy agradables, cafeterías y restaurante temáticos muy buenos con un personal magnífico, ama les y dispuestos con los clientes. Buen buffet, primera línea de playa . De repetir

reviews.author: Daniel A
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia, inolvidable, espectacular. Fuimos de Luna de Miel y fue un momento maravilloso. La atención fue espectacular, de todos sus trabajadores, principalmente de Eriol, nuestro concierge, quien fue muy amable, educado y atento con nosotros. Nos ayudó muchísimo, nos entregó sorpresas muy gratas y también su alegría hacía que cada día fuera alegre. También destacamos al personal de The Reserve, quienes fueron muy amables. atentos, principalmente a Marcos del Bar de la piscina, a Gustavo y a Juan del restaurante Santé, y a Celia de los restaurantes temáticos. Nos encantó la experiencia en Santé, la comida deliciosa y todo limpio. Las habitaciones espectaculares, hermosas, limpias, ordenadas, bien aromatizadas, la infraestructura nueva y elegante. Fue una experiencia inolvidable, unas vacaciones y Luna de Miel de lujo. Muy agradecidos y volveríamos felices!!!!!!!!! Totalmente recomendado!!!!!

reviews.author: Ashley R
reviews.title: THE BEST VACATION YET
reviews.text: This was the most amazing vacation I’ve ever been on. The staff was amazing ESPECIALLY Freilyn, Anderson, Joanna and Fernando. They took care of us and entertained us the entire week. We will definitely be coming back!!!

reviews.author: Lynda K
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Leaving tomorrow after a week in paradise.myself and two of my girlfriends stayed in a junior master suite just steps from the beach.  Beautiful room with plenty of room for the three of us. Service was excellent and always with a smile great food and top shelf liquor for drinks. Did a day trip to Saona island with Seaside Punta Cana….so beautiful… planning on bringing my kids and granddaughters here next June

reviews.author: Sandra G
reviews.title: FANTASTIC
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana with a friend and we had the time of our lives.  We are planning to return early next year.

reviews.author: Kobi C
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time staying at the resort. Everything was great - the rooms, the pools, the food, but especially the service.

reviews.author: Stella S
reviews.title: Great vacay with friends, made better by our amazing concierge Erolie!
reviews.text: We had an amazing quick vacation with all of our closest friends, and it was a perfect resort!  There was so much for everyone to do during the day - and we all got to enjoy 'family' dinners together at all of their fantastic restaurants. Our personal concierge, Erolie, took incredible care of us and made the trip extra special.

reviews.author: Shane D
reviews.title: September Honeymoon
reviews.text: The Reserve was great as it is at every Paradisus we’ve stayed at. Raphael made our stay as easy as possible, was always waiting for us at the beach with towels and made sure our drinks were never empty!

reviews.author: thenotorioussus
reviews.title: Phenomenal Stay at Paradisus – Thanks to Bacilio!
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Paradisus Resort was nothing short of phenomenal — and a huge part of that was thanks to our amazing concierge, Bacilio.

From the moment we arrived, Bacilio made us feel welcome and completely taken care of. He was attentive, incredibly helpful, and went above and beyond to make our trip effortless and enjoyable. Whether it was planning dinner reservations, booking excursions, or simply making sure we had everything we needed, Bacilio handled it all with such ease and professionalism.

We also decided to upgrade to the Reserve side of the resort, and it was absolutely worth it — the exclusive amenities, quieter atmosphere, and elevated service took the entire experience to another level.

He truly made our lives simple so we could focus on relaxing and enjoying every moment. It's rare to come across someone so dedicated and detail-oriented — it felt like he anticipated our needs before we even had to ask.

The resort itself was beautiful, the food was fantastic, and the atmosphere was perfect, but it was the exceptional service — especially from Bacilio — that made this trip unforgettable.

Highly recommend Paradisus, and if you're lucky enough to have Bacilio as your concierge, you’re in for a truly stress-free and memorable vacation!

reviews.author: AnaGG
reviews.title: Increíble
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia increíble de esas que se guardan en el corazón. Patricia del equipo de Concierge fue increíble , todo el equipo de camareros un amor , y he de destacar la pasión y alegría que trasmite Fernando de animación . No he visto a nadie con tanta pasión por su trabajo ni esa alegría que se contagia desde hace mucho. Se le ve muy apasionado y comprometido por su trabajo. Volvería y repetiría sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: trannguyenpat
reviews.title: Very relaxing experience
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, super friendly and helpful staffs. Extremely chill  atmosphere . Will definitely use these hotels again in the future at different countries.

reviews.author: Zack S
reviews.title: Hands down best concierge service
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real was a great resort. Good food (the Dominican restaurant Flora was the best), solid nightly entertainment, and a grand feel. But what will make it stand out in memory is the OUTSTANDING service from our personal concierge Yinesca. All the staff were wonderful, always warm and friendly. Always greeting us with a smile. But this young woman is a stand out. I cannot say enough about her. She was the epitome of professionalism and was still able to make us feel like family. Yinesca helped make dinner reservations and made sure anything we needed at our room was taken care of like any concierge would. But, she took time out of her already busy schedule to just talk and actually communicate to get to know us. She surprised us by going outside of her work hours and off the resort to assist us when we couldn’t find what we needed at the resort store. She came in early on our last day to see us off and make sure everything went smoothly. We literally couldn’t have hoped for a better concierge experience. As someone who owns his own businesses and knows the value of people skills, I can confidently say her people skills are stellar and the Paradisus Palma Real is extremely fortunate to have Yinesca.

reviews.author: Odyssey225017
reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived we were treated beyond our expectations, the hotel has breath taking views, the food and ambiance in all restaurants are amazing and to top it all we had Yaleidi Sims as our concierge, she went above and beyond to make it unforgettable. Without a doubt the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa is one of my favorite places to visit. Thank you for an amazing week and see you next year.

reviews.author: ZAR100
reviews.title: Excellent All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text: My friend and I were really impressed with this resort.  Our junior sweet with garden view was a 5-minute walk to the pool, beach and all the restaurants, so convenient!  It was nice to have to take a cart to either get from our room to the restaurants and lobby or vice-versa.  The junior suite was absolutely amazing, especially the unique and modern bath and separate shower. The room resort was spotless and our concierge, Leandro, was a 5-star concierge ! He checked in with us every single day, made sure we had everything we needed requested, and had reserved our first two days of restaurants for our convenience. He would respond to our requests within minutes! He really made us feel special!

reviews.author: hbukovchik
reviews.title: A perfect vacation to celebrate my moms birthday with our butler Emmanuel!
reviews.text:
We just came home from our trip yesterday and already want to go back. We have been to this resort many times but this experience was the best. My mom and I took our trip to celebrate her 79th birthday. Emmanuel was our “butler” (not sure what to call someone who is at your service 24/7). He greeted us as soon as we arrived and assisted us daily with whatever we needed. Although the resort store was not in business at this time  (for whatever the reason) Emmanuel went above and beyond to make sure I had some personal items I forgot at home. He did so on his own time and it was much appreciated. 
On the day we celebrated my mom’s birthday  we returned from the pool to see that the room was decorated with balloons, chocolate covered strawberrie and champagne , and rose petals. At dinner the servers surprised my mom with a beautiful, delicious cake and sang to her. She was so happy. 
This was the perfect time to visit Punta Cana. I already had a great base tan from summer and the sun intensified it perfectly. The ocean water and pools were like bath water. I walked right in which I’m normally not able to do. The service on the beach was also top notch. Every morning the beach crew helped us secure a spot in the front row so we had no obstruction to the ocean. We were delivered a light snack and as many drinks as we wanted. 
Our swim out room in the all adults  Reserve section was a perfect location to the beach and restaurants. The food was good. Although the shows at night we not as elaborate as what we are used to to at other resorts, it was a nice way to end the night. 
Overall I give our experience a 10. I give Emmanuel an 10+. I wish I remembered all the names of everyone who helped make our vacation wonderful. We are sad to be home and would go back tomorrow if we could.

reviews.author: Septiembre2025
reviews.title: El personal más amable del mundo
reviews.text: Bellísimo lugar, pero su más destacada cuidas es su personal: el más amable y con la sonrisa más sincera y contagiosa.

reviews.author: Gabriel G
reviews.title: Amazing time at the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Just came back from a week at the Palma Real - 4 couples in our group. We had such an amazing time at this resort. I have been going to Melia resorts for the past 8 or so years and the experience has been consistent.

The Palma Real is a beautiful resort on the Bavaro beach in Punta Cana. The grounds are maintained so beautifully by the staff who work tirelessly to make sure everything is perfect each day. Our group had some folks with dietary restrictions and there were always options for all of us. And all of the food was just amazing - especially all the fish options (raw an cooked)!!

But the big difference was the staff. Our concierge, Alam, over at the Reserve was always there to help with our daily requests. Be it reservations, drinks or other items for our rooms, Alam took care of things right away.

And a huge shout out to the Reserve Beach staff ... Pedro, Gilberto, Martin and Yudery. This crew was on point every day. Pedro especially!! Each day, our chairs, beds and palapas were setup early in the am with a bucket of ice cold water and soda. And, the drinks in our hands when we needed them. For something different, try some fresh squeezed orange with vodka. Not too sweet and so yummy!

One other point about the beach. Many beaches in the Caribbean suffer from too much seaweed. At this resort, they maintain a net a good distance from the shore that keep most of it away which was so nice!!

Melia has never disappointed me and the Reserve option has always been worth it.

reviews.author: Luna Z
reviews.title: Resort maravilhoso
reviews.text: Resort é maravilhoso, todos os restaurantes com refeicoes incriveis, serviço de quarto impecavel. Nosso concierge Emmanuel, sempre prestativo nos ajudando.

reviews.title: Professionalle
reviews.text: Increible el bar, muy amable la gente, los tragos excelentes, buena fiesta , buenos tragos los barman y meseras extraordinario servicio buena calidad de los productos

reviews.author: Jeffrey M
reviews.title: Everything was great.
reviews.text: Everything was great.  We were at the Adults Only section (Reserve) and Alam Molina was our concierge.  He was fantastic, attentive, and addressed all our requests.  The resort has been updated since our last visit many years ago.  The gardens and pathways were spectacular.  Beach was super clean (of seaweed, etc.) and the staff at the beach (Martin and Pedro) were always ahead of us with beds, chairs, towels, drinks, etc.  Really felt like a VIP.  Rooms were nicely done, only complaints are that we were on a 3rd floor unit with no elevators (and bad knees), and shower in room did not have any place to put things down on.  A/C worked great and bed was super comfortable.  Dining (service and food) was either good or great, depending on the restaurant.  I do prefer the Melia resorts in Cancun and Play del Carmen for dining service and food choices, but this was pretty good.  Shout out to Luis in the Asian restaurant as the best waiter this week.

reviews.author: Jun
reviews.title: The Reserve Swim-Up Junior Suite, Great Concierge Service
reviews.text:
The resort and property at Paradisus Palma Real was fantastic. My partner and I stayed in The Reserve and our personal concierge, Adriel, was amazing. He was able to get us all the reservations we asked for and a late checkout at no extra cost. Not to mention incredibly friendly, hospitable, and communicative — could not recommend him enough.

The resort itself was great. We had the opportunity to book one of the Swim-Up Junior Suites and had pool side service while there. The main and adults-only pools were both great with swim-up bars that will serve your go-to tiki drinks.

The one down-side that we had anticipated was the sargassum. While the resort does have a net to catch the seaweed and has machinery to clean it up, the buildup is inevitable during peak season.

The food and drink through the whole resort was great. We ate mostly at Santé for breakfast and lunch, but we tried most of the restaurants for dinner. Our favorite fare was Flora, their Dominican restaurant, though you can’t go wrong with any of the options. Overall a 10/10 experience.

reviews.author: RodolfoSepu
reviews.title: Great  service, location and hotel
reviews.text:
We have stayed at Melia and Paradisus in the past and this time it didn't disappoint.
booked rooms at the Reserve, Adults only. Reserve has its own check in area and we were received there by our Concierge Kelvin, who made our stay the best. He was always checking on us and making sure we had the reservations we wanted and helping us with any needs we had, specially when having a mid size group. Although the hotel has an area for all ages, if you want to stay in the adults only area, they keep it very well guarded for kids. 
Sante Restaurant for lunch in the Reserve area. They had crab , king crab legs and lobster a couple of day. sashimi Tuna and Salmon. For bkfst the  food and omelets were amazing ad very well done to order by Juan at the grill.
The sports bar, on the family side, it was pretty good, good burgers and great local IPA !!!
The "reservation" restaurants are very good, liked the mexican and steak the most.
If you want to have a good coffee, head to the lobby bar and hang out with Antonio. Makes the best drinks a very good conversation !!!!
At the reserve area, by the pool, you'll find the best bar and service by Marcos !!! great music, drinks and atmosphere for everyone that was hanging out there. 
The pool access rooms are totally worth it. One person in our group stayed and it is very private and your private terrace is very quiet and private as well.
Beach area by had plenty beds and you can request drinks to the beach. The only thing we missed a little, was to have snacks and maybe a hotdog/bbq station by the beach like they have at Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, but the hotel is small enough, you can go and grab something at any of the restaurants y 3 minutes walk.
They only down side, was the Sargasso, but at this time of the year, it is expected. The beach and pools were nice anyways. 
Definitely coming back !!!!

reviews.title: 베스트 호텔 Punta Cana
reviews.text:
많은 호텔을 Punta Cana에서 지내봤지만 이호텔를 따라갈 호텔은 없는것 같아요. 음식 써비스 방 모두가 100점입니다 딱한가지가 더해졌으면 하는게 있습니다 수영장에 그늘이 없어서 아쉬었습니다.
이탈리안식당은 두번이나 갈정도로 음식이 맛있고 써비스도 좋았습니다. 예씨카라는 웨이츠레스는 상냥하고 마음에들어서 두번째 방문했을때 똑같은 사람으로 요청까지 했습니다.Reserve club에서 지냈고 따로 갈수있는 식당이 있어서 아침 점심을 먹을수 있어서 좋았습니다 Butler Alram은 항상 웃는얼굴로 대해주었고 필요한것은 신속히 해결해줬습니다. 내년에도 꼭이호텔로 가겠습니다

reviews.author: Sophia B
reviews.title: Five Stars for Both the Resort and Concierge, Christopher
reviews.text:
resort was nothing short of amazing. The property itself is absolutely beautiful—peaceful, well-maintained, and filled with everything you could need for a relaxing and memorable vacation.

A huge part of what made our trip so special was our concierge, Christopher. He went above and beyond to make sure every detail of our stay was seamless. From helping us secure the best dinner reservations, to arranging activities tailored to our interests, to checking in on us with genuine care—Christopher’s hospitality was unmatched. He always greeted us with a warm smile, made us feel like VIP guests, and truly elevated our experience.

reviews.author: LeeBee
reviews.title: Short Stay, but a Great Stay
reviews.text:
Just checked out of Paradisus - Reserve - building 6 this AM and definitely night and day compared to Punta Cana Beach. Our concierge, Adriel, was amazing- very kind and such a pleasure. The staff here is gracious and you can tell they enjoy making the guests feel welcome. In hindsight, we probably should have booked the entire week here as the food, grounds, room and everything else couldn’t have been any better. Tons of options for dining, no shortage of beach chairs/palapas or Reserve pool chairs. 3 bars within walking distance to the Reserve pools and while the resort is large, it takes no time to walk anywhere on the resort. I think the sargassum is kept at bay better than Punta Cana Beach as well. The room was really nice and had great water pressure and plenty of room for our clothes along with a nice size balcony. We weren’t in the room much, but it was still nice to come back to at the end of the beach/ pool day and after dinner.
We had dinner at Flora Thursday night and dinner at Mina last night. Both nights the food was fantastic. After dinner both nights, we popped over to the bar connecting the Italian restaurant and Blue Agave and the espresso martinis were fantastic. 
It was also a nice surprise when we entered our room Thursday afternoon and there was a bottle of wine and a charcuterie plate waiting for us. After the frustrations we felt next door at Punta Cana Beach for 5 days, it was really such a thoughtful gesture.
As for check-in and check-out, that was seamless and done within less than 5 minutes. We barely had time to pour a glass of champagne and everything was already done! 
We even saw Adriel after breakfast this morning and he let us know he’d be at the lobby with us to make sure our bags were taken from our room and added for our airport pick-up. There must have been a mix up and our bags were still in our room but thanks to Adriel, he spoke to a porter and another gentleman jumped in a golf cart and within minutes retrieved our luggage just as our airport pick-up arrived. I really can’t comment enough on the level of service at this resort. Very similar to Paradisus Playa del Carmen on all fronts. If we come back, we want Adriel again!

reviews.author: Macarena B
reviews.title: Mejor..... Imposible
reviews.text:
Cada vez que voy a Paradisus Palma Real me sorprenden, shows nuevos, comidas nuevas, entretenciones nuevas, habitaciones nuevas y mas equipadas aun, pero lo que no es nuevo es el cariño de su gente, de sus empleados que año a año hacen que uno como turista se sienta querido.
No existe el sargazo porque el hotel tiene un gran perímetro con mayas especiales impidiendo que este entre al aerea del mar del nuestro hotel, y lo poco que entra la maquinaria del hotel lo saca diariamente de sus playas, que mas se puede pedir. Mis hijos entretenidos todo el día con las actividades de alto nivel que da el hotel, los cantantes y show de las noches hacen querer solamente pensar en volver. 
No puedo dejar de agradecer a Luis y Víctor nuestros barman de la piscina que con una paciencia de oro nos atienden y a los cuales conocemos hace muchos años. Mención especial a Ynes Nuñez y Juan Peña que día a día estuvieron pendientes de nosotros, se veían constantemente di ambulando por el hotel verificando que todo marchara como a ellos les gusta, perfecto. 
Gracias totales.

reviews.author: Castro-coru
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO
reviews.text:
Llevamos ya varios años alojándonos en The Reserve del Paradisus Palma Real, y siempre repetimos por muchas razones: las instalaciones, el entorno, la playa, las comodidades… Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es su equipo humano.
Queremos empezar agradeciendo a Álvaro, que siempre ha estado pendiente de nosotros en cada visita. Esta vez, por un cambio repentino, conocimos a parte de la nueva gerencia, y la experiencia fue igualmente maravillosa. En especial, destacamos a Carolina, que con su amabilidad y cercanía, hizo que nuestras vacaciones fueran inolvidables. También a Alexia, una pieza fundamental para que todo funcione a la perfección. Siempre con una sonrisa, cuidando cada detalle.
Nuestro concierge Gustavo merece una mención especial: atento, educado, servicial… uno de los mejores mayordomos del hotel sin duda.
Esta vez, aunque ya conocemos todos los restaurantes, fuimos directamente a Flora, el dominicano, donde trabaja Eduardo, a quien apreciamos muchísimo y que ya sentimos como un amigo más.
En The Reserve tienes acceso al restaurante Santé para desayunar, comer y cenar. La experiencia allí es siempre excelente: Barnelis te recibe con una calidez que se agradece muchísimo, y los chefs Santos y Rafa sorprenden con platos deliciosos y muy bien presentados. Enrique es un auténtico showman y el servicio de Reinaldo (al que cariñosamente llamamos “nuestro Mario Casas”) es de lujo. Y Misael, con su amabilidad y educación, se ha convertido en uno de nuestros camareros favoritos.
Mención muy especial también para Wendy, que siempre nos atiende con una sonrisa, haciendo que nos sintamos como en casa. Su dedicación y atención hacen que tu experiencia suba de nivel.
En la zona exclusiva de playa, el servicio es excelente gracias a Pedro, Martín, Rafa y Yuderis, siempre dispuestos a ayudarte con lo que necesites.
Ahora bien, queremos comentar algo que empañó un poco nuestra estancia: los supuestos “fotógrafos” con animales como guacamayos o iguanas, que no aceptan un no por respuesta y resultan bastante agresivos. Lamentablemente, tuvimos que solicitar la presencia de seguridad casi a diario por esta situación, que llegó a ser muy incómoda. Por eso, queremos agradecer a Juan, Elisaldo y otros miembros del equipo de seguridad por su profesionalidad. Este es un punto que el hotel debería revisar seriamente: este tipo de personas no deberían tener acceso a las zonas privadas.
Como sugerencia de mejora, creemos que un hotel de esta categoría debería retomar el código de vestimenta que existía antes. No es agradable ver a personas cenando en bañador y chanclas, o con los pies encima de las mesas en la Plaza Colonial. Son pequeños detalles, sí, pero en un 5 estrellas gran lujo, esos detalles son los que marcan la diferencia entre una buena experiencia y una excelente.
En resumen, seguimos eligiendo The Reserve no solo por lo bonito que es el lugar, sino por las personas que hacen que todo funcione y que cada visita sea especial. ¡Gracias por hacernos sentir siempre como en casa!

reviews.text: El hotel es una maravilla, el personal es increíble en especial Christopher, todo muy limpio, la comida excelente. No tengo ninguna calificación negativa para este hotel y su desempeño. El único consejo que le daría es que en las noches las actividades son escasas y no muy divertida. Quiero mencionar el trabajo excelente y de calidad que hizo Christopher, a pesar de de ser un muchacho joven es muy talentoso en el desempeño de su trabajo, nos hizo sentir en familia y que lo conocíamos de siempre, atendió a nuestras necesidades y resolvió de manera satisfactoria los problemas que se presentaban.

reviews.author: Mary G
reviews.title: Fabulous Trip, Great Staff
reviews.text: Amazing experience staying at The Reserve.  Rafael at the beach was outstanding. Very helpful and thoughtful in order to ensure we had a fantastic time on the beach!  Yohanna at the front desk was very helpful as well ensuring we had everything we needed. Fransico at The Winery was also a stand out!!   Really fabulous employees that the hotel should be very proud of and appreciate.

reviews.author: Christian V
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Alberto, Raisa, Greison Nos atendieron al 100% con un excelente servicio en el area de la piscina de adultos (90grados) 
De PR pa RD les deseamos éxito

reviews.author: Derian camilo R
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Muy buen lugar y excelente hotel, el servicio de la piscina de solo adultos espectacular. Nos hicieron un ambiente increíble, por greivin, raiza  y Alberto la experiencia se hizo aún mejor

reviews.author: Taylor M
reviews.title: Did not disappoint!
reviews.text: 10/10 did not disappoint! We spent 1 week peak summer and the heat did not deter us at all. There are more activities, restaurants, and accommodations than time spent at the resort - there’s no way to do it all in one trip! We had our own personal concierge service the entire duration of our trip. If you’re lucky enough to have Gustavo you won’t be disappointed. He had dinner reservations for us every night at one of the many restaurants on site, as well as sent us the daily activities every morning so we could plan our day accordingly. He was available to us at any time for any of our needs and responded in a quick fashion. The restaurants had a wide variety - definitely something for everyone. There were also multiple buffets available for all three meals for the days you want no structure. This was our second time at this resort and definitely won’t be our last!

reviews.author: Kevin F
reviews.title: Family fun
reviews.text: The resort and staff were really great.  Zonovia took great care of our family all week with reservations and special request at the restaurants, and Arisleida was proactive and attentive taking care of everything at the pool and beach.  Great food, beautiful resort!

reviews.author: Jacek K
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Very good location. Smaller hotel, enjoy adult area. I would recommend upgrading to reserved area to gain more access to quiet pools and restaurant. Hotel is very clean, our room was clean and comfortable with very easy access to pools, beach and restaurants. Food is average but recommend FLORA restaurant . Excellent food and atmosphere and our server was super nice. Absolutely the best. Entertainment just average nothing special or exciting. Unfortunately in July sargasso was very high but they did good job cleaning the beach. In my opinion it was the cleanest beach in the area. Overall we are happy and well rested.

reviews.author: dejanewkirk
reviews.text: LOVED IT HERE!!! The staff is amazing!! Harry was our concierge and he was the best!! Always helped us if we needed it! The whole resort is extremely clean, the food was 9/10! Certain things I just didn’t like cause it wasn’t my preference but the things I did like I really loved!! The pools are amazing and they’re pretty warm when the air is a little cool. So at night. They restock and clean your room everyday. Only thing that was a little iffy was room service. They will tell you 45 minutes but take almost 2 hours.

reviews.author: Robert Z
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real ~ Excellent
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Spa & Golf is such a beautiful resort! Gustavo was especially helpful with all of our needs. Thank you for everything! Until we meet again.

reviews.author: Ximena P
reviews.text: Flora restaurant was amazing! Our waiter Cesar was really good and recommended us the best dishes! We really enjoyed the afternoon

reviews.author: pazrafaj
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: Wonderful experience. Very good food and drinks. Hotel is very clean and service useful. The view was spectacular, We went with family snd we enjoy a lot of the week we spent at the hotel.

reviews.author: FarAway16471241538
reviews.text: In this place you will feel peace. Just relax and enjoy. Huge swimming pool, large rooms. Excellent cleaning. A couple of times we forgot our things, nothing was ever lost. Very safe. I will especially note the food, it was delicious and varied. The Hibachi restaurant was especially great, thanks to the chef for the show. It was a wonderful evening. The only thing is the beach ... everything is in seaweed and the sea is dirty. July is clearly not the season when you can swim in the turquoise sea.

reviews.author: Charles B
reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.text: Best holiday in many years. Resort was perfect with plenty of amenities and entertainment. Beach was fabulous. The concierge service is top notch. Very attentive and always on the job.

reviews.author: johnr212
reviews.title: Outstanding family vacation.
reviews.text: Great resort and awesome staff. Everyone went out of their way to ensure we had a great time.  The beach crews kept the beaches clean and clear of the sargassum. The best part of the trip by far was our concierge Christain, he came through with every reservation we wanted and set up all of our excursions. The bartenders were also very entertaining and extremely friendly. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: 873jeff
reviews.title: Incredible Resort
reviews.text: We had the best time at the Paradisus Palma Real. Our Concierge, Zenovia was the best. From the moment we arrived to the minute we left, she was there to make our stay as enjoyable as possible. We absolutely loved our stay. The food and drinks were amazing and beyond what we expected. We had an oceanfront room with spectacular views and amenities. Rosanna, a server at the pool,  was the best. Fernando in activities was so fun. Robinson with spa services was great and super helpful. I highly recommend staying here. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Maria Del C
reviews.title: Bueno para descansar en pareja.
reviews.text: Excelente hotel para descansar en pareja, alejarse del bullicio y pasar un rato relax. Ambiente de relajación y paz.

reviews.author: rosammp81
reviews.title: Hotel muy recomendable, tranquilo, cómodo, amplias piscinas, y bonitas y limpias habitaciones aunque poca animación
reviews.text: Hotel muy recomendable, tranquilo, cómodo, amplias piscinas, y bonitas y limpias habitaciones aunque si le tuviese que poner algún pero sería que tiene poca animación, y podrían añadir una zona de juegos como billares, futbolines,… o algo así para los niños y adolescentes.

reviews.author: Julieta B
reviews.text: Nuestro amigo fernando muy cómico y alentador!! El hotel un espectáculo, la comida muy rica, los restaurantes intachables!!

reviews.author: Ivanna B
reviews.text: The hotel is very clean and beautiful. My family and I spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real and we loved it ! Our concierge Aurora was spectacular. She was so helpful and made our stay very pleasant as she made all our reservations and suggested fun activities. The food is delicious and the waiters are super friendly. Anthony in the ginger bar makes the best coffees and Rosanna at the pool bar will keep your cup full all day. I highly encourage you to visit !

reviews.author: Frank R
reviews.title: Great Destination
reviews.text: They do a great job of keeping all the public areas in top notch conditions. Noticing a great improvement in the food served at Flora from last year. Mascalzone and Mina were great (as expected). However, what makes this place are the folks: Arisleydi, at beach central was the bomb-what a genuine human being; Franchesca at Flora, Dayhani at the Lunch Box-brought a home-made dessert; Bioni/Juan at front desk; Felix  at Mascalzone; Franklin at Mina and many more that assisted me. Great team of human beings-The compelling reason to return.

reviews.author: Barbara M
reviews.title: Gran estadía en Meliá Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Una estadía muy placentera en el resort Meliá Paradisus Palma Real ! Hemos disfrutado durante 10 días, con mucho sol y playa !!
Una especial mención para los pool  bartenders Luis y Víctor por su amabilidad y buena onda, además de la calidad de sus tragos !! Sin duda volveremos en breve !!!

reviews.author: Chuck B
reviews.text: My wife and I celebrated our 10th anniversary here. Food, entertainment, atmosphere was perfect. On top of that, our concierge Alam and beach assistant Martin made our stay and anniversary extra special. They went above and beyond+.  5 Star all the way.

reviews.author: johanna P
reviews.text:
El hotel me encanta por que tienen casi todos los restaurantes es la misma áreas,  las atenciones de nuestro mayordomo Eriol  fue espectacular siempre pendiente a nosotros y ayudarnos en lo que necesita 

Lo recomiendo

reviews.author: Flor A
reviews.title: Best time ever!
reviews.text: Great customer service. Great food, great property! My concierge Christopher was the best. I will definitely be coming back to this resort, pretty soon! I came to the resort by myself, and they made me feel like family! Everyone was super friendly and respectful!

reviews.author: Ramona E
reviews.title: a paradise Vacation
reviews.text:
What an amazing vacation, our concierge Christopher was incredible .  He made sure everything was taken care of , very detailed. He went above and beyond – he made my daughter birthday very special – from room décor to a beautiful cake celebration in the evening.  Christopher is the best 
The hotel itself was breathtaking . I loved the people there, I must shout out a few exceptional ones , like Wanda by the beach bar. She was so kind and made the best mudslide !  Rafael was super attentive and always made sure we had ou beach bed ready and never skipped a beat with our drinks . They were all friendly and kind. 
Overall, one of the best vacations !!  I highly recommend this world class hotel – it superseded m y expectations I’ll be back !!

reviews.author: Brian P
reviews.text:
So I just checked out of the Paradisius Palma Real on the 20th. Had an amazing time. My concierge was Cristian. 
He did an amazing job getting my dinner, restaurant reservations and checking in with me in the morning via text message and then making sure he found me everyday somewhere on property usually by the pool to make sure my day was going well and see if I needed anything. 
He took care of anything that I asked for in a timely fashion. 
He definitely made our trip very relaxing and we enjoyed every minute of it. 
Can't thank him enough

reviews.author: Mehul D
reviews.text: This was my 4th stay at an all inclusive resort with my wife and two sons. Our concierge, Cristian Gonzalez, went above and beyond to make sure we had an amazing experience. The best concierge so far. Our room had a small balcony compared to the photos and he found additional rooms to make sure it met our needs. He made all of dinner reservations and would check in at the restaurants to make sure we got a table. The resort is clean and quiet. It doesn't have as many activities as others we've been to, but we liked it. There were no lines at the various bars, which was great. The main pool is huge and didn't feel crowded during peak hours. If we had to complain about anything, we wish the main buffet would be available for dinner. As vegetarians, we find it easier to find food we like and can eat at buffets. Additionally, the hot tube on our balcony nor the tub in our bathroom held any water. The drain always stayed open. We didn't mention it to anyone there so can't say they didn't address the issue, but when paying $3,000+ I would like for these items to be tested and maintained.

reviews.author: Rolvin G
reviews.text:
La experiencia vivida en el Resort Paradisus fue fenomenal. Pero sobre todo agradezco el servicio brindado en el Bar 90 Degreees, con el servicio de brindado por Leticia y Greivin. Personal con un alto valor y excelencia en el servicio al cliente. 

Lo recomiendo al 100%

reviews.author: Getaway597556
reviews.text: I have come first time this place and resort for vacation with family and we have a blast vacation. The staff, chefs and all other employees are very nice and helpful. Specially Adriel Cabrera he helped us in all restaurants booking and other things, he also helped us in food since my son have lot of food allergies and he come with us and explained everything to chefs and he also provide stuff what we need for him. I would definitely recommend this resort for best experience without any doubt and I will soon come again.

reviews.author: Heather C
reviews.text:
We had a truly wonderful experience at Paradisus Palma Real. The room was beautiful, the grounds were meticulously maintained, and our meals at Sante were absolutely delicious.

A special thanks to Christian, our concierge, who made every effort to ensure our stay was perfect. He was attentive, personable, and always went the extra mile to accommodate our requests. His thoughtful service truly elevated our experience, and we will be requesting him on our next visit..

reviews.author: Omolayo L
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: Resort experience was elevated with the upgrade to the Reserve room. Kelvin took care of everything. He booked the restaurants and gave us good recommendations on activities to do on the resort. He was professional, very responsive and accommodative as we celebrated our anniversary. Will definitely recommend Kelvin as the concierge to my friends when they book this resort

reviews.author: GoPlaces46909612698
reviews.title: Great experience at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
First time in Punta Cana. We had a great experience here at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort. Our concierge was Adriel, he was very attentive from the beginning. He took us to our room, showed us all the hotel amenities and took care of making all the restaurants reservations. He made our experience easier, we just relaxed, enjoyed the pools, the beach, the food, and drinks. My favorite restaurant was Flora, is a Dominican gourmet style cuisine, food was delicious and the servers were very friendly and attentive. 
Service around the hotel was excellent, no complaints at all. Happy and friendly people. The only thing we did not like was the beach, it was full of seaweed, we were told this time of the year is like that, but other than that we had an great experience.

reviews.author: Josué M
reviews.title: Great experience.
reviews.text:
It was our first experience at Punta Cana DR. We had a great unforgettable experience from all the staff and facilities. The concierge Adriel Cabrera did an excellent job to make sure everything was great for us. 
Thanks Adriel.

reviews.author: Anita M
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text:
This was indeed one of the best vacations ever. The staff, especially ALAM and EMMANUEL were truly exceptional. I've never had personal butlers, and these two young men are the best of the best. The entire resort is phenomenal. Every day at lunch, WANDER took great care of us. He, too, was an excellent waiter. During the busy morning buffets, Jeff, (misspelling his name, but pictured below) ensured our needs were met. During my fabulous 7-day stay, I did not experience anything negative that reflects on the resort or the staff, they have no control on rain or beach vendors. 
Thank you so much for a beautiful time.

reviews.author: Dedric G
reviews.title: Relaxing Family Getaway – Swim-Up Room is a Must!
reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real with our little family. The resort is beautiful, and everything was designed for comfort and relaxation. Booking the swim-up room was the best decision; it added a whole new level of convenience and fun to our trip.

Our concierge, Adriel, truly made the experience even better. He took care of our restaurant reservations and helped coordinate excursions, making everything smooth and stress-free.

reviews.author: sharon c
reviews.text: Cristopher the concierge fue muy amable. La estadía estaba muy bien. Los restaurantes muy buenos. Definitivamente recomiendo que se queden en la parte reserve, todo es exclusivo y tienen piscinas, bars , y playa separado.

reviews.author: Ankit patel
reviews.text: We visited paradisus palma real in july 2025. The resort is amazing and we had a great time. The staff is very friendly and accomodate all your needs. We had a concierge assigned to take care of us during our stay. Our concierge, Emmanuel is amazing person. He took care of all our needs from getting us reservations to helping us book excursions. We are vegetarian and he made sure that all the restaurants were communicated accordingly and they prepared tasty vegetarian meals for us. Would definitely love to come again and thanks for making our stay memorable.

reviews.author: Danney N
reviews.text: The best service overall came from our amazing bartender, Yefry. He was always attentive and made sure we were well taken care of at all times. His warm personality and dedication truly made us feel special. Without a doubt, he’s one of the best we’ve encountered. Yefry deserves every recognition and perk you can offer—he absolutely earned it!

reviews.text: Hemos tenido una gran experiencia en el hotel con todo el personal por ejemplo Jeffry el bartender de la piscina , Jairo de animación , Mrs,Ayayay , los salvavidas súper nace , el cocinero Juan que nos hizo una comida excelente, mi room make fue súper me quede en l habitación 5310 muy buena ella , mi coordinadora de expedía Abigail fue muy amable y me ayudó mucho ya resolver los restaurantes.

reviews.author: Brenda W

reviews.text: The hotel was a 10 out of 10 our concierge Christian and Christopher was amazing I will definitely recommend this hotel to anyone. The staff was amazing. The rooms were perfectly cleaned.

reviews.author: Victoria N
reviews.title: Upgrade to the Reserve. It’s worth it.
reviews.text: The dedicated staff members on the Reserve part were amazing! From quickly handling obnoxious guests (it is a resort meant for relaxing) to making sure we had reservations to bringing ice or any other request, they made our stay so enjoyable! And the spa services were very good! Actually got some of my knots out!

reviews.author: Go24854972912
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text:
Muy buen servicio y muy buena la calidad de las instalaciones todo todo muy lindo

Volvería nuevamente...mi fam8lia quedo muy contenta

reviews.author: VNM
reviews.title: Wonderful restful Vacation
reviews.text: Our recent trip to Plama Real Reserve was excellent and restful for us. The food at all of the restaurants were excellent especially the Sante where we had breakfast and lunch daily. Bernadais the hostess at Sante, always greeted us with a smile and was very engaging. Gustavo the waiter, tended to our every need when dining. Drinks at the bars were good and we had an amazing time at the Winery! we spent most of the day at the beach and Pedro and Rafael were amazing, making sure we were comfortable and were well hydrated.. Kelvin our concierge checked in with us daily and made sure we had whatever we needed. Overall an amazing experience, once again!

reviews.author: Let’s Go
reviews.title: Relaxing Family Vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I just returned from a wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real, and we're already planning our return next year! The resort is immaculate and beautifully maintained, with breathtaking views in every direction.

Our children (ages 5 and 10) had an amazing time at the Kidsdom. The caregivers there are warm, attentive, and truly enjoy spending time with the kids — which gave us complete peace of mind while they played and made new friends.

We stayed in an Ocean Front Suite and were fortunate to have the absolute best concierge — Alam. He truly made our experience unforgettable. Attentive, warm, and engaging, Alam made us feel genuinely special from the moment we arrived. Thanks to his care, I didn’t have to worry about a thing; he ensured every detail was handled and that my entire family was well taken care of. His kindness toward my mother and children meant so much to us. No request was ever too big or too small. I sincerely hope he’s still there when we return next year — seeing him around the property and chatting with him was always a highlight.

I'd also like to recognize Lisandro, who consistently sought us out to ask how we were enjoying our meals and overall stay. He showed a genuine interest in both what the resort was doing well and how it could improve. My family and I looked forward to his friendly check-ins throughout our visit.

Finally, a special mention goes to Jeison. Whether at the breakfast buffet or just passing by during the day, he always greeted us with a big smile and warm conversation. His positive energy was contagious.

Together, Alam, Lisandro, and Jeison made our stay truly exceptional. We're so grateful to have met them and wish them all the best.

There were plenty of activities for the whole family to enjoy. The pool area was spacious, and we never had an issue finding available lounge chairs throughout our stay. The beach was clean, well-maintained, and absolutely beautiful. We didn't have any problems finding lounge chairs or beach bed either. 

We went parasailing and also took a glass-bottom boat tour. While the term “glass-bottom” is a bit misleading — it was really just a small rectangle of glass with not much to see — we still enjoyed the boat ride itself. The kids especially liked spotting the dolphins, shark, and stingrays. That said, seeing the animals in confined, aquarium-like enclosures left me feeling uneasy. If animal welfare is a concern, this part of the excursion might be one to skip. Still, the ride was peaceful and relaxing overall.

One thing to note: the beach vendors are quite persistent and can be a bit disruptive at times. Be prepared to firmly (and frequently) say "no" if you're not interested.

One more thing to note: please give more attention to the bed pillows. They were kind of sad and deflated.

reviews.author: Vanessa C
reviews.title: Great hospitality!
reviews.text: The hospitality is amazing! Everyone genuinely cares about your comfort and well being. Not having to worry about anything because we knew Emmanuel and Alam would take care of everything was great. My group and I were able to just relax.

reviews.author: Noelia E
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO
reviews.text:
Conoci el hotel por cuestiones profesionales y es un verdadero lujo.
La comida (deliciosa), las instalaciones el entreteniemiento todo funciona 10 puntos.
Tuvimos atencion del concierge CENA , espectacular , una atencion de excelencia.
Totalmente recomendable . Gracias  Cintia Brito tambien por su calidez y profesionalismo para atender nuestro grupo, todo es una maravilla, inolvidable experiencia en este complejo Melia

reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Angelo was absolutely fabulous he took care of us since we got to the resort he definitely made our stay extra special .!!! Super super fabulous and hopefully the next time we come back we bump into him food service every thing was super  our first time here but we definitely will be back .!!!

reviews.author: FATIMA
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Amamos o resort, tudo muito bonito e de muita qualidade! Para quem tem opção dos restaurantes para jantar, são de alta qualidade, o Mina (de churrasco) e o Blue Agave (de mexicano) o Tokimeku (asiático) um show a parte com o Felix fazendo e apresentando os pratos, maravilhoso . Recomendamos
