Excellent service in Sante Restaurant, especially Idelka, who was very kind with us and very sweet. 

And also Enrique, great service!

reviews.author: sergio g
reviews.title: El significado de la palabra "vivir una experiencia" la invento la cadena Melia
reviews.text: No es un hotel, es una experiencia de servicio de alto nivel de verdad, todo lo que uno puede pretender acá lo tenes. Un concerge a tu servicio, piletas enormes impecables, habitación de lujo, la gente con una onda de otro planeta y ..........

reviews.author: Ivan G
reviews.title: 7 days in Paradise
reviews.text: Had a great time.  Everyone was very nice and helpful.  Emmanuel was a great concierge and was always available.  Anthony and Ismael and Luis at the Ginger bar are incredible.  Olga at the adult pool was also a pleasure to be around

reviews.author: Antoine L
reviews.title: Leslie Family Vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed for 9 days in a swim up suite on the Reserve side of the Resort and it was absolutely amazing. Our Concierge was ZENOVIA!!Zenovia made this vacation what it was, we did not want for anything! Thank you Zenovia for taking care of my family. The Resort is absolutely beautiful and the food options were very good. We did eat at the Reserve private restaurant quite a bit, but most time for lunch we went to the buffet for more of a variety. Not sure what other vacationers are referring to when speaking of the buffet and saying it wasn’t  good but we found it to be one of the better buffets we have had while at a resort. We ate at all of the restaurants and our favorite was the Dominican restaurant. Our room was very spacious and suited our needs perfectly. I don’t think I can ever do another vacation without a swim up, best thing ever! The staff that works the swim up area is absolutely the best. Everyone always had a full glass, cup, or can of whatever they were drinking.
My only issue with this resort is the absolute lack of
TIPPING by most of the guests. I don’t care how much you payed to stay at the resort, TIP your servers!! they work very hard for you and they absolutely deserve it. Did I mention that I had the absolute best Concierge the Resort has to offer (ZENOVIA)!!!!😌, but seriously every once in a while you get to meet genuinely good person that you know you going to miss and that is absolutely ZENOVIA.

reviews.author: Rosa J
reviews.title: EXCELENCIA!
reviews.text: Excelente atención por mi concierge Eriol. Muy atento y dedicado. Las instalaciones del hotel...muy buenas y recomendadas

reviews.author: Jane I
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: Quintíno, Jonathan, Eddy, Víctor son los mejores en atención a los presentes en la piscina. Siempre me complacen con lo que les pido

reviews.author: Adolf S
reviews.title: Lo mejor
reviews.text: Excelente atención, mas la atención personalizada con Eirol, quien estuvo al pendiente siempre, igualmente la comida y todo su personal

reviews.author: Vacation12294236781
reviews.title: Best Week Ever!!
reviews.text: I have never loved a vacation more. The resort is so beautiful and well kept, and everything you could ever want in a vacation is included here. My favorite part had to be the staff and the friendships my family and I made with them. They were very good at anticipating our needs, communicating about reservations, and just all around know how to make your stay personal and memorable. Our concierge was Adriel, and he was personable from day 1. We knew we were going to have a great stay here because of him. We had great conversations with him, he always got us taken care of whether it was room service M&M’s, or getting us the restaurant we wanted that day. Whenever we passed him while at the resort, he would stop and be so present with us and ask us how our day was going. Some other notable staff were Yuderi and Martin from the reserve. Those men took such good care of us and always asked us if we wanted drinks, and my favorite thing they did was bring us cold towels at the peak of the day’s heat. They always provided service with such joy. I loved getting to know them too. Overall, this resort is fabulous, so fun, lively and personable. I would come again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Go49501591212
reviews.title: Presidential Suite at The Reserve is Top Tier
reviews.text: We stayed in the Presidential Suite at The Reserve and had a wonderful time. We had two concierge, Alam and Gustavo. Both of them were excellent at assisting us and checking in throughout our stay. Each day Alam would send us the day's activities and make our dinner reservations and whenever we saw Gustavo he was happy to answer our questions. The restaurant for The Reserve is Sante and all the staff there are kind and helpful. We ate breakfast and lunch there each day and everyone was especially helpful with exceptional service. In all the restaurants the staff was very accommodating to our dietary needs. We spent a lot of time at the beach and pool. Rafael always had a spot ready for us on the beach and made sure we had plenty of water and other beverages between swimming in the ocean and getting sun. At the pool, Martin would bring drinks and snacks, and if we visited the beach later in the day, he would get us set up. The bar at The Reserve pool was tended by Marcos. When we wanted a drink in the shade we would sit there for a drink and some pleasant conversation. Marcos helped us pick some rum to try and even opened up a coconut for a snack. The management of The Reserve were also present and helpful. They would say hello and ensured we had everything we needed. The gifts of wine, fruit, etc. that were sent to the room made the experience extra special. That goes for the housekeeping and bar service staff who tended to the room as well. Special mention to the porters who carted us around when we needed it and all the bar and wait staff at Ginger, who make excellent smoothies and frappes. It was clear that all the workers at the resort take pride in their jobs and work hard to make the experience special for all the guests.

reviews.author: Tyler K
reviews.title: Amazing, beautiful family vacation where we felt valued and cared for
reviews.text: Amazing family vacation with really fun activities and great food and service. Favorite part was the beach and the service from Yuderi and Martin! Also Adriel was an amazing helper with anything we needed and our meal times. Overall an amazing experience, would do again!

reviews.author: Kate H
reviews.title: Impeccable service
reviews.text: The service was outstanding! staff was attentive and thoughtful, especially our concierge Adriel. Food was delicious, room was clean and spacious. Pool and property was great.

reviews.author: ROCKY E
reviews.title: "Una bienvenida que abraza el alma"
reviews.text:
Una vez más regreso al Hotel Paradisus Palma Real, y como siempre, la magia comienza desde el primer instante. Al entrar al Ginger Bar, el querido Antony, con su carisma único y sonrisa inolvidable, me reconoció al instante. Ese gesto, tan sincero y espontáneo, hizo que me sintiera valorado y bienvenido como en casa. ¡Qué privilegio ser recibido con tanta calidez!

Poco después, Ismael, siempre impecable y apasionado por su trabajo, también me saludó con entusiasmo. Ambos son verdaderos embajadores de la excelencia en servicio, y ver cómo recuerdan a los huéspedes por nombre y preferencia es simplemente admirable.

Quiero extender mi reconocimiento también a Luis (capitán), Margaret (camarera) y Inés (encargada de actividades), quienes con su profesionalismo y amabilidad completan esta experiencia encantadora, acompañada como siempre por la atmósfera musical que convierte al Ginger Bar en un rincón mágico.

Gracias por seguir haciendo de cada visita algo inolvidable. ¡Ya estoy contando los días para volver!

reviews.author: Jacqueline N
reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE!!!
reviews.text:
This was an incredible experience from start to finish! It started with emailing with Alexia Garcia who was incredibly helpful and do friendly.  We couldn’t wait to meet her when we arrived.  
We arrived and were treated like royalty from the minute we stepped out of the car. They took our luggage and brought  us straight to the Reserve area.  We had champagne and met Carolina and the staff and were introduced to our concierges (we had two) Emmanuel Villa and Adriel Cabrera who were with us all five days and took care of everything!  They took us on a tour of the resort, booked our dinner reservations, came and picked us up for dinner, took care of our excursion reservations, brought us anything we needed to our room, etc.  Alexia, Emmanuel and Adriel set up a mixology lesson in our room that was so much fun! 
While on the yoga catamaran outing, we met Fernando who is incredible with the guests and so much fun!  We looked forward to seeing him around the resort daily at the activities. We did Aqua HIIT in the main pool with Freilyn who brings all the energy and knows how to work the crowd no matter where he is working throughout the day. 
We HIGHLY recommend the Reserve and the Presidential suite stay!

reviews.author: Julia K
reviews.title: Fabulous resort!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and kept very clean. The staff is VERY kind and friendly, as well as helpful. The food is great, too, with tons of options available. My family upgraded to the Reserve group, and it was amazing. Our personal concierge, Adriel Cabrera, was fantastic. He made our meal reservations, personally showed us around the resort, and was a friendly face during our stay. He was also available to us 24/7 via text and answered all of our questions!! Would definitely come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Tammy S
reviews.title: Great concierge!
reviews.text:
Alam Molina was our concierge and he was amazing! 

I booked and paid for a king swim out but was told at check in that the option was unavailable on the resort. This option is listed on the resort website and my reservation. This was an unacceptable situation.

However, Alam made the situation better with his many acts of kindness and consideration. He provided the activity schedule daily. He made all of our dinner reservations. Alam also made sure that we had answers to all of our questions. We saw Alam each day which was a highlight because he called us “family” and treated us like we were family.

reviews.author: Mariah K
reviews.title: Booze beaches and besties J8AMIZ
reviews.text: Fernando is amazing , the service and experience is amazing here. Very private and great vibes. I cant wait to come back to DR

reviews.author: Josie G
reviews.title: Ayayay is the best employee
reviews.text: Freilyn (Ayayay) was the absolute best employee there. He made our experience 10 time better. So friendly and kind and took the time to get to know me and my family. I’ll miss him!

reviews.author: Brandi G
reviews.title: Fabulous location!
reviews.text: Alberto, Marcos & Martin took excellent care of us at the adults only Reserve pool bar.  Our drinks were always full and cold!  The oceanfront room was literally steps from the beach. We spent time enjoying the view from our secluded patio. Definitely worth it.  We will make the trip again!  Shout out to our travel agent @72travel for the amazing recommendation!

reviews.author: TheSoonerGeek
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text: Wonderful resort with all you need for a relaxing family vacation! Staff was amazing, shout out to our concierge — Gustavo — who was amazing and always answered our text and came through on every request. Great onsite food and drink. Activities every day, if that’s your thing. The onsite tour booking service recommended three wonderful tours for us that were perfect. The beach is the perfect distance and they do all they can to mitigate the sargassum and it wasn’t bothersome. The pool was a bit deep throughout, only a small shallow one that seemed to be good for toddlers, not much in between for 10-ish.

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: The Family Getaway we needed!
reviews.text: Paradisus is a premier resort.  We’ve been to a few over the years and Paradisus surpasses them all.  We asked to be upgraded to The Reserve upon arrival and for a fair price we were upgraded.  Our concierge, Adriel Cabrera, was the best.  He checked on us every day, as well as booked us at all the restaurants- even coming by our room every evening to walk us to the restaurant to be sure we got in.  Our favorite parts were 1- the beach and view. 2- the pools which are pristine.  3- The room - totally immaculate.  Some of the restaurants are better than others.  But they are all good.  Breakfast at the Sante is top tier.  We were looking for a relaxing family getaway with our 4 grown kids and we would say that we got more than we expected.  Truly beautiful place.  I do think having “Reserve” privileges makes a difference.  So I would recommend doing that.  We are so glad we came and look forward to coming back again!

reviews.author: eymejia
reviews.title: Family
reviews.text: Everyone was amazed of the hotel the amenities  and food,drinks restaurants  and the bedrooms were cool

reviews.author: lianarodriguez
reviews.title: Best Vacation for both Adventure and Relaxation
reviews.text: Great experience, wonderful place but best of all spectacular staff! The room was beautiful, up to date, always cleaned daily, and outside my will was a beautiful pool with daily service. Plenty of restaurants, food is great, staff was better so many to name but these went above and beyond - the 2 Felix at hibachi restaurant, Gabriel at Mexican restaurant, Fausto at Italian restaurant! U have to order the lobster at Mexican restaurant - that was a huge surprise on how good it was. Also the steak and minestrone soup at Italian restaurant so  yummy! Endless mimosas! A special shout out to my favorite person, Jose! He was our concierge and available daily with a special touch of communicating w me daily in person and via wazzup. He made my reservations, he gave me list of daily activities, he had a special touch in my room daily, he linked me to activities outside resort- just an amazing person! Thank u Jose!!! This review is mainly bc of u. My family and I were so grateful for all ur attention and assistance. I will definitely go back and Hope ur there.  Oh yeah another shout out to the cleaning crew, especially Yubelkis!  The premises was always near and clean. Pools, rooms, dining area all clean. U gotta go, great place. Lots of fun!

reviews.author: Patricia K
reviews.title: Excellent!!! Will definitely return!
reviews.text: This place was amazing! The staff, especially Eriol, was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. Pools are clean and plenty of places to relax.

reviews.author: Gilma Bibiana B
reviews.title: Amo servicio en playa
reviews.text: Maravilloso el servicio con Jhohan y Yefry. La playa, el hotel todo. Espectacular. Gracias mil. Sobre todo el servicio.

reviews.author: Jennifer N
reviews.title: Great Experience - Gorgeous Views from Ocean Front Room
reviews.text:
We arrived at the hotel after a long taxi ride from the airport (due to rush hour), we were greeted with a welcome drink and treated with a sense of urgency. The check-in process was super easy and were introduced to our concierge, Adriel Cabrera. He personally escorted us to our room. As soon as he opened the door we saw a full view of the ocean. There was a plate of treats and a bottle of wine with a fully stocked minibar and snacks replenished daily.

Adriel sent us a daily activity list, made us reservations for dinner at a delicious steakhouse and got us transportation to an excursion and airport home. He kept us well informed via WhatsApp and the communication was easy. He made our stay stress free!

We mostly dined at the buffets. The breakfast buffet had a variety of options. Lots of night time entertainment for the kids. The beach was amazing and very little seaweed! In fact, the hotel had a seaweed barrier and the crew and remnants off the beach every morning. 

The hotel staff we encountered went above and beyond to make our stay special. They were always eager to help with recommendations, reservations, or conversation. As we were waiting for a taxi, which was late, Juanlly Robles was super friendly and talked to us which helped pass the time.

Would come back!

reviews.author: Rhonda A
reviews.title: Graduation Celebration
reviews.text: We went on this trip to celebrate our daughter’s high school graduation. We chose this resort for what it had to offer, its grandeur, its beauty, and the adult only section. We didn’t even realize that we would get our own concierge. What a pleasant surprise. Gustavo made our stay all the better! He arranged everything for us. Everyday he messaged us the day’s activities and our dinner reservations.  He also made a point everyday to find us to see how we were doing or if we needed anything.  The restaurants are fabulous and the nightly entertainment is great. I highly recommend this resort, and if luxury and relaxation are important, the Reserve Adult Only is a must!

reviews.author: Stanley S
reviews.title: Excellent Service-Late night service
reviews.text:
Santiago was absolutely amazing and professional in assisting us with transportation for our final night out. He also recommended a great place to go, which made our evening even more enjoyable. Santiago speaks excellent English and Spanish—skills that are incredibly valuable and reflect the high standards of service at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. I will definitely recommend that family and friends ask for Santiago when visiting.

Thank you again, Santiago! 🙏🏿

reviews.author: Tiffany B
reviews.title: 2 thumbs all the way up !
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Awesome Sports Bar at Paradisus Palma Real!

Kicks Sports Bar is a great spot to hang out if you’re staying at Paradisus Palma Real. Elidania was the best bartender ever! Makes the very best Gin & Tonic. The energy is fun and relaxed, with tons of big screens showing all kinds of sports — perfect for catching a game or just chilling with friends.

The service was excellent — super friendly and fast. Our server made us feel right at home, and the drinks were on point. The cocktails were well-made, and the local beers were served ice-cold.

The food was surprisingly great for a bar setting! We had the wings, sliders, and nachos — all delicious, fresh, and full of flavor.

There’s both indoor and outdoor seating, and the music added a nice vibe without being too loud. Whether you’re into sports or just looking for a cool place to relax, Kicks is definitely worth a visit.

Highly recommend checking it out while you’re at the resort!

reviews.author: HSam
reviews.title: Family friendly and great hospitality
reviews.text: Trip was 5 stars! Our concierge’s Eriol and Fransisco were very attentive and gave us peace of mind our entire trip! Definitely recommend it for anyone looking for great times with great food!

reviews.author: Gladys Z
reviews.title: Eriol the best  Concierge for ever
reviews.text: Hemos estado en Meliá paradises Palma real Eriol fue quien me asistió durante mi estancia todo fue muy bien .Siempre esta atento para cumplir su labor .todos los días nos envió las actividades del dia. Gracias Eriol Por todo y pronto nos veremos

reviews.author: Izeiah M
reviews.title: Big family vacation
reviews.text: Great experience the food was amazing service was on point made sure everything was great and Eriol was great help to my family

reviews.author: Joseph S
reviews.title: The best value and staff of any all inclusive, anywhere!
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough about this resort, specifically the staff. Unbelievable experience. We went there to celebrate our 25th wedding anniversary, including a vow renewal, with 37 family members and friends. About half of us had the Reserve level, but the concierges were kind and accommodating to the whole group! They went above and beyond. The grounds are meticulously maintained. The pools were large and clean. The beach was cleaned daily, which is a task to battle the seaweed this time of year in Punta Cana. Some specific shoutouts to the staff:

Luis is the most high energy, enthusiastic young man I’ve ever encountered at any of the dozens of all inclusive a we’ve been to. He was our server at every lunch (Kanna grill), and some dinners. He went out of his way to be accommodating, fun, and just a great host at every meal! The best. “Second only to god!” 

Junior at the breakfast buffet was incredible as well. Start your day out right by visiting him each morning. 

Maximo at the wine bar was absolutely amazing. He went above and beyond to throw us an epic wedding reception. He and his supervisor, Francisco, are just absolute professionals. Do not visit this resort and not go see how they can make your experience better. 

Our concierge was Eriol. I think he was pretty new, but still went out of his way to make the trip special for us, including a beautiful decoration of our room on vow renewal night. Many of our guests had Gustavo as their concierge, and this young man was nothing shy of amazing. “Everything is perfect” with Gustavo. Again, just went out of his way to help. 

We also loved Felix at the hibachi, and Ismael who helped serve out reception. 

Last but not least on the staff call outs, Louisa in Guest Services. One of our guests couldn’t seem to sleep without a fan blowing in his face, so Louisa took an uber to town, face timed us to pick a fan, and delivered it to our guest. Just too much! She helped with countless other things as well. If she’s not already in charge of guest services, she needs to be. 

Just an overall excellent experience. We’ve never felt compelled to return to the same all inclusive twice, but we will be back to this one, and we will definitely check out other Meliá properties. Thank you so much for everything!

reviews.author: Crystal W
reviews.title: Great time and great service with very nice staff
reviews.text: This is our second time visiting this resort and we have enjoyed it both times. Raphael took excellent care of us each day on the beach. The service was excellent. Zenova was fantastic and took wonderful care of us. She had a dinner set up for us the day we arrived and made sure we had everything we needed the entire trip. Luis served us when we had lunch at the manna beach club as well as dinner and he was so attentive and did a great job. We frequented the adults only pool bar as well as the main pool bar and the bartenders there we fantastic. They remembered our drink order after one visit. We had breakfast at Sante each day and the hostess there was so friendly and has our room number memorized by the end of the trip. The waiters there were great and on top of their game. We had a great time and will plan to return.

reviews.author: Johnathan J
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Great trip! Great atmosphere! We will return!  Gustavo was our concierge and did a fantastic job communicating with us and getting us what we needed. Fantastic gentleman! Perfect family vacation!

reviews.author: Gabriel H
reviews.title: EDDY, JONATHAN, VICTOR Y JORGE
reviews.text: Eddy, Jonathan, Victor y Jorge del celcius excelente servicio, nos hicieron plática y nos la hemos pasado de maravilla, son unas excelentes personas, si pueden venir con ellos, lo mejor del mundo. Lo que nos queda de visita, 100% con ellos.

reviews.author: Eva
reviews.title: Volveremos
reviews.text: Volveremos seguro, lo hemos pasado muy bien, quiero mencionar especialmente a Leticia y Raysa encantadoras y súper amables. Se merecen todo lo mejor, están en el bar de la piscina de adultos 90 grados

reviews.author: Kristin H
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: The staff is by far the best part of this resort. Gustavo and Eriol have been amazing. They both need a raise. The spa as well is amazing

reviews.author: Flyer13479578843
reviews.title: The perfect place for relaxation and celebration!
reviews.text: Our trip was a 25th anniversary celebration for our friends and we were there with a group of over 30 people. We stayed in the reserve and Eriol was our concierge. The staff was attentive and  accommodating. They happily took care of everything we needed. The grounds were beautifully kept and it was the perfect place  for us to relax in any of the multiple pools, beach or our room.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Short all inclusive stay
reviews.text: Highly recommend this resort, however I must be fully transparent about my review. We were on property for a short stay which was a benefit of my company making reservations at this property for some of our clients. I have no doubt that the service for everyone else Would have been equal to our better than the service we received but just want to make sure that readers of this review are aware of how we came to this property. We arrived for our three nights stay and were greeted at the check-in with a delicious refreshing welcoming drink, nonalcoholic. Our room was not quite ready however the staff directed us to one of the restaurants where we had lunch waiting for our room to be ready. We did receive an upgraded room which was the swim up suite in the family section. This room was absolutely amazing, being able to walk right out of bed a few steps and into the pool was incredible. Once our room was ready staff came and got us we got into our room we provided information about some of the events were happening on property we put on our swimsuits and began to enjoy but at that time seem to be our private pool. There was a large group on property which was using the convention center facilities which made the property seem less occupied. We were also there during one of the slower seasons so things may be slightly different and the busier seasons. The food and the à la cart restaurants was outstanding. The buffets were above average and typical buffet environment. The fresh omelettes were delicious and hot most all of the food during breakfast or lunch on the buffets was good and they seem to keep it rotating in and out. As mentioned it was not as busy so all of the buffets were not open at the same time although we were able to experience each of them on different days. The beach was wonderful lots of lounge chairs, this was during Sargasm season and they had the beach as clean as I believe they could keep it. Their barriers did a good job of keeping the sarcasm off of the beach and out of the water closest to the beach however there was still sarcasm around which is to be expected during the season. But that being said they were more than enough swimming pools and lounge chairs at the pools to enjoy them and also enough lounge chairs on the beach to enjoy the beach. Our checkout process was seamless we checked out online our luggage was picked up tagged and waiting for our transfer to the airport. A couple of things to keep in mind when you do the online checkout security will probably want to see the Email before you leave the property. Also even though tipping is not required we felt very generous and blessed to have been able to stay there so we did tip most of the staff make sure you have plenty of ones as change was a little difficult to come by. Holly recommend reserving a room and upgrading to concierge service our concierge Eriol was amazing Definitely worth the extra cost in my opinion. We will return and continue to offer this property as one of our favorite for our clients

reviews.author: Mariomart
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: De lujo, todo espectacular, el concierge Basilio fue A1, La comida, bebidas, todo excelente, el único problema fue el sargazo de la playa pero eso es en varias partes, no es culpa del hotel

reviews.author: Yellena D
reviews.title: Paradisus Real Spa And Golf Resort.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our vacation. The people who work here are amazing. Julia, Edickson, and Jose are very nice and always there to help. When we are at the pool, they came multiple times to check if we need anything. They are very polite and amazing. The best place to be with the family.

reviews.author: Thor W
reviews.title: 10/10 would recommend to anyone!
reviews.text: Simply the best all-inclusive resort vacation ever!  The property is beautiful.  The rooms are clean, spacious, and luxurious.  So many options for food, all of them delicious!  What most stands out though is the amazing, friendly staff.  It really makes a difference  when everyone, regardless of position, will take a moment to greet you with a smile.  Gustavo, our concierge, was absolutely wonderful, truly a member of our family for the week!  He took care of our large group amazingly well.  There were so many friendly, helpful people that made this week great, but a few others should be mentioned specifically: Poolside servers, Arisleda and Yefry; Spa coordinator, Robinson; and Waiters, Maximo, Ismael, and Luis.  All so helpful, positive energy, sincerely friendly, and just a pleasure to be around.

reviews.author: Lorene S
reviews.title: Gustavo
reviews.text: Gustavo was so friendly and wonderful. He is a very good asset for your resort. Everybody’s been fantastic, but I just wanted to point out Gustavo because he was so attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Mariana S
reviews.title: Imperdible unas vacaciones en Palma Real!
reviews.text: Fue un viaje increíble, la experiencia del hotel, los restaurantes, todas las zonas pero en especial la atención, la amabilidad de la gente y la ayuda  permanente del concierge hacen de este lugar un gran destino.

reviews.author: Andrea F
reviews.title: Grandioso.
reviews.text: Todo está demasiado bonito y la gente demasiado agradable, nos vamos con un muy buen sabor de boca, esperamos regresar pronto.

reviews.author: Marc D
reviews.title: Great time at the resort!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and I am a Club Melia Member since 1996. I have never had a concierge as professional and attentive as Eriol. Eriol made sure our every need was addressed and that our vacation would be an amazing experience. Eriol made sure we had reservations at the finest restaurant at Palma Real (Flora) for my daughter’s birthday and surprisingly there was a homemade cake at the end with her name on it and it was delicious. My daughter was so surprised and impressed and we have Eriol to thank for that and a wonderful vacation at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Frank Z
reviews.title: A vacation in paradise
reviews.text: Had a fantastic time the features and service were excellent especially our personal concierge Emmanuel. I had a romantic love story dinner planned and he made the experience effortless and she was very happy. Additionally, he was very knowledgeable about activities and any questions I had regarding booking excursions etc. Did a fantastic job also booking nightly dinners as well. We will be coming back and look to request him specifically. Staff was all very friendly. We enjoyed the nightly entertainment as well.

reviews.author: Alberto F
reviews.title: Una Experiencia Grata
reviews.text: El servicio del hotel es muy bueno, en general, Gustavo de Jesús quien fue nuestro Convierte, estuvo atento a todas nuestras necesidades, desde lomas simple hasta las reservas en restaurantes, tours y demás actividades dentro y fuera del hotel

reviews.author: Christopher M
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had an amazing 6 night getaway for our 1st time visiting the Dominican Republic in the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. From the moment we arrived the staff was very attentive to our every need. Samuel was excellent at check-in. Dalmis and Gustavo provided a wonderful personal experience as our personal concierges. They surprised us with a very special dinner at Sante with a pair of lobster tails, shrimp, vegetables, and fried plantain chips. Manuel, Gustavo and Enrique provided excellent service each night we had dinner there. Pedro was amazing and always checking on us as our cocktail concierge each day at the beach. Emmanuel was another personal concierge we met upon arrival who escorted us to our room. Each and every time we ran into him at the resort he took a moment to speak with my wife and I. All in all we loved every moment and look forward to our next visit in 2027 with our adult children and grandchildren. 5🌟 All the Way!

reviews.author: ximenaradicr
reviews.title: ESPECTACULAR HOTEL
reviews.text: Excelente hotel , lindas habitaciones, con muy buena atención del personal tanto en las habitaciones como en todo el complejo

reviews.author: eslynharris2013
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: would certainly be visiting again with friends and family. it is the ideal destination for fun and relaxation.

reviews.author: Vivian M
reviews.title: Buen servicio
reviews.text: En la playa falta más personal atendiendo y snaks, así como en el restaurante sante un poco más de variedad y calidad de servicio ya que la comida estaba fría

reviews.author: Robert D
reviews.title: An awesome experience
reviews.text: We had only spent 3 days at this resort celebrating our wedding anniversary and we had an awesome experience. The resort is beautiful, clean and the customer service was top notch. Eriol was our concierge, he Catered for all our needs very quickly, securing our dinner reservations and ensure we get the best dining experience. All the other staff we came across were courteous and pleasant as well but a big thank you to ERIOL for going above and beyond by putting service above self. You did everything right and so there's nothing else we could have asked of you. My wife and I were happy and you made our wedding anniversary a special one. Take care and keep up the good work, God bless y'all.

reviews.author: Antonio J
reviews.title: Muy bien
reviews.text: Todo muy bien en general el personal súper amable y atentos en todo momento y los restaurantes excelentes y el golf es un paraiso

reviews.author: Erik H
reviews.title: Amazingly beautiful resort
reviews.text: The resort is gorgeous and the staff all seem very happy and willing to do anything for you. Our concierge Gustavo was fantastic, texted us the activities in the morning and made reservations for us where ever we wanted to go  eat. He was answering texts from me at all hours of the day and night.

reviews.author: teharaclarke
reviews.title: Punta Cana Trip
reviews.text: Hotel and service was excellent  Would definitely recommend.  The entertainment was top notch,  The rooms were clean and the view and the grounds were amazing.  The staff was really friendly and assisted at every turn.

reviews.author: antony a
reviews.title: Punta Cana trip of a lifetime
reviews.text:
The overall experience was very good , had fun , all the staff were helpful & friendly , Antonio Ramirez & Rasta in the ginger bar created wonderful mixology drinks to wow us and make the trip extra special,
The staff in the buffet restaurant were outstanding, a big thank you.
The rooms where clean and well kept throughout our stay.
Loads of activities onsite and amazing day trips on party boats & Samoa island etc.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Excellent service beautiful property
reviews.text: Exceptional service. We had a swim up suite which was amazing! Beautiful room and grounds. Renovated in 2022 but showing a few scrapes and bruises which should be expected at any resort. Prime location on the beach, lots of pools and lounge chairs. Lots of space. Pool water was  well maintained. The beach was mostly clean of sargassum, the barrier did a good job. Water had some sargassum but it is the season. Overall very clean beach. Food at buffets were above average, resort was not very busy so all buffets were not open at the same time and the food was cycled in and out and kept at good temperature. The a la cart restaurants were amazing. Concierge, Eriol was amazing. Other staff was great Felix, Juan, Lorainne, Milvin and others were outstanding.

reviews.author: alejozaya
reviews.title: Vacaciones gratificantes
reviews.text: Unas vacaciones en familia muy descansadas y relajantes , la atención del personal excelente , juan sonrisas y las personas del restaurante Mina fabulosas, muchas gracias

reviews.author: lisakeishataylor
reviews.title: Great, unforgettable experience!
reviews.text: The staff was friendly and attentive and the hotel itself was beautiful, the room and service was excellent. I am jamaican and this destination is good competiton!

reviews.author: Nancy T
reviews.title: Fabulous Visit due to the staff!  Jose  and Wander are the BEST!
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous time and would definitely return again! We stayed in the club Melia section and our personal concierge Jose was phenomenal! He was very detail oriented and went above and beyond for our son Alexander’s 9th birthday. The red velvet birthday cake he had specially made for our son was the best cake we have ever tasted.  our son was ecstatic to have had his favorite cake flavor for his birth dinner. 

We were lucky to also have nightly reservations for dinner made by our concierge whichadenit much easier. We did hear that others had difficulty making them on their own. 

Jose should be the model for all concierge experiences that is how good he is at his job. They are very lucky to have him work for their hotel! 

All of the restaurants were great. The buffets were ok and had the typical food assortments you would expect. We were also blessed to have Wander as our daily waiter at the beach side lunch spot and steak house. He was very friendly and professional and always saved us a special spot! He is a hard worker and always went above and beyond. We enjoyed becoming friends with him during our stay! 

We can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.author: SAMUIL Y
reviews.title: Идеальный отдых в роскошном отеле Melia — мой топ-5!
reviews.text:
Отель заслуживает твёрдую пятёрку из пяти баллов — мой опыт здесь был просто великолепным! Прежде всего, меня впечатлила огромная территория отеля, которая позволяет наслаждаться прогулками в любое время дня, не чувствуя себя ограниченным. Пляж с белоснежным песком и прозрачной водой — настоящая мечта, идеальное место для отдыха и расслабления.

Особенно хочу отметить персонал — здесь работают настоящие профессионалы, которые делают всё, чтобы гости чувствовали себя комфортно и важными. Сотрудники всегда приветливые, внимательные и готовы помочь в любой ситуации. Они создают атмосферу тепла и гостеприимства, что делает пребывание по-настоящему приятным. Мне понравилось, как персонал быстро реагировал на мои просьбы и всегда с улыбкой встречал гостей.

Отель также радует разнообразием развлечений и удобств: есть спа, бассейны, рестораны с отличной кухней и множество активностей на любой вкус. Всё организовано на высшем уровне, что говорит о серьёзном подходе к качеству обслуживания.

В целом, это место идеально сочетает роскошь, комфорт и дружелюбие персонала. Я остался очень доволен и с удовольствием вернусь сюда снова!

reviews.author: Alexe A
reviews.title: Fun week with our baby!
reviews.text:
Trip advisor

Check-in: very easy ! We even asked to change rooms and it happened straight away. Great lobby serivce.

Room: junior swim-up is super nice and spacious! Travelling with a baby so we needed space for stroller,crib,bottle prep and washing and we had enough space and never felt squeezed. Comfy beds and sheets too. Crib was already setup for us upon arrival. Swim up is super fun with the baby and worth it to us. Alot of spacs on balcony + chairs and a bali bed outdoors. 

Super clean room and good room service. With the baby we needed alot of water bottles and an extra trash can and everything was brought to us rather quickly when we asked. Housekeeping ladies were so nice with us and our baby. 10/10 on this aspect. 

Eliezer was there to help us with everything we needed, it was great.

Food: the food is the only small thing that was not perfect. The buffet food is average. The big buffet was closed and only a tiny one is available. It's ok for breakfast but very average for lunch and dinner, same foods everyday. 

Restraurants:
Impossible to make dinner reservations! It's a real disaster. It took 20 minutes to book 3 nights only. I don't understand but everything is always full until 9:30pm or closed. 

Ginger coffee place near the lobby is good and fun to relax. Super good coffees and smoothies + nice staff. 
Anthony was the best! Great coffee and smoothies everyday.

Asian restaurant: air conditionning was leaking all over us and our food. Seemed to be the same for all the tables. The ceiling was wet all around the vents. Way too cold , make sure to bring a shirt. Service very slow.

Italian: excellent service and food! 

Steak house: excellent service, food and drinks.

Mexican: THE BEST! I could have gone everynight. Excellent food and service! 10/10 manuel and elxander.

All around we would go back and it was a good experience with our 5 month old baby.

reviews.author: brookmill
reviews.title: Another amazing stay
reviews.text: This was our third stay at the resort and we had another wonderful vacation. Alam was our concierge and he made our trip seamless and special. From making our nightly dinner reservations, to booking excursions, to arranging a late check out and transportation to the airport, he made sure our stay was perfect. He found us every day on the beach to check in and see if there was anymore he could do and was so responsive on messaging even about little things like renting catamarans or exploring the beach a bit.  We will definitely request him in the future! Also thank you to Martin and the other beach attendants. They had our beach bed ready every morning and checked in frequently to see if we needed anything. Also thank you to the Reserve Pool bar attendant (unfortunately don't remember her name!) who greeted us with a smile each day! And big thank you to housekeeping--the best service. They came at the time we requested each day, did nightly turn down service, and our fridge was stocked daily even if we had only used one Perrier--really amazing service. We will be back!

reviews.author: gelavalencia
reviews.title: El verdadero lujo caribeño
reviews.text: Infraestructura imponente, habitaciones de lujo, comida deliciosa, los restaurantes espectaculares y el servicio en cada rincón espectacular

reviews.author: Paradise21780756299
reviews.title: Thank you Sante Team!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience dining at Sante with Rosa and Enrique. The service was wonderful and the dinner felt very intimate and exclusive. My husband enjoyed the lamb and my rib eye was excellent. Lastly the Coulette was my favorite dessert in the entire resort. Thank you Sante Team for a wonderful dining experience.

reviews.author: Maddy R
reviews.title: Maria the Bartender
reviews.text: Rum Republic bartender Maria is an expert mixologist. The Heminguey Daiquiri was more than amazing. The service she provided was exceptional. I noticed another drink she prepared for another customer, the expression of enthusiasm and the smile that came as they sipped the drink was more than positive.

reviews.author: reikodyson
reviews.title: Convention/Vacation Good time
reviews.text: Everyone was so welcoming from the bellhops to the room service personnel.the grounds, beaches & pools were immaculate. The choice restaurants were amazing as well as the bar well stocked. I will definitely make a return to this beautiful paradise😊

reviews.author: NENETTE C
reviews.title: Exceeded our expectations
reviews.text: Our personal concierge Irvin was beyond excellent. He arranged all of our dinner reservations and was always available for our needs. Love shows and concerts were superb. Unlimited drinks, excellent bar tenders. Definitely returning.

reviews.author: Roberto B
reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text:
Our first time in DR and in the Paradisus Palma Real. We feel in love with the beautiful views and the quality of service.

Emmanuel was our Hotel Reserve Concierge and he did not disappoint. We felt as if we were his only guest he was attending to. He was very attentive to us, our needs, provide exceptional recommendations, and even left us a little surprise in our room for our anniversary. He was pleasure to work with. 

He insured we had our reservations for dinner, activities and transport all in a timely manner and was able to resolve any hiccups or mishap.

reviews.author: M E
reviews.title: Another fabulous year in our happy place!
reviews.text:
This was our fifth trip to the Dominican Republic and our second stay at Paradisus Palma Real — and once again, we were reminded why we keep coming back. A huge part of what made this trip so special was our concierge, Christopher.

From the moment we arrived, Christopher was attentive, responsive, and genuinely invested in making sure our stay was seamless and enjoyable. He kept in regular contact throughout the trip, always checking in to see if we needed anything and offering thoughtful suggestions. Whether it was helping with reservations, answering questions, or simply making sure we were comfortable, he handled everything with warmth and professionalism.

We’ve had wonderful experiences in the DR before, and Christopher helped make this year’s experience just as great. He made us feel cared for, not just as guests, but as people. His kind demeanor added an extra layer of ease and enjoyment to our vacation.

Thank you, Christopher, for going above and beyond. We look forward to returning again — and hope to see you next time!

reviews.author: Patty P
reviews.title: Experiencia Inolvidable
reviews.text:
Increíble experiencia, fuimos un grupo de 39 personas y todo funcionó perfecto. 
Luisa y Reinaldo organizaron todo para que tuviéramos unas vacaciones inolvidables!
El servicio del hotel excelente, todos muy amables y preocupados. Las habitaciones cómodas e impecables. Las actividades del hotel muy entretenidas. 
Esperamos volver pronto!!!

reviews.author: Maria S
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful! The food was excellent, especially at Sante restaurant, where we dined twice for dinner. Chef Rafael was wonderful, and our server, Kevin, provided outstanding service. At the Reserve Adult Pool, the bartender, Wanda, was amazing, along with the staff—Martin, Pedro, and Teofilo. 

We were assigned a personal staff member to cater to our needs. Romalo greeted us with a bottle of wine in our room and brought us champagne by the pool. He also kept us updated on our daily activities and ensured that our dinner reservations were made. I would definitely give this place 5 stars and will be going back!

reviews.author: A.M.C
reviews.title: Increíbles vacaciones
reviews.text:
Estuvimos 1 semana de vacaciones en Paradisus Palma Real con 3 familias de amigos. Éramos 39 personas de todas las edades y realmente lo pasamos espectacular. Las instalaciones muy cómodas y limpias, la comida muy rica, el personal siempre atento, la playa casi sin sargazo, pero lo que realmente marcó la diferencia, fue la atención de nuestra Guest Service Manager: Luisa María Mejía Carry. Fue ella quien hizo todo y más para que nuestra estadía fuera inolvidable, estuvo preocupada hasta el más mínimo detalle, siempre amable, dispuesta, resolutiva y pendiente de que todos estuviéramos felices. Junto con Reynaldo Martinez, organizó nuestras cenas y celebraciones al más alto nivel y nos atendieron como los dioses, lo que hace que queramos volver a visitarlos de todas maneras.
Muchas gracias a todos!

reviews.author: walter v
reviews.title: Mejor imposible
reviews.text:
Excelentes instalaciones y un personal muy amable, alegre y preocupado, siempre dispuestos a ayudar en lo que se requiera.
Mención especial a la dedicación de Luisa y Reynaldo que hicieron TODO lo que estuvo a su alcance para que nuestra estadía fuera simplemente MEMORABLE

reviews.author: Kim L
reviews.title: Front desk help
reviews.text:
We took a trip with friends and kids
  The resort was amazing but the front desk was as absolutely wonderful.   Santiago cheeked up in and made sure all our needs the resort were met !    We asked about taking the
Kids to the mall souvenir shopping he suggested a souvenir shop and arranged travel to and from for us and guaranteed it was safe !   It was a great experience. If you go to the Paradisus Palma Real Life please ask for Santiago he will take good care of you and make sure you have the best experience at the resort 
Thanks Santiago

reviews.author: Wanderer25257738196

reviews.text:
Excelente todo el personal, las habiataciones, restaurantes, en fin todo. Las noches en la plaza son espectaculares. Hoy fuimos al winery del hotel y la experiencia fue fabulosa , especialmente Jonathan y Juan muy profesionales, su servicio excepcional. Lo recomiendo 100%

reviews.author: Carla S
reviews.title: Graduación Simón! Pool bar!
reviews.text: Jonathan y Jorge (Bar de la piscina) excelente atención y buena vibra! Lo pasamos increíble en familia celebrando la graduación de Simon! La atención de este bar sin duda lo hizo más especial y disfrutamos de unos maravillosos días en Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Maria Jesus L
reviews.title: Excelente atención de Jonathan y Jorge
reviews.text: Felicidades al Bar piscina ,excelente atencion de Jonathan muy preocupado y atento con toda nuestra familia siempre atento a lo que necesitábamos y muy simpático tuvimos la mejor atención con él sin duda un excelente trabajador quedamos muy felices como familia

reviews.author: Daniela R
reviews.title: JONATHAN GOAT
reviews.text: Bar de la piscina: Excelente servicio, Jonathan es muy atento y amable. la atmósfera es increíble y la música está perfecta. El lugar es muy limpio y la atención buena. Las piñas coladas son exquisitas y el gin tonic es de otro mundo. la verdad muy feliz con la experiencia.

reviews.author: dranoala
reviews.title: Agradável
reviews.text: O hotel é de uma limpeza impecável quanto das áreas comuns bem como o quarto. Serviço prestado maravilhoso, funcionários cordeais e atenciosos. Comida maravilhosa e farta. Bebidas ótimas, melhor Pina Colada que ja tomei na vida.  Pode confiar em fazer a reserva de olhos fechados.

reviews.author: sebastian guill... v
reviews.title: Gran experiencia
reviews.text: El bar de la piscina es buenísimo. Excelente atención. Jonathan y Jorge entregan un excelente servicio en el bar de la piscina; muy buena calidad de los tragos. Todo en el hotel funciona de maravilla. Pasamos una semana increíble en familia. Pudieron coordinar todo considerando que eramos un grupo de 13 personas.

reviews.author: ΒΑΣΙΛΗΣ Σ
reviews.title: A Fastastic Honeymoon
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and everyone was available to help us.

We stayed on the Reserve side in a second-floor woth garden and pool view. The mini-bar was restocked daily as promised, and the housekeeping service was consistently excellent.

The beach in front of the resort was great and all the pools  was fantastic.

For dining, we especially enjoyed Sante for breakfast and lunch most days, and also had fantastic experiences at Mina, and Flora. 

A special shout-out to our concierge, Adriel Cabrera, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. He provided daily updates on activities, made all dining reservations. His thoughtfulness made our trip unforgettable.

All in all, this was a 5-star experience—beautiful property, excellent service, and memories that will last a lifetime.

reviews.author: Maria Jesus P
reviews.title: Mascalzone imperdible!
reviews.text: El restaurant italiano espectacular. La comida increíble y el servicio muy atento. Especialmente Alexandra, Félix y Milton que todo el tiempo estuvieron preocupados de nuestras necesidades. Muy recomendable. Mas aun, un imperdible!

reviews.author: Normita
reviews.title: Wonderful and relaxing experience in Punta Cana
reviews.text: The quality of service and friendliness of staff rates the Palma Real a notch higher than other resorts we have visited in RD. The hotel location within Playa Bávaro is excellent and the proximity to the beach quite convenient. Overall, the Palma Real is our preferred resort destination of all the Meliá properties visited in Mexico and the Caribbean.

reviews.author: fatima
reviews.title: A Perfect Honeymoon Getaway – Truly Memorable Experience!
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles that set the tone for the rest of our stay. The resort grounds were immaculate and beautifully maintained, creating a peaceful and inviting atmosphere.

We stayed on the Reserve side in a second-floor oceanfront room, and the view was absolutely breathtaking. The room was thoughtfully arranged with the bed facing the ocean, allowing us to wake up to stunning sunrises. The mini-bar was restocked daily as promised, and the housekeeping service was consistently excellent.

For dining, we especially enjoyed Sante for lunch most days, and also had fantastic experiences at Mina, Blue Agave, and the sushi experience. The food was top-notch, and the staff at each restaurant were friendly and attentive. All of the cocktails—house and specialty—were delicious, and even the breakfast buffets at both restaurants were impressive.

A special shout-out to our concierge, Sena, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. He provided daily updates on activities, made all our dining reservations, and even arranged a romantic surprise in our room to celebrate our long-awaited honeymoon—including beautiful decorations and a cake. His thoughtfulness made our trip unforgettable.

The entertainment in the evenings was the perfect way to wind down after days filled with beach time, pool lounging, and sunshine. My husband and I typically don’t return to the same resort twice, but this experience was so exceptional that we would gladly make an exception.

All in all, this was a 5-star experience—beautiful property, excellent service, and memories that will last a lifetime.

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.title: Amazing time at a great resort.
reviews.text: On arrival we were greeted by smiles and from that point on it was nothing but.  The grounds were beautiful and clean.  We stayed in the reserve side and had a second floor ocean front view.  It's absolutely amazing.  The room was set up with the bed facing the ocean.  Mini bar was stocked as promised everyday.  Cleaning service was great also. We dined at Sante most days for lunch. Then tried Mina, Blue Agave and sushi experience.  All were amazing along with the staff. All the house or special drinks were amazing. Even the breakfast buffet was good from both restaurants.  We had Sena as a concierge and he was very helpful. Sending all info and activities for the day and booking our restaurants.  He also set up the room as a surprise for our long awaited honeymoon.  The entire room was decorated plus a cake.  He was very thoughtful.  Entertainment was just enough street a long day of beach,  pool and sun.  My wife and I would definitely visit again and we usually do not visit the same place now than once.  All in all great experience with great up keep and staff.

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Exceptional Trip to Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our most recent trip to Paradisus Palma Real may have been the best one yet.  Outstanding service by our concierge, Juan Castillo, truly made the trip memorable.  He made sure he saw us every day and was so helpful in making our dinner reservations and with any minor issues we had.  Truly the best! Food seemed exceptional this time around and the omelets that Jerardo made for me were perfect.  Dining room assistance from Rosanna; Junior; and Yuderqui made the buffet more enjoyable.  Top notch service!  We also had the pleasure of dining in the winery with Jonathan as our host and sommelier.  He was warm, welcoming, and very knowledgeable on the wines he served us.  We were also able to dine in the new restaurant at Grand Cana where Abraham made us feel like family.  A special shout out to Andrea from Flora for a spectacular meal and service.  Martin was a great host when we were at the beach.  Service was amazing.  Julia was amazing as our bartender to our swim up pools.  She was on the ball and checked in on us regularly.  This trip exceeded my expectations, and we will definitely be back to visit soon.

reviews.author: Lilibeth L
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Elidania at the sports bar made us feel incredibly welcome! She even created a special drink for us that tasted amazing. Overall, our experience at this hotel has been outstanding. The staff is very attentive and the service is top-notch. Highly recommended!

Les ánimo a ir al sportbar y disfrutar del ambiente y los tragos.

reviews.author: Sanaah
reviews.title: Greivin  and Raysa Olga Lestica was very helpful, thought he didn’t speak English he still was polite and welcoming.
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Realm is a beautiful and spacious resort! The staff are very helpful and friendly. The drinks were excellent and the food was very good as well! We booked excursions with a group inside the airport, that helped us travel to the resort from the airport as well.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos R
reviews.title: Is a paradise in earth for the one who works all year long and wants to disconnect from work in one of the best beaches
reviews.text:
Very good quality resort. Accommodations, infrastructure and food can’t be better
The assignment of a person for making your life easier works wonderful.
Also , entertainment by night is very good quality.
Employees and personnel who works for the resort is friendly and very customer oriented

reviews.author: Guillermo C
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this amazing hotel! From the minute we checked in, our concierge Anayely took care of everything for us so that we didn't miss anything. She did a great job making our reservations and coordinating other activities for us.

At the pool bar, 32 Grados, our friend Derby, was ready to keep our glasses full with the good stuff.

Food was amazing and our experience at Flora exceeded our expectations. Cesar recommended a combination of dishes so that we sampled the best they offer. At Brisas, we had freshly cooked and delicious breakfast.
 
At the Yhi Spa, we had our Couples Massage and it was wonderful thanks to Alba and Dorka's masterful hands.

We enjoyed every minute of our stay at Palma Real and we'll be back soon. Thanks to Lewis de la Cruz and everyone else at the Black Circle Lounge!

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: Excelentes Vacaciones en excelente hotel
reviews.text: Nos gustó muchísimo el hotel. Las facilidades preciosas, la habitación muy cómoda y espaciosa, la comida en los restaurantes muy variada y de buena calidad. Además, el servicio superior y la atención a los detalles que los distingue, en especial la labor de excelencia del concierte Gustavo de Jesús y del colaborador en el lobby José Ramírez. Ambos se esmeraron en ayudarnos y asegurar nuestras necesidades de servicios se atendieran óptimamente. Gracias a ambos y al personal que nos atendió.

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: Encantados con el hotel Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Las facilidades del hotel son preciosas, habitación muy espaciosa y cómoda y la calidad de la comida muy buena. El servicio de concierne de Gustavo De Jesús fue maravilloso. Estuvo pendiente todos los días a cada detalle para nuestro entretenimiento y disfrute. Excelente trabajo!!!

reviews.author: John and Nancy L
reviews.title: Not our first trip and we’d love to go again.
reviews.text: Very nice time at Paradisus. This is our third trip and we’ve been to several other DR and Mexican  resorts. This is one of our favorites. Jendry, our concierge was in touch every day via messaging. It was an overall very relaxed and beautiful resort with excellent beaches!

reviews.author: Adriana M
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Everything about the hotel was great. Our concierge Gustavo was very attentive and made the DR feel like home. From the minute we walked in to the minute we left, everyone was friendly and welcoming. Would definitely recommend. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.title: Flora's Restaurant 😋
reviews.text: We had a great time. We went to Flora restaurant, Cesar recommended us different choices for dinner wich were extremely delicious. Please visit this restaurant you won't regret the food or the great service. Thanks Cesar. We will back. 100% recommended.

reviews.author: omcimports
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: El mejor entrenamiento la mejor calidad del servicio de verdad que la pasé Genial el Sport bar y los restaurantes fueron lo mejores 💯✨En especial MR AYAYAY FUE un chico excelente y maravilloso los recomiendo muchísimo el mejor servicio Gracias por todo

reviews.author: Compass38344701761
reviews.title: Group Stay
reviews.text: It was an amazing stay.  Our concierge Jendrie went above and beyond.  We had a group of 12 of us and we were well taken care of.  Rafael setup our beach accomodations every mornng and then made sure that we had whatever we needed.  Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: mattwaitman
reviews.title: Paradisus is the #1 all inclusive resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: This was our fourth trip staying at the Paradisus. Each time has been so great. The hotel is laid out very well with pools, buffets, shops easily accessible with minimal walking.  Everything is very clean and exceptional maintained. The best part is the staff. Everyone is so pleasant and friendly making the experience seem very personalized. I highly recommend visiting Antonio and the crew at Ginger Bar.  I can’t wait to book another trip there!

reviews.author: seanaustin1963
reviews.title: Beautiful accommodating  place with great staff!
reviews.text: Jendry was our concierge for our stay. We went there to celebrate our anniversary. Unfortunately the year before we suffered a tragic event and went away to also break away from our grief. Jendry without being asked set up our room for our anniversary. It was stunningly beautiful. Jendry made reservations for our dinner every night told us of every amenity available to us. Jendry is an extremely professional as well as accommodating friendly, polite person when we come back we would love to have Jendry as our concierge. Congratulations Paradisus on having such a great staff member and beautiful facility. We’ll be back!

reviews.author: Hector R
reviews.title: Vacation with friends.
reviews.text: The hotel super nice.  Employees very friendly and helpful.  Highly recommend the hotel.   We ate at Flora and our waiter Cesar was very courteous and knowledgeable.  His recommendations excellent.  Food was great and appetizers were amazing.

reviews.author: Scott T
reviews.title: Best Resort in the Dominican
reviews.text: Great resort that we keep going back to after trying multiple others in the Dominican.  All around best for beach, pools, food and service.  The staff is especially friendly and our concierge, Christopher, took care of everything we needed, whether it was extra pillows, restaurant reservations or transportation!

reviews.author: Amanda W
reviews.title: An incredible resort
reviews.text: An amazing experience! Incredible property and rooms. Food was excellent. In particular we had amazing experiences at our special dinners in The Winery with sommelier Johnatan and on the romantic beach dinner with our wonderful waiter We had a wonderful Arismendis Negueis Jean!

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Winery dinner
reviews.text: Jonathan the sommelier was absolutely incredible and provided the best experience! Will definitely return! Wine was excellent  and wine recommendations were perfect. Great atmosphere and personal service were exceptional. Probably a best experience for ever!

reviews.author: Ryan L
reviews.title: Wonderful Getaway
reviews.text: Gustavo, our concierge, made our vacation stress free. He organized our dinner reservations nightly and ensured that we were able to dine at each of the restaurants. They were all very good. Their menus had something to offer for everyone in my opinion. The room was nice and was frequently restocked with snacks, coffee, water, and other drinks. The pools and beach were nice and maintained well. My only complaint is that it was often hard to tell solicitors that you weren’t interested in purchasing whatever it was they were selling. Overall it was a great trip and Gustavo was a wonderful host.

reviews.author: citojose
reviews.title: Lo mejor, la atencion del Bar Celsius
reviews.text: Pasamos 10 dias muy muy lindos, sobresaliendo por mucho la esmerada y atenta atencion de los empleados del bar celsius de la piscina principal, todos muy atentos y muy en especial, Luis, Victor, Jorge, Quintino, Eddy, Jonathan, Rossana, y el resto. Nos trataron como de la familia.

reviews.author: Patti S
reviews.title: Another week in Paradise!!
reviews.text: We just completed our 10th visit to paradise! As always, our vacation was perfect. Our concierge Eriol took wonderful care of us each and every day. He made all of our reservations, surprised us with special treats in our room each afternoon, and make sure we had anything and everything we wanted. As usual, our beach experience was amazing thanks to Wanda, Pedro and Martin, who we love and are three of the reasons we continue to come back once or twice a year! And of course I cannot forget Gladys, who is the best massage therapist in the DR. She is incredible as is all those associated with the Yhi Spa! The room was spacious and clean with an ocean view and food choices were plentiful. There is nowhere that we travel where the people are kinder or want to enhance your experience more than Paradisus Palma Real!  Thank you and see you again soon!!

reviews.author: Alexander R
reviews.title: Amazing, Incredible, Unforgettable
reviews.text: This was our honeymoon and we were grateful for the experience we had. Our concierge, Gustavo, was top notch. He did everything from arranging our dinner reservations, bringing us chilled wine and putting together a bath with flowers and arranging our transportation to and from the resort to the airport. 10/10 would recommend and make sure to pay a little more and stay in the Reserve section of the hotel. The pool is private with Martin the best bartender in the Dominican.

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Domenican trip 2025
reviews.text: We ate at Flora and our experience was amazing.  The mushrooms deep were to die for. The food overall was exceptional and our server Andrea was the best!  We will defintely eat here again when we come back!  The atmosphere is so different as you feel as though you are eating in a park under trees with a lighted canopy. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
