reviews.author: I M
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Paradisus Palma Real Paradisus Palma Real Paradisus Palma Real Paradisus Palma Real Paradisus Palma
reviews.text:
El Paradisus Palma Real es un resort todo incluido de lujo en Punta Cana, ideal para quienes buscan descanso, buena gastronomía y entretenimiento de calidad. Desde la llegada, el servicio cálido y profesional destaca, y el entorno tropical invita a relajarse.

Uno de los puntos fuertes del hotel es su oferta de comida y bebida. Cuenta con restaurantes a la carta que ofrecen cocina internacional, carnes, sushi y más, además de un bufé muy variado con opciones frescas y sabrosas. Los bares están ubicados en zonas clave como la piscina y la playa, y sirven cócteles creativos, bebidas premium y refrescos durante todo el día, todo incluido en la experiencia.

Para los adultos, las actividades son variadas: deportes acuáticos como kayak o windsurf, clases de yoga y pilates, y por las noches, espectáculos en vivo, música y eventos temáticos. El área Royal Service ofrece un espacio más exclusivo para quienes buscan tranquilidad.

Mención especial merece Soranyi, la animadora del hotel. Su energía, carisma y dedicación transforman cada actividad en un momento inolvidable. Ya sea una clase de zumba o un juego en la piscina, ella logra conectar con los huéspedes y hacerlos sentir bienvenidos y entretenidos, creando un ambiente alegre y participativo.

reviews.author: jose vicente c
reviews.title: Recomendable
reviews.text:
Gran hotel para descansar y desconectar. Un lugar paradisiaco
Muchas gracias por la atencion del hotel. Mención especial a Gustavo, nuestro concierge . Nos ha facilitado los días. Un gran profesional y maravillosa persona .
Recomendable ,

reviews.author: tratliff2017
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: Great location, clean, good food and the staff was mostly pleasant. Getting our room cleaned seemed to be the only issue. Sometimes early morning but others times early evening. Our concierge, Francisco, was great!  Plan to return next year.

reviews.author: Jacqueline
reviews.title: Flora Restaurant was excellent
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant was great. All the plates we ate were delicious. Our waiter Jean was responsible for our great evening.  All the plates were good. I recommend the Sancocho Ahumado and Cocofish… definitely we’re coming back to taste the other menu.

reviews.author: Voyage31535086630
reviews.title: Most amazing getaway!
reviews.text: Most amazing vacation! Beautiful room. White sandy beach with beautiful water.  Our concierge Bascillio was the BEST! So friendly and informative, however not overbearing whatsoever.  We didn’t want for anything.  Felix brought our room service with a smile. He paid attention to detail.   Overall we had the best experience and cannot wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Heidi Z
reviews.title: Perfect Weekend Escape – Thanks to Alam!
reviews.text:
My sister and I took a quick weekend getaway, and it truly felt like a dream! The resort was absolutely beautiful. We stayed on the "Reserve" side, and our room was nothing short of luxurious—comfortable beds, spacious bathroom areas, and an overall serene atmosphere that made getting ready a breeze. The private beach access was also a huge plus, offering a peaceful and exclusive experience.

While everything about the resort was impressive, what really elevated our trip was the outstanding service from our concierge, Alam M. His attention to detail and dedication to ensuring we had a seamless experience were unmatched. He was incredibly responsive, helping us with questions and requests at any time. He handled all of our dinner and spa reservations, and even checked in with us each morning via text to share the day’s events and make sure we didn’t miss out on anything.

Alam was warm, professional, and genuinely seemed to love what he does. His thoughtful care made a great trip into an unforgettable one. We’re already talking about our next visit—and hope to have Alam as our concierge again! 10/10 would recommend the Paradisus to friends and family in the future!

reviews.author: lailarocha
reviews.title: Concierge service at resort
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at this beautiful resort and had a great experience with the concierge services from Mr. Errol Ali’s, who made our stay much more pleasant. It was my aunts 60th birthday and he spoiled her with surprise cake, balloons, room decorations. He also helped us arrange and book any experience and services we needed.
It was awesome!
Thank you!

reviews.author: Gabriel F
reviews.title: Eriol the best!
reviews.text: The place is amazing and the staff make it even better. Our amazing concierge Eriol was fantastic throughout our entire trip. He was thoughtful and helped our days run smoothly from signing up to activities to dinner reservations. The weather was awesome and I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Elvira A
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text:
Everything.  KIDNESS , food. Instalaciones.  And our advisor ERIOL. very profesional.  Todo ha salido a la perfección.  Gracias a nuestro advisor  ERIOL, que nos acompaño cada día y nos iba guiando en los restaurantes y actividades. 
El hotel está muy bien. Las piscinas , acceso a la playa. Destacariamos de todo ña gran disposición y amabilidad extrema de todo el personal del hotel.  Desde la recepción, camareros, monitores   Etc... enhorabuena 👏 para repetir experiencia

reviews.author: visitor from Maryland
reviews.title: first trip to DR
reviews.text: 4/28/25-5/2/25 stay in all adult RESERVE section,  everything was pefect, had so a great time to celebrate my 60th birthday with my girlfriends,  i  cant wait to bring my hubby, our butler KELVIN was the best,  we felt so safe and having KELVIN to assist us felt like having a friend watching over us!!

reviews.author: Ailin B
reviews.title: Una estancia en el paraíso
reviews.text:
Pasamos dos días de lujo en el paraíso. Vinimos en pareja solo a pasar el fin de semana, y la experiencia fue increíble de principio a fin. 

The Reserve es el lugar ideal si quieres descansar. El silencio, la comodidad, el servicio, la cercanía de la pileta y la playa, todo realmente increíble. Muchísimo detalle desde el check in, amenities, bebidas, room service. No falta nada en ningún momento. 

Párrafo aparte merece el servicio de concierge a cargo de Gustavo: ¡fue excelente!
Siempre atento a nuestras necesidades y gustos, elevó nuestra estancia al siguiente nivel. Muchas gracias Gustavo! 

Volveremos sin dudas a quedarnos más tiempo.

reviews.author: A..
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Simply put, everything was excellent.  Stayed on adults side.  Resort never felt crowded.  Always clean. Rooms are great. Food was good.  Beach was great.  Pools are great.  Staff is great.  Only negative I have is (which wasn't too bad) that sometimes families with kids would sit on adults only side of the beach.

reviews.author: Roberto J
reviews.title: Hermosa estadía !
reviews.text:
Hermosa habitación, con salida directa a la pileta.
Gustavo nuestro concierge un genio total! Da un servicio de excelencia .

Nos ayudó en todo e hizo las reservas de los  excelentes restaurantes del hotel.

Todo el personal del hotel es muy amable, atentos y serviciales.

reviews.author: Jason P
reviews.title: Flora is great
reviews.text: The server, Ana Michel, at Flora was amazing. Very friendly, attentive, and helpful with the menu. The food was also the best at Flora. I would recommend others to make reservations here if they can. The ambience is earthy and tropical at the same time, along with a very soothing atmosphere with the music and lighting.

reviews.author: Cho M
reviews.title: La mejors del mundo Leticia - Ariza y Olga que servicio
reviews.text: Hermoso destino en punta cana un servicio excepcional en la piscina 90 grados Paradisus palma real con Leticia,Raisa y Olga son las mejores si van a este hotel no duden en preguntar por ellas y buscarlas, gracias mil de corazón 🥰😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

reviews.author: AlexSP1981
reviews.title: Excelente Resort em Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Gostei bastante da minha semana de hospedagem no Paradisus Palma Real.
O resort é muito bem cuidado, com muitas piscinas, bons restaurantes e a equipe foi sempre cordial nos atendimentos, principalmente a atendente Carolina do bar ao lado da recepção.
O quarto era excepcional, com itens de alta qualidade, conforto e um ar condicionado que funciona perfeitamente.
Voltaria a me hospedar no Paradisus no futuro.

reviews.author: Charles B
reviews.title: Just what we needed...
reviews.text: What a perfect anniversary trip with my wife!  The staff at the PARADISUS was amazing.  Cristian Gonzalez was awesome and made our stay very special.  He took care of reservations, helping us every step of the way.  They even made up our room with rose petals, champagne, and a beautiful dessert for our special day!  The beach is incredible and our guy, Rafiel made sure that we had drinks, a great double bed (one in the sun and the other under the shade, and everything else!  I can not tell you how impressed we were with the Reserve.  The food was fantastic and the service just as good.  We will be back I can promise you that...  Charles and Gia.

reviews.author: ciepiela
reviews.title: service and food and amenities are tops
reviews.text: great place - clean, staff are friendly and very helpful and accommodating, the place is spacious and never feels crowded, food and service are great

reviews.author: Sharon E
reviews.title: Fabulous Getaway - Sharon E
reviews.text: My stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort was a place to remember, beautiful surroundings and friendly staff.  Superior Service received from the concierge Basilio whom was very knowledgeable, attentive and cordial.  It was such a pleasure dealing with him.  He helped make our vacation experience very special.

reviews.author: Roper2u
reviews.title: Refresh, Relax, Refocus it’s all about the people
reviews.text:
Let me start this resort is nice but what makes it 5 stars is the people.  Nearly everyone we came across made us fell welcome and special.  Thank you. These folks come to work each day with a smile and mindset to genuinely take service and caring of their guest the number 1 priority.  It was humbling and a great example for me personally. 

My wife and I stayed on the adult side Reserve which is quiet and relaxing. All three adult pools are nice, clean and there were plenty of places to sit both cabana or chairs with umbrellas. Reserve is worth the upgrade for the concierge: (Cristian your genuine desire to make our trip special blew us away you took care of more than we could have asked! Basilio thank you getting us to our room and reaching out later in the week was a bright spot), reserve beach clean nice and water & w/private watering hole (Pedro, Gilberto, Yeurdi welcoming everyday, mi hermanos) plus two extra adult quiet pools in addition to large adult pool with swimup and on top of all this Sante restaurants for breakfast, lunch and or dinner are part of Reserve experience. 

Restaurants are good not five star but good particularly liked Sante, Blue Agave, and Flora and the rum bar between Mina and Japanese place was cool: shout out to Miquel the ultimate mixologist who greeted us every night with a big smile and treated us like family. Sante is where we had breakfast and lunch everyday. 

Room again adult side reserved were clean, spacious and accommodating.  We had garden view not sure pool view is worth extra cost only because everything is in close proximity. 

Again,  the people make this place and I will list them because they need/deserve a heartfelt shoutout due to their work ethic and sincere efforts to make everyone’s’ stay memorable.  Thank you:

Cristian concierge 
Pedro, Gilbertoreserve beach
Robindson spa
Rosa and Luz (light) - Sante
Basilio concierge
Yeime, Fior and Glaydis spa
Milton and Wilmina - Italian 
Hector out front
Juan Barnelis Maria and Cesar - Sante
Giancarlo and Miquel Mina
Santo and Alexander from Blu Agave

reviews.author: Precious B
reviews.title: Personalize the mini bar
reviews.text:
This was one of my best Get aways.
The staff was so attentive from the extraordinary service of the concierge to the young man (Franklin O) that made sure our mini fridge was personalized to our liking.
The view food and staff made this a trip I will always remember

reviews.author: Lenin G
reviews.title: A stay in paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus is an amazing experience. Staff is friendly and accommodating. The hospitality is superb. Blue Agave restaurant is top notch and Delvin was the best waiter. Ariel was the best butler, making sure our stay was as comfortable as possible.

reviews.author: zebrah_c
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Spent one week at the Reserve Adults only section.  Food was great.  Staff were very friendly and helpful in all areas.  Easy to get sun and shade on the beach at any time of day and the staff were quick to assist getting towels to cover the sunbeds and coming around often to get drink orders.  Food was great.  We did not try any of the buffets in other restaurants.  Sante, the reserve restaurant was so good we ate there every day for breakfast and lunch.  Flora had melt in your mouth ribs.  Blue agave and the pizza/pasta place were good.  The steakhouse was a bit hit and miss but that could happen anywhere.  Drinks were fabulous.  Margaritas, martinis and mimosas.  We had a swim up suite so no issues with getting chairs by the pool but there were empty chairs available (perhaps we went on a quiet week?).  Our concierge, Emmanuel was always quick to respond to us and made sure we were satisfied with our stay.  Overall an amazing week.  We will definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: Anne-Julie D
reviews.title: Soirée formidable
reviews.text: Le restaurant italien était vraiment bon, un super service. Ils étaient très présent pour tous nos besoins, on le conseil. Notre fils de 2 ans a adoré aussi ses pâtes, il a presque tout mangé son assiette généreuse! Super resort, c’est bien adapté pour les adultes comme pour la famille.

reviews.author: corinne g
reviews.title: Mascalzones (Italian Restaurant)
reviews.text: Mascalzones Restaurant at the Palma Real. The service was fantastic, our waiter Alexander was great with meeting all of my dietary restrictions. The portions were perfect, and the food was delicious. The drinks were great. I got an Aperol Spritz and it tasted just like the ones I had in Italy. The deserts were stunning and very delicious. 10/10 would recommend the Italian restaurant at the Palma Real.

reviews.author: Karen E
reviews.title: Magnification
reviews.text: My stay was magnificent! Basilo who is part of the concierge staff made my stay everything I could dream. It was my 1st trip to Punta Cuna and the resort! I had s great time. Definitely take the ATV tour!    My room was beautiful, Room service was excellent

reviews.author: Stay36059229927
reviews.title: Great restaurant
reviews.text: Very nice welcome, good food, our waitress Aleksandra  was very kind and efficient. Beuatiful ambient cant wait to come again. One of better italian food in Dominician Republic. Desserts were also very good in italian traditional way. Great experience!!!

reviews.author: Arturo S
reviews.title: Una Experiencia Maravillosa
reviews.text: Nuestra visita al Paradisus Palma Real en Punta cana ha sido fantástica una experiencia cinco estrellas de principio a fin nos quedamos en el área exclusiva sólo para adultos (The Reserve) al llegar te reciben en un Lobby privado donde te hacen tu checking al Hotel, te asigna a un mayordomo (en nuestro caso fue Basilio) que te va a acompañar durante toda la estadía y te va a apoyar con reservas preguntas dudas en todo momento Luego te designan a una área exclusiva del Resort con piscina exclusiva para los miembros de la zona adultos y también en la playa tenemos nuestras propias camas y servicio directo al las camas donde estamos en la playa sin necesidad de levantarte para pedir un trago la atención 10 de 10 Todo ha sido espectacular. los restaurantes a la carta todos fueron fantásticos la atención del personal también la limpieza ha sido maravillosa la habitación que nos has tocado nos hospedamos en una suite Junior con vista directa o acceso directo a la piscina el cual fue increíble un mini bar que era rellenado cada día con todo lo que necesitábamos servicio a la habitación 24 horas Estamos complacidos con lo maravilloso que ha sido este Hotel y volveríamos sin ninguna duda lo recomiendo a toda persona que esté buscando un Resort en Punta cana.

reviews.author: Holden M
reviews.title: Excellent honeymoon dinner
reviews.text: The food was excellent! Gourmet and portion sizes are perfect! The dessert was not too sugary and just the right amount. We had the Dominican sliders and the fish and coconut sauce. Everything we ate was delicious and the staff were very helpful and friendly

reviews.author: Monica T
reviews.title: Gracias por el excelente servicios de todo el respeto te hacen sentir en casa y como estuvieras en familia, mil gracias
reviews.text: Excelente servicio, atención , una persona respetuosa, te hace sentir en casa, te trata como familia, el servicio en de la piscina central de Rosanna Aquino es encantador , de verdad nos sentimos muy felices con ella y los chico del bar Victor, quintino, Eddie, Jorge y jefrey son los mejores🙏🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: Trek24564819962
reviews.title: Melvin the best bartender!
reviews.text: Melvin is amazing! The drinks he recommended and made were amazing! Rum bar is great! We really enjoyed the atmosphere and hospitality. I am typically prefer a bourbon/old fashion but the rum old fashion is a must have! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: malegni a
reviews.title: Romantic Delighted Dinner
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience. Team and staff provided top- notch service. Everyone was outstanding especially Omar Ferrera  and Arismendi Jean . Omar and Arimendi provided exceptional service . They exceeded our expectations. We are very thankful and grateful of their service.

reviews.author: Arlene L
reviews.title: Thank you Melben
reviews.text: Melben made  fantastic Passion Mamajuana!! Super friendly and a great sense of humor!! Thank you! Great service too. He lights the cinnamon  which gives it a great flavor. Cheers to the Rum Republic Bar and the great bartenders! Come have them make you a delicious drink!

reviews.author: fsilva2023
reviews.title: Excellent Stay @ Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: I travelled to Punta Cana and my first choice was Melia Beach Caribe Resort, after a bad expirience  I changed Hotel to Paradisus Palma Real. All the expirience since the begining to the end was amazing. The Hotel fulfill all our expectetions, we stayed at the adult only and it was incredible the room, service and personnel.

reviews.author: vergine1979
reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: “El servicio de playa de Jusus fue excepcional. Siempre atento, amable y dispuesto a ayudarnos en todo momento. Su dedicación y profesionalismo hicieron que nuestra experiencia en la playa fuera perfecta. ¡Mil gracias, Jusus y Marileisy!!

reviews.author: CO70
reviews.text: Un lugar increíble! Carolina y su equipo son simplemente fantásticos, súper amables y atentos. El dueño también es muy simpático y se nota que todos trabajan con pasión. ¡No se vayan sin probar el Espresso Martini, es espectacular! 100 % recomendado.

reviews.author: Rossparty O
reviews.title: Having a wonderful time!
reviews.text:
Maria at Rum Republic is so amazing! She was very kind and friendly with our children and made the adults some fantastic pre-dinner cocktails!  

We have had a great vacation thus far. Our room is spacious and clean. It is a bit rundown, but the view of the ocean front more than makes up for it. 

The pool and beach are well maintained and there is plenty to do in terms of activities.

Thanks for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Alexandra D
reviews.title: Great vaca!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort and friendly staff!  Fernando and Miguel really take care of you at the Between Bar!  Go see them for a cocktail!

The resort has many pools and beach access.  They have on site activities as well, like pizza making.

This is the third paradisus hotel we’ve been too!  Great times to be had by all!

reviews.author: kbackel
reviews.title: Concierge Service
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort with a great staff. A lot of restaurant options as well as daily activities for people of all ages.  Adriel was a friendly and organized concierge who made sure all of your needs were met effortlessly.  He is diligent, helpful, kind and on top of everything.

reviews.author: danaincf
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with amazing staff and service.  Highly recommend. Hosted my daughter's wedding at the resort and it could not have been any better!  Truly remarkable event with every detail delivered beyond expectation.

reviews.author: Sudhanshu
reviews.title: Highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Me and my family had a wonderful experience! The food was great! Beach is awesome and they have a lot of bali huts. Lot of dining options too. Great vibes. Live music in the evening inbthe central area. Antonio and Maykol helped us a lot and are wonderful hosts.

reviews.author: Brynn C
reviews.title: Most relaxing vacation ever :)
reviews.text: We had an amazing unforgettable vacation at this resort. It is definitely worth it to splurge on the reserves- the room was beautiful and our personal concierge Gustavo was able to book all our dinner reservations, excursions, and spa apts. All the staff was so kind and welcoming.

reviews.author: Miguel Clase
reviews.title: Muy buena experiencia, con un evento negativo
reviews.text:
Excelente comida, servicio, un lugar tenomenal.
Lo único es que encontré una cucaracha en el comedor mientras cenaba.
Mientras estaba centado apareció por la parte de atrás de mi asiento en el buffet, luego vino un camarero y le mostré y pidió excusa por el insistente.

reviews.author: Sonia F
reviews.title: Paraíso dominicano
reviews.text: Magnífico hotel situado sobre una espectacular playa. Nos alojamos en una Master suite, habitación muy amplia, con salón independiente y vistas al mar. Los restaurantes de calidad, tanto el buffet como los restaurantes a la carta. La zona The Reserve (solo adultos) un oasis de paz, con varias piscinas, zona exclusiva en la playa con camas balinesas y experiencias incluidas como excursión en catamarán a una isla virgen para realizar yoga, muy top! El personal siempre atento y con una sonrisa. Destacar el servicio de nuestro concierge Christopher que hizo que nuestra experiencia fuese inmejorable, estuvo pendiente de nosotros en todo momento, realizando las reservas de los restaurantes y ayudándonos con todas nuestras peticiones. Repetiremos sin duda!

reviews.author: Javiera B
reviews.title: Flora
reviews.text:
Muy bueno todo! El restorán flora increíble. Melina nos atendió muy bien y con muy buena actitud  y la comida estaba espectacular. El pescado y la carne estaba increíble, el
Vino también. Lo único que podría mejorarse es los postres que la verdad los encontré insípidos y sin mucho sabor.

reviews.author: Eileen S S
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
El servicio, en general, fue excelente. Varios empleados superaron mis expectativas. Entre ellos, Leticia (barra piscina) y Andy (room service). 
Sin embargo, algunos aspectos pueden mejorar, como el tiempo de espera del room service.

reviews.author: Abel J
reviews.title: Vacaciones en el paraíso
reviews.text: Si buscas una experiencia de lujo que supere todas tus expectativas, no busques más: este resort es, sin duda, el mejor de la zona. Desde el entorno paradisíaco hasta las instalaciones de última generación, todo está pensado para ofrecer una estancia inolvidable. Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es el personal: profesionales impecables que te reciben con una sonrisa y te hacen sentir como en casa. Para una experiencia aún más exclusiva, recomiendo la opción Destination Inclusive con The Reserve. Disfrutarás de acceso a zonas premium y experiencias únicas, como una clase privada de yoga en una plataforma virgen con vistas espectaculares. Además, contarás con un servicio de mayordomo personalizado. Queremos destacar especialmente a Christopher, quien hizo de nuestra estancia algo mágico. Su atención al detalle, su amabilidad y su disposición para anticiparse a nuestras necesidades fueron excepcionales. ¡Gracias, Christopher! Sin duda, volveremos a este paraíso, y lo recomendaremos a todos nuestros amigos

reviews.author: Patricia Q
reviews.title: Melia 10/10
reviews.text:
Mejor atención imposible: Sara y  Auri Álvarez son los mejores. Gracias de verdad por la atención. 10/10 siempre. Gracias de verdad por el buen servicio y por la amabilidad de todos.

Gracias, gracias, gracias de verdad. Recomendado por siempre.

reviews.author: Elisenda Q
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Excelente hotel con todos los lujos y comodidades. Extraordinario trato por parte de  Christopher, nuestro mayordomo asignado para estas vacaciones. Siempre pendiente de nuestras necesidades y ayudándonos en todo. De hecho,  estamos pensando en volver y pediremos que nos atienda él de nuevo. 100% recomendable! Gracias por todo!

reviews.author: Cristina O
reviews.title: Piscina celsius
reviews.text: Lo pasamos fenomenal y en el bar de la piscina celsius nos trataron genial, especialmente Jonathan, Alberto, Jorge, Victor, Eddy, Rosanna y compañía!!! Los cócteles están buenísimos y el servicio es impecable. Volveremos seguro 💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼

reviews.author: irina j
reviews.title: Adults only vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at adults only reserve. The hotel rooms are very spacious and bed was very comfortable. The pools are amazing. We had no problems getting beds at the beach or the pool. The food was amazing. Our concierge Cristian was very best we ever had. He organized a great birthday celebration for me. We will come back here again. Wanda at the adults only bar makes the best drinks and Pedro will take care of you at the beach. Any employees that we met were so nice and they work very hard.

reviews.author: Ana M
reviews.title: Amazing bar experience
reviews.text: Luis es el mejor bar tender del mundo. Desde el primer día nos ha tratado genial. Su actitud y energía se contagia y te hace pasártelo mejor de lo que creías. Solo puedo decir que nos lo llevamos a España!!!!!!!!!!!🥳🥳🥳🥳💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼💃🏼🇪🇸🇪🇸🇪🇸🇪🇸🇪🇸🇪🇸🇪🇸

reviews.author: Clara C
reviews.title: Muy amables en todo
reviews.text:
Muy divertido los juegos del kidsdom y divinas las chicas que los cuidan. Muy atentas. En la pileta ponen juegos diferentes cada día.
La playa divina. Muy buena la atención en todos los lugares del hotel. 
Variedad de comida rica y tragos!!!
Los días lindos. Seguro vamos a volver.

reviews.author: C A
reviews.title: Opción perfecta para venir en familia!!
reviews.text:
Todo ha estado genial!!
Es un hotel perfecto para venir en familia!! 3 niños entre 8 y 3 años.

Personal, sobre todo KidsDom, muy atento!!

Hemos estado una semana y ha sido todo muy ameno, con actividades desde por la mañana hasta por la noche para adultos, niños y familia!

100% recomendable.

Volveremos

reviews.author: Mike M
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Paradisus was one of the better experiences we have had at a resort. Beautiful and well kept rooms, buildings and grounds. The service was what really made this place stand out though. Very attentive, always smiling and lots of fun attitudes. 
Special shout out to our concierge Romulus. Martin “the dancing machine”. And our incredible beach bartender Gilberto. Everyone at the resort was great, but these 3 really stick out and made our trip memorable

reviews.author: Monica Q
reviews.title: Excelente servicio, comida, atención. Cada detalle, el personal es muy amoroso y servicial, siempre al pendiente
reviews.text: Nuestra experiencia fue muy top, nos trataron con mucho cariño y respeto. Cada día teníamos actividades para escoger, las actividades son maravillosas. El personal del hotel está muy buen preparado en cuanto dar un buen servicio, siempre con una sonrisa y una palabra amable, todo muy bien pensado. Nuestro conserje fue Adriel Cabrera quien fue nuestra compañía perfecta durante toda la semana. Gracias de corazón Adriel.

reviews.author: ISABELLE L
reviews.title: Un autre magnifique séjour au Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Wow! Quel beau Resort dans un cadre idyllique et en bordure d'une magnifique plage de la mer turquoise des Caraîbe! La beauté, la propreté, la tranquillité et la bonté du personnel font la marque de commerce de cet hôtel qui assume bien ces 5 étoiles!

Pour ce séjour dans la Réserve (section adulte), nous avons été merveilleusement  accompagné par Basilio qui a été bien à l'écoute pour satisfaire tous nos besoins. 

La Réserve offre un bel oasis de paix  et l'exclusivité du Resto Santé avec la cuisine gastronomique du chef Rafaël! Tant à ce restaurant,  qu'au buffet Canna, nous avons trouvé de quoi satisfaire nos papilles gustatives à chaque jour: de beaux poissons, fruits de mer en abondance, bon choix de viande et de légumes locaux bien appréciés...

Le personnel y est dès plus sympathique et accueillant! Merci particulièrement aux hôtesses pour leur chaleureux accueil, à Henry, Juan, Edouardo et Gustavo du Resto Santé, ainsi qu' à Santo, Cyrillo, Rosanna et Yanira du buffet Canna qui se sont assuré de répondre avec entrain à tous nos besoins! 

Merci aussi à Carlos de l'équipe d'animation pour son enthousiame et à Pedro sur la plage qui accourt à la sueur de son front et avec tout son coeur pour vous servir!!

Les seuls désagréments de ce séjour ont été la musique très bruyante de certains spectacles le soir et  la monopolisation de la Place Coloniale un soir par un groupe privé qui a envahi l'hôtel quelques jours. 

Nous trouvons que l'hôtel devrait offrir une salle privée pour permettre à ces regroupements de tenir leurs activités et animation bruyante qui ne devraient pas avoir lieu dans les aires communes ...

Isabelle et Alain

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Luis is the man.
reviews.text: Luis was the best. He gave the best recommendations for dinner and things to do. My dude is like family now. I would recommend this trip. Give it 3 thumbs  up! Find Luis for anything you need. Friendly people, good food and great drinks. Pools are great and the beach is very nice. All the staff is great.

reviews.author: Collin C
reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.text: Best all inclusive I’ve been to so far! The pools were great. Luis did an excellent job, took care of us the whole time! The shows at night were a highlight. The food was a 9 out of 10. The only thing that was missing was a hot tub and maybe more servers walking around for drink service.

reviews.author: tristansofficial
reviews.title: Paradisus vacation
reviews.text: Staff is extremely accommodating. Special shout-out to Johnathan at the Celsius swim up bar. He is genuinely sweet and happy to not only help serve but interact with the guests to make sure they feel safe and have fun. He, as well of the rest of the staff, are always checking in to make sure you are having a nice experience. When you leave your room, you can leave for what feels like 5-10 minutes and return to a room with a bed made, snacks and refreshments restocked, with everything organized. This resort employee very enthusiastic, hard workers

reviews.author: Vicky
reviews.title: En el Paraíso 🏝️❤️
reviews.text:
Destaco la cena de enamorados , excelente y cordial atención de Arismendis Neguéis jean, que a pesar de la lluvia salvo una noche inolvidable ❤️ 
Ubicado en una de las mejores playas de Bávaro, su extensión un 10! 
Las instalaciones impecables , superó nuestras expectativas! 
Los restaurantes temáticos muy bien sugiero ponerle un poco más de fuerza a la experiencia japonesa.
Gracias a cada una de las personas que hicieron de nuestra experiencia momentos inolvidables🏝️🤍

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Must do experience!
reviews.text: Arismendis Negueis Jean arranged a private romantic dinner on the beach for us to celebrate our honeymoon. From beginning to end it was perfect. Surf and turf, wine, apps, and dessert. It was amazing! Make sure you do this if you go! 10/10 service!

reviews.author: Coleen J
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in The Reserve section and it was fabulous! Eriol was our concierge. He took care of every need.  He really pampered us and made it a memorable experience. We had a junior suite. It was perfect size and always well stocked. Flora and Mascalzones were our favorite cuisine. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Alejandro Q
reviews.title: Meliá Paradisus 10/10
reviews.text:
La atención de los meseros de la playa, Rafael, Yudery, Pedro , Martín, Arisleida, Teófilo, Joel 10/10 así mismo Luis Garcés jefe de zona es un caballero, amable y muy dispuesto para esta familia.

Gracias q todos por atendernos y estar disponibles siempre paga atendernos. 10/10 todos.

reviews.author: Yegzeru A
reviews.title: Relaxing experience at the beach
reviews.text: Our experience at the beach was great, thanks to Vanessa, who took care of us serving us drinks and anything we asked for. Vanessa checked in on us and was very attentive. Vanessa was a good server and we remembered her from our last trip here to DR.

reviews.author: Andrea D
reviews.title: Tropical paradise for adults only
reviews.text: Beautiful  clean and updated property. We stayed in the reserve section. The reserve is for adults only.  We had our own concierge,  Adriel, who was fantastic! He took care of all our reservations and anything else we needed. The food was top qualify. I'm definitely planning to return.

reviews.author: Amani M
reviews.title: Rum Republic is a must!!!
reviews.text: Jensy and Miguel we’re amazing and kept us coming back every night!!! If you come here, Rum Republic is a must!! They took great care of us and were extremely knowledgeable! Take my advice and try the Smoked Rum Fashioned, you will not be disappointed!!!

reviews.author: Alice K.
reviews.title: Thank You Melia!
reviews.text: Beautfiul hotel with picturesque rooms and very friendly staff. In particular, our concierge Basilio made sure our stay was enjoyable and that everything went smoothly. We stayed at the Reserve portion of the hotel and really enjoyed the quiet pools and beach this section offered.

reviews.author: guylainegervais
reviews.title: Nous étions au paradis
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une excellente semaine au Paradisus.Le site enchanteur, d’une propreté impeccable, le personnel gentil et courtois.
Il y a de la disponibilité pour s'asseoir à la mer et à la piscine au soleil ou à l’ombre.La nourriture digne d’un 5 étoiles avec collation dans la chambre.
Le seul bémol est la réservation des restaurants, L’idéal serait premier arrivé premier servi avec aucune réservation et après on prend une roulette et on attend qu’une table se libère ou sinon garder les réservations mais qu’on puisse tous les réserver à l’arrivée.
Il y a beaucoup d’animation autant le jour que le soir bon spectacle avec de la danse en fin de soirée.
Je recommande cette hôtel nous y retournerons sûrement.

reviews.author: Sherri R
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Christopher was attentive and eager to make sure everything was in order including reservations. He did what he was supposed to do, but if there is any feedback, I would say response time should be shortened. Christopher did ensure we were good when we saw him, I feel that he was stretched thin. All in all, good job.

reviews.author: Stay628400
reviews.title: Flora
reviews.text: If you’re in Punta, Cana, highly recommend. DCS Pomeroy, and the restaurant Flora or some Dominican food.Cocofongo is amazing at Flora. Ask for Andrea Santana. If you want to have DELICIOUS Dominican food She will set you up. Franklin too!

reviews.author: jkmac672025
reviews.title: Palma real
reviews.text: Outstanding experience. Staff very accommodating and friendly. Special mention to Jose Acosta and Pedro who remembered our favorite spot on the beach and was always out early to make sure we were set up with towels and beverages. We were present for the members gathering which was very nice and great opportunity to meet other members for dinner.

reviews.author: Patty G
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for 1 week and had Christopher as a concierge in the Reserve section of the resort.  Christopher was very friendly, attentive and really went out of his way to ensure our stay was the best experience.  We stayed with a group of 15 family and friends and even though he was our concierge, he made sure everyone from our party was feeling just as welcomed. I would highly recommend this resort and Christopher as your concierge.  Can’t wait to go back next year.

reviews.author: sgillette2016
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort Experience
reviews.text: All inclusive, overall friendly, clean, helpful staff, and beautiful beach.  A few staff were grumpy, like the dessert staff in the Lunch Box but the wait staff at every place we ate were great!

reviews.author: Kiara R
reviews.title: Our Wedding
reviews.text:
El pasado 28 de marzo de 2025, mi esposo y yo celebramos nuestra boda en el hermoso Paradisus Palma Real, y no podríamos estar más felices con la experiencia vivida. Cuando decidimos tener una boda destino, nos arriesgamos sin conocer personalmente a las personas que harían realidad nuestro sueño… pero hoy, podemos decir con certeza que fue la mejor decisión que tomamos.

Estamos profundamente agradecidos con cada persona que puso su corazón, esfuerzo y profesionalismo en hacer de este día algo mágico.

Un agradecimiento muy especial a Stephanie Borja, nuestra coordinadora de bodas, por su calidez, atención a cada detalle y por acompañarnos con tanto cariño durante todo el proceso. A Alki Fiesta, gracias por la magia de su decoración — superaron nuestras expectativas y transformaron cada espacio en algo sacado de un cuento. A los talentosos fotógrafos de Novia Mía, gracias por capturar cada emoción con tanto arte y sensibilidad; ahora tenemos recuerdos eternos para revivir nuestro día. A Wasabi Música, infinitas gracias por llenar el ambiente de alegría y energía con sus voces — ¡hicieron vibrar a todos los invitados!

Y por supuesto, al hotel Paradisus Palma Real, gracias por abrir las puertas a nuestros seres queridos y hacer que cada uno de ellos se sintiera especial. Su atención, hospitalidad y servicio fueron simplemente excepcionales.

Gracias a todos por hacer realidad nuestra boda soñada. ¡Fue un día perfecto e inolvidable!

On March 28th, 2025, my husband and I celebrated our wedding at the beautiful Paradisus Palma Real, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. When we decided to have a destination wedding, we took a leap of faith without knowing the people who would help bring our dream to life… but now, we can say with certainty that it was the best decision we ever made.

We are deeply grateful to every person who put their heart, effort, and professionalism into making this day truly magical.

A very special thank you to Stephanie Borja, our wedding coordinator, for her warmth, attention to detail, and for being so caring and supportive throughout the entire process. To Alki Fiesta, thank you for the magic of your decoration — you exceeded our expectations and turned every space into something straight out of a fairytale. To the talented photographers of Novia Mía, thank you for capturing every emotion with such artistry and sensitivity; we now have eternal memories to relive our day. To Wasabi Música, infinite thanks for filling the atmosphere with joy and energy through your voices — you made every guest feel the celebration in their hearts!

And of course, to the Paradisus Palma Real hotel, thank you for opening your doors to our loved ones and making each of them feel truly special. Your attention, hospitality, and service were simply exceptional.

Thank you all for making our dream wedding come true. It was a perfect and unforgettable day!

reviews.author: lou112358
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: This was the best vacation I ever had! The accommodations were wonderful and every staff member was helpful and very pleasant. Our concierge, Emmanuel, was unbelievable. Emmanuel kept us informed of events, made our reservations at restaurants for us, and checked on us and our comfort multiple times during the day. He also surprised me a birthday celebration . We are making this an annual trip and requesting Emmanuel as our concierge next year.

reviews.author: Donna B
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation in Paradise!
reviews.text: First trip to Punta Cana, and it was an absolutely amazing experience. The accommodations and amenities at The Reserve were exceptional, as were the services provided by our concierge Emmanuel. He checked in with us regularly, was so very attentive to our needs and very responsive to all of our requests. The resort had so much to offer, from the pristine beaches with comfy cabanas, to a multitude of pools (with swim-up bars!), great food and a diverse offering of activities and fun entertainment.  All staff members were extremely friendly and provided exceptional service. In particular Freilyn (AyeYaYa!), Carlos & Joefry were engaging, fun and made us feel extra special. This was a most memorable trip and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: dawn f
reviews.title: Fabulous experience!
reviews.text: Resort is gorgeous, room was so beautiful & very clean. Housekeeping was timely and did a great job. Staff everywhere were so friendly and accommodating. We had Emmanuel as our Concierge & he was amazing. Shared great info, gave us a lovely tour, secured reservations for dinners and a really fun excursion. Right from check in he made us feel comfortable, welcomed and at home.  Always smiling and eager to help us.

reviews.author: Ester P
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: La estancia en The reserve fue genial. Basilio y todo el equipo se encargaron de que no nos faltara de nada para pasar unos días de relax en família. Las excursiones a Isla Saona y Los Haitises son largas per recomendables. Ojalá volver pronto! :)

reviews.author: Camarin M
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this resort! We leave tomorrow. I wanted to write this review to give special shout outs to a few people that made our trip magical while we were here. 

The best service we had of at any of the restaurants was surprisingly the buffet. We always sat in Yanira’s and Rosanna’s section. They were two of the kindest people you will ever meet. They always welcomed us in and seemed happy to see us every day for breakfast and lunch. By the end of our trip i could honestly say they felt like family to us. Such amazing women. I will miss them both.

The other person i would like to highlight was Gladys from the Spa. She was walking around the pool showing people the spa menu. When she got to our chairs, she sat down with me and i could immediately feel her loving energy. My husband and i immediately booked services with her. My facial I received was incredible and my husband said the same of her massage. She truly had such good energy. Book with Gladys!

This resort was so clean!!! The pools were pristine!!! The plants were always being manicured and cared for. Such a beautiful resort. 

We got a master suite swim out pool and it was worth every penny. We could swim right out of our room into an impeccably clean huge lap pool. We also had our own cabana and lounge chairs. It was heavenly. Our room was always cleaned so nice daily. They stocked snacks, drinks and had a nice coffee bar with a nespresso machine. 

We are so very thankful to have been able to stay at this resort for everyone that made our stay so wonderful. 

Thank you for having us!

reviews.author: Heather M
reviews.title: Perfect Paradise
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing.   Came on a girls trip with family.   We were not disappointed.  Everything was on point.   From the time we arrived to the time we left we wanted for nothing.  Staying at the Reserve is definitely worth the extra cost.  Shout out to our concierge, Emmanuel, who made sure we had reservations for dinner & excursions.  Freilyn, Carlos & Joefry with activities made this a trip to remember.   We'll certainly be back.

reviews.author: emetz19
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful trip to Paradisus Palma Real! 
The Accommodations: We stayed in the Reserve Adults Only section.  We requested 2 separate beds but both of our rooms had king beds.  It ended up working out fine though. Emmanuel was our concierge and was so friendly and on top of everything!  We casually mentioned we were celebrating my mom’s 70th birthday on this trip.  One of the days we got back to the room, it had been decorated with balloons.  They also had a charcuterie board, cake, and bottle of champagne.  The adults only pool and beach areas were great and there were plenty of day beds and loungers.  

The food: Was pretty average at the buffet.  Was slightly disappointed in the selection in Sante for lunch but the fact that it was peaceful more than made up for it.  Our favorite meals were at Flora and Blue Agave.  Service was great at all of the restaurants.  

The entertainment: All I can say is WOW!  The activities staff have amazing talent!  Special shoutout to Freilyn (Mr. Wonderful Aye ya ya 😁), Jholfry, and Carlos for all of the amazing classes and activities.  They genuinely seem to enjoy their job and it was evident in the entertainment they provided.  

We absolutely will come back again and can’t wait to spend another week in this paradise!

reviews.author: Elissa V
reviews.title: Beach day
reviews.text: Me encantó el trato en todo el hotel y todos los departamentos. En especial Yesica del departamento de Kidsom. Super servicial y mis hijos amaron hacer castillos de arena con ella. 100% recomendado, si vienes a Punta Cana, necesitas venir a Paradisus y conocerla.

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.text: This place was paradise. We went with a group of friends and had the most amazing time. The service was top notch, the resort is beautiful, and so many fun things to do. Jendry was so helpful assisting us with anything and everything. They all know how to take care of their guests and are so accommodating to make sure you have the best experience.

reviews.author: Darcie C
reviews.title: My favorite place
reviews.text:
Our concierge Eriol was waiting for us and guided us through out the week. He was so helpful with the dinner plans and activities for the week. He was so kind.  Thank you Eriol ! 
 
Top notch service. 
We loved it so much we’re going back next year! We highly recommend this resort! Very clean, excellent food. There were no pesty bugs. 5 stars for us 

Blaine & Darcie

reviews.author: Renata Fonseca
reviews.title: Com certeza indico
reviews.text: Fiquei neste resort ha 10 anos e voltei em 2025 pois ele é sensacional e acima da média em Punta Cana, sei disso pois já me hospedei em outros resorts lá. Caso você tenha possibilidades de ser um "Reserve" a experiência fica melhor ainda mas não há necessidade pois o resort inteiro é maravilhoso. A Cada manhã vc fala com seu concierge e realiza as reservas nos vários restaurantes maravilhosos de lá. Aconselho levar uns casaquinhos leves pois o ar condicionado é forte tanto nos restaurantes quanto na musculação. Todos os dis tem atividades e shows. A Partir do momento que você entra não existem taxas para nada, as toalhas de praia são ilimitadas, a comida é ótima, as bebidas de qualidade e além disso tudo tem serviço de uqarto 24hs . Os funcionários são ótimos, em especial a Wanda do Bar da ala premium que decora até o que e como você bébe, te atendendo com muito carinho, também o Martin. Gostaria de elogiar o atendimento da equipe do Restaurante principal o Yensen, o Cirillo, a Maira, toda a nimação do Jeyson que acorda cantando e todo staff de forma geral. A Equipe de fitness e recreação o Fernando e seus amigos são bem atenciosos e animados. O Antonio que é tipo um supervisor geral. A equipe do café ao lado do Loby que serve drinks com café e sempre tem um docinho um bolinho...especial o expresso é fantástico. Toda a equipe dos carrinhos de golf que te leva para os outros resorts da rede Paradisus e para o cassino também e os carregadores de malas em especial o Hector. Devo elogiar meu concierge Samuel que conseguiu as reservas que eu queria em todos os restaurantes e também a minha agência de viagens a PHD travel em SP e minha agente Daniela Della Manna quem sempre me indica os melhores resorts e hotéis . Obrigada! Em fim, se você gosta do belo, de luxo e serviços,  vale a pena se hospedar ai e desfrutar de uma experiência bem melhor que em outros Resorts.

reviews.author: Luisa Fernanda Hernandez M
reviews.title: Un cumpleaños perfecto en el paraíso, gracias al increíble servicio de Ynes!
reviews.text:
Tuve el privilegio de celebrar mi cumpleaños en el Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort en Punta Cana, y fue una experiencia que jamás olvidaré. Desde el primer momento, la calidez y hospitalidad de su personal hicieron que me sintiera en casa, y quiero resaltar especialmente la increíble atención de Ynes, quien no solo nos dio una bienvenida excepcional, sino que nos mostró todos los secretos y servicios del hotel, incluyendo aquellos que no conocíamos. Gracias a ella, pudimos disfrutar a fondo de todo lo que el resort tiene para ofrecer.

Entre las actividades, tuve la oportunidad de probar aqua cycling, yoga aéreo y pintura, todas ellas con instructores maravillosos que hicieron que la experiencia fuera aún más enriquecedora. Cada actividad fue única y sumó un toque especial a nuestra estadía.

Quiero recordarles a los futuros huéspedes que es importante hacer las reservaciones para los restaurantes a las 2:45 p.m. del día anterior para asegurarse de disfrutar de la variedad gastronómica que el hotel ofrece.

Sin embargo, me gustaría hacer una pequeña sugerencia para el hotel: sería ideal trabajar más en la capacitación del personal de recepción. Si no fuera por Ynes, quien nos orientó en todo momento, no habríamos conocido todos los servicios disponibles ni el manejo de las diferentes categorías de miembros del hotel.

A pesar de este pequeño detalle, la experiencia fue inmejorable y, sin duda, volveré. ¡Gracias, Paradisus Palma Real, por hacer de mi cumpleaños una ocasión tan especial!

reviews.author: Roving54178999672
reviews.title: Another great stay at the Palma Real
reviews.text: This resort never disappoints. We have been coming here for 20 years and it still a great place to visit- we had a great meal at Flora- and the service is always great- everyone at the resort is always pleasant and accommodating. The rooms are great and the food is always good.

reviews.author: Angela H
reviews.title: Blew my mind! Can't wait to come back!
reviews.text:
This hotel blew my mind and is definitely worthy of its five star rating. Everything from this hotel was gorgeous: the room, the landscaping, and especially the pristine pools. I am a clean freak and this hotel exceeded my hopes on that score. Also having walked 10 miles of coastline in total while I was there I can say honestly the beach at this hotel was the best setup.

I loved the multitude of dining options all different types of cuisine and all excellent! 

And finally I can't say enough about the service! Everyone was so kind an polite, especially our concierge Basilio, guest services Antonio, waitress Rosanna, and room Taura.

reviews.author: Anne-Marie T
reviews.title: Vacances au paradis
reviews.text: Resort absolument magnifique!  Tout était parfait.  Chambre très propre, tout ce dont nous avions besoin était là, très facile de se retrouver sur le site,  que dire de la plage, superbe.  Beaucoup de choix au buffet, restaurant mexicain, tout simplement délicieux.  C'était ma 6e fois en République, ma premiere fois au Paradisius Palma Real et nous y retournerons c'est certain.  C'est vraiment le paradis.  Mention spéciale à George qui donne un service exceptionnel.  Toutes les personnes rencontrées ont été courtoises et aidantes.

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: Great atmosphere
reviews.text: Caesar is the best!!! Food was good, service was better. Will be back. I do not recommend the gnocchi. It was good, but only two shrimp in the entire dish. Steaks were not cooked as ordered, but Caesar made it much better. Excellent service, nice atmosphere, ok food!

reviews.author: carlos A
reviews.title: The lunch box
reviews.text: La comida fue magnífica, la variedad me pareció muy interesante, el sabor, el ambiente y el personal, en especial Laura la hostess de The Lunch Box, fue muy agradable, servicial, dinámica, muy atenta hizo que la experiencia fuese mucho más placentera.

reviews.author: alfred u
reviews.title: Review Laura
reviews.text:
Laura, hostess del lunch Box necesito que me le den un aumento, o cargo superior, iré el próximo año y espero esa noticia 

Excelente atención y disposición con los visitantes, tiene vocación de servicio, así que cuando regrese iré directamente allá

reviews.author: Martin1202
reviews.title: Great helpers
reviews.text: Carlitos and Soranyi were super helpful at the pool and I felt like a celebrity with all their attentiveness they gave us. I would recommend coming to this resort because of the great service here!!! I love Punta Cana.💕☺️😍👙🩱🩳👑☀️☀️🌴🌴

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Incredible Resort!
reviews.text:
Everything was absolutely wonderful. Service was excellent, the entire staff was amazing. The resort is beautiful, the food is really good. The Reserve (adults only) is the perfect choice when looking to relax, and you have a personal concierge. Ours was Basilio and he was simply the best. He was so sweet; took care of everything for us from dinner reservations, spa appointments, setting up excursions and sending us daily activities. He checked in on us every single day. We couldn’t have asked for more.
I highly recommend this hotel, I was so sad to leave and cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: Carole Clare
reviews.title: Great Holiday
reviews.text: We have been here at the hotel Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort Punta Cana for nearly 3 weeks and apart from the beautiful surroundings it's the people who have been looking after us so well that have made it so special, our shout out today goes to the guys around the adults only swimming pool by block 8, the bar person Wanda is lovely, so friendly (a beautiful soul) and does the best cocktails! Martin the server is so attentive and always asking if we want a drink and Pedro who's lust for life is infectious he "works in paradise" We want to thank them all for helping to make our stay so enjoyable. They are credit to your business highly recommend ❤️

reviews.author: mautello
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: El lugar es excelente, se disfruta mucho de los servicios que presta. La comida es muy buena, tanto en los restaurantes a la carta como en el buffet. Tiene una gran playa además de muy buenas piscinas. La habitación es muy confortable. Todo el lugar mostraba buen mantenimiento, limpieza y cuidado.

reviews.author: Sharad N
reviews.title: A stay that will define you trip to Punta Cana for LifeTime ...Wonderful!!!
reviews.text:
They say your accommodations/stays  are  a crucial part of your travel - and after being here , we have to say it was the most crucial, lovely and memorable part of our vacation to Punta Cana. A True 5 star in every aspect.  We(A couple and an 11 year Old)  can write a book on the kind of comfort, care and fun we had at this Resort , but let me start with the one which was kind of there in back of our minds, based on certain reviews , while booking this Resort . The Food - especially the Buffet - Its incredibly clean, healthy (you choose) , flavorful and most importantly available. We had  been to to 5 Star and 5 Star Deluxe  properties all across the world and I wouldn't rate this hotel below any of those -in fact above to most of those. 
We stayed at the Family side of this Resort (not the Reserve but the next door property) and we opted for the OCEAN VIEW SUITE - and IT WAS MAGNIFICENT. Just too good - and every penny worth of  a Splurge. When we go back we go back to this exact same suite.
The Section of Bavarro beach is glistening . The Beach chairs , lounges and cabanas are in plenty Tand he Property is just spic and span, super clean, safe and the best - the People. They Make you feel special, respected , helped at every corner. Variety of  activities for adults and children , in a perfectly safe and clean environment. 
This was a trip of a lifetime for us - and now I know why they say - Once you go to the  Caribbean, you return back to it,  and with Paradidus Palma Real - Its going to be even more convincing, We will be going back very soon and going back to this exact one. Another good thing - we literally saw, met people(mostly families with children)  from around the world - with the languages, cultures and just respect to each other - An aspect that your travels lets you experience.
Note : Its a paradise for those who are vegetarian and like the varieties and freshness of the Fruits and Vegetables.    And the Coffee is so flavorful.

reviews.author: HC
reviews.title: Vacaciones TOP
reviews.text:
Todo superó las expectativas, especialmente el servicio.
Mención especial para nuestro Concierge Christopher, siempre atento y disponible para hacernos la estancia más dinámica.
Pedro en el servicio de hamacas, un espectáculo. 
Igualmente Yeison, un maestro coctelero.

reviews.author: Michael N
reviews.title: Paradisus April 2025
reviews.text:
From check in to check out - absolutely superb experience at Paradisus Palma Real.
Ginger bar in the main lobby has the best drinks and the best service - shout out to Carolina - drinks kept coming with a special twist each time. 

Our flight was delayed 12 hours until 2:30am and we had to check out at noon.  Front desk booked us into a complimentary ocean view suite for the rest of the day until our transfer arrived to take us to the airport.

reviews.author: Bryan R
reviews.title: Great experience at paradisus
reviews.text: Everything is excelente the personal was great, the food at the Italian restaurant was very good the chef Juan has grand hands for making those delicious meals and our waiter Juleni was very attentive for everything we ordered we had a great time here

reviews.author: Alexis B
reviews.title: Recomendable!
reviews.text:
Muy recomendable el hotel, para ir con familia o amigos. 
Nos faltó una discoteque para bailar.

reviews.author: ignacia F

reviews.author: Paulo Q
reviews.title: Experiência memorável

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Birthday destination/celebration
reviews.text: My wife and I love this resort. The fact that we are Circle members also makes many options that much more available. I was disappointed that getting in touch with the “pre-arrival team”was disappointing to say the least. I needed to send multiple emails and call the resort to eventually get answers to many of my questions. But nevertheless, it all worked out. My room and two additional rooms that I booked for family and friends were all ready to go once we arrived. There isn’t enough words I can say to express how horrible our concierge treated us. Talking over me, did not show interest in explaining the amenities and activities. Appeared to be rushing the check in process to get out of work in time rather then showing us the room and making us feel welcomed. However, staff at the resort made my experience amazing. Every preference that the concierge said was definitely not possible, specific staff member made it happen. Special shout outs to Edito and Delvin. Edito made a dinner for 11 work out amazingly. All requests were appeased and he was on top of the whole meal from beginning to end. Two of our other dinners were made possible by Delvin. He gave top notch service and my whole family were delighted. Where the concierge dismissed the requests Delvin made my request a realization. The buffet food was always great and I always had something new to try out. We all loved it. Checkout went smooth without a glitch. Will be returning to this resort.

reviews.author: Helma T
reviews.title: Maravillosa experiencia
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, todos súper hospitalarios, el servicio al 100, súper atento todo el personal

Sobre todo en Ginger bar excelente trato, las bebidas súper ricas los cafés, los mojitos con fresa uff, gracias a Luis, Luis Alejandro, Andreina y Walquiria por sus atenciones me voy muy feliz de este viaje, encantada de regresar

reviews.author: Dylan H
reviews.text:

reviews.author: CAROLINA R
reviews.title: Fantástico Hotel y mejor personal ❤️❤️
reviews.text:
Maravillosa estancia, no ha podido ser más fantástica tanto por las instalaciones, habitaciones, gastronomía, piscinas y playa si no por el trato recibido por todos los trabajadores de este fantástico hotel! reviews.author: Federico S
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Pasamos días maravillosos, elevamos nuestra experiencia con The Reserve, nos rico el concierge Kelvin Fernández, el hizo que nuestra estadia sea inolvidable, organizo todo para nosotros, y el resto del personal también fantástico, sin dudarlo volveríamos!!

reviews.author: ColleenJ98
reviews.title: Fantastic resort, would definitely return!
reviews.text:
Just stayed 5 nights with my 18 ye old daughter at the Reserve. Upon arrival we were taken to Reserve lounge and check in where our concierge Adriel met us. He was fantastic—friendly, knowledgeable and dependable. He gave us a tour, showed us to our room and even got us a dinner reservation for that evening which we did not expect!

The room was exactly what we needed. The bathroom is only separated by semi sheer curtains from the rest of the room. The room with the toilet did have a door and the shower door had privacy panel. It was fine for our purposes but can be a surprise. The bed was firm but comfortable. The room was serviced every day including replenishing the fridge with drinks and snacks. 

Adriel was able to get us dinner reservations every night in a different restaurant. We didn’t mind what time we ate and there were only 2 of us which made things easier. Many guests had larger groups so were having more trouble getting reservations. Overall the food was great!  We did eat at Santé for breakfast and dinner which is exclusive to Reserve guests. The breakfast buffet is smaller than the Lunch Box but I thought was still wonderful and not as crowded. 

I like that a third of the resort is adults only. You could not stay in the Reserve and use the adults only pool but I thought that was a bit more crowded. We used the two Reserve pools everyday and enjoyed the section on the beach for Reserve members only.  While some people still got up early to save chairs and Bali beds, we never had an issue finding a chair at the pool or beds at the beach. It wasn’t important to us to be in the front row. In fact if you are farther back there are less vendors that walk by selling excursions, hair braiding etc. I think the Reserve is worth the extra money and I would shorten my stay and upgrade to the Reserve if needed. 

We were there during spring break time and there were some college and high school kids. However most of them were at the main pool and the Reserve pools were much quieter.  I wouldn’t consider this a huge spring break destination resort compared to others I’ve heard. 

We did go on an inclusive excursion of a boat ride, yoga on the beach and swimming in ocean in natural pool area. I liked and the boat crew made it a great atmosphere. 

I would definitely recommend and would return here. I would for sure ask for Adriel and stay in the Reserve.

reviews.title: BLUE AGAVE
reviews.text:
Muy buenas atenciones, el Sr. Santos y el José nos dieron una atención 10/10. Vinimos un grupo y la pasamos fenomenal, comida rica, música buena y hospitality bueno. Gracias a ellos volveríamos a repetir venir al hotel y sin duda volver a este restaurante.

reviews.author: Gabriela Bravo
reviews.title: Viviendo una semana en el paraíso 🌴🌞
reviews.text:
Es toda una maravilla quedarse en este hotel con la categoría The Reserve. Te consienten como tanto quieres. Nuestro concierge fue Adriel y se encargo de tenernos todo listo desde las experiencias de yoga, circuito, reservas de restaurantes y las amenidades de la habitación que solicitabanos. Las instalaciones del hotel son de primera. Todos sus restaurantes son una experiencia increíble, nuestros favoritos fueron Flora (Dominicano) y Mina (Cortes de carne). Las playas del hotel son muy limpias y tranquilas. Para el área The Reserve tienes bar y camas libanesas allí mismo. También la categoría te da acceso a 2 piscinas exclusivas solo para adultos. 

Nos ha encantado todo, sin duda volveríamos aquí 💖🌊🌴. Supera por mucho a los Melia de Puerto Vallarta y Cozumel.

reviews.title: Great family stay
reviews.text:

We enjoyed the evenings in the Colonde Plaza!

reviews.author: wanderingerin613
reviews.title: A Happy Surprise!
reviews.text:
We actually booked the Melia Wellness resort located nearby many months back, but they did not have the rooms we booked when we finally arrived, so Melia moved us to the Paradisus property. It was amazing! We stayed in the adults only, Reserve section. The separate breakfast restaurant for Reserve was lovely; it has both buffet and a la carte menu options. Overall the food was great; however, there were very few vegetarian options outside of the buffet. The process for reservations was annoying; if you are a Reserve guest, you are supposed to have a butler to do this for you, but our group was not assigned one. It much better to either make your reservations for the entire week at once, or forgo the entire reservation system like many other resorts do. In the end, we ate well though, so no real complaints. 
One of the best things about this resort, is that they never ran out of beach towels. They were always plentiful. And the hotel room towels themselves were great quality. Housekeeping was sometimes a bit too timely in the mornings, but they did an excellent job. The rooms and property were very well maintained.
My only suggestions for improvement are 1) that the rooms need more hooks/hangers for towels, wet clothing, robes, etc. in the bathrooms;  and, 2) it would be better if the entertainment options would be posted in a weekly format, instead of posted daily around the resort. It would allow people to better plan their activities and excursions.
The coffee bar in the lobby was a real treat. The staff were gracious and helpful. Overall, a very excellent week spent on this property!

reviews.author: seasonedtraveler2016
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text:
This resort experience checked ALL the boxes! We stayed as part of Club Melia and Customer Service was impeccable! Our concierge, Anayely took care of everything and went above and beyond for us. Reservations for our dinners were on point with a surprise for my birthday girl. Beach & Pool were so perfect & clean. Danny’s team from 39 Degrees Tiki Bar were PERFECTION, Raul and Vanessa. Smiles & Laughter, true heart of Dominican Republic people, we felt like family. Evenings in the Plaza where live entertainment and dancing were graciously handled by Jairo and Yisauri who looked after us as we enjoyed a table outside Kicks. We met an INCREDIBLE singer, Nayia, that put on a Rock Show everybody was cheering and dancing to. We looked forward to her performances. Class all the way in every aspect of this beautiful location. Our suite was comfortable and nicely decorated. Safety at every turn with security inconspicuously dressed in resort attire. 
We are planning our next visit. ❤️

reviews.author: Steve K
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, clean and the perfect vacation setting. The staff was amazing. Ariel our concierge made our stay extra special and the staff on the beach especially Demy and Hansel took great care of us. We had breakfast every day at Santa because the staff was so warm and welcoming and the entertainment at night in the square was always a good time. Definitely will go back!

reviews.author: Nikita S
reviews.title: THE GOAT RISOTTO
reviews.text: Flora is the place to be at this resort! Everything is great on the food menu, but I beg of you, please get the goat risotto. You will not be disappointed. If you want the best and friendliest service, you WILL ask for Andrea to be your server! She was AMAZING!!!!

reviews.author: Trisha D
reviews.title: Amazing time with friends and family
reviews.text: Part of our group stayed in the Reserve and absolutely loved it. Our concierge, Gustavo, was absolutely amazing! He assisted with reservations at restaurants and the spa, kept us updated on daily activities and seemed to always be around to say hello and ask if we needed anything. The nightly entertainment was wonderful. I would definitely recommend getting dinner reservations at the restaurants surrounding the main courtyard. They are all great! If you go be sure and ask for Gustavo!!

reviews.author: agucha28
reviews.title: Paraíso en el Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
La atención de los bares excelente ! Sobre todo de Hanzel y Derni en el Bar 32 -grados ! ,  música y excelente bebida !!!
La animacion de los Show familiares muy buena y divertida ! Súper recomendado 
lo malo fue la atención de recepción  que no nos solucionaron después de 3 días el tema de las habitaciones , espacio reducido y sin lugar de guardado!

reviews.author: Jojo
reviews.title: Paradisus, un petit paradis 😍👌
reviews.text:
Cet hôtel est merveilleux, grâce à son personnel toujours à l’écoute de ses clients. 
La nourriture est délicieuse partout, que ce soit au buffet, matin, midi ou soir ou aux différents restaurants Le meilleur est sans aucun doute le restaurant Santé. On y a mangé de la langouste certains midis et aussi le soir. Le vin blanc et rouge sont très bien aussi. 

-  Bravo à Hector qui s’occupe de tout et est un peu partout. Quel homme! Il a été d’une grande aide pour nous. Note de 11/10👌👋 Merci tellement! 😍

- Henry restaurant Santé ton service et ta gentillesse ont été très précieux pour nous. Note de 10/10 
- Barnellis hôtesse à l’entrée du resto Santé, note de 10/10
- Serveuse du Kicks Vianny, Note de 10/10 merci pour ton excellent service 
- Petite hôtesse du Flora qui a fait des efforts pour nous donner du service. 
- Gustavo au buffet Santé, merci pour ton excellent service Note de 10/10
- Merci au chef Raphaël pour ses excellents repas.
- Abigaîl service à la clientèle, merci pour ta disponibilité et ton excellent service, note de 10/10 
- Nouveau concierge Eriol qui a été merveilleux avec nous et qui a pris le temps de bien nous renseigner. Nous lui donnons la note de 10/10
Points négatifs: 
- Notre premier concierge, Christian, quel mauvais service! Ne le prenez pas s’il est encore là! 
Il ne nous a pas renseigné sur l’hôtel, il a fallu que je le relance à chaque journée pour qu’il s’occupe de nos réservations et vu qu’il nous a dit qu’il travaillait encore 
là-dessus sans résultats, lorsque Hector (un des gérants de l’hôtel) que nous avons rencontré, nous a demandé si tout allait bien, on lui a dit que oui, sauf nos réservations de restaurants qui étaient compliqués, il nous a demandé où nous voulions aller et en moins de quelques minutes, il nous a réservé 3 restaurants. 
Nous voulions aller au tour de bateau fourni par l’hôtel mais n’avions encore pas été informé par Christian. Il a fallu courir après l’info. Un soir, nous avons vu Abigail, du service à la clientèle et on lui a parlé du mauvais service de notre majordorme.  Nous avons rencontré un gérant de l’hôtel, Alvaro, à qui, nous avons parlé de ce nous avions vécu et on nous a assigné un nouveau concierge, Eriol. Tout un changement! Merci pour tout!
Nous recommandons vivement cet  
hôtel.

reviews.author: Jason R
reviews.title: Anniversary stay. Golf + Food allergy
reviews.text:
The resort is absolutely stunning. My girlfriend and I went to celebrate our anniversary. We did not do the circle or reserve. The reserve while beneficial is not needed and there was always plenty of space on the beach. 

All of the rooms are very close and easily walkable to the beach. The pools are nice and never a long wait at the swim up bar. 

The first day we had lunch at kana restraunt and Luis was the best.

If you have food allergies I would highly recommend contacting the resort prior to your stay. I have a nut/sesame allergy and I had to point out multiple things that were not OK after being told there was no sesame. However, we were instantly connected to Hector Abrue who was extremely helpful for anything we needed including booking reservations. 

Also, Antonio from guest services was helpful as well for giving us a complimentary romantic dinner after the issue in the previous paragraph. 

For the romantic dinner, they advertise steak and lobster. The meal did not taste amazing but the “vibe” was awesome and Hostet/Arindius were both amazing and catered to our every need. 

We also golfed twice and the golf was great. For only $120ish per round the course was ok and the greens were very slow. However, you have the course to yourself and there was no issue getting whatever tee time you desired. 

Overall, the hotel was gorgeous and after the allergy situation was sorted everything was amazing.

reviews.text: This facility clearly gets regular investment in upkeep and improvements. We've been several times but this was the best trip yet. The new Reserve rooms are wonderful. We had dinner at Blue Agave 3x during our stay -- Laura, Santos, Delvin and Ruby at the bar are incredibly friendly and service minded.

reviews.author: Sheila M
reviews.title: Pedro has made this vacation the best!
reviews.text:
Still enjoying our vacation for a few days, but PEDRO had been absolutely exceptional! 
Every morning he knows our favorite spot on the beach. He places towels, flowers and just his friendly touch everywhere we see him!
He is truly an asset to this resort. 
Pedro is very attentive not just us but all guests!
Our room, and restaurants have been incredible. 
Sante, so far has been our favorite. 
The layout of the resort is spacious yet easily able to be navigated with ease. 
The views from all areas are picturesque. 
Pedro is the reason for my review as he has made our vacation memorable!

Best,
Sheila and Andy McAfee

reviews.author: Nickolas B
reviews.title: Best Melia Resort stay (so far)
reviews.text:
We’ve been to a couple Melia resorts in Punta Cana and Paradisus is our favorite. The rooms are spacious, the restaurants offer great selection (best Melia food we’ve had by far) and lovely evening entertainment. The beach and pool were fantastic. The close proximity of our rooms to the restaurants, pool and beach were also a huge plus. 

Service here was also great. Christopher, our butler/concierge did a fantastic job balancing attentiveness (ie checking in with us throughout the day) and letting us be. He was very responsive to making dinner reservations and providing details on the resorts daily activities. He was also very attentive whenever we ran into any issues with restaurants, occasionally even after his standard work hours . 

The only downside (and it might’ve just been our room because our friends didn’t have the same issue) was our bed was very hard and the air conditioning unit was very loud when it turned on and off in the middle of the night. 

Overall - our whole group agrees - 10/10 would absolutely recommend -  we will be back.

reviews.author: Hans Sperber
reviews.title: Gran Hotel para Parejas y Familia
reviews.text:
El servicio del personal del hotel es de 5 estrellas, siempre pendientes de que el huésped esté feliz. El servicio de playa es súper recomendable, Vanesa, Raúl y Joel , de manera permanente se esfuerzan para hacer la estadía más agradable y confortable. La amabilidad , la
Sonrisa permanente y la preocupación de que estemos bien , es muy valioso en un hotel de esta categoría. Súper recomendable que se queden en este hotel, pues aparte de las instalaciones su mejor activo son el grupo de colaboradores. Por último gracias y felicitaciones a su directora Paula Forero quien es ejemplo de liderazgo, servicio y profesionalismo, su hospitalidad y gentileza nos hizo sentir como casa!!!. Felicitaciones de nuevo y volverémos  a este hotel de nuevo sin pensarlo!!!!!

reviews.author: Ignacio A
reviews.title: Experiencia para repetir una y otra vez
reviews.text:
Durante nuestra estancia en Punta Cana tuvimos la oportunidad de alojarnos en dos hoteles Paradisus, y sin duda, el Paradisus Palma Real nos dejó maravillados. La ubicación a pie de playa es inmejorable: una arena fina y limpia, un agua cristalina y una vista de cuento que hacen que la experiencia sea inolvidable.

Las habitaciones, aunque más pequeñas en comparación con el otro hotel donde nos alojamos (Grand Cana), están reformadas, bien decoradas y resultan muy acogedoras. En nuestro caso, nos hospedamos en una The Reserve Vista Lateral Mar Junior Suite, una estancia cómoda y con unas vistas preciosas.

Otro gran punto a favor es la conectividad: el wifi funciona de manera excepcional en las habitaciones e incluso en la playa, lo cual es un gran plus. En la piscina, sin embargo, notamos que en momentos de alta afluencia la conexión podía fallar un poco.

El ambiente en el hotel es muy bueno, con zonas diferenciadas para solo adultos, lo que permite disfrutar de mayor tranquilidad si así se desea.

Pero lo que realmente hace que la experiencia sea especial es el equipo humano, que nos brindó un servicio de primer nivel. Queremos hacer una mención especial a:

Basilio, nuestro concierge, quien nos mantenía informados de todas las actividades por WhatsApp y gestionó nuestras reservas en los restaurantes con gran eficiencia.
Wendy y Luz, en Santé, siempre atentas y amables.
Hansel, en Mina, brindando un excelente servicio.
Luis, en Ginger, un profesional impecable.
Santo y Melvin, en Blue Agave, donde comimos muy bien y el trato fue excepcional.
Ana Romero, en Más Calzone, muy detallista y atenta.
María, en Rum Republic, preparando cócteles de otro nivel. Su atención fue excepcional y realmente hizo la diferencia en nuestra experiencia. Su GinTonic es para probarlo!

El único aspecto que no podemos valorar es el restaurante Flora, ya que tras 45 minutos de espera sin recibir la cena, decidimos irnos. Fue una lástima, ya que teníamos muchas ganas de probarlo.

En definitiva, Paradisus Palma Real es un auténtico paraíso con una playa espectacular, un ambiente distinguido y un equipo de personas que hacen todo lo posible para que la estancia sea memorable. ¡Volveríamos sin dudarlo!
