reviews.author: PatriciaGN
reviews.title: Perfeito! Descanso total em família!
reviews.text: Comprei 4 pacotes na Decolar e fomos em 8 pessoas… Até o dia da viagem chegar enviei vários e-mails ao hotel explicando que eram 4 reservas diferentes mas todos da mesma família para comemorar meu aniversário! Chegamos super tarde ao hotel (voo atrasou) e é claro que não tinha nada do que eu pedi!!! MAS reclamei E muito (mostrei todas as trocas de e-mails) e tudo se ajeitou! Ficamos no Garden Adults Only, todos os quartos bem próximos (valeu reclamar)!!! Quarto grande, limpo, vista linda para um jardim privativo com a piscina ao fundo. A parte de reserva de restaurantes é bemmm confusa, mas ache (e é bem fácil) alguém do hotel para te mimar, fazer um serviço de concierge (sem custo algum) e pronto! Ela reservou todos os restaurantes! Tudo nesse hotel é uma delícia, a praia, a piscina (ficamos no Adults only) e era ótimo!!! Nao ficamos no The Reserve e não nos sentimos diferentes! Punta Cana não tem nada, então fique em um hotel muito bom e super recomendo esse. Apesar de dizer que não tem nada 😂 na recepção do hotel, contratamos Scuba dive, meus filhos foram pescar e pegaram um Marlin, parasailing… Enfim, adoramos tudo e ainda ganhei bolo e champanhe.

reviews.author: gentilhom
reviews.title: Grande expérience Paradisus
reviews.text:
Je pense que le titre dit tout, absolument tout. Clients habitués des Paradisus, nous en étions, si je me m'abuse, à notre huitième séjour au Palma Real et c'est celui que nous avons le mieux apprécié, mon épouse et moi, merci à notre ami Juan Carlos ainsi qu'à la charmante Carolina de la prestigieuse Réserve.
Séjour, donc de 13 nuits à la mi-février, nos attentes ont été surpassées cette fois-ci. Autant côté service, partout nous avons été traités en VIP. Et que dire de la nourriture! Succulente, délicieuse, gastronomique, ajoutez le qualificatif de votre choix. Je crois savoir que l'hôtel compte sur les services d'un nouveau grand chef, le moins qu'on puisse dire, c'est que cette personne fait plus que livrer la marchandise, avec en prime, le privilège que nous avons eu de prendre part à la soirée Épicure mettant en vedette deux chefs internationaux étoilés Michelin, pour ceux et celles qui savent ce que cela signifie.
En somme, j'ai beau essayer de trouver un ou deux défauts à l'hôtel, j'en suis incapable, si ce n'est du casino qui est accessible du côté du Melia, lequel casino offre bien peu de chances de gagner avec ses règlements farfelus! Par contre, les possibilités de jouer au tennis demeurent toujours aussi passionnantes, salutations à l'ami Virgilio, le professionnel avec lequel j'ai eu l'occasion d'échanger quelques bons coups de raquette. 
Merci à tous, donc, avec une mention également à notre majordome, Basilio qui fut un merveilleux partenaire de vacances pendant ces treize jours de rêve. Oui, bel et bien un séjour inoubliable, tout simplement.

reviews.author: juliofuentesno
reviews.title: Recomendable 100%
reviews.text: Las instalaciones y tanto la comida como las bebidas son de gran nivel, a eso hay que sumarle el gran trato recibido por Juan Peña (direccion) resolviendo a la perfección cualquier incidencia con un trato exquisito. Por otro lado esta el encargado de restauración nilson creo que se llamaba que nos organizo una cena con un variado de platos del restaurante flora (comida dominicana) que estaba espectacular, no quiero terminar mi comentario sin hablar de Juan luis (Ronaldo) que es el encargado del EPICURE bar de licores que prepara unos cócteles top y tiene un nivel de conocimientos en licores sorprendente. Por todo ello recomendaría al 100% a cualquier que quiera visitar este hotel. Quiero agradecer a todos ellos lo que nos han hecho disfrutar muchísimo estos días.

reviews.title: Amazing Trip
reviews.text:
Went for 2 weeks to celebrate wife's 50th bday.  Couldn't of asked for a better trip.  The staff are extremely friendly and courteous.
Eriol our concierge went out of his way to make sure we had what we needed.  He also made our dinner reservations which was a plus.  Checked in daily to see how we were doing and loves his job.
The bartenders at all the Celcius bars are awesome.  They remember you and what you like and are always happy and dancing and having fun.
The food at every restaurant was outstanding with lots of choices.  Something for everyone.  Starting with the hostesses who were very sweet to our servers not one bad thing to say.
The grounds are immaculate and the beach is groomed constantly to keep seaweed away.
If you read any negative reviews take them with a grain of salt.  This place is the real deal.

A pesar de ciertos detalles logísticos que podría mejorar el hotel como el servicio en el buffet , la calidad de las actividades y el profesionalismo de los organizadores y la riqueza cultural que se vivió durante el tiempo en el lugar hacen que esta sea una opción muy recomendable para quienes busquen una escapada que les permita conectarse con el entorno y aprender de él. Espero que nunca dejen de hacer estas actividades porque son las que al final del día unen a la familia!

reviews.author: Taviolo
reviews.title: Lujo
reviews.text: Ni bien llegas al hotel te das cuenta. Se trata de un All Inclusive 5 estrellas de lujo. Hermoso y señorial hotel con preciosas habitaciones muy cómodas y bien equipadas ( todas con vista ). El hotel cuenta con 2 picinas de uso común ambas con barra “in pool” y otras tantas picinas para uso exclusivo de clientes que acceden a niveles superiores. Gimnasio muy completo. 7 Restaurantes ( 6 de uso común y uno exclusivo ): Todos excelentes. La variedad y calidad de comida es verdaderamente premium ( aun en el buffet ) y esta acorde con la calidad del hotel. El servicio es otro punto alto a destacar. Los que fuimos por Expedia tenemos un Gest Service personal que en nuestro caso fue genial, Andres nos brindó siempre ayuda en todo lo que necesitamos dentro del hotel, fue realmente excelente. La playa donde esta emplazado el hotel es de las mejores que vimos: amplia, casi nada de Sargazo, buena zona para nadar en el mar. A mejorar: 1) El mantenimiento del hotel deja esta muy por debajo de su estandard: cuando llegamos nuestra habitación tenia muchos detalles que hubo que ir resolviendo ( ej: el agua caliente de la tina casi no salía ), La picina tiene en varios sectores venecitas despegadas, los hidromasajes no funcionan casi nunca. 2) Algo que tambien podrían mejorar facilemente es la calidad de los tragos en la zona de playa: Los que te sirven en el bar principal ( Gin Ger ) son excelentes, en cambio en las otras barras son tirando a feos, a nivel que no cuentan con cachaza para hacer caipirinhas.3) Inaceptable que un hotel de esta categoría no ofrezca un vino estadard y espumante decente, Frontera es espantoso. 4) Por momentos algunos empleados del hotel no parecen entender en que tipo de hotel están ( mal predispuestos, poco hábiles, lentos ). Para recomendar, si es que puedan elegir las habitaciones del cuerpo 6 y 5, en piso 2 son las mejores en ubicación y no tenes que pasarte de las Std. Costoso pero vale la pena.

reviews.author: Joan G
reviews.title: A Week in Paradise will cost you 4 lbs.
reviews.text: Our group of 4 couples were treated like family from the front door of the resort throughout the week. Gustavo and Emmanuel provided the best concierge services for the group. This is my 5th time at the resort. Everyone in our group is already planning next year's  return trip. Every member of the staff makes you feel welcome. The rooms are beautiful and very comfortable with great views of the pool and ocean. There is entertainment and a variety of activities from morning til evening hours. Each night we dined at a different restaurant. All served awesome food and we took may pictures of the presentation. We will be back!

reviews.author: Bih B
reviews.title: Amazing stay at Paradisus palma real
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Punta Cana, and after tons of research, I decided on Paradisus Palma Real—and I’m so glad I did! From the moment I called customer service, I knew I had made the right choice. The agent was super helpful and even reserved a private room for us.

When we arrived, the welcome was so warm, and check-in was a breeze. Then we met the real MVP of our trip—our butler, Gilbert Maldonado! He made sure we were comfortable, answered all our questions (even late at night!), secured taxis, and helped us find the best activities. He was beyond amazing and truly made our stay special.

The whole vibe of the resort was just perfect—clean, lively, and full of great music. The beach was gorgeous, and the staff was always ready to help with a smile. The all-inclusive experience was top-tier, with a buffet that had endless options for breakfast and dinner. Plus, there were so many bars to explore and try fun drinks!

Our room was super comfy and had everything we needed. Overall, this trip exceeded all expectations, and I can’t wait to come back! If you’re looking for a luxurious, stress-free getaway with incredible service, this is the place to be.

Huge thanks to the amazing staff

reviews.author: Steve L
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: Room was very nice. Only thing was the shower was difficult to figure how to turn on and get the correct temperature. Beach was gorgeous. Overall resort was too. Staff friendly and helpful. Our concierge Francisco was very good. We were a little disappointed that we weren’t able to try the Italian restaurant.

reviews.author: felixhesselmann
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Everything was just amazing. 
The Staff, the Food, the Pool and Beach Areas, the Room, the Hotel in total. Just everything!
Special thanks to Andres our concierge who was really helpful. To Darwyn from the Reception for giving us a real warm and nice Welcome at the Hotel. And also to Luis the waiter in the Asian Restaurant for his perfect service. 
Thank you guys and until the next time!

reviews.author: Gane N
reviews.title: Perfect vacation!!!!
reviews.text:
Travelled from Jan 25-Feb 1st.  Check in was very quick, friendly front desk staff.

Omar walked us to our room (SO KIND and professional!).  Our room was in the Adults side, garden view - we loved the quietness, spacious room and so clean!!!!! 

Food was delicious, we had no issues with making reservations. We were there for 6 nights, and went to 5 different a la cartes. Buffet food was pretty good as well.

There were plenty of loungers, we never had issues finding spots at the beach or pool no matter the time.  Only thing I noticed is that families would bring kids/babies to the "adult side" of the beach - this was a little inconsiderate in my opinion and I was surprised that Security allowed this.

Pros: bracelet as room key, towel process (no cards required, take as many as you need)

We have encountered some of the friendliest staff at this resort, but one in particular that I want to highlight is Arisleida (she's usually at the main pool or beach.  Her smile brightened my day. We told her once what we wanted to drink and she never forgot after that.  She must have seen us sitting down, and drinks were delivered to our chairs like moments later! She never once expected a tip but always appreciated it! This girl is truly so special! 

Another staff member was Luis at the lobby bar, ps. he makes the best Expresso Martinis! 

Cons: Reservations for restaurants (@Management - PLEASE remove this , a 5 star resort should avoid this at all costs!) Just let people enjoy their vacation, there has to be a better way to accommodate a la cartes. We're on vacation, we don't want "appointments" and reservations! :) 

I will definitely consider vacationing here again - it was a lovely resort and experience!

reviews.author: Jean-Didier M
reviews.title: Magnifique séjour sur la plage de Bavaro
reviews.text:
Super séjour,nous avons connu l’hôtel à ses débuts,les rénovations effectuées l’ont magnifié car il état déjà splendide.
Merci spécial à notre concierge Gustavo qui s’est vraiment bien occupé de nous pendant ces 15 jours.
L’offre culinaire est de qualité et nous avons bien profité de notre adhésion à Circle by Melia, en particulier pour le choix des vins

reviews.author: Miguel E
reviews.title: Nos encantó
reviews.text: El hotel y las habitaciones son muy cómodas.Excelente servicio y la comida muy buena en el restaurante Flora. Buen ambiente, definitivamente lo recomiendo. Volvería para probar los demás restaurantes. Estamos completamente satisfechos

reviews.author: Layla S
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: El lugar es hermoso, instalaciones de lujo, muchas piscinas, la playa muy bella, varios restaurantes con comida muy buena, la atención, la gente también lo hace un gran lugar para visitar. Tiene restaurantes de comida internacional solo que no alcance a reservar porque mi viaje fue de trabajo. Deseo volver con mi familia

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! Rooms are modern and clean. The pool area is beautiful and tons of places to lay out in the pool/beach area. Do recommend doing the reserve for the easiest experience- Emanuel did a great job planning our trips and restaurant reservations for the week. I also recommend doing those when you get there as the restaurants do seem to book up fast.

reviews.author: Nathan E
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real- Good food, friendly people
reviews.text: The food was the best we’ve had at an all inclusive and the room was extremely clean! Everyone was friendly and it was a great atmosphere.  Emmanuel was our butler and he made reservations for dinner and navigation around the resort extremely easy!

reviews.author: Joanna K
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus and were treated very well by our concierge Eriol the entire week! There was always something to do and we tried a couple of their workshops which included a coconut oil workshop. We were upgraded to the reserve which is adults only however our room was not in an adults only section but by being part of the reserve you have exclusive excess to certain parts of the resort. Would definitely go back.

reviews.author: YULLY ALEJANDRA T
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Estuve en el lobby bar todo muy lindo 
Excelente servicio 
Muy buena limpieza
Sin duda un lugar donde debes volver
La comida muy variada y deliciosa 
Todos muy amables
Muy buena atención de Ismael, Dominga, Antonio, María, Franchesca y clary.

reviews.author: Mauro Eligio A
reviews.title: Excelente Atencion .....................................................................................................
reviews.text: La estancia fue perfecta, la atencion de Samaria muy puntual y atenta, el servicio estuvo excelente y muy serviciales ......................................................................................................

reviews.author: thtgrl68
reviews.title: Great service and very friendly
reviews.text: First stop was the Ginger Bar, Staff there was amazing. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga,Maria,Francesca, and Clary were all so friendly. We will definitely stop here for more amazing drinks.  They were all very informative about their surroundings and the resort. My friend and I all had a great time there.

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: Friends vacation
reviews.text: The service was great! Antonio, Ismael, Dominga, Maria, Clara were fantastic. They were fast and so helpful. I will visit again! Highly recommend. Ginger bar was amazing! Thank you to the staff and the atmosphere was fantastic! Cheers to all of you!

reviews.author: Santiago J
reviews.title: Lo mejor de Punta Canna
reviews.text: Desde el dia 1 la atencion de todo el personal ha sido excelente pero en mayor medida y con una actitud de servicio que conciente hasta el cliente mas exigente, gracias Ismael, Antonio, dominga, franchesca clary y mayra y la calidad de los cafes y las bebidas de excelente calidad y sin lugar a dudas un lugar para regresar

reviews.author: Venture36892254154
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Muy buena atención por parte del perdonal, muy amables, Frank de conida oriental , storming encargado del restaurante cana, muy rico todo. Regresaría nuevamente, las albercas muy limpias. En la habitación estan super equipadas, hay de todo , por si se te olvida algo...Me encantó!!!!! ....

reviews.author: Traveler38800670567
reviews.title: Atención srita Laura Hostess del restaurante Blue Agave
reviews.text: Excelente lugar,  cuando vengan pregunten por Laura es Hostess del restaurante Blue Agave excelente atención al cliente, muy servicial y muy atenta. Te trata como si estuvieras en casa. Vivan la experiencia en el restaurante están riquísimos los tacos de cochinita

reviews.author: Juliana S
reviews.title: Cena en Mascalzone
reviews.text: Excelente servicio de Milton y Jessica en el restaurante Mascalzone!!. Comimos ahí con un grupo y siempre fueron muy amables y atentos.cenamos ahí en dos ocasiones en la semana en la que estuve hospedada en el complejo. Regresaría a cenar ahi

reviews.author: 467debrag
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Melia Real
reviews.text: We were provided accommodations and my husband and I could not be more impressed!  What a beautiful resort, meticulous housekeeping, attentive butler, and friendly restaurant staff.  The food was delicious!!!!  Gilberto went out of his way to assure our stay was perfect, and really made us feel special!

reviews.author: krisusa2018
reviews.title: Italian restaurant
reviews.text: Paradises Palma Real, Italian restaurant, very good food and service. Yuleni the servant, had very helpful food suggestions. Quick service. We we celebrated my wife's birthday. The cake was very good not too heavy and not too sweet. I would recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: We love the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Great time. Extremely clean, upgrading to the reserve was well worth it. Friendly staff and great service all around!

Pools were well kept, food was decent, and the events were entertaining at night. All in all, highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Maps13810384827
reviews.title: Excelente Howpitalida
reviews.text: La atención de Samaria en el Sports Bar y en recepción es muy buena, altamente recomendable Elydania y Wanda también muy buen servicio😁😄🍸🥃🍷🍾🍺🍻🥂🍹🍹🍹🍹🍹🍹🍸🍸🫗🥃🍷🥄..................................................

reviews.author: Claudia P
reviews.title: Perfect paradise!! 🥰
reviews.text: I recommend the "The Reserve" section. The reserved section on the beach with the Bali beds is simply as amazing as its staff. Our concierge Basilio was more than attentive to our requests and went above and beyond. Our honeymoon trip was perfect!

reviews.author: Cristina A
reviews.title: Unforgettable holiday
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. Nice beach, good food and above all very nice people. I was forgetting, excellent cocktails! I raccomend the caribean restaurant, Flora, and their professional waiters Starlin and Cesar. Maybe the reception could be improved with people welcoming and showing you around the resort.

reviews.author: Barbara B
reviews.title: Actividades en familia
reviews.text:
Felices con SORANYI en actividades !
Pintamos sombreros que llevaremos de recuerdo de nuestra estadía en Paradisus Palma Real…
Toda la semana nos puso al tanto del calendario. Gracias SORANYI ! 
Esperamos volver a verte pronto 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩

reviews.author: Maranadia C
reviews.title: Excelente estadia en el hotel
reviews.text:
Muy linda experiencia en el hotel, en todas sus áreas y sus actividades en compañía de Soranyi quien los guió y nos hizo sentir muy a gusto, con su atención y amabilidad
Les recomendamos las distintas actividades del hotel en compañía se su personal.

reviews.author: dolores m
reviews.title: Hotel de excelencia
reviews.text:
Excelentes las instalaciones del hotel, muy linda la playa. 
Destaco la excelente comida del restaurante Mascalzone y la excepcional atención de Milton y Ana Romero,  por la profesionalidad y amabilidad, Estuvieron en todo momento pendientes de todo detalle para hacer más agradable nuestra estancia.
También destaco la excelente atención de Maira del bufet principal y de Marileisy del bar de la playa 
Siempre sonrientes y amables.
Por último, destacó la amabilidad de las gestiones de Lizandrony de Antonio del guest concierge,  nos ayudaron en todo momento para resolver todas nuestras necesidades.
Gracias a todo el equipo!!!
Loli

reviews.author: Nathalie B
reviews.title: Palma Réal toujours aussi accueillant
reviews.text:
Le snaking Kanna est excellent ainsi que l'accueil de notre ami Luis. Toujours égal à lui-même depuis 3 ans. Merci merci merci😁😉
Et nos amis du bar du restaurant Blue Agave Victor, Ruby, Ysaura que l'on adore. Ils sont adorables. Vive leurs cocktails 🍸🍹

reviews.author: bifs1229
reviews.title: Maria at Rum Republic
reviews.text: Best exspesso martini by Maria!! She is a master and really treated us like VIP! Trust me you will not be disappointed! !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Dina H
reviews.title: Maria numero uno bartender with the best espresso martini in the place!!
reviews.text: Maria made the best Espresso martinis at Rum Republic!! She was so personable and made us feel welcomed!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!we will be back because of her!!

reviews.author: Milagros H
reviews.title: Bar Rum Republic- María, la mejor haciendo tragos.
reviews.text:
En el bar Rum Republic tomamos los mejores tragos hechos por Maria. Tragos personalizados. Deliciosos!!
Si vienen al palma real no pueden perderse estos tragos únicos e inigualables.
Mis tragos favoritos fueron la caipiriña de Ron malibu y el passion mamajuana.

reviews.author: Carolina M
reviews.title: Rum Republic - Maria 🤩
reviews.text:
Los mejores cocteles en Rum republic con María. La mejor!. Sus cócteles son buenísimos, siempre bien equilibrados y con una presentación increíble. Además, es súper amable y te recomienda justo lo que te puede gustar. Se nota que sabe lo que hace y le pone buena onda a todo.

Si vas, no dudes en pedirle una recomendación, seguro te sorprende.

reviews.author: drseimdc
reviews.title: Paradisus paradise
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful. All the restaurants have been outstanding both food and service. The entertainment at night has been eclectic-rock and roll, and circus performers are two that were fun. We loved the hibachi and Flora and waiting to try the Italian and Mexican however the buffet is amazing and I could eat there every meal.

reviews.author: Arnaldosilvio
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Nice and confortable property with a great service. MARIA the barman was great and prepare the best of the best Manhattan ever tasted.
We have enjoyed our stay and we are planning to come back soon with the rest of our family. Also Adriel the concierge is an incredible professional that takes care of every detail.

reviews.author: Exploration711462
reviews.title: Lua de mel perfeita!
reviews.text:
Desde quando chegamos no hotel fomos bem atendidos. Equipe fantástica. Cristian Gonzalez foi nosso concierge e nos atendeu em todas as nossas necessidades e mimos de nossa lua-de-mel. Os meninos, Jairo, Michael e outros da animação são excelentes tb. Todos os nossos dias no Palma Real foram maravilhosos. 
Pontos a melhorar: conexão do Wifi não funciona muito bem. Caia o tempo todo e só conseguimos nos conectar no dia seguinte de nossa chegada. 
Pró-atividade da equipe nos restaurantes deixa a desejar um pouco. Precisam melhorar nesse ponto.

reviews.author: Erica L
reviews.title: Best bartenders!
reviews.text: Alberto at 90 degrees bar at the Adults Only pool is THE BEST! He makes delicious fresh fruit drinks, I can’t recommend him enough! Ask for a Dirty Monkey with bananas or a Miami Vice! The resort is beautiful and we will definitely be back! 🌴🥥🍓🍺🍹🧉

reviews.author: Cosmopolitan522155
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Reserva Punta Cana
reviews.text: Top notch accommodations and service we would recommend this resort and stay here again. However, we experienced steady winds during our stay and while the Sargassum seaweed was limited by the floating beach barriers there was an unusual amount of plastic garbage that polluted the beautiful beach and sea.

reviews.author: Stacey
reviews.title: The best pool bar!
reviews.text: We just got here late last night and so far we are loving it! We spent the whole day at the adult only bar, 90 Degrees. Shout out to Alberto, Raysa, Olga. Excellent service! Ask for the special drink with ginger. Not too sweet or sour. It's perfect!

reviews.author: Victoria T
reviews.title: A Great Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had a great family vacation to this resort. We paid for the Reserve upgrade which did make for a less stressful vacation. Our concierge, Sevonia, was awesome. She catered to our every need and want. She made dinner reservations, arranged the free excursion which come with Reserve, decorated our rooms for Birthday celebrations and arranged transfers to and from the airport. Food was good. Didn't love the Mexican restaurant but the others were really good. Beach bar (on the Reserve side) was spectacular. Rafael and the bar staff were amazing. Rafael set up our towels and made sure we had endless supply of drinks throughout the day. They all spoke pretty good English which made communication much easier. The beach solicitations were a bit much but once you said no they typically didn't bother you again. Overall we had a great time here. Pools were super clean, our room was clean, the resort is well taken care of and the staff overall was amazing. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: mariesag2025
reviews.title: Magnifique séjour au Paradis
reviews.text: Nous avons passé un séjours parfais! L'hôtel est magnifique. Je voyage beaucoup et c'est le meilleur service que j'ai reçu. Personnel souriant, attentionné. Notre concierge Eriol a vraiment été super! Toujours à l'écoute et en contact avec nous. Il m'a même aidé à organiser une petite surprise pour mes parents. Les activités sont très variées autant pour les adultes que pour les enfants. La section The Reserve est un must si vous voulez être tranquille et la partie de la plage réservée pour cette section est parfaite incluant le personnel. A chaque jour Martin nous saluait et nous préparais notre place. Certes il y a quand même quelque vendeur sur la plage mais ils n'insistaient pas et étaient très courtois. Les restaurants à la carte sont très variés. Le Santé, exclusif  la section The Reserve  été notre coup de coeur. Les chambres sont propre et très grande. J'y retournerai c'est certain!

reviews.author: Karina Acosta
reviews.title: The best of all time
reviews.text: Lovely experience in Palma Real. The best one so far. I totally loved Yanira Sosa at The Box Lunch. Always at our service, always happy, very nice and friendly. Deserve a raise. Will definitely come back soon. I can honestly say this hotels is definitely a paradise.

reviews.author: Sightseer46471715726
reviews.title: Un site merveilleux !!!
reviews.text:
Un site merveilleux d’une beauté exceptionnelle. 
Les chambres sont d’une propreté sans reproche. Lit super confortable. La plage est très belle pour aller marcher et nous ne manquons jamais de chaises. La bouffe est très bonne et les restaurants à la carte sont excellents.
Une mention spéciale à Jean Carlos pour son service exceptionnel au restaurant. Toujours avec le sourire, il fait tout pour répondre à nos demandes pour toujours bien nous servir. Un serveur d’exception. 
Prendre l’apéro au lobby avec de la belle musique débute bien notre soirée.
Un site merveilleux !!!
Des vacances de rêve !!!

reviews.author: Osvaldo F
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente estadia sob a atenção de Yaleidi Sims , ótima comida em especial no restaurante Sante. Drinks muito bons especialmente nas areas de piscinas e no sport bar. Experiências gastronômicas muito interessantes nos restaurantes asiático, italiano e de carnes

reviews.author: Frank P
reviews.title: Excelente lugar
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio las señoritas muy guapa, Jose del Rosario me atendió y super amable.
La comida excelente, la cerveza buen fría y el ambiente del lugar está  muy bien.
La música excelente y las temáticas que manejan son de lo mejor  me la pase muy bien con mis amigos

reviews.author: Geovanny A
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia en Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Excelente atención del personal! Muy amables. Especialmente Laura en el restaurante mexicano se portó muy bien.
Las instalaciones de primer nivel y todo con mucho orden y limpieza. Definitivamente volvería a hospedarme en este resort.

reviews.author: Eduardo A
reviews.title: Lo máximo el hotel
reviews.text: El mejor hotel de República Dominicana la mejor atención, la mejor comida, la mejore bebida y las mejores personas.......super recomendado sus mejores playas y las mejores vistas del caribe en centro América. Toda la seguridad y la variedad del lugar realmente encandilan.

reviews.author: KathyEff
reviews.title: Truly blissful & spectacular
reviews.text: We literally felt like we were on the set of a TV show. they made us feel like royalty and family at the same time. I definitely recommend staying in the Reserve. Truly, it was over the top amazing. We highly recommend and we will be back.  Thank you, Yeison, for the exquisite experience.

reviews.author: lyonsm980
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Excellent resort good food and service good value for the money staff very friendly great location and great facilities consigares on top of things keeping you informed

reviews.author: Pilar B
reviews.title: Maravillosa semana de relax
reviews.text:
Lo pasamos genial, hemos estado una semana descansando y disfrutando del maravilloso hotel. 
 La playa una pasada pero lo que realmente hizo la estancia espectacular fue el trato y dedicación de Martín. Nos atendía todos los días con la misma ilusión y la misma sonrisa.. 
Volveremos el año que viene SEGURO

reviews.author: Carlota B
reviews.title: Estancia en reserve solo adultos. Muy recomendable
reviews.text: Ha sido una experiencia inmejorable! Hemos estado en el área de reserve sólo adultos y la playa y piscina súper agradables y habitación amplia, limpia y bonita. Trato del personal en la playa buenísima por parte de Martin. Restaurante buffet Sante el mejor y su personal también, tanto Juan, Santo como las chicas que estaban en la recepción siempre atentos a que estuvieramos perfectos. Sin duda volveremos muy pronto! La mejor opción de la zona!

reviews.author: Estefania L
reviews.title: Best bar
reviews.text: Alberto was the ! You have to go to 90 degrees bar! The service was amazing! Alberto let me play my music ! The service was great ! He got a cake for my fiancés birthday!!!!! I loved it everyone was attentive until the end. Anyone that comes to this resort needs to visit this bar. And no. Kidsssssss

reviews.author: Marcel N
reviews.title: Palma Real Paradisus experiencia
reviews.text:
Era un experiencia súper bien. Venimos por tercera ves. Y siempre encantamos. El máster suite está muy cómodo y los empleados son muy agradable.
Más en bar Ginger estuvimos muy contento con Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga y Clary. Hasta el proximo Palma Real.

reviews.author: Jaidy L
reviews.title: A wonderful way to start the new year!
reviews.text: My family and I had the best experience at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana! Management and staff were so helpful, sweet, professional and fun! Carlos and Rodolfo in the front desk were so helpful and accommodating. Absolutely fantastic customer service.  Make sure to visit the lobby bar Ginger Bar and say hi to Maria S and Anthony for the yummiest drinks.  Make sure to ask Anthony for his morning pick me up, the Anthony special! Delicious espresso slushie drink :) Luis at the pool bar, Celsius, was so friendly and fun! The adults only pool bar (90 degrees) also had the sweetest waitress and so attentive! I wish I could remember her name but she was wonderful. Rosaniris and her parner did a beautiful job with the room service and I loved catching up with them in the morning on our way out for breakfast!  Marileisy was fantastic! So was Pedro and Rafael at the reserve beach. The beach services were wonderful and attentive! Ricardo, Edgardo, Miguel, Francesca, Gustavo and Ovie (spelling?) from the restaurant services were a pleasure during our dining experiences! There were so many wonderful staff members that I wish I could recall all their names! The whole team made my mom's 70th birthday so special. It is a beautiful, clean resort with great customer service and wonderful ambiance. We will definitely be visiting again :) Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.author: Guide49777026075
reviews.title: Welcome to your home away from home
reviews.text:
Ramon at the beach provided excellent service.  He knew exactly when we needed something and brought it before we even asked.   He is the best!

Jonathan at the swim up pool bar was also amazing!  He anticipated our favorite drink!  Leyenda brugal on the rocks with lime, delicious!

Enjoyed the entertainment by the activities director Jhoffrey (?spelling).  Danced many nights away.  Also learned poolside dance moves and had a fun rum tasting.

Our snack attendant in building 4 was so welcoming with his kind smile.  He made sure we had all our snacks and sparkling waters daily.

For therapeutic massages Gladys (she has magic hands) and Dorka (also wonderful masseuse)  at the spa.  Have the herbal tea and select a complimentary aromatherapy. You won’t regret it.  

Juan Castillo was an attentive and caring concierge.  He took extra steps to ensure everyone was aware of our allergies- made the stay so much more enjoyable and relaxing from the start.  We love and appreciate him so much!

Make restaurant reservations- superior dining compared to the buffet for sure.  Kicks sports bar also has great food- try the shrimp!

reviews.author: didiercez
reviews.title: Superbe expérience
reviews.text:
Une superbe expérience tout est parfait . 

Nous nous sommes régalés dans une ambiance de folie

À refaire dans les meilleurs délais pour notre plus grand plaisir 

Une équipe dynamique dans un cadre très exceptionnel 

Nous vous conseillons cet établissement demandez Juan

Merci Juan à bientôt j’espère 🤞

reviews.author: Julián L
reviews.title: Zenovia y punta cana
reviews.text: La experiencia en punta cana fue casi un sueño hecho realidad, aunque el agua podría estar un poco más limpia, el estado de las playas fue óptimo y la atención un 10. Nuestra concierge Zenovia fue nuestro ángel que veló siempre por nosotros, siempre nos ayudó y estuvo atenta a todo lo que necesitáramos. ¡Volveremos por ella!

reviews.author: Rodrigo S
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Muy buen resort, excelentes instalaciones, destaco la atención de Alberto en el bar 90 degrees de la piscina, preocupado en todo momento de tenernos con un trago, y en ningún otro bar del hotel quedaban igual de bien preparados. Como aspecto débil es la excesiva suciedad en la orilla de la playa, llena de algas y basura como plásticos, bolsas, envases de helados, etc.

reviews.author: Laura G
reviews.title: THE RESERVE. Excelente, con algún detalle que mejorar.
reviews.text:
Estamos alojados en la tranquila zona THE RESERVE. Muy satisfechos con esta elección, con una zona de playa y piscina exclusiva muy elegante (las camas en la playa son lo más!). Es claramente un hotel para descansar, sin el bullicio de otros. La habitación nueva y genial decorada, tiene cama muy cómoda, amenities de alta gama y bebidas premium, entre otras comodidades. Hay chanclas de playa, zapatillas y albornoz. La limpieza y el estado en todo el hotel es excelente. Mención especial al restaurante Santé exclusivo para THE RESERVE, calidad muy superior a cualquier otro probado en otros hoteles de Punta Cana. Tiene opción de carta y pequeño buffet (incluso hay buen jamón cortado a cuchillo). También su servicio es bueno y amable, así como en la playa, donde el bar prepara bebidas de alta calidad (Martín, que nos atiende, es encantador).Desde luego está siendo un placer de vacaciones.
Sin embargo, no estamos contentos con el servicio concierge incluido, pues no nos ha facilitado las reservas (priotitarias supuestamente) en los restaurantes temáticos, dándonos muy pocas opciones. Nos quedaremos con pena de no probar apenas ninguno. Tampoco ha funcionado el servicio de descubierta nocturno, pues solamente lo han llevado a cabo una sola vez. Hubiéramos agradecido mejor información a la llegada también.
Otra cosa que nos sorprende es que THE RESERVE no tenga una zona de cortesía propia tras el check out.

reviews.author: Slavka M
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: Yiri the waitress was the best!!! Everything was very good. Food service was excellent. Everything was done with the smile. We will certainly enjoy coming back and having another drink. The atmosphere was amazing and we felt very welcome.

reviews.author: Sylvie B
reviews.title: Encore une fois très satisfaits, nous y retournerons
reviews.text: C’est la 2ieme fois que nous y allons dans la section adultes et l’expérience fut encore très agréable, chambre très confortable, superbes piscines et plage, très bons restaurants , personnel super sympa bref, expérience très positive.

reviews.author: Juan Manuel B
reviews.title: Hotel de primera categoría sin dudas.
reviews.text: Excelente el hotel, ubicación, playa, servicios en la playa, restaurantes (especial mencion a Dionys -responsable de Mina) piscina, barras. La gastronomía es muy buena. Nosotros estuvimos en the reserve, la parte más exclusiva y realmente te hacen sentir así con la atención y los lujos, el conserje Adriel Cabrera que nos tocó muy servicial y amable para con nuestras peticiones y atención. Fuimos a no preocuparnos por nada y solo relajarnos y así fue. Volveríamos sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: Jim K
reviews.title: Treat you like family.
reviews.text: The entire resort and staff were amazing! They treat you like family.  Ismael, Antonio, Dominga & Clary at Ginger make great coffees and cocktails. Can’t wait to come back again. The atmosphere is second to none. The late night entertainment is first class.

reviews.author: Marta Ligia V
reviews.title: Un maravilloso sitio para pasar unas muy buenas vacaciones
reviews.text:
El hotel es muy bueno, la comida excelente y lo mejor: la calidez de las personas que nos atienden, Andreina, Luis y Diógenes en el Bar son verdaderos Bar tenders que disfrutan su trabajo y te hacen sentir como en casa. 
El mejor Conserje que hemos tenido: Christopher Rivera, gracias, gracias por cuidar de nosotros y suplir nuestras necesidades eficientemente y con calidez, la justa atención sin que resulte demasiado que parezca fingido, todo un profesional en atender sus clientes y hacerlos sentir como reyes

reviews.author: Excursion770719
reviews.title: Very restful
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Paradisus. We stay for a full 7 days. It was very quiet and relaxing. We stayed in the adult section and we had the premium service. Because the resort was in between the shoulder and the high season we had the concierge to ourselves. The beach was wonderful the palapas were plentiful and it wasn't very crowded. Typical restaurant fare. Best restaurant was Sante for lunch and dinner. Best breakfast was at the buffet.

reviews.author: Dean S
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: We just completed our stay here for the third year in a row. Needless to say, we love it. The staff is always friendly and helpful and our concierge Basilio was the best!  He made our stay even better by helping with setting up a spa day and our evening meals. Looking forward to seeing him again when we return in December!

reviews.author: Jujusegalla
reviews.title: Excelente estadia!
reviews.text: Ficamos na categoria the reserve! Nota 10 em tudo! Todos os funcionários maravilhosos, o Gilberto da praia e o nosso concierge Emmanuel que agendou todos os serviços de forma eficiente e cuidadosa! Não lembro o nome dos outros funcionários, mas deixo meu carinho para todos!

reviews.author: alexandrausuga
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: El hotel es hermoso, la playa y la piscina son espacios muy bonitos. Tiene mucha oferta de restaurantes y el buffet también. La habitación es amplia y muy limpia. Súper recomendado

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Pool bar bartenders
reviews.text:
Thank you to Victor, Jorge, and Luis at the pool bar for their amazing service. They really contributed to our experience and made us feel like family. 

We miss them already! 

Overall, everyone was very friendly and welcoming. Beach was also incredible.

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: THE BEST!!!!
reviews.text: Santè was the best restaurant!!!! Make sure to go there. BEST SERVICE!!!!!!!!!! Everyone is so friendly and kind and the service is top notch. Do not hesitate to book here as the food is also delicious!!!! Paradisus is a beautiful resort with many ammenities.

reviews.author: Ed K
reviews.title: Fantastic week with our family
reviews.text: Having stayed at Paradisus Grand Cana (was called Falcons when we were there) the prior year we saw Paradisus Palma Real during a beach walk and were intrigued by its beauty and decided to book it this year with our two adult sons.  My wife and I had a King room and our sons had 2 queen beds in our two junior suites.  The view from our balcony (which was classified as Garden) had a partial view of the ocean which was a plus.  The only suggestion I would make would be for the hotel to guarantee the type of bed for the rooms as we were concerned our sons would not get 2 beds which would have really been an issue had they not received it.  We stayed in the Reserve (Adult only) which was well worth it (quiet and also had a fantastic breakfast area).  Our concierge Zenovia was exceptional, with just the right amount of communication but yet not overbearing.  She always seemed excited to see us and was able to get all the dinner options and times we wanted which really was an improvement over our experience the prior year.  We loved our rooms (although smaller than Grand Cana), the pools, the beach (Martin was so helpful) and we felt the food was outstanding, again a notch above what we experienced at Grand Cana.  Our only frustration was the transfer to the hotel from the airport (which was supposed to have been included in our package) and despite multiple communications starting 1 month prior, we were never able to get confirmed and we fortunately were able to get on a shuttle with another couple going to the resort and the transfer company let us join them.  Our return time was earlier than we wanted so we paid for a cab back.  If this would be improved, our trip would have been flawless.  The entertainment was also enjoyable, we enjoyed our excursion through Otium to a marine area where you could swim with sharks and sting rays.  We also really loved a trip on a boat to a private beach area with a yoga experience, all provided by the resort.  Our sons played golf at the course that the resort has an affiliation with, and although quite expensive even with the resort discount, they enjoyed the experience.  Overall this was a fantastic resort which we definitely plan to visit again.

reviews.author: Michael K
reviews.title: Great sever
reviews.text: I hade the nicest time at the ginger . Katyy our server is such a sweetheart so attentive . So sad it’s our last evening. You be very happy in the event she looks after you. Doesn’t get much better. Great service and a nice smile.how many more words required to pot this???

reviews.author: Loic T
reviews.text: Très bon service, les gens sont accueillant. La nourriture est excellente. Bonne grosseur d'assiettes, chaude et goûteuse. Nous avons testé tout les restaurants du resort, tous étaient parfait. Vin à volonté. Personnels soucieux de leur clientèle, je recommande.

reviews.author: nancy m
reviews.title: My experiencia fue muy agradable gracias Emmanuel por la amabilidad de sus servicios
reviews.text: Nos encanto todo muy hermoso y no se diga el personal del  Hotel muy amable y cordial gracias Emmanuel muy amable y por ayudarnos en nuestra estancia en el Hotel y yo le doy un 10 gracias muchas experiencias dentro y fuera del Hotel con la familia excursiones q ofrecen muchas excursiones y nos dieron como guía del Hotel a Emmanuel persona muy amable

reviews.author: Elena S
reviews.title: Experiencia excelente
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia increíble, el hotel era perfecto y tenía un montón de actividades que podías disfrutar. El personal era muy amable y transmitían muy buenas vibras. Especial mención a nuestro conserje Basilio, que estuvo pendiente de nosotros y de nuestras necesidades en todo momento. Repetiría mil veces.

reviews.author: santiag0sant0s
reviews.title: Vacaciones Navideñas en familia en Paradisus Palma Real The Reserve
reviews.text: Experiencia magnifica familiar de ocho dias en The Reserve del Paradisus Palma Real de Punta Cana. El concierge Basilio especialmente atento a todos los detalles de nuestra estancia. Buena ubicacion, buena variedad de Restaurantes y diversas actividades

reviews.author: Paula S
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones de Navidad!!
reviews.text: Nuestra estancia fue perfecta aunque el hotel estuviera al 100% de su capacidad. Sin duda valorar muy positivamente el personal del hotel: atento, simpático y muy dispuesto con especial mención a nuestro “Consierge” Basilio que estuvo pendiente de todas nuestras necesidades y peticiones durante la estancia.

reviews.author: Claudia M
reviews.title: Magnífica experiencia!!
reviews.text:
Magnífica experiencia en hotel de lujo con fantástica ubicación para terminar el año en familia. Han sido unas vacaciones que recordaremos durante años!
Muchas gracias a nuestro concierge Adriel en The Reserve, ya que consiguió acomodar a nuestra familia de 7 a la perfección, con las dificultades que un grupo grande conlleva, y más en una época de tanta demanda.
Me gustaría también destacar a Rafael y Pedro en la zona The Reserve en la playa, y a Quintino y Raysa en la piscina. Todos ellos nos regalaron deliciosos cocteles, grandes momentos y muchas risas.

reviews.author: FebaSpain
reviews.title: Fantástica experiencia
reviews.text: Hemos estado toda la familia para pasar una semana. El hotel es fantástico.Nuestra experiencia en The Reserve fue increíble y en eso tuvo mucho que ver nuestro concierge Adriel que ha estado en todo momento pendiente de nosotros (éramos 7!!!!) cumpliendo todas nuestras peticiones y facilitándonos  la estancia. Gracias, Adriel!!!

reviews.author: Malala A
reviews.title: I love i
reviews.text:
Perfect place to have nice and relax vacation! 
I love the spa and the winery.
The beach is beautiful and the color of the sea is magical 
Nights are great and happy. 
Verry good service.
The room was big enough for me and my family of 6.
I will loved to come back.

reviews.author: Robert Keith B
reviews.title: Relaxing Dominican Beach Trip
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort, with such excellent food, service, beach cabanas, pools, and restaurants.  The Dominican Flora restaurant was especially delicious!  And Our stay was complemented with a nearby excursion snorkeling on the reef, and swimming with sharks and sting rays too!

reviews.author: Yara V
reviews.title: Best all inclusive resort
reviews.text:
The best resort in Punta Cana, for families with kids or babies and couples. 

Best quality in food and liquor in an all inclusive. It’s a great experience for foodies and has option for picky eaters as well.

Recomended to visit the bar Rum Republic and ask for Maria, she’s the best.

reviews.author: Jean-Philippe O
reviews.title: Le Paradis
reviews.text: Séjour incroyable !!! Nous avons séjourné à la section The Reserve du 30 décembre au 6 janvier 2025. Tout a été parfait. Chambre moderne, spacieuse et luxueuse. Le restaurant exclusif à la section The Reserve, le Santé, est exceptionnel. Juan, notre serveur a été parfait. Il était au devant de nos besoins et nous a même préparé un souper surprise de 7 services. La piscine et la plage sont dotées de confortables lits à disposition. Nous avons fait plus de 20 hôtels de luxe dans les Caraïbes et en Europe et le Paradisus se situe dans le haut de la liste. Un gros coup de cœur !!!!

reviews.author: Teresa S
reviews.title: Family New Years Eve Celebration Trip
reviews.text:
We arrived on Dec 27 and will be leaving on January 3. It’s my husband, my two college-age kids, and me. So far, it has been an amazing trip. We booked reservations for the restaurants before arriving. So far, it has worked out for us. We have enjoyed the food at all the restaurants, and the service has been impeccable. We have food allergies and communicate them using Google Translate. The buffet has plenty of options. We especially enjoyed the cook-to-order stations and the Dominican food station. 

Our favorite night so far has been the Legend of the Sea New Year's Eve Party. It was an amazing party with live entertainment and dancing on the beach. They set up the beach beautifully with chairs, tables, lounge chairs, and plenty of 2025 props for photo ops. It exceeded our expectations. 

We are staying in a deluxe two-bedroom master suite. There is plenty of room for the 4 of us. The cleaning staff has been great. The rooms are clean and well-equipped. Some minor repairs are needed. One of our outlets is not working, and a few curtain clips are missing. Easy fixes 

The pools and the beach are gorgeous. We had no problem getting beach or pool chairs, and we are not early risers!

reviews.author: Andrea M
reviews.title: Family Christmas Vacation 2024
reviews.text: The resort was amazing. Our concierge Christopher took great care of us. He helped each day with our dinner plans, left thoughtful gifts, and checked in with us each day. I highly recommend him as your concierge. I would highly recommend this resort. The food and restaurants were great for an all inclusive vacation.

reviews.author: Flor M
reviews.title: Amazing vacations
reviews.text:
The selection of the room wasn't the best considering we were 3 adults and had cero privacy but the rest of the staying was the best. 
Our personal concierge Emmanuel was number one, no doubt. He helped us with everything we needed. Couldn't ask for a better one.

reviews.author: JORGE Q
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Todo espectacular!!! Muchas gracias Emmanuel por tus excelentes coordinaciones y atención cada uno de los días, además de las recomendaciones de actividades durante la estadía !!! Las pasamos muy bien en familia! Feliz año 2025!! Y nos vemos muy pronto!

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - swim up suite.
reviews.text:
My wife and I just spent 11 days at the Paradisus Palma Real resort. We had a junior swim up suite.  December 17 was the date we arrived and we departed on December 27.  For context, we are in our mid 50s, no kids 

We are melia club members since 2011.  

The Weather = more rain than usual.  It’s still paradise and great weather. But, one day it did rain a lot. Two other days = a couple of hours scattered throughout the day

We had two concierges.  Francisco and Jose.  As this was 10 nights around Christmas, a lot of employees were off part of this trip. Which is why we had two different concierges. Both were very good though. Made our dinner reservations. Told us the activities for the day.  My birthday is Christmas Eve.  My wife arranged a special dinner.  They had a cake sent to the restaurant for this. On the house 

Sante is the restaurant we went to the most. As they were open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. 

Barnelis was the hostess. By the third time we were there, she knew our room # 

Juan was a very good server.  As was starlin.  As was Yissell.  We had Juan more often though 

A different Juan was making omelette and other egg dishes for breakfast. He was very good as well 

Kanna = the restaurant we went to most often for lunch.  Luis was a very good waiter. On my birthday, he did something on his own.  My wife hadn’t set it up, like she did the dinner.  Olvi was another server that was good. But we had Luis as our server more often 

Tokimeku is the Japanese restaurant.  We had hibachi.  Rafael was the hibachi chef.  Fanni was the food server.  Yuieni was the drink server. The service here was better than the tokimeku we went to last month (in playa del Carmen).  Much better 

Mascalzone was  the Italian restaurant.  Pizzas, calzones and pastas mostly. Yuieni was a server here as well. As was Wilimena 

Mina is the steakhouse. Very good food. 

We went twice. Roberto was our server the first time. Jean and Celia were the servers the second time. 

Flora is the Dominican restaurant. 
Eduardo, starlin and Ana were the servers

Lunch box = buffet style lunch. We went there a couple of times 

We went to the beach six of the ten days.  

Wilber set us up there a few times. On two occasions he even saw me walking towards the beach, came out to get our stuff and carried it over. He was serving drinks also 

Rafael set us up the other days. Served drinks also. Like Wilber, he was very attentive.  Even though we hadn’t been there two days in a row, he had a spot ready for us the next time 

Swim up suite = drink service was good. Though not as quick as at the beach. 
Yeison was the main pool server. 

Ginger bar.   Open until 1 am. Though, one night we were there until 2:30. We went there 4 nights.  

Luis, Miguel , Jorge were the bartenders.  All were very good. 

Kicks bar.  Some nights it was a club. Open until 1 am 
We went once. Were the oldest people there :) 

Blue agave.  Has dinner, then just a bar from 10 pm - midnight.  Went twice. 
Randy was the bartender one night. Very Nice guy. 

Jose was the bartender the other night. Fun guy, even photobombed us :)

Rum republic.  We went one night.  Miguel was the bartender. 

We had dinner one night at Brisas. That’s Normally for circle members (we are not), but our conceives made the arrangements 

My wife went to the Yhi spa. 
Gladys was her masseuse.  Spas aren’t my thing, but my wife enjoyed it. 

We had a great time overall.

reviews.author: Juan Pablo M
reviews.title: Excelente opción para unos días en familia
reviews.text: Pasamos unos días muy especiales en familia, recomiendo THE RESERVE tienen un servicio muy especial Yaleidi nuestra conserje nos cuido y organizo todo durante nuestra estadía y fue ESPECTACULAR!!!! El hotel es perfecto para niños y tiene un lugar especial Solo Adultos, donde estuvimos muy tranquilos.

reviews.author: Anuradha U
reviews.title: Christmas in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
The hotel was so Beautiful. The staff were amazing Especially our Concierge Kelvin. He took care of us like Family! He made all our dinner reservations and even arranged round trip transportation for my son to go play golf . He would talk to us every day to see if we need anything! 
The Mexican and Italian restaurants were my favorite! The only thing I didn’t like was the buffet! Some of the items were cold. 
If you have American Express Reserve card you have some private areas to enjoy! You also have Concierge who will make your stay amazing ! As a Reserve card holder you will have beautiful beach area with very comfortable lounge chairs and views! 
I would Highly Recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Jessica A
reviews.title: A wonderful getaway!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real! We travelled the second week of December, when the resort was quieter. We loved that it didn’t feel crowded!

The resort
The resort is absolutely beautiful, not too big, grounds and buildings are very well maintained and felt very clean. There are many pools to swim, many bars, and quite a few restaurants. We stayed in the Master Suite Deluxe in building 10 on the third floor closest to the beach. There is no elevator so we got our steps in! The room itself was very spacious, had 4 sinks, A comfy king bed, sofa bed and we got a rollaway bed too. Our bar fridge was always full with the drinks we like and there are treats too like chips, chocolates to snack on in the room.

The food
We really enjoyed the food! They had a large selection at the buffet, but by the end of the week we felt like it was getting a bit repetitive. Great fresh fruit, the BEST guacamole, various salads, omelettes, fish, meat and much more!

Dinner restaurants
Our favorite a la carte restaurants were the Italian and the Asian. Service was very slow at the Asian both times we went, but the sushi was great and so was the fish! We also tried the steakhouse which was pretty good, Caribbean, and teppanyaki, which put on an entertaining show!

The staff
Many staff members at the resort went above and beyond to offer help. A Special shoutout to Reynaldo, who always greeted us with a warm smile, brought us jam everyday for breakfast, and made sure we were always taken care of at the restaurants and buffet. Special shoutout to Luisa, Guest Service Manager who really went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed for a perfect stay. Anything we needed was just a text message away! Thank you again Luisa! Special shoutout to Edito for making sure we were taken care of at the buffet! There are many staff members who don’t speak much English, but using Google Translate on our phones was very useful. The staff at the pool and outdoors bars were also very helpful and would gladly get us towels any time.

Activities / nightlife
We loved the foam party and paddle boarding in the main pool and enjoyed the nighttime rock show! We would have liked to see more evening entertainment and more activities during the daytime. Maybe a fun beach party and for sure more foam parties in the pool!

The beach
The beach is absolutely beautiful! It’s really one of the highlights of the resort. So many chairs and huts to choose from, and we never had an issue getting a chair when we headed to the beach in the morning. The beach is very clean and the workers use a tractor or a rake to clean up any seaweed pretty quickly. The sand is soft sand, and the ocean waves weren’t too rough! We REALLY loved walking up and down the beach. It’s a great way to stay in shape!

Vendors
There are some people coming up to you on the beach asking if you’d like to buy various items- hair braiding, cigars, excursions, clothing, etc. They aren’t pushy and just walk away if you say you’re not interested. 

Alcohol and drinks 
Alcohol was great! We loved the mudslides! The resort also provides ample bottled water. 

Overall, our vacation was very relaxing and we loved our stay! We hope to return again next year!

reviews.author: Johanne D
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our expérience at Paradisus was perfect, thanks to the excellent work of our concierge Christopher Rivera. He was absolutaly perfect!!!! It’s our 8th visit and we never had such great service. Yuderi, Pedro, Raphaël and Martin at the Beach are always  excellent year after year. We love them. At Santé… we adore the waiter Gustavo. 
Viva Paradisus!!!!!

reviews.author: Thomas B
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive Ever
reviews.text: We visited the Paradisus Palma Real for our honeymoon and we had an absolutely incredible time. We booked a reserve room which meant we were accompanied by an assistant. His name is Christopher and he was the absolute best. He made dinner reservations for us, showed us around the resort when we arrived, and made sure to check in with us every day to see how we were doing. He would send us activities going on in the resort every morning, as well as sending us the menu for the dinner reservations he made. He even brought us a sweet letter and balloons to celebrate our honeymoon. Christopher made our stay PERFECT!

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.title: Delicious food at Flora
reviews.text: Lovely well appointed resort . And amazing meal this evening at Flora - delicious Dominican fare . And so well looked after by Starlin our server . He was especially attentive to our needs and the food allergy of one of our family . Chef Leandro and team are doing a great job

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Mil gracias, Gustavo!
reviews.text:
Muchas gracias a Paradisus Palma Real, realmente una experiencia sin igual. Solo tenemos palabras de agradecimiento, ya que nos hicieron sentir como en casa y como verdaderas princesas. Este review está dedicado especialmente a Gustavo, nuestro concierge de *Reserve*. Luego iremos poniendo los reviews dedicados a las personas que marcaron positivamente nuestra estadía.

Gracias infinitas, Gustavo, por tu atención impecable y por estar siempre pendiente de nuestras necesidades. Fuiste receptivo a todo lo que requerimos y siempre aparecías en el momento exacto. No sabemos cómo, pero siempre sabías dónde encontrarnos y tus mensajes llegaban en los momentos perfectos.  

Nos sentimos muy bienvenidas y atendidas durante toda nuestra estadía. ¡Definitivamente volveremos! Muchas gracias a todo el equipo de *Reserve* por hacer de este viaje algo mágico. Mil gracias, Gustavo!

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.title: Perfect Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the adults only area with Basillio as our concierge.  He was amazing. He spoke perfect English and remembered all of our names ( there were 4 of us). He was very responsive when we had questions or needed to change something. He made our dinner reservations and recommended places we would like to eat after finding out what we liked. 

The only thing that could have been better was the food consistency. Example, We loved the Kicks burger but went back the next day and it was completely different. 

Japanese restaurant a la cart was not good at all. That was our least favorite. Sante service and food was our favorite. We loved Gustavo at breakfast and Miseal at dinner! Edwardo was always making sure we were happy. Thank you gentlemen!

reviews.author: Abby S
reviews.title: Fun in the DR
reviews.text: We are staying at the Paradisus Palma Real and our stay is fabulous so far! The resort is very clean and the food is delicious! The staff is very friendly! The Mexican restaurant is delicious! We have a 2 bedroom suite. It is perfect for our family of 4!

reviews.author: Hash H
reviews.title: Amazing service and fantastic surroundings
reviews.text: Our stay here has been wonderful thanks to an amazing staff and our concierge Gustavo. Gustavo is one of the main reason we will be back as his communication and accessibility was top tier. He even went out of his way to set up a birthday surprise for our daughter. Gustavo’s service was a 10/10 and we definitely see ourselves coming back here.

reviews.author: Climber32417959698
reviews.title: Hotel muito bom!
reviews.text: O hotel é muito bom e tranquilo, Excelente para férias de descanso e em casal. A praia em frente ao hotel é tranquilo e sem muitas ondas. Nosso concierge Christophwr foi extremamente atencioso e prestativo nos auxiliando do início ao fim de nossa estadia. Recomendamos o hotel !

reviews.author: Mehdi K
reviews.title: Great experience at Palma real
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to DR and I absolutely loved it. Stayed at paradisus Palma real and I was blown away.

Amazing staff and team. Great resort.
My concierge Adriel was amazing. He made my trip exceptional by taking care of everything from reservation to booking transport and informing me of activities.

I really appreciated his proactive initiative.
I absolutely loved my stay and hope to visit soon again.

Cheers 

Mk

reviews.author: Ashley D
reviews.title: Go to the Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text: The resort is relaxing full of good food and kind hospitable people. My favorite restaurants were Flora and Santé. The waiter at Santé Juan was amazing and made my boyfriend and I feel extremely welcomed and cared for. If you are looking for a relaxing but fun trip with friends, family or significant others I highly recommend the Paradisus Palma real. It has an amazing mix of calm relaxing and fun and exciting excursions and activities. If you can, opt for the concierge service. Ours was Adriel and he was super kind and helped us booked excursions, dinner reservations, spa treatments and more. He was a key aspect to making our trip unforgettable.

reviews.author: Gregory M
reviews.title: Amazing atmosphere
reviews.text: This place was amazing. The food was great, the beach was beautiful and everyone was so accommodating. I went with my girlfriend and our favorite place to eat was Santé. Our waiter Juan (at Santé) was by far our favorite. He was so charismatic and fun.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos T
reviews.title: EXCELENCIA PROFESIONAL
reviews.text: Excelente estadía de 10 días en sector THE RESERVE con salida a pileta. Todo 10 puntos, no exagero.  Pero para mi esposa y para mi lo verdaderamente más importante fue la atención y asistencia de nuestro conserje, Basilio, ( también cuando no se lo requirio ) estando atento al detalle. Desempeño altamente profesional ,a mi entender, capacitado para tareas de mayor responsabilidad. Gracias MELIA por este servicio. Gracias Basilio por tu alto profesionalismo. Hasta la proxima.

reviews.author: mimiazar52
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: We brought our friends who had never experienced such a wonderful and relaxing time on a vacation. Atmosphere, accommodations, restaurants and staff were all outstanding.

reviews.author: Kerry W
reviews.title: 3 night getaway
reviews.text: Great stay.  Rooms updated and very nice.  Staff super nice throughout.  Christopher, concierge in Reserve, was awesome!  You’ll be lucky to get him.  Food outlets very nice, good selections and no issues getting in.  Plenty of pool chairs, no need to run down early to save a chair. Beach nice, a few chairs need replacement.

reviews.author: Amanda J
reviews.title: Fabulous Resort All Around
reviews.text: Paradisus is one of the best resorts fiancée and I have been to. We came December 2024 as a site visit and plan to get married here in February 2025. First off, the staff is amazing, from the private concierge, to the wedding planner, to the restaurant and bar staff - 5 stars. Mina was our favorite restaurant with rum Old Fashions and bbq ribs that literally fell off the bone with a side of roasted potatoes. Kicks sports bar had American football in and pool tables to enjoy during a little rain passing through. Massages at the spa were fabulous and the views of the beach gorgeous. We’re looking forward to coming back in 2 months and spending a week here with family and friends!

reviews.author: kris K
reviews.title: Best resort so far!
reviews.text:
We love this resort.  This is our third trip here and we would come back tomorrow.   The ginger bar is wonderful with Ismael and Antonio serving you amazing coffee in the morning.  At night, the gingerbread transforms itself with live music.   If you’re looking for loud constant entertainment, this may not be the ideal resort, but is rather quieter. Beaches are beautiful.   Restaurants are wonderful, especially the Flora, which serves Mediterranean Dominican style food.   Our waitress this evening ANDREA Santana was wonderful. 
For leisure golf was acceptable but pricey. I also wonder what punta cana resort will be the first to develop facilities for the fastest growing sport among their US and Canadian clientele namely pickleball

reviews.author: sabrinal653
reviews.title: Simply amazing!
reviews.text:
Beautiful, clean, perdeft service, activities everyday all day long, great drink. Room was litteraly the size of an appartment with a separate room! Huge balcony. They clean the room and fill the bar everyday. Poeple that are working there were very very nice.
Shuttle to the beach every 5 min so you never wait.
Buffet very good
Water as you need and want
I recommend 100%

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Best Luxury Service in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
My experience was outstanding! The check-in process was smooth and easy. Our concierge, Adriel Cabrera, was incredibly accommodating and took excellent care of my sister and me. We were attending a wedding at another hotel, and he handled all the arrangements, from transportation to the makeup artist, Jeny from the spa wich was very talented.

Additionally, we were celebrating my sister's birthday, and Adriel made dinner reservations for us. He ensured that the waiter, Juan, brought out a cake and sang for her during dinner. The hotel facilities are beautiful, featuring stunning views, a lovely pool, and inviting common areas that feel like a dream.

Our room was extremely clean, and the housekeeping staff was discreet and friendly. I will definitely be returning with my family soon and highly recommend this amazing service and accommodation! Thank you to the staff for making our weekend so memorable.

reviews.author: T S
reviews.title: Amazing couple trip.
reviews.text: Emmanuel was amazing! Booked all our reservations for dinner - made everything so easy.  We loved it - comfy rooms.  We especially loved the adults only beach with the most Luxurious lounge chairs and huts! The food was fresh and delicious.  Drinks great and anything you wanted.

reviews.author: Francisco A
reviews.title: Un hotel increíble, con personal INCREIBLE
reviews.text:
Un hotel mágico, espectacular, pero las instalaciones no son nada sin el personal tan especial que trabajan en el, desde el primer día nos han hecho sentir como si fuésemos parte de la familia que compone Paradisus Palma Real .
Una mención  especial para Rosana del buffet, una persona encantadora, servicial y por supuesto profesional. 
Gracias "mis amores" como ella nos ha recibido todos los días

reviews.author: Eva C
reviews.title: Reseñas
reviews.text: Cada vez que vamos a la zona del buffet nos está esperando Rosana con su bonita sonrisa y su trato tan exquisito con todo el mundo. Hoy pensando que estaba de permiso hemos ido a desayunar al Santé pero al darnos cuenta que sí que estaba hemos ido a almorzar. Todos son encantadores pero Rosana es especial. Volveremos seguro, este será nuestro hotel de referencia en Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Felicia M
reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic vacation with friends
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful! We are a group of 6 who travel together frequently and all agreed that this was an excellent vacation with excellent service, great food and as it say, all-inclusive.  No tricks!  Hector, our concierge, was phenomenal.  He provided a birthday surprise and it was heartwarming.  The beach and pools as well as rooms were immaculately maintained.

reviews.author: Philippe
reviews.title: Au Paradis

reviews.author: Roam51013423228
reviews.title: Le paradis . .tout simplement
reviews.text: Juste parfait! La plage, le site, la qualite et variete de la restauration, la zone The reserve est un must avec sa plage et beds selective, ses piscines reservees sans enfants dont une piscine de 35 ms pour les nageurs et majordome Basilio dedie. La barre est haute !

reviews.author: MARÍA ELISA V
reviews.title: PARADISSUS PALMA REAL RECOMENDABLE 100%
reviews.text:
En el mes de junio estuve de vacaciones con mi marido.
He recorrido muchos hoteles de la compañía, ya que mi hija es Front Office Manager en Hotel Madrid Plaza España y Madrid Centro.

Solo puedo decir que es uno de mis hoteles preferidos, especialmente por la atención de todo el personal.
Tengo que destacar  la asistencia en The Level de Anthony en todo momento, ya que tuvimos incidencia con el equipaje por culpa de la aerolínea, y siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros, así como del equipaje para que se nos solucionase esto lo antes posible. Su atención hacia nosotros fue de 10.
También nos asignaron de asistente a Irvin Nolasco también su atención fue máxima en todo momento, con la reserva de restaurantes, planificación de actividades y en todo momento del día pendiente de nuestra estancia.
Solo tengo palabras de agradecimiento hacia estos trabajadores y en general hacia el resto del personal. Todos trabajan con una sonrisa y felices.

Por eso repito ahora para  pasar la Navidad. Deseando llegar a Paradissus a pasar unos días maravillosos con vosotros.
Po todo ello, vamos a repetir de nuevo con viaje familiar del 20 al 26 de diciembre para celebrar la Navidad.
A las personas que no conozcan el complejo se lo recomiendo 100%

reviews.author: Jacobo E
reviews.title: Gracias al personal tan amable y profesional.
reviews.text:
Quiero destacar la amabilidad del personal y en especial tanto a Marcos (recepción ) como a Iderca (restaurante snack).
Ha sido un placer haber experimentado la estancia tan agradable 
Han sido doso facilidades a la hora de cualquier consulta

reviews.author: FarAway24121306704
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real... Fantastic
reviews.text: Such a beautiful hotel.  Everything was just perfect.  Food was great, accomodation fantastic and can't say more for the staff.  I have never been at a resort where the staff were so engaged, efficient and caring.  For the most part our personal concierge, Eriol, made everything so easy and effortless.  We were two ladies travelling alone...thanks to eriol we always felt safe.  He checked on us constantly and made all our reservations without asking.  He provided us with lots of water and was always there via WhatsApp if he was at the hotel or not.  It was a very effortless vacation thanks to Eriol. Can't say enough.  He is a true gem to the Melia group.   Hope to come back to this stunning hotel soon.

reviews.author: Gaspar
reviews.title: Increíble servicio
reviews.text: Lo mejor del viaje sin lugar a dudas el trato de nuestro concierge Emmanuel y de nuestro barman favorito Gilberto!!! Estamos enormemente agradecidos por todo lo que han hecho durante nuestra estancia. Volveremos a visitarles sin duda. El hotel e instalaciones de 10

reviews.author: Shari F
reviews.title: Fabulous vacation experience
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve for adults only. Our concierge was Basilio. He was fantastic!! He made all of our reservations and our spa appointments. He was there for all our needs and checked in with us multiple times per day. He was a pleasure to deal with. We loved the hotel. The took the pool the beaches the food…all were terrific!! We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: smceleney
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week. Our concierge Harry was just wonderful. We had a relaxing week at a clean and we'll appointed beach hotel.

reviews.author: Tabi OYAJI
reviews.title: You are excelente, Basillo!  See you again soon!
reviews.text:
12月のはじめに行きました。プンタカーナは大型のオールインルシブ型のリゾートがどんどん建設中で、今後もいろんなところが進出してくると思われますが、そんな中で今回はParadisus Palma Realを選びました。ここはMelia系列のリゾートで、広い敷地に３つのMelia系列のリゾートがあります。空港から車で３０分弱で到着して、距離も近いので便利です。Paradisusはファミリー全般で滞在できるのですが、Reserveという地域は大人専用で、こちらは特に喧騒から離れてゆっくりしたい方にお薦めです。Reserveエリアを予約すると、特別のブレスレットが与えられ、担当のバトラーが付きます。このバトラーのBasilloさんは常に気を遣ってくれて、滞在中も頻繁に連絡をくれ、ニーズにこたえてくれました。レストランの予約もいち早くアドバイスをくれ、人気がある混雑しているレストランを抑えてくれたので、ディナーも大変楽しめました。彼には大変感謝です！
　またReserve Areaですと専用のレストラン、Santeにも入れますので、特に朝食時は混雑を避けられてゆっくりと楽しむことができました。泊まるなら是非、Reserveエリアをお薦めします。また３月に行ってきます！See you all Soon!

I went at the beginning of December. Punta Cana is currently seeing a surge in the construction of large-scale all-inclusive resorts, and it seems that more companies will be entering this space in the future. Among these, I chose Paradisus Palma Real for this trip. This is part of the Melia group of resorts, and there are three Melia-affiliated resorts within the expansive grounds.

It’s conveniently located just under 30 minutes by car from the airport. While Paradisus is suitable for families in general, the Reserve area is adults-only and is particularly recommended for those who want to relax away from the hustle and bustle. When you book in the Reserve area, you receive a special bracelet and are assigned a personal butler.

Our butler, Basillo, was incredibly attentive, staying in frequent contact with us throughout our stay and meeting all of our needs. He gave us great advice on restaurant reservations, securing spots at popular and busy restaurants, so we were able to fully enjoy our dinners. We are very grateful to him!

Additionally, by staying in the Reserve area, we had access to an exclusive restaurant, Sante, which allowed us to enjoy a relaxed and uncrowded breakfast. If you’re planning to stay here, I highly recommend booking the Reserve area.

I’ll be visiting again in March! See you all soon!

reviews.author: peter2432019
reviews.title: Perfekter Wohlfühlurlaub
reviews.text:
Sehr gutes Hotel. Gepflegt und mit freundlichem Personal. Die Nutzung der QR Codes für Bestellungen ist am ersten Tag sehr ungewohnt, danach kein Problem. Wenn das WiFi verfügbar ist. Der größte Teil des Personals war extrem freundlich und hilfsbereit. Der Wechsel zwischen dem Buffet im Hauptrestaurant und den Themenrestaurants sorgt für gute Abwechslung, auch wenn das Steakhouse und das mexikanische Restaurant nicht zu empfehlen sind. Als Ausgleich gibt es das fantastische dominikanische Restaurant Flora - nur zu empfehlen. Die Anlage selber würde in Europa keine 5 Sterne bekommen, dafür gibt es zu viele Kleinigkeiten, bei denen die Handwerker eher mit karibischer Lässigkeit gearbeitet haben. Aber das ist Jammern auf hohem Niveau.
Wir würden auf jeden Fall sofort wieder hinfliegen.

reviews.author: AMSArlette
reviews.title: El mejor hotel al que he asistido en años
reviews.text: Me ha encantado, me ha hecho el viaje inolvidable. cómodo, bonito, funcional, servicio de diez, gente maravillosa, calidad de la comida, entorno idílico. la únic pena no poder quedarme más días. Sin duda repetiré

reviews.author: philthewiggleman
reviews.title: GREAT Vacation!!
reviews.text:
The facility was TOP notch!!  Fransisco was the the best concierge!!!
Highly recommend!!  Food was Great and service was Great as well..

reviews.author: Ruby M
reviews.title: Very high caliber all inclusive!
reviews.text: We were here for a long weekend girls trip and the whole trip was nothing short of amazing! The facilities are very well kept and beautiful. The beach is calm and clean. The service and food were fantastic. The spa was one of the most relaxing ones I’ve been to. But the best part was our concierge Basilio. He took amazing care of us, paying attention to every detail and very responsive to all our answers and requests. Would highly recommend coming here and asking specifically for Basilio ☺️

reviews.author: DayTrip75201
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful vacation. We enjoyed the beach and ocean with the soft sand. The boys liked having the swim up pool by the room and we were happy to be able to watch them from the shaded patio. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. Yafreizy and Yaison we always attentive at the Lunch Box. Ariel our concierge was on top of everything we needed in arrangements for our stay. We loved the Romantic Dinner on the beach where Wilber and Hostet Lati supervised a special experience. One of my sons and I played tennis each morning before it was too hot. We didn’t get to meet Nadal - the Nadal collaboration with Zel was opening after we left. We brought our own racquet and balls but we saw they have racquets there. We don’t drink much alcohol so we can’t comment regarding the drinks. We did not do the available excursions.
