Overall this was a fun and relaxing stay in a beautiful resort and the staff made it special.

reviews.author: cindynruss
reviews.title: 13th visit to our home away from home
reviews.text:
We came "home" for 9 days from November 8 through 16. The weather could have been better but a rainy day there is still better a day at home. Most of our "family" is still here and the new family members we met are awesome. The check in was a breeze. Angelica got us checked in in no time. We were traveling with my mother in law (92). I asked for an upgrade so mom didn't have to walk too far for morning breakfast which she was able to give us (it was our 13th time here also, at this resort). We were also to get the same room we've had the past few visits, close to everything but a little noisy at night being close to Kicks sports bar. Everyone here is so friendly and gracious. We have made many friends over the years with the people of the resort ( I will name by name later) and with other guests. In particular the group we met last year from HWS in the New Paltz New York area and the guys from Raleigh NC, who were arriving the day we were leaving. Even though we had rain most of the days, we did have a great time. The beach was beautiful as always. We had dinner at Mascalzone a few nights and our server Yenseen was great our first visit and our dear friend Yuleni served us the other times we went. Milton at Mascalzone was the best, making sure we were having a good meal and the service was acceptable ( it was excelente). Mom's eggplant was so good, she asked to complement the chef and he graciously came out. The lunchbox buffet wasn't open for dinner most nights so we has to eat at Malva, the smaller buffet. Being as my wife and I are vegetarian it was a little restricted what we could eat as the Lunchbox has a larger variety to choose from. We didn't starve. We spend most of our time at the pool bar with our dear friends who treat us like family and they are our family. We did treat ourselves to some spa time with the best masseuse of all. Mom had Gladys, my wife had Ironelis and I had Evangelista Gil. We are looking forward to our next visit next year. I want to thank everyone by name...
Luis Diaz, Quintino, Jonathan, Victor, Jesus, Teo, Edy, Marileisy, Rosanna at the pool bar
Wanda at the Wanda bar
Gilberto and Martin at the 96 degrees bar on the beach
Gladys, Ironelis, and Evengelista Gil at YHI Spa
Yuleni, Milton, and Yenseen at Mascalzone 
Julie who brought us coffee every morning at 6.55, 5 mins before expected 7am time
Antonio and staff of the Ginger bar in the lobby.
We missed our breakfast server at lunchbox, Maria Ortiz who is on leave 🙏
Mayor Pilier who made check out a breeze.
Also a shout out to Amstar for transportation to and from the airport for 12 visits without a hiccup at all.
Looking forward to our next visit in the spring of '25.

reviews.author: Tanner G
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, very clean. Friendly staff. Buffet food wasn't the greatest however the restaurants were great. Night entertainment was great and really enjoyed the Ginger to hang out at. Had a lovely holiday with my family. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Melanie H
reviews.title: An excellent experience
reviews.text: Our first time to an all inclusive resort has been a wonderful experience. Being in the reserve and having an attentive and friendly concierge was a great pleasure. The entire staff is welcoming and amiable. The grounds are outstanding and the rooms are clean.

reviews.author: andreikenaga
reviews.title: Lugar paradisíaco com ótimo atendimento.
reviews.text:
A arquitetura do resort é tão bela quanto a natureza ao redor. Ótimas comidas (ressalva apenas para o inconveniente de ter que agendar a maioria e torcer para ter disponibilidade). 
Equipe atenciosa e prestativa. 
Se conseguir ficar com quarto de frente ao mar, será difícil sair da suíte.

reviews.author: Leandro Luna
reviews.title: PUNTA CANA as it's BEST!
reviews.text:
What can I say? This hotel is simply AMAZING!
I had the priviledge to stay at The Reserve room, and for that, we had a personal concierge. His name is Wolfan and it's THE best you can get!
I mean, whatever we needed, and I mean everything, we just sent him a message and he would do all he could to make it happen. THAT is what I call customer service. Thank you, Wolfan!
About the hotel itself, it was a great experience as well. A lot of pools available, the beach is breathtaking and as it is an all inclusive, you have a huge variaty of bars to have a drink, or a few of them.
The housekeeping service is great! They make it look like we were never there😅. Spotless!👏👏👏👏
The Santé restaurant, has the best hostess ever! I mean, she would recognize us from heart, since day 2! She would take care of us and made sure we had everything we needed. Thank you, Barneliz, you rock!
At the main pool bar, Jorge always had a smile to serve us, even when I just wanted my Coca Cola with grenadine😅. Thank you!
At the Kicks sports bar, José, what an amazing guy. Gave us some background on the countries history and he knew all about it. Thank you!
Worth mentioning they have some gigs everynight. Local music, rock, pop, everything pretty much. The space is open air and is a very likeable envirorment!
I totally reccomend this hotel if you are looking to relax and enjoy what it has! CONGRATS EVERYONE!!👏👏👏👏

reviews.author: Christine W
reviews.title: Amazing Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort resting most tropically on gorgeous bavaro beach.

I have been coming to various resorts over the years in Punta Cana.

This resort is outstanding from its cleanliness, amazing food, great location and hard working friendly staff.

From the moment you arrive until the moment you leave you are treated like royalty.

The food is amazing and the drinks are top notch.  The rooms are wonderful with comfy beds and great air conditioning.

I highly recommend Palma Real for your vacation in Punta Cana.

Thank you Gladys Baustina for your extensive attention to detail allowing this resort to run perfectly.

Thank you Josias Esponoda for your kind and amazing hospitality.  It was so nice meeting you.

Until we meet again Palma Real.

reviews.author: esteban812
reviews.title: Gran experiencia
reviews.text:
Un hotel muy recomendable, en general los servicios son de 10 y el personal muy atento.
Gracias a todo el personal por hacernos la estancia imejorable.

reviews.author: ECR1966

reviews.text: Excelente servicio y calidad en todo el hotel. Los restaurantes y buffet han sido muy variados. Mención especial para Emmanuel nuestro concierge que ha estado siempre ayudándonos en todas las reservas de restaurantes y pistas de tenis. Los cocteles servidos en el bar de la playa y la simpatía de Gilberto ha sido un regalo que no vamos a olvidar. GRACIAS A TODOS!!!

reviews.author: Andrea K

reviews.author: carminecapparelli
reviews.title: Hotel is great the New Circle program must be improved.
reviews.text:
We have been coming to this hotel for years now and we really enjoy the experience that is why we came twice this year. Hotel is great, staff service is great and they go out of their way to help.

reviews.author: Gonzalo m
reviews.title: Excelente Honey moon
reviews.text:
Tuvimos una excelente atención las 7 noches durante nuestra luna de miel. Las instalaciones son un lujo y destacar tambien a nuestro concierge Frankyn Pierret por su buena disposición a solucionar todos nuestros requerimientos.

reviews.author: Katherine S
reviews.title: Buena experiencia
reviews.text:
Como experiencia general, fue magnificado. Mucha tranquilidad, descanso y buena comida. Cómodas instalaciones y variedad de espacios.
Sobretodo, una excelente atención de parte de nuestro mayordomo Franklyn, quién se preocupó de cada detalle y que fuera una grata experiencia! Estamos muy contentos!

reviews.author: Scott K
reviews.title: Best all inclusive in Punta Cana! ( IMO)
reviews.text:
This was our fourth trip to Punta Cana. We’ve tried several different all inclusive resorts ,   but Paradisus Palma Real was our favorite and for one very big reason. The kids club was extraordinary. They entertain your children morning, noon and night, and they don’t just sit there looking at them. They took them in the pool for activities, they played games, they fed them, my children actually bonded with the wonderful ladies and gentlemen working there.
In addition, the restaurants were excellent, and we were assigned our own personal concierge. This place definitely gets two thumbs up and five stars and we will be back at our new favorite place in Punta Cana!!

reviews.author: Adriana D
reviews.title: 10 días de hermosas experiencias
reviews.text:
La ropa de cama, de baño, muy buena, minibar muy surtido. También tes y café Nespresso, golosinas. Completo todo.
La atención personalizada de nuestra Concierge la srta YALEIDI, maravillosa. Se ocupo de todo y cada cosa que quisiéramos. Amable, cordial, dispuesta, excelente 👌

Recomendable. Para volver.

reviews.author: mayabee
reviews.title: Pure Paradise
reviews.text: I would recommend this all inclusive resort to everyone looking for some relaxation from reality and some vitamin sea! Nice rooms, tasty restaurants, gorgeous beach and pool, unlimited drinks and smoothies and juice, daily activities including bachata and painting and nightly entertainment with music and karaoke. Emmanuel from concierge, Bernardo from baggage help, Osvaldo from Blue Agave, Yuderi from the reserve beach and Victor the cocktail machine from Flora were amazing.

reviews.author: Charly M
reviews.title: Vacaciones de ensueño
reviews.text:
Experiencia inigualable en todos los sentidos 
Pudimos ir a la zona VIP y el restaurante Sante es un espectáculo.
La comida riquísima y el trato de todos perfecto, especialmente Barnelis. Muy maja 
Está todo controlado al milímetro como me había dicho un familiar que lleva yendo 5 años seguidos allí, y después de vivirlo nosotros repetiremos seguro.
Un auténtico lujazo

reviews.author: Lauren S
reviews.title: Dinner reservation process cutthroat
reviews.text:
This is my honest review of the resort.  We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort between November 20-25th.  The resort itself is beautiful.  Check-in was easy, there was no line (we arrived at 4PM-ish).  While checking in, a server brought us a drink from the 24-hour Ginger bar.  One of the first questions I asked the concierge was how to make dinner reservations.  He explained dinner reservations were made at the desk in front of The Lunch Box buffet restaurant every day between 7:00AM to 5:00PM.  After we dropped off our stuff in our room (we were staying in a Master Suite Swim-up), I immediately headed to the dinner reservation desk.  All restaurants were booked for that night.  However, the dinner reservation booker woman explained you can eat at Tokimeku (asian cuisine) al a carte menu without a reservation.  You couldn’t eat at their hibachi tables without a reservation.  I proceeded to book a reservation for the next three days out (so for the 21st, 22nd, and 23rd). You can only book three-days out because I tried to make a reservation for the 24th and she wouldn’t let me.  She explained to come the following morning at 7AM to make the reservation for the 24th.  The only place I really wanted to eat at was the steakhouse Mina.  The only day available for two-people they had was on 23rd at 9PM (I booked that reservation but ended up canceling because of the time).  Our dinner reservations:  21st - Flora (Dominican cuisine), 22nd - Blue Agave (Mexican cuisine), 24th - Mascalzone (Italian cuisine).  On the 23rd we ate at Tokimeku’s al a carte menu without a reservation.  I would say our least favorite restaurant was Tokimeku and our favorite restaurants were Blue Agave and Madcalzone.  

My only complaint I have is how cut throat/stressful the dinner reservation process is.  The morning of the 21st at 7AM, I went to the dinner reservation desk and there was no one working it.  I asked a server from The Lunch Box what time the dinner reservation desk would be open — he said at 9AM.  At 8:30, my family and I went to The Lunch Box for breakfast and the dinner reservation desk was opened.  I asked the booker (this time a different woman) what time she had opened and she said at 8AM.  I tried to book Mina for the 24th, however all the time slots were booked except for 9PM.  The dinner reservation process is either rigged or Mina is that popular that within 30 mins, all the other guests were able to book better time slots.

On another note, the service was great — bartenders and servers were extremely friendly.  The resort does have baby cribs.  The resort does have a convenient store but the prices to some items were high.  For Tampax Pearl 34-count cost $32 (I opted for the less pricey Playtex).  They do have a photographer at the resort — getting the pictures taken are free, each digital print cost $25.

reviews.author: Rossie G
reviews.title: Mis vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente servicio, quedé fascinada. El personal atento y la camarera Vanesa excelente, muy jovial y atenta. Lo recomiendo y me gustaría regresar nuevamente para volver a disfrutar unas vacaciones inolvidables y llena de alegría. Mi familia quedó encantada

reviews.author: administracion282
reviews.title: Un Paraíso
reviews.text:
Lugar único y muy bonito 
Se puede decir que este hotel trabajan para que te sientas de 10
Siempre pendientes y resolutivos en la mayor brevedad posible

reviews.author: Kishorebabu
reviews.title: Great experience..
reviews.text: Service was excellent. Franklin is awesome guy, helped us for all our day to day dining reservations along with all our requests and kids place stuff are amazing  & super friendly and Maria & the staff from rum republic bar is super and they made best drink in whole resort

reviews.author: Ian E
reviews.title: skibidi coolnes hotel
reviews.text: very good hotel!! service is incredible and extremely skibidi i love this hotel would come back. food is amazing and the employees are very awesome sauce. i recommend the coco loco without alcohol to whoever comes here they the best here! food so good and bathtubs are so nice…!

reviews.author: Climber05582270985
reviews.title: Incredible Caribbean getaway
reviews.text: Amazing food and service!  Loved every restaurant and the employees were always helpful and welcoming.  The beach and pool are beautiful and inviting, plus the rooms are clean and very nice.  Walk up pool rooms are perfect for a private dip in pool

reviews.author: 305sallieg
reviews.title: A Great Time to Visit
reviews.text: It was my first trip to the DR. I loved the resort. Very open to the sea breeze. Lots of variety on restaurants. Entertainment every night. The rooms were spacious and comfortable. We were assigned our very own assistant who we could contact at any time. Great service throughout. Very relaxing trip!

reviews.author: sherylb921
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: The Melia Paradisus is amazing.  We had a beautiful view from our room, the beach is expansive and breathtaking!  We have come here many times and it has always been great.  The food was great and I love being able to have breakfast and lunch right at the beach.

reviews.author: nyy58
reviews.title: Review November 13-21
reviews.text: There were two things that I’d like to mention. First of all, we were there a whole week and requested several times to get wash cloths to our room and each request never got done except one day. We literally showered the whole week using towels to wash ourselves. We cannot understand why we could not get a washcloth. Something doesn’t add up. Sounds like a complaint, but we really feel that it was something not out of the ordinary to ask for wash cloths for the showers. Also, we were in building 20 and we put up with screaming young people at 2 o’clock in the morning, at least four nights. They had no regard for people like us who wanted to go to sleep. I know you cannot control that to a point, but it was a sticking pointthat may stop us from coming back. We may look more into an older resort.  That may stop us from coming back. We may look more into an older resort, for 55 and older people maybe. Overall, we loved being there and it is top-notch, but those two things stand out.

reviews.author: Daiane P
reviews.title: Lua de mel no paraíso
reviews.text:
O resort é incrível, o The reserve vale muito a pena. A comida é excelente, tudo muito limpo e organizado.
 Gustavo de Jesus fez um trabalho maravilhoso conosco. 
Gustavo restaurante sante ótimo atendimento.
Rafael na praia, tudo perfeito.

reviews.author: Nicolas O
reviews.title: Hermosas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Eriol....te agradecemos mucho tu atención....muy predispuesto ....
Espero que el año que biene nos encontremos.
Abrazo  Mario el papá de Nicolas.Le agradesco.mucho a todos los equipos que me han brindado un servicio extraordinario y especialmente mi concierge Eriol .muchas gracias por todo.

.

reviews.author: Sandy T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was outstanding. The resort is stunning, the beach is beautiful, the staff are delightful, food and entertainment were great, the room was beautifully appointed, spacious and airy. Special shout outs to Bernalis and the team at Sante, Harry Milor for his attentive service and friendship, Martin for making every day at the beach perfect. From start to finish it was a perfect holiday, and being in The Reserve was such a worthwhile luxury.

reviews.author: Nicolás O
reviews.title: Lindas vacaciones en familia
reviews.text:
La estadía fue muy buena, arrancó con un pequeño inconveniente con la habitación pero se solucionó muy rápido. 

La atención es excelente de todos, especialmente del concierge nuestro Eriol que este año fue un lujo. Estuvo siempre presente y atento a todas nuestras necesidades.

Desde 2018 elegimos este hotel y vamos a seguir viniendo.

reviews.author: NATALIA C
reviews.title: Hotel perfeito em tudo
reviews.text: Hotel impecável. Tivemos uma experiência perfeita, Franklyn nos recepcionou muito bem, tirou todas nossas dúvidas, e nos orientou em tudo. Ótimas opções de restaurantes e comidas. Na praia a água é uma delícia e eles limpam todos os dias.

reviews.author: Bruna Donadi F
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Hotel excelente, atendimento impecável e super receptivos. Franklyn nos acompanhou nesses dias e fez com que tivéssemos a melhor experiência possível. Oferecem passeios e a comida é maravilhosa também. Super indico para as férias ou com amigos.

reviews.author: Josephine
reviews.title: Beautiful beaches and great staff
reviews.text:
We had a great time at this resort. The food was mostly good. It took us a couple days to figure out our favourite spots to eat. The beach is beautiful! Probably my favourite beaches of any of our stays in the Dominican Republic. We never had a problem finding a spot near the beach or any of the pool. It was also very close to the airport and downtown Punta Cana. We took an Uber downtown one day and had a great time! The vibe is more of a relaxed vibe which we loved! 
We stayed on the reserve side which is adults only. When you stay there you are assigned a concierge. We were assigned Eriol and he was so great! He checked in with us multiple times a day and was able to help us with anything we needed. He played a big part in how great our stay was. He definitely went above and beyond. The next time we return we will be asking for Eriol again!

reviews.author: Elizabeth T
reviews.title: Mina Bar
reviews.text: We very much enjoyed our vacation at the Paradisus this trip. Maria in the bar is very friendly and efficient, she makes a wonderful martini which is hard to find at any resort. Thank you Maria! Gracias Bonita! Frank is funny and extremely courteous to all his guests. Judy Judy Judy is lovely and always ready with a big smile! How does she remember all our names? We will be back again for sure!

reviews.author: La Belen n
reviews.title: Martin de playas
reviews.text: Martin de playas es el mejor. Nos brindó un servicio excepcional desde el primer dia. Nos ha tratado fenomenal y siempre se ha ocupado de que tengamos nuestras hamacas listas y preparadas para nuestro disfrute. Todos los dias nos las reservaba y preparaba para que no tuviéramos que ocuparnos de nada

reviews.author: Lisa H
reviews.title: Amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real Adult Reserve
reviews.text: We are on our last day of our stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. We went to the Reserve Adult Only side of the resort where we were treated like absolute royalty! We had a personal concierge named Franklyn and he made sure our every request was met and more! Unlimited mini bar, snacks, ice on demand, and wine at our room upon our arrival were some of the many perks we received. We would 100% recommend this resort, and if you go, ask for Franklyn!

reviews.author: Eduardo R
reviews.title: Amazing Brunch!
reviews.text:
5-Star Experience at Kana Restaurant!

Idelka and Storming provided exceptional service during brunch. Their attentiveness, kindness, and willingness to go above and beyond made our experience truly unforgettable.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Punta Cana! I'll definitely return on my next visit.

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. The room was comfortable and always clean. My husband and I visited the coffee shop(Ginger) and we were treated very special. Our barista was Samaria and she prepared the best Cappuccinos and “Morir soñando” drinks we ever had. Big thanks to Jose, Raymundo and Jairo for outstanding service.

reviews.author: Violeta E
reviews.title: Excelente servicio en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
La atención por parte de todo el personal es muy amable, dentro del hotel hay muchas actividades por hacer, la limpieza en habites y areas es muy buena y los restaurantes todos muy ricos. La atención por parte de Franklyn es muy buena!!!
No duden en agendar sus vacaciones en este lugar.

reviews.author: Sara G
reviews.title: Paradise to rest
reviews.text:
The Hotel is Fantastic, food is overall great in taste and variety and a beautiful wine selection for Red circle members. The Winery staff is super friendly and gave great advice. Thank you Starlin for the Service at Flora, even if it was super busy he did great.
Our Concierge, Eriol, went out of his way to make us feel comfortable. Wonderful Service!!!
Proposed activities are not the so typical, so quite refreshing experience
Super clean, comfy bed and bathroom.
If I can give some feedback for improvement: something in the balcony for drying your swimsuit would be appreciated.

reviews.author: anamaor
reviews.title: Rum republic
reviews.text:
El mejor trato que hemos recibido ha sido por parte de Maria y Luis de Rum Republic!!!! 
Sin duda son los mejores
Nos trataron fenomenal desde el primer momento que llegamos!!! Siempre recomendando las mejores opciones
Volveremos solo por sus famosos tragos con horchata🩷

reviews.author: Robert K E
reviews.title: Punta Cana Review
reviews.text: Jholfry and Brandol were two of the activity staff members at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. They made my wife and I experience wonderful the entire week. Their energy and personalities kept everyone in good spirit and made us feel at home. The Palma Real is fortunate to have Jholfry and Brandol on staff!

reviews.author: Michele Massimino

reviews.text: Maria and Jose at Rum Republic make the most delicious fantastic drinks at the resort! They were both fantastic and super friendly as well! Every drink we tried at this bar was carefully and freshly made. It was so nice to sit here and chat with the two of them as well.

reviews.author: Cynthia D
reviews.title: Vacation couple
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel.  Kind people.  Great Italian food at Mascalzone.  Workers are so friendly and nice!! Hotel exceeded our expectations. The specialty restaurants are extremely good.  We are foodies.   Rooms are large clean and spacious. Will come back.

reviews.author: Emma G
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Excellent service in blue agave! The staff was phenomenal and warm! Laura and Alexander Bryan were excellent!!!!!!!!! The food had great Taste! They went out of their way to help set up a birthday suprise with great detail and attentation!

reviews.author: Tina M
reviews.title: 10 out of 10 experience
reviews.text: We had the absolute best time at the Paradisus Palma.  The weather was gorgeous, the resort was clean, modern and well maintained.  The food was delicious and variety was amazing!   The activities offered by the resort allowed for both rest/relaxation as well as fun and  enriching experiences.  But the absolute best part of the week was the staff.  They went above and beyond to make our experience top notch.  Every staff we interacted with worked with a smile on their face, hoping that they could do whatever it takes to make our week wonderful.  Special shout out to some of the best:  Milton, Frank, and Louis.  We will definitely return!

reviews.author: Jessie B
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Thank you to my butler Franklyn for making it possible to check in and out with ease! Also Franklyn sent the daily activities which is so useful. I loved the variety of pools and places to relax. I recommend the reserve section of Palma Real resort.

reviews.author: Madeline S

We were treated like royalty everone was great. Vitrudes our server and Santos are who to ask for. They offer excellent customer service and the food is delisioso!!!!

Cannot say enough Praise for this Resort. from the front Sales office ,Restaurants,Pool Staff,

will be planning to go back Early Summer 2025

reviews.author: Alexia C
reviews.title: Beautiful setting for a wedding!

Special shout out to Carlos and Wily on the front desk who were so helpful with every query we had!

reviews.author: Yadairy F
reviews.title: Muy satisfecha
reviews.text: El hotel es precioso, los restaurantes y la playa espectaculares. Nos alojamos en la parte exclusiva The reserve y la verdad que merece mucho la pena, hay un restaurante exclusivo para esa zona se llama Sante y mi fue lo mejor, junto al servicio y cuidado especial de Eriol nuestro concierge personalizado que estuvo muy atento todo el tiempo, el día antes de la salida estuvimos de excursión todo el día y al regresar nos tenía preparado el jacuzzi, lo amé! Muchas gracias Paradisus por hacer de nuestras vacaciones una experiencia memorable! Ya queremos volver 🤗

reviews.author: siriusmills
reviews.title: Ron and Lorraine's stay
reviews.text: It was a great experience and stay. My wife and I have stayed at Paradisus before in another area but the Palma Real was beautiful and we had a fun time during our short stay with friends.

reviews.author: Susanne R
reviews.title: Relax at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the Paradisus Palma Real. The staff was very friendly, the accommodation were very spacious, clean and had beautiful decor and the food was excellent. Cristian, our concierge was very kind  and attentive and made sure we had a pleasant stay! I can highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Lauren R
reviews.title: Honeymoon to remember!
reviews.text: This by far was the best resort we’ve stayed at!!! The food was amazing, the staff was friendly and helpful and the excursion had plenty of fun adventures to offer. I personally want to thank our concierge Adriel Cabrera he made this a honeymoon to remember thank you!!!

reviews.author: Aullon
reviews.title: Cena de luna de miel
reviews.text: Fantastico servicio y mejor comida. La camarera ha sido excelente. Rápido y de mucha calidad. Sin duda repetiré y recomendaré.!!!!mi pareja y yo, recién casados quedamos encantados…servicio rápido y amable.no han tardado nada en servir la comida. Grandes profesionales

reviews.author: lucia06751
reviews.title: Experiencia maravillosa
reviews.text: Trato fantástico por parte de la camarera, estuvo en todo momento muy atenta y muy amable.  No tardaron nada en servir la comida .   La comida estuvo riquísima! Este sitio tiene a grandes profesionales que se preocupan por si todo está en orden.

reviews.author: Andres B
reviews.title: Excelente disposicion del personal para hacer de tu estadia un momento grato.
reviews.text: Me encanto la disposicion de atencion y preocupacion de las personas… en todo momento se preocupan por ewcuchar que es lo que realmente puede lograr que tu experiencia sea la mejor posible. Se nota un tremendo trabajo en la seleccion y real preocupacion por lograr el mejor estandar de calidad y retorno de lo invertido. Un muy buen lugar para descanzar y regalonear con la belleza del entorno trabajado a full en cada detalle. Felicitaciones

reviews.author: Abby V
reviews.title: Excellent experience!
reviews.text: All the staff members were excellent and attentive! They made our event very special and memorable for our guests. The resort has great food with even better views.🌴 I would definitely recommend this resort for a vacation or a place to hold conferences or events.

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: Paradisus in Paradise.
reviews.text:
Such an amazing resort and experience. From a foodie aspect it was well worth it. I highly recommend upgrading to the reserve rooms, if it’s an adult trip. The adults only side of the resort is spectacular. Sante is a restaurant for the upgraded adult side of the resort. Same with the reserve beach area and bars.

Our concierge Emmanuel Nosotro was an amazing blessing. We were unaware of this before checking in. After we met Emmanuel we wanted for not as he took care of everything. Every morning he sent the event schedule for the day and every night as what the next days reservations were and booked them according. From fishing to the the ladies wanting to go to shopping her handled everything, above expectation. 

This was our first time here but not our last. The staff, the food, the location, the beauty of the resort, and on and on, made it worth the flight from California to here. Can’t wait to return, already planning the trip.

reviews.author: Victoria H
reviews.title: Muchas gracias Antonio  and Team from Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: My vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort was wonderful! We were well received by all and appreciate Antonio’s help so much! He was always so happy to help get our transportation reservations sorted out and always with a smile!

reviews.author: Traveler321
reviews.title: Couples and Birthday
reviews.text: El resort es expectacular y el trato de la gente es excelente. Los restaurantes, la comida, las facilidades todo es de buen trato y muy buena calidad. Especialmente quiero darle las gracias a Antonio, del concierge, fue excelente y un trato como nunca, estaba pendiente a todo, que no faltara nada, ayudo con las reservaciones y todas las acomodaciones. Definitivamente Antonio es un empleado estrella en el Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Worth Every Penny
reviews.text: This was probably the best vacation e we have ever had. The staff was very accommodating. Clean clean clean. Amazing. Spend the extra and come here. Food was excellent. Drinks impeccable. Felix at the Hibachi restaurant was a true entertainer. Can’t say enough about this place. We will be back.

reviews.author: Juan David F
reviews.title: Be on paradise
reviews.text: Everything was amazin. The People, support... the room very nice. A great place to be for a wonderful trip. We enojoy a lot with my wife our honey moon, the hotel provided us such a nice decoration with wine, cheese. Romantic place to be! The food was incredible and the beach fantastic!

reviews.author: Philipp K
reviews.title: Restaurant Mascalzone
reviews.text: Schönes italienisches Restaurant, welches im All-Inclusive Palet inbegriffen ist. Wir hatten Caprese Salat und Muscheln zu Vorspeise sowie Pizza und Nudeln zur Hauptspeise. Der Geschmack war hervorragend. Leider waren wir bereits satt und es hat kein Dessert mehr herein gepasst. Dieses sah aber bei anderen Gästen sehr gut aus. Unser Kellner Raider hat uns toll und aufmerksam durch den Abend begleitet, sodass es uns an nichts gemangelt hat. Auch sein Supervisor Milton hat sich vorgestellt und sich um uns gekümmert. Insgesamt: Hervorragender Service! :-)

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Incredible experience and an incredible service!
reviews.text:
We had a great time at Paradisus Palma Real! The staff is amazing and didn't leave us needing anything. Particularlg Anyela from the reception she was soooo helpful and always checked in and ensured that we are having a great experience. There is so much to do there, there was a fun show every night, suitable for individuals and families. Restaurants were great and the food was so clean! Definitely recommend and definitely will come back here soon ! 

Special shout out to Anyela for everything you have done for me and my family ! :)

reviews.author: Jason C
reviews.title: Amazing Angela at Paradissus Palma
reviews.text:
Arrived Monday night. Checked in at front desk. Had a very smooth check in process with Angela. Special shout out to Angela who went above and beyond to take care of me. She made sure to check in everyday, stock the fridge, refresh supplies in the room and best of all check in with me and see if I'm OK. 

Gracias Angela you are amazing at your job! I can't wait to come back to Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Carinette B
reviews.title: Quelles belles vacances!!!
reviews.text:
Superbe hôtel , service A1 et mentions spécial à Wander au resto de plage KANNU ainsi qu’au Mina . Nous avons été reçu comme la famille , avons même eu droit à des leçons d’espagnol . Cette hôtel porte bien  son nom , Paradisus!!!!

Le seule critère que j’aurai à dire , système de réservation pour les restos à la carte , en 2024 et avec la prestance de cet hôtel , ça ne devrait plus exister .

reviews.author: Daydream28598059637
reviews.title: Paradisius palma real
reviews.text: Excellent service par Wander👌🏻le service est excellent, la nourriture est tout aussi excellente.  Attentionné, à l’écoute et avec une petit cours d’espagnol en bonus.  L’hôtel est magnifique.  Le site est vraiment propre et magnifique

reviews.author: Meritxell C
reviews.title: Muy buena experiencia servicio y comida de 10
reviews.text: Increíble experiencia. John y Milton muy buen servicio en el restaurante Sante. John Briant satisfació nuestras necesidades en recepción. Hotel 5* como merece. Repetiremos seguro, grata experiencia y sin duda lo recomendamos a cualquier persona que venga

reviews.author: chema
reviews.title: El mejor hotel del Caribe, sin duda.
reviews.text: Sin duda el mejor hotel del Caribe. Habitaciones impecables, la comida, excelente, servicio de limpieza espectacular. Atención del personal, maravillosa. La playa, muy limpia. Spa impecable.  Y el conserje, Basilio, muy atento y eficiente.

reviews.author: Perry w
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Franscheka was an amazing server at our dinner and Flora!!! She was very kind and fun and gave lots of tips. The atmosphere was beautiful and all the staff was very friendly. The food was great and the bar was quick!! The trees and the artwork were inspiring and drinks were never ending!

reviews.author: Maria Catalina E
reviews.title: Experiencia con niños celiacos
reviews.text:
Fuimos en familia y eramos un grupo de 16 personas.
Dos niñas del grupo eran celiacas ( no podian comer gluten), tuvimos que cambiarnos desde el melia caribe, ya que no habia menu gluten free y en ese hotel no nos entendian lo que solicitabamos. 
El paradisus tampoco contaba con alimentos etiquetados en el buffet, sin embargo, aqui nos recibio la chef Nieves, quien nos ayudó y nos orientó en todo momento, estuvo disponible durante todas las comidas del dia toda la semana, nos preparó comida y postres aparte,  hizo que para las niñas y para todo el grupo la estadía fuera agradable, sin ella habria sido todo muy dificil.

reviews.author: Stony P
reviews.title: Tokimeku Restaurant
reviews.text: Kelvin Chef #7 y Fanni in Tokimeku was very entertaining and fun. The food was delicious and very enjoyable with the great attentive service. The seasoning in the food was tasty and what I attribute to Japanese tappenyaki *spellchecker help me. Thanks Gracias!

reviews.author: Iraida Isabel A
reviews.title: Satisfacción
reviews.text: Excelente servicio!! Gracias a Adriel Cabrera (de Reseve), Reynaldo el Capitán de restaurantes, y a Jayson (del bar de la piscina de Reserve), por sus magníficas atenciones, nos hicieron sentir tanto a mi como a mi familia, como en casa!! Intensamente agradecida por el buen trato que nos brindaron! El hotel es excelente!

reviews.author: Karl B
reviews.title: Phenomenal couple getaway in Punta Cana
reviews.text: The room and the amenities were fantastic. The food was top-notch. Everything was very well appointed our swim out room had a fantastic welcome surprise platter and wine with stocked fridge every day, and our wonderful concierge made all the difference and arranged everything our hearts desired. If you're going ask for Cristian he was simply phenomenal. he contacted us every morning and often throughout the day to let us know if the days activities ask if we had any other needs or request and replied in a very timely manner he was simply the guy you want on such a holiday.

reviews.author: Julio D
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia muy buena. Felicidades a Thomas por un muy buen trabajo. Siempre será nuestro Concierge en THE RESERVE . El hotel está muy limpio y las áreas muy limpias. Una experiencia especial para nosotros que venimos de cumpleaños

reviews.author: Oliver K
reviews.title: Fantastic family holiday
reviews.text: This was our 8th time that we stayed at one of the Paradisus hotels in Punta Cana. The Paradisus Palma Real is an incredibly beautiful hotel with spacious and modern rooms, many different restaurants, a variety of pools and entertainment, and a great beach. Our swim-up suite was fantastic, so were food and drinks. A special thank you to our concierge Ariel Benzo, who fulfilled all our wishes during our stay. A big thank you also to Yafreisy and Vanessa from the Lunch Box, Raul from the beach and Edi and Santa from Brisas. Not to forget Virginia, who we’ve known for years now, and Dayhani, who we met for the first time in 2022. We’ll definitely come back, as we feel at home in these beautiful Paradisus resorts.

reviews.author: Vincent K
reviews.title: Thank you very much for a great vacations
reviews.text: It great a great experience! Good quality variety of foods, nice beaches and clean place.  Our concierge Basalio was extremely helpful and always went extra miles to get things done for us. He was very friendly and excellent help to get. reviews.author: Benjamin G
reviews.title: Superó las expectativas, pero si hay algunos detalles a mejorar!
reviews.text: En general fue una excelente experiencia. Fuimos con mi Sra e hija de 1 año y medio. El hotel es tal cual como se ve en las fotos, espectacular y nos sorprendió lo limpio en todos los sectores. La habitacion tipo dpto con 2 ambientes es excelente para 3 o más personas ya que te permite una mejor logística con niños.

reviews.author: Sophia Sanabria
reviews.title: ANIVERSARIO EN EL PARAÍSO❤️‍🔥
reviews.text:
Mi novio y yo estuvimos de aniversario celebrando cinco años y decidimos ir a la parte THE RESERVE, esta sección del hotel solo para adultos incluye un concierge, en nuestro caso fue Zenovia, quien nos acompañó durante todo el proceso con reservas, ideas y sorpresas a la habotación que agregaron muchos momentos especiales a este fin de semana. 

Estuvimos en Mascalzone la primera noche con las atenciones de Reynalda y Fausto, nos encantó que tuvimos acceso (todos) a un menú especial por una chef, además todo estaba muy delicioso. La segunda noche fuimos a Blue Agave, wow la mejor spicy margarita con Ruby en el bar. Esa noche hubo música en vivo por el Día de los Muertos, fue espectácular y los tacos al pastor fueron nuestros favs. 

El domingo por primera vez tuvimos una mañana de spa en pareja y fue en YHI, wow que experiencia tan increíble, lo hicimos en una cabina en conjunto y a ambos nos encantó, estuvimos en otro universo por esos 50 minutos de masaje. 

Y finalmente fuimos a Flora a cenar esa noche, que orgullosa me siento que además de las clásicas cocinas que se encuentran, también hay una con nuestros sabores de la mano del chef Leandro Díaz.

Estuvimos en la playa y varias de las piscina, tanto del Rwserve como generales. 

Las atenciones no las cambio por nada, me hicieron sentir siempre en casa y con mucho cariño. La pase bien, comi muy rico, tomé cócteles con licor premium y fui muy feliz. 

Sophia Sanabria❤️‍🔥

reviews.author: Bez B
reviews.title: Lovely time in the Dom Rep
reviews.text: Reilyn, Kevin and Fauri were very attentive and helpful at our visit to Malva. The buffet was delicious 😋 and all of the restaurants so far have impressed us. The resort was quiet and still had plenty of staff. Thank you PARADISUS we will return one day.

reviews.author: Stephanie W
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real beautiful location
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The facility was beautiful, clean and the staff was outstanding. reviews.author: Kristin K
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Our trip was amazing. Our concierge Eolis was wonderful. We loved being there. We enjoyed everything and had a wonderful time. Our room was beautiful. The property was beautiful. The food was great. The entertainment was wonderful. The staff were helpful.

reviews.author: Brulance
reviews.title: Paradise for Real
reviews.text: It's my second time here, alongside my wife, after 10 years. The revamp a couple years ago definitely improved Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed at the adult-only sector called "The Reserve", which indeed imparts more privacy and quietness. Unlike the previous time, we went all in and stayed beach front (full sea view): in other words, that meant we had a private deck that took us right to the beach (that's the ground floor, guess it's out of luck and availability one gets those). Service-wise, it was on point and shout-out to our private concierge Eriol (included in this product tier offering) who made sure all our needs had been addressed throughout the stay,  and Adriel who helped cover in our last 2 days. Food in general is good, and the Dominican people make it taste better with their kindness and joie de vivre.

reviews.author: rodrigoaltro
reviews.title: Excelente resort para lua de mel
reviews.text:
Viemos em viagem de lua de mel. Hotel muito bonito e bem cosnervador. Quarto muito confortavel, ficamos na suite swin up The Reserve. Todos os funcionarios foram gentis, nosso concierge Adriel foi muito solícito e atencioso, nos recebendo e providenciando tudo para o nosso conforto.
Hotel calmo, perfeito para relaxar e passar Lua de Mel. Fomos aos restaurantes Santé (exclusivo para The Reserve), Blue Agave, Asian food (esqueci o nome) e Flora o qual foi nosso preferido.

reviews.author: Alexis R
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: Mis vacaciones en palma real fueron inolvidables de la mano de Adriel que hizo que esas vacaciones sean perfectas con mucha atención a los detalles, el servicio por parte de los empleados excepcional Luis del sport bar y Luis del bar Celsius súper buena personas, la comida con mucha calidad.

reviews.title: Experiencia espectacular

Tiene muchos restaurantes, piscinas y casi en su totalidad, una vista sensacional a la playa y el mar. Es para destacar la atención del personal. reviews.author: Angie V
reviews.title: Check out the concierge - Francisco!

Daniel was also the most fun addition to our trip! On top of that, this has to be the best resort I have ever been to!

reviews.author: Nicolas A
reviews.title: EXCELENTE ESTADIA
reviews.text: Fui del 8 al 22 de Octubre de 2024. En líneas generales un hotel de primerísimo nivel. Es un hotel tranquilo en líneas generales. Poco y nada de animación y  los shows nocturnos son en general pequeños numeros musicales temprano y ya... Habitaciones modernas, silenciosas y limpias. Me tocó una perfectamente ubicada en el edificio 10 pegado a la playa. Colchón y almohadas cómodas. Secador de pelo y plancha de vapor para la ropa. Servicio de frigobar perfecto, completo y sin problemas. Si hay algo que agregar o pedir se pidió por teléfono y respondieron a la brevedad. Buen aire acondicionado. Detalle de color de la habitación: el baño no tiene puerta principal para acceder al mismo (solo una cortina). Luego una vez en el baño están separados el duchador (con su puerta) y el inodoro (con su puerta) y la insonorización no es la mejor. Lo que quiero decir es que si estás en la cama acostado escuchás todo lo que pasa en el baño (calculo que me entienden a qué apunto). El servicio estuvo bien, los camareros atentos y siempre dispuestos aunque durante mi estadía el hotel estuvo entre 15 y 20% de ocupación solamente. La calidad de la comida excelente. Los restaurantes temáticos con ambientes algo fríos (no de temperatura sino de calidez ambiental). Rescato atención de Misael en restaurante Santé. Las piscinas bien, salvo que en la piscina principal hay varios hidro masajes y estaban todos fuera de servicio. La playa excelente, casi nada de sargazo... aunque el agua no tan transparente como algunos hoteles cercanos. En la playa rescato la atención de Vanesa, super atenta. Servicio de recepción excelente. Nuestro concierge fue Juan Castillo de quien tambíen rescato su atención. Un día antes de mi partida había coordinado la busqueda del equipaje juntamente con el concierge y un tal Emanuel y nunca nos vienieron a buscar las valijas, lo cual generó una tensión en los ultimos minutos de la estadía ya que el traslado se iba y tardaron en mandar maleteros. Descartado esto, todo ok.

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Another relaxing and enjoyable vacation
reviews.text:
My wife and I are Club Melia members and we try to visit Punta Cana as much as possible. We enjoy the warm weather, white sandy beaches and aqua blue ocean water. While we have stayed and had good experiences at most of the Melia properties in the Dominican Republic in the past, this time we stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for the past week. 

This is a very nice resort that was recently remodeled with nice and updated amenities (pools, spa, gym, etc). We found it to have good food and high quality service. In particular we received great service and friendship from all of the staff that we interacted with. The employees that stood out during our stay include Raul Jimenez (Farenheit/Circle Pool Bar) and Teofio (Celsius Pool Bar) who both served us drinks during our daily visits to the beach. When we were not at the beach, we enjoyed lounging by the pool located near our room and received high level service from both Erickson and Julia at the 36 degrees pool bar. Ismael and the rest of the staff at the Ginger Signature Bar in the main lobby were very helpful and made good drinks, whether it was in the morning for coffee and smoothies or the afternoon/evening for cocktails and refreshments. When we ate breakfast, lunch and sometimes dinner at the two buffets, we had great interactions and received good service from Frankie, Juan, Bronxin, Rosanna and Yanira at the Lunch Box Buffet as well as Tomas at the Malva (Adults Only) Buffet. It was also always a pleasure to interact with Gerrado at the Lunch Box Buffet Omelette Station every morning during breakfast. There are also several restaurants available for dinner and we appreciated the service by Melina at Flora (Dominican Food) & Kelvyn at the Mina Steakhouse. My wife and I also enjoyed a massage at the Yhi Spa with Gladys Dominguez who provided a relaxing and professional service in a nice & clean atmosphere.

Overall, we had a relaxing, fun and pleasurable vacation. We will definitely be back in the future!

reviews.author: DEOMaisonet
reviews.title: Excelente escapada
reviews.text: Una corta vacación. Muy complacidos con servicio.  Ariel fue nuestro mayordomo y hizo todo lo posible para coordinar y hacer de nuestra estadía una sin preocupaciones. Wander y Evelio en el área de los restaurantes. Jeyson y Martin en el área de playa y piscina. A todos gracias!!!

reviews.author: Ivette L
reviews.title: Memorable Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
The resort is absolutely beautiful!!

FLORA - Sterling was our server ... He was so much more, though. He explained the menu, made recommendations and took the order. Everything came exactly as ordered and as delicious as described. He was super personable, caring and respectful; definitely an asset to that team. 

SANTE - Barnelis, Manual, Fany, Luz .. these beautiful people took care of us for breakfast and lunch (we kept coming back again and again because of the service and attention to detail). It was a great menu -- the octopus, sancocho, shrimp salad WOW - DELICIOUS! Maria made a mean piña colada!!

BKUE AGAVE - Alquenio took care of us and he was amazing. What a great personality! The food was delicious 

The ladies at the spa were fantastic! My husband got a massage -- Fiora most certainly made sure he was relaxed and totally in heaven.

At the pool (the Circle) Vanessa cared for us. Everyday she knew exactly what our drinks would be -- Caipiroska, Maracuyá, Sauvignon Blanc.

Our hats off to our concierge JUAN CASTILLO!! Kuddos for a great job of keeping us entertained, taking care of our needs, putting together a great birthday celebration and for making us feel like the only guests he was taking care of. 

It was a beautiful vacation, one which we hope to repeat next year.

Harry  made sure we had everything we needed and more.

It was such a great mix of relaxation and adventure.

Thank you to the whole team, especially Harry  for making our stay unforgettable. We'll definitely be back soon!. 

Caroline

reviews.author: Rafael A
reviews.title: Paseo en familia inolvidable
reviews.text:
La recreación de los niños muy buenas y divertidas. martha y alexandra muy amorosas con los niños. Realmente mi hija lo disfruto mucho. Son diferentes actividades todos los dias, todas con mucho amor y cariño! 
Muchas gracias!!  Realmente maravilloso

reviews.author: Nony M
reviews.title: Island Paradise
reviews.text: We had a an amazing time here at Paradisus Palma Real. The property is extremely beautiful and the service was top notch. Our concierge, Gustavo, was knowledgeable, attentive, and personable. He went the extra mile to ensure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. We will DEFINITELY be back!

reviews.author: Mario A
reviews.title: Excelente lugar para vacacionar.
reviews.text: Estamos mas que agradecidos con Antonio por la ayuda y atención que en todo momento fue excepcional. ☺️ En general el personal, el hotel, todo es excelente. Definitivamente volveremos pronto. Si buscas pasarla increíble tienes que visitarlos. Nos vamos enamorados de este lugar.

reviews.author: ERIC A
reviews.title: Punta Cana 2024 Getaway
reviews.text: Great trip all around. The room was nice, weather was great, and the staff was very accommodating. We would like to thank Adriel our concierge for providing us with everything we needed. He helped us from beginning to end. He met us upon arrival and helped us all along our trip setting up our Spa Day, food reservations, etc. until he helped get us into our car for our return trip. We also want to thank Enriquillo for showing us the benefits of the Circle.

reviews.author: Victoria P
reviews.title: Excelente atención.
reviews.text:
El hotel espectacular, la atención aún más, son todos muy amables.
Festejé mi cumpleaños en el hotel y el conserje Basilio organizó todo de manera excelente, siempre estuvo pendiente de cada cosita que necesitábamos, muy atento! 
También disfrutamos de la playa con mi esposo y la atención de Pedro fue magnífica. Gracias infinitas por este viaje inolvidable a todos.

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones
reviews.text: Todo el hotel espectacular. Pero lo MEJOR fue el KidsDom, donde mis hijos jugaron felices y habían muchas actividades para distraerlos y yo poder disfrutar de las vacaciones (JANILDA es una maravilla, muy dulce y los entretiene con amor) Estuvimos todos felices.

reviews.author: chiefnomadwrites
reviews.title: Chief Nomad Talks
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is a beautiful facility with excellent services and very courteous staff

reviews.author: Adriana B
reviews.title: Good resort Palma Real
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio 
Teofilo y Mikita han sido excelente en la playa 
Nos tenían las toallas listas en las sillas frente al mar en primera fila apenas llegábamos de desayunar. Super pendientes de que si necesitábamos alguna bebida .  La gente en general muy amables

reviews.author: Rafael G
reviews.title: We really enjoyed Paradisus and all the crews
reviews.text: My wife and I went to the Paradisus in 2019 it was impressive but in this 2024 we wanted to return to this beautiful place, we were 8 days and 7 nights it was all wonderful starting with the welcome they gave us when we arrived at The reserves, our concierge Cristian Gonzalez was super friendly and super attentive to us and very respectful, He was always attentive to us, i would like to add that on friday we went to an activities from the hotel in which me and my wife pay for some pictures at the Island that we went but never received the pictures fron the private company and we asked Cristian Gonzalez to help us with that and he got me all the pictures, i just want to say thank you Cristian Gonzalez, thanks to the manager Juan Carlos who takes his time to answer us all, the truth is that the treatment they gave us pushes us to save more money to return to the Paradisus Palma Real where we feel at home. Shalom hugs family, thank you

reviews.author: ANGELICA E
reviews.title: Servicio a la playa
reviews.text:
Pasamos unos días increíbles, con un Excelente servicio de Teófilo en atención a la playa, super atento y amable. 
Nos ha engreído mucho 🍾🍾🍾 
Hemos disfrutado mucho nuestro estadía aquí en PUNTA CANA!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Cristian V
reviews.title: Atención impecable!!
reviews.text:
Servicio Premium 
El Sr Reinaldo atención impecable junto con  el manejo del CHEF Orlando  hacen un equipo de EXCELENCIA restáurate MINA,los platos estuvieron a la altura de un restaurante cincos estrellas mundial 
Gracias 🙏🏽 volveré 🇩🇴

reviews.author: laseray
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text: We had a really great time  mostly because the staff was so attentive. In particular Franklyn our personal concierge .  Always helping us plan each day's activity.  Had a great week golfing and relaxing.  Also Angela upgraded our room having some up patio.  It is off season and it felt  like we had the place to look our selves

reviews.author: Diego M
reviews.title: Gracias grupo Paradisus by Melia
reviews.text:
La. Verdad que me adelanto a la opinión …..aunque  todavia   Estoy en el hotel; realmente el
Servicio es de excelencia en todos los sentidos..., atención al cliente .... Gastronomía ..... resolución de inconvenientes (obvio menores ); el restaurante italiano con Jesicca y Milton a la orden en casa detalle …. Continuará …….

reviews.author: Kripa S
reviews.title: Amazing views, relaxing vibe, great resort!
reviews.text: This resort is amazing.  It's beautiful, accessible, and the staff is incredible.  We started our trip checking in with Anyela, who gave us the best room when we did an upgrade to a swim-up room (highly recommend) the patio leads directly to a large swimming pool, with super easy access to the beach.  She was friendly, professional, explained everything and seriously gave us the best room!  We had a large pool almost entirely to ourselves, and used it every day.  The restaurants are tasty, there's day and night activities, and just all-around relaxing beautiful scenery.  Highly recommend this for relaxing, unwinding, and de-stressing!

reviews.author: nancy w
reviews.title: Amazing Concierge
reviews.text: The resort it self is amazing the staff tops all staff that I have ever seen or being a part of. Our concierge Ariel  Benzo has made this vacation/honeymoon as amazing as our wedding. Anything we needed to know he was there, any questions he was able to answer as soon as we send the message. He set up every dinner each night I love the resort and I love Ariel Benzo.

reviews.author: Margarita C
reviews.title: Home again with my Melia Family!
reviews.text: We just returned from a week’s vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. This was a return visit for us. We stayed on the adults only Reserva section. Our concierge Zenovia greeted us with open arms, “welcome back family.”This is the hardest working woman I have met. She absolutely took care of everything for us (dinner reservations, special requests and constantly checking in with us). In her few days off Christian took over. What an amazing young man. He did an amazing job on fulfilling our requests. Also, the Reserva side has an inclusive restaurant for us Sante. All of the staff there (breakfast, lunch & dinner) were so professional and kind. They recognized us from last year. The a la carte restaurants were fabulous, some better than others but we definitely noticed some big changes in food items. Now the beach service..what can I say a true paradise. From the beach beds yes I said beds to the butler service. The staff that I must mention are Raphael, Pedro and Martin and also the bartender (forgot his name). You want luxury and top service book Reserva. These men worked tirelessly all day without a flinch. Always smiling and constantly refilling drinks which they remember by heart. Their kindness is next to none. Also treated myself to a massage and all I can say is Gladys you have some magic hands! Best massage ever! This is definitely my go to vacation spot. Thank you for the perfect vacation it takes a team effort to make a whole experience happen. Hasta luego till next year!

reviews.author: rgood1215
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
Overall the resort was beautiful and you are well taken care of! The only thing I would say negative: 

Venders constantly coming up to you on the beach to sell you something. This was frustrating. 

The food hurt my stomach due to the use of soybean oils/seed oils! I suggested the resort move to a more natural oil to fry/cook their food on the feedback survey I was sent!

reviews.author: amaross2024
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: Really friendly and accommodating staff. Lovely setup in rooms. Quiet time of year so peaceful and relaxing.

reviews.author: jazzmdix
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: My family and I visited The Paradisus late September and had a fantastic time. The resort, the food and the staff are amazing. This resort is definitely one we can come visit again and again! I only wish the beds were bigger. 😂

reviews.author: Rhonda H
reviews.title: It was AMAZING!
reviews.text: It was amazing!  Emmanuel Villa and Kelvin Fernandez treated us like family!  They were pleasant and professional.  I didn’t have to worry about anything.  They took care of dinner reservations and greeted us by name.  There were others, Santos, Felix, Cesar, and Melvin also made quite the impression.  I will definitely visit again and recommend Paradisus Palma  Real to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Sherry W
reviews.title: Awesome Resort🌴🌴🌴
reviews.text: Omg !! Don’t have enough words to express how Emanuel made me  my friends feel so Special from the arrival until the departure was very knowledgeable and very informative along with awesome ideas for our daily activities 🙌🏾🙌🏾💕💕 Emanuel is a great asset to the Team 🙌🏾

reviews.author: nicole a
reviews.title: Punta Cana, DR
reviews.text: The views were astonishing. Lovely customer service, we were treated very well by the workers. Lots of variety in food and restaurants. Many different activities included like yoga, gym, Djs by the pool, live music, and more. We really enjoyed this resort.

reviews.author: Francisco Gonzalez
reviews.title: Maravilloso!
reviews.text:
Gran experiencia con la atención de Kelvin el mejor Concierge se los recomiendo ampliamente, siempre muy atento a nosotros y cuido cada detalle de la habitación, agradezco cada uno de los detalles.

En la comida el chef Cristian, Santos, Joselo, Rafael siempre nos recibieron de la mejor forma, y nos consentían con la comida más deliciosa, motivándonos a regresar todo el tiempo y a Luz por atendernos siempre.

También quiero agradecer por la atención de Carlos Ozuna, Cristopher, Antonio Manzueta con una maravillosa atención en recepción ayudándonos con cada detalle para poder reservar unas noches más.

Las instalaciones son excelentes, desde el lobby, los restaurantes, las tiendas, las albercas, las habitaciones son excelentes!

También muchas gracias por una increíble atención de parte de Rafa que nos asistió en la playa, que nos mantuvo hidratados.

 Muchas gracias definitivamente lo recordaremos ampliamente

reviews.author: Micman55
reviews.title: Très satisfaite de cette hôtel
reviews.text: Nous avons été au Paradisus début septembre, une période basse alors l'hôtel était pas très occupé, c'était très tranquille, pour nous c'était vraiment parfait, on avait du service, pas besoin de réservé des chaises a la plage, on pouvais arrivé a n'importe quel heure de la journée on avais du choix... c'est l'avantage d'y aller en saison basse. la plage était nettoyer a tout les matins, il avait un peu d'algue mais rien pour nous empêcher de nous baigner, il a fait super beau et chaud. les chambres sont grandes et jolie, un style colonial, très confortable et propre, air climatisé fonctionnais très bien. le site est très vaste en largeur, tout est  pas trop loin, belle grandeur, j'étais dans la section adulte the reserve, très bon service de mon concierge qui parlait en plus en français. Pour les restaurants à la carte nous les avons tous adoré, le santé étais vraiment délicieux. Une petite critique, A mon avis un restaurant de plus ça serais mieux. Le buffet du matin et du midi une belle vérité et très bon. Le restaurant santé pour le déjeuner et diner on peux manger à la carte aussi, c'est très bon. Beaucoup de choix de piscine et de belle dimension. Un site tranquille, on a beaucoup apprécier! Le personnelle très gentil et souriant. Nous sommes très content d'avoir fait le choix d'aller au Paradisus Palma Real

reviews.author: Richalice99
reviews.title: Salvaged our honeymoon… thank you staff at palma!
reviews.text:
We had an unfortunate circumstance which forced us to move hotels from another, and we were moved to Paradisus Palma Real. 

To put it briefly… they saved our holiday (honeymoon)! They salvaged what was an eventful few days at the hotel prior to this one. 

Every staff member we walked past would say hello / good morning regardless of their job role. 

We had Antonio as a concierge who was fab, helping us book our restaurants and helping us in general. 

We didn’t leave our daughter at the kids club, but we done some activities with her - Alexandra was lovely and welcoming. 

We were in the deluxe block 3, and the lady (sorry, forgot her name) who served drinks by the swim up pools was so lovely. Always asking us / bringing us drinks and in general, a nice person. 

Reception staff were so helpful with our situation and gave us a really good impression. 

Even thought we had a dispute with the hotel chain themselves, we would return to this hotel as it was just fantastic. 

Pools / beach are amazing. 
I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Eric R
reviews.title: Amazing and unforgettable experience!
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful place, but you will know that by just looking at the pictures online. What left us really impressed was the superb and incredibly nice staff and service all-around. The staff was so incredible that I even remember the names of the ones that provided us with the best service we have ever seen. Thank you very much Edisson, Broxni, Yanira, Rosanna, Yafreisy and Santos. You all truly made it an amazing experience. We will be back soon!!

reviews.author: Astrid Z
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia para vacacionar en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Una experiencia Maravillosa!!

Una  excelente atención por parte de todo el personal! Quiero agradecer al Sr Santos, Cristian , Joselo, Milton, que hicieron nuestros desayunos, comidas y cenas las más amenas con una atención espectacular siempre recibiéndonos con una sonrisa, motivándonos a regresar todo el tiempo, a Kelvin que fue nuestro mayordomo que siempre estuvo al pendiente de nosotros, a Carlos Ozuna y Cristopher que nos ayudaron y nos guiaron para hacer otra reserva  y nos asistieron de la forma más paciente y amable 🫶🏻 

Es un hotel en el cual se siente uno relajado y consentido por todo el entorno, el personal y la comida, sin duda planeo regresar y recomendarlo ampliamente! 
Muchas gracias 🙏🏻 😃

reviews.author: Rodolfo H
reviews.title: Muy buen resort pero no es PET friendly como anuncian
reviews.text:
El resort para personas muy bien.
Recepción con José es de lo mejor que he visto, el resto del personal bueno.
En el restaurante Flor Andrea fue excelente dando recomendaciones y siendo muy amable con nuestra mascota.
Para el cumpleaños de mi esposa José hizo un arreglo excelente ya que no podíamos visitar los restaurantes por tener perrita. Jorge y Alberto de banquetes Meliá hicieron de esa noche algo inolvidable. Juan en la Winery preparó una cena en la terraza que cerró nuestra visita con broche de oro. Todos los nombrados merecen ser reconocidos por atención muy superior incluso al estándar 
Nuestra decepción fue con la indicación de PET friendly. A pesar de haber estado indicado el peso  9Kg la mascota en la reservación el kit trajo una cama para perros de máximo 3 Kg de peso. La lata de comida cada día había qu reclamarla. Por US $ 90 por noche es un abuso. 
Volveríamos cuando podamos viajar sin mascota.

reviews.author: Tempora C
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Me encanto todo de este hotel. Es un hotel excelente para la familia, la comida es deliciosa y nos gusto todo. 

Excelente el servicio de Rosanna, Hilda y Yanira en el buffet. También en la noche un joven llamado luis Rodríguez nos atendió súper. 

Gracias a todos

reviews.author: Omil G
reviews.title: Perfect!!
reviews.text: Perfect!! Muy buena experiencia, excelente servicio al cliente, muy atentos y capacitados, gran variedad de restaurantes y la comida excelente. Las diferentes areas siempre limpias, varias piscinas y excelentes areas de recreacion.

reviews.author: Sunilda C
reviews.title: Nos encantó el hotel
reviews.text: Amamos este hotel, es súper cómodo y exclusivo. La comida es deliciosa y puedes descansar, bailar y comer rico. La atención de samaria en lobby bar fue muy buena. Así también de Luis en el restaurante Mina. Excelente servicio. El personal de maletas también fue muy amable y nos ayudó en todo

reviews.author: Sightsee62890085761
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Nos quedamos en ese hermoso complejo por el cumpleaños de mi primo, la verdad el trato fue espectacular partiendo desde el check in hasta los demás servicios, como la limpieza en las habitaciones servicio de minibar y room service siempre atentos, especialmente Joel Valerio. Nuestro concierge Emmanuel siempre atento a muestras solicitudes, nos facilita todos de vrd la experiencia no fuera la misma si su servicio, el el restaurante mina nos celebraron el cumpleaños el staff muy amable. De vrd vamos a regresar. Lo recomienda cualquiera.

reviews.author: Bethany L
reviews.title: Great honeymoon!
reviews.text: We just returned from a 5 night stay at the resort! We did not do the melia/circle rewards, and based on what i saw it wouldnt have made a difference. I did a lot of research before we booked our trip and everything was great! The food at the restaurants was really good, the menus aren't super big/have too many options but every meal was delicious. There are multiple bars in the evening and during the day, the buffet was good but I'm also not a picky eater, my husband wasn't as pleased. The beach club had great lunch options though so it was fine! There are a few activities at night and during the day, but not a whole evening of activities in one place (show style) if that makes sense. Going on excursions was easy and flawless with getting transportation and feeling safe off the resort. The room service and housekeeping were on point, not to mention the full bar that was restocked daily. We would definitely go back.

reviews.author: ANJ
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: We had a issue with our room but Carlos Noel saved the day! He was very helpful and made sure we were taken care of and our room fixed. He was very kind and saved our vacation! If you have any issues please ask for Carlos because he will do everything he can to help. The resort was absolutely beautiful btw

reviews.author: Fran C
reviews.title: Perfecto!
reviews.text: Muy rico el hotel! Lo justo para descansar y pasarlo bien. El servicio muy bueno también. Nosotros tuvimos a Eriol de concierge y su preocupación y detalles realmente hacen la diferencia. Volveríamos 1.000 veces más con niños y solos. Ambiente para todos!

reviews.author: juliadsummey
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: My husband and I had the most wonderful time. The staff and our concierge were amazing!  We are very excited for our next trip to this resort!

reviews.author: Nomad774002
reviews.title: Ferien
reviews.text: Sehr gepflegte Hotelanlage und das personal ust sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Kann dieses hotel nur weiterempfehlen.

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text:
We first came here on an RCI trade and we loved it so much we bought in. I was skeptical about all inclusive resorts but never on e have I ever felt that there was ever any compromise on the facilities, the food, drink, service or entertainment. It is all outstanding and we are proud to bring friends and family here. The people are charming, friendly and professional. We feel particularly safe here and the other guests are also courteous and friendly.
This trip we have had 2 out of 2 great dining experiences. We loved the restaurant Sante- and Elvis, the sommelier helped us pick outstanding wines which he decanted at our table. The next night was at Flora and we really enjoyed the outstanding Dominican cuisine. Upon being seated they brought us appetizers- even before we ordered any. For mains we had short rib and a flavorful steak dish I can neither remember or pronounce. The short rib was the best I ever tasted. The steak was amazing as well- it had peppers, onions and chopped jalepeno with it. Our sommelier also decanted  our wine for us. They brought a tray full of desserts over after dinner. We weren’t rushed at all and after dinner we were so happy we called the manager, Eduardo over so we could tell him how satisfied we were with the food and the service that we received frim Francesca and her team!  Thanks Paradisius Palma Real! What an operation here!

reviews.author: laurie
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text:
The beach was beautiful and well maintained. There was always security around—we felt very safe. 
The service was exemplary. Our butler Zenobia was exceptional. Our days at the beach were steeped in luxury with the mindfulness and great courtesy and attentiveness by so many of their staff. Martin (a true treasure!) and Gilberto the bartender at the Reserve beach. There were obviously some staff still learning how to excel at anticipating guests needs but with these experts and the work of Andre (waiter for beach exp) Jean Carlos (beach club waiter/bartender) and YuisMairy (lovely champagne girl outside Malva) I know the others will get up to snuff in no time! 
The food at certain restaurants was quite delicious and well presented. The lobster and salmon were done very well. The reserve restaurant was lacking in service and taste. Room service breakfast was the best and always on time. 
Even with the cons this is a wonderful resort. We were already discussing returning next year!

reviews.author: Héctor Reynoso
reviews.title: Lo mejor del Caribe...lejos
reviews.text:
Hace 25 años que voy siempre a República Dominicana, y me alojo en los hoteles todo incluido de la cadena Melia.
En este cuarto de siglo, han construido nuevos hoteles, y este es el mejor de todos.
Garantía asegurada.
El All inclusive, es de los mejores del Caribe.
Con los años fuimos mejorando la membresía, actualmente pertenecemos a fundadores del hotel Circle, actualmente, Gran Cana, donde se cuida cada detalle.
En resumen, el Paraíso en su máximo nivel...

reviews.author: Francesco Crescimanno
reviews.title: Impecable visita al paraíso dominicano
reviews.text:
Hemos estado recientemente allí durante 9 noches y la experiencia ha sido magnífica. Desde el momento en el que llegas te reciben con una sonrisa y hacen todo lo posible por hacerte sentir bienvenido y mimado.

Destacamos la limpieza de la habitación, la calidad de la oferta de A&B (nos gustaron especialmente Blue Agave, Mascalzone y Mina), la calidez del servicio, las increíbles instalaciones de las que disponen…

A destacar el servicio ofrecido por los camareros Alex, Broxni y Milton (entre muchos), Vicmar en recepción y Nessatiel, quien se encargó de nuestras vacaciones cuidando cada detalle👏🏼☺️

Durante esta época, suele ser temporada baja y se notó bastante en el hotel, convirtiéndolo aún más en un oasis de paz y tranquilidad. A pesar de ser época ciclónica, tuvimos un tiempo soleado a diario.

Recomendaría una y otra vez este resort tanto para grupos de amigos, como parejas o familias, ya que se adaptan a todas las necesidades. ¡Esperamos volver a visitaros nuevamente muy pronto!

reviews.author: Celita Welsch
reviews.title: Inolvidable. un resort  perfecto
reviews.text:
Ya conocía este resort y con mi marido regresé. Me di cuenta de que la hermosa playa, el mar azul y tranquilo del Caribe, los numerosos restaurantes con tantas opciones, los vinos, las bebidas y la comodidad de los apartamentos, especialmente con vistas al mar, sin duda me harán volver por más.
El complejo cuenta con un servicio de transporte de ida y vuelta desde el aeropuerto de Punta Cana.
Somos bien recibidos por el gerente, que nos ayuda todos los días, hace reservas para algunos restaurantes, pero no en todos requieren reserva y todos son maravillosos. Me encantaron todos y la comida estaba muy bien presentada.
Para mí lo más importante es la gente que nos atiende, los camareros. Recordaré el cariño, la cortesía, que me impresionó mucho de muchos de ellos, mencionaré principalmente el Restaurante Sante, cuyo variado buffet sirve todas las comidas, estilo buffet con muchas variedades. Ellos son: Juan Domingo, Laura Batista, Alejandro González, Héctor Abreu Juan Alcántara, Misael, Yuleini, Yesica y Domingo. Nunca los olvidaré por su cortesía, cordialidad, sonrisas y aunque hay otros, los guardo en mi corazón.

reviews.author: clasch1971
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones - Sol a tope
reviews.text:
Hemos disfrutado el Paradisus Palma Real de inicio a fin, desde que llegamos nos han atendido muy bien, estamos en temporada baja pero todo ha funcionado sin inconvenientes. El clima excepcional, sol todos los dias y altas temperaturas, el agua de las piscinas y del mar a 32 grados celsius.
La comida variada en el desayuno, almuerzo y restaurantes de especialidad, solo mejorar el buffet de la noche que era pequeño y sin la variedad del almuerzo. Tambien desayunamos un par de dias en el restaurante de adultos en la Reserva, mas tranquilo y climatizado, muy bien. Mas pequeño pero personalizado, menos congestionado.
De los restaurantes los mejores en calidad el Italiano mascalzzone y el Mina de carnes. El teppanyaki entretenido por el show del chef. El mas debil no siendo malo, el mexicano. Tambien esta el dominicano flora solo adultos que tiene comida tipica muy buena.
Hicimos el taller de pizzas, muy entretenido. Tenias también actividades diarias en la piscina.
Los bares bien surtidos en marcas y de buena calidad. Especial reconocimiento a Julia del bar de las piscinas de las habitaciones y a Wanda del bar de la Reserva adultos. Siempre diligentes y con una alegría contagiosa. En la playa de adultos Gilberto y Pedro.
En general ha mejorado harto la atención del Palma Real (es nuestra 5ta visita), se preocupan de ti y muy atentos desde el check in hasta la salida.
No fue tema las reposeras ni las toallas ya que habian de sobra y siempre disponibles asi que nada de estar levantandose a las 6:00 para asegurar un lugar. El tener muchas pisicinas ayuda. 
Es un hotel tranquilo, elegante, ordenado, con sus jardines bien tenidos. Ideal para descansar en pareja o en familia ya que tienen espacios para todos. 
Felicitaciones a todo el personal y a la dirección que le han dado una especial orientación hacia los huéspedes.
La relacion precio calidad excelente, sobretodo para nosotros que somos melia rewards, buenas ofertas.
Con seguridad volveremos pronto.

reviews.author: Franklin R
reviews.title: El Restaurante Mina es el mejor de Palma Real
reviews.text:
Wander es un camarero espectacular que celebro mi cumpleaños y muy buena persona 

El restaurante Mina es un lugar Maravilloso el menú infantil me encantó  y  a mis padres las carnes

Es un lugar bonito y todo lo que comimos estaba delicioso 

Alfonso Reyes cumpleañero 10 años

This review is for the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  It is very long on purpose.  I could not find any of this information when I was researching my trip, so I’m hoping this will provide some assistance to others in their research.

Overall:

It was a very quiet resort with not too many crowds during our stay.  We never had any issue finding a place to sit by the pool or beach.  The food was good. Otherwise, the service was overall outstanding with just a few minor hiccups.  We had a concierge who was amazing, Harry Milor.  I can’t say enough great things about Harry.
