reviews.author: Ray C
reviews.title: ParadisusPalma Real
reviews.text:
**First and foremost, Punta Cana in August is hot. The sun is intense, and the humidity is high.**

**As for the resort, we stayed in a Nitke 2-Bedroom Master Suite with Swim-Up access, which the kids absolutely loved. The rooms were spacious, clean, and well-maintained, with daily housekeeping and nightly turndown service. The minibar was restocked every day.**

**The resort is right on the beach and easily accessible, though it is on the smaller side. While there was some seaweed, staff were diligent in cleaning it up daily with specialized equipment.**

**Our room included concierge service, but here’s a word of caution: Make sure you know who your assigned concierge is. Some staff might falsely claim to be your personal concierge, with the ulterior motive of steering you towards a timeshare presentation (Circle Club). Unfortunately, this happened to us. A supposed concierge offered to make dinner reservations but didn’t know the process and led us to the reservation desk instead—definitely a red flag. He also tried to entice us with a ‘VIP gift,’ which turned out to be an attempt to lure us into a timeshare pitch. After we declined, he ghosted us for the remainder of our stay. Thankfully, the next day, Emanuel, our actual assigned concierge, found us and introduced himself.**

**Emanuel was fantastic, promptly explaining his services, such as arranging daily dinner reservations, providing a schedule of activities, and checking in with us regularly to ensure everything was okay. He even went above and beyond when we mentioned my wife’s iPhone wouldn’t charge via the port. Emanuel offered to find a MagSafe charger off-site since the resort store didn’t have one. He tracked one down, sent us photos, and confirmed the price before proceeding. Although we didn’t purchase it in the end, I really appreciated his effort. Emanuel's level of service was exceptional, and future guests will be lucky to have him.**

**Regarding food, our first night was disappointing. The resort hosted an outdoor buffet in the main square, but the food was cold and unappetizing. The buffet was small with limited options, but thankfully, the lunchbox buffet, which had been under renovation, reopened during our stay, and the food there was significantly better. The restaurants available for bookings were decent, and if you didn’t enjoy your meal, you could always head to the buffet for a second dinner.**

**A few pieces of advice:**

1. **Bring smaller denominations for tips, as the main desk often didn’t have change.**
2. **Tip the restaurant staff and your real concierge.**
3. **Tip your housekeeper and the person restocking your minibar.**
4. **Bring alternative charging options for your phone.**

Our master concierge, Wolfan, took care of us like we were his own family, maybe even better.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: AT
reviews.title: Exceeded All Expectations
reviews.text:
The resort exceeded all of our expectations across the board. Great impressions right from the start with shuttle bus service from the airport. Check in was made that much better by the beautiful welcome area at the front with drinks upon arrival. 

Resort: better than the pictures on the website.  The ocean colour was an incredible blue. The beach is pristine with great little tiki huts that never seemed to busy. Good pool options for when you needed a break from the beach. Somehow it never seemed to get too busy despite being there during March break. Lots of places to set up on beach or near pools with plenty of towels. The restaurants are all located in the main square (piazza?), with a great social vibe around dinner time. Its a great area to just stroll after dinner, and for the children to explore and still be very safe. We found the service to be very good and staff really made an effort to serve or help us however they could. 

Room: We upgraded our room to Master Suite deluxe and to  get concierge at check in. It was absolutely worth it for the view alone. We were one of the closer units to the beach and very close to everything (unit 10 I think) - it's a relatively big resort so it would have been a different experience if we were further back from beach. Concierge was worth it for the reservations alone. Our guy was very helpful when we needed him, and was really important in getting us in some of the more popular restaurants. Rooms were clean and very spacious. 

Food: we found the food options to be excellent. The main buffet  is " the lunch box" has everything you'd ever want for breakfast and lunch. We found the quality to be very good and a lot of options to cater to the family. We had some fantastic dinners over the course of the week - most memorable were the steakhouse (Mina) and Mexican restaurante (Blue Agave) - servers were excellent at both. You definitely have to be organized to make reservations at the good restaurants. Timing was important to us as we had 2 young children so having the concierge manage that process for us was very useful. 

Staff: we found the staff at the resort to be excellent and very accommodating. They were eager to please and always very helpful. When we were locked out of our room, they were quick to respond to fix the issues with the door. The staff at the Lunch Box buffet were very kind and welcoming to our family. We had an infant with us and they ensured we were provided with everything we needed. 

Other feedback: The Circle club is a bit of a strange one. We witnessed a lot of beautiful space reserved for Circle members, but nobody was ever using it. The one criticism we have of the concierge service was they seemed to be evaluated based on  getting us to agree to hear the Circle club pitch. We told them many times we had no interest but it seems they are pressured by their boss to get us to agree no matter how much we explained it was not something that was practical for us to sit through with 2 young children (both adults must attend). This was definitely frustrating and somewhat insulting when you just want to be on vacation. When we did end up sitting through it, the salesman made the mistake of talking directly only to me ( the husband) when he should have been talking to the decision maker (my wife).  There is a restaurant in the main area that is not accessible to families which was empty most of the time we were there, but with the best location on the resort beside the pool and closest to the beach - seems like a missed opportunity. 

Overall: we looked at every one of the main all inclusive resorts suitable for families, and were very particular in what we wanted. Some of the reviews across all of the resorts seemed to be critical of the same things, and we came here with somewhat low expectations. We were very pleasantly surprised at what we discovered and would go back for sure. On the first day we said "what we are we going to do here for 7 days"? and looked into some 1/2 day excursions or activities. After 7 days of not leaving the resort at all (and booking nothing), we had answered our question of what we would do for the week - relax. We were able to totally unplug and relax and returned home well rested.

reviews.author: donnaschmonna
reviews.title: Really wonderful vacation spot
reviews.text: Our family of 13 picked Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for our yearly vacation.  (We had been going to the Atlantis for last 20 years.).  We are all in agreement that this vacation was fantastic and exceeded all our expectations!  Rooms are beautiful, clean and spacious. Food was great. Room service 24 hours  Cocktails delicious and not watered down or made with cheap stuff. We did not have to worry about the local water and getting sick. We didn’t drink it as there was bottled water whenever we wanted it.   The dinner reservations needed at the places other than buffet were tricky first 2 days - you need to make your reservation for following night’s dinner very early (7-8 AM) previous day if you have anyone under 18 in your party.  Otherwise if you are in Adults only, I was told you can ask for a private concierge to make all your reservations during your stay.  If your booking includes any spa credit or room upgrade credit, you must get these coupons when you check in.  Also if you have free transportation to and from airport, you need to email Otium (transportation company) to reserve your rides. They were great with responding to my emails. Casino is off this property at another Paradisus and is very very small if you compare to others like Atlantis.  Other than the normal “figuring out a new place”, this Paradisus was a really terrific vacation and value!

reviews.author: D S
reviews.title: Exceptional Luxury Vacation
reviews.text:
My daughter and I recently returned from Paradisus Palma Real Playa. The only way to explain our experience is extraordinary. I seriously don’t know where to begin. We’ve stayed in an all-inclusive resort once before Punta Cana before and multiple all-inclusive resorts in other locations. Without-a-doubt, Paradisus  is by far the best! In fact, it’s so ahead other that’s it’s not even comparable. 
First and foremost, pay more for The Reserve because it’s worth it. We were assigned a concierge at check in. Her name was Zenovia and saw to our every want and need- simply amazing. She made reservations for our dinners, and sent us daily activities, made necessary arrangements, and even brought me insect repellent to our room because I had forgotten to pack it. She made our vacation like no other- wow! I have never ever experienced anything like this level of service.
When we arrived, the front desk person, Christopher, greeted us and whisked us off to a private reception area to get us checked in. We arrived really early, but he gave us champagne and told us to get some lunch and relax while our room was prepared. He was so gracious. 
The food was amazing!  I know what you are thinking at an all-inclusive- YES!. In fact, I had some of the best food I have EVER eaten! 
We had exceptional service! There were so many people that went over and above to see to us. Martin, the beach attendant, made sure we had clean towels and drinks. He was the kindest person.Literally, everyone was just so unbelievably accommodating. Every waiter, bartender, activity person, hostess, and  housekeeper was on it- no joke! Some of the names I recall are as follows: Milton,Deangelo, Gustavo… there are so many! 
Some tips for the resort, pay extra to stay in the Reserve, request Zenovia, bring cash for tips like 1 & 5s, get drinks at Ginger, have dinner at the Italian restaurant, lunch and breakfast at Sante, and buy airport transfers when you are booking your package. I didn’t do this and wish I had.
The only thing that I would have done differently was fly a different airline, but that is my own fault! 
Thank you, Paradisus, for giving us the vacation of a lifetime!

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful. All the photos you see in reviews and on the websites…believe it! Very nice and only about 20 minutes from the airport. My family of 4 (two teen boys 19, 16), my wife and I, visited just to chill and enjoy an international trip. 
Check-in was very easy (granted we arrived around 9pm). They give you a wristband that has an RF ID embedded that serves as your room key. The bellhops will take your luggage and you to your room via golf cart. Get settled and then explore the grounds and try to grab the concierge to book any dinner reservations. 
Some tips…bring money for tips, watch videos on YouTube about the resort (do’s and don’ts). Tipping helps for sure and a dollar goes a long way. Set up transportation from the airport in advance. We used Otium transportation service (approx. $60 each way). There are tons of random transportation people outside the airport that are aggressive and probably a scam. 
Go to the pool and try to grab chairs near the bar. The music vibe and people watching are great. Get familiar with your server too. Our server Makati, was very nice and attentive he also found my wife’s Yeti cup she left behind and returned it to us the next day. He knew my drink after the first order. He’s awesome! 
Oh, try to remember some of that high school Spanish. Having some Spanish vocab helps. 
Here are some of my additional thoughts. 

Accommodations:
We booked the Nikte -Two room swim up master suite. Arrived on Tuesday night, left on Saturday morning. This came with a concierge. Wily was ours, he’s very attentive and willing to do whatever you need. We really only used him for dinner reservations and a few questions. 
Concierge service was ok, can survive without if the resort is not busy. 

Resort was maybe 50% full. Got more lively later in the week. 

Bugs- not a big deal for us. Got a few mosquito bites at night. 
Room service for breakfast was our go to. Had to order at 9am or after but took about 30 minutes to get. Was nice to eat in our suite. Food was decent. Coffee was great. Having the swim up option was really nice. Just a few steps outside of your room and you’re in the pool! 

Pros:
Very friendly and helpful staff. 
Well stocked fridge (Water, Coca-cola, Perrier, el Presidente/Corona beer, etc.). 
Two bottles of Wine in-room, cheese & sausage plate, bottle of rum. 
Check-in very quick, easy. I suggest calling a few days before arriving to reconfirm your reservation and to check if there is a better rate. 
Clean rooms, great water pressure for showering and sinks. 
Access to other properties (tennis, basketball, casino, etc.). 
Grounds are clean, well maintained and beautiful - always saw people working. 
Plenty of seating available at the beach, pools and center plaza (night entertainment). 
Great drink selection at all the bars. Some higher end liquor not available for “free”. Brugal Extra Viejo Rum is an excellent option, IMO. 
WiFi was decent. Worked well the whole trip. 
Room had a beach bag for holding towels, etc. 
Decent variety of activities for all ages-some are dependent on how many people are around. 
People…everyone we talked to was great! It was fun to meet some people from all over the world. One Love!! 

Cons:
Food labeling at buffet, sometimes not properly aligned, not allergy friendly. 
Room service took 30-45 minutes to deliver 
Outdoor furniture at our suite has some stains on the cabana bed and a loose bolt on a chair that I easily fixed. 
Beach needs to be cleaned thoroughly. Lots of small pieces of garbage, plastic zip-ties, random crap. 
Pushy independent vendors on the beach - they get mad if you ignore. 
Casino - small, not very loose. Can only play table games after 5pm. Only has blackjack, roulette. 
Some activities are not well organized, wish the activity leaders would at least try to recruit. We did play volleyball and sand soccer. The guy running it was very fun! 

Food:
The Winery - (had to sit through the 20 minute vacation membership spiel to get the “upgrade”). Steak was incredible!!Maximo and Juan were outstanding servers. 
Blue Agave - pastor tacos are great, I had the enchilada mole, and it was kinda dry. 
Tokimeku - hibachi style dinner, lots of fun, food was delicious, maybe slightly rich from sauces but still a good experience. 
Celsius Pool - great service, big pool area, most people to watch/meet. 
Buffet - decent, good selection of foods. Staff very nice and attentive. 
Night Entertainment - different theme each night. Music or performances. Dominican night included some local vendors (Jewelry, Cigars, Art). Overall a nice party vibe but not overwhelming. Definitely family friendly. 

Lastly, the checkout process was easy. Bellhops picked up our luggage and took it to reception. Be sure to ask for a final printout of your bill to ensure there are no additional fees-we didn’t have any but you never know.
We loved our stay here and would definitely recommend it and would come back.

reviews.author: Monica R
reviews.title: Realmente um Paradisus em Punta Cana
reviews.text:
All inclusive em Punta Cana são muitos, mas a grande parte não pode receber nota 5. Como viajante frequente posso afirmar que a experiência no Paradisus Palma Real é completa e perfeita, como se espera de um all incluse desse padrão. O complexo foi renovado em 2022. É uma área extensa com jardins, passeios, dezenas de bares e restaurantes, várias piscinas, estrutura de praia, muitos quartos, spa, um lobby aberto e encantador,loja de conveniências e lembranças, academia completa.Tudo muito bem cuidado e pensado. Ficamos hospedados no sistema The Reserve, apenas adultos, com suítes diferenciadas, piscina,restaurante e beach club exclusivos e muito mimos diários. Um diferecial encantador foi nosso Concierge particular - Fernando Ducoudray, um rapaz alegre que tornou nossa estadia mais agradável, providenciando tudo que pedíamos e um pouco mais! Alimentação e bebidas de alto padrão e com muitas opções. A área de diversão noturna é a Plaza, lindo espaço com restaurantes de padrão internacional e bares. A praia de mar calmo e lindo conta com estrutura de cabanas, espreguiçadeiras com colchões, salva vidas e bares. No mar existe um sistema de redes para evitar que muito sargaço chegue à praia, a areia é limpa diariamente.
A suite ampla, com vários ambientes, incluindo um páteo, muito bem decorada e agradável. Muito silenciosa. Frigobar, máquina Nespresso, abastecidos diariamente tudo incluído. Robes, chinelos, toalha de praia, amenities de qualidade, steamer para passar roupa e secador de cabelos. Recomendo levar dólares em notas pequenas para as gorjetas, são bem vindas e merecidas.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus Palma Real. We really enjoyed all the different food choices that were available at each of the 9 restaurants. The hospitality was very great overall from the moment we arrived. They helped book our activities so we didn’t have to worry about anything.

reviews.author: Diana T
reviews.title: Amazing from beginning to end
reviews.text:
Everything was so great from beginning to end. Airport/hotel transfer was easy and check-in was a breeze. 
I’ve stayed at multiple Paradisus properties and this is by far the most stunning. This resort is located right on the beach & has multiple restaurants and pools for your choosing. Given that this is an all-inclusive, the food was pretty decent. My favorite was Flora. 
Felix was our concierge and he was amazing! He helped us get settled in from our first day to our last day. Checked in with us every day, made sure we had our dinner reservations, and that we had a comfortable stay through our trip. This trip was also for my birthday and he had our room decorated … it was a nice surprise after a day at the beach. Highly recommend him if you’re thinking about going.

reviews.text: This place is our home away from home and we absolutely  love being here. Our concierge has always taken excellent care of us

reviews.author: Randy C
reviews.title: A Week In Paradise
reviews.text: Staff, food, drinks, service, rooms and beach are all amazing. Christian, Yanira, Daniella and Felix all stand out as wonderful, they made the trip for us and we can't wait to go back. We had a swim out room in the Nikte section and we loved every minute of it. We highly recommend the yoga / beach experience. Bottom Line, don't listen to the negative reviews!!!!

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real like visiting home!
reviews.text:
This was not my fisrt time at Paradisus Palma Real and this stay was just as wondeful as the others. I choose to stay in the adult only section called the Reserve. My personal conceige was Basilio and he was very nice, professional and kind! When I arrived he places a bottle of wine and fruit/cheese plate in my room, which was perfect after my travel day!  And when he found out this was my birthday trip, on my birthday he placed a bottle of champagne and birthday cake in my room and decorated the room with balloons! It was a wonderful surprise! And oh yes, I popped the champagne and ate the cake and both were delicious!😁
I would definitely recommend Basilio as a concierge!

The reserve has wondeful pools but I am a beach girl and they have the best beach beds (yes I said beds) of any resort in the DR I have been too so far. And I have been to 6 different resorts!  

Wanda is the bartender at the Reserve pool area and she is amazing! She is my favorite bartender on the resort, quick to service, fun and very nice! I consider her a freind!

All the restaurants are great, the beach is one of my favorites in the DR and the resort is easy to navigate! It is one of my favorite resorts thus far!
Happy traveling!😁

reviews.author: Angela W
reviews.title: Best vacation experience
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was AMAZING. My husband and I spent 5 nights celebrating my 40th bday and the resort exceeded our expectations. Our stay was luxurious and peaceful. The staff were very kind and helpful, and our concierge, Ralphy, was top notch! He made sure we had everything we needed-dinner reservations, excursions, spa treatments, anything we needed or wanted, he made it happen! If you come to the Paradisus Palma Real, ask for Ralphy, you won't be sorry!

reviews.author: Pam W
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: We loved our vacation at Paradisus in Punta Cana.  The rooms, pools, and grounds were beautiful and well maintained.  The ocean and beach were great!  We enjoyed all the restaurants and thought the food was awesome!  We had upgraded to The Reserve and found that beneficial in that our concierge was able to make all our reservations at the restaurants at the day and time we wanted!  We had read reviews that were not favorable…after spending a week there, I have no idea why there were be any negatives!!  Just don’t forget to do a ticket- coming and going!!!

reviews.author: Mario D
reviews.title: Un autre séjour mémorable!
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné au Palma Real du 20 au 28 avril 2024.  Il s'agissait de notre sixième séjour en tant que membres du Club Melia.  Encore une fois, nous avons été très satisfaits.
Tout d'abord, nous tenons à souligner le travail exceptionnel de notre concierge Lewis De La Cruz.  Il était rapidement disponible et au moindre problème, il était en mode solution. Certainement le meilleur que nous avons eu en six visites.  Il mérite un 10/10!
Nous voulons également souligner l'excellent service de Yafreisy qui nous a accueilli avec le sourire et amabilité au petit-déjeuner et au lunch pour la majorité de notre séjour.  Nous étions d'ailleurs surpris de sa mémoire pour nos demandes des journées précédentes.  De loin la meilleure parmi toutes les personnes qui nous ont servi lors des 22 repas pris sur ce site. Merci Yafreisy!
Pour ce qui est de notre chambre, le ménage était impeccable.  Notre seul bémol: le mini-bar n'était pas rempli à tous les jours.  Mais considérant notre faible consommation, c'est mineur.
En général, les repas dans les restos étaient excellents (sauf les desserts qui étaient bien moyens) et le buffet plus que respectable.  Et il a été d'une qualité irréprochable pendant les deux jours du congrès de l'industrie touristique DATE 2024.  J'imagine qu'on voulait impressionner cette visite VIP!
Quant à l'a plage, elle était propre et le peu de sargasses était ramassé quotidiennement. À l'occasion un peu bruyant selon le degré de supervision de certains parents (...) ou encore ceux qui oublient qu'aime pas nécessairement la même musique qu'eux et au même volume.  Il nous a fallu d'ailleurs demander à une reprise au personnel d'intervenir auprès de clientes qui se croyaient dans une disco afin qu'elles baissent le volume de leur haut parleur.  Ce qui a été fait rapidement et avec efficacité.
Bref, nous avons apprécié notre séjour et nous espérons que Lewis et Yafreisy y seront pour nous accueillir à nouveau dans deux ans lors de notre prochain séjour au Paradisus Palma Real!

Danielle et Mario

reviews.author: ISABELLE L
reviews.title: Séjour mémorable
reviews.text: Nous avons eu un séjour de 2 semaines mémorables à cet hôtel qui réunit toutes les conditions pour permettre des vacances de rêves... La beauté et le raffinement sont partout ainsi que la bonté des gens.Le personnel est dès plus accueillant, souriant et attentionné. Le site est grandiose et très bien entretenu. C'est un vrai Palace qui offre une vue exceptionnelle sur la mer turquoise des Caraïbes. La  plage est magnifique et les algues sont ramassées à chaque jour. Un véritable oasis où se côtoient la tranquilité et des activités et animations variées et créatives. Les buffet est en général très bon, mais moins variés certains jours. Pour la restauration, nous avons eu un coup de coeur pour le restaurant SANTÉ qui offre une cuisine gastronomique. Ce restaurant est toutefois accessible seulement à la clientèle de la RÉSERVE (section adulte) . Si vous avez des besoins alimentaires particuliers, le personnel  vous accompagne avec une gentillesse remarquable pour y répondre. A cet égard, nous tenons à remercier du fond du coeur, Stéfanie, Jordania, Katherine, Rafaël, Gorge, Juan, Éduardo, Santo et tous les autres qui ont contribués à rendre notre séjour si agrable! Nous retournerons à cet hôtel sans hésiter!!

reviews.title: Un séjour extraordinaire !!!

reviews.author: Emmy A
reviews.title: Can’t wait to return
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing stay with family (Couple and 2 kids) can NOT wait to go back. Staff is attentive, beach is gorgeous- no seaweed when we went. We did not feel like we had to rush for a spot on the beach. With the littles we rented the beach beds- very reasonably priced.  We did stay in the swim up suit and it’s so worth it especially with the kids. The grounds are not huge but big enough that you feel spread out. Food was good. I mean it’s an all inclusive resort it’s not going to be the highlight. Our butler was ok. Room- modern, clean, staff came by 2x a day to tidy up. My husband set up a beautiful dinner by the beach I’ll never forget. Overall book it if you are considering it. NOW this is not a party hotel. There is entertainment but not like in the huge resorts. So if you are looking for that- this isn’t it.

reviews.author: Mara C
reviews.title: Picture Perfect Relaxing Experience
reviews.text:
Picture perfect.
The Reserve is beautifully situated close to all amenities.( pools, bars,beach,private restaurant , spa…)
The grounds are pristine and are constantly manicured and cleaned .
A very quiet stress free location and facility.
Food  was excellent at the reserve and the Restaurants ( the main buffet lacked fresh salads and was not the best I have experienced but certainly adequate)
Our room was lovely , well stocked and 
spotless. 
Our concierge , Tomas , was attentive,available and helpful.
The welcome wine and charcuterie he delivered upon arrival and on our last evening was a very nice touch .
The friendly staff made this a 
Wonderful Experience !
We will most definitely return.
P.S. Don’t pay attention to the forecast,
Rain clouds appear and disappear quickly . A quick shower and the sun pops out !

reviews.author: Emma C
reviews.title: Relaxing and memorable stay

He answered all of our questions in a timely manner and helped us book restaurants. Overall it was a lovely week in paradise!

reviews.title: Beautiful resort

reviews.author: tristansofficial
reviews.title: Most amazing vacation
reviews.text: First and foremost, Paradisus has an exceptional staff. No request is taken as a burden or with an attitude. The team constantly was working hard, and somehow you’d familiarize yourself with most of the ginormous numbered staff. Through all hours of the night or day, they were there to accommodate any need we had. The room was unreal. Super clean, beautiful, and constantly stocked with fresh water, snacks, and beer with each cleaning service. You could not imagine a more friendly staff!

reviews.author: Givanni A
reviews.title: Paradise at it's finest!!
reviews.text: This trip was a yearly excursion for my company. About 80 employees attended and we had a phenomenal time. The resort is beautiful to say the least. Very clean, comfortable and accommodating. All our needs were met thanks to our amazing, responsive and attentive concierge Adriel. Adriel's customer service was top tier. We will definitely be revisiting.

reviews.author: liketotvl
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Paradisus Real Palma! The staff and service were exceptional, the food was great and the swim-out pool room in The Reserve was perfect. Our personal concierge, Irvin, made sure that everything ran smoothly and was always available to book dinner reservations and activities. The rooms were clean, the restaurant/bars were welcoming, and the lobby and layout were perfect for relaxing. The beach and pools were also clean and well-maintained. The staff and service were outstanding from arrival to departure. I highly recommend Paradisus Real Palma and can't wait to return!

On reviendra.

Nuestra experiencia en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real fue increíble, desde el comienzo hasta el final, estamos muy agradecidos especialmente con el chef ejecutivo Cristian Díaz, quien ayudó a convertir nuestra luna de miel en algo extraordinario, agradecemos a Cristian y a todo su equipo de colaboradores y esperamos poder visitar en conjunto con nuestros padres próximamente para compartir con ellos nuestra experiencia magnifica que tuvimos, esperamos volver a ver al chef cristian para que nuestros familiares vivan la experiencia tan maravillosa de la cual fuimos parte.

reviews.author: Matt M
reviews.title: Clean, great staff, beautiful, good food
reviews.text:
We booked through Costco Travel, along with two other families. I highly recommend this method. 

We had two concierge’s serving our group of 4 rooms. They were Ariel and Willy. Both were absolutely amazing!  Ariel would message me every morning with the event schedule of the day, so we always knew what we could participate in. The guys also made our dinner and excursion reservations for our group, which made this a hassle free vacation. They even arranged bag pick-up when it was time to leave. 

The resort itself is beautiful. We had the Nikte Swim Up Master Suite. It was worth the upgrade price. Our teen son slept on the pull-out in the living room and we had a king bed in the master.  

The entire staff was very friendly and there was constant upkeep being done. It was not distracting, just an observation. The entire property and buildings were spotless at all times. 

The buffet food was typical for breakfast. They cater to many cultures, so the variety is excellent. We only had one evening dinner there, but it was excellent and included fresh lobster tail. 

The other restaurants were excellent!  We were there. Week, so we tried everything. Great service at all. My favorite was the steak house and Jesus, our server. 

The resort is quite large, yet did not feel crowded. It was a mix of young families up to older couples. There were quite a few young children, but there are adult only areas if you do not want to day-drink around the pool with kids around. Note that the drinking age is 18 there, so you might see young adults with a drink. We did not witness any out of control partying though. 

We had 4 teenage (hs seniors) in our group and 3 dads who golfed multiple times. It was a very easy shuttle on the property to get to the clubhouse. Friendly staff at the course. The course itself is beautiful, but the greens are not great. If you are a very serious golfer, go with an open mind and be prepared for a few terrible greens.  Also, the course has a mix of family homes and mini vacation complexes on it. There are people constantly walking the cart path (more so on the weekends). 

Bring lots of tip money!  $1, $2, $5 get used a lot!!  If we were sitting poolside for a long period, we just tipped the servers big  ($20-$50) to start and then didn’t worry the rest of the day. 

Overall, we had a great time with friends and the resort was wonderful. Would definitely recommend and we plan to visit again.

reviews.author: charles-O s
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT !
reviews.text:
Great resort and so easy access Vs other resort in the Bavaro Area. 
We stayed at THE Reserve. rooms are nice and well furnished. We had 2 rooms side by side.  
No running in the morning to grad a chair or a palapa. Beach butler Pedro is just fantastic. Gave him our needs on day # 1 and every following day we had our palapa, towels. He would recognize us and call us by our names. Perfect set-up. Makes a big differences being in the Reserve - Adults only section Vs Normal section. I strongly recommend The Reserve area. 
 
My only constructive comment is in ref to the Food: the signage on the buffets ie. Santé or The lunch Box (main buffet) lacked of what the food items are. We have 2 allergic people (peanuts and fish) in the family so it was a challenge at these locations to find out the name of the food item. Many of the buffet stations  where missing service spoons for each food item to serve yourself properly. Ex: The Grazzie Station /Charcuterie board: people would take the folk from the salmon plater to get some ham and or other charcuterie, cheeses etc. I asked several times during the week to get additional cutlery to not contaminate.  All the hotels of this level have proper food signage and each item it's own food tong.  
Easily corrected if the F&B supervisor would just go around and check the buffet before the doors open.

reviews.author: Lidia H
reviews.title: Experiencia espectacular pero mejorable
reviews.text: Venir a Paradisus ha sido una experiencia maravillosa, aunque también se puede decir que mejorable. La comida muy rica, especialmente en los restaurantes Mina y Sante. Sin embargo el italiano Mascalzone y el mexicano Blue Agave dejan algo que desear… Por último, el restaurante Malva directamente no puedo opinar porque fuimos a cenar y no nos quisieron atender porque no tenían gente y no estaban por la labor. La chica que nos limpia la habitación es un encanto y nos la deja siempre perfecta. Luego hay una chica que trabaja en el chiringuito llamado 90 grados que se llama Rosanna Aquino y es la mejor de todos, te atiende que es una delicia y siempre tiene conversación para darte. De hecho vengo expresamente para pasarme un rato con ella😊  Y para finalizar, los que te atienden en la playa son muy simpáticos pero demasiado listos. Te ocupan las camas de la primera fila para “guardártelas” pero realmente te quitan la posibilidad de que lo hagas tú y así se llevan su propina de manera sucia, para mi gusto. Las instalaciones están muy bien, para que negarlo, y el personal en general muy agradable pero si tienes un problema te vas igual que viniste. Te ponen buena cara, te tratan bien, te hacen reír y parece que te van a solucionar el problema pero nada de eso. Llamémoslo ritmo dominicano… La conclusión es que volvería, pero con todo este aprendizaje en mente😂 Me lo he pasado divinamente y desde luego que he desconectado🥰

reviews.author: MattConway900

reviews.text:
This place is truly amazing, located right on the beach, which means you step out and you're on the sand. Every meal we had was delicious, with a great variety of choices that made each dining experience something to look forward to. The staff, without exception, were attentive and friendly, always going out of their way to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable.

A special shoutout to our personal concierge, Alvaro. He was just fantastic. From the moment we arrived, he was always checking in with us, making sure we had everything we needed. Whether it was restaurant recommendations, booking tours, or just ensuring our room had all the comforts, Alvaro was on it. He really made our stay stress-free and personalized. Evening entertainment was good. Our concierge Adriel was amazing. Checked in regularly, helped us settle in, got all our reservations, made sure our trip was enjoyable down to replacing our hairdryer for us.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Charie K
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
The name speaks for itself, the resort really felt like paradise! My husband and I are so happy we chose to stay at Paradisus Palma Real for my birthday week vacation, specifically in the Reserve, adults only area.

Booking this gave us the pleasure of working with our personal concierge, Zenovia — she guaranteed we had dinner reservations every night at different restaurants (which is a must), readily answered any of our questions, helped us with all our transportation needs, and made my birthday extra special with all the surprises she had up her sleeve. We can’t thank her enough for the amazing and most stress-free stay! ❤️

Additionally, the room we booked was beautiful and cleaned everyday. Most of the restaurants were exceptional especially considering that this is an all-inclusive resort, our favorites being Sante (only for Reserve), Mina, Flora, and the Winery. All the staff we had a pleasure of meeting were all great. The services we got at Blue Agave on 03/20 (I believe our server’s name was Jorge) and at the Winery on 03/22 were amazing — shoutout to our servers! Shoutout also to Adrian in the swim up bar for making my delicious drinks and giving great service.

All in all, the stay was super worth it and we’re hoping to come back again in the future. In the meantime, we highly recommend this place 1000%.

reviews.author: 123govacation
reviews.title: Best Resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
I travel extensively and have been to Punta Cana many times to 5 star resorts. This resort exceeded my expectations and is by far the best hotel I have stayed at in the Caribbean. The food is unbelievably good which I’ve never experienced at previous resorts. The grounds and room are immaculate. The service is exceptional. The beach is absolutely beautiful !
A big thank you to Adriel who went above and beyond to make our stay the best ever!

reviews.author: Kevin A
reviews.title: Que buen trato de parte de Emilio José bastardo.
reviews.text: Los servicios excelentes, pero lo que más me llamó la atención fue que incluso el compañero de mantenimiento Emilio José bastardo muy educado la verdad y un trato estaba perdido y me ayudó súper servicial. A pesar de que el es de mantenimiento y no le correspondía ayudarme me ayudó y me llevó hasta el GYM para que no me perdiera hablaba conmigo y muy respetuoso me encantó si trato.

reviews.author: Jorge Carrara
reviews.title: Volveré a la brevedad
reviews.text:
Excelente atención en general 
Bien el sector culinario y muy variado
El concierge Starlin Tavarez, fue un guía insustituible en toda nuestra estadía, con sugerencias y realizando tramites administrativos difíciles para el viajero.
Sin dudas un lugar para disfrutar.

reviews.author: Donna T
reviews.title: Our New Favorite Spot!
reviews.text: While staying at Paradisus Gran Cana, we dined at The Winery at Paradisus Palma Real.  What a wonderful experience!  From the minute we walked in the door, Johnathan, the sommelier, made us feel as though we were in for a special treat.  He is very knowledgeable about wines, presentations, and great service!  Maximo was an added compliment to the excellent service we received.   Thank you, Maximo! The wine selection is excellent, and we appreciate the fact that we could order from any restaurant.   But, I highly recommend the beef, salmon, and vegetable tray.  What a gem The Winery is!  We will definitely return!

reviews.author: Ramon P
reviews.title: A must go to location.
reviews.text:
The experience was amazing. Especially at the Ginger Signature bar close to the lobby. 

The staff is welcoming and very nice. 

I strongly recommend a quick stop on your next visit. Definitely recommending to our friends and family. 

Thank you Maria Superville, Ilyas, Dominga and Altagracia.

reviews.author: Marc R
reviews.title: This vacation were amazing, coming back soon!!!
reviews.text:
I met the trainer "Silverio" at the gym during my stay, he had positive energy kept the gym extremely clean, knew what he was talking about and knew just how much attention or non attention to give to the people working out, he spotted me when he saw i needed it and gave me good advice when i was cheating my reps, wish i could get that kind of service back home. My stay at this resort was excellent food, service, entertainment and the gym also the beach and pools were amazing and lots of cabana to hide from the sun. 

By the way whenever you have a question or feel lost, approach the front desk the guest service concierge will help out with your concerns, jendry were exceptional with his customer service Stephanie Castillo you're A SUN!!! Keep shining

reviews.author: Anny L
reviews.title: Excelente servicio del personal y belleza del lugar.
reviews.text:
Recomiendo este Hotel al 100 %, es  un Hotel muy bueno, muy bonito, todo está de alta calidad.  El lugar es maravilloso parece de sueños, pero lo más hermoso que tiene el alojamiento es su personar, el servicio es excelente especialmente en el área de A&B, es notable que el A&B manager Jacobo Reyes esta haciendo un excelente trabajo, ya que el servicio de ese departamento es excepcional, especialmente el servicio de varios colaboradores, Dentro de ellos: Rosanna Hernandez, quien se desempeña como camarera en el buffet, también cabe destacar la amabilidad de Félix quien se desempeña como capitán del buffet en las mañanas, pero también es capitán en las noches en el restaurante Mexicano Blue Agave, por otro esta el servicio excelente del camarero Jean Carlo del restaurante mina.
Y si necesitan un milagro, el capitán Santo del restaurante Tokimeko lo hará para usted hahaha.

Debo mencionar que el minibar de la habitación está perfectamente bien surtido con todo lo que necesitamos, y estos es gracias a Estarlin Joseph, quien está siempre al pendiente de que a los huéspedes no les falte absolutamente nada en su minibar. 

Por último debo resaltar el servicio y amabilidad de Richar Sánchez.

Definitivamente volvería!!!

reviews.author: philthewiggleman
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Resort
reviews.text: Excellent facility.  Top notch Service  Butler Francisco Vilorio gave AMAZING Service!!  Request him!!  Food was Great, Beaches and Pools were Great!!  Great location.  Attention to detail was over the top!!

reviews.author: Juan_Moscoso
reviews.title: Como en casa
reviews.text:
Como en casa. Definitivamente!
Lleno de cariño e increíble atención con el equipo de nuestro gran amigo Santo. 
Desde hace años nos hace sentir maravillosamente. 
La comida del lugar, simplemente magnífica. Es uno de los mejores restaurantes del lugar. 
Muy recomendado

reviews.author: Tpalmst
reviews.title: Italian Restaurant Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We are staying at the Paridisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.
This evening we are eating at the Italian Restaurant. The restaurant mood is calming and intimate. 
Our server Wilmina is geniunely sincere, polite and efficient.
Milton the Supervisor is a friendly and affable person.
Everything we ordered off the menu was excellently prepared and tasteful.
We ordered for appetizers Minestrone
soup excellent, Octopus , prepared perfectly, Caprese, and Mussels.
For our Main Course we ordered Linguini Shrimp. The Shrimp at this Resort is outstanding regardless where you go. The Linguini was exceptional, as I have never had Linguini and Shrimp
like that before.
To top it off the Tiramisu was out of this world.
Staff and Chef Excellent Job This Evening!!!!

reviews.author: MaggyZitaS
reviews.title: Restaurante Sante
reviews.text:
La mejor elección para celebrar nuestro Aniversary, fue una noche divina con una atención delicada, muchísimas gracias José del Rosario, Andino, Amanda, Pamela, Nicasio y Virginia todos espléndidos!
la infraestrucura es muy agradable, desde el ingreso en el Lobby con una vista asombros a la playa, eso no tiene precio. Comida y bebidas bien.

reviews.author: Edna T
reviews.title: An Amazing Trip on PC, DR.
reviews.text:
Our bedroom and bathroom was very clean and comfortable.  The restaurants were great, loved the food we were served. The pool was very clean and surrounded decks great. Our spa experience was relaxing and staff caring and well trained. 
Wolfen our concierge 
 was an amazing man who took care of everything for us. Very responsive and caring of our stay being excellent! He was very professional and knowledgeable of all the Resort and area.

reviews.author: Journey24060828812
reviews.title: Great Concierge
reviews.text: Beautiful pools and beaches. Never crowded. Didn't need to wake up early to find a nice spot for the day. My concierge, Adriel, was excellent. He made sure I has everything I needed including making dinner reservations for me every night and ensuring the fridge in my room was fully stocked with things that I like.

reviews.author: RealEstateMelody
reviews.title: 90 degrees is the place to be
reviews.text: Visit the pool bar 90 degrees. Fantastic services. Rosanna is the best bartender. Friendly, attentive and I watched her easily remember people's drinks. Drinks were delicious and we wanted to go every day. Stop in to say hi to Rosanna and you'll feel the same positive energy and receive the same great service.

reviews.author: Markus B
reviews.title: Our dreamvacation!
reviews.text:
The vacation was the best I habe ever had!
Eberything was perfect. 
The waiters of all restaurants were helpful, competent and very friendly.
In particular, the waitress in the Italian restaurant was remarkable! The supervisor of this restaurant dis a very great job!
The personal on the GingerBar is also excellent! They made so beautyful Cocktails!❤️
We will came back!!!

reviews.author: Monica H
reviews.title: A Fabulous and Unforgettable Stay
reviews.text:
We just returned from an amazing week at the Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana hotel.  This was a very special trip for our family, we were there to celebrate my mom's 80th birthday and we were a family of 6, with two younger kids, aged 14 and 10.  We had booked 2 Niktei suites.  
From the moment we entered the hotel, our exceptional journey began.  We were greeted by Juan, the rooms manager.  Our suites were great, no issues.
We were assigned the most amazing concierge, Yaliedi.  She was superb.  Proactive and took care of everything for us.  She is a true superstar.
On the beach, we were fortunate to meet Martin who took excellent care of every day.
Jonathan, the manager of the buffet and the restaurants always ensured that we were well taken care of and ensured that our family was given the special attention.
Wilfredi, the master chef - I just can't say enough wonderful things about him.  He impressed us every single night and ensured that our dining experience was super special and remarkable.
The entertainment every afternoon and evening was thoughtful and fantastic.
Every staff member was polite and helpful.
If you are considering this hotel, don't hesitate.  The hotel, the food, the service and entertainment are top notch.  You won't be disappointed.  We are already looking at booking our next visit and we've only been back 2 days!
Our sincere thanks to the staff members mentioned here and everyone else who made our stay so extra special!

reviews.author: jessicalbenson
reviews.title: Spring Break Girls Week Away---For Rest and Relaxation.  SUCCESS!
reviews.text: What an amazing week full of fun, sun, laughs and delicious food.  We loved the NITKE swim up suite which was perfect for the R and R that we needed.  We had a GREAT Concierge, Wolfan, who was excellent at his job and helped us with everything we asked of him!  We had an absolute wonderful girls week!!!!

reviews.author: Kara S
reviews.title: Our favorite place/Wedding Here!
reviews.text:
This is my family's 10th year in a row visiting the Palma Real/The Grand Cana, and this trip my husband and I got married here with our family and friends in attendance. The resort is beautiful, food and drinks are great, and staff is the best. Stephanie Bellido, our wedding planner, made sure the wedding was everything I wanted and more, she was so helpful the whole planning period, met with us multiple times, and made our vision come to life. I would recommend her to everyone getting married here. Carla also was so helpful with all audio/visual/DJ needs. She was our MC and helped us plan along the way and was always so knowledgeable and helpful.

Ranelli at the Grand Cana's pool bar and Odebi on the beach are our favorite staff members. They are so kind,  friendly, and helpful. Juan at Alula took great care of us as well. Already looking forward to next year's visit!

reviews.author: Lindsay W
reviews.title: 1st visit not our last.
reviews.text: What a wonderful all inclusive resort.  The Reserve room we had was right on the beach with a balcony, fantastic view.  The beach right in front of room, two pools to the left, reserve only bar and tiki thatch palapas everywhere on the beach, no problem getting one for the day.  The staff were all very friendly.  Our concierge Felix was very helpful getting us restaurant reservations every evening, he was awesome.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Meritxell C
reviews.title: Flora-great experience
reviews.text: We had dinner at Flora, Dominican Cuisine, delicious!!! Cesar, a very friendly waiter, recommended us a great variety of local dishes and deserts. Excellent food and service! Food came fast. The best experience during our stay at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Guide02073445812
reviews.title: Top holiday
reviews.text:
Basilo our consierege did a great job. He organized all for us and is super friendly. 
Thanks for that great vacation.
Just not many germans in here.
Good food, beautyful suits and great weather. Also many pools with good activities. 
Would come again.

reviews.author: sandrakhorn
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: We enjoyed the resort and services. We went to the Circle sales pitch. It was substandard. It was canned with no regard when we asked questions. It was a fail. We thought the changes were good but we would not like 2 weeks

reviews.author: Mariana L
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: Extraordinario hotel con playa insuperable. Quiero agradecer al impresionante servicio prestado por Katherin Santos! Desde el momento de las reservas y toda su ayuda durante nuestra estadía.  Un angelito en nuestro viaje!  Las sonrisas de todas las personas encargadas de nuestros cuartos fue bella al igual que su servicio. Y los que nos hicieron la estadía: Víctor, Luis y Quinto en el bar de la piscina!! Cada día mejor que el anterior - se convirtieron en familia! Y que decir tb del grupo del bar Ginger!!! Finalmente tb agradecemos mucho a todos los que nos sirvieron los desayunos y las cenas!!! La atención del restaurante italiano al igual que su comida fue la mejor cena que tuvimos, seguida por el japonés y Mina donde le cantaron feliz 70 anios a mi mami!  El restaurante mexicano tb estuvo bien y sus margaritas maravillosas!!

reviews.author: ISA c
reviews.title: The best vacations
reviews.text: Everything was excellent, it was my best vacation, the employees were very good people and super friendly, and an exquisite meal, I want to highlight the good service of Mrs. Katherine in the lobby during my check in, she is the best, very charismatic and with good service to the customer.. I will definitely return soon

reviews.author: Alice A
reviews.title: my first and best experience in paradisus palma real
reviews.text: My experience was the best. The hotel was wonderful. The people are lovely, but especially a girl named Cristy, very sweet and very dedicated to her work. She made us feel great. She gave us a great surprise. She worried about our room. When she saw us, she asked with questions. I really like it Cristy, you made our honeymoon wonderful, you deserve heaven.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Juan and Francesca were our servers at lunch and they were excellent.  We ate at the lunch box over looking the ocean. The staff were polite, friendly and ready to get us anything we needed. The weather was amazing and it was nice to get out of the sun and have a relaxing lunch. Thanks to Juan and Francesca.

reviews.author: Miguel R
reviews.title: Francis was the best!!
reviews.text: Francis went above and beyond!!! Never hesitated to please. Sat beach side and was extremely attentive . Always willing to get whatever/whenever  we needed at any time.  Francis beachside was the best!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Laurie G
reviews.title: Francis is the man!!
reviews.text: We bought the cabana on the beach for the day & it was beyond worth it! Spend the money! & Francis was amazing!!!!!! We are living our stay here and the staff is very attentive to our needs. Trust me the extra money for cabana is worth it!!! I wish we did this daily!

reviews.author: Ashley L
reviews.title: Great customer service and beautiful resort
reviews.text: It is a very beautiful resort to stay in. The beach and hotel grounds are amazing and a very nice hotel room. The stand out here is the customer service. My concierge Tomas was amazing, very attentive and helpful the entire trip. Took care of booking the restaurants for dinner and really went above and beyond my expectations. It allowed us to just enjoy the vacation with no work on our part. We also had a beach concierge Argenis who gave awesome service all week on the beach and took care of our drinks and remembered us everytime we came back. These smaller things make a huge difference in making a great trip. The entertainment at night was fun and different each evening. All around relaxing and beautiful place to stay. Would go back!

reviews.author: Myriam
reviews.title: Paradisus is a great place to stay
reviews.text: Just visited the Paradisus Palma Real in early March.  The resort is absolutely beautiful, the rooms in addition to the beach and pool areas are well maintained.  We stayed in The Reserve section of the resort which caters to adults.  We were assigned Basilio as our butler who went above and beyond.  His service and assistant was impeccable.   I highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real and Basilio our butler. Just one thing to note, as a number reviewers mentioned in their reviews, the restaurants do fill up for dinner so try to make a reservation in advance.  Other than that the Paradisus made for a memorable vacation.

reviews.author: Manuel Emil T
reviews.title: Ese calor humano que te hace sentir como en un sueño, tanta gente hermosa y amable desde que pisa las instalaciones.
reviews.text: Excelente muy buenas atenciones en especial al hacer el check up, un recibimiento caluroso y amable. Gracias mil,  Katherine lantigua  eres super sigues así Dios te bendiga. También debo decir que las habitaciones son sumamente cómodas amplias y muy limpias.

reviews.author: Amanda S
reviews.title: Fantastic and memorable trip!
reviews.text:
We just got back from Palma Real and our experience could not have been better. We had a corner reserve garden suite (8211) . We loved our location, on second floor , right next to the beach and reserve pool, with a great view.
Our concierge was Adriel and he went above and beyond to make our experience exceptional all week! I would definitely recommend upgrading to reserve level for a couples trip! 
We spent a lot of time in the reserve pool (ask for the Wanda special ) and the reserve area of the beach. We tipped Refael well, and he treated us well in return. He saved us a spot in a beach bed everyday and made fantastic drinks!
We took advantage of the reserve/Nikte/ circle catamaran “yoga” trip. (Majority did no yoga) We enjoyed walking the beautiful natural beach and then they took us to a shallow “party” area. The staff on the catamaran were perfect and everyone had a blast!! Definitely recommend!
We had seen poor reviews of the food before we went and we absolutely do not understand. 
Too much to write, but we LOVED Sante (reserve only) for breakfast and dinner.
We really enjoyed Mina and thought the presentation at the hibachi was AWESOME. 
The buffet at Kana was so plentiful, we could not figure out why some people would complain.
Lastly, we enjoyed a dinner at the wine bar. Anyone can do this reservation, you just need to buy a bottle of wine and they bring you multi-course charcuterie. It was a great couples experience and the wine was very reasonably priced!!
We loved our experience, all of the pleasant staff, and would definitely return!

reviews.author: anthony m
reviews.title: Excellent ambiance
reviews.text: Food and service was excellent, many thanks to Cesar for being so attentive. The air conditioning is just right and the restaurant looks bright and new with an amazing selection of drinks. Glenys was our server and pulled out all the stops to make our evening special. 👌

reviews.author: Andrew G
reviews.title: Great hotel, excellent service
reviews.text: Great experience at the Palma, Eriol was our dedicated concierge and he helped take all the administrative and busy work out of our hands.  Daily activities, restaurant reservations, regularly checking on our stay and if there is anything he can do to enhance our visit, like helping to reserve golf at Cocotal, sending a bottle of champagne to our room and shifting dinner times to accommodate the sleep schedule of our 1 year old.  Great hotel, excellent service. Thank you Eriol for a great experience and hope to see you again next time!

reviews.author: jcolestoapple
reviews.title: A wonderful resort to escape to!
reviews.text:
I had a very enjoyable stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. My stay was in early March and I opted in for the Reserve, Adults Only package. The biggest perk of this package was staying in a building/room much closer to the beach. 

Overall, the grounds are spacious and extremely well-maintained. This includes the beachfront which arguably has the cleanest/best patch of beach to any of the neighboring resorts. This is due in part to the incredible staff who are as professional as they are attentive. A big shoutout to my concierge, Osvaldo. He made my stay the best it could be, and elevated the experience through his responsiveness and help with whatever question I had! 

The drinks were great, and the bar staff in the Reserve areas were friendly and attentive all day long. The restaurant selections are plentiful, and are enjoyable but not otherworldly. The spaciousness of the common areas are inviting to a lot of patrons, but never did it feel overwhelming busy.

Overall it was a satisfying stay and enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Ana P
reviews.title: Incleible experiência
reviews.text:
Estivemos no Paradisus Palma Real.
Um hotel incrível, tudo é fantástico: as piscinas, os restaurantes teem todos excelente comida, os empregados muito amáveis e sempre atentos a todos os pormenores.
Teem uma viagem de catamaran, fomos a uma praia fazer ioga, a seguir paramos numa piscina natural, havia música e coctails.
Tivemos um “concierge”(que é um mordomo), chamado Adriel, muito simpático, atento e gentil, antecipando-se a todas as nossas necessidades, organizou tudo o que precisamos seja restaurantes, o catamaran, tudo.
Tivemos umas férias fantásticas graças à sua preocupação, em que estivéssemos sempre o melhor e felizes.

reviews.author: ravimedi
reviews.title: great resort
reviews.text: Our check in was smooth and our  room was clean and comfortable. We participated in the activities and we enjoyed all of them. Food was excellent and there were many choices at the buffet and at the restaurants. Great place to take it easy and just relax. Only con was some places were excluded to us but there is no sign mentioning this and  I felt we were told rudely the place was not for our level. If you ignore this it was a great resort. .

reviews.author: Elly
reviews.title: Relaxing Paradise!
reviews.text:
We had a great time! Loved our room and view. The pools were great and the beach was very nice. Lots of spaces to sit and relax. 

Eriol was incredible!! He was very helpful and went above and beyond to make sure our stay was enjoyable. 

Entertainment was good too on the plaza at night. This is a large resort and was able to walk around a lot. Plenty of bars around to get drinks thru day.

reviews.author: Collette S
reviews.title: Perfect vacation spot
reviews.text: Great value. Fun things to do but not overly loud.  Good food and the staff was excellent clean and comfortable rooms.  Hotel is on the beach.  Beach is clean and safe.  Water is swim able. We ate at the restaurants but the buffet was better for us.  More variety and food was very good. Staff goes universally and beyond.

reviews.author: Kate V
reviews.title: Is a blast!!
reviews.text: Thank you Jendry Acosta for helping us with my daughter’s needs regarding her celiac disease! You helped me relax and enjoy my vacation knowing that you guys were taking it seriously. So happy! Keep it up! Definitely planning on coming back!

reviews.author: Erika O
reviews.title: Thank you guys
reviews.text: Jendry did amazing dealing with my party’s gluten free issue. I could NOT be happier. 100% satisfaction!! Jendry Acosta and Katherine Mota (and Carlos and Joel) fixed everything for us! So happy to be here, feeling very comfortable as a family with allergies and celiac!!!!

reviews.author: Mo Perez
reviews.title: Wonderful 👍😊
reviews.text: Great service all around. Our man Francis did a great job hooking us up with the Cabana and just a super job all day. He made it a fun experience and just awesome. I would recommend this resort all day long and definitely ask for Francis..above and beyond truly a great experience.

reviews.author: LD38
reviews.title: Delightful friendly service.
reviews.text: Beautiful resort that feels very intimate despite its size.  That’s largely due to welcoming, friendly associates like Francis, the beach butler, who went out of his way to make my birthday celebration special.  Nothing was too much trouble for this charming man.

reviews.author: Rodrigo A
reviews.title: Would return! service was great
reviews.text: Great time on the beach! Francis was amazing, he was the best server! Would return to the hotel. The service was really good, especially by the beach. Lovely view and the hotel was really nice. Beach area was my favorite and the drinks were well made

reviews.author: Claudio
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text:
Excelente estadía. Comida rica, pieza muy limpia. Tranquilo, pocos niños. Agradecemos a Luis del bar Celsius, muy amable!!!!, se nota que disfruta mucho su trabajo, muy alegre y tragos ricos.
Muy buena experiencia, rica playa y piscina.

reviews.author: Grace C
reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text:
This resort is very beautiful! The beach and pools are very nice. Our room was nicer than I had expected.  Adriel was great and helped us with dinner reservations and showing us around the resort! Definitely recommend staying here. 

Very relaxing vacation, lots of restaurants and bars around the resort all had great food!

reviews.author: Hot S
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: The resort was very nice I’m glad I came! The weather is very nice every day. We were greeted friendly and we were shown around by Adriel. He was very helpful the whole time with showing us around. The resort was set up in a good, straight forward manor. We were able to easily navigate and find what we needed . The food was very delicious. There is a buffet with many options to choose from. There is also 24/7 room service and they are very pleasant. The drinks are made quick I liked the straw berry dak. At night they play live music and people are dancing and having a good time.

reviews.author: Colin K
reviews.title: College spring break
reviews.text: Great workers and all are very friendly. The bars were easy to get service at and the sports bar had impressive service. The dj booth was always bumping and the people were all very friendly and social. The pool are was always very busy but was very fun and the room service was quick and could be used anytime.

reviews.author: D Oliveira
reviews.title: Amazing Experience and Incredible Staff
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real never fails…once again had an amazing experience.  Special thanks to our concierge Nicolas, Reserve beach staff Pedro,  Martin, Rafael and Yuderi, Wanda, Gilberto, Francisco on the beach who does a great job in the evening making it pristine for the following morning…also special thanks to Eduardo and Adriana at Flora, Gustavo at Sante and chefs Rafael (Sante) and Tojeilin (Italian restaurant).

reviews.author: Rob C
reviews.title: Margarita and Ceviche experience
reviews.text: Angel, Josario and the crew were excellent!  This was part of the resort experience and we had a great time.  The margaritas were fresh and so was the ceviche.  We learned the difference between tequila and mescal which was informative.   Great job to the team!

reviews.author: Jim H
reviews.title: Reserve at Palma Real is our favourite vacation!
reviews.text:
My wife and I have stayed in three of the Meliá hotels in Punta Cana- Grand Cana, Garden Suites and the Reserve at Palma Real, which is the ocean front location.

We love the Reserve at Palma Real for many reasons:

1.  it’s “Adult Only”
2. Access to some of the best restaurants.
3. Great food at the buffets and specialty restaurants.
4. Recently renovated rooms are very comfortable.
5. Easy access to the 27 hole Cocotel golf course.
6. Excellent spa services.

A special thank you to Richard, the Reserve Manager and Luis in the office.  Both were a pleasure to work with and did an excellent job ensuring we enjoyed our vacation experience.

Irvin and Wolf were very helpful as our concierge.  Wanda and Pedro always make our pool and beach time enjoyable.  Miguel on the sales team has stayed in touch with us over multiple trips providing great opportunities for our future stays.

We look forward to seeing all the familiar faces in the fall.

Sincerely Jim and May

reviews.author: O6258JJangeloc
reviews.title: The Winery lo mejor
reviews.text:
Muy buen hotel

Lo mejor la atención y experiencia en el Winery  

Buenos vinos te dan la comida de todos los restaurantes, lo que pidas y se disfruta con un buen maridaje

El servicio de Jonatan Samaniego 👏👏👏🍷 muy buenas recomendaciones para el maridaje

reviews.author: Laurie G
reviews.title: Supervisor was fantastic !!!!
reviews.text: Cirilo Rijo the supervisor at Lunch box restaurant made our vacation absolutely wonderful by treating us as family not just a customer!!!! He was vey professional!! If you visit the Lunch Box look him up and we are sure he will take care of you as well!!

reviews.author: Pete T
reviews.title: Top rate service

reviews.author: Melissa B
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!! Upgrade to Reserve or Nikte!!
reviews.text: We loved our 4 night stay late February into March- quiet week at the resort! This was a mother daughter trip & we had the best time! We booked our vacation just 2 weeks before arriving, we booked directly on the Melia site. We stayed in a Junior garden view suite in the reserve. We felt the upgrade to the Reserve was well worth it! We ate at Santi every morning for breakfast & every afternoon for lunch! We loved the private adults only pools & beach area. The beach staff was incredible!! Our concierge was just okay but all the other perks made up for that! Including the catamaran ride to a private beach for yoga, then swimming at private, shallow, calm swim area in the ocean! It was so much fun!!! The resort was gorgeous, modern & clean!! The staff was friendly as well! Plenty of options for dining, we didn’t ever try the buffet but all the sit down places were delicious with solid service! No long waits, as shared in other reviews, but again it was very quiet when we were there! I’d highly recommend the resort and we hope to return in the future!!!

reviews.author: zkrieger
reviews.title: Overall Great Stay (Our sixth time!)
reviews.text: We keep coming back to this resort because it's simply beautiful. Easy to get to the beach, great food, great service, and the people who work there are friendly. So overall, we will be coming back! The only critical feedback I have about this specific stay was at the beginning of the trip there was a huge corporate outing and we were moved down to Grand Cana instead of where we booked at Paradisus. This caused us to call our Apple rep who then came to the rescue - and specifically Stephanie in Guest Services at Paradisus really saved the day. She got us moved back to Paradisus after one day and got our vacation back on track. I played golf four times, and hung out at the beach with my wife in a beautiful area with a lot of shopping opportunities and good eats along the ocean front. Needless to say, we will be coming back for a seventh year in a row in 2025! Special shout out again to our friend Stephanie in Guest Services at Palma Real, she's a keeper!

reviews.author: julia M
reviews.title: Buffet
reviews.text: Rosana at the buffet was amazing! So much help! Great service, very fast, helped a lot! Very friendly, always smiling, very helpful! We ordered so much food, and she kept on cleaning the table when we were done, the table always looked spectacular!

reviews.author: Lisa L
reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at this beautiful beachfront property.  Loved being close to beach with ocean views in gorgeously updated suite.   Best though was friendly and helpful service.  Special shout out to our concierge Cristian and Jose at Brisas.  Both were amazing and really made our stay special.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Great experience for first time AIR guest
reviews.text:
3 night stay with fiancée, first time at an AI resort. all staff was expedient and generous with all services included in our trip. Check in was fast and there was plenty to do as soon as we checked in. There was no waiting around for anything to happen. 

When we did go to our room, the air conditioner was working great and it was actually a bit cold for our liking. Pillows were too fluffy for my liking, but fresh linens daily. The room we got had an ocean view, balcony, tub, shower, stocked bar, and some snacks all included. 

Our concierge, Fernando D,  got a list of all of the restaurants we wanted and made us reservations in advance to make sure we didn't miss anything. The buffet and sports bar were walk in and of course the experience is what you would expect from walk in dining.. They always had food and drinks ready to go, though. Plenty of choices also for a traveler who prefers American menus. Just make sure you have an idea of what time each place is open for food. Drinks were not skimpy.

Pools were quiet and relaxing, beach was not crowded. The outdoor bars (swim up and beach) were fairly quick but it was also a slower time of the year for them. Don't play into the locals selling ripoff photos and trinkets at the beach. They will haggle if you really want what they are selling.

This resort supposedly has undergone a relatively recent remodel, and it does show. They were actually doing some painting while we stayed but nobody was in our way or a nuisance. There were no areas in disrepair either, important to me.

Some evening entertainment was available to attend, but we didnt attend. We could see and hear most of it from our balcony, but there is a 'curfew' of sorts, albeit somewhat late (11pm) and there are suites in less busy areas of the resort if you want a private, quiet stay.

We didn't do any excursions or tours during our stay. I had heard mixed reviews about the island yoga experience, just be aware that those have to be scheduled and can take up a chunk of your day.

reviews.author: Hope I
reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful trip! The drinks were good, the bed was comfortable, the hotel was very clean. We had a great experience with the help of our butler Fernando. Fernando went above and beyond to give us a wonderful vacation. After a surprising proposal from my now fiancé, Fernando went all out decorating our room! Bartenders Victor and Luis are phenomenal at their job!! The best drinks and such fun guys! Jesus was delivering us drinks while we were hanging by the pool and on the beach and he was so great always checking if we needed something. The ginger bar is such a cool hangout spot. Lots of good entertainment! Kelvin at the steak restaurant was a wonderful waiter and was so quick to getting us anything we needed! The Italian restaurant was my favorite, the shrimp basil pasta was incredible! The buffets for breakfast and lunch did have tons of options, but the food was cold a lot of the time and quality not the greatest. The beach was not crowded at all and the ocean water felt wonderful! The gentlemen that were working in the towel area by the pool we so fun and spunky. They were always having a great time with the guests! The pool was a bit chilly, but after jumping in it didn’t take long to get used to. It was a nice, relaxing trip! Cant wait to return!!

reviews.author: Yoo_Ann
reviews.title: Heaven on earth!!! Love this place, only 1 issue
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of staying for four nights, and overall, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I checked in at the reserve area, which was very professional, I was impressed by the level of service and attention to detail.

**Check-In:** The check-in process was superb, with the staff ensuring a smooth and efficient arrival experience, thanks to a competent check-in clerk who efficiently merged my 2 separate reservations, so we didn't have to check out and in again mid stay, job well done. Our concierge, Lewis De La Cruz, welcomed us warmly, but unfortunately, he seemed more focused on making a sales pitch rather than enhancing our stay with personalized touches. In fact, Lewis was so unhelpful that later in our stay when it was time to meet for the sales offer he couldn't even organize the meeting, wasting my precious vacation time.

**Accommodation:** I reserved a  oceanfront reserve junior suite in the adult only section of the resort, got a ground level room, and I must say, the room exceeded my expectations. The view was breathtaking, and the suite itself was outstanding in terms of comfort and amenities, a full mini bar refilled each day, L shaped sofa, lots of storage space, robes and slippers, a umbrella, a bottle of rum, mamajuana and wine & much more. As a delightful touch, the room came with a complimentary beach bag, complete with flip-flops, adding an extra touch of luxury to my stay. The room opened up to a patio with two rocking chairs, providing a serene spot to enjoy the ocean breeze, Another highlight of the room was the direct access to the ocean, allowing for convenient and picturesque strolls along the beach whenever desired.

**Facilities:** The resort's pools were a highlight of my stay. There are 3 adult only pools They were beautifully maintained and provided a perfect setting for relaxation. The bars and bartenders were exceptional, offering personalized service that made me feel truly valued as a guest. Special mention goes to "Wanda" at the pool bar, whose service was amazing.

**Reserve Adults Only Pool:** The reserve adults-only pool is were I spend most of the day  it is a very quiet place for sunbathing and to relax. For pool events and music, however, you needed to hop over to the main pool, which is huge, by the way.

**Towel Service:** A special shoutout to the towel person who escorted me each day to my pool chair, making sure I had everything I needed with a touch of humor. He made the experience even more enjoyable and memorable. Additionally, the guy who took care of the pool area had a great sense of humor and made everyone laugh. His cheerful demeanor added to the fun and relaxed atmosphere by the pool.

**Helpful Tour:** Despite the initial focus on sales, Lewis did provide us with a very helpful and informative tour of the property, highlighting key amenities and points of interest. But, failed to tell me about my 1 free excursion that was included with my stay, i only realized it later when I arrived home. 

**Spa Treatment:** I must mention that the spa treatment I eventually received was very, very good. It was a rejuvenating experience that added to the overall relaxation and enjoyment of my stay.

**Kick Sports Bar:** The resort's Kick Sports Bar was another standout feature, with great bartenders and lively entertainment every night. It provided the perfect setting for enjoying drinks and socializing with other guests. I wish I knew the name of Kick's bartender to thank her personally for the great service she provided.

**Entertainment:** Each night, the resort offered great entertainment options. the "plaza" as its called, and kicks bar were alive with activities, providing a diverse range of entertainment options, from live music to circus acts, koreoke, I personally loved the mirror danse party, just ensuring there was something for everyone to enjoy. the plaza was also a great place to relax and have a drink at night, with bartenders going around fulfilling all your needs, creating a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere

**Dining:** I must emphasize that all restaurants, too numerous to name individually, were outstanding in all aspects of the word. From the quality of the food to the service and ambiance, dining at the Resort was an unforgettable experience.

**Issue:** However, my experience was marred by one major issue. I encountered a "huge" bug in my washroom, which was quite unsettling. Despite notifying Lewis, the issue was not promptly addressed, and I had to wait until late afternoon before being able to use the washroom comfortably. We were promised by Lewis compensation in the form of a spa treatment, but unfortunately, this was not honored at the spa, it was a true disappointment as Lewis failed to follow through, leaving us feeling deceived and undervalued as guests. I was lucky I didn't pay for the spa upfront; I only added the fee to my room, so I had a chance of reimbursement at check out.

**Resolution:** Thankfully, the manager, Richard, stepped in and rectified the situation at checkout. He addressed my concerns promptly and ensured that I left the resort feeling satisfied.

Overall, despite the hiccup with the bug and the initial spa treatment mishap, my stay  was memorable for all the right reasons. The outstanding service, luxurious accommodations, and beautiful facilities more than made up for any shortcomings. I would certainly be returning in the future.
