reviews.author: Erica C
reviews.title: 7 days in paradise
reviews.text: My friend and I were gifted a 5 night stay at the Paradisus after coming last year and decided to add an extra night. To say this trip was unmatched is an understatement. From the moment we arrived at the resort we were immediately taken care of. We stayed in a junior suite in the reserve section. We are both teachers so having a quiet area to relax over vacation was exactly what we were looking for. We were checked in and greeted by Alvaro. He took care of us our entire stay, making sure we got everything we needed from reservations to a late checkout. We were also taken care of on the beach. Martin made sure each morning our chairs were saved for us.  We have made many friends during our stay and hope to see them here again.  We couldn’t have asked for a better 6 nights here and are sad to go. If you are staying in the reserve I highly suggest requesting Alvaro if possible. He was absolutely wonderful.

He literally read our minds and helped bring food and snacks to our 2 year old as well as champagne, cold beer, water and ice for the adults. We went on a small work trip with about 16 adults plus our baby and everyone agreed that Raphael was the highlight of the trip. We were treated like royalty. 

We upgraded to Nikte concierge service and had Ariel for all of our guests. He was AMAZING. He took care of us as personal friends. Was caring and compassionate. Took care of reservations and activities for all. We just can’t speak highly enough of Ariel.

reviews.author: funtravels2018
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: We had an awesome trip with family in the Reserve Adult section. Food was very good, especially in the buffet. Some of the A la cartes are just ok. Beautiful grounds, very clean hotel. Beach is huge with fine white sand, and tons of pallapas. No problem finding a space everyday. Even though hotel was full, it never felt crowded or overly busy. Our butler Hector was awesome, he helped us book group meals, celebrate a family birthday with a lovely cake and organized a group boat excursion, which was so much fun. He was available everyday to help with any little issues! All in all excellent resort!

Our concierge Osvaldo Veloz was very communicative and always helped handle any needs or issues even when he was not on work time!! He is checked in throughout the day and we got our activities schedule early ever morning. We couldn’t have anyone better!

reviews.author: tinakalkesean
reviews.title: Vacation 2024
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, the facilities are excellent but the best thing is the attention, the friendliness of the staff, we will return . highlight the attention of Jose from guest service, very helpful

reviews.author: Nicole T
reviews.title: Definitely coming back!
reviews.text:
Book this resort!!! After reading several reviews before leaving for the week,I was worried about how my boyfriend and I would enjoy our vacation. This resort exceeded our expectations, so much so we are planning our return next year.
We had a Nikte Master suite swim up room - it was HUGE and newly renovated. Our room faced north east which meant we only got sun in the late afternoon. That being said our section of the resort was super quiet therefore there were plenty of sun beds in the opposite side of the semi private pool. This room came with an amazing concierge named Yaleidi Sims. She was incredible in checking in with us, making reservations for restaurants (benefits to Nikte) and providing for any additional requests like bottles of wine and a lovely surprise cheese plate yesterday afternoon to make our last day extra special.
The food was great as well. Both buffets offered enough variety that it would be hard to get bored. That being said, please do not expect high end dining at the restaurants. Mexican restaurants was excellent but the others ( we did not get to Flora) were just okay. Other reviews have had great things to say about the restaurants so it might be personal preference and who is in the kitchen that night.
The live music every night was entertaining and a great way to spend a few hours in the evening. There are a lot of activities during the day. Not my thing but they seem to have been well attended.
Because people all mention this there is little to no seaweed on the beach at the moment.
Staff are all terrific. Friendly and clearly working their butts off whether it was the housekeeping staff or the bar staff (visit the gin and tonic bar cart in the main square - really good cocktails)
Once again don’t hesitate to book the resort and if you can the swim up rooms are beautiful and a wonderful way to truly relax on your vacation.

reviews.author: Sunny Sombrero
reviews.title: Fantastic Experience
reviews.text:
Service 5/5
Staff will go above and beyond to make sure you are happy and have everything you need. Everyone is very kind.

Room 4.5/5
Very nice and modern. Spotless cleaning. AC is spot on. You can actually control the temperature. Mini bar restocked daily with Nespresso. Bed is short for a true king. If you're over 6' your feet will dangle which is very annoying.

Buffet 3/5
Its ok, you won't go hungry. Burgers, fries, bacon if you're into that kind of stuff. Good variety of salads and freshly squeezed juices. Morning eggs and waffles but nothing that stands out.

Restaurants 7/5
Wow! Especially the steakhouse. It's better than most steakhouses in NY. Seriously it's amazing, some of the best steaks I've ever had. Standing ovation to the Mexican and Dominican (Flora). Great great food! Notable mention to the beach restaurant, seafood paella everyday and good chicken.

Beach 4.5/5
Seaweed cleanup is great. Even better than Secrets/Dreams which is to the left of Paradisus (looking at the ocean). The beach is wide with pristine white powdery sand and you can swim far out (unlike Lopesan to the right where you can barely go in to your waist) . There is always palapas available at any time of the day. Minus half a star for intense harassment by beach vendors and security not enforcing adults only side. Sometimes you had families with loud kids on the adults section. Sitting area could us better sweeping of cigarette butts in the sand. It's very nice beside that. 

Pool 4/5
Main pool is nice for families. Adults pool is extremely zen until locals invade on the weekends or some younger crowds come and try to turn it into a party pool. This is not a party hotel, they clearly picked the wrong spot.

Entertainement
We love the fact that this resort doesn't have a theater with lousy shows. Instead they have a band most nights playing Latin music in an open air area between restaurants surrounded by seating spread around. People come me hang out, listen, relax, chat, walk around. The music with nice brezze from ocean right behind creates a magical atmosphere. It's very unique! 

Overall 5/5
One of the best resort in Punta Cana Bavaro Area.

reviews.title: Excellent séjour dans un superbe hotel; merci spécial àè notre concierge Eriol
reviews.text:
Excellent séjour dans un superbe hôtel; merci spécial à notre concierge Eriol
Nous étions dans la section Réserve adultes. Un hôtel très bien aménagé, une chambre spacieuse, avec douche parapluie avec eau chaude à profusion, de nombreuses piscines, des chaises en quantité à la plage et aux piscines, des serviettes disponibles à volonté partout, un personnel très nombreux et avenant.
Plusieurs restaurants disponibles sur réservation par notre concierge, la nourriture est généralement bonne parfois plus et parfois moins. La nécessité d’avoir WHATSAPP pour communiquer avec les concierges est désagréable, l’on devrait pouvoir aussi fonctionner sur Message sur IPhone. Seul désagrément pour une chambre côté jardin: la voie qui sépare de l’hôtel voisin est parfois achalandée et bruyante. 
Notre concierge Eriol a été d’une compagnie fort agréable et son support a été très efficace; digne de mention.

Overall the resort and our experience was a 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Alyssa O
reviews.title: My best friends Wedding and A lifetime of Memories
reviews.text:
When my best friend invited me to her wedding in the D.R., I had no idea what to expect. Once the van doors opened up into the breath-taking entry of the main lobby until I had to depart for the airport; Luciano and Jimmy took great care of me and with a smile! 

At the front desk, I'm not sure who was more excited for us to be there. Us or Wilmer Donastorg! Even though communication can be difficult- His uplifting spirit and knowledge of the resort made me feel so welcomed and excited! Along with his colleagues; Katherine Lantigua, Ervia Medina and Gorge!

In the evening, Ramon Lorenzo, Nathally and Robenson were there to help me with my ever need-- and I had a few! They went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable; one of my favorite trips. 

At the Kanna Bar, Liz was always there to make me feel like a true VIP! I do not recall the lady that often was assisting her but together they kept the Tito's flowing! Make sure you also visit the Spa and ask for Eva! If you need your nails done with YHI, make sure to contact Katherine, she's friendly and helped pick out the perfect color! 

These are just some of the other amazing staff members that you will run into here at the resort that make your experience in paradise something truly magical. 

Thank you all and I will see you again soon <3 Alyssa O'Malia #3312 -> 4302 <3 <3 <3 

Playas de Bavaro, Punta Cana 23000
Hotel Confirmation: 370orcNZNo    & Aprobacion: 71755Z

(***helpful hint - at the very least practice Spanish and/or speak slowly and have patience. It's island time, and we're visiting. Be appreciative and respectful of people and the environment. reviews.author: Travis B
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently enjoyed a seven-day stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, and our experience was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, we were captivated by the breathtaking beauty of the beach, which we found to be the best in Punta Cana. Special thanks to Martin, Wanda, and Gilberto for making our beach days truly memorable. Each morning, we were delighted to find our reserved beach bed waiting for us, allowing us to soak in the sun in style. The service at the beach was impeccable, with staff going above and beyond to ensure our comfort. I am a beach person and this was by far the best beach in Punta Cana. 

While the pools were a bit chilly as it is January, they were nonetheless well-designed and added to the resort’s allure. We would cool off from the beach. The meticulously landscaped grounds provided a picturesque backdrop to our stay, and we found ourselves constantly in awe of the resort’s beauty. When you walk into the resort you are wowed looking through the lobby right to the beach. 

We did have a converge Nathaniel who booked our dinners each night and arranged a cake for my wife for her birthday. We are very self-sufficient, so this was all we really used the concierge service for.

Check-in was very quick probably about 20 to 30 minutes. Our room was ready right when we arrived. Our room was a haven of modern comfort, cleaned daily and stocked with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

The sports bar was a highlight of our evenings, offering a wide selection of drinks that were consistently strong and plentiful. 

One of the standout features of Paradisus Palma Real was the dining experience. Breakfast and lunch were consistently fantastic, with the Sante reserve area offering a particularly memorable culinary experience. We at the hibachi, wine bar, blue agave, and the Italian restaurant. I never have high expectations but the food was delicious. We did the buffet but some food was cold but that's what you expect from a buffet. 

Having previously stayed at resorts like Dreams Onyx and the Majestic Elegance, each with its own strengths, our experience at Paradisus Palma Real stood out as the best overall. We found ourselves consistently impressed with every aspect of our stay, from the stunning beach to the impeccable service and delectable dining options.

As a special treat for my wife’s birthday, we ate at the wine bar, and the food exceeded our expectations. You get a cheese board and then chicken, steak, and fish. It was delicious! We ended the dinner with a birthday cake and signing. It was perfect. 

Throughout our stay, we couldn’t find a single reason to fault the service or the quality of the cuisine. In fact, we were left wondering why anyone would have anything negative to say about Paradisus Palma Real. It truly exceeded our expectations in every way possible, making it a standout choice for future vacations.

Overall, our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Reserve exceeded our expectations, and we look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: Amanda H
reviews.title: Great family vacation with very young kids
reviews.text:
Trip advisor 

We were a family of 4 - my husband, a toddler and 8 month old. This resort is really great for anyone with young kids. The beach was wonderful, clean, calm waters, minimal sargasum, plenty of shady lounge chairs, great drink service… side note I recommend Arondis at the beach his margaritas were fantastic. The pool was equally as fun, a little chillier than the ocean but still nice. My baby was happy in there. The main pool is about 5 feet deep. There’s a pool bar. Always found a chair by the pool. Servers were also kind. There’s a small baby pool which we didn’t use. Activities by the pool include fitness classes and blow up toys. I even saw little boat toys for kids to ride in one day. Now for the kids club … we aren’t ones to use kids clubs but the people who work here are exceptional and just so kind and welcoming. My daughter was asking to go! We sent her three times and she really had so much fun face painting and doing crafts. They always had something fun going on and remembered my daughter’s name throughout our stay. Joanna was exceptionally kind with us and reassuring. I highly recommend! Ginger bar was our favorite. Amazing coffee and beverages and they always have little loaf cakes or muffins and cookies that are fresh. We enjoyed Antonio’s service every day. The breakfast buffets were good especially the omelette station, Junior made us eggs every morning. The lunch buffet was average I’ll be honest. And we only did Malta buffet for dinner once and it sucked. All the restaurants were good and food was also good. They provided high chairs and kids menus. PS some high chairs didn’t have seat belts. I did read some bad reviews about the food prior to the trip but that wasn’t the case for us. Our favorite was the lamb chops and pork tacos at the Mexican restaurant and the rice balls at the Italian. Dinner reservations were taken care of by our concierge every day. We had a swim out room which included a consiege. We never had one before and I was expecting it to be a waste besides booking dinners. Wily our consierge was absolutely exceptional. We are SO lucky to have had him. He was kind and took care of every hiccup we had along the way. Our room was a shared room which we didn’t book meaning we had to share our palapa and lounge chairs with the neighbours. Wily took care of arranging us a new room or a voucher for the mishap. He also took cake of issues like sending maintenance for our safe that stopped working, sending housekeeping for changing bedding when the baby soiled the bed, and arranged medical services when our toddler got an ear infection in the second day. He even went off the resort to find her a bathing cap to wear since she was not allowed to wet her ears the rest of the trip. He met us before dinner to ensure our reservations went smoothly. He was honestly the best resource. He arranged our family massages and met us prior to each massage as well. He didn’t push any circle member meetings on us or even ask us to mention him on any online reviews. Actually no one we met pushed any kind of self promotion on us. I highly recommend Wily. Btw the medical doctor was also great, she was able to clean out my daughter’s ear and provide medication for the trip and also dealt with the insurances for us. Very hassle free. And she even had us come back to check the ears again to make sure we would be ok for our flight home. My toddler loves evening entertainment and every night they had a little something at the main square. Mostly live music but one show was an acrobatic type circus in the pool which was super fun. Resort was very clean, room was clean and beds were comfortable. Staff was kind and always smiling and saying hello. Loved this place!

reviews.author: rage912

reviews.text: We loved staying at Palma Real Reserve for Adults only. We came for extended New Years Eve and it was so much fun. reviews.author: Dee C
reviews.title: Great trip to the Dominican.
reviews.text: We love Punta Cana. Our Butler was Edgar. He was amazing, he made our trip so special. He went up and beyond the duties of a Concierge. Can’t wait to see him again this year. The staff at the  Melia Palma Real were very friendly and helpful. The beach staff were also friendly and helpful. This resort is a wonder place to stay and we highly recommend it. reviews.author: Caio
reviews.title: Really exclusive resort at Punta Cana

reviews.author: Kim Domenico
reviews.title: Good family location, food good, staff friendly. Do have a few complaints.
reviews.text: Club Melia members for 13 years. We enjoy coming to this place but sad to see they took away some of our benefits we paid for while creating the Falcon (Circle) and giving those people all the perks we used to get. Then they try to sell us a membership to Falcon so we could have our benefits back! We did not buy! But we do enjoy the trip to this hotel, staff is friendly and location is good. Last complaint would be please get all those people off the beach annoying you non stop to buy things. Hard to even take a walk without getting bothered minimum 5-7 times.

reviews.author: apuertes2023
reviews.title: Excalentes Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: El Hotel muy acogedor frente al mar, con mucha vida ya que todo gira en torno a una plaza central, las instalaciones excelentes así como la atención y el trato de todos los empleados, muchas actividades para todos y muy amenas, nuestro concierge Eriol estuvo en todo momento pendiente de cualquier necesidad que tuvieramos, la verdad mis espectativas fueron superadas en todo, lo único que mejoraría sería el menu en algún restaurante pero en general muy bien la comida. Super recomendable para familias con niños pequeños, las chicas del Kidsdome espectaculares, repetiremos.

reviews.author: Ligia I
reviews.title: Beautiful Experience at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Christmas Eve at Santé restaurant tonight was a beautiful experience and very classy: starting with food preparation and presentation, and excellent service and great live violin music. Congratulations and thanks to chef Raphael and crew, Misael, Ariel and everyone who worked so hard and made Christmas Eve at Sante Paradisus Palma Real a very beautiful experience. Overall thanks to our concierge Nicholas who made our stay special and also Wanda at the pool bar, and Alexander at the Mexican restaurant Agave. The entire staff was great and we are enjoying our vacation very much!
This is our second stay at Paradisus Palma Real and will come back. A current very happy customer - Ligia Ion. Very Classy Paradisus!

reviews.author: TTT
reviews.title: Melia Concierge Makes the Trip Great
reviews.text: Our concierge- Lewis- was awesome.  He made the trip a wonderful experience.  He was proactive in meeting our needs and requests.  He made our restaurant reservations and gave us guidance on different places on the resort to visit.  He connected with us several times a day and provided the activities for the day.  I hope that he will be our concierge on our next visit.  Additional people to recognize is:  Hansel and Loyda.  They kept us replenished on the beach with drinks and a surprise birthday cake.  These three staff members are the best!

reviews.author: halfpint302023

The females working the reservation desk are RUDE and a bit unprofessional considering this is hospitality but Franklin is awesome.

reviews.author: Roberto Martinez
reviews.title: Excellent vacation @ Paradisus Palma 🌴 Real
reviews.text:
We stayed for 8 days, we went to celebrate my wife birthday

Very friendly staff, we feel like we were at home 
I would like to thanks to all personal from housekeeping to restaurants, bars and beach team for great services provided and special thanks to our concierge Juan, Joel Polanco @ food and beverage team and Rafael at Beach bar

reviews.author: Josph G
reviews.title: Vacation with friends
reviews.text: We are having a great time with my friends and we like the activity of going to the Bar in the Lobby with the singers, it is very nice and relaxing. Although my favorite restaurant is the Mina and then the Japanese show with Mr. Santos i like the hotel

reviews.author: cbfordman
reviews.title: paradises
reviews.text: The best resort I have ever stayed in 73 yrs  from the staff to the cleanest to great food . from the buffet to the 5 restaurants.  Our assistance Sosa was the best I have ever dealt with he handle all of our reservations and concerns, what a guy. Because of him I became a member with Melia.  I would return to the same place again.

reviews.author: Cali4niaBound
reviews.title: Thanks Maria!

Maria was great and helped us make a table to seat all 16 of us even though we would’ve been fine with three separate tables. It was very nice and appreciated. She also made sure our water glasses were never empty - and wine as well for those who wanted. Thanks for helping make a great first night Maria!

reviews.author: Daniel M
reviews.title: We will come back!

reviews.author: Anthony B

reviews.author: Excursion54226325620

reviews.author: Getaway60748224678

reviews.author: Johanne B
reviews.title: Wonderful

The staff including the concierge and service were attentive to our request.  The Restaurant and Buffet had a wide selection.  We had a great time and we could recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Tracey S

reviews.author: Sonia T
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text:
What a beautiful resort! So large, lots of pool options: on the one side: lively music, party-style, swim-up bar and on the other side: quieter, relaxing pool area. Plus separate adults only pools and children's pools - lots of choice! 
Also, love the layout of the beautiful courtryard central plaza area - it's super large, open-aired and beautifully decorated with all the a-la-carte restaurants lining the side. In the evening, the courtyard comes alive with music or the other entertainment options that have been scheduled.
The beach is stunning and -if you get a higher-up Nikte suite like we did-  you will have the most stunning view of it from your large balcony. Not to mention our suite was massive! So airy, spacious and beautifully decorated.  A special shoutout to our personal concierge Eriol - he reached out to us every morning to ask which a-la-carte he could reserve for us and to provide us with the resort's daily activity schedule and to see if there was anything else he could do for us.  Truly superb top-tier service.
Beautiful resort overall!

reviews.author: Joel D
reviews.title: Blueagave is great
reviews.text: Went to blueagave with my family.Food and service were amazing, idelka was amazing and would recommend her to anyone who comes here.She’s very helpful and is on top of her game she’s perfect help.Next time I come I’ll ask for her

reviews.author: Kimberly R
reviews.title: Exceptional Resort
reviews.text: My husband and I visited for our honeymoon and we had the most wonderful time. The service was exceptional and the staff are extremely nice. Lewis, our concierge, was very attentive, personable and helpful. The food options and restaurants were great and the incredible service we received from everyone was appreciated. Overall our time at this resort was excellent and a trip we will always remember!

reviews.author: Nari B
reviews.title: Club Melia
reviews.text: This trip was my first solo trip. What I love about my Club Melia membership is that it allows me a vacation of relaxation every year, of I choose. Sitting through a private presentation by the Circle for a change to that program was one that did not meet my needs at this time.

reviews.author: Jessica B
reviews.title: The Reserve is a Must!
reviews.text:
This was a wonderful hotel, better than expected as it was a first time in Dominican. We did the reserve adults only and it was amazing. Fantastic pools and oceanfront. We always found a seat! Pedro our beach/pool friend was so nice and happy. Our main Stars for our days out were Wanda and Yeisen at the beachfront adults only pool. They were fun, amazing service, great drinks and made this trip! Our concierge Hector J was impeccable. Everything was done and organized before I even went to ask! From ice in our room to our dinner reservations, he even called our flight agency to ensure our rep was sending someone for our pick up. We went golfing on this trip and he handled all of our bookings, as well as a beautiful yoga day retreat and catamaran trip. Hector J. Made this seamless and stress free which was really needed- can’t say anymore, he was amazing. Last shout out was to our breakfast omelette chef Alexandra - she was amazing, thank you for making our breakfasts delicious!
The rooms were beautiful! The hairdryer isn’t easy use bring your own! Some of the restaurants were closed during our stay which was unfortunate. The music playing around the resort was dated and needs an upgrade, was a bit repetitive. The Italian and Mexican were our favourites. Cocktails at Kicks were delicious and playing pool was fun.
Thanks for a great stay!

reviews.author: Journey759315
reviews.title: Beautiful resort! Excellent concierge service!
reviews.text:
My family and I spent December 1 through December 6 at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. We had heard really great things about the resort from our travel agent. The resort is absolutely gorgeous! We checked in at the front desk and were welcomed by an incredibly friendly staff. After getting checked in we were introduced to our concierge  Nathanael Montilla. Nathanael was AMAZING! He was incredibly nice and accommodating our entire trip and it began on day one. He started by showing us around the property and then walked us to our room and made sure we got settled in okay. This five star review is for Nathanael because without him, my review might be different. 

We had a few issues while at the resort, but Nathanael worked them out. He contacted the appropriate individuals to make sure we had everything we needed and to ensure things were "fixed" that needed attention. He was attentive and very responsive throughout our stay. Whenever I sent him a note or made a request, he responded in a timely manner and even checked back to make sure everything was taken care of. 

One issue we had was related to housekeeping. Dirty towels and washcloths were removed from our room, which was good, but washcloths were never replaced. I consistently had to cantact housekeeping to bring more and each time I called, I would get half of what I requested. I personally did not share this with my concierge since I could easily call housekeeping to get more. This is something that I feel needs to be addressed though. 

Definitely request Nathanael if you visit the resort. He will make your stay very special. This is a place that I would visit again.

reviews.author: VelezS
reviews.title: Clases de pintura !!
reviews.text: Hemos tenido una clase de pintura increíble ! Súper recomendable ! Gracias Agustín por esta clase ! Sacamos el talento oculto ! Además de relajante ! Es una actividad diferente, relajante y fácil de hacer ! El hotel está hermoso ! La comida deliciosa ! Las habitaciones muy lindas

We couldn’t fault this hotel 
5-stars all the way from the rooms to the concierge (Eriol) who made all our restaurant reservations and any thing else we needed he Was there to arrange them. He was the icing on our perfectly made cake ! 5-stars to him

reviews.author: Marecit61
reviews.title: Totalmente Recomendable!!

Recomiendo The Reserve  ,zona de solo adultos por la privacidad y el servicio exclusivo que dan los Consierge . La parte de playa donde está situado el hotel , en mi opinión, es una de las mejores . Un personal super amable y buena cocina. No se puede pedir más, solo poder volver una y otra vez.

reviews.author: Aubrey L
reviews.title: Great Getaway
reviews.text:
The food and weather was amazing!
The cleanliness is 5 star! Impressed and will return.  I would like to see the idea of a nightlife other than karaoke explored.  They have an excellent DJ during Karaoke.

reviews.author: Giselle B
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Eriol was a spectacular concierge. He always went above and beyond for us during our stay. Our visit was very special thanks to him, especially on our anniversary! He even decorated our room personally and got us a cake on our anniversary. Eriol assured that we enjoyed some activities while at the resort as well. We hope to have him again on our next visit.

reviews.author: KMM
reviews.title: Viaje inolvidable!!!
reviews.text: Muy buena estancia, personal muy amable y de gran simpatía, gran variedad de alimentos y bebidas, todo muy bien elaborados y de gran calidad. Restaurantes a la carta variados y muy atractivos con una amplia gama de platos con mucho sabor y estilo. Áreas públicas muy espaciosas y muy bien decoradas, los jardines son impresionantes así cómo la playa. La habitación era muy linda y amplia, muy bien mantenida y con reposición diaria de las bebidas del minibar. Piscinas muy espaciosas y con diferentes opciones gastronómicas. Quisiera mencionar a nuestro Conserje Dalmis, al súper Pedro en la playa siempre con un carisma sin igual y a Wanda en el bar de la piscina. Fue una muy linda experiencia. Un saludo a todos!!!

reviews.author: Kandy C
reviews.title: Una semana para repetir
reviews.text: Una semana llena de emociones y experiencias: culinarias, gastronómicas, sensaciones más allá de lo esperado , pero la gente, que decir de la gente. Nuestro conserje Dalmis, el mejor de los mejores, un servicio profesional y dedicado, al tanto de cada detalle. Gracias, gracias a todos por una semana inolvidable. No podemos dejar de mencionar a Rafael y Pedro en la playa, espectaculares los jugos de Chinola, vieron, me acordé, Hostel el señor de la parrilla del bufet, Milton que se aparece en cualquier restaurante con una sonrisa grande. Pero el abrazo más lindo para Alejandro, el chef pastelero, sin él, la experiencia no hubiese sido completa, gracias por compartir con nosotros parte de su historia, su cultura, por permitirnos conocer su país del que quedamos encantados. Dominicana nos enamoro con su encanto y Paradisus Palma Real hizo nuestros sueños realidad. Un lugar maravilloso donde su arquitecto sensorial (no me acuerdo del nombre) logra que te sientas en armonía con sus paisajes, la naturaleza y el entorno.

reviews.title: Amazing Hotel!
reviews.text:
This resort is SO beautiful and so clean. We stayed in the reserve adults only side. 

We LOVED the adults only beach service. Rafael is the best and the guy you want to see! He was attentive to us all week, setting up our towels/chairs and constantly bringing drinks. Amazing service! 

Our concierge Zenovia was fabulous. She took care of our dinner reservations and helped us with some room items. Great service and so fun and nice.

Lo mejor. El nuevo paradisus palma real es lo mejor para el relajo. Recomendado1000%
El servicio destacafo, el personal alegre aamable; la habitación maravillosa. La comida de primer nivel.

reviews.author: BA M
reviews.title: Beauty and the Beach
reviews.text: What a fantastic stay! Edgar was incredible the entire week. Always asking us what we needed. Providing shuttles, answering questions, recommending places. He was courteous, respectful and because of him we will definitely be back. Clean beach, amazing food, helpful warm staff. Rafael and Martin at the beach made sure we had loungers by the Ocean, cold beer and great laughs. What a spectacular time!

reviews.author: YammyyL
reviews.title: Una experiencia memorable
reviews.text:
El servicio en The Reserve es excelente. Su habitación es amplia, climatizada adecuadamente, con una cama súper cómoda y con el mayodormo Felix verificando cada detalle para una estadía memorable.
La comida es muy buena, principalmente en el restaurante Santé, con Estafani, Gustavo, Luz, Nilsa y demás personal atendiendo todos tus deseos y necesidades. 
Las instalaciones son de primera, con varias piscinas y el servicio en la playa con Pedro y sus compañeros aún mejor.

reviews.author: licelo02
reviews.title: Recently renovated but the staff made it memorable
reviews.text:
Full disclosure: have been a very happy owner at Melia for over 20 years.

The Palma Real, been there done that….not! Updated neutrals, suites as large as ever but grounds felt smaller which was easier to go were I wanted to go. The food plentiful and good to excellent. The staff the best ever! Now the details:

Check-in: we were early but very accommodating. The passion fruit drink to welcome us was delicious.

The Master Suite: walked into a small kitchen area with a stocked minibar and a dining table with 4 chairs. The living room was beautiful and had a comfortable full sleeper sofa. For views, see photos from living room in one room and another from the balcony of the other room. The bedroom big, comfortable with tub and double sink area. Separate shower and toilet with another sink area with access from the living room and bedroom. Great set up for dressing up. Balcony accessible from living room and bedroom. One of our units was in a building with an elevator. Thank you Anita for fulfilling all of our requests for our units in the third floor of building 6.

Uncrowded pools! since each building has its own pool, the other pools were relatively empty. None of our rooms were swim-up units. The main pool was signature Melia with a swim-up bar. There were others pools for adult only which I did not visit. All had service for drinks. At the pool closest to the Celsius bar, some snacks were served. The friendly Staff: Raul, Luis, Steven Valdez, Hansel Peguero, Jairo, and Loyda Tejeda thank you from all of us.

The beach: Warm, clean, turquoise and no seaweed which has been a problem with global warming in the Caribbean. Same staff from Celsius, same good time.

Let’s eat: the buffet plenty of options including Dominican food which were lacking in the past. Mascalzone delicious, Mina bring a big carnivorous appetite, Blue Agave wonderful. Our favorite: Tokimeku a la carte but others were enjoying the Hibachi. Wonderful sommeliers, hostesses and servers, so sorry I did not get everybody’s name. Thank you all and Mr. Edito Rondon.

Other activities: Yoga, hat making, dancing and shows after dinner, painting, tennis and so many other activities I wanted to get too but never did.

Check out: flawless. Finally, a huge thanks to our butler Ernesto Guerrero Reyes for his impecable professionalism and taking such good care of our group of 7.

So much fun, some of us are heading back December 2023.

reviews.author: Pawel S
reviews.title: Great family trip
reviews.text: The hotel was great and very clean. Food was very good, especially the steakhouse restaurant and hibachi. The beach was really nice. Service was excellent. Especially Luis from pool bar, Virginia from sports bar and Wonder from lunch restaurant were excellent!

reviews.author: Jessie C

reviews.text: Overall excellent experience for our first time at an all-inclusive resort. The room and amenities were great, and all of the food was delicious. Big shout outs to Hector, Rafael, Wanda, and all of the staff members for everything that they do.

reviews.author: mauriciocartagena
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia 5 estrellas....
reviews.text: Disfrute al maximo la estancia, lugar relajado en su mayoria adultos, segregados por categorias de membresia... las comidas muy buenas en general, me servi un TOMAHAWK de brontosaurio... muy bueno. Lo mejor su gente... en general un servicio parejo, pero destacan algunas personas como Runelys Baez, una señorita que tenia un carisma y un espiritu de servicio orientado al cliente que deberian aprender de ella, un amor de persona, cercana y preocupada de hacerte sentir comodo, tambien nuestro Concierge Starlin Tavarez, muy preocupado que no nos faltara nada, anticipando siempre, sugiriendo y haciendonos pasar unos dias de ensueño si preocupaciones. gabriel Rodriguez, que nos presento el programa y nos convencio de embarcarnos en esta aventura de disfrutar del circulo de privilegios.... Muy buen lugar.

reviews.author: Laura Lopez
reviews.title: Another Amazing Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: We’re very happy to return to Paradisus Palma Real where we got married five years ago (with our infant daughter). It’s been so nice to see Alvaro and Wanda again (and Irvin who has been really helpful). Maria at the Lunch Box has been remarkable and so caring. Milton, Raider and Ana over at Mascalzone and his team provides exceptional service (the food was delicious!) and Juan over at Rum Republic was incredible. It’s nice to be back at our home away from home. We will be back soon!

reviews.author: Sanjna K
reviews.title: Fantastic dinner!
reviews.text: Paradisus is amazing! Tonight we went to the Italian restaurant and the service from Milton was fantastic. The food was delicious, my partner had the fish was made perfectly and I had the linguine was was also very tasty. 100% recommend.

reviews.author: Brenda H
reviews.title: Fabulous and awesome trip! Such a beautiful resort!
reviews.text: I would like to thank the wonderful staff, Nicholas, Martin, Raphael and all the rest of the staff that made our stay so enjoyable. Great food, beautiful grounds and rooms. Gorgeous resort with breathtaking views. So much to do and see. Everything was fabulous! From day one till our last day here we were taking good care of. All of our needs were met and always accommodated. I will definitely come back to stay here again.

reviews.author: dina m
reviews.title: Excellent anniversary trip!
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely beautiful and the grounds are well maintained. Recent renovations have been done well and add value to the resort. The food at the buffet was ok, but all of the restaurants were delicious! The room service menu needs to be expanded a bit, at least to add pizza which should be a staple on every room service menu. Now, for the best part - the Staff. These ladies and gentlemen work very hard to make your stay wonderful! The beach crew, Martin and Raphael took wonderful care of us the entire week. Eido, our waiter most every morning was excellent! Our concierge, Nicolas, was outstanding and really treated us like family. I cannot say enough good things about the staff here, they are amazing and make you want to keep coming back. This is our first visit back since Covid and there is no doubt we will be returning. A wonderful way to spend our anniversary!

reviews.author: Scott M
reviews.title: Paradisus Beach Front Bliss
reviews.text: Our first visit back after Covid and the resort did not disappoint. The renovations recently completed have been done well. We stayed in a beach front suite with beautiful views.  The staff is friendly and works very hard to ensure you have a wonderful stay! Martin and Raphael on the beach we’re excellent, Eido was our waiter on several occasions and was also excellent, but our concierge, Nicolas went above and beyond - he is top notch and we will definitely be requesting him when we return.  We will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Hector M
reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.text: Excellent value for a very nice hotel. Friendly service   To of food variety. The oceanfront suites were fabulous. Traveled with man infant and the staff was kind and friendly with her. The pool area was comfortable and accessible

reviews.author: Marilou F
reviews.title: Dinner at Flora!
reviews.text: Dinner at Flora was amazing! People were So kind! Food and drinks were amazing and they even prepared us a special table since we arrived at an occupied time. Amazing service and staff, will not forget this dinner soon as it was our last one here at Melia Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Chloe M
reviews.title: Sante restaurant - highlight of trip
reviews.text: I went to the Paradisus Palma Real with my mother for a relaxing vacation. We stayed in the Reserve, which I highly recommend. In the Reserve you have access to restaurant Santé. Each morning we ate at Santé sitting by the pool, with excellent service and food. Gustavo greeted us with a smile, was attentive to our needs, and made excellent coffee/juices/drinks. We looked forward to seeing him each morning. I highly recommend this resort

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Our dreamed Honey moon
reviews.text:
We came for our honeymoon, and it truly was an incredible experience from check-in to check-out. The quality of service, the friendliness of the staff, and our concierge, Zenobia, made our stay more enjoyable. We opted for "The Reserve" in the exclusive adults-only area, highly recommended for the tranquility and exclusivity of the services. The rooms were very well-equipped, and the restaurant options were excellent. The "Destination" excursion was very pleasant, and we also participated in a fun painting cultural activity to learn more about the Dominican Republic's culture.

There was one instance when they didn't refill the snacks, but when we mentioned it, they took care of it the next day. They took a bit longer to bring the robes and slippers, but they eventually did.

The support staff provided excellent service for carrying and picking up our luggage, even securing an umbrella on a rainy night to guide us to our room.

reviews.author: Darcey M
reviews.title: Best trip ever
reviews.text:
Outstanding grounds and service the staff is simply amazing especially Jose Sepulveda and Katherine can not recommend enough 
The pools and beach are beautiful and I can not wait to come back soon hopefully next year

reviews.author: Blago H
reviews.title: Vacay
reviews.text:
Julio treated very well, good guy, very detailed and friendly!!!

He resolved our concerns and helped us with reservations.

He was very helpful and treated us well, he is a true professional!

Julio was awesome!!

reviews.author: Julio C J
reviews.title: Gracias Delvin y Engel por el excelente trato.
reviews.text: Un servicio excelente por todo el personal del hotel. Muy buena comida y un trato muy amable de las personas que nos atendieron en el restaurante Mexicano. Gracias a Delvin and Engel. Mi deseo es de regresar pronto.

reviews.author: Misael D
reviews.title: Mejor experiencia en República Dominicana.
reviews.text:
Una de las mejores experiencias que he tenido en muchos años.  Paradisus Palma Real nos brindó atenciones que realmente excedieron expectativas. 

En especial quiero reconocer a Delvin y Engel en el restaurante Mexicano, ambos son unas súper estrellas.  De verdad que no quisiera irme de este paraíso. 

Gracias por todas las atenciones.  Definitivamente recomiendo el hotel.

reviews.author: Albert pichardo
reviews.title: The Best Great Experience
reviews.text: Waoooo tremenda experiencia en este hotel y sobre todo les recomiendo el restaurant Blue Agave, un Excellente trato y un servicio muy profesional. A la Excelencia 🙌💪. Gracias a Delvin por ser tan profesional y El chef Ángel por la excelente atención y calidad de la comida. 101% recomendado

reviews.author: daniela lizbeth r
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel!!!!
reviews.text:
Hotel lindisimo! Varias opciones de restaurantes y bares, hotel a orilla de playa, servicio inigualable. 100% recomendable. 
Cuenta con área de solo adultos y atributo the reserve (exclusividad) donde hay servicio de mayordomo. Te atienden excelentemente, un agradecimiento especial a Edgar quien fue siempre atento.

reviews.author: A P
reviews.title: Resort is beautiful & Sante Delicate Cooking staff was excellent
reviews.text: Loved the resort!   It is beautiful & clean.   We were with a very large group…. With that said it was hard to get into any restaurant with reservations.   As always with being out of USA, if you tip you get better service at resort.   Staff was always friendly & Helpful.   The crew at Sante’s made my husbands birthday so special.     They were a blast actually… they had the best time singing & dancing happy birthday to my husband.  They brought a cake out.   Thank you to Jose, Amanda, Daniela, Sanyi & Nilza for a fun dinner & celebration.

reviews.author: Alex I
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We were a group of 9 - 4 adults and 5 kids. Overall experience was great. Special thanks to Loyda with the beach services. She made our time. Always helped with getting our place ready, brought us towels and drinks were coming all the time. She is the nicest person ever!

reviews.author: Leonela C
reviews.title: Buenísimo fin de semana
reviews.text: Mi familia y yo estuvimos en paradisus palmar real por el fin de semana largo, lo amamos. Disfrutamos muchísimo!! nos encanto nuestro tipo de habitación swim up tranquilo para compartir y en las noches en el sport bar buenisimooo. Gracias a nuestro mayordomo Osvaldo por ayudarnos con nuestras cenas, éramos muchos y el nos acomodó a todos. La primera noche cenamos en el japonés con un show buenísimo Victor nos hizo la noche y la última noche fuimos al Italiano delicioso. GRACIAS 🤍

reviews.author: Howie M
reviews.title: Nice week away
reviews.text:
Just returned from a great 1 week stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.
My wife and I were in The Reserve Oceanfront section.
Check in was easy and we were in our room within 45 minutes of arrival.
Although only half of our balcony could see the ocean, it was fine and the room was nice (8204).
The staff at The Paradisus is great and we were well taken care of.
Irvin, our concierge, made all of our dinner reservations and kept us informed of the days activities.
He also helped us out on our last full day by helping to make sure our transport to the airport was taken care of.
The representative on site was not much help.
We ate breakfast and lunch at the Santé restaurant and we were well taken care of by Franklin and all of the staff.
All of the restaurants were good and took care of my wife who is allergic to gluten.
For Dinner we ate at Santé, Flora, Japanese (Hibachi & regular), Mexican (Blue Agave) The Steakhouse (Mina) and Italian (Mas Calzone).
Days were spent on the beach and it was very easy to get a spot (we had the same spot everyday and only got down to the beach around 10:30 each morning).
Gilberto, at the beach bar, and Jayson & Raphael making sure we had towels and drinks made for great days.
The first day there was lots of seaweed (windy and red flags for beach), but they cleaned it up and there was very little the rest of the week.
The resort is very nice and it was very quiet (for the most part).
The ladies at the Spa were good and the entire staff was pleasant during our stay.
It was a little hard to get change for tips, so bring plenty of small bills.
All in all, a very nice place.

reviews.author: Cristian R
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
El hotel muy bien,si eres socio circle tienes muchas más ventajas .
Quería destacar el trato del personal ,de los restaurantes,por ejemplo en de bluegave quiero destacar a Santi Acosta y a Melvin .
En el italiano pasa lo mismo.
Las piscinas una pasada.
El personal de la ludoteca ,han sido de gran ayuda,ya que nuestra hija  de 4 años se lo pasaba de maravilla cada día unas horas.

reviews.author: NorthStar28456208001
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - The Reserve
reviews.text:
El mejor servicio que he tenido en un hotel todo incluido. Eriol fué mi concerge durante mi estancia, me brindo un servicio excepcional. Me hizo reservas en los restaurantes que le pedi y fué muy servicial con cualquier solicitud que tuve.  
La comida de los restaurantes temáticos muy rica. El restaurante Santé exclusivo para adultos en The Reserve muy bueno. 

El servicio de limpieza de la habitación excelente.

El servicio de la playa bueno. Las tumbonas súper cómodas. Una de las personas que me atendió en la playa lo hizo de manera excelente.  El otro compañero que atiende en la playa no tan bueno, tuve una experiencia un poco desagradable con él,  esto se  lo reporte a mi concerge. Apenas lo reporte cambió su actitud de manera positiva. Los dias siguientes si me dió una buena atención en la playa. 

La playa estuvo bien. Buena idea que el hotel tenga malla para prevenir que el sargazo entre a la costa. De 8 dias que estuve, me tocaron solo 2 dias con un poco de sargazo y basura. El primer dia vi que un tractor recogia el sargazo, parte lo mezclaba con la arena, pero  otro parte lo tiraba frente al mar donde nos correspondia bañarnos. Lo que hizo que ese dia fuera imposible bañarnos frente a la playa que nos correspondía . Lo que deben hacer es enterrar ese sargazo, no devolverlo al mar. El otro dia,después de una noche de lluvia, la playa amanecio con algo sargazo y botellas, me sorprendió que el hotel no tuviera personal encargado de recoger la basura ese mismo dia. Alguien lo hizo al dia siguiente. No se si la limpieza de esa area le corresponde al hotel o al gobierno, pero el hotel, buscando el bienestar de los clientes, deberia hacer algo al respecto.

Yo decidi bañarme en la playa  un poco más hacia la derecha de mi hotel, frente a otro hotel (de la misma cadena Meliá) donde el area estaba cubierta cln mas mallas y la playa estaba más limpia.

reviews.author: Almudena C
reviews.title: Una magnífica atención en un gran hotel
reviews.text: Una gran experiencia, todo en la habitación perfecto, al igual que las piscinas, la playa ...Y ello gracias en gran parte a Héctor, el concierge, que me ayudó en cualquier cosa que pudiera necesitar, reservando en restaurantes, ocupándose del check-in, localizando taxis...en todo. Gracias!

reviews.author: Clint P
reviews.title: Georgi is the best.
reviews.text: Blue Agave is great. Georgi is the best!! Good food, great drinks. Derny the bartender is top notch.The service is top notch from top to bottom. I would highly recommend anyone visit here if you have a chance.

reviews.author: barret s
reviews.title: Best experience!
reviews.text: Blue Agave is awesome! Georgi was fantastic! He makes you feel relaxed and welcome ! He was great ! Excellent waiter and he made experience was great ! It was an excellent experience and the food was and the bartender Deeny  was great !

reviews.author: stefanie h
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
My friend and I booked this trip last minute and we are so glad we did- we did a Sunday-Thursday and booked the reserve/adults only accommodations. From the moment we got to the resort the staff was amazing! Irvin our concierge was SO helpful! He made all of our dinner reservations, made recommendations, checked in everyday via text and sent the daily activities to us. We decided not to do any of the offered excursions but there were plenty to chose from. Jonathan at the pool bar took care of us all day serving great cocktails! All
Of our dinners were wonderful but I highly recommend you make reservations at the winery. Here you can buy a good bottle of wine and then order your food from any of the restaurants available. They do a meat board from Mina the steak house and the steak was outstanding, cooked to perfection! Jonathan, Jhonathan and Maximo are so helpful at the winery and will give wine recommendations if needed. Another gem is the bar Ginger. They make the best espresso martinis and have coffee 24/7. There was plenty of live music and entertainment every night but If you are looking for a club you won’t find that here. We are already planning to go back in 2024- the only things we would do differently is stay longer so we can do an excursion or 2 and go at a different time of year. We would like to be with a more lively crowd- it was on the quieter side and we believe it’s because the time of year we went.

reviews.author: LizM149_73
reviews.title: Did not want to leave this paradise
reviews.text: Our experience with this hotel was beyond wonderful.  The hotel itself was stunning and looked like something out of a movie or magazine spread.  From check in to departure, our stay was amazing from beginning to end.  From our amazingly comfortable and spacious room, to the many pools, the gorgeous beach,  great entertainment, delicious food and so much more, we never wanted to leave.  Most notable was the brilliant staff.  We were spoiled with an amazing concierge (Yaleidi) and spoiled again with the breakfast  and lunch staff, who after the first day already knew our orders.  This hotel experience is not to be missed.  I'd live there if I could.

reviews.author: Xabier L
reviews.title: Días tranquilos
reviews.text: Buen hotel en cuanto a las habitaciones y toda la zona de un piscina y playa con una buena atención por el personal y sobre todo por el mayordomo A.Eriol que en todo momento estuvo pendiente de nosotros para la reserva de restaurante y las actividades programadas

reviews.author: Shawna
reviews.title: Chef Oscar is PHENOMENAL
reviews.text: Chef Oscar is AMAZING! My sister-n-love and brother celebrated their 12th wedding anniversary. Her husband is from Jamaica  and he arranged to have Chef Oscar cook Escovitch and it taste like authentic Jamaican. We couldn't have been more thrilled.

reviews.author: Meghan
reviews.title: Amazing service at The Winery
reviews.text: Our experience at The Winery was amazing thanks to the exceptional service from Maximo and Juan!! If you’re staying here you should make a reservation! We had a delicious dinner from the Italian restaurant and 2 fantastic bottles of wine.

reviews.author: Pablo C
reviews.title: Gracias por todos al área de los maleteros estamos muy encantados de su servicio especialmente Miguel de la Rosa y Juanl
reviews.text: Gracias por todos al área de los maleteros estamos muy encantados de su servicio especialmente Miguel de la Rosa y Juanlly robles siempre muy atentos con la maleta al momento de la llegada fue algo Super encantador Gracias por todo chicos

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: On our recommended list
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent 2nd week of October at the Paradisus and we had a great time. I'll skip repeating what others have already mentioned multiple times in other reviews and just add our own humble observations:

We stayed in a Nikte Master swim up suite # 9316 which was very near the beach and bars/restaurants ( 75 second walk) . We always prefer to to be as close to the beach / restaurants as possible because it reduces travel time and made it convenient to travel between room / pool/ restaurant/ beach through out the day

- Surprisingly there were very few mosquitos on the Nikte / family side of the resort indoor or outdoors ( wife gets severe reaction to bites so we brought our own plug in bug killer for the room but we only had 2 mosquitos during the week) . However one afternoon we walked through the reserve side of the resort and she got several bites in 15 minutes which I suspect is due to the heavier garden foliage on the Reserve side .
- Ironically the Nikte/ family side of the resort was only at about  20% occupancy that week , but the Reserve/ adult side was much busier so it was actually much quieter at the family pools / beach / bars then on the adult side so keep this in mind when travelling when schools are not on holidays
- Many places are banning plastic cups/ straws / utensils / bags so we actually brought our own stash and that came in useful
- The best coffee/ smoothies / frapaccinos / cocktails were from Ginger Lobby Bar which is open 24/7  
- The gym is small but it was only busy early mornings
- Food was fine ( they don't over laden with salt/ suger  like we're used to in North America) surprisingly the best meal I had the entire week was at the buffet when the chefs cooked up a giant seafood Paella with lobster tails! 
- You can gift anything to staff but just write on label so everyone knows. Staff left snacks and alcohol everyday in our room that we didn't touch so we would just bag it and gift it to various staff with handwritten sharpie notes ( we also tipped generously )
- Not much happening after 9 pm because demographics are mostly families / middle age and seniors ( I'm almost retired) 
- As others have noted Paradisus very regimented about 3pm check in so we picked flights which arrived and departed in afternoon so we wouldn't have to wait for room. This is were Paradisus could improve by allowing more flexibility for check in/out
- A few staff are "not engaged", not surprising after pandemic experience same dynamic everyone sees back in North America. Keep in mind the average wage in DR is 2 to 4 $ per hour and they work 6 days per week. Also many only see their families every 2 weeks because they live far from home so have some empathy and tip well if you can afford too!
- Overall we had a great time and we felt the swim up suite was worth extra cost because of easy access to pool. We both wanted to rest after long work hours so Paradisus was perfect. Thanks for reading!

reviews.author: conamatcynthiaol2023
reviews.title: Cadena de hoteles Melia
reviews.text: Me encantan los hoteles e instalaciones de esta cadena, pero la verdad el servicio y atención de Playa del Carmen es mejor que en Punta Cana, lo que destacó de Palma Real son los extras que tienen para los socios del circle.

reviews.author: AmanecuvS9245TG
reviews.title: Lugar onde realizei meu casamento dos sonhos.
reviews.text: Não poderia ter escolhido lugar melhor para o dia mais importante da minha vida neste ano de 2022, meu casamento. Este resort faz jus ao nome, realmente um paraíso, e o serviço de concierge cuidou de todos os detalhes da cerimônia da nossa data de união. A experiência já começou na chegada ao aeroporto, mesmo antes de chegar ao Resort. A única coisa que tenho a dizer, foi até então o melhor dia das nossas vidas. O agradecimento é geral e a todos, por isso seria injustiça escrever um nome só, se todos merecem ser reconhecidos pelo excelente serviço prestado para que este dia fosse perfeito.  Casamento para mim é para a vida toda, e o nosso foi feito com vocês. Não é preciso dizer nada mais sobre um resort com tudo incluído, que possui nada mais nada menos do que 12 restaurantes. Obrigado por tudo.

reviews.author: MACARENA R
reviews.title: Excelente!! Para siempre volver solo a Melia
reviews.text: El restaurant mediterráneo es impresionante!!! La atención de primer nivel!! Mención especial para Franclyn quien nos atendió con una sonrisa y eficiencia y mucha dedicación tanto en el desayuno como en las comidas, el es mozo en el restaurant Mediterráneo !! Lo felicito!! También a nuestra con Sergio Zenovia, sin ella nada hubiese sido igual nos hizo los días aun más agradables!!

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Great Experiences at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We are members at the Circle Resort Club that operates the Paradisus Palma Real and some other resorts that are nearby. The real estate is beautifully landscaped and the buildings beautifully architected and well constructed. Everything is clean and the resort is well-enough appointed where you can eat at a different restaurant every night if your stay- and enjoy every meal. The entertainment and activities are lots of fun - like a slice of cirque du soleil- very classy! The entertainment and the wonderful people that serve your food and drinks and keep that place going made us want to join. It’s a great all inclusive experience with all the amenities. It’s on the beach and has great pool action. The rooms are nice but you can hear your neighbors a lot. Tips are not required but are well-deserved and appreciated. Spanish is spoken by everyone but my wife and i only speak English- and we manage just fine. We love Paradisus Palma Real.  Juan Castillo, our expert concierge makes sure our vacations flow perfectly and are stress-free. Even the airport experience was smooth. Thanks Juan! Gracias mi Amigos a Paradisius Palma Real y Circle by Melia!

reviews.author: Evelyn L
reviews.title: Un sueño hecho realidad
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y buenas instalaciones. 
Los camareros son muy amigables y respetuosos. La verdad, volvería cua do tenga vacaciones de nuevo. 
Naomi, nuestra camarera , se portó por encima de nuestras expectativas en el restaurante Flora.

reviews.author: Sorivel lassis
reviews.title: Super
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y buena comida buena servicio a la habitación con buena y atención 
Nos atendió Frankiln bautista en el italiano muy servicial y atento y siempre todo el equipo con una sonrisa y en todo momento atentos a nuestro mesa

reviews.author: Vileysi E
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente sus instalaciones y el servicio es de muy buena calidad. Las atenciones de nuestro concierge Héctor Rodriguez fue fenomenal, atento a que cada detalle para que nuestra estancia sea la mejor.

reviews.author: Pirata1934
reviews.title: Paradise at Pardisus Punta Cana Resort
reviews.text: My wife and I just spent a week at Paradisus Punta Cana Resort and it is a beautiful place with great people. We had a great time and were very happy with the way were treated by all the staff there. I highly recommend this resort. We stayed on the adult only side. We would have breakfast everyday at Sante where the captain Adoni and the waiters Franklin, Gusatvo and Luz Villas where just fantastic and the food was great. We also had dinner there one night and it was fantastic. We had the pleasure of speaking with Krisy Nuñuz and Caren Disla in the Circle office they were very helpful in getting us all the information we needed. Juan Vicente and Maria who are the bartenders in the bar that is between Blue Agave and Mina steakhouse are great and make a mean mamajuana Passion make sure you have at least one! We got to the Blue Agave one night a little late for our dinner reservation and Santo Avila Castillo made sure we got a table right away and treated us like royalty, Thank you again Santo! Francy Javier who is one of the chefs at Blue Agave is amazing the food is just great and Virtudes Mercedes who waited on us was so nice. We did have a problem one night with the lock in our room but we called the front desk and Carlos Mendez and Rayman from security came right over and fixed it right away and got us on our way. We also saw lots of friendly faces like Veronica who we saw many times on this trip as well as when we were at Falcons in August. We also had a couples massage at the Yhi eco spa and it was so incredibly relaxing and enjoyable. Alba Martinez who works at the spa was great answering all our questions and showing us what was available for us to do there. Finally I would like to give a special thanks to Daniel Dominguez who was just great giving us information and guidance while we were there and Gabrielle Bobadilla who helped us out when we had a little hiccup on our trip.

reviews.author: dijoebers
reviews.title: Excelente vacaciones
reviews.text: El hotel cuenta con excelente personal, facilidades y ubicación. Tiene accesible la playa con personal disponible en todo momento para satisfacer tus gustos y necesidades. Recomiendo a cualquier persona que desee pasarla bien en Punta Cana.

reviews.author: DeniseM245
reviews.title: October visit
reviews.text:
It was an amazing visit to one of our favorite Meliá properties.  It was Memberfest!  
We have been Meliá vacation club members for 20 years.  We have never had a disappointing vacation .  All their properties are beautiful, comfortable and the staff is friendly and accommodating.  
This particular visit was more than exceptional.  The Memberfest Celebration exceeded any expectations.  Glorious!

reviews.author: Felix M
reviews.title: Member's fest
reviews.text: World class facilities, really nice beaches and pools; and friendly staff. The resort needs to improve the reservation systems for rooms, restaurants, and events in order to make a perfect vacation. I've have a very good time!

reviews.author: jennifercI9105DR
reviews.title: MembersFest 2023 WAS AMAZING
reviews.text:
We had a great time at MembersFest 2023.
The staff is warm and welcoming. Always willing to go above and beyond.
Even before we arrived, our pre-arrival service team (Marcello, Wilmer, Aris and Katia) were always in contact with us to make sure our room was prepared to our needs.

We stayed in the 1 bedroom master suite on the 3rd floor. The room was very spacious and very clean. The first thing we saw was our welcome drinks and dessert in our room (wine and chocolates). After walking around the room I saw the beautiful welcome gifts(silk robes, big beach hat, baseball cap, recyled cotton shawl, a Yeti Insulated Bottle, Hugo Boss Notebook and Pen and a bamboo fan...all in a beautiful cotton rope basket). We got a beach tote bag to use around the resort. We also received Sothys products. Wow!!! Of course these items were part of this special MembersFest Event. The regular amenities in the room: Nespresso machine, fridge stocked with drinks (Heineken, Presidente and Corona beers, Coca Cola and Sprite, sparkling and regular water and juices) and snacks (Lays chips, Plaintain chips, M&Ms and Oreos). The bathroom had Biology hand wash, lotion, shampoo and conditioner. It also had cotton pads and swabs, shower cap and toothbrush and paste. Hair dryer and steamer instead of an iron.

The food & drinks were very good. We enjoyed Brisas and Mina the most. We really enjoyed the steaks and fresh fruits! Our wait staff at Brisas, Jose, Oswaldo and Laicha were very attentive and always welcomed us with a smile. The restaurant manager, Hector was always willing to hear our feedback and very helpful when we had issues with mosquitos. (which had nothing to do with food) He got us some natural insect repellant!!! I also want to thank Melvin who recognized us from our last stay. He too was very attentive even though the farewell brunch didn't start for a half hour. He welcomed us and brought us coffee and juice anyway. The juices were always fresh squeezed and if they weren't they were sure to let us know. Kanna Beach restaurant: I wish they would bring back the baja tacos (fried fish tacos). They were amazing.

We went for Membersfest Week. They really did a great job with the events. Ivette Sanchez and her team (Linda, Sarah, Gabriel, Krisy, Alenny, there are others too) did a fantastic job on all the events and making us feel so special. We had hat painting, canvas painting, Larimar jewelry making, chocolate experience (and they surprised us in our room with special package filled with chocolates and passionfruit honey...WOW!), the golf event (included a kit in our room with caps, shirts and golf balls), the Sunset Boat Cruise and the beautiful dinner galas! They were all amazing. Our concierge was very attentive. While there were a few hiccups, A.Eriol was quick to address them. He even set up a farewell surprise for us on our last evening (Wine and chocolates and a bubble bath with beautiful floating flowers). Even on our last day when our transportation was late, he stayed with us (almost 20 minutes late) until we got into the car, knowing we were a bit nervous. Christian Felix, Carlos Traveras and Carlos Roca have always made us feel welcome with their warm smiles and always willing to hear our suggestions (even though they are on the Sales Team) At the Infinite Black Lounge, we would sit around and play board games and the staff (Giesel and others) would come by to say hi or ask if we needed anything. The massages I got at Palma Real was excellent. Laylet was so good I asked for her again. Cons: I didn't truly like the massage and facial special over at Falcon's Maia. The person who sold us on this package mis-represented what we would get. I wanted a deep tissue massage and clarifying facial but was told I would only get the relaxing massage and just a basic facial. Dinner at Flora was not typical of the resort. We had a very late reservation (9:30pm). The staff wasn't very attentive and when we asked about dessert around 10:30 at first they said they would bring a menu but then after a bit they said the kitchen closed at 10 and we would need to go somewhere else to get dessert. We pointed out that the table with a large party just got their parade of desserts. We couldn't seem to get our message through so we had to forgo dessert.

reviews.author: Gloria G
reviews.title: Perfect Relaxation
reviews.text:
Time spent October 14 - October 23
Our room was a swim up Junior Suite Facing the Morning Sun.
All staff at the resort were great.  Ready to help in any way they can. 
But standing out was definitely our concierge Edger.  From the arrival to the departure he was always helpful.  Making all our dinner reservations, making sure we were on time for excursions and just general conversion - Thank you Edger.
The swimup was always clean and pool always looked after to make sure the water was up to standards.  Not a lot of people using it but was great for me and my husband, seemed to have the pool to ourselves most days.  And oh my gosh the bar staff were tremendous.  Julia and Erickson.    Most of the days Julia was our waitress - always made sure we had plenty of drinks, great conversation and always  looked after in one way or another.  Thank you both for making our holiday a great one.
The meals were good. Edger would make our reservations, confirm our reservation, and confirm our reservations again.  We would get to the restaurant and have no reservations or reservation somewhere else.  This happened twice to us.  Lucky for us Sante and the beach both fit us in.   Thinking it is not fault of Edger but It is very frustrating to look forward to a dinner and have no reservations when you apparently had reservations.   We had many banquets to attend so we didn’t get to try out many of the restaurants.  We had a couple of dinners at Sante and Romantic dinner on the beach which were very very good. 
The resort staff keep the resort very clean.  Bathrooms were always clean and pathways were garbage free.  Great job!    The beach was clean and not much seaweed but that may be because of the time of the year.
We did have a massage at the spa.  It was great.  Thank you Dorka.
The only thing that we would complain about is our room was a joining room to a master suite and our neighbours were very noisy during the wee hours of the morning and sounded like they were right in the room.  It would be nice if a bit of sound proofing could be done.
Thank you to all the staff working at the resort.
Would we go back to Palma Real - definitely!!!!

reviews.text:

The Crew is amazing, they made sure I was always Happy and enjoyed every moment during my stay. All the activities were very well organized and executed. Everyday was so much FUN.

I am looking forward to the Fest 2024 and expecting it to be filled with more surprises and more fun activities!!!!

reviews.author: Maykol A
reviews.title: Maravilloso!
reviews.text: Hemos ido varias veces como miembros a los hoteles de Melia en Punta Cana sin embargo fue nuestra primera estadía en el palma real y he de decir que MariaElisa Nuñez hizo de nuestra estadía un tiempo maravilloso. Su servicio como concierge fue excelente!!! Muy rápido y eficiente. La comunicación que tuvimos fue el éxito de unas vacaciones inolvidables.

reviews.author: chiom
reviews.title: excelente hotel
reviews.text: nuestro hotel preferido de mi familia, todos son muy amables, mi conserge excelente JUAN CASTILLO, siempre muy atento con nuestro pedidos, tuvimos unas vacaciones hermosas, disfrutamos mucho el MEMBER FEST

reviews.author: Ambar D
reviews.title: Comodidad y tranquilidad
reviews.text: Me encantó mi estadía, todo super limpio, privacidad, muy buena atención del personal en especial al mayordomo Kelvin,las habitaciones espaciosas , la comida excelente, Me gusto mucho la piscina y la playa , todo está súper cerca, no hay que caminar mucho para ir a los restaurantes o a la playa. reviews.text: Loved the flora restaurant. Jerk chicken was so good and our server Eduardo was very attentive with our needs. We had a very pleasant experience and we would go back. We loved the cornbread dessert after dinner too.

reviews.title: Un fin de semana inolvidable
reviews.text: Jordania el servicio es excelente. Los empleados muy amable y atentos. La habitación es muy preciosa. La comida también excelente y sobre todo variedad . Pronto regresaré a este maravilloso hotel junto a mi familia

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Punta Cana Perfection
reviews.text: We stayed 10 days at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was simply amazing.  We loved Jhon at the Bell Desk who went out of his way to make sure we were greeted by name every time we arrived back on property from golf.  Not to mention our concierge team of Fransisco and Juan who were simply awesome. They made our dinner reservations and kept us informed of all daily activities. Francisco even drove off property twice to pick up large bandages that covered a nasty gash I got on an off site island tour.  If you are planning a trip to Punta Cana, this is definitely the place to stay.

reviews.author: Iris S
reviews.title: Fahrenheit bar en Palma Real
reviews.text: El servicio en Fahrenheit bar es excelente. Wanda y Yuderi dan el máximo para complacerte y hacer que tus vacaciones sean especiales. Su hospitalidad y amabilidad siempre están al nivel máximo. Les recomiendo este lugar para disfrutar y pasarla super.

reviews.author: Elizabeth A
reviews.title: An Excellent and much needed little get away to Paradise!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is a Beautiful and well maintained resort.  This was my second time there and it's a great get away!  The first time there, last April, the restaurant choices were definitely more abundant.  Not sure why so many restrictions on who can use certain restaurants, but the restaurants that we were able to get reservations at were all Wonderful!  Especially Flora, a newer Dominican restaurant.  I'm amazed at the cleanliness and well maintained property!  The pools all glimmer & sparkle ...the pool bars are plentiful and the staff throughout the entire resort are so accommodating!  A Great place for total Rest & Relaxation, and the night life and entertainment are Fabulous too!

reviews.author: chrissykoennecker
reviews.title: Great trip to the Dominican!
reviews.text: We loved our trip to Paradisus Palma Real. There were 6 of us and we thoroughly enjoyed the week. Relaxation by the pool and a trip to the spa.  Food is always exceptional. Our concierges (Jose Simeon and Fernando ) were fabulous. They did a great job keeping on top of everything for the week.

reviews.author: Laura Montalban
reviews.title: Super resort
reviews.text: Todo genial ,un gran resort y nuestro concierge Cristian de lo mejor que nos hemos encontrado ,desde el primer momento se ha adelantado a nuestras necesidades y nos ha ayudado a relajarnos ,cada noche nos decía donde y a qué hora era la cena ,simplemente fantástico, todos los días venía a vernos por si necesitábamos algo .

reviews.author: Peter A
reviews.title: Highly recommend for a honeymoon!
reviews.text: My wife and I just stayed here for a week for our honeymoon and had an amazing stay at the Reserve. Every morning Martin, Pedro and Gilberto were extremely kind and attentive while we relaxed at the beach! Pedro made sure we had a perfect spot set up with towels, and Martin and Gilberto never had us waiting for a drink. They were awesome. Back at the reserve pool, Yuderi made every afternoon an awesome time with excellent service, drinks and kindness. At the main pool bar, Jonathan served up smiles and some of the best drinks we’ve ever had! Luis and the rest of the bar staff were also excellent. Throughout our stay we had so many meals with extremely kind waitstaff like Misael at Sante, Luis at Lunchbox and everywhere else. Lastly our concierge Fernando was extremely kind, helpful and made sure we had an amazing stay! Overall the location and the staff throughout the resort made our honeymoon everything we could have wanted. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Bill L
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: There have been many times we have gone to paradise Palma Real. This was 1 of the best trips we have ever had. The people were amazing starting with the hotel manager mister Alberto. His staff including his opinion JuanCarlos Juan Pena and Francisco cannot do enough for you. Anytime you saw them day or night they will come greet you and ask him how your day is going. We stayed at the reserve the room were just remodel and they are beautiful    we had to swim up suite that was amazing. It let us to a bar that our friend Wanda was still the bartender If you go there please make sure you have a Wanda special.   We had a lot of time to spend with a young lady named Stephanie She also was 1 of the managers. This young lady knew what you wanted to do before you did that much on top of her job.    The restaurant manager his name  is Hipalito. We saw him morning noon night and he always had a smile on his face and make sure you had quality food.  Another manager we met his name was Jessie he's in charge of the rooms Like the others always there to help. Insane that 1 of the managers under him Mary Lisa    she was in charge of the butlers.1 of the couples that came with us flight was delayed and they got in about 930 at night she went out of her way to make sure they could get a hot meal before they turned in for the night.   The gentlemen around the pool was also very helpful. His name was Edgar it did not matter if you wanted a coke a sprite work cocktail he may sure he brought it to you with a smile on his face. Always make sure you had enough tiles and if you wanted a day bed he make sure you had that also.  The beach is beautiful very wide with many a day beds on it also. There are many choices for restaurants from the steakhouse to seafood to just a quick buffet and bleach me the buffets are also outstanding. So did not matter what you wanted snack or a full meal there's always something there for you to enjoy as a matter of fact they would bring snacks around the pool such as little pc of melon To make sure that you have something to snack on.    1 of the massage ladies her name is Gladys would come around the pool give you a 5 minute or so neck rub or shoulder rub and invite you to come for a full massage believe me it was well worth the 90 minutes you spent with her.  The entertainment very good in the evening.   Every night there was something different in the main area around the restaurants.  I could go on and on to how great this location is. But I think I said enough when we already Planning our trip for April. I hope to see you there again 1 of the best trips we've ever had

reviews.author: Annoynmous
reviews.title: Resort and concierge
reviews.text:
