reviews.author: Babil Delgado
reviews.title: Kids Dom Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: El kids Dom para niños está genial, muy limpio y con bastantes opciones de ocio. Tenemos dos niños, estuvimos una semana en el hotel y quedaron encantados tanto ellos como nosotros. El personal nos dió mucha confianza, sobre todo Martha, Jenny y Susu 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: Bertha S
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: We had butler service and Ralphy was fantastic. Gave us his cell number, checked in on us twice a day and whenever we needed ANYTHING, he was on it. Martin was our dedicated person at the beach. He saved us seats every morning with towels in place. Got us drinks throughout the day and always service with a smile.

reviews.author: Lenin G
reviews.title: The Reserve Experience is Impeccable
reviews.text:
This was my second time this year. Originally went in June on a whim after seeing beautiful pictures and the kind of experience I wanted -- Adults Only.

I went again this time to celebrate my birthday. I went in with no expectations and I feel like it exceeded even my wildest dreams of how it would've gone. I ended up making friends with people from Scotland, Chile, Argentina, and Canada.

The staff are attentive and friendly. If you stay on The Reserve (Adults Only) side, then you have to go to Wanda at the bar between the pool and the beach. She's always smiling and a good time. She has different servers working there, Yuriel (I called him Barahona) is attentive and funny.

The swim-up bar pool on The Reserve side I was served by Nathanael and Rosanna. I had one of the best times there. They were both great --  drinks flowing, dancing, joking. Just an incredible time, couldn't have asked for better.

In the Plaza you'll find Manuela working either the Tanqueray or Titos bar carts. You can't go wrong with either drink and Manuela is there to take care of you.

Santo killed it at Flora with my surprise bday cake. He went out of his way with making the night spectacular and memorable. Smile on his face and ready to make your night as amazing as it can be. Flora in general is delicious, it's my fave restaurant there. You have to try the octopus! tender on the inside and crispy/crunchy on the outside.

Our concierge was Alvaro. I cannot say enough good things about him. He is top tier. Above and beyond.

Overall, the place is magical. Make friends with people all over the world. Have the friendliest and most helpful staff. Eat delicious food (ceviche is a must). Drinks flowing. Beautifully located in front of a white sand beach.

reviews.author: Doug R
reviews.title: Incredible Experience
reviews.text:
Traveled with a group of friends for a birthday trip and we were in the reserve (adults only) section. Honestly, the whole experience was incredible. Our concierge Alvaro made sure to get our restaurants booked and even arranged special surprises for my friends birthday. There were 3 adults only pools, one with a swim up bar where we had a great time with Natanael and received great service.

At the pool bar Wanda and Yuderi were a godsend and were always there to make sure we had drinks and were having fun. They were incredible!

The restaurants were very good. My personal favorites were the French toast at Santé for breakfast. The Italian restaurant was also pretty good, but Flora was probably the best. The Chivo Guisado was very good, but the attentive service by Santo there was even better.

Would come back.

reviews.author: Helen W
reviews.title: Great Vacation Experience
reviews.text:
Our vacation at the Melia Paradisus Resort more than exceeded our expectations.   Everything we needed or wanted to do was made so much easier and trouble-free with the assistance of our awesome concierge Claritzel Otanez.  She was very friendly, professional, knowledgeable and accommodating.  Claritzel is an asset to their organization.  We'll look for her whenever we return to Punta Cana.
Helen West

reviews.author: Michaela H
reviews.title: Paradisus paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, wonderful staff, great food and service. Trip tailored to your liking. Luxurious experience. Juan Carlos, Martin, Isaias, Wanda, and all the staff are exceptional. Great views. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Orisel B
reviews.title: I’d give it 6 stars if I could.
reviews.text: This place is amazing. Everyone from Alvaro (our personal concierge) to Wanda, Yuderi, Grey and Gilberto at the poolside bar were wonderful. Do yourself a favor and come here to find out for yourself.

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.title: Fun vacation with the family!
reviews.text:
Greaaaaattttt food, rooms and experiences :) The restaurant “Floral” is really good. The hotel is beautiful and the sports bar is fun. 

thank you for the great time! I’m looking forward to visiting again.

Jordania, was so helpful and kind! She was always willing to assist with our dinner needs and excursion needs!

reviews.author: Lily

reviews.text: Nos hospedamos para celebrar el cumpleaños de nuestro hijo y la pasamos super! Quedamos encantados con la comodidad de las habitaciones, el lujo y las amenidades fueron fantasticas. reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Italian restaurant
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Raider and Milton at the Italian restaurant! The food and service was amazing. They made sure we liked our food and everything came out very quickly. The pizza is very good!

reviews.author: Ignacio B

reviews.text: Felices con la experiencia. Buenas vacaciones familiares. Nos cerraron todas las noches un restorant para estar en familia. Buena Atencion de parte de los empleados. En especial. Vicmar, maría del buffet, jose y Pedro el maletero. Jose del bar piscina.

reviews.author: Josefina P

reviews.author: Mauricio Lopez ...

reviews.author: Savannah Willis

reviews.text: This was an awesome experience staying here. Everything is organized and clean. Everyone was very helpful and nice. We had a great time celebrating my boyfriend’s 30th birthday. We are so excited to return one day soon! This is the place to stay in DR! Jordania has excellent service!

reviews.author: ABZMum

reviews.author: Virginia D
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text: Hemos disfrutado de una noche maravillosa en el restaurante flora de paradisus palma real la atención de Eduardo ha sido excepcional  !  La comida exquisita y el clima súper ameno ! La decoración del lugar nos encanto también ! Volveremos pronto

reviews.author: magaly V

reviews.author: Ahmed P

reviews.text: Jordania and the entire team was amazing. Great service, great resort and really good food. I’d say the best things for me was the pool, the beach area and the room! Btw the drinks here are well made and loved them

reviews.author: Chimerajoe
reviews.title: Great meal at Blue Agave
reviews.text: Had a fantastic meal at Blue Agave. Excellent flavors and great service.  Liver that ceviche, rack of lamb and the deserts were great.  Cocktails at the front bar were good. Shout out to our server Melvin and to our hostess Laura and host Franklin … we will be back !

reviews.author: Lucrecia M
reviews.title: Excelente entrenamiento en el gym!! Me voy satisfecha de mi esfuerzo 💪🏻💪🏻
reviews.text: Como siempre excelente atención y ayuda de Juan Guerrero el entrenador del gym, muy cordial y gentil, orienta muy bien en los ejercicios. El gym es bueno y limpio, tiene lo necesario para entrenar duro💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻

reviews.author: Allan R
reviews.title: Awesome stay in paradise.
reviews.text: Great time with the family. Food quality and options were great. The personal pools were convenient. The room and amenities and room service were also great. Def a 4-5 star resort. The only downside is it wasnt a kids friendly resort in my opinion. Will book again in the future.

reviews.author: Margarita C
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation!
reviews.text: I have travelled to other Meliá properties and all are beautiful. I have to say the customer service I received at the hotel was incredible. This was a friends vacation to relax from our daily stressful lives. We decided to stay in the Reserve section because it was adults only. Best decision ever! The check in was private and so welcoming. Then we were introduced to our concierge “Zenovia”. This woman made our whole vacation. The amount of love we received from her was incredible. The whole time making dinner reservations for us..coming to the beach to check in on us..even in the restaurants. This is customer service on a whole other level. The hardest working woman I saw..running around making all wishes come true. A true professional in all aspects. Then there was Pedro & Raphael at the beach once again both of them went out of their way with setting up our beach beds everyday..to remembering our drinks..we were definitely spoiled. Pedro was outstanding can’t say enough about him! I had a massage with Gladis at the spa, it was the best massage ever! She was so friendly. In the evenings we enjoyed the entertainment at the main square..the shows were varied and classy. Jorge from the activities/entertainment department made our nights..encouraging us to dance and participate within the activities offered. He is one hard working person who did not stop smiling. To all of the hostesses, servers, bartenders in the a la cart restaurants many thanks. All their suggestions and keeping our wine glass full was great! Too many names to remember but all worked super hard to accommodate us. We are planning our return Jan/Feb 2024.

reviews.author: Elisa L
reviews.title: Vacación en familia
reviews.text:
Todo súper bien! Nos encantó la vacación aquí! Vinimos con un grupo grande de la familia

José (maletas), Amanda (bar tender sante) mega buen servicio

Regresaría otra vez con mi familia muchas gracias por el servicio! Pasamos súper 👍🏽👍🏽 Linda vacación

reviews.author: 683sga
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: El hotel es una maravilla pero el personal es excepcional en trato, atención, servicio .... un buen buen sitio para ir de vacaciones con la familia, amigos. Noes nuestra primera visita ni será la última

reviews.author: Bernard P
reviews.title: Paradisus lives up to its name
reviews.text:
Fresh offf a recent renovation, the buildings and grounds are looking fantastic. But the real asset is the staff, they were always there to give us just that extra bit of service that sets this resort apart.
After staying at least 12 times in the Dominican Republic we have discovered one of the best 
We were in the Reserve part of the resort with the Santé restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner. But we also dined at the Asian, Italian and Dominican restaurants, of which the last one was our favourite. Special thanks to all the staff at Santé, Gustavo comes to mind but many others as well, and also Nicolas, our concierge. We will be back!!

reviews.author: Maria G. Quintana
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text:
Nos quedamos en la zona de solo adultos, a la que ellos llaman “The reserve “ y genial, la comida en el restaurante era fantástica, fuimos un día al buffet normal al que podían ir los que se alojan en la zona con niños y estaba muy bien, se nota la calidad. Pero merece la pena pagar un poco más y poder disfrutar en la zona adults only.

Las piscinas impresionantes, y pegadas a la playa.
La habitación nueva, amplia, con terraza, todo bien.

Recomendable 100%

reviews.author: Oscar G
reviews.title: Restaurant Mexicano en Paradisus Palma Real en Punta Cana
reviews.text: Maravillosa experiencia el menú de este Restaurant mexicano en hotel Paradisus Palma Real. Me comentan que el nombre del Chef es Engel. Felicitaciones!! La excelente experiencia de sabores muy bien acompañada por la excelente atención de Edito, un mesero de lujo que ademas da muy buenas recomendaciones.

reviews.author: Allen
reviews.title: Servicio en Restaurantes
reviews.text: Excelente nivel de servicio, hemos sido atendidos en los restaurantes tanto en el tiempo de desayuno como en la cena de excelente forma, resaltar principalmente el rol y atención de Eduardo, supervisor de restaurantes. Excelente Eduardo, mención honorífica !

reviews.author: flipps26
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: I recommend this place to you . It was a nice experience. The area is so clean , food taste very good , rooms are clean just had an issue with the Ac at anytime the fan stop . Very good experience . Staff is so friendly

reviews.author: sheilahunt2023
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: The entire team was professional, and  knowledgeable. We arrived early so room was not ready, we were checked in and escorted to lunch. Shout out to our concierge Alvaro, made our dinner reservations and stayed in touch to see if we were in need of anything. Bartenders made delicious consistent drinks. Wait staff at restaurants courteous. The service at the Ala cart restaurants  professional and the food was good. Shout out to Jorge who tries to get everyone involved in the daily activities. The team at the beach on the reserve side are on point. Thank you Paradisius team, your service is what makes you a resort of choice for premium travelers.

reviews.author: Victor Benzi
reviews.title: Restaurante Tokimeku
reviews.text: O restaurante Tokimeku nos trouxe uma experiencia gastronomica fantástica, vale muito vir a este hotel paradisus palma real golf & spa resort na República Dominicana, adoramos a estadia e a simpatia de todos os atendentes, muito obrigado

reviews.author: Lais S
reviews.title: Restaurante Tokimeku
reviews.text:
Ótimo atendimento do restaurante Tokimeku!
Atendimento do Roberto e a equipe foi fantástico! Muito bom, com uma experiência gastronômica diferenciada e animada, pois ele consegue interagir com todos, independentemente do idioma, todos participam.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos F
reviews.title: El mejor escape.
reviews.text: Hermoso lugar para ir de vacaciones.  Majestuosas instalaciones, excelente campo de Golf cocotal. El Area Reserve es exclusiva para adultos y las Atenciones maravillosas. Recibimos atenciones especiales de nuestro Concierge Edgar Rodriguez y del personal del Restaurante Sante.

reviews.author: Gul Y
reviews.title: Lovely honeymoon in Punta Cana.
reviews.text: We went to celebrate our honeymoon and we loved our stay. The service is amazing, lovely, helpful personal. Food was ok, I recommend doing a new a la carte restaurant everyday for dinner. They suprised us with some fruit and red wine upon arrival which was very kind. Big thanks to Arisleida for being so kind and always make us smile :).

reviews.author: purple71blue
reviews.title: Worthit
reviews.text: This was such a great resort to wind down and experience luxury in a totally different level if your looking for a resort in Punta Cana . The staff were very friendly and I love Sante our breakfast restaurant, the layout of the buffet bar was fabulous! I’d definitely go back and already recommended it to a colleague of mine.

reviews.author: Helen S
reviews.title: The Reserve @ Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful with updated rooms in the Reserve.  Our concierge, Eriol, was very helpful and accommodating.  He booked our dinner reservations each night and made sure we had everything we needed during our stay. The pools and beach area are nice- plenty of loungers/sun beds .  Overall, we enjoyed our stay.  The food could be better, but not too bad for an all inclusive.  Would also recommend the aromatherapy fusion massage!!

reviews.author: melvin e
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text: Súper bien buen  café Angie Báez buenas atenciones y servicio. Las habitaciones modernas y cómodas. La comida y restaurantes súper. Aquí limitar el uso de los documentos caracteres entiendo se puede dar una opinión

reviews.author: Dreamer25498224074
reviews.title: We had an awesome vacation. Milton and his staff went above and beyond. The rooms are spacious and clean.
reviews.text:
Francisco Vilorio our concierge was an awesome person who exceeded our expectations. His commitment to ensuring that we have an unforgettable vacation. He greeted us every morning and looked for us at night before he retired for the day. He was accessible responding promptly to our questions and needs. He took care of us making all restaurant reservations. At dinner, he was there to greet us. His warm and friendly attitude made our entire vacation enjoyable. I recommend his services to anyone seeking a vacation concierge. 
Francisco's expertise and dedication make him a true gem.

reviews.author: Elizabeth S
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Muy buenas atenciones. El restaurante Tokimeku (asiático) muy bueno, sobretodo lo cocinado por el chef Kelvin, además todo lo equipo muy atento para que estemos a gusto, una buena opción para la cena

reviews.author: Escape693709
reviews.title: Restaurante Mina
reviews.text: Vinimos al resto Mina, excelente el servicio de Kelvin y Ana, calidas y serviciales personas. La carne riquísima , pedimos diferentes cortes y todos estaban muy bien, volveremos y recomendamos el lugar. Arrancamos muy bien nuestras vacaciones en el hotel!

reviews.author: Adhara D
reviews.title: Outstanding experience
reviews.text: Excellent service, great food quality, very clean. Room service was on point, we had food and beverages replenish every day in the morning, and clean towels. The staff was very friendly and serviceable

reviews.author: BU24_7
reviews.title: Dominican Paradise
reviews.text:
This hotel is absolutely gorgeous! No detail in decor or comfort was overlooked. It was impeccably maintained and we were amazed by the meticulous grounds and how well they enhanced the natural beauty. 
Our concierge, Christian, was fantastic. He met every request and anticipated every need. Dinner reservations, daily activities, minibar requests, towels, transportation…he saw to it that we didn’t lift a finger, a phone or have a worry in the world. He met us each day at least twice to make sure we were well taken care of. 
Our second Melía stay and our first trip to the DR did not disappoint! We’ll be back!!!

reviews.author: Todd W
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: The resort is new and includes all the amenities. We were visiting during the low season, so they seemed to rotate the restaurants that were open using a smaller staff. But that still allowed us to experience all of their excellent food. Christian, our concierge, took wonderful care of us!

reviews.author: Jeinerys B
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente servicio, muy atentos los entregadores Juan guerrero y skerling, me encantó el gym muy buenas máquinas. Me gusto el paradise gym, desde que vuelva, vengo de una vez para acá sin pensarlo dos veces.

reviews.author: rogertoronto88
reviews.title: Very professional five star service
reviews.text: Grade a hotel by how they solve issues when they occur. We had unexpected medical issues and Stephanie at this hotel went over and beyond our expectations to ensure our stay was an excellent experience. She saved our vacation and really cared about how we were doing. She checked in with us every day and made sure we were enjoying this beautiful hotel. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Yolanda B
reviews.title: Cena de aniversario
reviews.text: Restaurante Blue Agabe, excelente excelente cheff Engel, la comida exquisita, sabores balanceados, Edito muy buen servicio, cercano y explicando muy bien cada plato. Recomendado, una excelente experiencia en la gastronomía Mexicana

reviews.author: Kayla J
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Highly recommend! We love the swim up bar Jose, Quintino, and Olgal go about and beyond!!! Our concierge Nicolas has also been so helpful in booking all our dinner reservations and excursions! 😊 great service all around!

reviews.author: jmac386
reviews.title: Service at Paradisius Palma Real is great.
reviews.text: The service at Paradisius was exceptional across the board. Jhonathan and Quintana and Marielisa at Celsius Pool Bar set the bar. Thank you for making us feel at home. I look forward to my next visit to Paradisius Palma and the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: joaoalmeida2023
reviews.title: Excellent overall service quality.
reviews.text:
I would like to highlight the friendliness of the entire staff, the quality and variety of the food at the buffets and in all the restaurants, especially Mina, where the meat is of high quality and grilled to perfection.
The rooms are very well preserved, as is the entire resort, with no signs of wear due to the maintenance they carry out regularly.
The cleanliness of all areas of the resort, as well as the rooms, also deserves a very positive mention.

reviews.author: joannc887
reviews.title: Could not ask for more!!
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel was great. We stayed at the Reserve section of the resort which was adult only.  The beach and pool accommodations were a step up - lounge beds vs. lounge chairs - and access to adult only restaurants.  The place was gorgeous, the rooms were immaculate, the drinks were plentiful and the food was good.  Our concierge, Eriol, was the best!!  He made sure everything was perfect for us.  He contacted us every day to assist with reservations, etc.  My sister and I took our mother for her 87th birthday.  Well, Eriol had surprised us with balloons and champagne in our room on her birthday and had alerted the restaurant at dinner and they had a special Happy Birthday cake for her.  The restaurant personnel were all so very pleasant and helpful.  I will definitely return!!

reviews.author: Christine R
reviews.title: Relaxing get away
reviews.text: Traveled with another couple. Rooms were comfortable, food was great. Our concierge Francisco was excellent. He was very attentive and made sure our needs were completely met. Would recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Safari558096
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: We had excellent time at this resort. Food was very good , room was excellent . Customer service was good . This trip was very good . The only downside was that we had to call 3 time the room service to supply us with coffee.

reviews.author: cesarz102
reviews.title: Superb hotel and great food!
reviews.text: We came to this hotel 2nd time and will definitely get back there. Great hotel location with beach layout. There are few thematic restaurants. But you can get awesome food at the main restaurant as well. Hassle free holiday. Our concierge Ernesto looked after us during the stay. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Wanda R
reviews.title: Paradisíaco
reviews.text: Excelente estadía gracias a las maravillosas atenciones del personal, en especial al chef Roberto del restaurante italiano, jesse hernan, Francis, Norjandro,  Estebanni, gracias por todo, la animación muy buena y los shows nocturnos, habitaciones hermosas y confortables y la comida muy buena en fin quedé encantada. Volvería sin dudas

reviews.author: Bill S
reviews.title: An amazing stay
reviews.text: We’re having an amazing time here.  We’ve just had and incredible evening with Jhonatan and Juan at the Winery restaurant.  Jhonatan was very helpful in help us pick out just the right wine to celebrate or 55th anniversary. Our concierge, Zenovia, has been on top of everything for us, helping to make the the most special celebration.  All the staff is incredible.

reviews.author: Dulce B
reviews.title: Amazing food at Mascalzone
reviews.text:
At Mascalzone Raider and team including Chef Angel was and is one of the best services we keep receiving. I must admit that everywhere you go everyone gives their best but this was one of the outstanding ones. Thank you and honestly from the bottom of our hearts you guys serve and cook from the bottom of their hearts. 

Gracias y de verdad con corazón ellos te sirven y cocinan con corazón!

reviews.author: YENNI A
reviews.title: Una experiencia maravillosa.
reviews.text: Excelente Servicio,  muy agradecida con las atenciones de los colabores: Katherine Mota, Marcos Benjamin, Ivelisse y Stephanie del Depto. De reservas. Gracias mil por todo el apoyo. Excelente gastronomía en todo el hotel, buen show y buen espectáculo.

reviews.author: Karina Martinez
reviews.title: Family vacations
reviews.text: Excelentes atenciones, el hotel magnifico, Jesse Hernan hizo de la primera noche una memorable, el restaurante italiano muy bueno el chef roberto con sus excelentes platos y atención con mi familia, los camareros, fausto y norjando en sante que fueron siempre muy amables y atentos, la hostess estebannia en sante muy amable y servicial … Definitivamente una estancia memorable y divertida para todos

reviews.author: clasch1971
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Habiamos venido varias veces años anteriores y tuvinos buenas experiencias, la diferencia es que ahora el hotel fue renovado en diciembre pasado y quedó mucho mejor, piezas grandes y muy comodas, y excelente servicio. Destacar a Katherine y a Ivelicce de recepcion, nos solucionaron lo que necesitábamos con una excelente disposicion. Hotel es precioso y con muchas piscinas luego de la remodelacion. Estuvimos en la seccion familiar, todos los primeros pisos hacia el centro del hotel con piscina tipo swim up que se podian usar sin problemas por los demás huéspedes. El servicio a la habitación fue siempre rapido y reponian el frigobar todos los dias y a requerimiento en caso necesario. En esta epoca habia poca gente ya que es temporada baja. Habian algunas mantenciones pero no generaban mayores problemas. Destacar tambien el servicio de bar de la piscina principal, siempre dispuestos a atender con la mejor actitud, tambien te llevaban bebidas a la playa. El nivel de los licores era bueno, algunos si solo para socios circle igual que algunas zonas de la playa restringidas para ellos. Es entendible ya que les cobran mas por eso. Respecto de la comida, el buffet era variado y para los restaurantes de especialidad siempre habia disponibilidad incluso para el mismo dia. El que mas nos gusto fue el Mina que es de carnes. Tb bueno el italiano y mexicano. El Japonés tiene opcion de teppanyaki y libre, fuimos a ambas y las disfrutamos. Habian 2 restaurantes mas que eran solo adultos. En general unas excelentes vacaciones y un hotel muy recomendable. Sin duda regresaremos

reviews.author: sizzlehammer
reviews.title: Excellent Anniversary Experience
reviews.text:
Excellent experience. From our concierge, Nathaniel, to our energetic activities guy Jorge, it was an excellent experience. Traveling this time of year meant the resort was sparsely populated and some services/activities didn’t happen or were a little slower than usual, but that was totally OK with us. The food was good. The steak house was our favorite. Mean was our least favorite, but still OK. Do the wine tasting experience and ask for Juan if you can. The beaches definitely have lots of sargassum, but it’s nature so that’s not the resort’s fault. They do try to clean it up. We also did the wellness excursion with yoga on the beach and the natural pool - both very nice. 

The couples massage was excellent and I would highly recommend Eva and Dorka as a pair or either one for yourself. 

We traveled for our anniversary and our concierge Nathaniel made it a romantic and memorable experience. 

Protip: there are no TV services so if you want to watch TV or movies you should bring a Firestick or HDMI cable or something to stream to your TV.

reviews.author: Fernanda S
reviews.title: Excelente gimnasio y excelente servicio  y excelente asistencia de Juan Guerrero
reviews.text: El gimnasio esta muy bien bonito y equipado, las instalaciones son muy acogedoras. Hoy tuve un excelente entrenamiento gracias a que el gimnasio está bien equipado y gracias a la asistencia de Juan quien me entrenó y fue muy profesional.

reviews.author: Виктория Ч
reviews.title: Рекомендую это место для отдыха
reviews.text:
Отдыхала тут с мужем. Он тут уже 6-й раз, я первый. Очень красивое место. Красивые локации для фото. Приятный персонал. Всегда принесут все, что просят. Рекомендую для отдыха.
Вкусная и разнообразные разная еда, напитки. Уборка каждый день. Официант приходит лично и приносит все, что ты хочешь.
Servis Jordania

reviews.author: bessienoellynino
reviews.title: Excelencia en la atención al Cliente.
reviews.text: .Lo recomendaría a amigos, Sugiero paquetes promocionales familiares a los que han visitado el hotel, que lo envíen vía correo, también las ofertas disponibles para las diferentes épocas del año, enviar planes de aniversarios, cumpleaños.

reviews.author: Kimberly A
reviews.title: Excelente daycare
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia! Sobre todo en el daycare fue lo mejor, deje a mis 3 niños estaban encantados, las cuidadoras muy colaboradoras,simpaticas y cuidadosas. Les ofrecian varias actividades que realizar a los niños y siempre se mantenian al pendiente. Lo mejor del hotel es sin duda este daycare

reviews.author: Alexandre G
reviews.title: Surprise
reviews.text: It's no surprise that we returned to the hotel once again. Impeccable service, good restaurants and easy booking. Bars with quality drinks. Good, new rooms. The only criticism I can make is that the website states that there are no cribs for babies. But when we arrived here, a cot was readily available. I recommend it and we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Juan I
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Buen servicio. Rápido y amables, las instalaciones son muy modernas. Y buen servicio del personal. El ambiente agradable y ameno.  Muy amplias las habitaciones   Definitivamente regresaría.  Un hotel de calidad

reviews.author: Lady L
reviews.title: Congreso dominicano de nefrología 2023
reviews.text: Me encantó la experiencia súper divertida, e inolvidable , la atención del personal , la calidad de la comida , y la higiene de las habitaciones, me gustó los restaurantes temáticos , la calidad de los alimentos frescos y la música típica de nuestra quisquella !

reviews.author: Emely S
reviews.title: Hospedaje en Paradisus
reviews.text: Súper encantada con las atenciones, el servicio y el personal. La comida, la habitación y todo lo demás, 10/10. La joven Stephanie, súper amable, atenta y servicial. Definitivamente volveré, esperando que la próxima sea con mi familia  🙏🏽😁

reviews.author: Paula B
reviews.title: Loved the place but mostly the food!
reviews.text: The rooms are great and super comfortable! The numerous pools are great. The personnel is super nice, open, and attentive. The asian food was great. The buffet has great diversity. Ive heard the mediterranean place is awesome. The mexican restaurant was great. Overall, the place is super beautiful, comfortable and feels like an escape

reviews.author: Florida A
reviews.title: Best drinks ever.
reviews.text:
The service across the hotel is amazing. The bartenders  were the best making wonderful drinks.
 bar had great drinks and coffees and Amazing pastries . The best part of it was the wonderful service from my concierge FRANSISCO VILORIO , I highly recommend him, he knows what he's doing, very clear communication in my native language, I hope he never quits.
 THANKS  ALL OF YOU 🙏 FOR THE WONDERFUL SERVICE.

reviews.author: Yainery S
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Muy buenas atenciones. Recomendado. Sobre todo Jordania dispuesta asistirle.
Las habitaciones son fenomenales . El personal es muy atento. La comida es variada y buena. La limpieza es 1A.  Este hotel es lo mejor

reviews.author: Gustavo R
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2023
reviews.text: mis mejores vacaciones la acabo de pasar en Paradisus palma real donde fui recibido por un excelente personal en especial por el concierje Francisco vilorio quien nos brindó muy buenas atenciones me encantó su forma de ser su carisma siempre está alegre sonriente a la vez que nos brindó un buen servicio,  recomiendo este hotel tiene buenas piscinas y maravillosas playas, are de masajes entretenimiento, los restaurantes son excelentes su pelsonal, les doy un 10 a todo😍❤️

reviews.author: Road41859508297
reviews.title: Amazing time with family
reviews.text: One of the best experiences my family has had.  Our Concior frank vilorio was extremely helpful and never fell short on any Necessities that our family needed. The resort was beautiful the food was amazing, And all of the stuff was very polite. Would recommend this place to anyone, It's paradise beautiful view amazing fand very peaceful we will be back.

reviews.author: Cristian o
reviews.title: excelente experiencia
reviews.text:
muy buena toda la experiencia, estuvimos 7 dias y nos gusto nucho, volveremos!!!! , el servicio de maletas a cargo del señor jose ramirez, jhon carvajal y luciano del rosario fue exelente!!! 
el servicio de restaurantes es de una variedad inmenza, no nos imaginabamos que fuera tan especial!!!

reviews.author: Kaory P
reviews.title: Excelente Sevicio y Calidad
reviews.text: Excelente servicio por parte de todo el equipo, sobre todo nuestro Maletero José Ramirez, excelentes atenciones y servicio, me encantó bastante el hotel y las atenciones en todas las áreas, espero volver a visitarle pronto

reviews.author: lauratravelagency
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Muy lujoso hotel de primera, todo está limpio, la vista al mar de mi habitación fue expectacular, la comida muy deliciosa, el personal del hotel muy amables, Mi concierge Osvaldo Veloz fuen excelente conmigo y siempre estuvo pendiente de toda mi estadía muchas gracias a todos ellos.

reviews.author: Maggy
reviews.title: Best service!!! WOW! Welcome/Bienvenue Coeliac!/Cœliaque
reviews.text: Endroit magnifique!  Propre, excellent service en tout temps et rapide!  Nourriture variée et très bonne! Vous pouvez combiner repos, amusement et activités selon vos besoins, c'est tout simplement parfait!  Mention spéciale au responsable Batista (Hemeregildo) en charge de  la restauration..Merci!  Il m'a accompagné tout au long de mon séjour et j'ai pu manger varié et sans aucun problème , mon voyage familiale a été réussi avec perfection grâce à cette personne d'exception!  L'option Pool/room (swim out) est recommandé, un vrai coup de coeur.  Nous prévoyons déja y retourner l'an prochain!

reviews.author: Luciolo M
reviews.title: El mejor hotel y el mejor personal
reviews.text: Todo muy bueno los chicos de la piscina principal muy divertidos, son los mejores, el personal muy bueno, la limpieza muy buena, el servicio es excelente Marielisa es una persona de admirar por el buen servicio, estoy muy contento con el servicio de todos, las habitaciones hermosas son 10/10

reviews.author: Astride G
reviews.title: Bellas bacaciones.
reviews.text:
Muy atentos y serviciales, en la piscina para mi destacan, marielisa la supervisora the reserve y gilberto en el bar de la piscina ➡️.  
El servicio de la habitación es de lo 👍 👍 🏝🏖🏞🏝🏜🧭🗺🌏🌎🌍🌍🌍🌍

reviews.author: aneudys n
reviews.title: Sr. José Ramirez me presto un excelente servicio.
reviews.text: Jose Ramirez me resivió muy bien cuando llegue al hotel, restaurante,habitaciones y los servicios  excelente lo puedo recomendar a otros personas las instalaciones son excelentes. Muy agradecido volvería a visitar.

reviews.author: Francisco Monegro
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente en todos los sentidos, muy cómodas habitaciones, un ambiente natural muy bueno. Personal muy atento y amable. El Bar Rum Republic muy acogedor, excelentes tragos sobre todo el PassionMamajuana.

reviews.author: Antonia R
reviews.title: Restaurante MasCasones: Excelente lugar
reviews.text:
Restaurante MasCasones: Buen servicio, buen ambiente y muy buena comida. Raider excelente anfitrión.
No tuve que esperar tanto para ser atendida...................
...................................!

reviews.author: personal15
reviews.title: Una grata experiencia.
reviews.text: Visitamos el Restaurante Flora, nuestra mesera fue Melina un persona bien amable y agradable, nos hizo sentir super cómodos. El chef Jerand nos visito en la mesa y nos compartió parte de sus secretos de cocina. El somelier Maximo una gran persona con mucho conocimiento en su area. Recomendado para vivir la experiencia de la comida Dominicana. Regresamos.

reviews.author: JO
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Excelente servicio de parte de todos! Muy buena atención y dedicación de parte de Ricky en los desayunos. Going above and beyond to pleased our demands, that's how Mirton made us feel! Definitely did not feel any discrimination and highly recommend the resort!

reviews.author: gentilhom
reviews.title: Paradisus or simply PARADISE?
reviews.text:
Through the years (more than 12 years), we've been frequent and proud guests of many Paradisus, either in Punta Cana, Cuba, etc, and this trip to Paradisus Palma Real was our fourth in this beautiful Hotel, this time, for a very special celebration. 

Trust me, we had another G-R-E-A-T vacation, a week we are not going to forget soon! Actually, the only factor that was "against" us was weather, but when Mother Nature talks, there is really nothing a human can control hahaha. We did'nt have a bad week but it was not as sunny as usual in Punta Cana...a lot of rain mixed with sunshine, anyway we did enjoy what it was possible to! 

Thanks to our old (but still young...) friends Juan Carlos, Christelle, and we also had the privilege to meet Senor Bonilla, we were assigned what was probably the nicest room we ever had in the Carabeeans, in building seven, a room with a spectacular view (ocean AND pool, make that three pools), a very confortable room with all the amenities. Our morning coffee delivered each day by our Haitian friend Wilson was very appreciated. Our room was close to the beach, and not far from the heart of the resort, to make it simple, we were extremely happy. What makes one of the points where Paradisus is over the top compared to other resorts, is the fact they recognize and sincerely appreciate their repeat guests! We will always come back to you, guys. As a matter of fact, what was our nice surprise to renew with one of the friends we made with in one of our last stays at the Paradisus, our best waiter Gustavo, had a picture of us in his cell phone, a picture taken before pandemic as he touched our hearts showing wife and I that we are important persons for him. 

Other people we would like to express our gratitude are, of course, Zenovia, mi amor numero dos, our partner for the second time in less than a year, as she was our majordome also last fall, thanks, Zenovia, you too will always have a special place in our lives and we will still request your so special services next times we will come back. My friendly tennis partner Virgilio is another star of our week, as I was still able to play a few sets with him when it was not raining... I should also identify our excellent server Virdules, from the mexican restaurant, and of course, the assistant chief Francis who, under the supervision of the Prince Juan Carlos, offered one of the most spectacular and delicious dinner a couple could hope for. 

To sommarize our seven night stay at Paradisus Palma Real, we are full of gratitude and we want to thank all of our second family for what was another brillant escape. Magic is still in the air, Paradisus, LUV U!!!

reviews.author: Manuel G
reviews.title: The Best All Inclusive Resort of Punta Cana
reviews.text: Very good food, excellent attention, friendly, careful and smiling employees. Premium amenities throughout. Quality of food and its ingredients. Premium drinks, spirits and cocktails. the price is worth it

reviews.author: karenwilliams1232023
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: The hotel was excellent! The restaurants are very good, the beach is beautiful, the pools were great, room service was also on point. We had concierge service, and Dalmis was amazing. We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Laura T
reviews.title: My Bday
reviews.text:
Mi estadía en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real fue una experiencia fenomenal, todo el personal son muy amables lo tratan a uno con respeto y siempre ayudan al huésped en lo necesita. Las habitaciones están muy limpias y siempre que entraba tenía un olor agradable. La comida súper deliciosa, variedad de diferentes países, me encanto los restaurantes a la carta. En los bares ay variedad de bebidas alcohólicas. Actividades durante el día como clases de merengue y bachata. La plaza tiene diferentes actividades de noche. Voy súper contenta con mis vacaciones. El día de mi cumpleaños me decoraron la habitación muy bonita con champagne, globos, la tina con agua, espuma y un pastel, gracias al concierge Osvaldo Veloz que se encargó de tan lindo detalle.
Fueron mis mejores y bonitas vacaciones

reviews.title: Excellent Spa and team!!
reviews.text: Spa 🧖‍♀️ is a excellent! We wre at at couple massage with Alba & Lilete ans there wee wonderfull!! Francis at the check in desk was excellent. Melia is wonderful with a very professional team. Our concierge was Starlin wonderful…10 Star for everyone here at Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Gina B
reviews.title: Amazing concierge, not the best night life
reviews.text: I went on a couples trip to Paradisus Palma real this past week. We had an amazing time! The people there are so nice, helpful, appreciative, and hard working. Our concierge Jose Simeon was absolutely PHENOMENAL. He took amazing care of us and went above and beyond to meet every request we had and made sure our time there was nothing short of amazing. He took care of our dinner reservations, excursions, helped make sure we were able to switch rooms/upgrade, as well as went to the lengths to decorate our room romantically. We were craving authentic Dominican food, so he made sure to make a special request for us to the chef and served us. I can’t say enough great things about him. The one thing I will say is that the hotel lacks a night life and for a younger crowd may be boring. Other than that we had an amazing week.

reviews.title: La mejor experienca la vas a vivir en Melia
reviews.text:
El hotel Paradisus Palma Real Melia en Punta Cana es el mejor hotel de toda la zona sin duda. Repito cada año todos los agostos y diciembres.

El servicio excepcional, por no hablar de todo el personal siempre atento, agradable y super amable.

Lo recomiendo sin duda.

Stephanie la encargada es una bellísima persona y ha estado pendiente de mi familia en toda nuestra estadía.

Por no hablar de Daiana la hostess siempre alegre con su sonrisa, que buena energía transmite.

Volver es un placer.

reviews.author: ONAZIRA
reviews.title: BODAS DE PLATA
reviews.text:
Este año, y como la ocasión bien merecía, nos fuimos a Punta Cana de vacaciones. Concretamente al Hotel Paradisus Palma Real. Se trata de un 5 estrellas T.I. perteneciente a la cadena hotelera Meliá. Estuvimos 10 días disfrutando de un hotel espectacular. Nos alojamos en The Reserve, una zona solo para adultos, con restaurantes y bares exclusivos independientes de la otra parte del hotel dedicada para familias, aunque teníamos acceso a ella. En dicha parte se encontraban la mayor parte de restaurantes y bares. Mucho donde escoger, italiano, mejicano, japonés (tepanyaki o a la carta) y un extraordinario restaurante parrilla de carne (Mina), con el que aún estoy soñando con aquellos entrecots.
Nuestra recepción fue muy agradable, tuvimos un asistente durante toda nuestra estancia llamado Nicolás. Un tío perfecto, nos hizo todas las reservas y se encargó de todo para que no tuviéramos más preocupación que disfrutar de esos 10 días. El personal realmente educado, de 10. Una mención muy especial para Wanda y Pedro (chiringuito de la piscina) y para José, Eduardo, Walder y más de los que no me acuerdo...
En cuanto a la polémica del sargazo, bueno, teniendo en cuenta que allí es temporada baja y con el paso de la tormenta Franklin, durante los dos primeros días si que hubo, pero los siguientes días no más que en cualquiera de nuestras playas. Trabajaban noche y día para resolver el problema y lo resolvieron, no como otros hoteles de la zona que tenían verdaderas montañas de algas, con lo que pudimos disfrutar de buenos paseos por playa y estupendos baños sin algas y sin olores. 
Agradezco a todo el personal y a Juan Carlos (subdirector), como al director del hotel el hacernos sentir como en casa en esta fecha tan señalada para nosotros.
Gracias a todos y espero que hasta pronto.

reviews.title: Amazing stay at Paradisus Punta Cana

The front desk staff were friendly and helpful and the staff in the restaurants were outstanding, especially Delvin and Virginia. But our most appreciation goes to Willy Mercado, our concierge. He was just amazing. He made sure every part of our stay was amazing, he was always available and he treated us like family. We will really miss him! reviews.text:

Atención excelente, rcién remodelado. Tranquilidad para pasarte unos dias de relax total. El entorno increible. Todo supercuidado, con todos esos árboles, lagos...Da gusto pasear por todo el reciento. Y sobre todo dar las gracias a Ariel Benzo, que nos hizo la estancia mucho más fácil.

reviews.author: Miguel P
reviews.title: Renovated and improved
reviews.text:
This is a hotel that we have come to several times over the years, we have always loved it, but in 2018 we thought we would not return, it had fallen in every way, it was not worth it.

However, we have returned and the surprise could not be better. Some details have failed, they are things that can be easily improved and they are details, but in general we are delighted to have returned due to such a positive change, much better than we remembered even more than 10 years ago.

An example is the beach, it has always been a problem due to algae, but they have cleaned everything in an extraordinary way (I am now staying there). I think it is the first time that we have bathed right in front of it, before the algae always prevented it.

Restaurants like Santé (it wasn't its name before I think I remember, but the location is the same) give a much better service, and the beach has improved a lot in terms of the number of sunbeds…

reviews.author: Mercedes V

The buffet has been really good so far and we’re excited to try out the sushi and Italian places! I really like it here!

reviews.author: John and Kelly P
reviews.title: Unforgettable 5-Star Experience!! The most relaxing family vacation to date!
reviews.text:
It was exceptional. We had the Reserve Junior Suite Swim up room. That was amazing was out of your room to your own patio space right to the pool.

When we arrived, since we were staying at the Reserve, we were whisked away to a private check-in experience. 

The VIP experience even warms my heart now as I think about it...we truly felt special!

Nicholas, our Concierge, managed all our room details,  had one of the filters changed at my request, took care of dinner reservations each night, shared tips for what to do to enhance our visit on property and even surprised us with a birthday cake for our 19 year old daughter. The staff at Tokimeku serenaded her with the traditional feliz compleanos as well as a few other songs that had everyone clapping to the beat, smiling and joining in on the fun.

The Concierge are invaluable to the operation and keeping things running smoothly.

Bellman Jose to the Rescue, he ensured we made it to our excursion on time with a quick yet safe golf cart ride to the front gate of the complex so we wouldn't miss our ride. (I would say if you book excursions, clarify if they are picking you up at the Lobby or at the security gate. There is a big difference)

While we booked our excursions before we arrived on the Island, I saw that there is staff on site to take care of any activity you would want to do to see and take in all that Punta Cana and the DR has to offer.

Oh and the Bellman staff each handled our luggage with care.

Housekeeping was amazing in keeping our suite clean, replenished our towels and our fridge stocked.

The wait staff at each restaurant and the front desk made us feel like family. 

The food was amazing from the Buffett to the exclusve Sante, The Steak ar Mina was grilled to perfections, the Hibachi experience was great. Malva for breakfast was incredible...we ordered from the menu one morning and then did the buffet another day. The French toast and the Waffles from the menu are heavenly and their fresh fruit drinks made to order were refreshing.

The Buffett had something for everyone!

There were other restaurants that we didn't get to.  The only restaurant we couldn't give a 5 star was the Blue Agave, the portions were very small and it the meal wasn't very appetizing.

There is plenty to do on property, be sure to stroll the path that surrounds the Paradisus and its sister resorts. That was a great experience as well. 

There were some great photo opportunities as well both during the day and at night.

They also have different activities throughout out the day and early evening.

This was the most relaxing family vacation we have had to date, we wished that we had stayed a few more nights. 

Highly recommend this all-inclusive!

reviews.author: Macarena B
reviews.title: Gracias!!
reviews.text:
Espectacular como siempre, pero ahora con el hotel remodelado, siempre con novedades, siempre en línea con la tecnología, con los espectáculos, con todo lo relacionado con la entretención para nosotros los turistas; que a mi me dejan con el sabor a que hay que volver.......... el problema? que siempre deja ese sabor. Hay que sumarle su gente, su staff que te atienden de maravilla, se preocupan de cada detalle: de hacerte sentir especial. No puedo dejar de menciona a Ynes que como siempre, año a año, se preocupa de mis hijos, de las actividades para ellos, para nosotros que siempre son distintas y entretenidas; de informarnos de todos los detalles. De igual forma mención especial a Juan Peña (Guest Experience Manager) que día a día se preocupo de nosotros, preguntándonos por nuestra estadía por algún requerimientos, recomendándonos, un gerente preocupado por los turistas.
Luis nuestro barman de la piscina, ya hace varios años, nada mas que decir, un amigo. Añoramos volver, Dios quiera que sea lo antes posible. solo nos queda decirles, gracias totales.

reviews.author: Vanessa L
reviews.title: Great hotel and beach!
reviews.text:
For all concerned regarding zargazo algae, there was almost nothing. This is the most important thing.

For reviewers to know how I compare experiences: I have travelled a lot and to very good hotels, so I have a high standard.

Rooms: recently renewed; they are wonderful and in comparison to other similar level all inclusives, this is one of the best. My room was closer to the beach than others. The room had everything we needed. The only thing is that mini bar was replenished once a day,  so if you had your light of not disturb, they would not do so till the next day. You could ask, however, for them to send thing a to your room. They do the room daily ( many hotels are still in covid mode and try to skip one day from cleaning. Housekeeping would pass again at night.

Lobby: beautiful; there’s a coffee and milkshake bar. All the restaurants are together, so you don’t need to walk much. There’s no casino.

Beach: fantastic; clean and perfect for swiming. I never had a problem finding a place in first or second roll (and I came to the beach late). There are some parts of the beach for adults only. There were nice people bringing drinks to our place in the beach. Yuderi, made our stay especially nice. He was always asking if we needed anything. The only thing is that they didn’t bring food to the beach (only some tacos or something like that), but the pool lunch was very close by, so there was no problem. If you love being at the beach, this is the perfect place.

Buffet: better than many others. They have high quality steak and fish on demand, that is cooked at the minute. Food is never wonderful in these all inclusives, but this was better than others. 

Restaurants: they were nice and a bit better than the buffet, but again, you come for the beach more than the food. They have special meals and drinks with an extra cost. It was easy for us to get reservations at the restaurants because we received special treatment by Expedia. I can’t say if people without this benefit had the same access to them.

Night shows: all nights there was live music. Not many shows, but music and one night circus. 

Daily activities: there were at least 4-6 daily activities.

Kids: I would have liked more activities for kids at the beach. But, there were some and some days they brought floating games for the pool and games that are inflated to the beach.

We had concierge service: both Deysi and Ernesto, helped us with everything. Not everyone has this though.

SPA: I expected more of the SPA archirecture, size and decoration. My massage was really nice, but the space lacked of that special environment these hotels normally provide. It was very expensive.

Final note: all of the people were very concerned asking if we were ok, any comments for improvement and offering assistance. 

So, in overall, considering price, I am fully satisfied and everything was very good.

reviews.title: Paradissus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Have stayed in this property 3 times, in Punta Cana 5. My wife and I had a great experience each time. We opted for the reserve experience again. Ralphy was super nice and got us specialty presidente from in town. He helped us switch rooms to be closer to the bar. Chris, our concierge from January even stopped by to chat and catch up. We really enjoyed Eddie the bar tender who made a really great rum drink that my wife loved. We also got a good bottle of wine from Maximo whom I've always liked. Many of the staff like Rosanna and Delvin gave us hugs on seeing us and it felt really special.

The reserve restaurant is easily the best on property and the staff helped me with my disability unasked by bringing a lamp to the table. 

The Circus was amazing and a surprise. They should rename it because Americans think of kids stuff and creepy clowns. It was very similar to cirque du soleil sp? Which is obviously a literal circus but still. 

My only negative comment is the Melia circle presentation is terrible. If the Financials were presented in a clear way I'd buy it. Imo the sales model needs a good sales consultant to completely overhaul it.

reviews.author: Ashley O
reviews.title: This resort is a must stay in the Dominican
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I  went for our birthdays for 8 days.   We typically go to Mexico but this year we chose the DR. We chose to use the company Dominican Tours and Transfers to get us to and from the airport. We found them on trip advisor, they were trustworthy and efficient. 
 The beach was well kept, the ocean was a little rough. There was seaweed- it’s the ocean.. so no worries.   Snorkeling wasn’t great.  People will walk up to tying to sell things.   They are very nice, a simple no thank you will and they will leave you alone.    Other than it is not the country or city to go for good snorkeling, is the only complaint I have.  
 The property is well maintained and the pools are kept spotless.  The food is very good.   
Some tips: upgrade to the Reserve. You will have a very different experience.  The pool is very quiet there and the bar is amazing.  The entire Reserve area is adult only. The reserve  beach has its own private area as well, with free Bali beds and a bar that serves you while you enjoy the beach. Martin at the beach bar was fun and pleasant. 
Wanda and Grey at the reserve bar treated us like family.   They are kind and patient and have a great sense of humor.   They surprised both of us on our birthdays with champagne and a little celebration.  Heiron, the activity guy was outstanding. He made us laugh the whole time. 
  The Reserve also gives you a conceirge. Ours was Francisco.  We used the WhatsApp to communicate. He reserved dinner for us every night, and helped us navigate the resort.  He is amazing. 
 The entire stay, we never wandered into the other pool or beach where the kids were.  But you could hear and see the hustle and bustle of families and party music. It looked like the kids were enjoying themselves.
  The buffet has a lot of selections for breakfast lunch and dinner.    
We enjoyed Sante- which is reserve only.  Gustavo and Franklin take very good care of us there. 
At night, the entertainment was good.   The sports bar kicks is fun and lively. Victor is the bartender there, he is wonderul! 
The Ginger bar upstairs has the best espresso and espresso martinis.   Lucia is a bar tender there.   You have to see her if you have the hiccups!!  She has the cure!  And she’ll will make you laugh so hard. 
The excursions are very different from Mexico’s.   You can’t just take a taxi to where you want to go. I think for safety reasons. 
The resort offers a handful of excursions.  We chose to risk it and do an excursion that a guy on the beach was selling.   We got to drive a speed boat and snorkel and see the dolphins enclosed in an ocean park.  It wasn’t to expensive but wasn’t a full 2 hours as promised.   It was a good experience and worth the risk.   
All in all, this vacation was wonderful. This resort is spectacular.  You need to have patience, the language barrier makes things challenging.  Learning some Spanish will be helpful.  Tip the staff and stay in the reserve if you aren’t bringing kids and you will never want to leave.

reviews.author: wvdowney
reviews.title: Another superb family visit to Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Another phenomenal experience at Paradisus Palma Real! I have to start my review by sending an HUGE shoutout to our concierge Francisco. Simply put, he was absolutely fantastic. He took care of everything and made it a priority to ensure that my family had the best experience. Francisco, we cannot thank you enough!

In terms of the resort, everything was top notch as usual. Even items outside their control, they were quick to remedy. The dining experience and the food at the various restaurants was superb. We highly recommended Mina (steakhouse), Blue Agave (Mexican cuisine), and Mascalzone (Italian cuisine). With that said, I’ll admit that our favorite hangout spot was Ginger Bar. It had the best vibe and every bartender/wait staff was helpful, friendly, and attentive. Whether you crave coffee, smoothies, or adult beverages, this is the hang spot. Be sure to ask for Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga Rosario, Soranji, or Clary. They will make sure you are well taken care of. 

To round out the review, I must admit we weren’t expecting to see as much seaweed as we did on the beach and in the water. If you love the beach then you may want to check which months give you the best option to travel here. With that said, there’s no shortage of activities for any member of the family. Kids will enjoy the many hands-on workshops and adults can enjoy various tastings, crafts, and social gatherings. And of course, everyone can dance the night away during the nightly music events featuring live performances. 

If you are looking for a great family vacation then I recommend you seriously look at Paradisus Palma Real. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Ana C
reviews.title: Unforgettable vacations.
reviews.text:
Like every year my husband and I go on vacation to the Dominican Republic, this time we stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. We were there from June 14 to June 28 and stayed in a Nikte Junior Suite Swim Up room. Before we start our review, it is good to clarify that we are members of the Circle by Melia vacation club, and our status as red members is a factor that influences our opinion and our experience.

Check in
The arrival at the hotel was an extremely pleasant experience because the beauty of this hotel is indisputable. We were immediately escorted to check in, treated to a cocktail, and introduced to our concierge. The check in process was fast and very nice thanks to Daisy Gonzalez. She took care of answering our questions and was very helpful every time we needed to know something.

Concierge
Our concierge was Starlin Tavarez. He made sure that our vacations were perfect, from the restaurant reservations to the perfect service in every part of the hotel. Recommendation #1, if you can ask for a concierge before you get there or when you are at check in, Starlin is the name to remember.

Restaurants
Our favorite restaurants were Brisas, Flora and Mascalzones. At Brisas we received first-class service, thanks to Jose Ramos and Rosanna. The food is delicious, and the treatment is personalized. They remember your name and preferences the next day. Recommendation #2, ask Jose to make you one of his cocktails. Flora was a pleasant surprise for us because of the beauty of the restaurant, because they serve Dominican food and because of the luxury service that Francisco offered us. In our opinion Francisco is one of the best waiters we have ever met. His attention to every detail made our dinners (we went to dinner 3 times) unforgettable memories. Recommendation #3, visit Flora restaurant for an authentic Dominican experience. Mascalzones is the Italian restaurant and we really liked it. Fausto is another of the luxury waiters at the Paradisus Palma Real. He waited on us at Mascalzones and at other resort restaurants.

Room
The room was clean. The hotel provides turndown service, if you request it. One problem was that there were mosquitoes in the room. Something curious is that there were no mosquitoes in other parts of the resort. Recommendation #4, you should bring insect repellent.

Beach and pool.
The beach was beautiful, there was no sargassum and Raul kept us hydrated all the time. Raul is one of the people who attends to the guests on the beach. He is fast and very nice. In the pool (our swim up) we had Julia. I had never seen someone as efficient, hard-working and friendly as Julia. We really enjoyed the beach and the pool and much of this was due to their excellent service.

Entertainment.
Every day our concierge sent us a notification with the activities that were going to happen in the resort. From what we read there are many activities for all ages, but in truth we did not participate in many because our interest was to relax on the beach and the pool.

In general.
We loved the remodel of the hotel, the service was excellent, the attention as Circle members was the best we have experienced. Many thanks to Gabriel Bobadilla member service manager, for his hard work and dedication. We are very satisfied with the service offered and we are sure that we will return very soon.

Mi esposa y un servidor decidimos pasarnos unas cortas vacaciones en Republica Dominicana y escogimos el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real The Reserve de la cadena Melia en el area de Bavaro en Punta Cana.
Les cuentos que nuetra estancia fue por cinco dias/cuatros noches en el mes de Junio/Julio un poco caluroso para nosotros pero nada comparado con el buen servicio recibido por parte de todo el personal del hotel.
El resort cuenta con varios restaurant a la carta , servicio de habitacion y buffet pero toda nuestra atencion se la llevó el restaurant The Santé especializado en comida mediterranea y sobre todo en dar un servicio FIVE STAR PLUS.
Queremos por este medio reconocer el profesionalismo de todo su staff desde su Capitan Eduardo Aquino , las Hostess Hirlenes Jimenes y Estevania Caraballo , los bartender y waiters Zuleica Rodriguez , Sunirda Joseph , Amanda , Rosa , Pamela , Franklin Acevedo , Gustavo Vazquez , Kelvin Feliciano , Bladimir Peguero , Roberto , los cheff Roberto el Pana y Santo de la Cruz.
Especial reconocimiento a la persona que nos recibio el primer dia y fue todo un profesional del servicio al cliente ( cinco estrellas plus ) durante nuestra estancia, al señor Jose Rosario. Gracias , muchas gracias por tu servicio y amistad.
Gracias a todo su equipo de parte de Maribel por portarse tan lindo el dia de su cumpleaños.
Quiero darles las gracias al concierge Dalmis Rodriguez y a las bellas camareras de piso por su diario y eficiente servicio.
No quiero concluir sin reconocer el trabajo del personal del Bar Piscina y playa del area The Reserve y al carismatico el pequeño Pedro.
A todos muchisimas gracia por hacer de nuestra estancia de las mejores en nuestras vidas. Gracias por hacernos sentir una gran Plama Real en medio del Paraiso

Maribel Gonzalez Delgado y Pavel Luque
Junio 29 - Julio 3 2023

reviews.author: Lindsey K
reviews.title: Spring Break '23 Trip with Family
reviews.text:
Great family. stay for Spring Break '23. We had intended to go back to Paradisus Playa Del Carmen, but didn't book in time so decided to check out Palma Real instead. The resort was recently renovated is the is a beautiful property on the ocean.

The good:
- Activities: A ton of activities for both adults and children. We did a fabulous parents only wine + tomahawk night which was one of our best "meals" of the trip. For kids/families, the nighttime activities were so much fun inclusive of a carnival night a neon music night. 
- Pools: Main pool is lovely and great service. Our swim up pool was also nice with awesome and attentive service.
- Spa: Location is a little weird right next to the pool, but service was excellent.
- Accommodation: We loved our swim-up one-bedroom. Plenty of space for our family of 5. As some reviewers mentioned, the main bathroom sink area + tub is sectioned off by a curtain vs a wall, which is a little strange, but was fine for us. The shower and toilet is separate. 
- Restaurants: For an all inclusive, pretty good food. The only place we did not like was Kanna. Our favorite meals were Blue Agave and Sante (parents only dinner). Ginger Bar had fabulous coffee/pastries in the morning and great drinks in the evening. 
- Kids Club: Great staff for all ages. Having a 1 year old, it was amazing to have a safe space to drop her off for a couple hours. Our older kids (4 and 6) also had fun in the bigger kids room.

The So-So:
- Premium option: We stayed at a swim up Nikte suite. As mentioned, the suite itself was lovely, but the Nikte experience in general was lacking compared to the Reserve option at Playa Del Carmen. They have a Reserve option for adults, but not families at Palma Real. There was no special lounge, no ability to plan your dinners before your trip, no exclusive family restaurant, and no exclusive pool. These perks were all incredible at Playa Del Carmen and helped make our trip (especially the lounge snack bar, which had great treats and coffee all day long!)
- Kids swimming: As mentioned, the main pool is lovely. But I wish they had more kid options. Playa Del Carmen has a pirate ship kids pool and water park. Palma Real did not have anything like this. I heard that a sister property did have a water park, but it didn't seem to be something they offered up freely or made convenient to get to.

All in all, we had a great trip and continue to enjoy staying at Paradisus properties.

reviews.author: ltarv23
reviews.title: Best Mother/Daughter Relaxation Vacation!
reviews.text:
I stayed at The Paradisus Palma Real in the Reserve Section. The main reason I came was for a quick, relaxing getaway with my mother. I fully believe the experience wouldn’t be the same without my concierge Edgar who has been very helpful and attentive so far! June is the perfect time to stay at Paradisus because it’s not crowded and the weather is perfect. I don’t understand why this is considered the off season. No rain just sunshine and good vibes! 

Beach:
I’ve spent most of my time at the Beach. I’ve noticed in the Reserve section there’s mostly beach beds as opposed to beach chairs. This section of the beach is limited to Reserve guests only, making it quiet and peaceful. The beach staff have been very attentive as well. Special thanks to Rafael for making out beach beds for us everyday and providing us with knowledgeable conversation. Also thanks to Martin for bringing me all the drinks that  I wanted and always having a smile on his face! He was exceptional! I hardly spent any time at the pool but I did spend time with Teofilo and Quintino at Wanda’s bar. Quintino went through the trouble of finding the champagne I liked and Teofilo brought me the bottle of Rigol champagne (exclusive to reserve guests) to the beach! 

Room: 
The room is tasteful designed and spacious. I love the premium items that Reserve guest get like Perrier water and peanut m&ms. Each reserve room has a bottle of Dominican rum and Mamajuana. As well as a fully stocked mini fridge! When we arrived there was a bottle of wine and cheese board waiting for us! If I had known prior I would have specified what kind of wine I preferred but they can always change it for you once you arrive. The only issues we ran into with our room were the our mini fridge stopped working. When we called maintenance at like 10pm they told us they would send someone up in 40min but no one ever came. When we called back at 11pm the man told us that someone came and brought a new fridge. When we informed him that there was in fact no new fridge he called us liars and ended the call. The next morning we informed our concierge Edgar and he made sure there was a new fridge! He’s amazing! I also have to say that housekeeping would clean the room and replace the towels but each time they would forget something like face cloths or a shower mat. Next time I come back I will immediately request extra towels upon arriving to my room and store them. 

Restaurants:

Sante:
This is definitely my favorite restaurant at the resort. It’s exclusive to Reserve guests and has a Mediterranean/Italian menu. Everything is fresh on the menu and the portion sizes are definitely larger than the other restaurants on property. I enjoyed breakfast, lunch, and dinner here. For breakfast a highlight was the freshly pressed juice options and smoked salmon omelet. I really loved that I could get a ribeye steak at lunch and milk fish ceviche. A dinner highlight was the Coconut shrimp and coriander risotto! Such an interesting combination but it was divine. Juan is so sweet, kind and attentive! 

Tokimeku😊 
The Nitsuke roast was my favorite. The sushi was excellent as well. My mother had the grouper/halibut (it said halibut on the menu but when they brought it out it was grouper) and she enjoyed it. 

Blue Agave 🙃: 
The Chintollo tacos were very very good.The chicken fajitas were dry and the tacos al pastor were dry. The margarita was basically just sweetened lime juice which I liked. 

Flora 😊: 
Sooooo good. Omg the salmon was soo good! The pineapple salasa on top was spicy but I love spicy food so it paired perfectly with the fish. The stewed goat and jerk chicken were ok. The jerk chicken was more like a roast chicken not jerk. The grilled octopus was exceptional. The whole fish was a Chillo or snapper. I’m not a fan of snapper but my mother loved it. 

Ginger bar: 
Probably my favorite place in the resort besides the beach. I loved the vibes in this area and the music at night time. This was the only other place in the resort I could easily get Rigol Champagne besides Sante and the Reserve Checkin. The only coffee drink I tried was the detox martini which was coffee and ginger juice shaken and poured over ice. It was actually really really good and I might have to make it a staple drink in my coffee routine when I get home! 

Lunch box: it was fine just your standard international buffet. I definitely could tell the difference in service from the Reserve section and even the dinner restaurants. I ate lunch and breakfast here and definitely preferred lunch. 

I wish we had time to try Mina and the Italian place for dinner. 

Overall I’ve enjoyed my stay at Paradisus Palms Real at the Reserve. I will definitely add Meliá to my rotation of hotel companies. I will also be coming to the Paradisus Real but I will only ever stay in the Reserve section.

reviews.author: David F
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay at a Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: One of our most memorable stays.  This all inclusive was fantastic, a beautiful resort in an ideal location on the beach.  Everything was incredibly clean including the many pools located throughout the property.  Not too many staff speak English but we were always able to find someone to answer our questions.  Our personal concierge, Claritzel O, was amazing.  She proactively sought us out and ensured we had reservations at one of their restaurants for dinner each night.  She had our cell number and regularly sent texts with valuable information.

reviews.author: Fabio s
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso,conservação maravilhosa,quartos limpos pintura nova sem um mofo , localização excelente, all inclusive com tudo de primeira, concierge Ruan nota 10 nossa primeira vez em Punta Cana com certeza voltaremos valeu a pena a experiência!

reviews.author: Francisco Santibañez
reviews.title: Excelente viaje a Bávaro

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Beach lover
reviews.text:
This was my first time at Paradisus Palma Real since Jan 2020 and since they have remodel the Royal Service (Now called The Reserve) section and it is beautiful.  The enlarges the adult only pool and added a second pool with room on the first floor that have walkouts to the pool.  It is very nice.
The restaurants were all wonderful and there is now an adult only buffet as well.  This resort is on the best beach - so if love the beach as I do and love to walk the beach, this is the place for you!

But what made my stay perfect, or I should say who made my stay perfect, was my concierge Kelvin Fernandez.  He was so kind, polite and very professional.  He checked in every morning so see how my days was going, if there was anything he could assist with and to make sure I received the list of daily activities.  He also checked in during the day, again asking if there was anything I needed and to make my dinner reservation.  He was very patient when I wasn't sure where I wanted to eat and made wonderful suggestions.  
I happen to mention that I needed coffee one morning and he took the time to show me they best coffee spot in the resort (The Ginger Bar).  He was right!

I would love to return to Paradisus Palma Real again and when I do I will most definitely be requesting Kelvin Fernandez as my concierge.  I don't think anyone could top his service!

I also have to give a shout out to Wanda the bartender at the Adult only pool area! She is friendly, fun and makes the best drinks! 

I can't wait to stay there again!

reviews.author: FarAway532061
reviews.title: Amazing STAFF AND CLEANLINESS
reviews.text:
Multiple staff members were so wonderful and helpful. Always happy and genuine!!
The resort was so spotless! Clean and sanitized. Beautiful! We loved the food in most of restaurants and service was on spot. Not much to do at night. A short show- which was good… but we went to casino for entertainment every night.

reviews.author: Emely P
reviews.title: Maravilloso!

reviews.author: sgripka
reviews.title: Ginger Bar is the place to be
reviews.text: We took a family trip and enjoyed our stay. We had great service everywhere, but really enjoyed our drinks at the Ginger bar. Ismael, Dominga, Antonio, Lisbeth, and Criceida at the Ginger bar took great care of us. Gracias!

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: El mejor bar
reviews.text:

Mi mejor recomendación es estar en el area lounge y pedirle a ellos que no paren de servirles tragos clásicos.

reviews.author: tara c
reviews.title: Great family place w amazing kids club

A few servers stood out: johnathon pool bar makes amazing drinks as well as Antonio and Olga at Ginger! Sonayti at ginger too! reviews.author: RJ R
reviews.title: Awesome week at  Palma Real.
reviews.text:
This is our 6th time to the resort. The resort has been totally renovated! New rooms and re-designed pool areas. Great staff. Very friendly.

Nicolas, our butler/concierge, has made every visit special, from our first visit in 2016 till now. His professionalism, and knowledge of the resort and area our unmatched. He’s the reason we keep coming back and also why we purchased timeshare at the resort.

I would also like to recognize and thank Pedro who works in the VIP beach area, and the beach crew.

All of the restaurants were good, but our favorite restaurant was Sante. Ask for Pana, he'll cook you a meal you won't forget!

reviews.author: Tory S.
reviews.title: Trip of a Life Time
reviews.text: From the moment in which we started communication with the resort to ask about transportation and how restaurant reservations worked they were nothing but professional, providing that high level of service you would expect. This continued during the entirety of the stay including the checkout process. Now for all the good from the stay itself. Upon arrival we were greeted and taken into the check in area given welcome drinks as well as champagne and then met our concierge, Cesar! He showed us around the full resort which was so impressively clean and not a leaf out of place. From there he explained how he would be the brains for our trip and that he was! I can’t even begin to say how wonderful it was to have him for the entirety of the stay just a text or phone call away. From making dinner reservations to the bottles of wine for “romance night” in the room. Everything was done with the upmost professionalism and love. With all the great he did we can’t forget about the staff like Wanda and Martin from the pool and beach who took care of us with drinks, cabanas and anything else we could ever want while outside the room. Giving guest space but knowing that exact right time to check in with them to provide the high level of service you would expect in the Reserve section. These 3 really made for a wonderful and memorable trip!  With a special additional shout out to those at Sante  restaurant Franklin, Gustavo and Sunirda what hard working and attentive individual! Always keeping out wine glasses full and mimosas with our breakfast. So attentive with everything they do. With that being said there were a few things which would level up the stay just a bit more. Leveling up the deserts to be something really enjoyable instead of just something to satisfy that sweet craving. The chocolate covered strawberries Cesar had in our room were the best desert we had during our stay! Having staff wait until the end of the trip to ask for review to really allow guest to soak in all the great experiences before asking for the review. Cesar really took care of us with his and even asked a coworker to back off. That being said they all were so respectful once you said you would be waiting until the end of the trip. This is a resort in which we would 100% return to and recommend to others!
