reviews.author: HappyTrailsTaU
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real, Thanks For The Memories
reviews.text:
As I look at the photos from our two week vacation in the Dominican and our stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, it is with the fondest of memories. We had a marvellous time!! The property is so beautiful and we commented to each other that it has real class! Our ocean front accommodation not only allowed for a stunning view of the ocean, but also to witness spectacular sunrises. We paid the extra for The Reserve & the perks offered were well worth it.

We did have wrist bands, but they are very tasteful and something that we actually wanted to keep as mementos. What we really appreciated was that they were easily scanned to give us access to our room so there was no need to remember a room key.
Our lovely suite was well appointed and very comfortable. A concierge was assigned to us during our stay and I've given him a special mention below because he is most deserving.

All the restaurants offered delightful dining experiences & delicious meals. We did have our personal favourites though. There were, however, a few surprises when some of the menu items weren't exactly what we expected. We think it was a matter of interpretation & we actually found it rather amusing. When travelling to another country, it's not realistic to expect that everything will be exactly as it is back home. So we just went with the flow & thought of it as an adventure.

We found some things to be a bit inconsistent with house keeping. Such as not always getting enough face cloths, turn down service being a bit hit & miss (not a big deal) or a pair of our slippers (from the resort) taken away one evening. When we asked for a replacement pair, we got two. The housekeeping staff were always friendly & most obliging when we asked for whatever we needed.

At times, we were challenged a bit with communication. It surprised us that some of the servers had very limited understanding of English. One would think they would need to know a bit more with the number of English speaking guests at the resort.

As for the evening entertainment, it takes place in the main courtyard, unlike other all-inclusive resorts that do an evening show in a theater. At Paradisus you just find a spot to sit & listen or watch, while servers come around with drink offerings. We enjoyed top notch musicians, dancers & gymnasts. Each evening followed a theme (i.e. jazz, Dominican night), but a particular favourite that we thoroughly enjoyed twice was the tribute to Il Divo. Only 3 singers, but wow, they were fabulous!

Besides deciding on where to dine each evening, was whether to hang out on one of the beds poolside or lounge under a palapa on the beach. Both were most enjoyable. We obviously were there at off season because there was always availability.

And the beach. Oh my goodness! The water is most inviting with such gorgeous hues of aqua & shades of blue. And so warm. The sand is some of the whitest and the stretch of beach just goes & goes in either direction. We certainly took advantage of that and set our goals to walk a bit further each time whichever way we went.

Friendly staff, bartenders & servers, etc made for a welcoming experience all round. There are some that we developed a great rapport with & they will always hold a special place in our hearts. If we should ever return to the Dominican, we would book at this resort again in a heartbeat, and can confidently recommend it to others who plan to vacation in that country.
******
This part of the review is exclusively for our awesome concierge at Paradisus Palma Real in the Dominican. His name is Juan Castillo & we were so blessed that he was appointed to serve us during our stay there.
The evening we arrived and were checked in, we met Juan who gave us a tour of the main areas of the resort and showed us things in our suite.
He was very diligent and stayed connected through texts & even met us somewhere on the property while he was on the job each day. He made our dinner reservations at the restaurants and stayed on top of anything we needed or requested.

The reason for our vacation was to celebrate my husband's milestone birthday and Juan was sure to make note of the date when we told him. On the day of, after an afternoon by the pool, we returned to our suite to find some delightful surprises. As we learned, Juan was responsible for it all.
Then Juan appeared at the door to deliver a cake, a bottle of champagne & a really cool hat for the birthday boy that demonstrated impressive craftsmanship. He even sang Happy Birthday! Needless to say, it all made for an exceptionally memorable birthday!

Another day we returned to our suite to find a little charcuterie plate and the tub again bath ready with fresh flowers afloat. Juan had arranged that as well. Too bad it was in the middle of the afternoon. Had it been in the evening one of us would have enjoyed the warm soak.

I called on Juan about getting a battery for my mouse (computer) which had died. I figured he'd know exactly where to get them. He gladly purchased that for me.

The last few days of our stay, Juan was off, but left us in the very capable hands of his colleague, Ralphie, who also served us well. The day we were to leave was Juan's first day back to work and we were able to connect with him, spend a bit of time together, and say our goodbyes. which was bitter sweet.

We believe that Juan went above & beyond his expected duties on our behalf, and we will never forget his kindness. We're certain that we made a new friend!

reviews.author: Rachel W
reviews.title: Impeccable Service
reviews.text:
I can not express how grateful I am for the above and beyond service at the Paradisus Palme Real. 

My company booked an incentive trip at this property and I almost didn’t accept the trip due to severe food allergies. I had a lot of anxiety before the trip,  but after I checked in I received a text from a private concierge, Nicholas, who was assigned to me. After meeting Nicholas, all my anxiety went away. 

Nicholas translated to the wait staff and chef and ensure my food would be safe. To my surprised when I mentioned I love mangos, he found a whole mango for me, his availability and always checking if I needed anything, not even food related, added an extra special touch to this trip.

Thank you to Nicholas, chefs, and wait staff, especially Andino who waited on my most meals and remembered my allergies and added to making my time in Punta Cana magical.

If you have severe cross contact allergies, I highly recommend this property. I look forward to returning for a personal trip in the future.

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Best Vacation In A While.
reviews.text: Our trip to this wonderful place was nothing short of amazing.  The staff and I mean each and every one of them were friendly and helpful.  Our room was really nice and I loved our firm mattress and comfy pillows.  The food was good and there is something for everyone. The pools and the beach were fantastic  and not crowded at all. Louis and Mario were our friendly bartenders and  were tremendous and so nice. This place is so big and so nice that we hope to make it back there as soon as possible.

reviews.title: Recomendado!

reviews.author: samsstang2
reviews.title: Another great trip to Paradisus.
reviews.text:
What an amazing trip to Paradisus.  This was our 2nd trip and both were amazing.    We did arrive very early, so our room was not ready but we had a drink at the lounge bar.    The best drinks!!    Thank you Olga Rosario and Ana Person.  They made amazing drinks with excellent service.  Olga might have been the nicest person we ever met at an all inclusive.  Always smiling, great service, and very sweet to the entire family.   

The rooms are very clean and spacious.  The Hotel is beautiful.  Never too far of a walk even though it is a large hotel.  It is very well organized.  

We went to the gym most days.  Has everything you need and never too busy.  

The beach is very nice.  A few days with seaweed but nothing they can do to avoid that.  The water was calm and beautiful.   The pools are very large and nice.  Go to get a drink at the pool bar.  Luis and Victor Feliz were the best.  Very quick service, great drinks, and a good time.  We did end up walking to the shops a few hotels away.   Not sure if it is worth it,  but we did buy a bunch of stuff.  

The service overall was excellent.  Maybe the best any at all inclusive and we have been to many.  Special thank you to Wander, Irwin,  Victor Sanchez, Luis Rodriguez at lunch, German at sports bar, Ezequiel Castillo, & Elise at Blue Age.   

Also I can not forget Stephanie Castillo who helped us set up a memorable dinner on the beach!!   Thank you.  You made our trip.  

For food we enjoyed the breakfast buffet.  For lunch the BBQ on the beach was my favorite.  Try the lamb chops!  My wife loved ordering lunch at the beach and that little bar has such good drinks and coffee.   

The restaurants for dinner were nice.  Nothing crazy,  Food was good.  Always different options.  Our favorite was Mexican,  we did not love the Italian.   They did have an adults only restaurant which was always empty while the other restaurants were full.  They should have opened that up for families to try.  

Make sure to check out the sports bar.  A lot of fun a great drinks.  Thank you German!!   They let kids stay until 9pm which is fair.   

The entertainment for adults and kids was nice.   Volleyball every day.  They even had soccer for some of the kids.  At night did not have a ton of entertainment but enough for us.  

Overall another amazing trip to Paradisus Pamla Real.  What made the trip was the service of the employees.  They always went above and beyond and I am sure I am missing someone but that made out trip.  5 Stars!!!

reviews.author: joni51
reviews.title: Excellent stay, Excellent staff! Attention to detail!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real
April 22-30

Check-in:
This resort is stunning! The view when entering is breathtaking, elegant and welcoming. There is a direct view from the lobby to the ocean.

Upon arrival, we were escorted to the Reserve (Adult only) check-in area where we were offered a welcome drink.  We signed our check-in agreement and received our bracelets which double as a room key.  We were met by our concierge Starlin and escorted to our room. 

Room:  
Our room 7102 was the Reserve swim up Jr suite.  The room was beautiful. It had a modern decor with neutral tones that created a very relaxing space.  There was plenty of closet and drawer space for our belongings.  The room included robes, slippers, and an umbrella.  The mini refrigerator included water, beer, soda, juices and snacks. Additionally, we were given welcome plate of chocolate covered strawberries and a bottle of merlot.  There was also a bottle of Rum and Mamajuana in the room.  The bed sat a bit high off the ground (I’m short) but it was very comfortable and we both slept well every night.  The room was a bit warm for me, I called the front desk and they were able to lower the temperature.   
The room walked out to a patio that contained 2 pool lounge chairs and an umbrella for shade, with direct pool access.  This pool was amazing and was always the perfect temperature.  The only downside to this was that on 3 different occasions we found other guests using our patio lounge chairs.  This room location was very close to the beach and the adults only “Wanda bar.”

Also a must mention- excellent Wi-Fi through-out the resort and beach! We streamed video in our room at night before bed with no interruptions. 

Pools:
There were 3 separate adult pools.  There was one large Freeform adult only pool with a swim up bar and plenty of chairs and umbrellas.  The other 2 pools were were part of the swim-up suites.  The pool closest to the beach is home to water activities such as aqua-gym.  There is also a very large family pool with a swim up bar in the center of the resort near the beach.  Still other pools are located on the family side of the resort with swim up room options as well.

Restaurants:
Mina: My husband had the t-bone (extra charge) and I had the veal.  The food was good but we were so tired from traveling all day, I really don’t remember much of this experience.  The wait staff was excellent.

Mascalzone: My husband had the ravioli and I had the lasagna. The lasagna was very rich, it was good but I couldn’t eat more than 4 bites.  My husband ate all of his ravioli and the rest of my lasagna.  Excellent service, wine and food!

Tokimeku: My husband had short ribs that were excellent. I had a sushi roll. Not too bad. 

Blue Agave: I had the meatballs, which were very spicy.  My husband had an assortment of tacos, they were very good. 

Winery:  EXCELLENT diner!!! This was the best meals of all time! Steak, fish, potatoes and vegetable on a board (see photo). This was my birthday dinner, they sang and brought me a cake. Perfect evening beyond words.  The Jonathons were on top of everything! 

Malva: The food here was ok, my steak was a bit hard to chew for me, but the potatoes were excellent and the wait staff were on top of it!  

Sante: This is one of our favorite places.  We had breakfast here most mornings. We also had dinner here one evening and had steak and lobster. Lobster was so good, I was full and couldn’t eat the steak. The next time for dinner, I had pasta with shrimp and my husband had ribs he loved them!! They also have a Sunday brunch that is excellent!!

Flora: We had lunch at Flora one day,  had the jerk chicken, it was excellent!

The Lunch Box: Yanira is the best! She always recognizes us each time we return! She is always happy to see us and makes us feel at home! We ate at this location for breakfast and lunch. Wide variety of foods to choose from and the staff was excellent!  

Kanna Beach Club: This has your typical American cuisine, hamburgers, wings, hotdogs, Quesadillas, great comfort food.   The wings were my husbands favorite!

Kicks Sports Bar: This place is the “cheers bar” of the Palma Real, we love our friends (staff) at this bar.  They brought me a cake and sang for my birthday and the hugs and genuine care is why I cant wait to go back!! The attention to detail was phenomenal! EVER SINGLE one of them treated us like family! We also participated in a mixology class in this bar one afternoon. It was so fun!  Shout out to Andreina, Victor, Miguel and Fiol, thank you so much for your wonderful hospitality!

Wanda Bar: Wanda kept us laughing and made drinks with a smile! She was there from 6am to 6pm every day! Also if you have an upset stomach talk to Wanda, she has the cure! It may not taste great, but IT WORKS (yes my husbands knows this from experience!)

Entertainment: Every evening they had something is the square. One night they had telescopes, got some great detailed photos of the moon.  They also had bands, singers, dancers, fire twirlers and over the water acrobats. Also kicks had a DJ or band later in the evening. Kicks also had any and every game or sporting event on their TVs. 

Beach: The beach is my happy place! Pedro at the beach kept us laughing and was on top of everything! Unfortunately Mother Nature struck and the sargasso was challenging, yes the resort did their best to clean it up.  Pedro even brought us plenty of Mimosas’ and flowers for my birthday! 

Spa: Good massage, wish they had hydrotherapy at this resort.  

Golf:  Just a quick shuttle ride to the gold course(0.8 miles), if you are staying at Palma Real you just need to cover your cart fees.  If you have your own clubs, bring them, rentals available if needed. Beautiful golf course! There are 27 holes, driving range and putting greens. Well manicured course.  Easy to sign up for  tee time on the website, they pick you up and go!

Above and beyond for my 55th birthday!!  Please see the video! Starlin and Yaleidi, were excellent concierges!! Our room was decorated with balloons, streamers, flowers, desserts and champagne! The bathtub had flower pedals as well as the bed!  We also had turn down service that night with chocolates on the pillows! The attention to detail was amazing!! 

Negatives: Just a few brief points: 
Random people on our patio swim up loungers on multiple occasions.  
wish turndown service was every night (feeling spoiled asking for this one). 

Summary: This vacation went by too fast, we cant wait to go back and see our family!  This was so amazing I don’t have words.  The food was better than we remembered. We have been to this resort a few times, but this was our first visit since the renovations, love the updates! Yanira is excellent at the Lunch box! Pedro at the beach also excellent! Starlin and Yaleidi excellent concierges’, always available when needed! Kicks family, Adreina, Fiol, Victor and Miguel, cant wait to see you again! 
What we love the most, is the staff remember us from previous visits.

reviews.author: lbdsdraper
reviews.title: Felt like royalty for the week
reviews.text: We changed our resort at the last minute due to a flash sale on Expedia for this property and I am so happy we did! We stayed in a beautiful nichte swim-out room and had an amazing time. Check in was quite smooth, we were met with a cool towel and were directed to the buffet to get a snack while our room was getting finished. Our room was clean, updated, large, and came with Concierge service- this was great because he was able to get us dinner reservations at all of the different restaurants. Before we arrived at the resort, the property sent us an information sheet and asked if we were celebrating anything special and any special needs to be aware of. We were tickled to have our room decorated with balloons and a cake for our 35th anniversary. We had an exceptional concierge with Osvaldo Veloz and want to send him a special thank you. Beach and pool service was exceptional- I have never been to a resort where  staff was so attentive as a whole. Property and pools were clean. There is an abundance of umbrellas and loungers both near the beach and the pools so you do not have to get up at 7 am to get shade! Loved that!  The resort needs to offer more shows at the resort- pretty quiet at night at this resort and more entertainment is needed. I appreciated many of the staff and had a good experience in general with all. Even though this is an all inclusive, bring dollars and tip these hard working employees. It might have been 88 degrees and hot, but Erickson M. always had a smile on his face as he provided drink service around the nicte rooms and their multiple pools. These employees work hard and I appreciated the way that they made me feel like royalty for a week. Housekeeping, front desk, and restaurant workers greeted us with kind words no matter where we were.

reviews.author: Shana B
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!
reviews.text:
My husband, sister and brother in-law and I stayed at the Reserve in late-April 2023 to celebrate my husband's 40th. It was our second time (first in April 2016), my sister and brother-in-law's first. It was also our first time away from our two kids, 1 and 3, for an extended period of time. WE HAD A BLAST!

The Reserve was pretty empty, due to time of year, which we LOVED. It was mostly quiet and felt so private. The resort has been completely renovated and looked fantastic (it was lovely before as well). The check in was seamless and a beautiful area. Our room was ready upon arrival and pristine, clean and cool. The gym was clean, cool and spacious. The restaurants were delicious (Mina and Flora were our favorites! And Sante was good for lunch.) and the adults-only pool and beach area was absolutely beautiful and relaxing, with the exception of a loud and rowdy, lower-end crew that seemed to trickle in just for the weekend (loud personal pools-side speakers drowning out the mellow music the resort was playing, throwing up in the pool-side garden). 

As far as activities went, we LOVED the catamaran ride to a quiet part of the island to do yoga and then swim in the ocean with monkeys and parrots. My sister and I each did a massage at the Yhi Spa, which we enjoyed, and the boys played golf twice and enjoyed the course! We also loved the daily activities, and had a blast doing the water aerobics and laughed our way through the in-pool pole-dancing (LOL!!). 

Our concierge, Manuel, was EXCEPTIONAL and such a gentleman! He made sure we knew what restaurants and amenities were available to us, checked-in regularly in a very low-key manner, made us every reservation we requested in a timely manner, and sent over a special treat in honor of my husband's birthday. Paradisus is truly lucky to have him, and I do not remember having such a wonderful experience with our past concierge (known then as a butler) in 2016.

A few other standout employees were Jorge, who ran some of the pool and beach activities, and Wanda, Grey and Maximo at the Reserve pool and bar. All of their service and demeanors were wonderful and they made our trip truly the most relaxing and memorable. We can't  wait to go back.

My only constructive criticism would be to have more knowledge of how to accommodate people with food allergies and preferences. I am unable to eat foods prepared with certain oils, and it was very tough to communicate this to the staff (language barrier), even with a custom card our amazing concierge, Manuel, provided us. Even when communicated, my food still came out incorrectly prepared most of the time. Luckily my reaction isn't life-threatening, and just inconvenient.

reviews.author: Dorothy B
reviews.title: AN OASIS OF PAMPERING & RELAXATION
reviews.text: We had 10 days at the beautiful Reserve Nitka Room swim up.  This was our first time here and it is gorgeous!  The beach is breathtaking; the facility is immaculate; and we were thrilled with the restaurants, activities, ocean and pool swims as well as night shows which more than met our expectations.  We were blessed with the best concierge ever - Wily Mercado who took care of our every need and whim - making all reservations for us and answering our questions in such a timely manner.  Wily went ABOVE & BEYOND all you could possibly expect.  Huge thank yous to the lovely Loyda Tejeda who was our fun and super attentive  pool bar server extraordinaire!  She made our trip extra fun for sure!  Gladys Dominguez provided an amazing massage and even helped cure my sore shoulder!  Elizabeth Joaquin worked hard to keep the buffet area so clean and neat and always had a beautiful smile on her face (every single day!)  and was so welcoming and warm.  We enjoyed many lunches at the Kanna Restaurant and received great service and laughs with Elvin and Francisco who were also so welcoming and helpful and spoiled us every day.  The food at Sante Restaurant was exceptionally delicious but truly, all the meals we had were fantastic and so many choices at the buffet as well.   We did have a slight issue with a long wait at one of the restaurants but once we voiced our concerns, it was all made good and we felt that management really cared about their guests and wanted to make our stay excellent in every way and they followed up with us repeatedly to make sure we were happy.  The whole experience was so relaxing and everywhere you looked there was beauty in the surroundings and especially, in the people who served us.   We would definitely go back again and I highly recommend this beautiful oasis of total pampering!

Se puede solicitar cualquier bebida y alimento en casi cualquier lugar del hotel, las instalaciones son de primera. Volvería sin dudarlo!.

reviews.author: Julie F
reviews.title: Beautiful paradise!
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful! We went with a networking business event where we had some planned dinners and some days/evenings to ourselves and the resort was perfect for that. The Japanese hibachi restaurant was the best food we had and the buffets were plentiful. 
We had a Consierge named Dalmis Rodriguez and he was very helpful! He sent us the daily activities, made our reservations, and even helped us get more M&Ms (lol). Very nice staff.

reviews.author: Jose Maria P
reviews.title: Estancia maravillosa en Paradisus Palma Real !!
reviews.text: Hemos pasado una estadía maravillosa en el hotel.  Hemos viajado mucho y por muchas cadenas de hoteles y en Paradisus sin duda ha cumplido todas nuestras expectativas, tanto de tranquilidad como de disfrute en familia.  Sin duda volveremos

reviews.author: anapS3663OO
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Hotel muy bueno, personal muy amable, servicio excelente de restaurantes y comida muy buena. Lo recomiendo 100%. Ubicación inmejorable frente al mar, se puede ver desde cualquier punto del hotel. Increíble!

reviews.author: Christian Chena
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia, hermoso lugar y el mejor equipo humano.
reviews.text: No sabría cómo empezar para explicar lo bien que pasamos con mi familia en este hermoso resort que es Paradisus Palma Real. El servicio impecable, las actividades del día siempre cargadas de belleza del lugar y un acompañamiento más que excelente del equipo humano de este resort. Atribuyo el 100% de la experiencia maravillosa a la gestión del Sr. Wily Mercado, quien siempre hace que la estadía en el lugar no sea solo un viaje, sino un recuerdo de esos que brillan siempre en la memoria. También destaco al mejor soporte que es el amigo Franklin, que siempre estuvo ante cualquier consulta de asistencia técnica. Cada vez que visitamos Punta Cana, no dudamos que Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort es el lugar para ir, y consideramos a Wily Mercado, definitivamente, familia.

reviews.author: Beatriz J
reviews.title: Restaurant Sante
reviews.text: We loved the restaurant Sante for adults only from the food to all the service and in particular the Sante staff like Zuleica, Fausto, the two Franklins, Luz, Gustavo, Jose, Juan, Pamela, Zunilda and everybody else, as well as the chefs  Juan Tavera y Rafael. They were always very warm, kind and cheerful. And I had a very special birthday celebration!!❤️

reviews.author: Melwin M
reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text:
The hotel was amazing! They gave us the most incredible Concierge who went out of his way to make sure our stay was incredible. Shout out to Felix Garcia! 

The restaurants at the hotel were a bit slow, but maybe that's just because I'm used to faster service in Europe. They often forgot orders but that might've been a language barrier. Though, it felt like there was a disconnect between the kitchen and staff.

Make sure you reserve either through one of the awesome Concierges or by yourself, even if the restaurant isn't full, they will tell you it's full. We went up to one of the restaurants and we got the message that it was full and they couldn't serve us, even though we clearly saw that there were 4 people sitting in the restaurant. But because they had a reservation at 9PM (It was 6:30 at the time) they couldn't serve us because it would be too busy.

reviews.author: brookmill
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
We just returned from an amazing 7 night stay in the Reserve. The resort is absolutely beautiful! Team of people out every morning cleaning and refreshing everything from cushions on chairs, to the beach, to the pool, to the walkways. Always greeted with smiles and every person we met was ready to help with anything we might need.

Our concierge, Starlin, was AMAZING! He arranged all of our dinners, even one night making a last minute switch when our excursion returned late. He was there to help with anything we might need.

Loved the variety of activities--from unique exercise (spin class in pool!) to pizza making/Aperol Spritz workshop--fun and low key and no need to sign up in advance

Food and Drink--first time I have been at all inclusive that had true craft cocktails. Each bar had signature drinks and each had a slightly different vibe. Food was very good--some hits/misses but overall very good. We only ate at Sante one night and wish we had gone more often--if you like steak--go there instead of Mina. We mostly at Sante for breakfast and lunch, but unlike many buffets, there's is WONDERFUL--great selection and the lovely seating area with attentive staff to bring drinks and clear tables. Definitely check out the grilling stations on the beach next to the Taco Truck and next to the snack restaurant on the beach.

Some of the people who made our stay amazing;
Starlin--WONDERFUL concierge
Eduardo and Gustavo--Sante
Lucia Diaz--Ginger Bar
Wanda--ReservePool Bar
Martin--Beach Attendant

We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Freddy B
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Ismael in the ginger bar was so helpful making us terrific tropical cocktails as we're all the waitresses they made us feel at home....my concierge Aeriol was absolutely terrific and over the top 5 star service all the way can't thank you enough your my reason for wanting to come back and we will come back for sure sooner than later.truly my best stay here in Punta Cana Ever and I've been Here six times I'm al.ost Dominican Now lol.

reviews.author: Michele B
reviews.title: Amazing restaurant service
reviews.text: Amazing service at the resort and especially Nikte restaurant, Jose del Rosario, Feliz, Andino,   Laicho, Saudys, and Alex Marthur were all attentive, professional, and helpful. And, very delicious food!

reviews.author: dleone123
reviews.title: April 2023
reviews.text: The resort was only reopened for 4/5 months before our arrival after a huge renovation.  The rooms were beautiful and everything was very clean.  We had the Nitke Master 2 bedroom swim up.  The swim up room was the best decision we made- definitely worth the extra money.  The concierge service was great.  Fernando was the best- scheduled all of our dinner reservations and excursions.  He was always available and overall a terrific guide and he made sure we had a great experience.  The only downside was the food.  It wasn’t bad, but not the greatest either.  Our teens loved the buffet as they are picky eaters and could always find something good to eat. The restaurants were ok- the Italian was our favorite.  Overall, we loved our vacation and would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Fetiye T
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We had a great vacation at Paradisus Palma Real. Our concierge Yaleidi was great. Super attentive,  and she helped us book our dinners and excursions and answered all our questions. She walked all the way to the beach of another hotel to help us when we wanted to do parasailing. She found us at least once a day everyday to check in person. She made our overall experience great!

reviews.author: Danilo L

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Spring Break 2023 - One for the books
reviews.text:
We booked our stay Dream Makers Vacation Services. I highly recommend them. Mike helped to allay any concerns I had about the DR and the Paradisus Renovation. This was our third trip to this resort and it did not disappoint.  The property has grown since our last visit in 2018 and dare I say the customer service has grown as well.   Everyone we encountered from our assigned concierge Diana to the Manager Cesar was professional, friendly and helpful.  We had terrific weather and excellent meals, the Buffet, to taco truck on the beach, the steak house, MINA check out my tomahawk post, the Mexican restaurant. We had delicious meals and a fully stocked room with snacks which my children enjoyed daily.  We stayed in the swim up suite. Every day we took advantage of walking out our sliding doors and into the pool.  This was a truly an added perk. 
Finally, again I must say that vacations are a time for family memories and meeting new people. The people we met at Paradisus will forever be remembered.  
Roseanna  (Buffet Breakfast, and lunch always with a  warm smile and hot coffee)
Yudi Javier (Besos!!!!! We wish we could have brought you home with us. Such a delight working morning and night and every time we saw you you made us laugh or smile. Bless you.)

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Family Vacation Success at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
If I could rate this 4.5, I would. Not quite a 5, but nearly perfect. 

The good/great: 
- The room. We stayed in a swim up Nikte master bedroom suite. We were traveling with our toddler (2.5) and she stayed in a hotel provided crib in an alcove in the master bedroom where the tub/extra sink was. BUT there was a curtain divider and a separate door to the bathroom, so we could stay in the living room during bedtime/naps and she couldn't see us at night/in the morning. 
- The pool outside our room was great - sun bed, chaise lounges. The hotel staff would swing by to offer a drink (or you could grab a beer from your stocked minibar.) 
- The beach. We were about a 5 minute walk to the beach. Yes, there is a bit of seaweed, but nothing crazy and it is the ocean after all. The waves were manageable and my toddler enjoyed playing in the wake and going into the water. 
- The restaurants. The restaurants for dinner - especially Mina and Blue Agave - were great. The buffet was good and had lots of options. The fruit, tostadas and French toast were all especially good at breakfast. Some things were a miss at the buffet but they're catering to many different tastes. 
- The staff. This should be #1. Everyone from front desk, to our concierge (Edgar!), to the servers at the buffet and restaurants and the staff at the kids club was lovely and trying to make our stay enjoyable. 
-The hotel/design. This place is beautiful. The beach is beautiful. 

We didn't use the kids club b/c the kids seemed to skew older than toddler, so we didn't think our daughter would enjoy it. But we saw kids participating in the activities - which are numerous - around the resort. Susu - a staffer in the kid club - was very welcoming when we went to check it out. 

This hotel seemed to cater to conferences, which could go either way, but seemed to make the place quite while being busy. You always got a beach chair, always got a seat at the buffet and just generally had peace and quiet. 

Overall, we had a wonderful, chill beach vacation where we didn't have to worry about anything in a beautiful place with wonderful, welcoming people. What's better than that?

reviews.author: Lorrainbow
reviews.title: Luxurious hotel, great food, great service, too pushy on the sales
reviews.text:
We (family of 2 adults, 2 kids aged 10 and 8) booked Melia hotel with Loveholiday. Less than a week before they emailed and said there were no rooms available and had changed the reservation to paradisus. Paradisus is a much more luxurious hotel but less child friendly. It's not anti child just melia has a water park and is more lively. 

We got caught in a sales pitch. Our concierge said we should try breakfast in the other hotel and he had a $100 voucher for us which we thought was for the hotel change inconvenience. It wasn't, it was for sitting through an aggressive sales pitch. The sales person sat with us at breakfast, she was very friendly but the whole thing was very pushy, writing down numbers. I tried to be polite and said enough after an hour but they didn't listen and started again. My husband was very blunt and said no and stood up. 

That was only 1 of 2 negative parts of the holiday. 

The two bedroom hotel room was amazing. The rooms were interconnecting, ground floor with an outdoor shower and hot tub outside each room. Seating area, kitchen, it was like a mini hotel. 

The pools were great. Bars were great, high quality drinks. The buffet was great. Different food every meal, every day.  Lots to choose from and lots cooked fresh in front of you. 

As many people have mentioned there is so much staff around. If you need anything they're right there to help. 

The second bad thing was the restaurants. The pizza place was not good, the pizza at the buffet was better. It was soggy and didn't taste great. The steak restaurant is amazing, we went there twice. The Mexican restaurant, we arrived at our reservation time at say 7.30pm. At 8pm we asked when we'd be seated, they said the next table was ours. We watched them give it to another family 15 minutes later. So 45 minutes of waiting we left. That was disappointing. 

We booked a catamaran trip, skape park and Katmandu. All excellent. Skape park is very simple and you can't quite fill the full day. The bus drops you off in the morning and collects you at 5pm but 3pm would have been better. It's a lot of walking but everything is great, zip wire, cave swim. The monkey "island" is a patch of grass in the entrance! But it was a great day out.

Katmandu is setup like Disneyland, lots of staff, lots of places for people to queue but when we went it was empty and felt a bit soulless. The rides weren't amazing, very tame. But still a fun day out. 

Altogether it was an excellent holiday, very luxurious, very hot. We don't tend to visit the same hotel again and again so we wouldn't go here precisely but maybe a different hotel, like the Melia!

reviews.author: jent1005
reviews.title: Nikte - PPR Adult Trip Swim Up (Circle Black)
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from a 5 night stay at The Palma Real - Black Circle Members, staying in a Nikte swim up room. This trip was seamless for us! We were met deplaning at the airport, taken to the lounge, no immigration, baggage in the car and at the resort for check-in just 50 minutes of time! Outstanding. The only blip was that we arrived earlier in the morning and no one seemed ready to receive us. But once we had our concierge, Kenneth, everything was PERFECTION. To the Management:  Kenneth deserves a promotion.  We have been members for 10 years now, first Club Melia now Circle.  Kenneth stands out.  He has a bright future with you and should be noticed/rewarded appropriately.
In the room with our welcome chocolates/berries/Cava was a note explaining all of the amenities included in our stay. It was clear, and appreciated. And met with my expectations of what was included. This was a couple/adult stay for us and we had no need to be at Falcon or visit Katmandu. Service across the resort was on point and no one let us want for anything - ever. We were offered lobster or steak or lobster AND steak in one form or another at each of our dinners. The presentation and quality of the Tomahawk steak at Mina is over THE top! We laughed and had fun with the staff. Shout out to Jorge at the Black Circle Lounge (tending bar)...to Rosanny at breakfast.  We shared our Easter meal with the staff at Brisas - great meal, great staff (Yonely, Denice, Stomin).  More thanks to the staff at Mascalzone, everyone at Mina (Kelvin, Esekiel, Blue Agave too!  We did our best to appreciate everyone. We would not be more pleased with the improvements and are very happy to have the Members only Beach Club at the Palma Real. IMHO it was lacking with The Reserve (now Garden Suites) and Level Guests being mixed with members. At every turn our member level upgrades were offered and received. Oh.....and our room was made up each day and turn down service each night. 
 Just remember to put the light on requesting it when you leave the room.  Already looking to come back!  Well done.

El hotel es lindisimo, muy bien ambientados todos los espacios. La habitación es espectacular. Todo muy limpio.
La comida del buffet es riquísima, de enorme variedad y buena calidad. El hecho de que esté abierto todo el día es comodisimo. Genial el food truck en la playa con cebiches y parrilla. Probamos el restaurante de sushi y el de pastas y no valieron la pena. El personal en el desayuno varía en su nivel de atención, hay que encontrar con insistencia quien te sirva el café. 
La atención de Eriol Alix fue muy amable y atenta, siempre pendiente de lo que necesitáramos y preocupado porque estemos bien, haciendo más agradable nuestra estadía. Se esforzó por todos los días ocuparse de todo.
Destaco que además fue excelente la atención médica de la Dra. Grullón ante una emergencia que tuvimos. Sorprende contar con una profesional de ese nivel de manera permanente en un hotel. Pedimos una ambulancia que llegó en el acto. Son cosas que uno no piensa de antemano que va a necesitar y fue gratificante que todo funcionara tan bien. 
El kids club regenteado por Yesmeily Tejeda Abreu, Martha y sus compañeras fue inolvidable y uno de los motivos por los que nuestra estadía fue excelente. Amorosas, divertidas, confiables. Todos los dias una actividad mejor que otra, superó cualquier cosa que hubiéramos imaginado. ¡¡Increibles las actividades y el manejo de los chicos!! De lo mejor.
Las canchas de tenis muy buenas, nos dieron raquetas y pelotas. Sugeriría más actividades para los adultos, el nivel no se compara con las de los chicos.

reviews.author: vanessam714
reviews.title: Amazing Family Trip
reviews.text:
I was nervous because of all the challenged reviews. It was an unbelievable vacation. Absolutely recommend for families!  Don’t hesitate!

We had a 2 bedroom Nikite Suite.  Super comfortable beds and beautiful rooms that are just intuitive in their layout and BIG. My only critique was the one of the bedrooms didn’t get cold enough but when we called our concierge it was fixed immediately which I believe just meant they lowered the set floor for the thermostat allowing it to cool more. 

The pool waitstaff and bartenders are outrageously attentive and so friendly – you don’t go more than 3 minutes without a drink if you want one. It’s remarkable how hard everyone is working to make sure you have a good time.  All of us said it was the best service we have had at any hotel ever. 

There are pools that surround the rooms which all have drink service. A really nice touch if you don’t feel like dealing with the chaos of the larger pool or just need a break. 

The fact that your room key is on your wrist at all times (and works all the time) is brilliant. All of us commented how we wish it was like that all hotels. 

Our concierge was Nicolas and he was super responsive and helpful. He got us great dinner reservations each night, made massage and other spa appointments and made our kids laugh. He sent us the daily activities each morning too along with the room service and spa menus. We never had to chase – always proactively texting to provide info.

We did the buffet for breakfast and sometimes lunch.  It was good with offerings changing just enough to make it interesting.  Highly recommend the omelet stations and the fresh fish cooking station was a bit hit.   Kanna is next to the buffet and has really great offerings for snacks / lunch. There were also grill stations on the beach each day with meats and vegetables. Our favorite restaurants for dinner were Agave Blue (Mexican) and Mina (steak) but also liked the Italian restaurant. Special shout-out to Manuel and Eduardo at Blue Agave – unbelievably welcoming and responsive hospitality staff.  Truthfully, all of the restaurants were good.  The only restaurant I would skip next time is Malva which had great service but the steaks were chewy. Highly recommend the Ginger bar – they had the best drinks + they have games (chess etc) in the cabinets. 

The hotel goes out of the way to provide unique offerings day and night – it’s just a great touch that a lot of places don’t take on and the staff has such great energy so it feels fun. We have 6 and 9 year old boys so we gravitated toward the kids-oriented activities.  During the day, this included pool activities like inflatables, body boards, obstacle courses, and then on the beach there was face painting, basketball inflatables, soccer games, dancing, etc.  It’s amazing how much they organize each day to make it unique.   There were also events each night including a circus night with performers, astronomy with telescopes, dancing transformers, and a local market among others. These were all on the plaza with bars throughout. It was a great way to spend time with kids and adults after dinner.  

The Xi spa and the fitness center could use a refresh but honestly not a big deal for us.  Skip the gift shop if you can – it’s crazy expensive and it’s likely worth asking if there are nearby alternatives if needed. I know there is a pharmacy nearby that delivers.  

I got a massage at the eco spa and I highly recommend Katherine – she was fantastic – I went 2x.  

We did go to Katmandu one to the afternoons.  It is a theme park on the hotel property.  The hotel will give you bracelets which allow you to enter one of the attractions at the park for free - the quadragon. It is a dimensional climbing gym. Our kids probably spent 30 minutes playing. I’d recommend it if you’re there and need something new / active to do as it’s a golf cart ride from the hotel. Accessing the rest of the park costs $120 for 1 adult + 1 child. CRAZY!! So we skipped it. Honestly they are going to struggle unless they lower the price by 60-75%. 

One piece of advice - do yourself a favor and bring $100-200 in small bills to tip. We never carry cash and the ATMs weren’t working.  It doesn’t feel like there is any expectation to tip but we wanted to and having the small bills would have been nice.

reviews.author: Marissa H
reviews.title: Great week!!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week at the Paradisus Palma Real. The grounds are gorgeous and the staff so friendly and helpful. We don’t bill ourselves as “all inclusive” people - mostly because we are pretty picky about having good food and had a bad experience at a different all inclusive resort many years ago. Lucky for us, the food all week was fantastic! We ate at most of the restaurants and did the buffet for breakfast and lunch. There were also grills going everyday at lunch outside where you could get different meats freshly grilled. Room service was also available. Our two favorite restaurants were Blue Agave (Mexican) and Mina (steakhouse). Franklin from Malva was a great server. Wilmer went above and beyond to take care of us at the pool/beach bars. And the best for last, Kelvin was our concierge and was amazing. He secured our dinner reservations and helped us with misc requests all week long. Would highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: joannecasey
reviews.title: Time of our lives !!
reviews.text:
My hubby and I visited the Paradisus Palma Real from March 20-27/2023.  We initially booked a swim up room at the Reserve, however when we got there we were asked if we wanted to be upgraded to the newly renovated Palma Real. We were very skeptical as to why we received the upgrade, perhaps they overbooked, however we really lucked out.

Our swim up room was stunning and spotlessly clean. Our concierge Yaleidi Sims was a beautifully sweet lady who took care of whatever we needed. She dropped by 3 separate times during the week with wine, dipped fruit trays, and meat and cheese trays. She connected with us daily through WhatsApp, no problems getting reservations. The staff at the bar by the swim up rooms was fantastic as well. Whenever they noticed us outside they came right over to see what they could get us.

The staff everywhere were so happy and personable. And I mean everyone. From the restaurants, to the beach, to the pool, to the maintenance staff. They really did make us feel like family.

While I see a lot of complaints about the food we were very pleasantly surprised. The flavors and spices they used were absolutely delicious. My husband has been a chef here in Canada for 30 years and he gained 8lbs while away lol  He was so impressed by a t-bone we had at the steak house that he asked to speak with the chef. 

The servers at the buffet, the Italian and steak restaurant are now like our best friends. They greeted us every day with a huge smile, never let a glass go empty and just could not have been more happy to help us. Be on the look out for the following names, I believe they rotate through the restaurants :
Arito, Virtudes Mercedes, Melvin de la Cruz, Yonely Cancu, Andrea Santana. They will give you excellent service <3

The pool ... oh I miss that pool.  Never felt crowded, great swim up bar and lots of loungers. We were able to get a covered hut next to the pool every day we spent there and it was heaven. They made the huts up with towels and pillows and constant drink service. We had many an outdoor nap in those huts ! Jose our pool guy was the best !!

The beach was stunning, both the sand and the water. The only thing that we found a little hard was the vendors. I have never seen as many as that before, but they were all friendly .. there was just a lot of them :)  But we realize they are trying to support their families so we just politely declined and they would move on happily. The water was really warn and did have a little bit of seaweed but they constantly are removing it from the beach. Plus we are East Coasters so we aren't afraid of a little seaweed !

The entire resort is so beautifully decorated and very very clean. As much as some seems not to, we really enjoyed the entertainment they provided.  Great bands, and opening for those bands one night was a super talented electric guitar player, she was beautiful to listen to. Another night was a violin player and a mermaid by the fountain. And on Earth Day they shut all the lights off in that area and had a really stunning ceremony with candles. 

Honestly we cannot say enough about the service and amenities here. We were very fortunate to get a crazy good deal here last August through Costco. Unfortunately I see now that the price has really gone up. But I would pay it to be here. When we left, we felt like we were leaving home. Cannot wait to go back !!

reviews.author: soapbox73
reviews.title: 7 Days of Paradise at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa
reviews.text: Sitting here on our last night and reflecting about what a good time we’ve had and have so much to say. The property is beautiful and so clean! You can smell the cleanliness in the air as you arrive and walk around. The entire staff is so professional, hard working and willing to do most of whatever you ask. As Americans, we felt like a minority which is fine. The resort seemed to have guests from many different countries, especially Europeans, so Spanish is the main language spoken but many staff did know English also. We were happy to be immersed in the local culture and not have that drowned out a bunch of American culture or influences. The food, pools and beach are all very good! We had a 2 bdrm master suite for four of us including myself, husband and 2 boys ages 14 and 15. The room was perfect once you get the hang of all the light fixtures and what they operate, etc. Room service was prompt and always available just as advertised. We were here for spring break and there were always chairs available at both the pool or on the beach. We had a concierge named Nicholas and he was so helpful because we always had dinner reservations for exactly where we wanted each night. Not sure how our stay would have been without him? The only downsides as far as we could see was that traveling w teens we wished there would be more for them? A teen oriented club or hang out would be great. We saw a lot of other “bored” teens either walking around aimlessly looking at their phones and/or hanging with their parents which I don’t think they necessarily wanted to do but being at an awkward age not really knowing how to facilitate meeting other teens, especially from other countries, on their own. Also, there are no hot tubs on the property at all, which I thought was strange for a resort of this size. Hot tubs are always a great place to unwind after a long day and they also facilitate conversation for adults and teens alike. There are none. The resort is brand new and seems to have a lot of large spaces dedicated towards the “Circle Members” of Melia that never had anyone in them! Dedicated restaurants and private hang out areas that could possibly used for something else? A teen lounge with some pool & ping pong tables, foosball, video games, board games, air hockey, Uno and playing cards, etc. would be really cool. My husband and I would have had a better time if our kids were having a better time. They did have a beautiful child care center for younger children, I’d say for maybe 7 or 8 years old and younger. All in all we had a wonderful stay and would probably stay here again in the future. The staff and grounds are what really make the resort special.

reviews.author: Judy P
reviews.title: Service and amenities and beauty are beyond ones hopes and dreams!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I have traveled extensively in our 55 yrs of marriage. Living in Europe for 10 years in the 1980’s, we traveled extensively and stayed at hotels throughout. This was our first time in the Dominican Republc and at an all inclusive hotel. Our experience was outstanding!!! I arrive at the resort with a most unexpected injury that occurred on our fight to the DR. We were instantly welcomed by Marielisa Nunez and Karina Santana. They were our very first impression of this glorious resort and such a positive one. They were so compassionate and eager to assist me and my husband in any way! A phenomenal on site/in-house doctor, Dr. Batista, saw me immediately. In the interim,  my room was most unexpectedly  upgraded from a junior suite with a garden view to one with a pool AND ocean view! Lovely array of sweet delectables and a chilled bottle of wine awaited us upon our return from the hospital emergency room. Diagnosed with a lacerated LCL, I was told minimal walking, wheel chair, no swimming in the multitude of glorious pools, and no beach! 24 hour room service was magical as I could keep my leg elevated while eating breakfast and enjoy the breathtaking view of the ocean, the lush gardens and a beautiful pool. Our concierge Ernesto would call each morning to check on me and he and Rosemary de la Cruz would take me by wheelchair to a chaise lounge and almost lift me up so that my feet didn’t touch the soft white sand. Drinks were offered to me as I relaxed and enjoyed the beautiful colors of the sea! Marielisa Nunez, truly an asset to this glorious resort, would consistently surprise me with her thoughtfulness. One of many examples, she’d walk to the beach in her free time, to be sure I was most comfortable. Thanks to the many on-site restaurants, the buffets and evening entertainment, my husband and I truly did not feel “handicapped”  in spite of my inability to walk and, instead, be in a wheelchair. Aside from the stunning resort, ( I could not stop taking photographs of it) , our beautiful room, the overall immaculate cleanliness, there was such attention to details, AND the entire staff were the most warm and gracious and genuine people we’d ever experienced.  There was not one member of the staff that was anything less than wonderful! As my husband loves to golf, I insisted that he go in spite of my injury. He was so taken by surprise when he returned to our room from his first day onthe course, to discover that my wheelchair AND I were not there!  That was only possible because of the unbelievable staff assuming the task of taking me by wheelchair to wherever I wanted to GO! Had this not been true, I would have no alternative but to remain in our hotel room until my husband returned from a game of golf.  I felt as though I had my own personal staff.Ernesto, our concierge and Rosemary de la Cruz  accompanied him and even wheeled me into a store on the premises where they assisted as I chose a beach hat and purchased my sunscreen!   Talk about “ ALL inclusive!”  Hearts of gold is what they have! The mini bar was replenished each day, our room was attended to whenever it was best for us and a large bag of ice was brought to me each evening so that I could follow the doctor’s orders and ice my swollen knee. 
Regretfully, I only have the names of a few others that were so very dear to me. Might I suggest you take photos of their name tags. 
Eduardo Aquino has the sweetest smile and a twinkle in his eyes, Miguel De La Rosa, John Carvajal, and again, I must repeat Marie Nunez, not enough positive adjectives to describe her!  Our personal concierge, Ernesto and Rosemary de la Cruz were the best chariot drivers and so very kind to me. We highly recommend this incredibly wonderful resort and spa. The Melia hotels will be those we chose wherever they may be in our future travels!

reviews.text:

reviews.title: Great annual trip to Melia Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Just got back from a great vacation at the Melia Paradisus Palma Real.
We stayed in the Reserve Adults only for the second time. They remodeled the rooms and put two new pools in which was extremely nice.
The bar was remodeled and is very nice.
Fortunately Wanda is still the bartender. she does a great job, the drinks are the best and always greets you with a smile and hi poppy.

reviews.author: JT
reviews.title: Spring Break Get-Away
reviews.text: Overall, the resort grounds, buildings and amenities are first class. We found the service to be excellent. With the buffet, there was always plenty of food. We were lucky enough to have concierge service which made it easier to navigate the resort. Our concierge was Raul who was great. He was extremely responsive to our needs.

reviews.author: Brendan T
reviews.title: Phenomenal Relaxing Luxurious Vacation Paradise
reviews.text:
Phenomenal stay! A perfect relaxing trip with family. 

This is the fourth time we have stayed at this resort and the improvements and renovations were definitely felt. The new restaurants and areas are luxurious and perfect. The hospitality, service, and attention to detail is incredible. 

A few shout-outs are deserved here. Wanda and Luis at the Reserve Pool bar are incredible. You have got to try the Wanda special. She would always be happy to help you and always with a smile on her face. Just lovely. Gilberto at the Reserve beach bar and the rest of the crew are also fantastic, always helping us with setup of the bali beds and with drinks. Luis our personal concierge included with the Reserve always checked up on us and got us our restaurant reservations without issues. Countless others like the waiters at the Sante restaurant and the Lunch Box / Kanna Cafe were always so fantastic and got us all we needed.

The beach was beautiful as it used to be, just minor seaweed which is unfortunately getting worse in the whole Caribbean region every year. Totally swim-able ocean waters. This season seems to be much better than in late summer months when we used to go. There was effort made every day to clean the beach of the seaweed which was greatly appreciated. 

The food was definitely improved on since our last stay. The new Reserve exclusive Sante restaurant was incredible, the best spot by far. We went twice. The buffet (Lunch Box) options were all good for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Mexican restaurant had great food but was a little too loud. The steakhouse was as bit disappointing, only the skirt steak was tasty, and better cuts were locked behind paid fees. 

Lots of pools and bars around and very lively even at night with the new sports bar club and nightly entertainment in the palazzo area.

The new renovated rooms were very nice, but not as large as the previous Reserve section. I believe that is now a separate hotel called Garden Suites. Unsure if they have access to the Paradisus. That would be the only complaint. And no jacuzzi on the terrace / balcony as previously had.

The membership / timeshare pitch is a bit absurd and one presenter was very arrogant during discussion. 

Overall an amazing stay, looking forward to visit again!

reviews.author: Gary
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
This resort was our 3rd vacation this winter and also our best. We were greeted upon arrival with a nice cocktail and was looked after very well the whole week by our concierge Miguelito Cuevas. Every thing from doing Sunwings job, to making our dinner reservations,  to making sure we had extra water in our room every day.
Our room was large and clean. We did have a couple problems like the 1 sink very slow to drain and the tub leaking which was fixed immediately.

The food in the buffet was great, plentiful and varied.  We tried 3 of the 4 ala carts and decided to stick with the buffet.  We didnt have to worry about a time and we could eat whatever we felt like that day.

We did not go on any excursions. We go for the beach and it did not disappoint. It was huge with soft white sand and it seemed to be cleaned daily of seaweed.  There was never a problem finding a palapa. There were lots. 

The resort seemed huge but was never crowded. It was well kept and very clean.

We would certainly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Demetria T
reviews.title: Spectacular Service
reviews.text:
Great Hotel!

I stayed in the Nikita suite at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort and Spa. I had an amazing time! The hotel is right on the water, and the ocean was a perfect turquoise blue! There is some seaweed and the hotel does a good job of trying to keep the beach well maintained. Did I mention the beachside service - a waiter carrying your favorite drink was always available! Drinks can be as strong or as light as you prefer (ask for a Dominican Sangria and try the mamajuana). My concierge (Felix) did an amazing job and was very attentive, welcoming, and thoughtful. He decorated my room for my birthday and helped make arrangements for anything I needed.  The suite was huge and ocean front - waking up to that spectacular view everyday was definitely a highlight. I can’t say enough about the service, everyone was nice and extremely helpful (house keeping, wait staff, lobbyist, etc). The spa is a unique outdoor spa - Dorka did my massage, and was very thorough. Gladys gave me a beachside shoulder massage and was amazing.  This hotel is not the party hotel, it’s much more designed for relaxation and families. There was some entertainment at night (live band, violinist, acrobats, dancers) but mostly this is a chill environment.

Cons - Food - I struggled to find good food. Breakfast, I ordered room service (which was fine). Buffet was bad (skip it and order off menu - shrimp tacos). The small bites at the bars are your best bet for lunch. Dinner - by far the best restaurant was the Blue Agave (Mexican), the food was spicy and flavorful.  The steak
Restaurant was meh, not a fan of how the beef tastes. The Hibachi restaurant was ok (mostly because of service - I never saw an empty glass the whole night).

Cons - beach vendors are extremely aggressive, especially if your a woman (they aren’t just selling souvenirs).. after day3 of 6, I wanted to avoid the beach all together.. which was unfortunate because that’s what I came for..

Overall - I had a great time and would go back for sure!

reviews.author: PavementDude
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real...
reviews.text:
My family and I, as well as another couple with kids, just returned from a great vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana.  This was our second time at the combined resort, which includes the Garden Suites and Falcon Resort, and to which we had access.  

We stayed in a one-bedroom swim up suite, which was recently renovated.  The kids loved being able to jump in a pool from the patio and there is a bar very close by with attentive staff.  The provided cabana was great for relaxing and getting out of the sun.  Room service was prompt and cleaning staff were friendly.  The only real issue with the room was that there was no bathroom door - only a sheer drape.  Not sure if this is a temporary supply-chain issue or the final design.  Privacy in the separate toilet and shower areas was provided with opaque glass doors, so it wasn't a big deal.    

The resort itself is beautiful, with a central Roman-style plaza that is used for the various evening shows, which included a rock band, Elvis impersonator, circus, etc.  The shows were very professional and enjoyable.  In addition to the buffet, there are a number of restaurants including Italian, Mexican, Asian, Seafood, Organic, and a Sports Bar.  The selection and quality of the food at the buffet was very good and the staff were excellent.  One evening we enjoyed local Dominican fare at the Falcon Resort - again great quality and service.  

As the resorts are connected, we were given bracelets to access the waterpark at the Garden Suites.  It is relatively small, although it has separate areas of varying water depth and is suitable for babies up to 12 year old kids.  Our kids are ages 6 through 11, so they had a fun morning followed by lunch at the on-site grill.  

The resorts main pool is huge and there is a separate Adults Only area, which we enjoyed one day while the kids were at the kids club.  

We paid extra for a private wine-tasting in the on-site Wine Cellar.  Our sommelier was enthusiastic and walked us through six different wines.  He also let us know that we could reserve a table in the cellar and have food from the other restaurants brought in if we wanted a more intimate dinner one night.  We'll take him up on that offer the next time!  

As we were celebrating a milestone birthday, we ordered the Romantic Beach Dinner for one evening.  The staff setup a separate table on the beach with lighting and provided a dedicated server.  We enjoyed a set menu including cucumber salad, pumpkin soup and an enormous steak topped with half a lobster tail!  Dessert included a small serving of cheesecake and a birthday cake.  It was an amazing evening for sure.

The Kids Club staff were very kind and attentive and there were a decent number of individual activities - some in the club itself (Kidsdom) and some at the beach.  The St. Patricks Day Scavenger Hunt was a big hit.  Our kids enjoyed it a lot, but not for the whole day - you can probably count on them wanting to be there for about half of the day.  

The resort is on the beach, so there is a nice area with chairs and thatched umbrellas.  Raul was very nice and attentive - bringing us towels and drinks.  As with any other resort, there are a number of salespeople that approach you on the beach selling everything from tours to souvenirs, although I will say that they are quite friendly and not aggressive at all.

Finally, our overall experience at the resort can be attributed to our dedicated Concierge, Nathaneal, who helped us navigate the resort, book restaurant reservations, plan our day, ensure our minibar was restocked, and generally ensured that we were not lacking anything.  Thanks very much Nathaneal!!!

So, although we like to try new places when we travel, it's likely that we'll be back to the Paradisus Palma Real given our excellent experience and would recommend it to anyone looking for an all-inclusive with great service and facilities.

reviews.author: Ludivine S
reviews.title: A refaire ! Hôtel et vacances exceptionnels !
reviews.text:
Nous revenons d un séjour en famille en République dominicaine dans cet hôtel … et à refaire nous signerions de suite ! 
L hôtel est magnifique , la nourriture excellente , le personnel hyper sympa , et les installations au top ! 
L hôtel est plus ou moins divisés en 3 parties , nous avons séjourné dans la partie thé réservé / ou garden suite au centre , c est la partie non rénovée mais hyper verdoyante et c est ce qu on aime particulièrement ( même pas rénové il est vraiment tés bien ) ! 
Les piscine sont grandes , avec différentes hauteurs de bassin pour les enfants , aucun soucis à trouver transat ou lit balinais ! La plage n est pas juste à côté mais pas très loin non plus - une voiturette fait des trajets allers retours ! 
A la plage même principe , aucun soucis de transat , boisson ou autre ! 
Il y a un espace enfants avec toboggans , glace à l italienne et burger en non stop ! Cet espace et en même temps proche de tout et assez éloigné pour ne pas déranger les éventuelles siestes au bord des autres  piscines ! 
La nourriture est variée et vraiment excellente ! La majorité des restaurants sont en plein air et ventilés par des hélices ( on est pas fan des clims) . 
Le seul petit détail , on a testé les restau ( aussi inclus ) et aucune différence de menu entre le peruvien , l asiatique et le tapaniaki donc à faire une fois mais sinon sans intérêt ! 
On est également adeptes des bons cocktails ( important quand même ) , les bartender sont au top , pas d alcool bas de gamme et beaucoup de choix ! 
Pourtant nous n avons pas été des clients simples : un doudou de perdu et un petit accident de foot pour mes enfants ( points de suture quand même ) mais l hôtel s est parfaitement occupé de nous , doudou retrouvé ! Et pour la petite blessure de mon fils médecin / traducteur / taxi bref ils étaient au top ! 
N hésitez pas , vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés !

reviews.author: Hollie D
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with our two teenagers. We had previously been to the Paradisus Punta Cana which has now been torn down so I'll talk about that as a comparison for those who have stayed on the Paradisus Punta Cana (PPC). We loved that resort so much and were looking for someplace to replace it.  This resort is a different style but still wonderful in its own way.

Rooms-We stayed in the Two Bedroom Master Suite on the Nikte side, second floor. The room was updated and we had a nice view of the swim up pools. Our shower leaked quite a bit at first but they fixed it right away. Otherwise,  absolutely beautiful rooms. 

Food- The Lunch Box buffet was great, better than the buffet at PPC. We went to all of the a la cartes for families and liked the Mexican and Italian restaurants and the steak house. We had great service at all. 

Pools- They were a little cool but welcome when it was 30 degrees outside. The main pool was cooler than the swim up pools. The pool at the PPC was warmer for those who have been there. We swam at the beach in the morning and at the swim up pools in the afternoon. We never had to fight  for pool loungers which is a first ever for us at a resort. There were also a couple of bars for the swim up pools and they came around regularly to see if you wanted anything to drink.

Beach- Absolutely beautiful beach. There was an abundance of palapas and beach chairs so once again no challenges with finding a spot. The service was great and they took drink orders regularly. The water was calmer than at the Paradisus Punta Cana and much more swimmable. The ocean was a very comfortable temperature.  They groomed the beach regularly.  There was seaweed but it wasn't that bad. 

Service- Overall there was great service at this hotel. You had to make reservations for a la cartes every morning for that night. You couldn't reserve ahead. We had a personal assistant though who made reservations for us. 

The resort is beautiful with amazing views from the lobby and looks stunning from the beach too. The landscaping is less lush or tropical than it was at the Paradisus Punta Cana. I think the gardens are growing up after the renovation and probably won't take long to fill in. Still very beautiful. Melia Garden Suites seems more like a mini Paradisus Punta Cana in style.

It's a low density resort so you never feel like you're tripping over anyone and adds to a feeling of luxury.  Sometimes we felt like the swim up pool was just for us!

The  only thing I think we missed was the entertainment. The shows at Paradisus Punta Cana were so great with a lot of special surprises and events for guests (e.g., surprise flash mob dancers in the lobby, a mystical garden dinner, fun beach parties). We missed seeing dancers and shows. They had some great musicians though. Just more low key. This is more of a chill out resort. 

Overall, we had a wonderful, relaxing time at this beautiful resort and would highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Tracy G
reviews.title: March vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I along with two other couples just returned home from a week long vacation to the Paradisus resort.  We had a wonderful week of relaxation and fun.  We highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real resort for anyone thinking of getting away.  We stayed in the adult only section, the Reserve, and were impressed from the moment our vacation began.  The facility, our room, the restaurants did not disappoint.  I can't end this review without bringing positive attention to the staff.  In particular Harry Milor, our consierge, made our trip from arrival to departure a seemless experience.  He was available to us at all times and anything we requested he made happen.  His personality, kindness, consideration and thoughtfulness was something not to be overlooked.  He undoubtedly had other clients but never did he not give us his full attention when attending to our needs.  In addition to Harry I would like to mention Jose Reinosa (Jose drinky drinky, to us this week)  who served us drinks by the pool every day.  He went out of his way make our days relaxing and enjoyable.   Rosanda, who served us breakfast and lunch at the Lunch Box was one of the kindest servers we met this week.  She would seek us out, often having a table prepared for us in advance.  She greeted us with a wave and a smile from across the courtyard in the mornings in anticipation of our arrival. Martins, Yuredi, Rafael and the crew by the ocean side greeted us daily as well.  They went out of their way each morning to have our area where we liked to sit all ready even before our arrival.  There was not one person during our stay who did not make us feel very special on this trip.  The conversations that we had this week with Harry and Jose were inspiring.  These people are good, kind and genuine.  Thank you for a wonderful week.

reviews.author: Donna Marie
reviews.title: Beautiful Property! Excellent Service!
reviews.text: Won this trip with 100 others as a reward with my job! It’s on the beach and gorgeous! My personal concierge, Luis, was the best! I forgot to ID one of my luggage, I texted him and he had it delivered! He made dinner reservations, and was truly at my service! Some guests were members of this property and I can see why! The people in Punta Cana are super friendly and helpful! I definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: Sue S
reviews.title: Great Beach Vacation!
reviews.text: Amazingly few tourists at resort.  Plenty of chairs (under umbrellas) at beach and pool. White soft sand. Room was huge with included refrig drinks and snacks.  Easy to be overserved!  As soon as you sit down anywhere, someone offers to bring you a drink!  Great beach tote included in room.  Arrived to bottle of wine and fresh fruit tray in room.  Only need reservations for teppanyaki table, steak house and italian restaurant.  Great entertainment.  Eat at 6 or 6:30 p.m. and then go out to courtyard for entertainment.  Room key is a cute braided bracelet!  Never leave room without access to room!  Negatives: Water very slow to heat up.  Kids in "adult pool" and no employee stopped them.  Adults only Malva was closed most of the time we were there.  "Oceanview" room was only visible from over bathtub window, but we were truly very close to beach from our room.  Learn a few spanish words before you go because some staff are not fluent in english (soap, washcloth, pillow, asking for ginger ale gets you a moscow mule!).

reviews.author: Phil F
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent resort. The service was over the top.  Francisco V was our consultant and he went over and above.  Food was great. The beach was amazing as well.  Highly recommend.  I will be going back many times.

reviews.author: Joseph I
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Can’t wait to go back!! The weather was good and the food was delicious. Rooms were clean, shows were great beaches where great.  The butler was great… even mad some money in the casino. Highly recommend

reviews.author: jacqueline s
reviews.title: Chef
reviews.text: Un aplauso muy especial al chef  Jonás Jimenez que lkegó hace 2 meses al complejo, a mejorar la calidad de los alimentos en los restaurantes. Con mucho cariño lo ha logrado y nos ha atendido en forma personal a toda la familia en las actividades programadas del hotel.  Clases de ceviches varios, clases de Tomahawk, demostración de sushi. A sido un privilegio conocerlo y probar sus dotes culinarias.  Recomiendo a todos participar en estas actividades.

reviews.author: Rob G
reviews.title: Always an Incredible Experience
reviews.text: My wife and I have been to the Palma Real before on a large family trip and it was an amazing experience. This time we went by ourselves to see the newly renovated resort and it did not disappoint. One of the highlights of our experience was our Concierge, Francisco. From the moment we arrived, Francisco made us feel at home. He made sure we had a reserved section at the beach every single day, whenever I reached out to him he answered immediately and he helped us schedule a private boat for one of the days by making sure it was a safe trip and recommended we go to Isle Saona (which was a perfect day). It was Valentine’s Day as well the week we went and Francisco was my wing man .. while we were out at the beach that day he went to our room and set up a whole Valentines Day scene. By the end of the trip Francisco was basically family and we can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Anita L
