reviews.author: coastal218549
reviews.title: Golf Group
reviews.text:
Our group of 9 golfers has been staying at Paradissus Palma Real for years, and this was our best trip yet. Our rooms were newly renovated, as was most of the resort, and they have done a fantastic job !
A special shout out to our concierge Nicolas who always looks after us with professional top notch service. Nicolas has become a friend to our group over the years with his friendly attitude and his willingness to go above and beyond. He is the best !
I would also like to mention Francisco Santos, the Reserve manager for helping guide our group prior to arrival . Francisco checked in with us to make sure all was well, which was a nice personal touch. 
We met Juan Pena, the customer experience manager, who came around at several of our meals to make sure we were happy.
Our Bellman, Jose Ramirez, greeted us each day with a big smile and a helping hand.
The restaurants have all been renovated. We especially enjoyed the Blue Agave and the Wine Bar.
Beaches are outstanding  , new swimming pools and landscaping.
Would definitely recommend this resort !

reviews.author: scorona75
reviews.title: Buena experiencia
reviews.text: Muy buena experiencia en el hotel, aunque tienen que mejorar las actividades nocturnas y la manera para reservar en los restaurantes. Excelente los restaurantes Flora y Blue Agave Mexicano. En el restaurante mexicano quiero mencionar a la señorita Jeiry que prepara los tragos y cócteles. Excelente persona y muy profesional.

reviews.author: Nancy A
reviews.title: truly beautiful
reviews.text: Gloriously beautiful property with fountains, pools, lots of varied and well-designed places to swim or read or talk with friends or just hang out.  Well designed rooms, very comfortable.  Incredibly friendly and helpful staff (you will say 'hola' two hundred times a day in response to friendly greetings from everyone you pass).  Alejandro Gomez is an amazing concierge who cheerfully and magically made everything work, from a room change (for a larger bed), restaurant reservations (for a restaurant which was supposedly fully booked), to the ultimate miracle - spouse's mobility scooter was damaged by airline handling and Alejandro had technicians at the room in half an hour who fixed it expertly and permanently.  Great evening displays in the main fountain area which varied from night to night, including acrobats one evening, a telescope for moon and planet viewing another, and classy old cars another.  I was worried I'd be bored staying mostly on the resort grounds for four days but I was not bored at all.  The water and sea air vibes let me be in the moment.  The spa is one of the most beautiful I've ever seen and the massages were great.  Was everything perfect?  Well, no.  Food is mostly good but you have to choose carefully - you'll learn which items on the breakfast buffet translate well to the setting and which don't (there is a huge variety so there should be something for everyone).  There are ice buckets in the room but no ice machines, you have to call room service for ice.  The room has a coffee machine and a hot pot for tea water but no cups.  Housekeeping doesn't always keep up.   Spa didn't have a robe large enough for spouse.  Still, those are small details and everyone is accommodating and tried their best to correct any issues.  Would go back tomorrow.

reviews.author: Marc Z
reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.text:
Our first trip to the DR.  Was told many great things about the resort and now understand why....location, location, location!  It is so scenic and beautiful.  The resort is wonderfully situated with stunning views and lots of places to relax and take it all in.  There are multiple pools, lounges, and cabanas across the property, with wonderful folks to take care of you during the week.  

A few stand out people include...
--Antony Ortiz
--Jhonatan Acosta
--Rina Herman
--Maximo Cedano
Their service was so exceptional that we had to capture their full names to recognize them here!  They truly made our week special!  Thank you!!!

Also a shout out to our concierge, Juan Castillo.  He was there for anything we needed throughout the entire week.  We appreciate all you did.

The only negative about the week is that it is apparent the resort is still getting up to full speed after its major renovation.  Our understanding is that they just reopened at the end of 2022, and it shows.  Some property fit and finish needs correcting, and there were some hiccups in the week when it came to restaurant reservations and service.  But none of that detracted from our overall enjoyment, and only means things can be even better in the future!

reviews.author: Irene B
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text: Just spent 5 days at the resort and it was wonderful.  The food at the buffet was a large variety and all delicious.  The different restaurants were also good. Our concierge,  Hector,  was extremely helpful and pleasant to work.  Would definitely return.

reviews.author: LMN
reviews.title: Awesome times at Sante Restaurant!!!
reviews.text: If you want to be spoiled be sure to spend time with Jose and his incredible team, Dionis Marelin,Andrea,and Rafael at Sante Restaurant! They will leave u with incredible moments and memories that will last u a lifetime. Thank u from the bottom of our hearts!!!

reviews.author: Tom N
reviews.title: 5 star
reviews.text: The trip was excellent, for the second time. The staff were fantastic. Walquiria Brito and Luis Desa in the Gin Ger cantina was primo and took the best care of us. They took great care of us while we were here for 9 days. I would stay here evert time I thought of coming to the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: David H
reviews.title: Best resort in Punta Cana!!
reviews.text: My wife and I came to Paradisus for her 40th birthday. We had an amazing time. The resort is beautiful and we will definitely be back. Our concierge, Jose Simeon, was fantastic and made our visit even more special with his attention to detail, thoughtfulness, and professionalism. 5 stars!

reviews.author: sflmarbella
reviews.title: Paradisus palma Real
reviews.text: Grandes instalaciones y buenísimo servicio tanto por Oswaldo en servicio de atención al huésped y Yelisza en el bar gin ger, muy bien también la comida del restaurante Satén y sobre todo Pedro en el servicio de playa, todo amabilidad.

reviews.author: Jessica K
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Jose Emilio (manager) was great, hostess Sunirda was so accommodating and the food was wonderful! The resort is beautiful and so well taken care of. Great waterfront location. I strongly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Crystal G
reviews.title: A little piece of paradise
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel. Service was great. Everyone made us feel welcome. Our room and the property was beautiful, great access to beach. Our conceraige Nathaniel was very helpful, and always responded to us quickly. This is a wonderful place❣️

reviews.author: elenabieber0830
reviews.title: The best resort!
reviews.text:
This resort always exceeds my expectations! It’s my 4th time in Paradisus Palma Real ( Punta Cana) and I will definitely go back! 
The atmosphere, service, food , facilities are all excellent! 
Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Jose Tomas Olivares
reviews.title: Lujoso y tranquilo Resort para descansar
reviews.text:
Recien remodelado, lugar muy bonito y tranquilo para descansar. 

El servicio podría ser mejor, ya que se nota hay mucha gente nueva que esta todavía aprendiendo. A pesar de esto, la experiencia y atención al cliente es muy buena, por personas que se esmeran en dar lo mejor y entregar soluciones. Mención especial a Pedro de la playa, Alan de servicio al cliente, Miguelito el concierge y a Milqueya Camilo del restaurant Sante.

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Amazing experience!!! Magnificent complex with all sort of food and amenities for all ages
reviews.text: The Hotel Melia Paradisus is perfectly named after the experience you will live in this wonderful resort. Besides the magnificent decoration, the lovely atmosphere and delicious aroma, you will mainly enjoy amazing beach and gourmet food. The staff is extremely nice and helpful. The rooms are spacious and comfy, with different areas and all the amenities needed! My wife and I had a wonderful vacation and will for sure come back :) I would like to thank Ariel our concierge who prepared several surprises for my wife's birthday, and Miguel, Jhon, Paola and Valentina from The Circle Office!! Thank you very much!! you are wonderful!!

reviews.author: bwhited1
reviews.title: Great value and experience for the money.  Would return
reviews.text: Overall a great experience.  Food was as expected for an all-inclusive resort and wifi was spotty sometimes, but overall a great time.  Irvin was the best host, and always took care of us! We would definitely return, and possibly with kids.  There seemed to be more than we anticipated to entertain kids.

reviews.author: Maria gracia V
reviews.title: Buena experiencia
reviews.text: Muy entretenido todo especialmente por jorge ben muy buenas actividades y lección de baile y actividades de la piscina! Muuuy buena persona

reviews.author: Brian r
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text:
Excellent staff and accommodation’s were provided at the Paradisus Palma Real.  We were there for two weeks commencing January 23, 2023 to February 6, 2023.

The maids were great at their jobs but the service at the restaurants and bars was excellent.

reviews.author: havefunexploring29
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Great service. Clean rooms. Fresh food. Great people and customer service. They have a lot of staff working on the resort. Security, etc. Beautiful beach. Highly recommend. We plan on coming back. Thanks!

reviews.author: Simone N
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text: experiência incrível para tudo, atendimento, limpeza, lazer, comida, restaurantes, bebidas, funcionários super prestativos, quartos maravilhosos, comida deliciosa, drinks incríveis. Só tenho coisas boas a falar deste hotel, sem problemas com nada. Família, casal, solteiro… vai aproveitar e muito…

reviews.author: Sixto Camacho
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text:
I am a frequent guest and the main reason is the staff. The bellmen (Emmanuel, Omar, Pedro, Jimmy, José Arismendy, Miguel, Luciano etc) they are awesome and always willing to help. The people at Tokimeku and Flora are great specially Fanni, Greysi, Dayhani, Frank and Ana.

I always recomend this hotel and like I said the big difference is the service. Best staff ever.

reviews.author: Sara T
reviews.title: Can’t wait to go back again!
reviews.text:
Stayed 7 nights on a paid vendor trip. From the moment we arrived we were treated like royalty. Everyone was so kind and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and felt comfortable.

The 90 Celsius bar by the adults only pool is a must hangout!! It had the most amazing staff- Arisleida, Eddy and Rosana were a blast and we loved them! They all went above and beyond to make sure our time there was perfect!

reviews.author: D_morri
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: We scheduled our girls trip back in September 2022 and we finally arrived to Paradisus in February 2023. The service we had from Arisleida Perez, Eddie and Rosanna at 90 Degree bar was hands down the highlight of our trip. Great service and such fantastic people. So wonderful and they really made our trip. Kudos to Arisleida, Rosanna and Eddie!

reviews.author: Sergio6464
reviews.title: One week at Paradisus Parma Real
reviews.text: The service by our concierge Edgar. R. Was superior! Room, meal was exellente. We see fiew good show, circus, music, the Moïtos was exellent. They put a lot of money on the site and for the maintenance, lot of bunch a peaple working ther for it.We go there again next time!

reviews.author: Marina G
reviews.title: ¡De 10!
reviews.text:
El Paradisus Palma Real fue la última parada de nuestra ruta por este maravilloso país. Una sabia elección para disfrutar de unos días de descanso y desconexión antes de poner rumbo a Madrid. Cuando creíamos que con semejantes instalaciones y un entorno de ensueño la experiencia sería inmejorable, llegó Alan López para recordarnos qué se siente cuando alguien trabaja con el corazón; sin lugar a duda, él ya ha pasado a formar parte de nuestros mejores recuerdos del viaje a República Dominicana. Su amabilidad y atención constante hacen que te sientas especial y no quieras irte jamás. Me gustaría destacar también la profesionalidad del Chef, Ángel Duarte, el cual, además de encantador es capaz de deleitar hasta los paladares más exigentes. Víctor Feliz (su propio apellido lo define), Geraldino, Patricia, Franklin y Yanira Sosa son otras de las muchas caras amables y sonrientes que siempre estaban “a la orden” e hicieron de nuestra estancia una EXPERIENCIA INOLVIDABLE. 
¡Gracias! 
¡Ya estamos deseando volver!

reviews.author: Dave L
reviews.title: 90 Degree Bar experience and Service above and beyond.
reviews.text:
We visited the subject resort Jan 23 to Feb 6 2023. 
Overall rating is excellent and in particular Eddy Luis de los santos and Arisleida Perez went above and beyond to make our stay excellent. They were the servers at the bar 90 Degrees.
We would certainly recommend that if visiting the resort to attend at the 90 Degree Bar and pool.

reviews.author: GyroPelican
reviews.title: Rina Herman is the best pool person
reviews.text:
Rina made our trip extremely special. She anticipated our needs and went above and beyond. When you stay here you must ask for her and your trip will be much brighter.   
The family buffet has a very wide range of food options and the staff was very helpful.

reviews.author: Maude D
reviews.title: FLORA restaurant
reviews.text: Grandiose service by Felix, great food. Best meal and best service we had all week. GRACIAS Felix Uribe! He was vwry attentive and efficient. We will be back for sure. Other restaurants dont conpare, go there for lunch!

reviews.author: AmourSpain
reviews.title: great hotel and amazing people.
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 days, 
warm staff , great food, amazing beach , high level decoración .

Special thank you to Fb manager Cesar, running around everywhere non stop, ready to solve any problem . 
Ralphy was our angel these days.

You Rock guys!!!

reviews.author: Samuel M
reviews.title: Comentario Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Muy buen servicio, fue una muy buena experiencia para pasar con la familia. El trato de los trabajadores es muy bueno y cercano, sobretodo el de Altagracia Cruz, que trabaja en el Sport bar, donde pasamos muchas noches. Muy recomendado para la familia.

reviews.author: Kika M
reviews.title: Comentario palma real paradisus
reviews.text:
En el sport bar la experiencia fue muy buena, siempre cariñosos y pendientes de uno. Destacó a Altagracia cruz, José Hernández, Miguel soler,  yisauri Contreras y Victor Sánchez que siempre te recibían con una sonrisa y muy atentos. 

Muy buena atención

reviews.author: Constanza p
reviews.title: Vaciones
reviews.text: El hotel es buenísimo y la atención es mejor. En la playa Isaías estuvo siempre atento a todo lo que necesitabamos y siempre se ocupó de que disfrutemos nuestras vaciones. La comida es muy buena al igual que las habitaciones que dan frente al mar

reviews.author: stefano m
reviews.title: Excelente.
reviews.text: Nuestra estadía en el hotel fue muy buena, nos atendió Isais, muy buena onda y atento a todo lo que le pedíamos. Siempre dispuesto a ayudarnos, nos conseguía buenas reposeras y atención las 24 horas, por siempre agradecidos.

reviews.author: Tracey A
reviews.title: Experience
reviews.text: Unbelievable experience at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. The staff were so accommodating and friendly. The resort has something to offer for everyone. The for and services were top notch. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Manuel F
reviews.title: Best of the best 👌
reviews.text: An amazing vacation!  Thanks to Nicolas Maracallo for consistently going above and beyond!  Thanks to Pedro, Martin and Yuderi from Reserve beach for the best beach experience!  Amazing food and staff at Sante and Blue Agave (Delvin and Miguel).

reviews.author: D Oliveira
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text:
Amazing experience time and time again! Special thanks to Nicolas Maracallo, our Concierge, for handling every detail.  A big thank you to Pedro, Martin and Yuderi from the Reserve beach for there amazing service and attention.  This team makes us feel like we are home!  

We loved Sante and they have the best staff! Also Blue Agave staff was great, especially Delvin and Miguel!

I highly recommend this hotel! Beautiful beaches, amazing service and great food.  This hotel has the best employees who constantly go above and beyond!

reviews.author: Carlos N
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia Ginger Var
reviews.text: Excelente atención. Muy buenos tragos y especialmente María Peguero muy buena atención y excelentes consejos sobre las bebidas. 5 estrellas su atención. Todo en el lugar concuerda con la clase y el nivel del hotel. Y repito sin ánimos al de equivocarme que la atención de maría es espectacular!!!

reviews.author: Allen W
reviews.title: Incredible Trip At a Top Shelf Resort
reviews.text: This is a Melia all inclusive resort.  Expensive but first class. Beach, bars and food are incredible. .  Staff is attentive and friendly and our personal concierge (Nicholas) was great! Gotta go back

reviews.author: Brady D
reviews.title: My stay at the paradisus real golf resort and spa
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Palma real golf and spa resort was maxing from start to finish! Upon arriving , we were greeted with smiles and cocktails of our choosing with a fast and speedy check in and an escorted walk to our room.  Throughout our entire stay the service …restaurants …and all staff from custodians to waiters to bartenders was all second to none …but to put icing on the cake our concierge Nicolas Maracallo took the term luxury travel to new heights.  Every morning was able to give us a full itinerary for the resorts day, and get us any reservations when needed at any restaurant of our choosing .  Not to mention, upon request when we were poolside all day…came and ironed and steamed multiple dress shirts! Not only would I get concierge service again…but will be putting a request in for Nicolas! If you like relaxing ….good food , great service and amazing views , than paradisus palma real golf resort and spa is the place for you!!

reviews.author: franklin b
reviews.title: Punta cana relaxing time with bachata classes
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the place, super relaxing, friendly atmosphere.
One of the best things we got to enjoy were the dancing classes, the instructor Jorge Ben was great. He took of from zero to one hundred.. overall an great experience

reviews.author: 697josemanuelb
reviews.title: Semana de vacaciones
reviews.text: Un servicio en general extraordinario y muy en especial el trato y la eficacia en su gestión de José Simeón persona detallista y afable un gran profesional en todo momento pendiente de nuestras necesidades

reviews.author: Ray K
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf Spa
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with a lot amenities. I proposed to my girlfriend there and everyone went out of their way to make sure everything went smoothly. Special thanks to Miguelito who helped me with everything from service to planning activities. He was very friendly, responsive, and attentive.

reviews.author: Alfa
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real- first vacation in Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
Our first vacation in Dominican Republic was at Paradisus Palma Real at presidential suite adults only ocean view, the suite was very beautiful with two bedrooms, living room and a huge terrace with whirlpool tub on the terrace. 
We could have bring 4 more people with us to stay at this suite but we didn’t know that the suite would be that big. 
The resort was fully renovated so everything was very nice and clean. 
The food was delicious at any restaurant we went to, the buffet was great and so many options available. Whatever your heart desire they would cook for you on the grill right in front of you. The pasta bar was absolutely delicious with many sauce options to choose from. 
The beach was perfect, there is no lack of chairs, palapa, cabanas and bars. 
The two bar tenders at the beach on adults only side ( Yuderi Reyes and Maximo Cedano ) were amazing. They took care of us whenever we were at the beach. 
The pool side bar tender Wanda was incredibly talented, she would make you a drink with passion and craft. 
The pools were a bit cold but felt great jumping in the cold water when you are overheated on a hot sunny day. 
I hope they get the pools heated a bit as that would be perfect.
The entertainment in the evening was good, not a place for the young crowd as there is no night club there but for those that love quite relaxing vacation time this is the place to be.
Last but not the least I wanted to mention our concierge Miguelito Cuevas and how amazing he was, everything we asked for Miguelito was able to accommodate for us. 
If you want beat of the best you ask for him to be your concierge. He truly is the best!!

We enjoyed every minute of it and we are planning our next trip for next year at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Atmo F
reviews.title: Paradisus, a 5-star resort
reviews.text:
New and refurbished rooms come with great design and very comfortable. Plenty of space and lap swimming pools is a big plus. Fantastic beach for walking, running, whatever!

Most importantly, the friendly staff would not let you down! Many restaurants to choose from and it is all included.

reviews.author: Nathalie F
reviews.title: Premium quality all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: Newly renovated in Dec 2022. We stayed at the Nikte swim up suite. I would highly recommend this. It came with a gorgeous patio. Our concierge Francisco V was amazing. Elizabeth B. The room attendant was excellent.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Kim S
reviews.text: This trip was fantastic we had the best time at the resort. Days were very relaxed and calming beach and pool time was very relaxing. Mingling with the staff was always a positive experience. I wanted to point out one special staff member that made my stay extra special.Jorge Ben was the beach dance instructor that made my stay extra special he spent time with each person no Matter the skill level and was very professional and helpful.

reviews.author: Myisha R
reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text:
Gustavo Vasquez  Vivianny Reyes  Sunirda Joseph and Andino Jimenez  was awesome 👌🏽 
They accommodated all of our specific needs and was speedy with service. We will be back for my birthday breakfast 😋.

reviews.author: Quest610364
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus…
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful with several areas that offer a nice beach … beautiful pools although were cold … a little heated water would of been nice .. the restaurants were good however a little more consistency in the food offered as the same items were presented different or looked different …. Service was top notch .. Martin at the pool was great and Luis Cadet our concierge was amazing …. the whole experience overall was amazing and an issues we may have had were quickly addressed !

reviews.author: Brian C
reviews.title: Holiday in Punta Cana
reviews.text: We were taken care from day one by our concierge Harry Milor. He was fantastic and kept us updated daily with the happenings around the property and within close proximity. The accommodations were impeccable and kept that way by the resort staff.

reviews.author: Catalina M
reviews.title: Experiencia restaurante tokimeku
reviews.text:
La comida superó las expectativas, era realmentw buena. 
Además, los camareros, Alexander Santos y su compañero Brahian Espinal, eran súper atentos y amorosos… ¡Excelente servicio!
Muchas gracias por todo

reviews.author: Taylor g
reviews.title: A+ experience
reviews.text: Buffet was great. Franklin and Melina were friendly, attentive, and provided amazing service to me and my husband. They made skipping the restaurants and going to the buffet very worth it. Very happy to go back multiple times on our trip

reviews.author: Barbara A
reviews.title: Lounge bosh
reviews.text: Excelente servicio muy buen buffet de comidas sobre todo la atención de Franklin dias y Celine muy buenos anfitriones, muy atentos y cordiales… muy recomendados, todo fresco y delicioso….muy buenooooo

reviews.author: heidi j
reviews.title: Nice resort and amenities. Super friendly service. Eddy at the 90° pool bar is fantastic! Thanks to Eddy and everyone!
reviews.text: Super fun, friendly and safe! The facility and views are amazing! Food and drinks are great. A special thank you to Eddy at the 90° swim up bar. He kept us well “hydrated”. Entertainment in the plaza was a surprise and very cool. We will be back!

reviews.author: Luanne C
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. People very nice. Had one hiccup with room service but otherwise a great time!!  Good entertainment!  Japanese restaurant is the best !  Jorge Ben was a great help and good personality!!

reviews.author: Fred P
reviews.title: Great Vacation wonderful 7 days.
reviews.text:
Excellent service at all bars and restaurants. Room staff was great!
Large selections of pools.
Cocotal Golf is a bargain, beautifully maintained and challenging. 
Spa was very nice, people very friendly.

reviews.author: Holly L
reviews.title: Felix is the best
reviews.text: Felix was an amazing butler! The property was gorgeous. The staff was very friendly and very accommodating. The spa was really great. Easy to make appointments and flexible with your schedule. I loved all of the pools!

reviews.author: SoyMarioFernandez
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2023
reviews.text:
Visitamos el Paradisus Palma Real, por segunda vez. Las comodidades del hotel y la comida es excelente. Los restaurantes que más nos gustaron fueron el Japonés y el Mexicano. 
Los shows nocturnos son espectaculares. 
El Spa y los masajes 100% recomendables. 
Existen diferentes talleres, fuimos al de sushi no sólo participamos en el armado sino que también  hicimos la degustacion. 
Los chicos de animación Jairo y Jorge siempre nos acompañaron en el aprendizaje de las clases de bachata, salsa y merengue una paciencia increíble 😆
Starling Tavares nos acompaño en todo momento para disfrutar y hacer nuestra estadía más placentera, un genio. 
Seguimos apostando a los hoteles de Paradisus te hacen un mimo al alma.

reviews.author: mariana S
reviews.title: Excelente todo muy buena predisposición de los empleados, nuestro concierge Sairen
reviews.text:
Excelente todo muy buena predisposición de los empleados, nuestro concierge Sairen una persona muy amable y siempre dispuesto a solucionar cualquier inquietud, servicio o inconveniente.
Recomendaría plenamente a  Paradisus Palma Real

reviews.author: Néstor M
reviews.title: AGRADECIMIENTO
reviews.text: Para una concierge muy especial, Zenovia Nova, quiero agradecerle la asistencia profesional brindada en lo personal y a toda mi familia. Asimismo manifestar mi agradecimiento a Fanni Tejada en el desayuno y en el restaurante Toki meku, a los Sres Joel Valdes y Jonatan Rodriguez del Bar 32 grados. Un especial agradecimiento a Yuleisy del Restaurante Brisas y al amigo Raúl jimenes de Playa. A todo les estoy muy agradecido por la impecable atención y la cordialidad de siempre.

reviews.author: greta m
reviews.title: Exelente experiencia y atención
reviews.text:
Pasamos unas vacaciones bellísimas.
Hermoso hotel...impecable la atención y predisposición de todo el personal, destacando a Zenovia Nova, todos los años nos recibe con el mismo cariño y afecto que construimos durante nuestras visitas al hotel. Al igual que los chicos de 32 grados; Jonatan Rodríguez, Joel Valdez y Marileisy. En el desayuno del buffet y en Toki Meku; Fanni Tejada. En el restaurante exclusivo para socios, Brisas; Yuleisy. Y en la playa también; Raúl Jiménez. Muchas gracias a todos ellos que nos han hecho sentir como en casa cada uno de los días de nuestra estadía.

reviews.author: Serena M
reviews.title: Gracias por todo
reviews.text: Hermoso hotel y muy buena comida, pero lo que nos llevamos como familia de estas vacaciones es la excelente atención y el cariño de Zenovia Nova, nuestra consierge, de Fanni tejada en el desayuno y Toki Meku, Joel Valdés, Jonatan Rodriguez y Marileisy del bar 32 grados, Yuleisy de" Brisas" y Raúl Jiménez de playa. Gracias a todos por atendernos tan bien. 💗

reviews.author: Manuel M
reviews.title: Best host, Mackenson Cesar.
reviews.text: Our stay was exceptional. We were there for a business trip with a big group including spouses. I had the pleasure of having the best host in the resort, Mackenson Cesar. Since the time we stepped out of the airport van to the minute we left, he took care of us everyday, helping us with anything we needed. Great host, very professional and cordial. Highly recommended. The resort was also great. The food was amazing and the location perfect. We will be back and hope to see Mack again.

reviews.author: Javier C
reviews.title: Tokimeku paraiso palma real
reviews.text: En el restaurante tokimeku (japones) alexander santos con el chef kelvin nos brindaron una excelente atención , la comida deliciosa fue todo muy entrenido realizo por el chef , fue una magia de sabor.

reviews.author: Barbara a
reviews.title: Experiencia paradisius palma real
reviews.text: Excelente atencion y servicio, sobre todo en el restaurante tokimeku y la atencion de Alexander y el chef Kelvin ! Todo exquisito y prolijo ! Una experiencia que vale la pena totalmente … totalmente recomendado

reviews.author: Francisca Costa
reviews.title: Experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Alexander nos atendió excelete, el mejor Garzón que me ha atendido en todo Punta Cana! Atento en tokimeku! Muy simpático y amoroso! Muy buena atención durante toda la cena!!!! Me encanto todooooooooooo

reviews.author: maria alejandra t
reviews.title: La calidez y la excelente atención recibida.
reviews.text:
El hotel remodelado...una maravilla.  La comida es excelente y los servicios impecables.
La calidez y el trato del personal de destacar.
Nuestra concierge Zenovia Nova...tan dedicada y amorosa como siempre.
Fanni Tejada en desayuno y Toki Meku.
Joel Valdés, Jonatan Rodríguez, Marileisy y Dominga...del bar 32 grados.
Yuleisy de Brisas  y Raúl Jiménez de Playa.
Agradecimiento a todos ellos por todo el cariño y la dedicación que nos brindaron.

reviews.author: Veronica S
reviews.title: Best Staff
reviews.text: Not only was this beautiful but the staff was absolutely amazing. Specifically Eddy Luis and Arilesda from the 90 Degree Bar. They were super friendly, accommodating and the drinks were great!! We will certainly go back.

reviews.author: Joe B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: The resort is spectacular.  Recently renovated and you could tell.  The rooms were nice, grounds are beautiful and the pools are huge.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.   Arisleida and Eddy at the smaller pool bar were great,  It was much less crowded. The only drawback is the food.  The Italian restaurant was just bad.  The buffets were definitely better than the restaurants.  Making reservations for the Hibachi are a pain but worth, need to be at the front desk at 10 am sharp and could on,y make a reservation for that night.  They have a sit down section also with sushi and other Asian dishes.  Just over order because the portions are small.  The YHI Spa is really nice but really expensive, thankfully it was included in our trip.  But overall great vacation.

reviews.author: Gabriel Alvarez
reviews.title: Agradecimientos
reviews.text: Agradezco la atención recibida por el Mayordomo Kelvin Fernández, quien hizo que mis vacaciones fueran llenas de confort y de tranquilidad en mi estadía en el Hotel, siempre atento a mis necesidades de reserva de transporte, spa y restaurantes. Muchas Gracias Kelvin, por tu amabilidad y la ayuda prestada para gozar de mis vacaciones un 100%. Muchos éxitos que tengas muchos mas huéspedes felices.

reviews.author: ErimafrancoGomez
reviews.title: Felicitaciones
reviews.text: Gracias por la maravillosa atención y cordialidad recibida por parte de Gilberto Mejia barman del bar 96 grados de la playa solo adultos... Eres el mejor gracias por tu amabilidad esperamos volver para compartir de nuevo contigo y tus compañeros. Mil gracias.

reviews.author: Laurie K
reviews.title: Sante at Paradisus Palma
reviews.text:
Omg  what an experience!!  So glad we upgraded to Reserve! 
Fantastic food & service always by Wander, Jose  manuel del Rosario y Amanda Henrique  laicha Reyes & Felix!!
Highly recommend 

You can  also enjoy them at the Other restaurants  Jose at Hasienda!  & Wander always FANTASTIC at the buffet too.  Wether you’re with your partner or alone he’ll make U feel at home ☺️

reviews.author: Rossana M
reviews.title: Restaurant  Lunch BoxHotel Melia Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:

Menú muy variado y exquisitos platos.
Ambiente agradable , con mesas siempre disponibles y al lado de la playa.
Lo recomiendo ya sea para almuerzo o cena.

reviews.author: Scenic3232
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real IS Paradise!
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from our week escape to the Paradisus Real...This  was our 3rd vacation here in the past 9 years.  Each experience has been incredible yet this year was truly a magical and memorable in so many ways.  From the amazing and gorgeous new renovations and upgrades, the wonderful variety of new restaurants/delicious cuisine, to the beautiful pristine pools.  The fun entertainment and certainly most of all, the fantastically kind and most accommodating staff we have encountered in all of our travels throughout the many past years.  Our extra special concierge, Kenneth Nivar was beyond outstanding.  He was friendly and so wonderfully kind to us.  We always knew Kenneth was there for us for our every need, yet gave us space to enjoy our time/vacation without pressure.  His lighthearted fun spirit was an added joy!  We call him our new family member!!  Kenneth made ALL the difference for us.  Also, I must give huge accolades to our beautiful Wanda who daily took care of us at the adult only bar.  She was amazing the BEST of the BEST mixologists and has the most incredible attitude and heart!  Liola (sp) was also such a bright spot during our visit to that bar area.  All in all, although we will travel to other destinations in the world, the Paradisus Real is our favorite home away from home.  We'll be back in 2023!!!

reviews.author: MrsAnn P
reviews.title: LOVED everything about this resort!
reviews.text: LOVED everything about this resort! It is beautiful.  Vacationed last year at the Paradisus in Los Cabos and loved it but this Punta Cana Bavaro Beach location is amazing.  The pools are enormous! We stayed in building 9 in a Master Suite Deluxe that was 818 sq.Ft.! It had a large balcony with a pool and partial ocean view.  The beach is beautiful with the largest # of lounge chairs available for guests that we've ever seen at a resort.  The service from all the staff was top notch but we were so lucky to have met Cristian Gonzalez.  This young man was our personal concierge and he did everything for us! Anything we needed, any questions we had, reservations we wanted, he took care of it all.  He offered to communicate via text with us and that was very convenient.  Every morning we would receive  our "Good morning " text from him with an attached itinerary for that day.  Cristian works very hard to ensure your experience is the best it can be and he delivers that!  Everytime we ran into him on the property we were greeted with his great smile!  On our departure day, he tracked us down to say goodbye.  Cristian, you really made this vacation extra special for us.  You are truly a very hard working special young man.  Thank you so much Cristian!  We LOVED  the dolphin excursion that we booked right at the pool one day with Micheal and it was only a 10 minute shuttle away.  Our favorite restaurant was the Hibachi with our chef Roberto and the check out process was easy peasy with the lovely Ivelicce Sanchez.

reviews.author: krad4d
reviews.title: Paradisus - Punta Cana
reviews.text:
I found the resort to be full of wonderful, thoughtful and accommodating people. Our area had been recently renovated and there was still some finishing touches going on in other areas that were not intrusive to our experience in any way.

I would like to offer a special "Shout Out" to these amazing people: Daysi G. in Reception, Lewis D. in Customer Relations, Andrea S. at the Blue Agave, Yanira S. at the Lunch Box and last but not least, Gerinaldo U. our favorite bartender at the Celsius swim up bar!

reviews.author: apollomolina
reviews.title: Another awesome stay at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Just returned from celebrating my birthday for the week at Paradisus Palmer Real for the second year in a row.  I liked all the upgrades they’ve made it to the resort.  There are many new pools around the property now which means the main pool is no longer crowded.  The food and drinks are better now as well. We stayed in the adult only section which used to have one small pool but now has three large pools.

The staff at the resort is amazing.  Our concierge, Ralphy, did an amazing job for the second year in a row.  Among other things, he helped us get our room upgrade, had special request, beverages stocked in our fridge, decorated our room for my birthday with balloons, Champaign, and chocolates, and set up a special meal for us within one of the restaurants with items that are not on the menu.  Pedro at the beach was also amazing for the second year in a row.  He is always all smiles.  He had our beach beds set up and waiting for us. Each day, kept us hydrated with cocktails, and Harris, laughing with his funny stories all afternoon.  Roxanna (or Rosanna?) at the buffet also took great care of us each morning for breakfast.
It is the amazing staff at the resort. That’ll keep us coming back again and again. See you all within a year.

reviews.author: María Elena G
reviews.title: Gracias
reviews.text: Excelente servicio todo el personal fue amable los restaurantes ofrecen una comida deliciosa sobre todo el de las brisas, italiano y mexicano   Atención de 10 por parte de Lewis nuestro consergie, la atención de algunos meseros como Suleika, Santos

reviews.author: Violeta Allione
reviews.title: Vacaciones de verano
reviews.text: Melia como siempre ofrece los mejores servicios:  Gastronómico , atención personalizada( Héctor Rodríguez ) nuestro Conserge “ siempre a la orden “ como se dice en Dominicana.  La playa increíble!!! El mar soñado! Un legar para relajarse y disfrutar!

reviews.author: Jose E
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our stay in Paradisus Palma Real was amazing. It has been our second time in the resort and we definitely are coming back. Everything about the place is amazing. Rooms are fully renovated and looks beautiful and clean. Pool was super clean. Food was great as well as drinks options. One of the highlights of the place is the people. Everyone is so welcoming and make you feel special. Our concierge Kenneth Nivar  went above and beyond. He was extremely helpful in every aspect and he made our experience even better. We highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real for everyone that wants to a dreams vacation.

reviews.author: Milagros H
reviews.title: Tokimeku
reviews.text:
Destaco el restaurante Tokimeku: excelente el menú, muy variado, y la atención en general (Franklin un genio).
Quiero agradecerle especialmente a Alba por su cálido recibimiento; súper amable y predispuesta a resolver cualquier inconveniente.

reviews.author: Elizabeth T
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with the BEST staff
reviews.text: This resort was beautiful and the people working there were incredible. Jorge the activities guy at the pool was so much fun and so upbeat and our concierge Lewis was so attentive and was always around to help with reservations, spa, etc. He was amazing. The guys working the main pool bar were the nicest. Everything was perfect

reviews.author: Sue D
reviews.title: Experience at Paradiso Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Own a time share for over 15 years, stop visiting because every time returning with stomach pain so this time we took med.  by Dr’s order and it worked. We met concierge Louise Del-a Cruz, who was giving us a tour of newly renovated Paradisus Palma Real.  Place was up-to-date. Everyone was very friendly and cleaned. Our concierge was friendly, and was always there for our niece. That was the best concierge we ever met for the first time. Paradiso Palma Real Punta is the best paradise I ever can ask for and has everything the beautiful beach, the place the food and also golf. We enjoy the most.

reviews.author: Rob W
reviews.title: 5 STAR SERVICE
reviews.text:
If you want to stay In a beautifully updated resort where the people working make you feel like you’ve known them for years and not just your first visit this is the place to go. 
We upgraded our rooms to the reserve section, Adults only with their own pool areas and  beach areas,  we stayed in the Junior suite Garden view, Which from our porch/deck area there was plenty of ocean view.
 
The upgrades to the resort look almost complete so it was like staying in a new resort.  
With The reserve you get a concierge. Ours was Raul
He did a five star job. 
Raul would contact me every morning to see if there was anything I needed that day. At which time I would give him my evenings request for dinner reservations, only 1 out of 7 I had to go a 1/2 hour earlier than requested. 
While visiting the Mexican restaurant I was introduced to Delvin our server for the night. 
We didn’t even need to look at the menus he told us he would just keep bringing different things and that ended up being the best suggestion of the night. Food was excellent and finally had to tell him to stop. 

Delvin was also instrumental a second night, what could’ve been a disaster at the Italian restaurant turned into a very enjoyable evening eating Italian in his Mexican restaurant. His managers weren’t happy but his customers were and I believe that is what is the most important. 
All the restaurants there were very good especially the steakhouse and the Winery. If we went back those will be the first two stops we would make. 

Finally just want to say thanks to Wanda at the poolside/ beach bar. And all the wait staff that work the beach and pool areas, great drinks and service the entire week
 
This was our 4th Meliá  all inclusive resort and look forward to our next!!

reviews.author: Alexander M
reviews.title: Vacaciones  2023 familia mora Solis
reviews.text: Maravilloso lugar, muy recomendable, la atención de todos los colaboradores muy amables, la comida en el servicio de buffette la atención en la playa, muy buenas habitaciones muy seguro, las actividades nocturnas de muy buena calidad

reviews.author: Daniela R
reviews.title: Vacations at paradissus palma real Punta Cana
reviews.text: The days at paradissus palma real were perfect, our host Starlin Tavares was the best person, excellent very kind, the waiters Rosanny paniagua and boris santos were very friendly and excellent people, and the pothographer rafael of novia mia, very friendly, very professional, very funny and excellent work. Highly recommended. The hotel is excellent and very beautiful.

reviews.author: Carlos Daniel V
reviews.title: Vacaciones en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Pasamos una semana increíble! Disfrutamos mucho todo el hotel y la atención fue excelente desde nuestro anfitrión Starlin T. que estuvo al pendiente de todas nuestras solicitudes y festejos, también fuimos atendidos muy amablemente por Rosani Paniagua y Boris Santos durante nuestros estupendos almuerzos, las cenas dentro del hotel son excelentes en los diferentes restaurantes, en general absolutamente todo estuvo excelente! 100% recomendado

reviews.author: Mafer B
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de punta cana
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio desde que pisamos el hotel.Starling Tavares muy amable y dispuesto en cada momento y el personal en gral demasiado atentos 
Agradecimiento especial a Rosany y Santos que nos atendieron de la mejor forma en el restaurante.
La atención personalizada en todo momento 
El hotel ,la comida ,el personal y las actividades sin duda una experiencia inolvidable.

reviews.author: Diego J
reviews.title: Great Expirience !!
reviews.text: Beautiful experience with the family, great places and events all the time, exquisite food and impeccable service. From the entrance to the airport, reception, stay, everything in order. again we will plan to return due to the quality of service, very grateful

reviews.author: Johanna Castro
reviews.title: Bar: 32 grados
reviews.text:
Primero que nada, fueron unas vacaciones
Maravillosas !!!
Pasamos días completos en la piscina del 
Bar: 32 Grados, los empleados todos muy respetuosos y muy gentiles. Sin duda los mejores del lugar. Joel Valdez , Lisbeth Brito , Marileisy Joseph y Dominga Vasquez los extrañaremos.
Gracias por el servicio impecable que tuvieron conmigo y mi familia !!
Nos volveremos a ver eso es seguro 😁

reviews.author: Trina S
reviews.title: EPIC family vacation!
reviews.text: We decided to do a trip to the Palma Real in Punta Cana with the family over New Years and had an incredible time.  From the service to the food to the room, all was magnificent.  Our concierge Francisco Vilorio was top notch and there to assist on every need.  We met so many staff members that were extremely friendly and always looking to make sure we were having the best experience possible.  Fausto and Manuela were two of our favorites.  This truly was an epic vacation and I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing and fun tropical getaway!

reviews.author: Getaway49892127680
reviews.title: Una experiencia formidable
reviews.text:
Ha sido una experiencia muy agradable, el hotel tiene unas habitaciones espectaculares es tranquilo y cuenta con suficientes zonas para variar cada día.

La comida tanto en el buffet como en los restaurantes es realmente buena y variada.

Especialmente destacará Mina por la gran calidad de las carnes servidas.

Todo el staff desde que llegas hasta que te vas es super amable especial atención para Alex y su asistente en la parte comercial que nos atendieron de forma espectacular. Asi como a mi concierge asignado Miguel que me hizo sentir como en casa.

Muchas gracias a todos nos vemos pro to de nuevo.

reviews.author: Mariana S
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text: Ginger un bar espectacular, muy completo y una atención hermosa, especialmente por estas mujeres: Yiri, Lucía y Walkiria, que nos trataron súper bien. Música agradable, muy buen café, mucha variedad de tragos y comida muy rica y deliciosa

reviews.author: Tina H
reviews.title: I had a very good experience.
reviews.text:
A vacation with the company… it was a relaxing vacation where I enjoyed, spend time with friends and had some fun. I’ve meet Lewis, he was great !!

Good staff, good restaurants and everybody was friendly. 

I recommend the hotel!!

The only thing was.. we paid for an upgraded room for $2800 and didn’t feel as though we got any amenities more than the group we were with, unhappy with paying the extra money but Lewis made it special.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort.  Great staff, restaurants had an amazing varieties to choose from. We enjoyed the perks that come with being a member. Expedited check in service , to personal concierge services. Our concierge Manuel above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed.  He definitely made our trip that much more special .

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: The BEST vacation experience
reviews.text: This resort is an amazing experience!  This was our 2nd trip to Palma Real and we are planning another later this year!  The resort is beautiful but it is the staff that made our vacation amazing.  Cris, our concierge, was phenomenal.  He made reservations, sent event calendars and checked with us throughout our stay. He even remembered our 10th anniversary date and had a cake sent to our table.  Maxsimo, our bartender, made several drink suggestions and came to our poolside patio to keep them coming!  11 out of 10 experience.  We hope to see them next time!

reviews.author: Jordan C
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great service!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort with fantastic service, we had a wonderful stay! 

Our concierge Francisco was wonderful, he was always available to help with any requests we had. He made sure our time at the resort was fabulous!

The only negative has to do with the sales department who did try to move us to a different resort when we arrived as they did to many others. We booked through a travel agent who called to reconfirm we were on property at the Palma Real but when we arrived they informed us we were in the Gardens resort. Fortunately the front desk manager worked with us and after several hours was able to accommodate us at the Palma Real.

reviews.author: Héctor Reynoso
reviews.title: El mejor all inclusive del Caribe
reviews.text:
Soy socio del programa Circle de Melia.
Vamos todos los años.
Meliá es marca garantizada.
Meliá Palma Real es un All inclusive de primerísimo nivel.
Fué renovado profundamente, siguiendo el concepto Circle.
Todo perfecto.
Nuestro agradecimiento a los concerges Manuel, Raúl, en todos los detalles, y en especial al Sr.Lewis, que solucionó un inconveniente de alojamiento de una pareja amiga, y en lo personal, me ha asistido de manera superprofesional.
Felicitaciones al restaurant de carnes Mina, exquisito, y al personal que nos asistió.
Excelentes los buffet Malva y the box, con comidas de primerísimo nivel.
Volveremos el próximo año, como lo hacemos desde el año 2.000

reviews.author: Luis Emilio O
reviews.title: Como en casa
reviews.text: Hace 23 años que pasamos nuestra vacaciones de verano en  Melia punta Cana, para nuestra familia es  como estar en casa. El  Palma Real tiene todas las comodidades que se necedutan ,  hermosas habitaciones, una playa excepcional, y todo el personal , como ellos dicen : siempre a la orden. En brisa  Borys S y Rosany,; en el bufet Rosana y Yuderky ; y nuestro concierge  ( Hector Rodriguez ) siempre atento  a nuestros requerimientos . La comida  espectacular! En fin! Un lugar  soñado!

reviews.author: Kayleigh C
reviews.title: Lovely trip!
reviews.text:
Fabulous resort and fabulous service! Felix was our favorite concierge- always kind, smiling, and happy to lend a hand. Would go back!
The pools and drinks were perfectly chilly for the warm weather and the service was exceptional.

reviews.author: Dana V
reviews.title: exceptional and unforgettable stay at Paradisus Real
reviews.text: Beautiful place,  high quality restaurants and buffet, perfect service, nice staff with a very special thanks to Harry and Francisco who were exceptional throughout our stay, outstanding service performance. Can’t wait to come back in this unique resort!

reviews.author: lucianabrendamatias
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Viajamos mi pareja y yo para disfrutar un tiempo juntos, en este hotel fue todo increíble, la comida, los empleados, fueron respetuosos, el lugar era como de ensueño. Me gustó que los empleados no pedían propina por todo, aun así nos trataban super bien eran amigables. Pudimos disfrutar de un hotel prácticamente vacío (llegamos un miércoles) y hasta el viernes todo iba bien. Pero llego el fin de semana, con ello mas personas, y eso se notaba mas en los restaurantes y listas de espera, pero a parte de eso, todo perfecto.

reviews.author: Ramon G
reviews.title: Vacaciones excelentes
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, sobretodo la atención del personal, mención especial para Jhudelkis Jacobs mena.
Hemos venido a este hotel muchas veces y seguiremos volviendo, súper recomendable, la pasamos súper, saludos

reviews.author: Christina N
reviews.title: Excellent service!
reviews.text: Excellent service! Jose Miguel was amazing!!! Super friendly people and very sweet! They offered us a few great drinks we wouldn’t have known about. We really enjoyed our stay at their bar and would recommend coming again for sure!

reviews.author: ivntvm
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: Jose Ventura at the Shaker is absolutely magnificent! We had the best night with Jose. We had the best craft margaritas and conversations with the guests and the bartenders. We enjoy dinner had the best service right after!

reviews.author: Diane B
reviews.title: Amazing Memories Made!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is a wonderful location to gather with friends or family for fun and relaxation. The newly renovated resort has been updated beautifully and is sparkling clean.  While not completely done, any areas that were still being worked on you couldn’t see or hear any of the work being done.  All of the restaurants were well staffed, and the food was always fresh & flavorful with a wide array of choices. We never had a problem getting seated or with service anywhere we went.  The head chef for the resort is frequently seen checking in around the resort.  

Our suite was beautiful, spacious and comfortable.  The mini-bar and snacks were always well stocked.  We requested extra towels which was no problem.  The bath and shower amenities were very nice.  Our wonderful concierge, Felix, was so attentive and happy to assist with anything we needed, always ready to answer questions promptly no matter the time! 

The main asset to the resort, which made our experience so memorable, was outstanding staff we encountered.  As mentioned above Felix went above & beyond.  Another concierge that was so helpful and always smiling was Harry.  Our favorite place to visit, relax, people watch or just look out at the gorgeous view was the lobby bar Ginger.  From morning to night everyone is ready with a smile! Antonio, Ismael Criceida, Lucia, and several more special people!  The best espresso, cortado and pastries in the morning to finishing off the night with an old fashion & espresso martini.  

We look forward to our next visit!

reviews.author: sgm918
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel
reviews.text:
El hotel fue remodelado por completo. Esta muy bueno.  La atencion es excelente. Todo el personal es muy amable y dedicado a su trabajo. Una especial mención a Edgar Rodrigues que estuvo atento todo el tiempo a nuestros pedidos 
 Es más de 10 años que vamos sin duda fue el mejor conciege que tuvimos. Gracias Edgar

reviews.author: Justin S
reviews.title: A true all inclusive experience
reviews.text: A truly all inclusive experience with everything you could want only a few steps away. Beautiful property, expansive pools, and the softest sandy beach. Our personal concierge, Luis, was incredibly attentive and truly felt like a friend

reviews.author: Katya T
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We had such an amazing time here! Special shout out to Siomara Herrera and Leonela Duran from the lobby, they took such good care of us! So sweet and make the best drinks ❤️ We will always come back here!

reviews.author: Robertobaez1
reviews.title: Restaurante mascalzone de Palma Real, atención excelente.
reviews.text: En nuestra estancia hemos visitado el hotel Palma Real y hemos cenado 2 veces en el restaurante máscalzonne, es el mejor restaurante de comida italiana que he probado, además la atención es de primera, muy personalizada, destaco la excelente atención de don Santos Avila, quien se preocupa personalmente que cada mesa esté satisfecha y feliz. Además se siente un calor de hogar en el restaurant, lo que lo hace más italiano aún.

reviews.author: Valerie P
reviews.title: Beautiful place with amazing staff
reviews.text: This was a mixed purpose conference and pleasure trip. My husband and I had a great time. The buildings and grounds  are beautiful, well maintained, the food has a lot of variety and is very tasty. The service is amazing:  Olvi Almonte, at our favourite place (The Lunch Box ) was always very genuinely helpful and friendly. We definitely recommend this place and hope to come again!

reviews.author: Todd N
reviews.title: Great Time at Paradisus!
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip to this resort with many good memories made.  From the meals staff, to the hotel staff the service was excellent.  Our butler Felix went out of his way any way he could to make our trip easy, and kept in constant contact every day of our stay. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Niki L
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful property. The staff was very polite from beginning to end.
reviews.text: The entire staff especially Miguelito Cuevas was amazing and helpful! Miguelito was always asking if we needed anything. He had attention  to detail. The room was always clean and he even left some extra special snacks and water.

reviews.author: cindyjgreenfield
reviews.title: Another great vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We have been going to the Paradisus Palma Real for many years and it has turned into our home away from home.  The recent renovations are absolutely beautiful.  I first experienced this resort in the early 2000’s on a corporate sales award trip and we have been coming back ever since.  What brings us back year after year is not only the beauty of this resort, the value for your money and the beaches but because of the staff.  We stay in the adult section and request the same butler/concierge each time…Ariel Benzo who attends to our every need and has become a wonderful friend over the years.  He makes our visits very special. Thanks once again to Ariel as well as Pedro and Martine who prepare our lounges on the beach as well as Wanda at the pool bar — all who do a terrific job and make us feel like family.  Looking forward to returning soon!

reviews.author: Brenda n
reviews.title: Recommendation compliment
reviews.text:
Manuel Alimonte Paradisus was the best. Followed up diligently. Was very helpful and committed to helping to make our family time at the resort special. 
He really went. Above and beyond. 
Much appreciated his help.

reviews.author: Sylvain T
reviews.title: Une note parfaite pour notre concierge
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé deux magnifiques semaine nous avons été choyé d'avoir un concierge incroyable toujours disponible un gros merci Fernando.
Car je dois dire que notre arriver n'as pas été des plus facile ...un peu de difficulté a avoir la chambre pour laquelle on n'avais réservé.

reviews.author: ashley f
reviews.title: Love this resort!
reviews.text: This has the most beautiful view upon arrival and the property overall is gorgeous. The staff is all extremely kind. If you are able to have a butler, Nicolas (Cage) Maracallo is fantastic and ensure you have anything you need.  I highly recommend this resort over the many others I have been to across the world.

reviews.author: Ksenia L
reviews.title: Ksenia
reviews.text: Estamos casi un mes en vacaciones,hotel está mucho más interesante después de la obra nueva.Como siempre,nos gustaría decir muchas gracias a todas las personas quienes han estado trabajando para nosotros,la gente muy amable,bondadosa,abierta para ayudarte en cualquier momento.Además,mil palabras agradecidas a Sr.Máximo Cedano,nuestra concerje Sra.Anayely,las Señoritas de la limpieza,los cocineros por muy rica comida variable y todas las personas del hotel,hemos pasado muy buenas vacaciones y esperamos volverse pronto.El Paradisus Palma Real es seguro un Paradisus para todos los gustos

reviews.author: Jenn F
reviews.title: Beautiful paradise
reviews.text: We stayed in the recently renovated Palma. Everything was absolutely beautiful. Martine on the beach and Luis at the lunchbox took care of our party all week, and they were wonderful! Junior at the front desk was a huge help as well. The staff was friendly and attentive. The food at the buffet however, was pretty lack luster. What should have been local dishes were very bland and nothing was kept hot/ cold. Everything was room temperature. Overall, would definitely return. We had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Miguel Goncalves Pereira
reviews.title: Amazing time. Thank you Hector!
reviews.text: We would like to share our experience while staying at Palma real - Paradisus hotel to help other potencial guests while deciding if they should stay here. My wife, my daughter and I were at Domenican republic for more than 1 month on vacation, we stayed in 3 diferent hotels, always changing due to the bad service offered by the previous hotels in the area. When we arrived at Palma Real, we were welcomed by Mr.Hector, wich was our personal assistant on the resort. From there on, this person have attended all of our requests, always with a smile on his face and with a substantial profissional approach. We had special needs as we were traveling with our 1yo baby, regarding food restrictions(no salt, no sugar, etc…) and he made sure every time it was time to have the request ready, everything was exactly as we asked and at right timing. Thank you for being so good on your service Hector. We and our baby appreciate it very much. He also helped with all kinds of activities on a very responsive and quick way, something that is very hard to find around domenican republic. We even  suggested him to give formation to the remaining staff once he is on his own championship and should be recognize for the amazing work, although we didn’t have a chance to tell it to his boss. We felt so good at the resort, mainly because of his work that decided to extend our stay for almost another week…we really hope that his work and dedication will be recognize to help the resort to put their quality standards at the highest level. I risk to say that we felt the same approach from him than we usual have on four seasons for example…the resort is nice and pleasant but their food can get better, specially regarding the healthy food.  The remaining staff were friendly to us but off course you always have one or another that are more “cold” however…we really enjoyed our time and will be coming back but only if it’s possible to have Mr.Hector again as our personal assistant! The babysitting service was also good with kind and efficient lady’s. See you next year…best regards.

reviews.author: Maria A
reviews.title: Manuel was fab
reviews.text: I met Manuel on the first day, and he was perfect. I had a few issues with my room and he helped me get into a new room right away, even helping me move my stuff into the new room. He also checked in on me and helped me make dinner reservations, and would send me the daily agenda each am. The resort staff are amazing at this resort (though English was not widely spoken); keep up the great hiring, Melia.

reviews.author: Dean S
reviews.title: Outstanding Resort!
reviews.text: Staff is excellent, especially Wanda, Ralphy, Angel, Gilberto (and the others at the pool bar) as well as the ladies at the Between bar. All food was excellent (especially Malva for lunch and the Mexican restaurant for dinner). Italian restaurant was a bit of a disappointment though. Definitely returning in 2024!

reviews.author: Marc-andré B
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great service! Marianna our janitor was really kind. Recommand this hôtel for everyone. The beach was Great. The alcohol was on point. The drink were strong and tasty. The wifi was a little bit hard to get on the resort

reviews.author: DAVID C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real

Special word to our Concierge Osvaldo Veloz always with attention and efficiency, made our stay easier.

reviews.author: Niouffeg
reviews.title: Superbe séjour!
reviews.text:
Superbe séjour, hôtel très agréable, bien entretenu et un personnel très accueillant (particulièrement Anyelina Guerrero) 
Nous avons passé 10 jours de rêve en famille! Seul petit bémol: la qualité/diversité de la nourriture un peu décevante mais le reste l’emporte! Nous étions ravis :)

reviews.author: JlO2023
reviews.title: A wonderful family vacation!
reviews.text: We just returned from a wonderful trip to Punta Cana at the Paradisus Palma Real golf and spa resort!  We highly recommend  traveling to Punta Cana and the Paradisus Palma Real.  The property is still finishing up renovations so the full property is not opened yet and they are completing it which caused some concerns in the beginning as you would expect but they were attentive and fixed any of our concerns immediately and the renovations should be completed soon.  It did not distract from the resort and the amazing staff doing their best to e make sure we had a wonderful experience.  All staff were wonderful as mentioned and helped make our trip memorable.  Hector Julio Rodriguez was our concierge and was with us from the first day ensuring we knew everything about the resort and assisted us with all of our excursions, activity and daily information and needs making our trip so comfortable! He was amazing and such a valued employee! Juan Peña (guest services mgr) and Fransisco and Daiyze from Guest services helped us from day one and to assist us in any issues and concerns during our stay as well.  The entire wait and drink staff were excellent and to name a few memorable individuals that helped us throughout our stay: (Server) Frank Feliz - such great energy and character, pool attendant Jose Reinoso and Antonio - the early morning  barista at the Ginger Bar. All willing to go above and beyond which is priceless in the service industry. The spa staff were all so pleasant and wonderful as well! We are looking forward to our next trip back!

reviews.author: Connector48354115019
reviews.title: Felicitaciones y agradecimiento The shaker en Melia Caribe
reviews.text:
Los bartender del bar Shaker, Estailyn Santos y José Miguel Ventura han sido muy buenos anfitriones, con amplio conocimiento de carta internacional, respetuosos, amables y simpáticos con todos los pasajeros. Hicieron muy grata nuestra estadía.
Gracias.

reviews.author: John T
reviews.title: Very pleased with the new renovation!
reviews.text:
We have been Melia vacation club members for approximately 15 years. We have gotten to know some staff such as Luis at the pool bar and Jose Ramos at various restaurants. These staff members provided great service again and remembered us as always and made our stay seamless. Lewis our concierge was extremely helpful as well.  
The renovation of the rooms brought the resort back up to the old days when it was first built.  The layouts and furniture in the rooms is actually nicer than the original rooms. The restaurant renovations were fantastic and an improvement.
We liked it so much we upgraded our current membership to the black level. Francisco helped us with this and showed us it was easy to do at a very low cost and detailed the many benefits of doing so.
The resort is truly 5 star and worth every penny!
Great job to all!

reviews.author: steplewis3
reviews.title: The BEST Vaca!
reviews.text: This is our second time to Paradisus Palma Real in 2 years and we will keep going back! We absolutely love everything about it- the food, the activities, the location, the hotel, and the PEOPLE! Our favorite is Starlin Tavarez who always makes our trip the best it can be! He is honestly one of the reasons we keep visiting.  We also enjoyed meeting Lewis who was wonderful! We are truly treated like family here!

reviews.author: fabian r
reviews.title: Muy buenas vacaciones
reviews.text: Será un gran hotel cuando todo funcione correctamente. Se nota que hicieron la re apertura en forma anticipada. No obstante ello, debo reconocer que el personal se esmera para solucionar los inconvenientes que se presentan. Debo resaltar particularmente el desempeño de Juan Pena  y su Director Alberto V.  Además de Santiago  que recorre el hotel a toda hora para mejorar los servicios.

reviews.author: Craig R
reviews.title: Amazing trip- despite dinner dining fiasco
reviews.text:
The best feature of this resort is the staff. Every staff member you encounter will greet you with a smile and ask you if you need anything. Even with that being said, some members who stuck out were our concierge Irvin Nolasco, who was extremely responsive. If you text Irvin with a request, he will respond immediately with a result; Felix at Flora was great; Melvin was terrific at both Blue Agave and Malve; the entire staff at Kicks- this is a very fun sports bar they opened on the property. One night they had a rock cover band which was awesome.  The bartender and all the servers work very hard to get the drinks out and keep the fun going; Lastly, our favorite staff member was Hansel at the reserve beach. Hansel remembered our names and preferred seat location after the first time we met, was always around when we wanted a drink and wasn't around when we wanted solitude, always had a smile on his face and was always willing to assist. 
The worst feature of this resort is the dinner dining situation.  The three most popular restaurants- the steakhouse, Italian and Sushi/Tepanyaki are impossible to get into. They don't accept reservations and if you are told it will only take a few minutes be prepared to wait an hour. To clarify, Tepanyaki is the only restaurant to take reservations and we still waited an hour. 
In summary if eating on time and as scheduled is very important to you, this might not be the right resort for you. 
However, if being on a beautiful property with a beautiful beach, beautifully renovated rooms and an attentive staff are important to you, you will have an incredible stay at this resort.

reviews.author: Ron K
reviews.title: Palma Real worth the trip
reviews.text: Our family has been to Palma Real 6 times and this was one of the best.  We were 10 this time, including 2 grandchildren. The renovations were excellent as the club looks great. Our concierge,  Starlin was outstanding in every way. Definitely will be returning and requesting Starlin as our concierge

reviews.author: Dewey T
reviews.title: An amazing resort  with staff that go beyond expectations to deliver an experience you won’t forget and will want to run
reviews.text:
The visit starts with our butler - Edgar Martinez and his boss - Gabe. Whenever we had a question or a need arose during our stay Edgar made sure that he got an answer or delivered on our requests. 
A resort like the Melia Paridsus has so many options that a a butler/guide is needed to match your requests to the experience of the resort. Edgar was there for us throughout our stay.
Especially on the last day when he personally contacted Hertz to make sure our car rental could be returned a bit later than we booked for.

If you go to this resort be prepared to nothing or to ramp up your visit with a great round of golf, dining that was ecellectic and activities that can consume your day.

reviews.author: Jake S
reviews.title: Best honeymoon experience we could ask for
reviews.text: We came on our honeymoon to Paradisus Palma Real and could not recommend it enough. It was the perfect balance of adults only / class, and then also a hub and lively vibe. The service was excellent and no ask was never too much. Bladimere and Juan were the BEST!! Highly recommend to all.

reviews.author: Ken B
reviews.title: A picky traveler - Expectations Meet
reviews.text: This was our first stay at this resort and me being picky I must say this resort passed with flying colors. We stayed at this resort for 6 days 5 nights and I must say that we had an amazing time. The resort was beautiful and our beach front room was also great. The resort had some great night performers in the open areas and bars that I really enjoyed. There were several food options and restaurants to choose from but our favorite restaurant was Flora, the food and service there was amazing. The resort staff were amazing people they were always willing to help and make sure we did not need anything while on vacation. Wanda who worked as a bartender was so carrying and considerate when my husband started to feel sick.  She made sure she nursed him back to health. Pedro made sure we stayed comfortable and entertained with jokes. Nicholas and Fernando were our room concierge who were also great people that made sure they keep things in line with our room and stay. Nicholas made sure he kept us informed with daily activities at the resort and made sure that we did not get involved with the wrong things. We definitely loved this resort and will be back soon.

reviews.author: Paulina A
reviews.title: Hillary rumu
reviews.text:
Tuvimos una muy buena relación con ella, se portó excelente y fue muy simpática. Recomendadisima como camarera 
Aparte fue muy amable y cariñosa con nuestra hija pendiente de si necesitábamos cosas para ella

reviews.author: Helen T
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: En nuestra estadía tuvimos una emergencia médica y el señor Toribio Fernandez fue quien nos trasladó de ida y de regreso al hospital. Demostró ser una persona muy humana, humilde y servicial. También quiero agradecer a Santos el gerente nocturno de seguridad que estuvo ayudandonos y pendiente de nuestro bienestar durante el tiempo que estuvimos en el Hospital y de regreso al hotel. Ambos son un ejemplo a seguir!

reviews.author: Pedro S
reviews.title: Un nuevo Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text:
Estamos pasando navidad en el Hotel. Fuimos los afortunados de estar en una habitación remodelada completamente. Con un diseño muy lindo y  destacable.  Las nuevas piscinas para las habitaciones swim up una maravilla. Muy similar a Paradisus la perla o esmeralda. Sigue destacando la calidad en comidas y bebidas. Su personal como siempre muy cordial y agradables. Destacar a cada uno de ellos pero si hay algo que no puedo dejar de escribir es ver al gerente general paseando por el hotel mirando y ayudando a que este todo en orden. Dejare unas fotos para compartir este nuevo y lindo Hotel.como siempre un hotel tranquilo y en general sin filas para pedir comida 
Lo único malo es que algunos tragos no están incluidos dentro del todo incluido. 
Como toda obra nueva algunos detalles pero los están reparando a medida que uno informa. 
Terminado nuestra estadía destacaré a los que hacen aún más distinta la estadía.
