reviews.author: lugmila d
reviews.title: En el parque de niños.una atención excelente
reviews.text: Excelente servicio de las camareras y. El personal, el parque está en adecuadas opciones y la comida muy buena, se puede visitar en familia un ambiente acojedor para la familia completa realmente lo recomiendo

reviews.author: Ashley P.
reviews.title: Wonderful staff
reviews.text:
I stayed a week at this property with my family in the last couple of months. While the service is generally great, there are some people who we saw a few times and who always ensured that we had everything we needed. Raul Jimenez at the beach  always, always goes above and beyond to ensure we are comfortable and happy, and makes what I would consider to be the absolute best caipirinha in the Caribbean - and he does it with warmth and a great sense of humor. Gelmari at Gabi Club at the Reserve makes a perfect coco loco, and if you go to Nube Bar at Grand Cana, look for Jose Hernandez and ask for his "Creation" - it is a passionfruit cocktail that is the perfect mix of sweet and tart. Finally, Magdelin Cedano waited on us at Mina (the steakhouse at Grand Cana), and she was so, so attentive. We asked for some french fries for the table to share with the appetizers, and she made sure that there was always a plate of hot french fries on the table during our meal. We were sort of undecided about what sauces we wanted on our steaks, so she brought steaming hot bowls with all of the sauces over so that we could try whatever we wanted. Overall, the service here is wonderful and the staff work tremendously hard.
Now - the only downside is the pressure Melia puts on people to upgrade. We are Vacation Club members at Paradisus Palma Real and it appears that Melia wants to transition VC members to their Circle program. We have no interest in moving to the Circle program and it would be nice to be able to ask questions of Melia without feeling pressure to buy, so to speak. We did attend a presentation and got a certificate for two people to spend a week at the resort - but when we call, we have not been able to reach anyone to book because the staff that picks up either leaves us on hold or isn't familiar with the program. We are hoping that Melia will great the training out ASAP, because surely they aren't handing out certificates that can't be used.

reviews.author: Curiosity18196500675
reviews.title: Grate place
reviews.text:
We just came back yesterday from The Reserve at Paradisus palma real and the vacation was amazing. The hotel is very nice and super clean, the food is very good and the staff..hmm...the staff is AMAZING. Our concierge Juan Sierra, took care of us, from the moment we stepped out of the bus in front of the hotel, to the very end of our trip. He made our vacation perfect. Luis Diaz and Victor Feliz at the lobby bar, are the best bartenders, i encourage you to taste as many cocktails as you can, they make the best ones, but especially Luis, he is the soul of the party in The Reserve, he is so fun and genuine friendly, i've never seen anyone like him, in any place I've been.
At the beach, you have everything as well, good food, drinks and very nice staff that helps you with anything you need.
The only problem was the golf carts, that takes you from the lobby to the beach, as the distance is quite big (5 minutes cart drive ). Sometimes you get lucky and find them quick, but most of the time you wait to much or, there are to many people waiting for them and not all fit.
Overall it was a 5 star vacation, the staff there, 10 star 🌟and we will surely return.
Thanks for taking your time to read this and i hope it helps.

reviews.author: Yimmy
reviews.title: The best resort ever
reviews.text: El mejor servicio jamás antes visto esta en este resort, todos son super amables y atento con todos sus visitantes les recomiendo a todos este lugar al 100% es uno de los mejores lugares del Caribe garantizado.

reviews.author: Reagan M
reviews.title: Second time here!!
reviews.text:
Everything at this beautiful, spacious resort is perfect always!! We were here 6 years ago, and they revamped the entire beach(old main bar still there!) by adding a beautiful, stunning addition, with a new bar and a new bar and open concept beach party area, with a new restaurant that you can look at the ocean while you enjoy your meals!!
Simon was our main guy! He speaks 5 languages!! Each day we started out visiting him in the main bar by the pool and Simon would get us started. Throughout the early evenings we'd see, Raymol, Melvin, and Emilio who were ready to help with anything with a smile and a high-five!
After that we'd spend the day down at the beach with Ricardo, Junior, Carmen (she helped me heal my crazy bites that were blistering!!), and Juan.  
It was so great! We had our wedding booked here and this was a trip to finalize some things.  The wedding department is wonderful!  Miguelina Martinez is so kind and knowledgeable.  They even made us a mini wedding cake to sample!!  <3 <3 <3
All in all, the upgrades that have been made make this a world-class resort that is not to be missed!!  We love everything about it!
Reagan & James
Warman, Canada

reviews.title: Hydro grill
reviews.text: We had an excellent time at the hydro grill! The food was delicious and came out very quickly. The steak and the short rib were cooked perfectly. Alba was very helpful at getting us a last minute reservation.

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Another excellent experience
reviews.text: My wife and I are Club Meliá Members and we regularly visit Bavaro Beach in Punta Cana. As usual, our recent visit to this property was wonderful. Not only do we enjoy the Caribbean sun, white sandy beaches and aqua blue ocean water but the service provided was phenomenal. While the property has many al la carte restaurants to choose from we also enjoy eating at the Gabi Club buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The staff members at the Gabi Club made us feel like home and provided excellent service. In particular Santo, Fausto Cabrera, Domingo Perdomo were a pleasure to see and speak to in a daily basis. The bartender at the Gabi Club Luis Diaz is also very helpful and a pleasure to interact with. Also the staff at the Hydro Grill, Frankie, Alba, and Franklin Bautista were pleasant and provided excellent service along with delicious food. The Bell Boys, especially Francisco Williams, were also very helpful with our luggage as well as coordinating our daily trips from the hotel to the beach. My wife & I also had massages on the beach with Gladys Dominguez who also provided excellent service and a relaxing experience. Do not hesitate to visit this amazing resort.

reviews.author: Gideon
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful week at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real.
The very best part was the wonderful staff that work there! All the staffers are helpful and warm and welcoming.
Our concierge was Marianayi. She was charming, and cheerful, and attentive, and super helpful! If you are lucky to get her as a concierge your vacation is going to be great!!
In the Gabi Buffet Domingo  and Maria  were such excellent servers! Every day they looked for us and made sure we were doing well.
Leonardo is a server at the restaurant Aqua. If you stay at this resort, go find Leonardo so you can have a superior vacation! He is the best!!!
The bar closest to our room was manned by Miguel who was maybe the best resort bartender I ever met. Danely is a masseuse at the spa who is very nice and gives a great hot stone massage!
The landscaping and pool areas are beautiful here!
Our time here was lovely. I will offer a few critiques so that the reader will know I am being honest:
The rooms need a renovation-they are clean and nice but a little dated. This renovation is happening now at the Paradisus Palma Real next door. I expect The Reserve will be renewed next year or soon thereafter.
The beach along this resort is having a lot of sea weed wash up at this time. Also the vendors are friendly but very persistent. We took a taxi to Macao Beach (30 minutes each way $80 US round trip-the driver waited for us all afternoon). The water at Macao was beautiful and we had a super lovely time there.
In this initial Post-COVID period it is impressive to see The Dominican Republic working so hard to welcome the world back so we can all enjoy this wonderful country and it’s most excellent people!! We will return soon!

reviews.author: Rhonda W
reviews.title: ONE OF THE MOST AMAZING TRIPS I HAVE BEEN ON IN YEARS!!!!!!
reviews.text: We booked our trip to Punta Cana back in November 2021 which we took from Aug 3 through Aug 9, 2022.    We originally booked at Melia Caribe Beach Resort, however upon arrival, we were upgraded to Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort and spa aka The Reserve.  Immediately, we were greeted by our concierge, Eliezer Sanchez.  He was very pleasant, talked with us to see what we needed upon check in, and advised us he would allow us to get settled in and to let him know what we wanted to do for the rest of the evening.  The room was BEAUTIFUL!!  We had our 11-year-old twins with us, and they had a connecting suite exactly like ours.  It was so AMAZING.  We noticed that the twins’ side was very cool, and our side was very warm.  The toilet was also stopped up, so we messaged Eliezer, and both issues were taking care of within 20 minutes.  All the restaurants were amazing, the service was impeccable, Juan was at the bar every morning and greeted me with my favorite cocktail.  I can’t say enough good things about this resort.  We also became members of their Circle program.  If you decide to visit, please sit through the presentation if they ask you to, you will be amazed at how much the membership makes sense if you spend a certain amount of money each year traveling.  We will definitely be returning next year, but sans the kids this time! LOL!

reviews.author: Yoa A
reviews.title: Nice family trip!
reviews.text: The Reserve is great, we were looking to get away and have fun without too much noise and that is exactly what we experienced. The Palma Real is closed, however, since we stayed in the Reserve, we had access to the Gran Cana, which was amazing. It was beautiful, the restaurants and buffet were great, you take a short 3 min golf cart to the Gran Cana. The Mizu restaurant at the Reserve was great, entertaining and great food. Samuel was our concierge and he was excellent. He was professional, courteous, kind and most of all respected our privacy, knew when to come check on us, without being pushy. He made our stay wonderful, and took care of all our needs. Thank you Samuel, you are an asset to the hotel!

reviews.author: LDF
reviews.title: Excellent Restaurant Staff
reviews.text: I stayed at the resort and while the accommodations were not so great, it was the kind and helpful restaurant staff that offered more care to the guests than the hotel itself.  In particular, Yuderaui Javier Robles hotel waitress at the Gabi Club and Agua Restaurant treated us very kindly and delivered excellent service far above any of the hotel staff, specifically any of the managers and concierge. Sometimes it is the small things...When I ran out of coffee because the room wasn't serviced for that, I was told by the manager that it would need to wait until the following day.  Certainly not what I would expect from a luxury all-inclusive experience.  When I mentioned this to Judy (Yuderaui) at the buffet, she went out of her way to get me the coffee pods I requested.  Similarly, she was very helpful in the restaurant providing excellent service in a manner that exceeded above and beyond.  This is the kind of employee that takes personal satisfaction in doing her job and it shows.  This is the kind of person that should be running Melia resorts or at least the hotel in some way as she knows how to treat guests in a kind and professional way.  Thank you Judy for being such a wonderful and pleasant person at your job and being an example to the world.

reviews.title: Summer vacation 2022

Our concierge, Samuel A made the experience even more enjoyable by arranging excursions for our family that wee fun and also making dinner reservations for us every night! reviews.author: Compass723786
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text:
Our vacation was excellent! The Reserve was awesome and our Concierge, Samuel Avelino was amazing. The Concierge we’ve ever had after traveling to numerous places all over the world!
We look forward to returning in the winter and I will definitely plan on looking for Samuel again.

reviews.author: Evan O
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: Amazing time at beautiful location with great concierge (Samuel Avelino) who helped make it even better! There are many pools with lots of huts and poolside beds to relax in. The rooms are big and even have hot tubs!

reviews.author: Javonne A
reviews.title: Mama Juana Tasting at The Reserve @ Palma Real
reviews.text: What a wonderful treat to get to hear the history of the traditional drink of the Dominican Republic as one of the included activities while at our resort. Johanna did a beautiful Mama Juana tasting presentation and had an equally beautiful personality. We sampled Mama Juana made by Johanna. It was delicious. She even personally made Mama Juana mojitos. The first of that type of mojito that we've ever tried! Thank you Johanna for a great experience!!

reviews.author: Curious562540
reviews.title: Girls Trip

reviews.author: Joe M
reviews.title: Honeymoon

reviews.title: Anniversary

One individual ,Claritzel, our concierge stood out above the rest. She made sure that our anniversary was one that we will remember forever. Red carpet service the entire 7 day trip. reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience the service and the staff were awesome!!! Relaxing/ family friendly!! The food was amazing between both Melia hotels. The pool at Gran Caña/ DJ great vibe  ! Claritzel is amazing Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: Becky G
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
We just stayed for a week at the Reserve. We had a fabulous time and would definitely recommend. The 2 bedroom master suite was spacious (we are 2 adults and 3 teens). And the pool and beach are beautiful
and relaxing. All the staff are pleasant, and we loved our concierge Mariannyi. She checked in with us every morning and made us dinner reservations for every night. We have previously stayed at the Grand Cana twice (before Covid), and we were just as happy at the Reserve this time. We will certainly return for future vacations.

reviews.author: Lou M
reviews.title: Punta Cana Birthday
reviews.text: This is a huge complex with many amenities to choose from. The staff is extremely mannered and pleasant. The hotel, accommodation, food and drinks are impeccable and tasteful. Our concierge Anayely Rivera was always prompt to our requests and very attentive to our needs. She went above and beyond to accommodate our requests. My only disappointment was the distance from the hotel to the beach. It’s a 25 minute walk, no room with ocean views as I thought we had booked. Nevertheless, we were granted a Certificate of Stay for another vacation there. The only problem is you can’t get them on the phone to book it! lol

reviews.author: Fernanda B
reviews.title: Gran atencion
reviews.text: El hotel con excelentes servicios, fuimos con un bebe de 1 año que aun no come sal ni azúcar y en todos los restaurantes, playa y guardería  nos solucionaron esta petición haciéndole comida especial. Las piscinas preciosas y muy amplias, si uno quería podia bañarse solo. Las habitaciones de gran tamaño, solo podrían hacerles mantencion por  ciertos detalles. Esta todo super bien pensado para ir en familia con niños, en la guardería todo el equipo muy dedicado a los pequeños lo que hacia fácil dejarlos ahi un rato, destaco especialmente a Martina y Johana de Kidsdom por su entrega (todo el equipo es excelente). La concierge Anayely buenísima, una tremenda disposición para todo, estuvimos unos dias enfermos con mi hijo y se preocupo hasta de conseguirnos los remedios para que llegaran al hotel, siempre preocupada de nuestras necesidades y dispuesta a resolver cualquier duda. Por ultimo felicitar a Dania Viñas, fue la que hizo posible que hasta en la playa nos pudieran hacer comida especial sin sal con una disposición de oro. Tuvimos unas excelentes vacaciones y el equipo humano del hotel fue el gran responsable de esto.

reviews.author: Sasha P
reviews.title: Lovely resort and 5* customer service
reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay at the Paradisus resort. The customer service was excellent at all times which made our experience very enjoyable. 

Our concierge Claritzel was phenomenal and assisted us throughout our stay at all times with anything that we needed. 

The only downside was that our original booking was for Palma Real which is closed for renovations and we were put in The Reserve instead which is in the same resort. However overall our experience at the Resort was very pleasant and i would 100% stay at another Melia Resort in future as their customer service is fantastic and probably the best customer service we have come across.

reviews.author: karapisani
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation in Punta Cana
reviews.text: We are just leaving a 5 day trip that my friend and I planned for our recent high school graduate sons. Coming from Fort Lauderdale, FL it was a quick 2.5 hr flight. We arranged transport through Odium to get 5 of us from airport to paradisus resort. It was an easy process getting from airport to hotel. Well organized and well marked. Upon arrival at resort the lobby had snacks, drinks, etc waiting for us and the check-in process was easy as can be. I’m not sure where the bad reviews are coming from. We found the staff to be warm, friendly and so helpful every step of the way. The hotel rooms were clean and spacious. We stayed in the Reserve and that hotel was more geared to families but we had access the grand Cana- the adult resort. Our concierge, Claritzel Otañez, was excellent- very helpful in making hotel reservations and provided us with activities and excursions during our stay. We selected a tour yo a private island that included stops at Chavon River, casa de campo and the worlds largest natural swimming pool. To say it was gorgeous is an understatement. The food at the resort was good enough. No real complaints there and plenty of everything. I highly recommend staying at Paradisus Punta Cana. You can not go wrong for the price with an all- inclusive resort!!!

reviews.author: Resort677893
reviews.title: Celebración de cumpleaños
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia. La comida exquisita muy buen servicio de todos en los diferentes restaurantes y muy bien dirigiros por Claritzel, muy pendiente de nosotros en toda nuestra estadía. El Spa delicioso me encanto el servicio, nos hicimos masajes Dos días. La exfoliación buenísima, definitivamente volveremos. Gracias punta Cana.

reviews.author: Pablo M
reviews.title: Trip to Paradise
reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly people,  awesome drinks. Our concierge Samuel was incredible. Anything that we needed, he was there for us.  The beach and access to food and drinks while at the beach was an added bonus.

reviews.author: Heather R
reviews.title: A private romantic getaway in paradise!
reviews.text:
My husband and I took our delayed honeymoon this May, my mother in law recommended The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. We had the most amazing couples trip we have ever taken. 

The Reserve is perfect! It’s a beautiful resort with a winding pool with plenty of shade. We were always able to find a spot in and around the pool where we were the only people there. The resort provided a variety of lounge chairs that accommodated those who love the sun, and those who wish to avoid it or burn easily.

Everyone at the resort was attentive and kind, but the superstar of our stay was our concierge Samuel. Samuel went above and beyond to make our stay magical. 

The beach and sister resort Grand Cana were a brief walk away or a quick ride on a golf cart. The Reserve was a quieter more intimate setting than Grand Cana. 

The food was great as well, Paradisus Palma Real had a variety of cuisine available. Some of our favorite places were Lemon Fish and Aqua. 

The buffet at the Reserve was a fun experience too, we got to try several dishes I will be making at home from now on. Mashed plantains was a huge crown pleaser with my husband.

Our room was a ground level with a garden patio. It was private, quiet, and came with a tiki hut in the back. We spent most mornings reading in the shaded tiki hut.

If you are thinking about booking a romantic couples getaway for pure relaxation and rejuvenation this is the place for you!

reviews.author: normanj788
reviews.title: Amazing vacation with Harry Milor
reviews.text: We have a fantastic vacation here are the reserve services are excellent our Concierge Harry Milor is very friendly and attentive he pay attention to our details and help us with all of our need and find us where ever we are in the resort nice place to welcome groups and individuals for vacation thank you Harry Milor you are the best.

reviews.author: Denise P
reviews.title: Paradisas Palma Real
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! Everything from the rooms to the pool to the restaurants to the fitness center was very clean and well-maintained. Friendly staff, good variety of activities (loved the poolside painting class!). Not as close to the beach as I expected, but it was very quick and easy to catch a golf cart shuttle to the beach. Plenty of beach and poolside cabanas. Great restaurants on site and at a sister property. And our concierge Nicolas Maracallo was especially attentive, helping us secure dinner reservations every night (for a group on of 10), scheduling activities, answering questions, and going above and beyond to provide some special touches to help my parents celebrate their anniversary! He made sure we were well cared for!

reviews.author: Brandon Santiago
reviews.title: Always more than expected!
reviews.text: LOVE STAYING HERE. I travel a lot and this is one of my favorite places. The resort is packed with stuff to do and plenty of restaurants. The real reason I love it here is the amazing staff. So many to mention but my concierge Jessica is the best. I request her services every time I stay. She truly goes above and beyond for me and my family and it does not go unnoticed. She remembers little details, what we like and don't like and always makes our stay that much more enjoyable. She assists with tours and outings outside of the resort and basically everything at the resort for us. The resort is exactly what you would expect and what you see on the website is exactly what you see when you visit.

reviews.author: Ben P
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Had an amazing time on our trip here. The whole family came for our grandparents 52nd wedding anniversary and the trip was awesome. Great service, great food, and our concierge Nicolas Maracallo was incredibly helpful and really made the trip special.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: Beautiful place and great staff! Our butler, Claritzel was phenomenal and made sure we had everything we needed. She made reservations for us at all of the restaurants and helped us book the best tours and photos. She was available whenever we needed her. It wouldn’t have been the experience it was without her! She made it our home away from home! Food and drinks were great too! Plenty of activities during the day and every evening. Cant wait to come back!

reviews.author: nsciotti
reviews.title: our trip to punta canta was amazing!
reviews.text: First I want to say our concierge Irvin was amazing and super helpful. Everything was very easy going. The restaurant options are great! You are also welcomed to use other facilities within the strip complex of hotel. We specifically loved The Reserve because there were cabanas everywhere with pockets of privacy. It is also very family friendly but yet quite private for couples. This was a trip for our “baby moon” with being pregnant I had many limitations but there was also something entertaining to do and every one was very accommodating with food as well.  The buffet at the reserve was always good. The beach was absolutely stunning, and all the hard workers servicing you with free food and drinks were very good at their jobs. We had an amazing trip and would definitely recommend to couples and families with children. These people try their very best to please you and they are all extremely hard working and kind.

reviews.author: Sarah J
reviews.title: Wonderful Service
reviews.text: Thank you to the team in the Sports Bar for fantastic service and the best drinks at the resort! Pamela was a fantastic member of the staff!  I highly recommend the espresso martini or ask for your favorite drink and they will make it with love.

reviews.author: Silvia R
reviews.title: Vacaciones excepcionales
reviews.text:
Durante todo el mes de Abril  junto con mi esposo Jorge E. Moldaver, estuvimos alojados en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real de Punta Cana.  Pasamos unas vacaciones geniales porque el hotel se encuentra en todo su esplendor después de superada la pandemia y pudimos disfrutar de las bondades del sector para adultos conocido como Reserve de Luxe que incluye algunos restaurantes exclusivos que junto a los comunes permiten una variedad de ofertas gastronómicas muy satisfactorias, además de piscina y sector de playa para adultos. 
      El  funcionamiento tan eficiente  de todos los servicios del hotel según nuestro criterio, se debe entre otras a estas personas a las cuales vimos trabajar con profesionalismo  y mucha empatía hacia los huéspedes: 
Gerenta Adriane Romero y su secretaria Mayte Vazquez Gex, que se ocuparon personalmente de que todo fuera perfecto.
     El chef Marcos que colaboró para que disfrutara plenamente nuestras  cenas en los diversos restaurantes y que me relacionó con José Batista Montero y Leuri Gimenes dos encargados de restaurantes que trabajan a la par de sus subordinados y consiguen que donde estén ellos todo sea superlativo.
     Otra mención especial merece el Restaurant Palazzo en el cual  almorzamos  casi todos lo días donde la oferta y presentación de su buffet es espectacular, debido al esfuerzo y talento de Juan Gaiceras y Miladys Carpio, también el capitán del salón Franklin Bautista y  los camareros en representación de todos cito a Fausto, fueron muy amables y simpáticos con nosotros en especial y con todos los huéspedes en general .
      Muchas gracias a todos y hasta la próxima.
                                           Silvia Y Jorge

reviews.author: 65MAYS
reviews.title: Royal Treatment
reviews.text:
This was my first time at a Melia, thanks to my friend's invitation, as she is a member of the Melia Group.

I was AMAZED of the service, food, accommodations, and the STAFF!!!  So professional.

I have to mention our Concierge Ralphy Tejada... He was one of a kind.  Always ready to answer all our questions.  Arranged for me to have the Covid test, and walked all the way through the results (as it was for me 1st time I had a test) as I had my 2 boosters already.  He arranged for taxi to the airport, and respectful of our needs.

Our room was fantastic, with a beautiful ocean view/front.  We had Yvaniry to make sure that our room was clean and had enough towels.  And arrange to give us enough coffee pods and creamer.

And we have EDITO, he was working at the Buffet and he was always ready to serve my friend her Cappuccino and  me my "cortadito."

The night shows/music were great.  I love merengue and bachata; which I had enjoy dancing with some of the show staff.  They were two lovely ladies.

What an experience.... in a couple of weeks I will experience another Melia, this time in Playa del Carmen, Mexico.

Thanks for your warm hospitality and professionalism.

Congratulations!

reviews.author: Mallory C
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with excellent service!
reviews.text: From sitting poolside with Pedro and Wanda hooking up the towels and excellent drinks to our concierge Nicolas who was incredibly helpful and thoughtful we had the best vacation! The many pools and beautiful beachfront were so relaxing.

reviews.author: Heidi
reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: Here for a week staff and resort are wonderful.  Ocean, pool, and swim up bars are awesome. Views are spectacular. Great weather even if it rains. Very welcoming, Relaxing, and fun 🤩.  Would definitely book again.

reviews.author: Nicole Cruz
reviews.title: Servicio y comida de primera calidad
reviews.text:
Excelente experiencia. El personal sumamente atento y eficiente, sumamente complacida.
La comida 10/10, alta cocina de mucha calidad, la bebida excelente. Los restaurantes ofrecen un menú muy exquisito. Las habitaciones muy cómodas y limpias.

reviews.author: Michelle K
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This resort is my second HOME.. The service and care I receive each time we come is excellent— let me tell you about Darleni Alvarado was our concierge. She gave us the best customer service . She was always available to assist us with all of our vacation needs. If I could give Ms. Alvarado 10 STARS I would. She loves what she does and it shows by her how we were serviced..

reviews.author: Jeanette B
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation
reviews.text: We had such an amazing experience staying at the reserve! The people were so kind, the food was exceptional and the landscaping was nothing short of immaculate. However, the best part of the whole trip was the Kidsdom. We have a two year old, and not only is it hard to find a resort that has the facility and staff to care for that age but to find one that my son LOVED was such a blessing. They remembered his name from day one, fed him meals (super hard since he is a picky eater) and had a ton of one on one play time with him. The facility was super clean and child safe, I never hesitated leaving him. Thank you to everyone for a great vacation and some much needed peace!

reviews.author: thai h
reviews.title: Cielo restaurant
reviews.text: Jose Batista has the BEST staff. The food is amazing. Francis Javier has amazing food and the food waiter Bryan Alexander, Hostess Jafreisy Lopez are the best. So happy with the Paradisus Palma Real Reserve!

reviews.author: Jan Steehler
reviews.title: Sal. Steak Cave
reviews.text: Fantastic meal! If you visit Punta Cana  you must  see Abraham  and enjoy your memorable meal from start ro finish! The steak, salad, mashed potatoes and roasted mushrooms  are amazing. Dessert is delicious also!

reviews.author: Laura J
reviews.title: Cielo
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Palma real was amazing. Quiet and great place for a honeymoon! The swim up suites are private and quaint. 

Many restaurants included to chose from in the all inclusive. Cielo: best restaurant at Paridisus Palma Real! Frances Javier made the best Chimichuri sauce I’ve had. Fresh Ingredients. Jose Batista greeted us right as we came in the restaurant. His staff including Bryan Alexander, Jafreisy Lopez made our experience a 10/10

reviews.author: Ct P
reviews.title: Excellent all inclusive resort. We will definitely visit again soon.
reviews.text: Excellent stay. All inclusive food and drinks. Staff are all very nice and provide great customer service. Rooms are cleaned every day. Snacks and drinks are supplied in the rooms. The swim up bar was the best. Bartenders Victor Felis and Luis are very polite and provide great drinks. They made us feel very comfortable and it was nice to be able to swim up to the bar and enjoy our drinks. Overall it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience at this resort our Butler Nicolas was exceptional.  He set everything up for us, visited and texted us regularly to make sure we were enjoying our time and that we had everything we needed.  He even served us guacamole on the beach!  Definitely request him as your Butler!  Great bar service by my girls Wanda and Ruby loved them both!  Hansel serving our drinks A+ such a sweet cute guy!  If you are thinking of a trip to Punta Cana this was a great place to stay!

reviews.author: Katherine
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text: Where do I begin? My husband and I came for a friend’s wedding and let me just say that I’m glad they chose this resort! We selected the upgraded package and stayed at the reserve; which is a part of the resort but includes premium treatment. Our concierge, Edward was phenomenal! He was attentive to our needs and every little detail in between. Edward kept us on our schedule each day, had all of our reservations and activities planned with no hiccups. The food was amazing! All staff members that we came in contact with were excellent and always smiled. Our spa experience was top tier! You cannot help but be relaxed during your stay. Be warned, you will not want to leave and will go through though withdrawals. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Andrea P

Nos vinimos a casar con nuestros amigos y familia y fue DE LO MEJOR. El servicio perfecto. La playa, la piscina hermosisima. La boda quedo HERMOSA. No Tuvimos ni un problema y todos mis invitados (70) estuvieron muy contentos con las habitaciones.

Y nuestra server favorita ALTAGRACIA, de parte de todos mis 70 invitados, muchas gracias por tu servicio tan perfecto! Super recommendada, siempre estaba alli con nosotros y super atenta. Nos hizo reir tanto!!! Con mucho amor, gracias Altagracia.

reviews.author: Isamary G
reviews.title: Vacaciones

reviews.author: Severine M
reviews.title: Excelente ubicación del Hotel en Punta Caña con vistas espectaculares y sobre todo un personal muy atento en todo moment
reviews.text:
Excelente ubicación y servicio.  El hotel es espectacular. 
Muchísimas gracias a Lucia Díaz, Luis Desa, Ana Person, Walquiria Brito y Olga Martínez por el excelente servicio que nos brindaron durante toda nuestra estancia.
Nos vemos pronto otra vez aquí!!!

reviews.author: Kenneth M
reviews.title: Another wonderful trip to paradise
reviews.text:
We just returned from another wonderful trip to the Paradisus Palma Real property in Punta Cana. We have been to the Melia properties there (the Beach Club and the Paradisus Palma Real) five times over the past several years, including a trip this past December, and we always know that we are going to have a quality experience. 

We booked the adult 16+ Reserve Jr Suite which gave us access to the adult only area of the property (e.g., pool & beach area) as well as our personal butler (concierge) to assist us with our stay. 

Zanovia was our butler (as we requested her again after our December trip) and she is amazing! Not only is she great at her job in keeping us informed, ensuring dinner reservations are what we wanted, checking in on us every day to see if we needed anything, and delivering a few added surprise snacks and drinks, she is just a warm, sincere, and happy human being that makes everyone smile.  Thank you Zanovia!

The adult only areas are a valuable premium, especially if you are a couple going there to get away and have time just to yourselves. The adult only pool area is quiet and very private with a bar located adjacent where Wanda and other wonderful staff take great care of you. The adult only beach area is the best we have found in any resort. Whether you like to be in the sun, have chairs under a palapa, or have a private palapa with a bed in the shade and chairs to use in the sun as needed, you will find what you need. Pedro (he is awesome!) and the beach staff are attentive and make sure you always have a water or your beverage of choice.

For those of you that frequent all-inclusive resorts, you know what to expect in terms of dining. The Paradisus Real is definitely all-inclusive type of dining, in terms of expectations, but we believe they are a cut above others. The buffet (breakfast and lunch) has plenty of choices of fresh or made to order items, and there is a larger than normal list of dinner restaurants to choose from here. We love the Winery (thank you Johnston!) where you can enjoy a lovely four course dinner (included) with a wine bottle purchase. The other restaurants that are fully included are also better than the average resort food. We enjoyed them all. 

For those wanting a peaceful trip to paradise, this is a great value and we can highly recommend.

reviews.author: JoseBVirginie
reviews.title: Le paradis sur terre
reviews.text:
L'hôtel nous a vraiment beaucoup plu!!!  Très bel emplacement avec la plage à proximité. Un jardin très bien entretenu, verdoyant.  Très bon accueil et chaleureux de la part de tout le personnel, principalement de notre concierge Raul Mota, qui était très disponible et nous a offert un service exemplaire et personnalisé !!! 

Seul bémol: le buffet qui n'était pas trop à notre goût, mais  il y avait suffisamment de restaurants, qui offraient une grande variété de plats

reviews.author: Aline N
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This hotel is perfect for honeymoon, was there in a part of the hotel called the reserve, totally vip, with cabanas close to the beach, private bar and pool and a concierge just to ourselves to provide us the best experience ever, she was so helpful with restaurants reservations and scheduling the excursions! (Thank you Darleni 🧡) and also Martín at the beach was always ready to find a good cabana at the beach and bringing us good drinks! (Thank you Martín 🧡)

reviews.author: Bahar F
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay very much! Very family friendly, lots of food, kids club made things very easy! Activities every night and all through the day. Our third time here. Now a water park which made the kids very happy!

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.title: Amazing Paradisus!! Real paradise
reviews.text: We had an incredible time in Paradisus Palma Real. This is a real paradise and the service is amazing. I have to mention Fausto from Vento restaurant, Giovanni from Tokimeku and Victor from the pool bar. We just had an incredible time. The concierge Jairo helped us with all reservations at the restaurants. We have been at Paradisus 12 times and will continue to come every year. It has been a dream vacation and can’t wait to come back next year!!

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: Buena atención de todo el personal, variedad en el bufete en el desayuno, almuerzo y cena, siempre encuentras bar disponible y la amabilidad del personal es excelente. Hotel impecable, servicio de aseo permanente.

reviews.author: Cathy M

The place is really nice for Punta Cana, the chef has great Mediterranean influences and the result is pretty good.
The parpadelles and the Greek moussaka are good choices

reviews.author: Justin W
reviews.title: Cielo must do
reviews.text: My wife and I had reservations as the first guests. We were promptly greeted and “wow”is all I can say from there. Fresh guacamole, fresh pico de gallo, fresh warm tortilla chips… Just the start. I had the best red snapper I have ever eaten in my entire life, my wife, the vegetarian, had some of the best vegan meatballs she’s ever had. Kudos to the manager, Batiste and his crew. Five stars. Wish we were hungrier, I would have eaten the napkins everything was so good!

reviews.author: alandriver99
reviews.title: Melos (DR) Paradisus Palma Real Resort Lobby Bar
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Resort Lobby Bar with Luis Desa, Lucia Diaz and Walquiria Brito was the best spot for drinks in the entire resort! The conversation, attention to detail and yummy drinks are what made this spot our first stop every night! If you visit, you must go see them!

reviews.author: Pelaez F
reviews.title: Brisas

reviews.author: Daniela F
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text:
Os quartos são muito bonitos, assim como a piscina e a praia. Este hotel é memorável! 
Fomos jantar ao restaurante mexicano e a comida estava maravilhosa, especialmente a carne. O funcionário Alexander Santos merece os parabéns, muito simpático e prestável. Assim como Juan Vicente fez as nossas bebidas, Francis Javier cozinhou estes pratos deliciosa os, e José Batista, o chefe de sala, foi muito prestável também.

Comida é boa não é picante

reviews.author: Sandra L
reviews.title: Beautiful Location - Wonderful People
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from 7 fabulous days at Paradisus Palma Real (The Reserve).  Stunningly beautiful property with FANTASTIC staff.
Many thanks to the team at The Reserve beach area, always helpful and accommodating...making for a very relaxing vacation!  Pedro on the beach, Wanda at the bar (ask for the "Wanda Special", you'll LOVE IT) and  the gentleman who greeted me at the beach every morning with a warm "excelente" smile (I'm sorry I did not get his name).  
A big thank you to our butler Lewis who was always there to make our vacation carefree, organising dinner reservations and tending to any request we had.
I have included a picture of the view from our Panoramic Beach Front Junior Suite (room 6109)...breathtaking!  Having the view of the ocean was such a bonus, we enjoyed drinks and snacks on the balcony and even room service for breakfast.
I strongly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: wattersj165
reviews.title: Fantastic resort
reviews.text: Just finished a week long vacation with the family. The resort is beautiful and the food was wonderful. Our concierge, sairen Rebinson, was fantastic. He  helped with all reservations, handled all requests and made sure we enjoyed every moment. Definitely coming back.

reviews.author: Francheskca B

Hotel maravilhoso, comida deliciosa mas o destaque vai para o concierge Starling que fez nossa estadia se tornar ainda mais especial pois nos ajudou a celebrar nossos casamento com muito carinho!! Recomendo de olhos fechados
Obrigada a todos!!

reviews.author: george k
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Everything in this resort is first class from the   service and the quality of food and presentation to the serenity of the beach and accommodations. Highly recommend Palma Real Reserve for everyone looking for the best. Check out Cielo for authentic Mexican Michelin ⭐️ ❤️🙏❤️

reviews.title: Una cena fenomenal

reviews.title: Aqua restaurant ( Mediterranean)
reviews.text: The best service in Paradisus ( Melia) , wonderful time, delicious food, and Abraham service was excellent with the best option in the menu. Was the best option por the dinner, don't hesitate in visit it.

reviews.author: julian v
reviews.title: Aqua restaurant
reviews.text:
Lo mejor de aqua el servido de ABRAHAM 

Recomendados todos los platos, en especial el cordero 

Todo es el especial, el servicio, la cena. Recomendado la musaka, el salmón y para finalizar postre de chocolate, mama Juana y amaretto

reviews.author: ammie_11
reviews.title: Beach bar on adult side
reviews.text: Wanda and martin are the best! Martin Had our beach spot set up everyday and Wanda always had great drinks! Ruby at the Gabi Beach bar was super every night! Simeon was great getting our dinners set up! Enjoy a great trip business and personal!

reviews.author: James Phelan
reviews.title: Give Raul a Raise!!!
reviews.text: Raul Jiminez was the best. He kept is from all but guaranteed dehydration with his excellent drink service. Look for Raul on at the pool bar or beach on your next trip to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Enrique A.
reviews.title: Playa del hotel Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: El trato del personal en la playa es inmejorable, en especial mencionar a Wilmer Sabino e Iván Pérez por su simpatía y profesionalidad. Seguro que volveremos, sea en pareja o en familia. Muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Carrie B
reviews.title: Service Manager Town & Country Services
reviews.text:
Very excellent service. Friendly staff. Glenny was an excellent waitress and Jose the service manager was always pleasant and accommodating.  Fresh food and quick service. Portions are perfect. 5 stars
.

reviews.author: Beth7816
reviews.title: Great evening
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time dining here. Great food and wonderful service! Above and beyond especially with the drink service. Very relaxing, especially loved the chips and salsa, the margaritas and the tres leches! José and a Carlos took great care of us.

reviews.author: Iratxe
reviews.title: Vacaciones de ensueño
reviews.text:
Realizamos nuestro viaje a finales de noviembre, invierno boreal en R.D. Por un invierno así, firmamos de por vida (25C° día y 18 - 20C° durante la noche). Nuestra estancia en un alojamiento de belleza incomparable,cumplió nuestras expectativas incluso por encima de lo contratado desde la agencia. Una estructura del hotel monumental manteniendo su esencia acogedora, cómoda y muy tropical. Comodidades continuas en cada zona del resort, con diferentes ambientes para cada momento del día.
Especial mención al trato siempre amable, atento  y servicial de todos sus empleados comenzando desde el excelente servicio de limpieza siempre pendiente de todas las necesidades de acomodo.
Trabajadores que hicieron que nuestra estancia allí fuera inolvidable:
Nuestra organizadora Leonela Calderón que se esforzó mucho en satisfacer nuestro disfrute y entretenimiento allí. Cariñosa, cercana al tiempo que sutil en su presencia. Nuestro barman de piscina don Víctor Feliz excelente profesional dedicado en cuerpo y alma a su trabajo y a sus clientes. Nos atendió como miembros de su familia, preocupado siempre por nuestro mejor bienestar. Para disfrutar de una cena show inolvidable, nuestra recomendación es el chef Henrry, del restaurante asiático Tokimeku, y para una cena espectacular y suculenta, el restaurante Sal Steak Cave.
Para disfrutar de los mejores cócteles nuestro barman Jonathan Rodríguez y nuestra camarera por excelencia Ivelisse Abad, dos personas cariñosas y entrañables pendientes siempre de ofrecer el mejor servicio en el pub Gabi.
Agradecer también el trato amable y la diligencia a Yicel de la Cruz y a Jesús Peguero.
Única recomendación a mejorar, la habitación de cortesía del último día, que fue un auténtico desastre, la habitación es inexistente, solo te procuran un pequeño vestuario donde ducharte y cambiarte. Mal acondicionado, sucio y sin atención. Una forma extrema de terminar con el paraíso y volver a la realidad. Algo que no se resuelve con la mala gestión, actitud y falta de respeto de la encargada del Dpto. del cliente Dña. Grace hacia los empleados. No es un fallo de los empleados sino de la cadena del hotel.

reviews.author: Nicole R
reviews.title: Great Dinner
reviews.text: We are stayed at the Reserve and had dinner at Cielo. The chef Francis Javier, manager Jose Batista and server Isaura Urena were amazing. The service was wonderful and the food was delicious. We highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: steven j
reviews.title: A beautiful property with a terrific staff helped make our vacation a great success. Oh and the weather is also fantastic here.
reviews.text: We had a terrific time at Paradisus Palma Real. They met and exceeded our expectations. Pablo Perez, our host, was great and helped us throughout the week with reservations and other details. He was very attentive and took care of every detail in timely fashion. The resort is beautiful with plenty of happy and attentive staff. Beautifully landscaped, with plenty of pools and private nooks. Although the resort was full we never felt like it was crowded, and never had to wait in line. We are coming back again next year and bringing the family.

reviews.author: Doug A
reviews.title: Doug
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the Palma Real resort. We spent 11 days there and it met or exceeded our expectations every day. Our Concierge/Butler Samuel did a wonderful job. He arranged every dinner, spa treatment, golf game and anything else we needed. The fun time around the pool was extremely enjoyable as well. Raul (the pool side server) both entertained us and provided top notch service. 

We would definitely recommend this resort to anyone thinking about a trip to the Dominican. The food was very good and the complimentary golf was a real bonus. To be able to play 5 rounds when there is still snow on the ground back home was awesome. 

We will return

reviews.author: Rodney N
reviews.title: Poolside Service
reviews.text:
When vacationing, customer service is priority #1.  Raul is provided exceptional service for our group everyday.  He locked down the cabanas, had the buckets of beer on ice (and kept them full), as well as made sure our entire team felt like VIPs.

Thank you Raul!

reviews.author: Kimberly P
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! The whole experience, from room to concierge service, it was just amazing! The location, right on the beach and the grounds with pools was the best. Our personal concierge was named Simeon and he was AWESOME! He was very attentive to our every need. He made sure he was available to us for whatever we needed. He told us what places were available for dinner each evening and made reservations for us each night. I had an issue with accessing my COVID test that was required before leaving and he took care of everything! I had a slight issue with my room initially, and he made sure I was accommodated with what I needed. I will definitely visit Palma Real again and again!

reviews.author: Benedick Cruzado
reviews.title: The home away from home. The family we found in Punta Cana.
reviews.text: From the moment we made the arrangements to stay in the all inclusive resort, it has been nothing but amazing and with ease. They were more than accommodating and tended to me and my love ones needs. They made our first family Vacation something to remember with. From the pick up form the airport, to our stay in our ocean front rooms, everything was impeccable. They even went out of their way and gave us a welcome surprise. The accessibility to the pools, restaurant, entertainment was definitely something memorable. Altagracia, Luis, Margia, Boris, Kiris, Antonio, Julia at Bar Avenue was so I tune with our needs that at times we don’t even have to ask and we have drinks on our hand or at times coffee or tea. Adonis came over an do really again to make sure we were taken care of. Yonier was so helpful . From errands, to reservations to arranging our amazing photo shoot with Edwin! They all went above and beyond. They were very engaging and the food was amazing. There are different selections of the type of food and the chef at times even came out and ask if we would want something more local or what we felt like having. Unforgettable. I will definitely remember our stay here and will definitely come back. Thank you thank you thank you once again.

reviews.author: Damaris
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text: Great service loved the attention from each individual! Will return 100% recommend to family and friends. Great experience no complaints. Experience was full of laughter and enjoyment. Made to feel very special

reviews.author: Mariela Nieva
reviews.title: Bufete Nao
reviews.text: Estuvimos de vacaciones 12 días en el hotel! Realmente pasamos unos días espectaculares, no solo el lugar es hermoso, la calidad de la comida y la atención cálida que recibimos nos hicieron terminar nuestra estadía con una sonrisa. En varias ocaciones tuvimos la suerte de coincidir con José Batista, quien nos atendió con mucha amabilidad, predisposición y alegria. Un gusto cruzarse con gente así. Extrañaremos no solo la comodidad y confort del hotel sino también la calidez de su gente y servicio! Volveremos!

reviews.author: Agustin Bernasconi
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text:
Estuvimos 2 semanas en paradisus y la pasamos muy bien. 
Jose Batista nos atendió muy bien tanto en el buffet Nao como en Cielo.
También destacar la atención de Alexander en Mama y Juana y de marilin sanchez en el buffet de paradisus gran cana.

reviews.author: Carmen
reviews.title: Fabuloso almuerzo en buffet Nao
reviews.text: Nos atendió muy amablemente José Emilio Batista!. Excelente variedad de comida y un gran servicio. Nos hospedamos en Grand Cana pero disfrutamos varios días de esta gran opción para almorzar al visitar la playa.

reviews.text: We had a great time the staff was excellent. Yoiner was our personal concierge. He was very responsive. He along with Julio in the Circle office made my stay easy and enjoyable. Arisleida and Reyna greeted us with a smile every day. This is why I joined as a member this weekend.

reviews.author: Brandon L
reviews.title: Another great time!
reviews.text:
Very kind staff and always willing to help. Arisleida Valdez and Joel Perez who work at the Gabi Beach Bar, for example, treated us like friends and family....even taught me some Spanish too. My wife and I have been here 5 times now. The resort changed some over the past two years....partially because of COVID maybe...The adults area and the family locations of the Reserve flipped. So, this time we were much closer to the beach. But, we still liked visiting both areas.

 I did not use it, but I hear that the Melia app is very helpful in sorting out the somewhat confusing details. It requires your booking confirmation but gave us an error...and I didnt feel like messing with tech problems while laying on a beach. 

We did discover that Pallazo for lunch is very nice (baked salmon, chimmichurri (sp) steak, Tuna steak....) if you want to get away from the Naos restaurant (which is also good) where a lot of people go for lunch. The Hydro Grill at the Reserve family section is also a good option.

They do push a little bit on time shares....but not too bad. Our concierge talked to us once about it, insisted and offered a free massage at the Spa, but then accepted that we didn't want to sit through a free breakfast (at an all inclusive resort...haha) for 45 minutes (which is never just 45 minutes based on a previous experience.) He was doing his job and was respectful of our decision and not pushy....which was nice. 

We plan to come back! :)

reviews.title: Didnt start well but ended well. Have very few complains.
reviews.text: I actually look the paradisus punta cana resort when  I got to the gate for that resort I was told the resort was under renovation that they could not let me in, I had to call the number that was email so they could informed me that my reservation was taken by a different hotel which took me 20 mins to drive there. I  wish they could have email me about this, But there was no communication. My reservation was at paradisus  palma real. When I got there I stop at the lobby with the vehicle bellman did not approach me I had to go up to them so they could acknowledge me. I took my bags out of my car. They finally came over to me. I ask where can I park my vehicle they said they can do it or I can do it my self I allow them to do it. I went to front desk  ask to speak to a manager  because i didnt like how the beginning  of my stay was going, they had me sit down for 15 to 20 mins. I explain to the manager  that I didn't like that I book for one resort and I ended up some where else even though I book directly  through their agent over the phone, show  him all the emails I got in regards to my stay , he told me there's nothing they can do, I left it just like that because my wife is pregnant and just wanted to get to the room at that point. The rest of my stay at the resort I can't lie was honestly amazing. Staff was great very friendly. Had a dinner on the beach which the food was great and it was only 119 dollars for both of us but it was alot of food everything was delicious. We where celebrating our anniversary. Everything came out awesome. We also made reservations  for one of their restaurants cielos awesome Mexican food the pico de Gallo and guacamole  was great. Staff was extremely  friendly, wish I could see more of their faces could not do that because they all had mask on, and that didn't  make sence to me since guest don't have to wear a mask but employees do. Please allow them to take them off I feel that It would be nice to see their smiles. The only other thing about the resort is that I wish they had more shows are night. I did like the last night they had dominican night  show was great. I would love to see more things like that. Lastly I would deff go back to this resort they treat you great, food is great.  And very friendly  staff. I'm looking foward to coming again in the future.

Wanda, Gilberto and Pedro at the adults only bar were fantastic, they provided us with a superb service for our 10 day trip. Always greeted you with a smile and a joke. I’m sorry for my bad Spanish! 😄

Wander the barman was excellent at the bar between Sal & Tomieku. He made the best cocktails. Really nice guy who you could have a laugh and joke with.

Overall, we really enjoyed our trip and would definitely come again!

reviews.title: Absolutely wonderful experience and place to vacation

From the moment we arrived we were provided first class customer service by the staff, especially our personal concierage, Edgar Rodriguez.  The Palma Real is an all inclusive resort that is breathtakenly beautiful, the service by all the staff friendly and attentive, the beach and pool area beautiful, the food and restaurants great, the bars were convenient and well stocked and the 24hr free room service was awesome. Our room was clean, and comfortable, although we spent most of our time walking the beach, swimming and enjoying our personal cabana. We loved our stay so much we have booked another week stay in January 2023. What a great getaway from the cold and dreariness of Ohio.

reviews.author: GpsPat
reviews.title: Un Paradis dans jardin tropical
reviews.text:
Notre avis se base sur une réservation directe avec le call-center MELIA suite à des précédents séjours MELIA en France, Espagne, Portugal et Cap-Vert (voir mes avis précédents ;-)
Type Chambre : The RESERVE panoramic ocean view junior suite / Adult Only
1. Emplacement : 10/10
Directement sur la plage de Bavaro pour de longues balades, Nettoyage régulier des sargasses. Beaucoup de transat & d’ombre 
2. Accueil / Personnel : 10/10
Nous sommes arrivés en Taxi mais en même temps qu’un bus. Mais rapidement nous avons été accompagnés vers la réception salon dédié The Reserve. Check-In parfait et mise en relation immédiate avec notre concierge qui a pris en main la gestion des bagages et nous a accompagné à notre suite. Le lendemain visite guidée du complexe 
3. Chambre : 09/10
Vue sur la mer & piscine the Reserve, à notre grande surprise le bâtiment central est tres calme calme, Equipement irréprochable, Terrasse pour profiter lever de soleil. Préparation exemplaire tous les jours. Frigo & snack rechargé au quotidien. Dans cette zone chambres récentes donc mobilier neufs & design modern. Pour les européens, prévoir 1 adaptateur prise US car une seule prise fiche Europe. (que des prises US dans la salle de bain). 
4. Petit-déjeuner : 10/10 Service à table au restaurant exclusif PALAZIO
Bon choix et produits frais et de qualité supérieure. 
5. Restaurants Soir
Réservation obligatoire. Notre concierge a su nous trouver une place pour chaque diner
Notre TOP :
- CIELO Mexicain un sans-faute grâce au service de ADRIEL PEREZ et la supervision du manager du restaurant JOSE BATISTA
- BRISAS : cuisine fusion japonaise/Péruvienne emplacement face à la mer et ventilé
- PALAZIO : cuisine raffiné : par exemple   le steak de thon rouge un délice 
Le FLOP
- SAL Steack House : Bruyant, service long, non maitrise de la cuisson. Et le T-bone facturé
en supplément 6. Bars
Le TOP : bar BRISAS c’est le seul bar ou tous les cocktails sont 100% frais, fruits mixés et boissons premium. MIGUEL le Barman nous a fait découvrir chaque soir une de ses créations.
FLOP : Bar de la piscine The Reserve Adult/Only : Service minimum & cocktail industriel dilué. 
Meilleur service et qualité au bar de la piscine standard ou piscine the Reserve. 
7. Plage exclusive The reserve/Adult Only
PEDRO le plagiste était aux petits soins pour nous trouver une place et généreux avec les serviettes de plage.
8. Mesure COVID 10/10
A savoir en République Dominicaine plus de mesures, mais Melia maintient les protocoles.
Tout le personnel avec un masque, gel disponible dans les parties communes. 

Nous avons passé 12 jours loin des tensions en Europe; Le séjour a été parfait grâce à 3 personnesclés :
Nathanael Montilla : le meilleur des concierges
Pedro : le plagiste pour vous préparer une journée sur la plage
Miguel : Au bar du Brisas et non fameux cocktail ''No Name''

Seul bémol la forte présence des "spring break américains" les 3 derniers jours du séjour …. Heureusement pas de bruit dans notre bâtiment la nuit ;-)

reviews.author: nataliaalejoo
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text:
Aún no podemos superar los maravillosos días que vivimos en el hotel ya que brindan un gran servicios en todas las áreas del lugar. 
Queremos primeramente felicitar al staff de animación quienes día a día alegraron nuestra estadía especialmente a Reynaldo Monegro, Pedro Inocencio, Jairo Cepeda y Darlin Baéz 
Tambien resaltar el servicio tanto en los bares Avenue bar donde Altagracia, Antonio y Doris nos han atendido siempre muy bien y en Lobby bar resaltar el labor de Lucia, complaciendo todo lo solicitado. 
Agradecer la atención en la barra de la pileta a Jesus, Miguel y Victor... las mejores cheese burger las hace Benton!!! un 10 para él! 
Las noches las cerrabamos en el casino donde  Aneuris, Susy, Hansell y Eleno siempre nos recibían muy bien.

Hemos querido resaltar a parte del staff que hoy conforma y si bien nos hemos olvidado de muchos nombres nos parece super valioso que ustedes lo sepan... Es lindo sentirse "como en casa" ya que todos son personas muy cálidas y agradables.
Por último y como crítica constructiva deberían modificar el tema de las reservas a los restaurantes por las noches, ya que muchas veces se torna difícil poder conseguir una reserva.
 
Ojalá podamos volver nuevamente a Palma Real, siempre a la altura de la cadena Meliá!
Muchas gracias por todo!! 
Saludos desde Arg.

reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Reserve Upgrade
reviews.text: Let me start by saying the Dominican Republic is amazing! We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real. Upon arriving I asked about the upgrade to Reserve status and we decided to do it! With him just a text or call away on WhatsApp I didn’t have to worry about a thing. He made all of our restaurant reservations, took care of some excursion issues, and helped answer a ton of questions. He came by to see us wherever we were hanging out and was just an all around good guy. We had a few issues our first day but he fixed everything within a few hours of his service and we never looked back. One of the best trips we’ve done and Simeon made it all the better. We will be back. 💜💜
