reviews.text: Estoy encantado con el servicio de éste hotel en general y destacar el buen servicio del bard avenue, y felicitar a Doris es una exelente camarera todos quedamos encantado con ella y sus compañeros del bard

reviews.author: Natassia
reviews.title: Bar Gabi Beach
reviews.text: Hotel Paradisus Palama Real - Ruby Vallejo es una excelente camarera. Sus colegas de trabajo tambien nos servió muy bien. Muchas gracias por todo. 🥰 Siempre con mucho humor. Recomendaremos venir aqui.

reviews.author: Melissa K
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Paradisus palma
reviews.text: We travelled from Canada for 6 days. We had an amazing experience at this resort. Everything was perfect. Food, housekeeping, bars, pools, gardens. Staff at the buffet and resuturants are very nice. The night music and bands are so good and very different with other resort I have been in south before. Thank you Alba, Atrahracia, Edwin, Adriel, Jose. I’ll definitely come back 🙏😍

reviews.author: Trek186048
reviews.title: dinner
reviews.text: great place! Had an awesome time. Food was good and so were the people! Abraham and yuleisy were awesome and  so accomadating! had a great dinner. would recommend to come here anytime. chocolate cake was delish.

reviews.author: Trish333
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing!! I had an issue and they were very prompt to assist me and follow up! Night shows were great! Staff was super friendly especially Yiri, Altagracia, Luis and Antonio from Avenue Bar. If you have any issues you would want have Delbis from guest service and Andres (manager) by your side! I am beyond thankful for them!! My stay was amazing and they for sure made it better! Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: horaciorosales
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excelente atención de Ulises. Muy buen menu, buena atención. 
El lugar es muy cómodo, la atención personalizada y una excelente lista de vinos para poder seleccionar. 
Recomendamos este lugar tanto por la comida como por la atención

reviews.author: Katie N
reviews.title: Absolutely delicious!
reviews.text: Wonderful selection of seafood, as well as beef and chicken plates. I got the chicken canga, which was so flavorful. AB, aka Abraham, who is the manager, was delightful! Highly recommend at Paradisus!

reviews.author: hanly83
reviews.title: Engagement vacay
reviews.text: Excellent service. We loved visiting our favorite resort at Paradisus Palma Real. The lobby bar staff were attentive and friendly. Edison is one of the best mixologist ever. He makes extraordinary cocktails with lovely decorations. He is one of the reasons we love returning to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Erik S
reviews.title: Palma real
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Palma real. We had the best experience with Edison. He treated us unique drinks that were really delicious. He is a great person to talked to and funny. The treatment for all employees were great. Rooms were well kept and food did not disappoint.

reviews.author: ANDREW V
reviews.title: Paradises The Reserves
reviews.text: Awesome trip with awesome staff. Irvin did a fantastic job and every other staff was all so helpful. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience in Punta Cana. The whole resort was amazing and beautiful. Thanks again. We will be back!

reviews.author: Alyssa H
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Spent a 6 day family vacation here at The Reserve. The staff were professional and friendly. We loved our bartenders Gustavo, Quintino, and Darwin. Made tasty drinks and had fast/proficient service when ordering at the bar. Would definitely book again if we ever come back to Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: Cecilia H
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Our host Irvin did such a good job accommodating our large family with dinner reservations. Our favorite bartenders during our stay were Darwin and Gustavo. They were all super friendly and nice. The reserve is quiet and peaceful but if you want more of the night life scene, the other side is just a golf cart ride down the street. Overall a beautiful resort. Would recommend to family and friends and definitely come back.

reviews.author: Marissa G
reviews.title: H20 Bar - Johanna
reviews.text: Amazing experience at H20 Bar!! Johanna made our experience incredible. She also makes the best specialty cocktails, especially espresso martinis! Make sure to stop at this bar and give her a visit :)

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Restaurante Sal
reviews.text:
Muy buena comida, servicio de 10. Espacio entre mesas.
El sr Leuri nos atendió súper bien. Ya hemos cenado dos veces y volveremos a repetir. Por el trato y sobretodo por la buena comida, la carne hecha correctamente.

reviews.author: Aleatha Parrish
reviews.title: Paradise Enchanting beautiful
reviews.text: Samual our concierge was amazing..He went out of his way to make sure my birthday and our anniversary plans went smooth. He was very pleasant and easy to talk to…Samual called periodically to check in on my husband and I..If you are staying in Paradisus Palma Real ask for Samual he is the best.

reviews.author: Alba
reviews.title: Sin duda, el paraíso
reviews.text:
No podemos decir nada malo de nuestra estancia en el hotel.

Destacamos el personal, atento y amable, pendiente del detalle en todo momento. La comida, variada y con mucha calidad. Las instalaciones, cuidadas al detalle…

Pero sobre todo, la calidad humana.
Gracias Zenovia, por hacer que nuestra experiencia haya sido, aún si cabe, mucho mejor. Eres maravillosa. ♥️
Mayte y Adriane, cuidáis cada detalle y nos habéis hecho sentir en casa. Bueno no, mejor! 😄
Pedro, en la playa. Eres genial! 

No podríamos haber elegido mejor!
Volveremos!

reviews.author: Callum V
reviews.title: Great Family Getaway
reviews.text:
Staff was incredible our concierge (Reyna) is a 12 out of 10, i can’t say enough good things about her, she is the best!
Special shout out to Raul(mi amigo) at the pool side bar and his colleagues are fantastic. 
The hotel and restaurants are great, did not have one bad meal (Sals was amazing) Rooms are clean. Room service was great, a beautiful resort. 

We loved it and are already planning our trip next year.

reviews.author: Lisa Z
reviews.title: Cielo
reviews.text:
Just finished an amazing dinner at Cielo, thank you Glennys villavicencio, manager Battista and Chef Javier for making it so special!! 

La Hostess Jafreisy Lopez is beautiful and has such a special personality!!!

reviews.author: Fernando V
reviews.title: Recomendado 100%! Muy buena experiencia 👌
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio !!! Nos encanto  venir para acá!!! Muchas gracias también a Rosanny paniagua!! Excelente servicio, muy atenta, amable y preocupada por cada detalle ! La mejor !  Muchas gracias por todo! Recomendamos 100% este hotel
Fue nuestra primera visita y fue espectacular !

reviews.author: Nathaly T
reviews.title: El mejor servicio
reviews.text: estuvimos la semana pasada en este hotel, es la primera vez que voy pero me encanto todo, desde el checkin hasta la salida, todo fue genial, resaltar las excelentes atenciones de Eladio quien nos atendio como Reyes en el restaurante Naos. Espero regresar pronto!!!

reviews.author: Shailey P
reviews.title: Food review
reviews.text:
Ask for Chef Wilkin Tapia for sure!
He is very accommodating and overall is an amazing chef 
Very welcoming and amazing 
Great experience 
He helped us custom some of the food choices and was always ready to help!

reviews.author: Covadonga Miguel
reviews.title: Un mexicano exquisito
reviews.text: Estando hospedadas en el hotel Melia Paradisus Palma Real en Punta Cana, el cual es espectacular, perfecto para todo tipo de vacaciones y en el que la gente es súper agradable, pudimos probar el nuevo restaurante de cocina mexicana llamado Cielo. Uno de los mejores restaurantes del hotel en los que comí, y además una atención excelente de Glendys, Alexander Santos y el encargado Jose Batista. Mis felicitaciones al chef y a todo el equipo. Si venís reservar para cenar sin duda alguna. Desde luego unas vacaciones a todo lujo y totalmente recomendables.

reviews.author: Therese J
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text:
I can just find one word and thats WOW.
What a beautiful hotel and location. I really loved to stay in this hotel. I was there for 2 weeks with my famaly, and we Would definitely go back.. we are already talk about our next trip. 

And the service in the restaurant Brisas where we get really good service and get taken care of properly by Eladio minier.
 I would really recommend this hotel to everyone that plans to go to the Dominican.🌴🌴🌴

reviews.author: Juan de Jesús D
reviews.title: The best hotel in the world 🤗🌎
reviews.text: my family and I have had the best vacation I really loved the stay we were for 3 sem Ana and it was a great experience the food and drinks are the best the service is super good thanks eladio minier from Naos buffet for the good attentions you made us feel like home from the first day we met I hope that when we return we will meet again. The shows are super, the beach is great This hotel I recommend will not be remedied! 🤗...

reviews.author: Alejandro L
reviews.title: Restó Óleo en Paradisus Palma Real golf & spa.
reviews.text:
Muy linda cena en óleo, excelente atención de Jessica, un servicio de alta calidad
Nuestra primera noche en esta temporada arrancó muy bien, es grato sentirse tan bien recibido, veremos como sigue en los próximos dias

reviews.author: Caroline B
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text: 5 stars for Thomas good service. We loved the restaurant and the food thank you so much! Let us sit down and have us drinks and we're very nice to me and all of my friends. Not really sure what else to write!

reviews.author: Shane P
reviews.title: Kanye
reviews.text: Victor sanchez is the best!!! Give this man a raise!!!! Service was incredible, everyone was very nice. Beach and pool were amazing and the drinks were fantastic! 10/10 would recommend for college spring breakers

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Victor Sanchez is the GOAT. Great service, great laughs with even better friends. I had a lot of fun on this trip and will definitely recommend this hotel to my friends and family. I hope I can come back

reviews.author: Sandra P
reviews.title: Excelente servicio en Naos
reviews.text: El servicio recibido en nuestro primer día ya marco la diferencia, excelente de parte de Maria Ortiz, Hilda, Rohander, Yendry y Gregorin, nos sentimos muy bien recibidos y su servicio profesional han hecho la diferencia. Gracias muchachos

reviews.author: Nate
reviews.title: Traveler
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Palma Real back in February and had an amazing time with our family of 4.
We stayed at the Reserve. If you have children, this place is great! 
Our personal concierge, Jose was so helpful in every way. He booked any restaurants and activities we wanted to attend. He went above and beyond the call of duty to fulfill our needs. 
Emmanuelle and the kidzone staff were so good with our 8 and 5 year old. They had different activities planned every day. Our kids loved it!
The wait staff go out of there way to please you. Leonardo is the best!

We'll definitely be returning to this beautiful resort in the future. 
Highly recommended!

Nate

reviews.author: Juan S
reviews.title: Paddle surf
reviews.text: Excellent experience for our 10 year old son. The staff, Axel and Leonardo, is extremely friendly and engaging. My son enjoyed the paddle surf activity with other kids. The activity in the pool is safe for beginners.

reviews.author: Christopher S
reviews.title: Chef Wilkin is amazing
reviews.text:
The chef at the restaurant (Wilkin Tapia) made our trip very special by cooking food for my family that we had requested even though it wasn’t on the menu.  The food was amazing 5/5! The food was amazing and tasted great. This was one of the highlights of our trip

Gracias Wilkin

reviews.author: Beatriz J
reviews.title: Palazzo restaurante
reviews.text: Palazzo restaurant for “adults only” has a great ambiance, excellency gourmet food. The service is impecable and very friendly from the receptionist Annie to the servers, Edito, Frank, Georgi, Gustavo, Luz, Franklin, and Juan in charge of the buffet, always ready to satisfy your demands. We will miss them all. Hope to be back soon….

reviews.author: Caleb C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Great bar. Great resort with a very friendly staff. They will treat you well! The rooms are very clean and the staff is very nice. The Avenue bar is the best one in the resort and they will hook you up. Find Luis Rosario, Altagracia, Daniel, and Luis Morel in the Avenue bar and they will treat you right. Overall, a great vacation and great experience.

reviews.author: Mirelis B
reviews.title: Lo mejor de todo RD
reviews.text: Me encantó la comida del buffer naos muy rica mucha variedad sobre todo, buen servicio departe del de parte de Eladio excelente trato regresaría una vez más al hotel mucha calidad humana de su parte tenía ganas de un sumo natural de limón y me lo hizo posible hay mucha empatía en él personal las áreas muy limpias habitaciones impecables lo ame y a mi esposo ni se diga totalmente complacida!!

reviews.author: Aris
reviews.title: Un paraíso
reviews.text: Gracias a todo el personal de paradisus fue maravilloso 👏 visitar ese lugar tan bello la comida deliciosa 😋 y el personal muy agradable eladio nos dio un servicio excelente 👌 más la habitación súper limpia gracia por su buen servicio!!!

reviews.author: Nenad
reviews.title: Nice place; Friendly staff; Gusts could do better
reviews.text:
Place is great to visit.
Staff are very nice and friendly. The only problem we’ve had, has nothing to do with the resort but the visitors. Some staff members were treated poorly by the guests and that was hard to witness. 
Our concierge Irvin was responsive and helped us with any request we had. Would suggest eating breakfast and lunch at Palazzo (if you have access to it). Frankie Feliz, a staff member there, is a very friendly guy.

reviews.author: nduncan8
reviews.title: The staff makes the stay.
reviews.text:
I was skeptical of how people rave about all-inclusive resorts but I was pleasantly surprised by the hospitality of all the staff. Notable staff were Luis Desa at the lobby bar and Jose Ramos, the manager of Olio. 

I was so sad to leave. Not because of the beach or the sun, but because of the genuine people that we had gotten to know.

reviews.author: Anisia M
reviews.title: Spectacularness !!!!
reviews.text:
Everything at this resort was beyond 5 stars. From
the friendly staff and service to the amazing food. 

We are big foodies and every restaurant we dined at including the buffet was consistently on point and delicious. It’s typical that resort  buffet food is nothing to brag about. This was everything to brag about , fresh exotic fruits and juices, grilled steak, Dominican style food that tastes homemade. 

There is something for everyone, families and couples.  The beach had little to no seaweed, water crystal clear and warm.  The pools had nice areas to relax under shade with tiled beds to lay on. 

There was nighttime entertainment and the resort is huge, you can walk around and never get bored.

However the best part of this hotel besides the good is the view of the oven from the moment you enter.

I  can pretty much write a book about this resort on how much the entire experience exceeded our expectations. We will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Darlene H
reviews.title: Great trip with group!
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with a large group last week.  There were 16 of us total and we all had a great time.  Our concierge was Nikolas and he was amazing!!  He took care of all of us even though he was not the concierge for the entire group.  He made a point to check on us daily making sure everyone's needs were met.  When I needed a bathrobe or wash cloth all I had to do was tell Nikolas and the next time we were in the room, they were there.  He was able to get us in restaurants most nights.  He also booked our excursions for us.  We enjoyed his jokes and special attention.  He is very good at what he does and the Paradisus is lucky to have him.  
The restaurant, The Winery, was very nice but you need to purchase a bottle of wine to go.  Not a problem, as we were told that ahead of time.  Great food at all the restaurants.  The buffet was plentiful with many options for all nationalities.  It was required to wear a mask in the buffet still but that I appreciated.
Our room was huge!  We had an Ocean front Junior Suite at the Reserve and the view was beautiful.  On our last night we came into a beautiful bath drawn with chocolates!  
My husband and I took advantage of the Spa and enjoyed a couples massage.  The spa was so calming.  
The adult pool and private bar was a great place to hang for the day.  Wanda, the bartender, worked very hard while our group was there.  Ha, Ha!  Our large group for most would have been tough to handle but she rocked it!  She never stopped moving and always worked hard!
Covid test process was seamless!
This resort is gorgeous in the day and night.  We would definitely stay at this resort again! 
Geno and Darlene

reviews.author: Mandi W
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent a week at this resort to celebrate our 10 year anniversary.  We had a fabulous trip!  The weather was absolutely beautiful, and we spent the majority of our trip lounging in the cabanas at the beach and pool...the entire property is beautiful!  We stayed in the Reserve Oceanfront suite and had a stunning view from our balcony.
Our butler, Nicholas, greeted us upon arrival and helped us get settled.  He took care of all of our dinner reservations, spa reservations, excursion reservations, and he went above and beyond to make our anniversary special!  He even surprised us with  the most delicious coconut creme cake that was delivered to the restaurant that we ate at on our actual anniversary.  I can't say enough good things about his service.  
Also, we visited Miguel at the Brisas bar just about every evening after dinner.  He was the absolute best bar tender and made the most delicious drinks for us (pineapple mojitos, passion fruit cocktails, and variety of different gin cocktails that my husband loved)!  If you visit this resort, you must stop at the Brisas bar for a cocktail made by Miguel. 
We enjoyed all the restaurants we ate at, with Tokemiku, Sal, and Winery being our top favorites.  The buffet at breakfast and lunch also had a huge selection! 
I would not hesitate to book a trip here again, and we look forward to returning in the future!

reviews.author: The McCabe F
reviews.title: Cielo restaurant
reviews.text:
Todays service was amazing … Jose Baptiste is a great manager… so great and great service. 

The food was the best at this resort… such a great experience 

Lissette is so great … deliver all our food and drinks accurately ❤️

reviews.author: Melissa G
reviews.title: Punta Cana dinner
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my dinner. I came to the restaurant with a group of nine other people. I had the vegetarian toast, the vegetable stew and the vegetarian meatballs. We had prompt and friendly service with Lissette Montilla. The manager Jose Batista checked on us frequently to make sure everything was to our liking. The chef was Francis Javier and another server that helped us was Adriel Perez. They all did a great job! I highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Muy recomendado Restaurante Sal
reviews.text:
Decidimos cambiar la comida en el buffet del hotel y probar algo diferente y optamos por probar el Restaurante Sal dentro del hotel y la comida fue excelente. 
Pedimos de entrante los camarones, la provoleta y el carpaccio: todos riquísimos y muy recomendable.
Pero sin duda lo mejor el plato principal: pedimos dos picanhas que estaban buenísimas.
El corte de la Carme y el punto de cocción eran excelentes ( todo a cargo del chef Orlando el cual fue muy atento explicándonos la preparación de los platos)
Recomendadisimo ir Al restaurante sal si van al Melia beach resort en punta cana

reviews.author: Gonzalo B
reviews.title: Increíble experiencia
reviews.text: Los trabajadores son más majos que las pesetas. Todo muy rico. El entorno es único. Repetiría sin ninguna duda. Joel Valdez, del bar Gaby, es un profesional sin parangón, igual que Luis, del bar del Lobby. Marisol deja más que desear, todo hay que decirlo.

reviews.author: Vince D
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
FANTASTIC VACATION !….
Eliezer Sanchez 
Ha attended to our needs, I love the place and would highly recommend Sol Melia 
I ‘am looking forward for the next vacation. 
Thank you for everything 
Vince DeRentiis

reviews.author: Eag23
reviews.title: Ya quiero regresar!!
reviews.text:
Reservé en PPRL para celebrar mi cumpleaños y pasar un buen rato con familia y amigos, gratamente, resultó en una experiencia inolvidable desde antes de llegar. Estamos muy agradecidos con las consideraciones de Genaro Gil con las habitaciones y gestión en general, con el check in vip con Daniel, Katherine (la sonrisa más bonita de la recepción) y Angeli. Me sentí privilegiada de tener al mejor mayordomo que he conocido Starling Tavarez, que genuinamente se preocupó por cada detalle de mi celebración y mis reservas. 
En el restaurante Gaby, en THR mi querido Santos que supera todas las expectativas de servicio, los maleteros Omar Hasbun y Francisco Williams destacados por su proactividad. Resaltando el masaje del spa con las terapeutas Karina y Eliana que brindaron un servicio de lujo. 
En conclusión, espero regresar pronto y seguir viendo esos rostros alegres y esas personas maravillosas que caracterizan este hotel. No fuera lo mismo sin ellos.

reviews.author: Christine M
reviews.title: Lobby bar- don’t miss!
reviews.text: Antonio and the staff at the lobby bar were fantastic! We were greeted warmly upon arrival and treated so very well all week long. The best cappuccino at the resort and creative and delicious cocktails. We will miss our new friends on staff at the Paradisis, hope to be back again soon. :)

reviews.author: Taty
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: It was our first time staying at the Melia Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa resort. We liked absolutely everything - the resort is beautiful and clean, food and service is outstanding! The concierge service provided by Leonela Calderón was excellent and exclusive- from the restaurant reservations to any possible questions and requests we had, she was always available and helped us immediately! All staff is extremely friendly. We had absolutely awesome experience and would definitely come back! We would like to thank all staff for making our vacation the best!

reviews.author: Marcos Veloso
reviews.title: Cielo Restaurant
reviews.text: Tonight I had an amazing night in this Restaurant, Jose Batista, Silvania Pérez, Adriel Pérez and Alexander Santos made us feel really great and laught a lot. The place is amazing, The food was really good too.

reviews.author: sara00fantastic
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real & Oilo
reviews.text: Olio restaurant was delicious. Our experience was made so much better by Jose Ramos and Bernabe. We ordered just about everything on the menu and enjoyed it all! We’re about to enjoy all of the desserts and call it a night. Thank you to the resort, to our concierge Anayely, and all of the lovely people we’ve met along the way.

reviews.author: Maria c
reviews.title: Vacaciones en palma real
reviews.text: Encantada 3era vez con este hotel y cada vez supera mis expectativa quiero agradecer de manera especial la attention de eliezer Sanchez y starlin Tavares quienes estubieron trabajando directly con nosotras y se encargaron de que tuvieramos un estadia super relajada sin lugar a duda recommended y volvere esta es mi segunda casa gracias a todo el equipo que saca Adelante el servicio super Estrellas todos

reviews.author: Masiel Jiménez
reviews.title: My vacations
reviews.text: beautiful hotel, excellent quality, very good variety of menu, a cozy atmosphere, it met my expectations, but what I liked the most was the service of the palazzo restaurant, thanks to the waiter Gustavo Vásquez for making my vacation extraordinary, I recommend it to any person who goes and asks that excellent waiter attend to him, and make him feel at home, being this very professional, thank you very much Gustavo Vásquez and the paradisus hotel for making my vacations the best.

reviews.author: pcbound09
reviews.title: Beautiful Property! Great Time!
reviews.text:
Had a great time with my family at Paradisus Palma Real. Most of the staff are friendly and helpful. Our concierge Edgar was great and helped with all of our requests. My favorite people of all were Luis at the swim up bar and Wonder at the restaurant bar who have an awesome attitude, always greeted me with a big smile and went the extra mile to make a unique tropical drink when asked. Gracias Amigos!
Rosa at the hostess stand was great as well getting us into the restaurants without reservations! 
Also want to thank the gardeners who were always there with a fresh coconut and keep the entire property looking great! Can’t forget the pool  attendants, maids and buffet servers who work tirelessly. 
Some of the restaurants could use some better food quality control with regard to serving consistently lukewarm food. Also think they need to work on some of the menus for better and more expanded options. Honestly an authentic Dominican restaurant would be better than the Italian or Mediterranean place. Let the people who work there cook the food they’ve been cooking and eating their whole lives!
Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Christian Barrera A
reviews.title: Restaurante "Cielo", el paraíso en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Restaurante "Cielo". Efectivamente es como estar en el mismísimo paraíso. Sin perjuicio de que la comida mexicana podría parecer monótona, clásica o aburrida, la carta es bastante innovadora y los platos reveladores. Una experiencia más que recomendada para salir de la rutina de los sabores cotidianos. Todo acompañado de la mejor atención de todo el hotel y también de varios otros hoteles. Sugiero probar la entrada de pulpo y el ceviche y de fondo la entraña (carne de res). No olvidar las margaritas. Hacerse atender exclusivamente por José Batista y Adriel Pérez (cualquier otra elección asumala bajo su propio riesgo).

Respecto de la atención general del hotel, le doy 5 puntos de 10.- A "Cielo", 10 de 10.-

reviews.author: Jimena F
reviews.title: Una increíble experiencia
reviews.text: Me encuentro en punta cana en el hotel Paradisus y hemos venido mi familia y yo al restaurante Cielo… INCREÍBLE!! Desde que entras te reciben de la mejor manera y la atención A1. Recomendadisimo!!!! Gracias a José Batista Manager, Glenys Villavicencio, Adriel Perez, Virtudes Mercedes, Alexander santos y a Carlos Lorenzo por el increíble momento.

reviews.author: Matias Flores
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Una especial felicitación a José Batista Manager, Glenys Villavicencio, Adriel Perez, Virtudes Mercedes, Alexander santos y Carlos Lorenzo. Excelente servicio en el restaurante Cielo del hotel Paradisus.

reviews.author: Sibela R
reviews.title: Best Birthday Celebration!!
reviews.text:
My partner and I were excited to get away for my 30th birthday celebration. Couldn’t be happier with our choice!The resort is beautiful with plenty restaurants, bars, and pools! During the day there are a lot of activities like pool Zumba etc and during the night you can either enjoy a cocktail by the terrace or dance at the night club or play casino!! 

 -We want to give a Huge shout out to our butler Nicolas Maracallo- he made our stay and my birthday very special! He went out of his way to set up a beautiful surprise in our room (see picture), a wonderful birthday dinner and he also made great recommendations for the rest of the nights. One of our top favorite restaurants is the wine bar. 100% recommended! 
 If you have a celebration and you want to make it special request Nicolas! 

Stuff was very professional, hospitable and warm. 

We will definitely be back 🤗🤗🤗

reviews.author: koukla69
reviews.title: Friend vacation
reviews.text: Virtudes went above and beyond my expectations we asked her to order for us as if we were visiting her in her home and we ate every last bit the service was unbelievable and I can be on our expectations we highly recommend Cielo at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana even the manager came up to visit us Jose to make sure everything was up to par

reviews.author: Titanick
reviews.title: Excellent resort ! Du service 5 étoiles 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.text:
- Service EXEMPLAIRE  à tous les bars et aux restaurants.  
- Personnel très courtois et à l’écoute de nos besoins. 
- Nourriture très bonne  (buffets et plusieurs resto la carte).
- site très propre et plusieurs chaises à disposition en tout temps. Grand site ! 
- 👌mention spéciale à Leonardo qui offre un service chaleureux et personnalisé ! 
- 👌Mention spéciale à Irvin au service de conciergerie qui nous a tout organisé ce qu’on avait besoin !

reviews.author: Alfredo L
reviews.title: Cena mexicano
reviews.text: Un trato perfecto , buena comida y atención muy profesional, si encargado nos trató de lujo, repetiremos y seguro que en el mismo sitio, esperemos que sea pronto y podamos volver a disfrutar del servicio

reviews.author: Elizabeth D
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I went here for winter break vacation with my son.  Called ahead of time and Lexington from guest services was very helpful.  The place is beautiful, our room was located conveniently near the beach. I was able to book all our dinner reservations at the restaurants on the following day upon arrival.  Get there by 10 am or you will have to wait on line. (this took about an hour, but got all our nights reserved)  The food was very good.   Every night, we were surprised with  some new entertainment only to be amazed by.   We booked lots of things to do each day with Roberto Silvestre who handles all this at the resort.  Everything was well worth it! I want to give special thank you for the wonderful service provided by Wander the barman at Sal restaurant and Aberson from the evening services by the beach who both went above and beyond! Everyone was extremely nice and it was a wonderful time. Hope to visit again!

reviews.author: Vicente F
reviews.title: Una grata sorpresa!!
reviews.text: Tuvimos un viaje familiar y nos dimos con la sorpresa con este restaurante mexicano Cielo. Excelente comida y servicio. Una súper atención del equipo: Adriel Pérez, Glenys Villavicencio, Adriel Perez , Virtudes Mercedes , Alexander Santos y Carlos Lorenzo, muy bien dirigidos por el manager José Batista. A1, gran equipo!!

reviews.author: Eric D
reviews.title: Amazing dinner at Ceilo
reviews.text: Our dinner was perfect! I came here w my girlfriend and the service was amazing we had the tacos al pastor and golden chicken and octopus toast appetizers  which were very tasty! along w the chicken enchiladas and fish for main course! Jose Bautista was the main chef and manager and he personally came over to our table to ensure that we were having the most amazing experience. They even made a custom skinny Margarita for me and my girlfriend per our request. Cant recommend this place enough 100/10!! Mui bien!!

reviews.author: Quest20360803935
reviews.title: Such sweet people and phenomenal service!
reviews.text: All in all we have enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Palma Real. The beaches are gorgeous and they truly try to keep the beaches as clean as possible! One of our nightly routines have been us stopping by the Gabi Beach Lounge to see Cauri Herrera because she is on point and one of the sweetest people we have met! Also, Reynaldo Monegra who does the entertainment is Amazing as well!!! Definitely been very pleased!!!

reviews.author: Fabian H
reviews.title: Palma Real Restaurante Cielo
reviews.text: La comida es buenísima, la carne de muy buena calidad, no me lo esperaba! El personal excelente, Virtudes, Mercedes y José batista nos atendieron de maravilla. Muy recomendable! La mejor comida mexicana que he probado!

reviews.author: JanR
reviews.title: Service was outstanding
reviews.text: My sister , mom and I took our annual girls trip this year to the Paradisus Palma Real.  Traveling with an elderly person can be difficult but Emily Moran at the front desk was an unbelievable source of help and comfort ( even though we were reserve guests). She went above and beyond- as did our butler Wily Mercado..  We could not have gotten a better butler ; he assisted , was patient , kind and such a pleasure to be around. Thank you for the wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Z S
reviews.title: Great food
reviews.text: The service and the food were fantastic. The steak and appetizers were worth ordering. My wife loved the deserts and tried all three.We will definitely try again when we are at Paradisus in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Venture793629
reviews.title: First time in DR
reviews.text:
Had such a great time at the reserve paradisus grand real. Room was ocean front and can’t recommend it enough! The staff were amazing esp wander at the bar (she makes the best cocktails) and Ronaldo aka GPS always on a vibe check. He kept us entertained throughout and kept the vibe going all week long. Thanks guys ! 

Will be returning!

reviews.author: Anna Y
reviews.title: Wedding review
reviews.text: I recently got married at Paradisus. It was very overwhelming planning your wedding strictly through e-mail but it all worked out so wonderfully and beautifully. My coordinator was Gissel Ramirez and she was so thoughtful and thorough. She put me at ease every step of the way and even had a few surprises up her sleeve to make sure my husband and I and our families felt really special. If you choose to get married here I highly highly suggest requesting Gissel as your coordinator!!

reviews.author: Monika K
reviews.title: Positive Visible Changes
reviews.text:
We have been coming to the resort for the past 10 years, and I must say we were positively surprised by the changes we have seen this time. We travelled during the Christmas/NYE holidays and stayed until mid January 2022. In 2018 the hotel started to downgrade a little bit, but this year we have seen changes bringing the hotel back to what it was before. We saw an improvement on every step; the food and drinks quality, the service and hospitality ect.. After these holidays, we can again recommend this resort for those regulars who decided to never come back. The new management has really lifted the hotel, and as the current hotel director and guest experience manager told us...better changes are continuously on the way. 
Monika Karnowska

reviews.author: mariana t
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real- Gabi Beach
reviews.text: Serviço excelente, inclusive o do Bar Gabi Beach, fomos atendido pela Arisleida Pérez, muito atenciosa e querida, bebidas excelentes e de qualidade com uma vista maravilhosa, ambiente muito agradável!

reviews.author: João Vitor Taguti
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Gabi Beach Bar. Fomos atendidos pela Arisleida Pérez, que nos proporcionou uma experiência excelente! Muito simpática e atenciosa. O bar é muito bonito com uma bela vista da praia, mas com toda a certeza o ponto alto foi o atendimento, nota 10!

reviews.author: Melissa T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Atendente Arisleida Pérez muito solícita e simpática, atendimento rápido e completo, drinks muito bem feitos, fez tudo para nos proporcionar a melhor experiência possível em nossa estadia. Voltaremos mais vezes!

reviews.author: Lidia Morales
reviews.title: Excelente Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: El hotel es excelente, y el personal insuperable. Los restaurantes dentro del Resort tienen una calidad excepcional, por primera vez estuve en un tepanyaki dentro del restaurante Tokimeku, el cocinero Henry José se portó excepcional con nosotros, tuvimos una comida muy especial y él nos hizo la comida mejor todavía, no solo por su profesionalidad sino por su carisma también! Sin duda nos llevamos un muy buen recuerdo. Repetiremos!

reviews.author: Marie P
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text: Had an amazing time.  Everyone is so friendly and attentive.  Book your dinner times as soon as you get there to make sure you get the restaurants you want.  The beach is gorgeous and the sand is pristine.  Will definitely make our way back here. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Ricardo Ünger
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
5 stars all the way. The room, the service, the gorgeous beaches.

Bernardino my personal concierge was above and beyond and always took care of all my needs.

Food was great and Wanda at the beach bar on the reserve side was wonderful as well.

Everything was perfect and again could not be more grateful for Bernardino. Made the trip wonderful for us.

reviews.author: Livia G
reviews.title: The Paradisus Palma Real Resort at Punta Cana
reviews.text: It’s a great looking hotel with a luxurious lobby area, a lot of opportunities to do, great food, wonderful beach and a great staff, especially Delgis Castillo, who helped us a great deal, gave us all the necessary information and made us feel like at home.

reviews.author: Michael O
reviews.title: Great experience in tropical paradise
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real when our friends got married. Great atmosphere and environment by the beach. Wonderful and friendly service for drinks and refreshments at the Gabi Beach Bar by Arisleisa Perez. Delicious coffee. Strong cocktails. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ferminvera
reviews.title: Excelente servicio y comida ñ
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio de Scarlin y Paola muy amables, serviciales y con excelente energía nos hicieron sentir en casa! 

La comida otro nivel muy recomendado yo me pedi la picanha terminó medio y estuvo fenomenal!

reviews.author: Standd1966
reviews.title: Dinner at Sal
reviews.text: Terrific food and service from Dionys.  Very enjoyable.  Made very welcome and very attentive service.  Had T bone which was cooked exactly as I requested.  Good quality cut and very well presented.  Happy to come back.

reviews.author: Patricio M
reviews.title: Excellent food, unbelievable service
reviews.text: Excellent food, unbelievable service, Abram was the best of the wonderful experience we had, thank you very much for all the details and time you gave us to my family. We are sure coming back next year

reviews.author: magiandjay
reviews.title: Sal restaurant @ Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Modern grill restaurant with an open kitchen and modern decor. Food cooked right and artistic plating of food. Excellent and attentive service by Dionys Ramírez. Staff very friendly. Noise level  could use some improvementt.

reviews.author: D Oliveira
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
The staff and resort are the best!  What makes this resort the best in the Caribbean is the dedicated employees who consistently go above and beyond to exceed your expectations.  I would like to particularly acknowledge and recognize the following individuals who rise to the challenge, no matter the circumstance.  Make no mistake, the resorts success is directly attributed to your continued commitment to excellence:

- Nicolas Maracallo (Reserve Butler)
- Pedro, Martin, Wanda, Francisco, Hansel (Reserve Beach/Pool staff)
- Delvin, Tojeilin Cuevas, Eduardo Aquino (Vento Restaurant)

Hope to see you all soon!

reviews.author: Angela R
reviews.title: Muy rico!
reviews.text: El ambiente del restaurante muy divertido, hace que todos en la mesa de integren y la comida muy rica. La cocinera fue Jessica y la mesera que nos atendió fue Jessica y son muy amables. Muy recomendado para ir en familia!!!

reviews.author: José Luis M
reviews.title: Fin de año involidable
reviews.text: Pasamos unos días geniales en familia en el hotel para fin de año después de tantas visitas, pero sobre todo esta vez de forma tan especial, después de los cierres debido a la pandemia. Esto es importante reseñarlo, ya que alcanzar el nivel de experiencia de cliente que hemos vivido con este contexto, demuestra todo el trabajo del personal que hay detrás. Hemos disfrutando del sol, la playa y las innumerables atenciones de todo el equipo de Paradisus. Gregory, Odeibi y todo el equipo de bares en The Reserve, no han cesado ni un minuto en tratar de agradar, complacer y resolver todo tipo de situaciones que se dan en fechas alta ocupación como las que fuimos. No importa si es en la playa o en las piscinas (que es donde prácticamente pasamos la mayor parte del tiempo) ellos siempre están ahí para hacer que todo funcione y fluya, haciendo la estancia tremendamente agradable.

reviews.author: ontheroxs
reviews.title: Mrs Paulino
reviews.text:
The service was amazing! Such a peaceful breakfast away from the crowds. & Food is delicious. 

Frank was our waiter almost every morning. He makes the best cappuccinos! He always had a second one ready as I was finishing my last sip.

Breakfast, lunch and dinner was always amazing at the Palazzo. We will miss the workers and their kindliness.

reviews.author: Juli O
reviews.title: Axel and Darlin are amazing
reviews.text: Axel and Darlin are the best! They are great at dancing and getting the crowd to join in! Very great with the kids! My nephew loved them! Can’t wait to come back for another vacation and see them again!

reviews.author: Amber W
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real  Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Ruby Vallejo, Miguel Solar and Yiri Sil Vestre at Gabi Beach was very welcoming and friendly. Best part of our trip was spending time with them, and their friendliness. We definitely recommend this resort with their amazing team.

reviews.author: LightPacker211179
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Great all around experience at the resort. Our bartender Wanda was wonderful and always served us delicious drinks with the biggest smile. Would definitely recommend and can’t wait until our next visit!

reviews.author: Diana Oliveira
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
Me and my family have been going to Paradisus Palma Real for 10 years. Nothing but good things to say about the staff and hotel. We went on vacation and stayed at the Reserve for 2 weeks. Nicolas Maracallo was our butler and he is AMAZING. Handled all of our reservations and was always there taking care of us. Love him!! 

Love Pedro, Martin, Hansel and Wanda. Always being very attentive and great with us. We sure miss them already. We also were very happy with Francisco who did a fabulous job with organizing the beach every evening. 

We went many nights to Vento. Great service and great food. Eduardo Aquino is a fabulous manager, Tojeilin Cuevas prepared the best food, and Delvin was the best server. So grateful for all of them. 

Can’t wait to go back!! Love this place and most importantly the people that work there.

reviews.author: Maite A
reviews.title: Unas fantásticas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Nuestras vacaciones fueron maravillosas gracias a todo el personal del hotel Paradisus Palma Real. Empezando por su amable y competente directora, Adriane, que nos atendió con mucha amabilidad y profesionalismo. También Natali, gerente de actividades nos ayudó y acogió amablemente y con una sonrisa permanente.
Las habitaciones son muy buenas, cómodas, espaciosas y limpias. La comida y bebida  deliciosa y de alto nivel. Las instalaciones muy acogedoras y  adecuadas para el descanso y la entretención. 
Las actividades para niños y adultos son variadas y entretenidas. Especial mención a Emanuel Ulloa del kidsdom y Kelvin Diaz de teens club, que con su entusiasmo y dedicación nos animaron a participar en variadas actividades, haciendo que mis niños disfrutaran un más sus vacaciones.
Muchas gracias  a la Directora del hotel, a la gerente de actividades y al resto del personal del hotel que nos ayudaron y atendieron amablemente, haciendo de esta experiencia un recuerdo inolvidable.

reviews.author: Milica L
reviews.title: Erstes Mal im Reserve.
reviews.text: Der Strand ist wunderschön😍 das Reserve ist sehr stilvoll und nicht so voll und laut wie das Palma. Das Familienzimmer ist gross mit einem grossen Balkon mit Jacuzzi. Das Buffetrestaurant war besser als die Spezialiitätenrestaurants. Am meisten mochten wir unsere Concierge Marinanyi. Sie hat sich bis am Schluss rührend um uns gekümmert mit kleinen Ueberraschungen für unsere Tochter(Jacuzzi mit Ballonen) Wir haben sie ins Herz geschlossen wegen ihrer herzluchen und professionellen Art.

reviews.author: Juan D
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay for my best friends wedding
reviews.text: I had a great time at the resort for my best friends wedding… food is okay but we all know resort food isn’t the best — we not there for that… the service is awesome and the staff is super friendly… if you hit the pool look for my man Jesus Evangelista he is on point and kept the drinks flowing all day non stop… without even needing to ask… rooms are nice I didn’t use the jacuzzi tub but the rooms are clean… beach is clean… AC works great… nothing more to add I have no complains it’s beautiful over there…

reviews.author: Navigate391393
reviews.title: Best resort ever!
reviews.text: We spent 5 weeks at the Palma real in punta cana in the adult section. I cannot say enough nice things about our stay. From the butler Zinovia to the restaurant Pàazzo where meals were amazing to satisfy the most difficult  palate.  Franklin the supervisor always ready to make sure all is perfect.  Adriane Romero manages the hotel beautifully ensuring that all guests enjoy their stay here  Would rate this a 5 + star resort

reviews.author: Kathy P
reviews.title: Nice vacation!
reviews.text: We took a couples trip as a winter getaway to the Paradisus Palma Real. There was interesting entertainment every night and the upbeat mystic was fun throughout the hotel and grounds.  The service was good although our Spanish was wanting and made it a little difficult.  Our concierge Eliezer S. Was the best!  He really accommodated everything we needed from dinner reservations to the transfer to the airport. We really appreciated him. Beautiful place!

reviews.author: Rene P
reviews.title: Winter getaway
reviews.text: We had a travel agent suggest the Paradisus Palma Real for the unlimited golf and adult only areas.  We were assigned to Eliezer S. As our concierge.  He was amazing, helping us navigate whith our extremely limited command of Spanish. He treated us like his only client (he had at least 20 families). The room was great but as 60 somethings we would have preferred to be a little further away from the nightly entertainment. The restaurants were good and the variety of options superb.  Beach and pools literally perfect. We wish we were more fluent in Spanish as we were the only English speaking tourists on our excursion to Santo Domingo.  But they try to be accommodating and were helpful all the way.  But really, if you are lucky enough to get Eliezer as your concierge,  you'll be warmly rewarded! Love this place!

reviews.author: Clarisel
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Our first time at this Melia at the Dominican Republic in Punta Cana. The experience has been amazing for my family and friends. We were a family of 13 of a mixture of adults and children. The food was amazing and a variety of restaurants throughout the resorts. The night activities are fun for both children and adults. Jairo Cepeda one of the entertainers at the nightly activities made everything fun for everyone. He was great at keeping people on their feet. Our waiter at the Aqua restaurant was extremely friendly and full of energy. His name is Leonardo and made out night at Aqua pleasant. Also Luis, the bartender at the lobby bar made our alcoholic moments memorable lol . Amazing drinks. There is also an amazing water park for children all ages.  I would recommend this resort for both families and adults. And will be back to this location soon.

reviews.author: Carly B
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: The entertainment and staff running the evening events are amazing! Pedro is so fun and had everyone in my family dancing and partying! The silent disco was a highlight of our trip! Pedro gets the party started and kept it going. The music was great and played tunes for all ages!

reviews.author: Rachel F
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: The entertainment and events were amazing!! The staff made everyone feel very welcome and brought the party to life. Great music and atmosphere. Had an especially amazing time at the Silent Disco. Pedro is the and made out trip so much fun!

reviews.author: Cory B
reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: Entertainment is excellent! Pedro is the best! He gets the party going for everyone! Awesome experience! Definitely recommend for anyone looking to have a good time. The music and dancing is great and fun for all!

reviews.author: Milt K
reviews.title: Come to Paradisa….truly a week in Paradise!!!!
reviews.text: Weather was GREAT…..we enjoyed everything Leonela planned for us….reservations at the best places …and other suggestions….we will certainly recommend this vacation to all in frigid Iowa!!!!!! We especially enjoyed the 9:00 entertainment!!!

reviews.author: mariscalhorse
reviews.title: Cena en SAL
reviews.text: Excelente comida, y sobre todo hay que felicitar al Sr Orlando , muy buen asador. La atención de todo el personal , muy buena. Gran personal. Muy buen lugar y fuimos atendidos muy bien con gran cariños . Gracias

reviews.author: Stephanie D
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This was my first time at an all inclusive resort and I have to say it was a wonderful experience. The resort is clean, the staff is friendly, and the drinks are delicious. We dined at most of the restaurants at the resort. Abraham took care of us in two of the restaurants. He was always considerate, friendly and attentive. Wonda at the adults only pool was lively and kept us laughing as we drank the day away. We were fortunate enough to have a butler throughout our stay. Kelvin responded to all of our needs quickly and surprised us throughout the trip with little amenities. He was always a text or a phone call away and made us feel very comfortable. Mayte made us feel so welcomed from the minute we arrived. We can’t wait to come back soon!

reviews.author: Nicole J
reviews.title: Best Bartender
reviews.text:
Wonder was one of the best bartenders on the resort!
He was friendly professional and a true mixologist. He made excellent margaritas And a special honeymoon drink for us. You can find Wonder at the bar tokimeku and Yelitza they are great!!!!

reviews.author: Richard A
reviews.title: Vacation!
reviews.text: Isaura Urena, Gregorian Arias was awesome!! They were the best manager and waiter we had our entire trip. They were excellent and we will be back to see them. Exceptional service and food was amazing as well!

reviews.author: Mamacunda M
reviews.title: Yovanny
reviews.text: The best experience during our whole vacation was in tokimeku. We repeated the same restaurant twice: the food was delicious and Yovanny was so charismatic and made our lunch/dinner a wonderful, uplifting experience. I recommend this restaurant and resort to anyone who wants to have a good time.

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Felix uribe andino Jimenez y Chet Juan gave us great service at Palazzo Resto.
Luis. Desa at the lobby bar was also great. We were there for 9 days and he always remembered our drinks after our first visit. Courteous and efficient with a smile.

reviews.author: Lauren F
reviews.title: Guest
reviews.text: Went to palazzo the chef was Juan and the food was amazing. Service was provided by Yeison and Andino and it was absolutely excellent. They were attentive and fun while providing the best food. Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Wendy B
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa all Inclusive
reviews.text: Recomiendo este hotel al maximo. El servicio y el personal fueron excelente. Quiero darle las gracias especialmente a Jesus ( restaurante buffet y Vento) , Rosanna y Edwin del restaurante buffet.❤️🥰😎

reviews.author: Amelia T
reviews.title: Palazzo Restaurant at Paradisus Palms Real
reviews.text: We had a awesome meal tonight. Chef Nelson and Javier cooked two wonderful dishes. Red Snapper and beef tenderloin. Andino our waiter was on point also Definitely coming back on our next visit to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Stephanie R
reviews.title: Always a Great Time!
reviews.text: We have been Club Melia members for close to 20 years and always enjoy coming to the Paradisus resorts. The Reserve is top notch in service and ambiance and we would highly recommend it for families and couples alike. The grounds are beautiful and everything is extremely well kemp. Our children (ages 8,5 & 3) frequented the Kidsdom kids club multiple times and enjoyed it very much between all the activities and amazing staff, especially Axel, Darlin and Carmen. All of them are wonderful with the children! Our concierge Jessica was amazing and took care of all of our requests and dinner reservations. We love it here and definitely recommend it for a amazing vacation!

reviews.author: Claudio F
reviews.title: Paradisius Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Durante nuestra estadía en Punta Cana, pasamos 10 días en las hermosas  instalaciones y playa del paradisius Palma Real, DESTACAMOS y AGRADECEMOS en mayúsculas y muy especialmente a LEONELA CALDERON, por su dedicación y forma de ocuparse de nuestras necesidades. Demostró en todo momentos su profesionalismo estando a la altura de nuestras exigencias, haciéndonos disfrutar cada momento sin tener q preocuparnos por nada!!!  Habitación, limpieza, comida, restaurantes,  de luxe. Gracias!!!

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.title: Dinner time @ the Hibachi with Chef Henry
reviews.text: While staying at the Paradisus Palma Real with family and friends dinner time is so much fun and enjoyable. We decided for Hibachi that night and it was the best experience ever. We had an awesome chef (Henry) which kept us laughing and falling out of our seats. The show was spectacular that we didn’t want to leave. I can honestly say Chef Henry enjoys his craft and for that l thank him.  Fyi the food was delicious 😂

reviews.author: Texastorrs
reviews.title: Beautiful property, divine beach, amazing staff, relaxing vacation.
reviews.text:
We just spent 6 nights at the Paradisus Palma Real. We reluctantly returned to real life, but our hearts are still in Punta Cana. We had a one bedroom master suite (non reserve). It was spacious and clean. My 13 year old loved having her own space and slept like a log on the pull out bed. My husband and I found the king sized bed in our bedroom very comfortable and the pillows were surprisingly good. 

Everyone we encountered during our stay went out of their way to welcome us and were incredibly friendly. The men serving drinks on the beach worked very hard and delivered my Cuba libre with a smile. The bartenders at Gabi Beach made an excellent martini. Leonela, our concierge, did an amazing job getting us reservations. We loved Olio and Tokimeku. The buffet at breakfast and lunch was varied and tasty.  My husband played golf several times and on our last day the shuttle left without him  even though he was in the lobby and waiting early. Jhon at the bell stand went out of his way to help and shuttled him over so he didn’t miss his tee time. The morning we left he turned up at our door to help us with our bags. He is an absolute asset to the hotel and we are very thankful for his help. 

The beach was so beautiful I could have happily spent another week just relaxing and enjoying the breeze. The Palma Real definitely is paradise. We can’t wait to return. Thank you for taking such good care of us. Until next time!

reviews.author: daisy201029
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Perfect Weather, R&R
reviews.text:
We booked three rooms through Costco Travel for six days this month.  The 
Blue shuttle service was provided and got us efficiently to and from PUJ.  The property itself is breathtaking and has a relaxing vibe.   Our rooms were Luxury Junior Suites with a nice patio for coffee (from The Lounge) in the morning and easy walking distance to everything. Great shower! I have read many of the negative reviews in an effort to temper my expectations.  Yes, the property is due for a refresh, but is not run down by any means.    Based on our experience, the service was great from checking in, to room service, the dining venues, the beach and the bars.  Very friendly and welcoming staff.  We felt well cared for.  We particularly enjoyed The Show at the Tokimeku restaurant.  Brisas was also very good.  We ate mostly at the Naos buffet for breakfast, lunch and a few dinners.  The eggs can be cooked to order.   The fresh fruit was excellent.  It was easy to find some good fresh choices among all the variety provided.  We hung out mostly on the beach and pool area.  There was a burger stand on the beach and the Swim Up Bar offered great service.  The evening entertainment was varied and excellent.  We didn't participate in many activities - it would have been helpful to get text messages about when and where things were happening.  Overall, it was awesome to experience such perfect weather at this beautiful resort!  Thanks for everyone at Paradisus for the great hospitality!

reviews.author: Jeffrey L
reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.text:
Every one was fantastic (the store staff were a little aloof) and the meals were great (outrageously 
slow service at the mexican restaurant) overall. We'll be back.
And why do I need to drag this review out for 200 characters?

reviews.author: pozniakovvsky
reviews.title: Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This hotel is a dream! But it is STAFF that makes it as it is. Wanda - bartender at the swimming pool - is absolutely perfect person that takes care of you and your drinks! And Zenovia - the concierge - is an Angel! Thanks to them to take care of us during our stay! J

reviews.author: REGINE1969
reviews.title: Vacances de rêves au paradis
reviews.text:
Super séjour à Punta cana dans un hôtel de rêve 
Accompagnés du premier au dernier jour de Yesica Reyes qui était au petits soins pour tout 
Très bon restaurants une préférence pour le Vento 
Très bon petit déjeuner au Palazzo avec vue sur piscine et mer 
Hôtel à recommander personnel aux petits soins

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: Jason Lewis
reviews.text:
Edward was amazing! He provided a great experience and was really accommodating. He always reached out to make sure we were taken care of and knew the best amenities. I would recommend that you ask for Edward if you are staying at the Palma Reserve. 

Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Coragonza
reviews.title:
Alejandro Gómez - Excelente Servicio al Cliente!
Alejandro Gómez - Outstanding Customer Service!
reviews.text:
SPANISH VERSION: Desde el primer día Alejandro fue la cara amable que vimos en la recepción. Sin ser nuestro Concierge, Alejandro dió la milla extra, especialmente ayudándonos con la logística de las pruebas de COVID para poder regresar a nuestro país. 
Nos mantuvo informadas en todo momento haciéndonos sentir tranquilas y en buenas manos. 
Empleados con este nivel de servicio y dedicación son los que los huéspedes buscamos cuando escogemos dónde pasar nuestras vacaciones! 

ENGLISH VERSION: Since day one Alejandro was that positive first impression when we arrived at the lobby. Even when he wasn't our assigned Concierge he went the extra mile, specially helping us coordinate the logistics to comply with the COVID test on time. 
He kept us informed at all times makings us feel at ease and in good hands. 
Team members with this level of dedication is what guests look for when we choose where to stay!

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: Buen servicio
reviews.text: Exelente, servicio, estoy encantado con este hotel, su buen servicio en todo el sentido, Estoy agusto con el bard avenue, Doris es mug especial y sue compañeros, altagracia, victor, Yiri, Anthonio, yisauris exelenten

reviews.author: SergioJr
reviews.title: Restaurante Mizu
reviews.text:
Excelente atención de Fanny y Joel, pendientes en todo momento de nosotros y de nuestro confort. Rafael, el chef, hizo una obra magistral, cocina sencilla pero muy bien ejecutada en el tepanyaki.
Los productos empleados de muy buena calidad. Un placer esta noche.

reviews.author: jppk1
reviews.title: Cena restaurante Mizu
reviews.text:
Fanny es excelente. Joel buenísimo! Hemos disfrutado mucho de todo y todos. Una experiencia imprescindible en este lugar, Joel y Fanny no lo pueden hacer mejor y la comida es buenísima. 
Recomiendo a todo el que esté por la zona venir y ojalá tengáis suerte y estéis en manos de Joel y Fanny.

Rafael cocino espectacular!

reviews.author: Cecilia D
reviews.title: Excelente cena MIZU
reviews.text:
Impecable atención de Fanni y Joel. Calidez y profesionalidad que lo hace a uno sentir único. Rafael cocino para  nosotros con maestría. 
Postre de cheese cake frito con el helado imperdible.  Para  repetir y repetir

reviews.author: Seaside335105
reviews.title: The place is beautiful  and  peaceful. Food was delicious  and my room was unbelievable.
reviews.text: Amazing place to spend your vacation, looking forward to go back as soon as possible. Staff was pretty amazing. I had an assistant that was out this world unbelievable I have nothing to worry, Edgar Rodriguez made my stay there an unbelievable weekend. I totally love the place and would go back.

reviews.author: Ben P
reviews.title: Excelente servicio.
reviews.text: he quedado loco con este hotel, me encanta su servicio, el servicio Exelente, la comida, la piscina, los bares, en buen manejo el bard avenue, Todos estamos encantados con Doris, he notado que todos hablamos de Ella y sus compañeros, altagracia, yisauris, Antonio y sus supervisora yiri, son un amor

reviews.author: Julio M
reviews.title: Los mejores
reviews.text:
Nada como pasar nuestra vacaciones con estas personas tan agrávales y el mejor servicio en bares. 
Luis Díaz , Víctor feliz. Jesús Evangelista  
 
En los restaurante el chef juan del palazzo increíble la comida y el servicio. El chef francis del óleo súper bien bunas la comida y un cervical increíble. 

Las habitaciones los chicos de mantenimiento Carlos Joely Amaurys robles todo funcionando excelente

Genaro gil calidad de cervicio trato increíble a las personas

Gabriel irani demaciodo bien tú trabajo en el launge 

La disco el Dj ronny buena música y un ambiente buenísimo 
Una experiencia increíble Gracias a todos.

reviews.author: WALTER C
reviews.title: Atención
reviews.text:
He disfrutado en oportunidades anteriores, sigue manteniendo la calidez y excelente atención.ñ, salvando algunas dificultades manifiestas atribuibles a la pandemia.
Quiero felicitar la atención en la playa de Hensel Peguero, educación y calidez. Excelente

reviews.author: mandita55
reviews.title: Espectacular!
reviews.text: Muy buena la experiencia en el hotel. Todo muy bien preparado para pasar unas vacaciones sin preocupaciones y relajado! Las playas son espectaculares y las noches muy divertidas. Los tragos del bar avenue son geniales! Gracias Doris, Luis Rosario, Víctor, Alta  Gracia y Manuela

reviews.author: Lisa Y
reviews.title: Volsfan
reviews.text: Excellent service from Leonardo and the meal was fabulous!  Hope to make it back again in this trip. We all had different entrees and all were really good.  Also sampled the desserts and they were also good

reviews.author: Marcel N
reviews.title: Een week Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana/Barvaro
reviews.text: Een van de betere resorts in Punta Cana/Barvaro, zo de beste ! En ik ben overal inmiddels wel een keer geweest. Schitterend verzorgde  (junior)suites, heerlijk eten en uitstekend personeel zoals een heel attente Doris Bocio, en uiteraard ook de barman Victor en collega Yisauris erg servicegericht!

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.title: Umas férias maravilhosas
reviews.text:
Adoro a winery do paradisus palma real! É maravilhosa!!vcs devem ir lá qdo
Se hospedarem!! 
Lá servem um jantar maravilhoso e vinhos com
Marcas reconhecidíssimas!! O serviço também , eh excelente ! Recomendo

reviews.author: Mery G
reviews.title: Restaurant TOKIMEKO
reviews.text:
Mil aplausos para nuestro chef estrella KELVIN (siete) no solo nos cocinó para nosotros a nuestro gusto, sino que también se ocupo de nuestros niños y de hacerles un juego para entretenerlos. 
Todos box privados, maravillosa comida a la plancha!!
👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

reviews.author: Oscar C
reviews.title: La gente del Hotel
reviews.text:
Excelente la atención en el Gabi Beach, felicitaciones para Luis, Andreina, Ruby y Yiri.

El personal de todas las áreas tiene una muy buena actitud y está siempre dispuesto para ayudar.

Las instalaciones son de primer nivel y la playa espectacular.

reviews.author: Karoll F
reviews.title: Great family vacation ❤
reviews.text: We stayed for a week at The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real, everything excellent, staff are super friendly (Sairen De La Cruz,  Domingo, Leonardo, Manuel); beautiful resort! We will be back in the future.

reviews.author: Juan Andres G
reviews.title: Cena Mexicana en el Cielo
reviews.text:
Hemos sido atendidos (y mimados..) por Adriel Pérez y ha logrado junto a todo el Stars hacer que la excelente comida creada por el chef Abraham sea aún más sabrosa, desde el simple nachos con guacamole y queso fundido de bienvenida hasta la pesca del día y la carne cortada a cuchillo especialmente para nuestros seis niños, demasiado atentos, no fue suficiente dejar propina por la maravillosa noche que nos hicieron pasar, sino que y queremos volver a visitarlos, recomendable al 200%
Así que  que viva Mexico, salud Punta Cana y saludos de un grupo de 11 Argentinos que aprecian la buena comida y la buena onda!!

reviews.author: ruiz C
reviews.title: Restaurant Brisas
reviews.text: El mejor lugar para almorzar. El ceviche clásico una delicia y los tartaki de atún impresionante. El lugar siempre impecable y la atención de Marta Paulino es excelente. Todo el personal es atento. Muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Rosangela Cruz Martínez
reviews.title: Mejor viaje familiar! Servicio y experiencia excepcional!
reviews.text: La familia Martínez se hospedó a La Reserva Palma Real y el Paradisus Palma Real Adults Only Desde el 28 de Enero por cuatro noches. Celebramos los 16 años de nuestra hija, Kelsy. Desde antes de llegar al hotel Delgis Castillo, Guest Service Manager Assistant, se encargó de hacer los preparativos para la cena especial para 23 personas! El estuvo al tanto hasta la cena y es algo que le agradezco mucho. No hubiera podido organizar la cena sin el. Nuestra llegada al hotel y check in fue muy bien organizada. No tuvimos que esperar en línea mientras nos hacían el check in.  Jose Salvador se encargo de todo y mientras estuvimos en en hotel, el fue una persona muy atenta. Nos ayudó con reservaciones en los restaurantes para acomodar nuestra familia de 23 personas. El estuvo a cargo de ayudarme con el pedido de bizcocho, reservaciones  para una sesión de fotos en el jardín para mi niña, y asegurarse que estuviéramos informados de las actividades en el hotel y que nos sintiéramos cómodos. También nos ayudó a planear y reevaluate una excursión en un party boat solo para nuestra familia. Su servicio fue excepcional!!!! El chef, Wilson Mindy de el restante Naos, fue increíble. El y Luis el camarero organizaron tres cenas para nuestra gran familia. Nos pudieron acomodar en el restaurante con una mesa larga para que todos nos sentáramos. La comida que se sirvió fue deliciosa y había muchas variedades. Nosotros nos sentimos muy cómodos y las el servicio fue VIP. Todos quedamos encantados con el servicio al cliente y no hay nada que cambiaríamos. Si estamos planeando regresar otra vez. Gracias a todos por hacer nuestro viaje inolvidable!

reviews.author: Esteban C
reviews.title: Muy buenos tragos en VENTO
reviews.text:
Hay un bar tender de nombre juan Vicente que hace muy buenos tragos en el hotel paradisus de punta cana. A parte de eso el restaurante mexicano CIELO, está muy bueno. 

Allí se los recomiendo el pulpo grillado
