reviews.author: Anthea D
reviews.title: Staff is Amazing!
reviews.text: Every staff member working at the Paradisus is so friendly and helpful. In particular,  our butler, Bernardino was so accommodating and always made sure we were happy with our stay. He would take care of our reservations and anything else we needed help with. Overall, the grounds were beautiful and the staff was so nice.  Great luxury hotel in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.title: Super Mannschaft sehr freundliches Personal, alles was man sich wünschen kann für ein perfektes Urlaub!Weiter so Jose Ma
reviews.text: Super Mannschaft sehr freundliches Personal, alles was man sich wünschen kann für ein perfektes Urlaub!Weiter so Jose Martínez,Lucia Díaz ,Luis Desa,Walquria Britto und Olga Martínez !🇩🇴❤️❤️❤️🥂🏝Sehr gute Cocktails ! Top top top top top !!

reviews.author: Colleen K
reviews.title: Beautiful, amazing and memorable
reviews.text:
Beautiful and memorable.  With covid precautions in place it was obvious things were not what they were pre covid.  But I felt safe and ensured of cleanliness with the current pandemic.  All the staff wore masks at all times and going into the buffet, you were given a mask and gloves. They asked if you had any allergies your room number and how many person in your party. 
I also very much enjoyed having a bracelet instead of a card for our room to get in. It is very convenient.

We had a concierge, which I must say I’ve never had. His name was Sandy Gil. And this man made a most amazing trip for my husband and I. It was our 20th wedding anniversary and he decorated our sweet tub outside with rose petals and a bubble bath and a bottle of champagne. Even on his day off he had checked on us and made reservations for our dinner. I have been in this service/hospitality industry for over 20 years and I have to say he is amazing at his job and definitely needs to be recognized for that. He has crafted his skill and I was honored to be one of his clients. Anything we asked for he came through each and every time. He went above and beyond his job to ensure our happiness.

The staff is extremely nice and polite. Every morning they would greet us with a “hola familia”. And I must say they truly did make us feel like family. Wanda at the sunset bar was amazing. She remembered our drinks and always had a smile for us and out of the millions upon thousands she’s probably seen to have someone remember that means the world.

reviews.author: Алена К
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: It was perfect relax! Wanda do the nicest cocktails in this hotel! And Pedro do the excellent service! Thank you so much! All of them every time try to help you! You feel your self royal! Are the best manager is Abraham from Brazery!

reviews.author: Paulaaaa
reviews.title: Gabi Bar!
reviews.text: If you are staying at this resort you must come and see Joel Valdez and Jonathan Rodriguez at Gabi Beach bar! They both are amazing, funny and make the best cocktails!  Because of them Gabi Bar was our favorite place to hang out, every day they were surprising us whit different,  delicious, specials made of fresh fruits.

reviews.author: Camila Diaz
reviews.title: Personal muy amable
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado con mi familia , una de las vacaciones más hermosas de toda nuestra vida.
Con mis nietos, hija y yerno.
Esto se debió no solo a sus magníficas playas sino a la atención INCREÍBLE de las siguientes personas;
Jose Vargas …. Excelencia pura
Adonis, Ulises y Garber en la atención magistral de los restaurantes, con la eficiencia en el comando de Carlos Almoyna ,
También en el restaurante destacar a Joaquina, María muy dulces con mis nietos.
Destaco la profesionalidad y lo atensiosa de Grisel Aquino , en habitaciones ( pulcritud maxima).
A Antonio del resto “The reserve” y a Antonio del lobby bar. Deseo destacar la naturalidad del cariño ofrecido por todo el Staff del Meliá , la profesionalidad combinada con el amor por el servicio , hacen de este lugar y hotel sean calificados de “ únicos”. Merecen también una mención el personal de Kidsom, Martina, Támara, Carmen, Julissa y Emmanuel. Muy atentos
He andado por todo el mundo… pero en ningún lugar atendido con tanto respeto , esmero y cariño.
Fue la cuarta vez que hemos estado…. Ansiosos esperamos ir nuevamente en julio.
Gracias querida Mayte Vazquez…. Por conducir tan hermoso equipo con tanta delicadeza

reviews.author: zavia
reviews.title: The hospitality at this resort was exceptional and will certainly revisit 🔥🔥
reviews.text: Throughout our stay the people at the hotel were attentive, friendly and respectful. They always tried to ensure that our needs were always met. Our villas was clean and had a really great view of the coconut trees and the pool and our balcony also was equipped with a jacuzzi. Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks were always provided and the bar was always open ready to serve you. (They closed at 1AM). We also really enjoyed the swim up bar as well. When not in the pool we were by the beach and the staff always walked around and ensure that we had drinks and we felt good. They also had shows at night that were great and the restaurants were all different but had good food. I would definitely revisit and I recommend for sure!

reviews.author: Daniel Durán
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Sin duda una experiencia increíble, todos muy amables y atentos a la necesidad y el bienestar del huésped en especial a Raúl Jiménez quien en la piscina y en la playa nos atendió de una manera increíble muy preocupado Y muy amable, muchas gracias por todo Raúl.

reviews.author: Andrea B
reviews.title: muye buena visita...super trato...regresaremos seguramente.
reviews.text:
estuve en Paradisus Palma Real, por unas mini vacaciones de 2 noches 3 días, y mi pareja yo yo la pasamos muy bien.

El lobby bar es muy acogedor, la recepción funciona muy bien (Ivelisse muy profesional y el room division Manager Sr Gennaro, super atento y profesional).

comimos en "Palazzo" y nos gustó. cenamos en Steak House, y la atención del supervisión (no recuerdo el nombre) fue divina, es un chico con modales muy buenos.

Nos gustó también el restaurante mexicano, para la segunda cena.

Pudimos conocer La Hotel Manager Adriane la cual es muy amable y profesional, igual que la enc. de Guest experience mayte y la Gte. de Relaciones Publicas Grace...las 3 son muy profesionales y atentas. 

la suite vista mar, estaba fenomenal. muy limpia.

la playa es hermosa y muy bien equipada. 
En general, todo el personal es muy atento. 

como oportunidad de mejora les recomiendo potenciar mas servicio y supervisión en el buffet Naos, y del buffet del Grand Reserve.

reviews.author: Jenn R
reviews.title: Amazing service at The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text: We had amazing service. Alvaro and Edward we so attentive as our concierge’s. John and Fernando our VIP Golf cart drivers were always Johnny on the spot whenever we called!! Mario kept the drinks flowing at the swim up bar at Palma Real. Jesus did a great job as our server at Vento. Leonardo took good care of us at the Gabi Club for breakfast. And Darius was so attentive with our room service orders. Everyone made us feel like we were in paradise!!!

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Great vacation at The Reserve!!
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip. There were 17 of us. Edward, Alvaro, and Edgar were FANTASTIC! They answered all our questions super quick. They made the trip smooth and easy. They definitely went above and beyond! We will definitely recommend for friends!

reviews.author: VICTOR F. RANKLIN M.
reviews.title: Siempre las mejores vacaciones!!!
reviews.text: La estadía fue estupenda es un hotel con un gran valor sentimental, aquí conocí a mi esposa hace 10 años y cada año venimos aquí y lo sentimos tan especial como el primero. Especial agradecimiento a los chicos de animación Happy  boy (Alejandro ) Nathaly , también al equipo de recepción  Christopher, al Sr. Genaro Gil, a Gabriel Bobadilla, y de alimento y bebidas  al Sr. JORGE quien se encargo de nuestras reservas de cenas. Todos hicieron que el cumpleaños  de mi esposa fuera inolvidable  los veré pronto chicos son la razón más importante de que cada año Palma real y the reserve sean nuestra primera opción de viaje.

reviews.author: YaniraMendoza
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia!
reviews.text: Tuvimos una estadía super agradable en Paradisus Palma Real at Reserve, los chicos super atentos a todos nuestros requerimientos. Desde que llegamos Cristopher el joven de recepción muy amable nos brindó la información del hotel, y Jorge el jefe de mozos muy atento a nuestras  reservas de restaurantes y Alejandro de animacion un joven super atento y carismático  siempre sonriente y pendiente de que disfrutemos cada actividad y show brindados en el hotel.  Todo super genial, pase un cumpleaños espectacular junto a mi familia. Nataly una persona super linda que estuvo pendiente de todo. Gracias totales 100% recomendado ❤️

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: 25th Wedding Anniversary trip.
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful. We continue to comeback for the past 10 years. We look forward to our next visit. Starlin our personal concierge was amazing and he look after our every need. Great dinners at the Winery, Vento, Pollazo and Sal Steak House. Servers were Great especially Jonathan at the Winery!!

reviews.author: Vicky G
reviews.title: 25th Anniversary Celebration at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: As usual the resort did not disappoint.  Wonderful service.  Our Concierge was amazing.  He couldn’t do enough for us.   Starlin was an absolute star for us.  Thank you Punta Cana once again.   We will be back.

reviews.author: Benjamin H
reviews.title: 2022 vacation
reviews.text: Hello our weekend was absolutely incredible the facilities were wonderful 1st class all the way Sterling was a help each and every day keeping us surprised of the activities and what was it going on that evening whenever we had any questions at all if he couldn't answer him right then he would go and find out force and get back to us later the room was very nice the beach was beautiful the food was decent When our flight was canceled on Saturday early Sterling helped us to arrange other transportation to the airport so we didn't have to go to the airport hours ahead of time it was very convenient for us hush so what do you do with us I'll keep it came from the wine will come back soon we love here

reviews.author: Debra H
reviews.title: Couple vacation
reviews.text: Hello my name is Deborah our stay here I'm going on vacation was wonderful starlin Tavares did a wonderful job very helpful every question we had he answered his personality was wonderful very friendly always available to help us whatever we needed we had a wonderful time plan on coming back next year or two weeks and when we come back we will be asking for Sterling so make sure you take good care of him while we are gone thank you so much goodbye

reviews.author: Paola O
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Bello hotel, maravillosa playa, muy buenos restaurantes, estuve de cumpleaños y me llenaron de lindos detalles, muy buena atención en especial de Alvin Batista y los garzones Alexis y apellido feliz. Recomiendo The reserve ya que tiene playa exclusiva y dos restaurantes, Palazo muy recomendable

reviews.author: Beachbum757
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: The service from Edward and Alvaro was perfect! They were both very helpful and quick to reply to messages with information or anything that we needed. If we come back, I hope we get them as our hosts on our next visit.

reviews.author: Daniel V
reviews.title: Excelente restaurante !
reviews.text: Excelente servicio de Leonardo, Daviel, y Abraham.  La comida fue exquisita y super deliciosa.    El mejor restaurante en todo el resort Paradisus Palma Real resort.   Gracias.   Regresaremos muy pronto! Muy pronto!!

reviews.author: Staci B
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Amazing resort. Had an amazing time.  All
Of the staff were amazing especially Robert (bar tender) Mario at the swim-up bar.  The Rum tasting activity with Darwin and Happy Boy was fun and entertaining.  Not only did we get to do shots of local rum we had a great time doing it.

reviews.author: Addison R
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real the best!!!!!
reviews.text: If you have thoughts of staying here solo, couples or a big group, they check the boxes with all. This last time my wife and I had our wedding in DR. We had our whole wedding party of 46 people stay at Paradisus and everyone raved to us about how amazing the resort was. Our concierge Juan Carlos was amazing. Anything we needed, he delivered. He had a family emergency one of the days, and even off the resort. He made sure we were all set. That showed me, he really cared about his job and his guests. We will most certainly be back and will be asking for Juan Carlos again.

reviews.author: Gabriel Umansky
reviews.title: VACACIONES INOLVIDABLES EN FAMILIA
reviews.text:
Esta fue nuestra 5a visita a Paradisus Palma Real, y sigue superando las expectativas en cada oportunidad.
Pasamos 8 días en familia, con TODO lo necesario para descansar, divertirse y recargar energías.
Las instalaciones, impecables, la playa paradisíaca, el servicio excelente.
Se destaca la amabilidad y disposición del personal, siempre atento a todos los detalles. Los restaurantes, todos muy buenos, con una especial mención a SAL y todo su equipo.
Quiero destacar especialmente el servicio del bar tender ALVIN, un profesional de primera, super cálido y apasionado por su trabajo. También a Pedro, el beach concierge, que se encarga de comenzar el día con una sonrisa.
Por último, mis felicitaciones a la Gerente del Resort, Adriane, siempre atenta a cada detalle y disponible con cada huésped. Se nota su atención a cada detalle y su liderazgo de ese gran equipo.

reviews.author: ELPIRO
reviews.title: A most in Punta Cana! Second time there and will be back soon.
reviews.text: Just a great experience. From the moment we arrived to getting on the car back to the airport, it was just amazing. The reception and registration was great. We meet Bladimir, our butler, and he gave us a great intro to the resort and a short tour while we walk to our right room. The food was great, the ground is breathtaking and service second to none for this type of resort.

reviews.author: Yonathan C
reviews.title: Lo mejor
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma real como su nombre lo indica es un paraíso en punta cana las atenciones sobre todo el personal de aliementos y bebidas y a Eddy suero por estar siempre pendiente a nuestras reservas y días tras día recomendarnos los mejores restaurantes

reviews.author: Camila P
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel con la mejor atención
reviews.text:
Paradisus tiene el mejor personal, todos son muy amables. 
Hicimos un gran evento gracias a las instalaciones. La comida es muy buena, con gran variedad de opciones, el salón para los eventos excelente. 
10 puntos para la limpieza.

reviews.author: Paul McGinty
reviews.title: Paradises is Paradis!
reviews.text:
Clean rooms. Clean Beaches. The all inclusive includes 8-10 restaurants.
Service personnel are very attentive the service is 5 stars. We plan to return.
The one downside for us is the sales pressure to buy a vacation plan.

reviews.author: Andrew F
reviews.title: Lo mejor de punta cana
reviews.text: Lo mejor en punta cana es un paraíso en este hotel paradisus palma real sin lugar a duda las habitaciones el servicio pero sobre todo los restaurantes el personal muy amable tokimeku el trato fue espectacular

reviews.author: Josh R
reviews.title: A Week With Starlin!
reviews.text:
Starlin was an absolute joy. He handled everything we needed throughout the week and add in some delightful extras.

He was kind,responsible, personable, and funny. If we return to the resort we would request him in a heartbeat.

Coming from the hospitality world I can say with confidence that Starlin demonstrated excellence on the highest caliber. 

We hope to see him again in the future.

Sincerely,

Josh Rothberg

reviews.author: Giancarlo M
reviews.title: Hotel paradisus palma real
reviews.text: En el bar vento el bartender Juan Vicente me dio un servicio excepcional y sus tragos especiales fueron muy buenos su atencion al cliente es una de las mejores que eh recibido,  muchas gracias por todo este bar es muy recomendado!

reviews.author: Marcelo Cristoferi
reviews.title: Vacaciones soñadas en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el complejo Paradisius Real hotel 
Excelente hotel, atendidos de manera muy cordial, Juan Castillo nuestro coordinador muy atento siempre y manteniendo nos informados siempre.
Los restaurantes muy lindos, Sal, Olió, y sobre todo el bufet siempre muy variado, tal vez ciertas comidas calientes no lo estaban, pero destacó la variedad de comidas 
Critico la poca variedad de comidas en la playa, solo había hamburguesa y panchos, nachos y helado en horarios muy cortos, la atención de  los  mosos muy buena siempre.
Desde q llegamos hasta nuestra partida fue muy lindo todo.
Crítico del hotel la tienda de ropas y regalos que no toma billetes usd menor al año 2000.
Masajes muy elevados en costo rondando los usd 200

reviews.author: Reynerio M
reviews.title: Un paraíso
reviews.text: Encantados con el servicio de este maravilloso paraíso con un paisaje espectacular la comida exquisita especialmente destacar el servicios de los restaurantes el trato, el servicio la comida es excelente

reviews.author: Nanette B
reviews.title: Punta Cana Palma real
reviews.text: Juan Carlos Serra was an excellent concierge. Best we have had by far.  Rosanna Hernandez was wonderful to us at breakfast and lunch. She went out of her way to make sure we were taken care of everyday. Jorge Medina was also fantastic as was Lucia Dias   Everyone of them made our trip special. Can’t wayto come back next year

reviews.author: Denisa F
reviews.title: Amazing food and service!
reviews.text: Brisas was big surprised for us. The food was amazing . We try ceviche, sushi, chicken and beef. The meat was so soft. As a dessert we have tried chocolate cake and cheesecake. As well very good. Service was excellent, big thanks to Ricardo, Abraham, Yuleisy and Tomas!

reviews.author: Louise Ballantyne
reviews.title: Dream Honeymoon
reviews.text:
I wish I had more room to write this review
From the moment we landed in the Dominican Republic we knew this was the perfect place to celebrate our honeymoon after our marriage in November 
The Paradisus Palma Real is nothing short of outstanding. A half hour drive from the Punta Cana airport saw us driving up a stunning drive way lined with trees and plants perfectly manicured. We decided that since it was a special occasion to upgrade to be Reserve guests and from the moment we set foot in the lobby we were looked after so well. A lovely Porter brought us through to the Reserve Lounge where we had a private check in which was so simple and no fuss at all. Our bags were taken directly to our rooms and we had a delicious meal at the Palazzo resturaunt. We were both exhausted from the flight but couldn’t help but admire our perfect room which was a sea view suite. The next mornings views took our breaths away! Turquoise blue sea white sand and little palm tree shaded areas on the beach with lots of sun loungers. I’m going to take this opportunity to mention our Butler Osvaldo! What an absolute star! He made all our reservations for us at the A La Carte resturaunts as well as taking the time to WhatsApp me with the activities for the day and then personally coming to check in with us that we were ok! He went over and above the help us get our transfers sorted after a bit of a mix up with our travel agent. He was also super for learning bits of local information and history and for telling us interesting facts about the Dominican Republic! We could not be more grateful to him!
Our rooms were spotless everyday with the biggest bathtub I’ve seen and at first it wasn’t working quite right and Osvaldo straight away had someone there to context it! 
 The Spa was also a real highlight!!! Definitely worth a visit! And the girls who work there are a real credit! 
Every day the beach was cleaned from seaweed, the water warm and life guards on duty to keep an eye on things! we were both lucky enough to be swimming out in deeper water and got joined by two sea turtles who clearly were investigating who was swimming in their area. The pool although a little cold was massive! And I really liked the swim up bar. reserve clients have their own area to relax by the pool and by the sea which was a lovely touch and the team who checked on us for drinks and sorted out our towels were fabulous! 
The resturaunts- just Wow! We loved Sal (steak house) and the Habatchi in tominekeu both Definetly worth a trip! But even the food in the Buffet resturaunt Naos was pretty good with loads of selection and we ate breakfast and lunch there a few times but otherwise we used our reserve luxury to eat in Palazzo! 
Where I’m going to place special mention is to the Lobby Bar! the team there are outstanding with their cocktails and Lucia and Luis really are phenomenal at their job but the person who I am going to mention is Olga! If you get to meet her she will win you over with her personality! olga went over and above every night as we visited roughly the same time! She was attentive and polite and someone who I really was sad to say goodbye to when we left! 
Olga always noticed if our cocktails were near empty and had a refill waiting on standbye! She is just the most lovely person and I hope this review mention gets known to her and Melia hotels take note of the people who make a difference to peoples holidays! 
Overall it was the best 10 days and we are so excited about making our plans to return to this resort

reviews.author: Walt_tbay
reviews.title: Triumphant Return to Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
For many years, my buddies and I have organized a January trip to the Dominican Republic to enjoy the great weather, beaches and golf courses.  The Paradisus Palma Real has been our go-to property for most of those years.  We weren't able to travel last year because of Covid-19 and were excited to book this two-week trip back in September.  This was my first trip out of Canada since the start of the pandemic and I'm glad that we carried through with it despite the trepidation around the Omicron variant.

The protocols in place at the hotel made us feel very safe - staff were masked; there were lots of hand sanitizing stations; masks and gloves were provided at the entrance of restaurants/buffets; contact tracing information was collected at facilities; and as a guest one had the ability to manage the level of social distancing one practiced in the public areas around the pool, beach, courtyard and lobby.  The pre-departure PCR testing service that the hotel provided was extremely efficient and fast, which reduced the level of anxiety we felt around complying with Canada's requirements to be tested 72-hours prior to returning.

Our butler Nicolas was first class and went above and beyond in terms of making sure our stay was enjoyable.  He resolved any issues that arose quickly and dealt with details like making dinner reservations.  He also provided excellent advice when we enquired about excursions to Santo Domingo and the Basilica in Higuey.

It was great to see Luis, our favourite bartender at the pool.  He always provides a high level of service in an entertaining manner.  He's been at the hotel for almost as long as we've been staying there and it's always nice to get the annual update about how he and his family are doing.

Since our golf games are a little rusty, we always arrange for massages at the spa to get tuned up.  Gladys was my masseuse this year and she did such a great job with the 50-minute massage that I booked a second massage for 80 minutes.  The 80 minute massage dropped 8 strokes off my score the next day.  LOL

Speaking of golf, Cocotal Golf Club is across the street from the resort.  Tee-times were very accessible.  The course was in great shape and a pleasure to play.   

Bartenders  Lucia and Luis in the lobby bar did an excellent job preparing the pre-dinner and pre-bedtime cocktails for us.  Their Expresso Martinis and Manhattans were awesome.  Altagracia, Victor and Luis at the Avenue Bar took excellent care of us after dinner while watching the nightly entertainment and enjoying the odd cigar.

The quality of the food and service was excellent at all the restaurants.  The wine list had a good selection at reasonable prices.  Special kudos to Franklin at Palazzo, Delvin at Vento, Jonathan at the Winery and Manuel at the Gabi.  I'm sure I missed naming some of the staff that made our dining experience exceptional at these and the other restaurants we went to (Aqua, Olio, Naos, Sal Steak Cave).

The Paradisus Palma Real is highly recommended and we're looking forward to returning next year!

reviews.author: fernanda f
reviews.title: Lobby bar paradisus palma real
reviews.text: Lobby bar lo mejor!!!!! Ismael ,Olga ,cris ,solange y todos felicitación es,la mejor piña colada,el mejor mojito,lejos el mejor bar de paradisus palma real,de noche y día la mejor disposición de las personas que atienden

reviews.author: Sebastian U
reviews.title: He venido y seguiré viniendo
reviews.text:
En mis estadías anteriores, tanto el servicio como la calidad de las comidas fue mejor. 
Pero, a pesar de lo anterior y debido a la increíble calidad de los Concierge, Delgis Castillo y Rose Mary de Jesus así como el servicio de Ruby Vallejo en el Gaby Bar, Raul Jimenez en el Pool Bar y por último y no menos importante una tremenda acogida y cariño del manager del Buffet Carlos Martinez-Almoyna, es que seguiremos volviendo a este lugar idílico. Donde el simple hecho de estar en sus jardines, nos genera una paz y tranquilidad increíble. 
Hay que volver pronto, la vida es corta!!!!

reviews.author: Carlos D
reviews.title: Increíble servicio
reviews.text: Un lugar increíble, desde las personas del servicio al cliente, hicieron nuestra estancia placentera con asesoría personalizada, Delgis Castillo, nos acompaño en todo y nos dió asesoría de lujo. Volvería mil veces a este lugar

reviews.author: Mafer G
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: Excelente lugar. La mejor atención, personal muy capacitado y preocupado por las personas. Increíble experiencia sobre todo la atención personalizada de parte de Delgis Castillo de servicio al cliente. Nos apoyó en todo lo necesario e hizo nuestra estancia una experiencia muy acogedora

reviews.author: Alexandria J
reviews.title: Satisfied customer
reviews.text:
We received great service from Juan Vicente! He makes the best drinks friendly welcoming vibes. Always smiling giving a good laugh when needed. When visiting please
Ask for Juan VICENTE. He may be at a different area but try his drinks and energy!

reviews.author: Kendal G
reviews.title: Lucia! Mi favorita
reviews.text: Incredible service from Lucia at the lobby bar. She makes the best drinks and is always smiling. We came to order drinks from her every night. She was always in the best mood and offered great suggestions.

reviews.author: Ana C
reviews.title:
Paradisus Palma Real golf and spa 
Excellent bartenders!!
reviews.text: Luis and lucia are the best bartenders I have ever encountered with, they are extremely friendly and always willing to take care of their Customer. Great customer service. I will definitely be coming back because of them, they make me feel welcome. These are the type of employees that someone needs to keep around them, these are the type of employees that attract more customers! Definitely loved being around them!

reviews.author: Lillian Calderon
reviews.title: Amazing experience!!
reviews.text: The service was amazing!!! The lobby bar specially, Lucia, Luis, Olga y Flor. All four of them are AMAZING!!! :) the resort was great, but what makes the most of it are the people who work there. The food is good. I would definitely come bald to this place and enjoy the beach and the people.

reviews.author: Darling Sax
reviews.title: Que gran hotel
reviews.text:
Soy Saxofonista en este hotel , pero nunca lo visité como cliente 

Y wao … quede encantado 

La comida , los bares , la playa , los empleados 

Todo fue fenomenal 

Gracias a la dirección, gerencia y todo el equipo de entrenamiento 

Pedro , Nataly, La señora Adrianne , la señora anuska … gracias por su amabilidad y hospitalidad

reviews.author: Carlos Vert
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
El trato del personal excepcional, desde la dirección hasta el personal del buffet. Habitación muy correcta. La calidad de los alimentos en los restaurantes temáticos es excepcional, desde la carne hasta el pescado. Cada año repetimos porque además el clima acompaña, una temperatura estable de 28°C por la mañana y 24°C por la noche. Voy a dar un par de nombres del personal que nos han ayudado a pasar 16 días de ensueño: Mencion especial a la direccion: Santiago, Adrianne, Mayte, Edy, Rafael (Subchef).
Y al personal de primera línea:
Franklin, Adonis, Georgi Vargas, Leuris Jimenez, Pedro Cedano, Martín y Wanda en la playa,Starlin, Jose, Gerbert, ... y a tantos que no podemos nombrar. 
Además me gustaría remarcar en que somos muchas familias de todo el mundo que repetimos y nos encontramos en las mismas fechas, algo muy bonito. Los clientes están todos muy contentos al igual que nosotros.
Un saludo y hasta el año que viene, si Dios quiere.

reviews.author: jjmoore81
reviews.title: Antonio at the Lounge bar A++
reviews.text: Resort was good, vey clean and kept up nice. Only negative was the lack of English speaking employees we had helping us. The best dining experience we had was at the steak house our last night, the others were OK, but I wish we had just eaten there every night. Antonio , at the “Lounge Bar” was simply the best part of the entire stay. He was exceptional, and provided the absolute best and most sincerest service on the property.  He is a very accomplished mixologist, and I recommend the run sour, mojito with Mamajuana, and the “mini beer.   I would have given this resort 4 stars, but Antonio brought it up to a 5 star for me.

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.title: Prolonged Stay - Covid Issues
reviews.text:
I was staying at the resort for a work kick-off. Unfortunately before my flight back to the United States, I tested positive for Covid and was there for an additional 3 days (I am vaxxed, boosted, and never had a single Covid symptom). The reason I am including this detail is that the staff (especially Delgis Castillo) did a terrific job with brining room service, daily covid testing, and making a discomforting situation as comforting as possible.

Pros on resort: Staff (Delgis and others), beautiful beaches and pools.

Cons: The food is, ummm, not my favorite. Not sure what to pinpoint exactly but just wish the food from room service and buffet was better.

reviews.author: Kathleen V
reviews.title: Lovely vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real for a 5 day vacation! It was an amazing experience. The place is absolutely beautiful. All of the employees were friendly and helpful. We got to have a variety of meals at different restaurants throughout our stay and it was delicious. Jose Salvador was our concierge and he was awesome. Incredibly helpful at any time of the day and so nice! He made the experience that much better!!

reviews.author: prod tamoentoa
reviews.title: Day pass entre amigos
reviews.text: Wao!! Sorprendente pasar un día en el hotel palma real compartir un montón con mis amigos buen ambiente el real paraíso con buena bebida, entretenimiento del equipo de Meliá los muchachos nos acompañaron todo el día con sus actividades

reviews.author: Robbc
reviews.title: Gabi Bar at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Alvin Batista, bar tender at the Gabi Bar was excellent!  Don’t forget to tip him. He’s friendly, cordial, professional and makes a wonderful drink. He’s expert!!!!  Super nice gentleman!!  Again……Excellennt!!!

reviews.author: SharPNYC
reviews.title: Nice Quick Trip
reviews.text:
The hotel grounds were phenomenal. This was my first solo trip and I could not have felt any safer. The staff were friendly and accommodating, the bartender (Ruby) learned my name and looked out for me. My room was spacious and the bed was comfortable. The beach was dreamy as I watched the sunrise every morning. 
The only Con; the spa staff were not trained manicurists and I ended up paying for a $115 dollar manicure and pedicure that I could have done better myself.

reviews.author: Miguel Gonzalez Castro
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text:
Unos dias espectaculares en Punta Cana en el Paradisus by Melia. A resaltar el trato exquisito dispensado por el señor Juan Castillo, el equipo del restaurante Brisas siempre atentos, deliciosos ceviches y la atraccion del parque acuatico que siempre recordaran los mas pequeños. We will come back!

Miguel Gonzalez Castro

reviews.author: Explorer65034
reviews.title: Muy buenas vacaciones
reviews.text: Hotel con unas caracteristicas muy peculiares, estilo colonial, ubicacion a 20 metros de la playa exclusiva. Personal atento ,en especial nuestro concierge Oswaldo. Rtes con buen producto y elaboracion . Hemos disfrutado

reviews.author: Paola VaLu
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Excelente el servicio y la comida súper rica. Sobre todo el servicio de Ariel Benzo hizo la diferencia en mi estancia en el hotel
Las albercas muy padres, muchas actividades para disfrutar en familia.

reviews.author: Francisco Domenech
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Lugar paradisíaco gente maravillosa ve y disfruta de lo demás se encarga un equipo de profesionales gente cercana y familiar en especial Adriane encantadora y siempre atenta restaurantes de lujo seguro que encuentras el tuyo a tu gusto y actividades para todos los gustos recomendado 100x100

reviews.author: Fred A
reviews.title: A wonderful peace oasis
reviews.text: Great time on the beach or in the swimming pool. All the places are very very clean and convenient. The bar waiters are really cool and smiling. A special message to the TOKIMEKU's chef who is just an absolutely wonderful guy!

reviews.author: Andrea B
reviews.title: Lovely facilities
reviews.text: Very friendly and clean resort. The pools are amazing and the staff are very helpful. The Spa has a wide range of services and it is easily booked and accessed.  The conference facilities were excellent and the standards of CV19 precautions very high. English is spoken by most staff, some fluently but mostly good enough if not perfect.  Restaurant booking is a little bit and miss but that will probably smooth out as the season continues.

reviews.author: Olivier N
reviews.title: See you soon
reviews.text:
Great resort, amazing food choice, fantastic team, a real 5 stars resort in Punta Cana which is not so obvious as many resorts are fake 5-star level.
Adriane Romero is the best General Manager I have seen to support us over all the week taking care of our 53 invites! Yorbelis and Alejandro on a daily basis were so amazing as well.

Thank you Paradisus Palma Real team!
See you soon

reviews.author: potxolito
reviews.title: Expectacular
reviews.text: Viajamos a punta Cana  buscando relax y playa  el hotel ha superado nuestras expectativas .es elegante , tiene múltiples instalaciones y  servicios en perfectas condiciones la playa es preciosa,  a las habitaciones no les falta un detalle  y son súper amplias , el servicio súper profesional con la srta. adriane  romero al frente , muchas gracias … regresaremos…

reviews.author: falconeti
reviews.title: Fabuloso
reviews.text: El Hotel es fantástico y expectacular Destaca su situación inmejorable en una zona tranquila lo que le da sensación de privacidad. El personal es muy amable y siempre cumplidores para que no falte de nada durante nuestra estancia.los restaurantes recomendable 100%. Medidas covid muy bien gestionadas  sin dudarlo volveremos ....es mi hotel en punta cana .

reviews.author: Jesus P
reviews.title: COMIENZO DE 2022
reviews.text:
Magnífica atención de todo el personal en especial a Julián siempre buscando las mejores opciones para estar  lo mejor posible 
Por otro lado la comida , el entorno muy bien cuidado y un clima inmejorable 
No me importaría en absoluto volver a este paraíso

reviews.author: LuisRaele
reviews.title: Férias espetaculares, Hotel Maravilhoso !
reviews.text:
Uma das melhores férias que já tivemos ! O Hotel é simplesmente fantástico ! Escolhi a opção "The Reserve" , que lhe dará alguns serviços e acessos adicionais, que falarei abaixo ... Mas vamos lá, desde a chegada no hotel, por ser do The Reserve, recebemos um tratamento diferenciado no checkin, numa área reservada, já sendo recebidos com drinks de boas vindas, docinhos, etc ... Fomos acomodados num quarto grande e confortável, na verdade um apto, com sala, cozinha, 2 banheiros, banheira de hidro, dentro e na sacada, realmente muito confortável ... As dependências do hotel são excelentes, lindas, arrumadas e bem cuidadas. Piscinas impecáveis, jardins, tudo lindo. Qdo vc escolhe a opção The Reserve, você fica numa área mais isolada, com menos hóspedes , mas podendo usar todas as dependências do hotel. Você vai ter piscinas, restaurantes, bares, praia, exclusivos para o The Reserve. Todos os restaurantes são maravilhosos. Comida boa , saborosa. Cada noite tínhamos um restaurante diferente para irmos ...Italiano, Carne, Japonês, Mediterrâneo, Snacks, Buffet ...Funcionários educados e alegres, que lhe tratam super bem em todos os momentos, com um sorriso no rosto.
Destaques especiais que gostaria de deixar: Para a minha concierge (exclusivo para hóspedes do The Reserve), Yessica Reyes , que não mediu esforços para reservar todos restaurantes que pedíamos, que nos ajudou com questões do dia a dia, que nos ajudou com indicação de passeios e empresas que suportavam isto, enfim excelente profissional e muito amável e educada ! E por fim, destaque especial também para a garçonete (mesera) do restaurante Gabi Club, a Jessica Jean. Que desde o 1o dia que nos atendeu, foi de uma simpatia, educação, gentileza, sempre nos atendendo super bem e com um sorriso no rosto. Dava gosto de almoçar ou jantar sendo atendido pela Jessica Jean ! Enfim, super recomendo Punta Cana e o Hotel Paradisus Palma Real ... Uma das melhores experiências de férias q tivemos ! Parabéns ao hotel !

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Yiri, Ruby, Albin, and Raysen give amazing service at the Gabi Beach Bar!!! They are all so helpful, friendly and energetic. They really made our trip so great! Definitely recommend the resort overall!

reviews.author: kathia h
reviews.title: Beautiful friendly bar
reviews.text:
They were beyond amazing. We had a long day of traveling with a crying toddler and they made us delicious drinks. Have my daughter juice and we were all happy.
They allowed my significant other to try their different types of rum to decide which one would be best for our drinks.

reviews.author: DAIANE LETICIA
reviews.title: Melhor Hotel
reviews.text: Foi a segunda vez da minha familia neste hotel, a primeira durante as festas de fim de ano e como sempre ficamos encantados com a estrutura do hotel e a alegria dos dominicanos!  As atividades musicais organizadas durante toda a semana foram muito elegantes! Fomos em 4 restaurantes temáticos, o  Sal de carnes e Brisas que é japones/ peruano foram os nossos preferidos! A Praia é perfeita, parece um sonho, areia branquinha e mar azul do Caribe, é enorme e super confortável! Quería agradecer também  ao carinho de todos, principalmente dos funcionarios do Avenue Bar, sempre prestativos e divertidos preparavam os melhores drinks da noite! Voltarei sempre que for possivel (e o preco do dólar permitir!)

reviews.author: Mariana P
reviews.title: De 10!
reviews.text:
Vacaciones con todas las letras! Carlos gran anfitrión y el jugo de chinola lo mejor!!
Tremenda el hospedaje y todo un lujo!  La comida excelente y la atención de primera!!
Espero poder volver el próximo año!

reviews.author: luislamadrid07
reviews.title: Atención Personalizada
reviews.text: El Hotel brinda un servicio personalizado, debo destacar la calidad de atención de Felipe Morla, su preocupación por lograr que la familia se sienta cómoda y disfrute de las vacaciones fue realmente ejemplar, personas como Felipe hacen la diferencia entre los hoteles de esta categoría

reviews.author: Glenis E
reviews.title: Un paraíso en punta cana
reviews.text: Este hotel es espectacular con una Plata hermosa pero sobre todo con una gastronomía exquisita destacar el servicio de todo el personal de alimentos y bebidas en especial el de Eddy suero quien nos ayudo con las reservas y bueno el show cooking fue lo mejor

reviews.author: ana maria G
reviews.title: Variedad de resultantes y shows para todas las edades.
reviews.text:
Pasamos muy felices en estas vacaciones! El hotel muy grande, completo y lindo.
La atención de Rosana en el restaurante bufet espectacular.
Tienen jugo de naranja natural 
Las camas de la piscina súper cómodas
Variedad de restaurantes y shows todas las noches

reviews.author: Miguel A
reviews.title: Superb New Years Celebration
reviews.text: Great ocean front hotel with several a la carte restaurants (make sure you make your reservations on day 1). White sand beach,  one of the very few in the area  with no seaweed. The team delivered an epic New Years celebration at their hotel plaza with great mojitos and international DJs. We were a family of 12 with  kids, we upgraded to The Reserve and they ve managed to keep everyone occupied with games and activities! Shout out to Happy Boy, Santo (Gabi Club) and Wanda (pool bar). See you guys next year!!!

reviews.author: SANTINA
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO HOTEL PARA VOLVER SIEMPRE!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Este es nuestro hotel de playa preferido. En esta estancia familiar hemos ido 8 personas, padres, hijos y nietos por primera vez en Navidades y la estancia ha sido maravillosa como siempre. Hemos pasado unos días inolvidables, con recuerdos de experiencias memorables..
 
El personal es muy capaz, son atentos, trabajan con conocimiento, precisión, eficacia, empatía y con una actitud sobresaliente y te ofrecen experiencias de corazón, ya que no dan aquello que se les pide que den, les aseguro que dan más, y además con una exquisitez, un agrado, una simpatía, una amabilidad… que hacen que te sientas feliz durante toda la estancia.

Felicitaciones a Adriane Romero por gestionar el hotel de una forma tan maravillosa y a Mayte Vazquez por gestionar la experiencia del cliente de una forma maravillosa. Ambas son excepcionales y te hacen sentir como en casa estando pendientes de cualquier detalle.
 
Citar a todos los empleados con nombres y apellidos sería imposible, pero destacaremos a alguno de ellos felicitándoles por su trabajo y dedicación:
 
Juan Castillo de mayordomía, Gregory y Obeydi de playa y piscinas, Chefs Rafael y Carlos Seuno, en Palazzo a Franklin, Gustavo y Oswaldo, Jorge Castillo de The Reserve y Santos, Gregoryn Arias y José Ramos de restaurantes, Marino y Edison de supervisión de bares, Martha y Wendy de Brisas, Ivanini en habitaciones, Reyes, Enmanuel y Omar de maleteros, todos ellos extraordinarios trabajadores y atentos y dedicados al cliente haciéndonos sentir mejor que en brazos en cada una de las áreas.
 
Nuca habíamos estado en Navidades y he de comentar que el desarrollo de la fiesta de Nochevieja fue fantástico, espectacular en todos los sentidos, difícil de superar, tanto en la organización del espacio como iluminación, decoración, música, atención de bares y camareros, etc…Fue una noche inolvidable.
 
Es un hotel para disfrutar y ser feliz !!! Totalmente recomendable !!!

Santina Fajardo

reviews.author: Monique
reviews.title: First time at the Paradisus hotel
reviews.text: Our time at Paradisus hotel in Punta Cana, AMAZING!! We had Starlin as our personal concierge,  He took care of all of our needs and then some. I cannot say enough! Starlin Tavares is beyond phenomenal. He is the epitome is hospitality excellence. He made our stay magnificent. We were so pleased with his services. He made us feel loved.

reviews.author: Sal H
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text:
I am gonna brief and right to he point:
Rooms are clean with balcony and easy access.
Minor issue sliding door and toilet were fixed quickly.
No connected rooms are available but booking early gets you the right room.
Room service was amazing and was included at no cost.
Booking early to use the gym was understood cuz of pandemic limits.
Dining at specialty restaurants is a great experience .
Our favorite were the Peruvian, Japanese and Sal's steak house.
Book early to these restaurants as limits apply.
Carlos the dining manager was amazing and staying on top of all activities and quality of service.
Dinners and shows kept us busy in the evenings  with nice music nightly.
Everyone was courteuos  smiling and helpful.
I encourage guests to have cash change always on hand ... attendants deserve it.

reviews.author: 63shshah
reviews.title: Unbelievable Service
reviews.text: The resort is really beautiful and is kept very clean. So many places to eat thru out the whole day. Due to Covid on couple days the buffet was closed for dinner but other restaurants had good food choices. Being vegetarian, choices very limited so we asked the guest service if they can for next couple days make us Indian vegetarian food? Walla!! we got Guest Services director Edy and Chef Carlos visit us in few minutes after talking to guest services. Both Edy and Carlos promised us Indian vegetarin food until the buffet opens in couple days. They kept their promise, who in this world will go out of the way to cook and provide Indian vegetarian for 4 guests in such a big resort. The food was excellent in tase, better than so many places we have eaten. I would give this place 5+ stars in customer service and guest relationship. Will highly recommend the resort.

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.title: Increíble experiencia
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, instalaciones impresionantes. Pero más destacable aún son sus empleados, que te hacen vivir una experiencia única y disfrutar de cada detalle en playa, piscina, habitación y por supuesto sus fantásticos restaurantes. Gracias especialmente a Odeybi y Gregory en la playa y Santo del Gabi Club

reviews.author: Rosa V
reviews.title: Best Bartender Award at Bar Palazzo
reviews.text: Stephanie Beltre is by far the absolute best bartender on the resort. Get you a Paloma (grapefruit is known as toronja) and an old fashioned. She’s at the Bar Palazzo, open at 6 pm every night. Made my entire birthday; ) thank you Stephanie!!!!

reviews.author: Rosanna Gomez
reviews.title: Mala experiencia,
reviews.text: En sentido general todo excelente,pero hay un detalle que debe ser corregido de una forma profesional,decimos ir a cenar al Rest.(sal) a comer la( Wagyu Ribeye) que cuesta $55 dólares, pero la espera fue de una hora y media, porque el equipo completo estaba enfocado en darle prioridad a los clientes que estaban en el Winery.          Nosotros pudimos ver cuantas tablas de carnes salieron mientras nosotros teniamos una hora y media sin comer, Y lo mas increíble es que te pasan todas las tablas por el frente y puedes apreciar todo un equipo de supervisores y jefes en líneas dentro del restaurante totalmente enfocado en que todo llegue a tiempo a esas personas 🤦🏽‍♀️ mientras que los turistas enjaulados comiendo 🥐.

reviews.author: Gperraudin
reviews.title: Séjour du 25.11 au 20.12.2021.
reviews.text:
Nous étions au Royal Service dans le bâtiment du lobby au-dessus du restaurant Palazzo (3ème étage). Très agréable car proche du restaurant du petit-déjeuner et également de la piscine pour adulte et la plage réservée.
Le service de chambre a été très correct avec un approvisionnement quotidien en serviettes, produits de soins et mini-bar.
Le personnel de la piscine, de son bar et de la plage était très agréable et très professionnel. Je ne saurais oublier le magnifique Pedro (qui est l'âme de la piscine/plage) et ses compagnons dont Martin toujours aussi de bonne humeur et l'indispensable Wanda, toutes ces personnes ayant toujours fait de leur mieux pour nous être agréables.
Et pour terminer, je dois mettre en exergue notre majordome Juan Castillo pour lequel je n'ai pas assez de mots pour qualifier sa prestation.Je ne m'explique pas comment il faisait mais il semble disposer du don d'ubiquité. Il était toujours là on nous avions besoin de lui, anticipant même nos désirs et nos besoins et doté d'une rigueur professionnelle et d'une gentillesse infinie. Je souligne aussi son mérite de s'adresser à nous toujours en français, même si je parle plutôt bien espagnol.
En conclusion, depuis un peu plus de 15 ans que nous sommes clients de Mélia, c'est toujours un grand plaisir de séjourner dans ses hôtels de République dominicaine.

reviews.author: Enrique R
reviews.title: Beautiful Views and Caring Staff
reviews.text:
The Meliá resort Paradisus Palma Real was one of the most beautiful repeats I’ve ever been to. The moment you step out of your car you see a beautiful plaza, pool and ocean in your view. The amenities were amazing and having a personal concierge made it so nice to not have to take care of anything. 

Security & safety is always important. I want to highlight the security staff because I lost my wallet. Not only was it found but everything was left in tact including the cash I had inside. Would go back again without a hesitation.

reviews.author: Arnau P
reviews.title: Vacaciones perfectas
reviews.text: Nos sentimos arropados como en una gran familia en Palma Real, la atención y el servicio fueron inmejorables. Desde la gerencia fueron atentos y detallistas en todo momento, debemos agradecer en este sentido a Adriane y Mayte el trato que hemos recibido. Agradecer tambien a Zenovia que nos ha hecho sentir cómo en casa ayudándonos en todo lo posible y con una actitud inmejorable hacia nuestro bebé

reviews.author: Carole D
reviews.title: Vacances in Paradise
reviews.text:
Les activités ainsi que le  mini club Kidsdom sont vraiment bien.
Merci à Darlin, Happy boy Emmanuel et toute l equipe du kids dom  pour lea activities Stretching yoga paddle …
On a passé d excellente vacances grace à eux.

reviews.author: psykep
reviews.title: Excepcional
reviews.text:
Simplemente excepcional , tanto el trato como el servicio.  Las instalaciones son maravillosas, todo súper bien mantenido y cuidado, el trato excelente. El complejo es una pasada, las piscinas, los jardines…. todo es una maravilla y todo cuidado  hasta el último detalle.  
Viajábamos con un bebé y siempre tenían palabras amables para ella, nos buscaban siempre una trona, y nos preparaban comida adaptada para ella. Hicimos una reunión con el chef y Mayte (experience manager) para comentar el tema de sus comidas, y nos lo pusieron todo súper fácil, ya que era un tema que nos preocupaba. En la habitación, nos pusieron una cuna y un lote de set de baño para ella.  
Los restaurantes son geniales, hay mucha diversidad de opciones y en todos te tratan genial, y un detalle que nos gustó mucho es que siempre preguntaban tema de alergias alimentarias. El buffet también es una maravilla, con un montón de opciones y todo con las medidas anti COVID.  Tienen un servicio de pruebas COVID y al irnos nos hicieron un test de antígenos gratis y a las pocas horas ya teníamos el certificado en el email. 
Teníamos un servicio de mayordomo incluido y fue increíble tener siempre una persona dispuesta a ayudar y a facilitarnos todas las gestiones. Atendía todas nuestras peticiones, nos reservaba la mesa para los restaurantes, nos gestionaba el tema de las papillas y hizo que nos sintiéramos súper arropados y acompañados.  
Solo tengo palabras bonitas para el Palma Real, gracias al chef, Mayte, Zenovia y Adriane por crearnos recuerdos tan bonitos y por hacernos sentir como en casa al otro lado del Atlántico. Y en especial, felicitaciones a Adriane por gestionar un hotel de manera tan maravillosa, y gracias por los mil detalles, por la ayuda y por la atención. Está claro, que las personas son las que marcan la diferencia. 
Por desgracia, nuestro vuelo de vuelta fue cancelado y la compañía nos reubicó en un hotel de 4*, que nada tenía que ver con el Palma Real, ni en el servicio, ni instalaciones, ni limpieza… no le llegaba a la suela de los zapatos. Tras esa experiencia, pudimos reafirmar nuestra buena elección con el Palma Real. 
Enhorabuena por vuestro trabajo tan bien hecho!

l chef, Mayte, Zenovia y Adriane. Mil felicitaciones por la faena tan bien hecha, por crear un hogar al otro lado del atlantico.

reviews.author: Sofiya B
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort
reviews.text:
We would like to express our gratitude to Alexander and Violetta for making our trip extra special and extraordinary. Their professionalism and dedication to hospitality are a testament to the importance that this hotel places on the comfort, enjoyment, satisfaction, and needs of their guests. 

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and look forward to returning soon.

reviews.author: Roman Sh
reviews.title: Love Dominican republic and Paradisus Palm Real Golf & Spa
reviews.text: This hotel is wonderful. Place is a fairytale - beautiful beach, beautiful design of hotel. Varied tasty food, excellent night parties. Very friendly personnel. Especially gratitude to Yanira Sosa, the waitress who always helps us and is so nice and careful. Would like to come back here again and again

reviews.author: steplewis3
reviews.title: Family trip first time in punta cana
reviews.text: I this is been a perfect holiday here with our best concierge Starlin we’ve had a wonderful wonderful vacation for a family of four the resort is beautiful the beach has been perfect the pool the activities everything has been suburban thank you Puta Cana for having us

reviews.author: Chris McG
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: This is been the most perfect vacation for a family of four the resort was beautiful and our concierge Starlin Tavarez  was the best that they have we will be coming back in June to visit again and to request the same concierge thank you for having us Puta Cana

reviews.author: 280raquel
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text:
Un día de diversión y entretenimiento, la reserva fue de inmediato e hizo un bonito día para la práctica; previo a un torneo en otra locación.  Fue de mucho beneficio.
Posteriormente luego del golf pasé un día experimentando las instalaciones y servicios del SPA.  Muy recomendado.

reviews.author: Puts
reviews.title: Magical stay. As always with Melia. Food and drinks of highest quality.I wish there could be more areas for adults only
reviews.text:
Great hotel, gorgeous beach. Amazing premises gardens and pools.
Drinks of highest quality and very attentive staff. I truly memorable experience. Please increase the adults only areas and it would be simply perfect!!

reviews.author: DJ S
reviews.title: DJ Swanson
reviews.text: We all really enjoyed our stay! Every single employee was super super kind, and the experience was like no other. Altagracia Cruz at the avenue bar was fantastic as a server, and really made us feel at home. Lucia Diaz at the lobby bar was also extremely sweet and served us everything we needed all week :). I would very highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Ligia V
reviews.title: Lua de mel perfeita
reviews.text: O hotel é lindo, imponente e bem estruturado. Mantém os espaços sempre limpos e me senti segura em relação a Covid. Alimentação e bebidas de qualidade, espreguiçadeira na área da praia e piscina em quantidade suficiente para todos os hóspedes. Elogio em especial ao concierge Ralph que tornou nossa experiência ainda melhor.

reviews.author: Doug K
reviews.title: Great Time!
reviews.text:
We had Juan Carlos as our concierge at the Palma Real. He was great and the room was great! 

Highly recommend, we will be going back for sure next year. 

All of the staff was Friendly and the food was good as well!

reviews.author: Shari W
reviews.title: BEST FAMILY VACATION!!!!
reviews.text: We just got home from spending the week in PARADISE!!!!! From the moment we checked in until the time we checked out, it was truly a WONDERFUL experience!!!!! We are a Family of four (kids in their 20’s) and we ALL had the BEST TIME!!!! The hotel is BEAUTIFUL and the food was GREAT-every meal was GREAT!!!!!!! A special THANK YOU goes to Delgis, the Concierge who went ABOVE and BEYOND to ensure our vacation was AWESOME!!!!!! THANK YOU, Delgis!!!!!!!!!! We can’t wait to go back!!!!!!

reviews.author: Milka C
reviews.title: Vacaciones en Palma Real punta Cana
reviews.text: Excelente  eres vacaciones, Darlin y Roberto muy buenos entretenedores y anfitriones de las distintas actividades del hotel. Existen muchas actividades, la comida muy buena y pudimos descansar. Volveríamos en una próxima oportunidad.

reviews.author: Gerardo
reviews.title: Melia Vacaciones
reviews.text:
El mejor lugar para disfrutar del baile y la alegria caribeña! La playa excelente, los chicos de animación Roberto y Darlin muy buenos profesores de baile!
Muy bueno para hacer deporte y botar en el baile lo tomado y comido!

reviews.author: BigPapaDave
reviews.title: Great place, food could use some help.
reviews.text: The people make this place.  The staff was absolutely wonderful.  The rooms/suites were enormous and elegant. The beach was nice. The bars were well manned and stocked. The food sucked! I can't overstate how wonderful the people that work here are. every last one of them were amazing and bent over backwards to accommodate our every wish.  Reynaldo is the man to see!

reviews.author: Hamilton D
reviews.title: Beyond expectations
reviews.text:
Excellent stay, in a wonderful hotel complex, well kept, with very nice staff.
Many options of restaurants, bars, lounges, pools and beach areas.
A special remark to our concierge Darleni, that made our experience better and more enjoyable.

reviews.author: mjgonzales8
reviews.title: Amazing Time!
reviews.text: The team at this hotel was absolutely amazing! There is a bar directly across from where you check in on the second story. I believe it's called the 'Lobby Bar'. That’s the only place that you'll want to spend your entire trip. There are multiple amazing bartenders and cocktail servers...Ismael, Criseida & Raysa, thank you!!!

reviews.author: Teo Diaz
reviews.title: Excellent place to relax and enjoy a beautiful setting.
reviews.text: The hotel is great and the staff is fantastic. The food can get old, however, the individual restaurants with reservations were excellent. We highly recommend this property. The setting right on the beach is incredible.

reviews.author: Rudy R
reviews.title: Activo
reviews.text:
El mejor entreteniemto,
 Esta persona fueron lo responsable de la buena atenciónn; Roberto,Darlin,Jairo y axel me atreveria a volver todos los años por,tods la,atención que he recibido en este hotel y los chicosndd animacion son duro duro!

reviews.author: Cyrus Family
reviews.title: Excellent concierge service
reviews.text: Having a personal concierge assigned to us was a perfect way to improve our stay! Starlin made our stay relaxing and carefree. The Paradisua Palma Real is a great resort with lots of amenities and activities for everyone.

reviews.author: MHOBR
reviews.title: Muito bom, mas pode melhorar bastante!
reviews.text: O hotel esta localizado no complexo de hotéis da rede Melia. Tem acesso direto à praia e um.bom conjunto de piscinas. Ainda, os hóspedes têm acesso ao parque aquático Blast, excelente. O serviço é razoável, com ilhas de excelência na área de recreação infantil e em restaurantes como  Sal.e Naos.   Em alguns outros restaurantes o serviço foi sofrível e medíocre, muito ruim.  O quarto era amplo, mas com um.especto de abandono, decadente, com móveis em madeira escuta, necessitando reparos. A caixa de distribuição de energia elétrica, dentro de um dos armários, estava exposta, com fiação improvisada  e precária. A reposição do frigobar, assim como a disponibilidade dos utensílios no quarto era errätica e ineficiente.  O serviço de concierge, para agendamentos de jantares e outras facilidades, foi apenas suficiente, com vários equívocos e omissões. A estada, no geral, foi satisfatória, mas muito inferior à do Circle.

reviews.author: Mary C
reviews.title: A great annual family tradition
reviews.text: OK as always every year we have had a wonderful family vacation Starlin took really good care of us and made all of our reservations and is giving a Special a Janssen to fix my transportation problems so thank you Sterling and we are tired we have had a full week so see you next year

reviews.author: Luis P
reviews.title: Reparadoras vacaciones
reviews.text:
Fuimos en familia y elegimos este hotel por el prestigio de la cadena Meliá y la línea Paradisus y no nos defraudó. La comodidad de las instalaciones, su ubicación y la limpieza nos hizo pasar unas vacaciones muy confortables y reparadoras. El desayuno muy variado y expedito, con medidas de seguridad para disminuir el contagio por el Buffet (mascarillas y guantes), los restaurantes correctos, con personal amable y el menú digital.  Todas las noches shows en la plaza colonial de muy buena calidad y variados.

Cosas a mejorar: en el desayuno incluir lácteos sin lactosa, dejar disponible en la mesa sal, ya que había que solicitarla a cada momento y tener un cajero ATM que funcione con tarjetas internacionales (tuvimos que ir al Paradisus Gran Cana a efectuar un giro).

No quiero despedirme sin agradecer la dedicación y profesionalismo de nuestra concierge Lisette Carrasco, quien siempre estuvo atenta a nuestros requerimientos y necesidades, lo que claramente hizo más grata nuestra experiencia.

reviews.author: Matias Pr
reviews.title: Maravillosas Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Gran estadia en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real, la atencion de Ariel Benzo hizo nuestras vacaciones mas relajadas al encargarse de la organización y planificación de nuestros dias.
Sin dudas volveremos en un futuro próximo.
Muchas gracias

reviews.author: A S
reviews.title: Winter vacation
reviews.text: Sairen was our concierge for the week and he did not disappoint. He took extra care of me and my travel partner. He was very attentive to our requests and insured that our requests were met with satisfaction. This resort always delivers excellent service and the staff are always friendly, courteous and aim to please. Thank you Sairen for taking great attention and care!

reviews.author: Samantha W
reviews.title: Perfect visit
reviews.text: The most relaxing five days I’ve had in years. The Reserve package is absolutely worth it. All my needs were met from the moment I arrived. The dedicated, adult-only pool and restaurant were some of my favorite parts of my stay. My concierge, Franklin Truque, made my visit seamless. He took care of my dinner reservations, made suggestions about excursions, sent me daily activity options, really, anything you can imagine. I had a massage and a facial at the YHI spa—both of which were some of the best I’ve ever had. If you go, ask for Ruth. I also took part in a healing mud workshop offered at the spa. Sal and Palazzo were my favorite dining options. I chose a junior suite and my room was beautiful and immaculate. The jacuzzi tub was definitely a highlight. The only less than stellar part of the trip is the Meliá app. It needs a lot of work. Luckily, I had Franklin so it wasn’t a problem. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: Great resort & Concierge Franklin
reviews.text:
Wanted to write this review before I departed spent an exceptional time  at Paradisus Palma Real over the last week . The weather/beach/ resort was perfect but more important were the staff , always greeted with a smile . During my stay , the concierge Franklin Truque was tremendously helpful  whether it was restaurant recommendations or activities . Franklin was very professional ,he knows the resort well and shared best recommendations for lunch / dinner each day . Franklin’s attention to detail made our stay even better , so much so another trip is being planned ! 

Thank you Paradisus Palma Real and Franklin !

reviews.author: irmscher7
reviews.title: Hotel precioso
reviews.text: Hotel muy bonito con personal muy amable y atento. Se come muy bien en los restaurantes, sobretodo en el Brisas, Sal y Tokymeku. Comer en este último es un espectáculo. El lugar es inmejorable, delante de una preciosa playa de arena blanca. Volvería sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: Manel M
reviews.title: Vacaciones espectaculares!
reviews.text:
Tanto las instalaciones, como el personal, como los restaurantes son espectaculares!
Hotel totalmente recomendable para venir, en pareja, en familia o con amigos.
Ya estamos planeando volver el próximo invierno!

reviews.author: Albert Achón
reviews.title: Totalmente recomendable
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, muy limpio y con un personal muy amable y todo tipo de servicios. Ideal para pasar unos días en la isla. La comida buenísima y variada. Una experiencia muy grata y que repetiría sin dudarlo. Totalmente recomendable.

reviews.author: Lena
reviews.title: Wedding group: Personal & Perfect
reviews.text:
My now husband and I chose Paradisus for our 70 person wedding group and we could not be happier about this decision. We got married at Kukua (also a-m-a-z-i-n-g) but had our guests stay here for the week and it could not have been a more perfect choice. 

The grounds are beautiful and the perfect size for a group like this: Big enough for privacy if you want it and variety, but also not too big / just the right size for getting from the beach to your room to the reception, and finding your group without too much organization. My group is full of travellers and many said this was the most beautiful resort they had been to.

Grace Arellano & Delgis Castillo made us feel like royalty. Truly they made our experience there so so memorable and I am so grateful for them. They made all my plans and vision for the week come to life by helping me to organize our group dinners. They welcomed us every night and constantly checked up on us to make sure everything was perfect. They gave me their personal cellphone numbers and were available at the touch of my fingertips for any of my inquiries and needs. They were also just kind and genuine people, real gems, big thank you to them both for making our stay so special!

The food was above my expectations compared to previous resorts I had been too, and many restaurant choices which were all beautiful so it made the experience fun!

The beach was well kept, the water was warm. Algae season was over so we enjoyed swimming in mostly clear water! The pool was well kept and perfect size as well, swim up bar is open and running! (Pool closes at 6pm though which we found early, I would suggest to close it later if possible!)

The room was spacious & comfortable with nice bathrooms/showers! We all chose the luxury suites or master suites and everyone was happy with their rooms! If there were any small issues, the team fixed it right away! And Room cleaning was on point, room was spotless every day, make sure to leave a nice tip the cleaning ladies do a great job and work super hard for that perfect freshness!

Gabi beach was the perfect hang out spot, actually beautiiiiiiful, good cocktails, right on the beach, lobby bar is fresh as well! There were DJ's a few nights, pretty happening till about 11/midnight , then there's one bar open till later but it's not as happenning. We were a large group so we made the party/vibe  happen anywhere but it's not a party resort. 

A large portion of my group were our friends that are mid 20's-30's, then there were my aunts/parents in their 60's and some kids between 4-6. All these age groups were pleased, there was something for everyone. The kids club was a hit, and gave my cousins free time to come drink and hang out without the little ones (who also had a blast) during the day some days!

Overall, I would highly recommend Paradisus for a wedding group, we were on cloud 9 all week long 

Thank you to everyone at Paradisus for our wonderful stay, will be a week to remember for all of us!

Lena & Louis-Philippe

reviews.author: Justin T
reviews.title: Great Service!!
reviews.text: My group of 10 stayed here last week, and we received amazing service specifically at the beach! Our server Jesus Evangelista was very attentive and was super nice! He would help grab us drinks whether we were sitting poolside or by the beach. He made our trip such a wonderful experience. Thanks Jesus!

reviews.author: Rosmi Almamzar
reviews.title: La mas chevere
reviews.text:
Me encanto el servicio de Stephanie Beltre del bar Aveniue🤩 Super simpática y si colocarán anuncios hasta eso bailaría 😂 quede encantada.

Toda una semana de gran servicio y siempre muy cortes.

Así también del lobby bar Lucia nos estuvo asistiendo ☺️

reviews.author: Jacques F
reviews.title: Paradies!
reviews.text:
Wir waren vor ungefähr 2 Wochen im Paradisus und es war wirklich sehr schön und perfekt. Hatten eine schöne Zeit dort ,das Personal war sehr freundlich. Die Anlage ist ein Traum, das Essen war gut und abwechslungsreich. Wir werden sicher nochmal wieder kommen. Sehr zu empfehlen ist auch das Romantische Essen am Strand. 
Grüße gehen an Rafael Luis (Foto) vom Strand Service!!! Hilfsbereit, nett und hatte immer gute Empfehlungen. Da blieb kein Wunsch unerfüllt,vielen Dank! Wir werden uns wieder sehen.

reviews.author: luisarama3
reviews.title: Un paraíso en Punta Cana.
reviews.text: Excelente servicio. Los empleados fueron amables y muy atentos. la comida es excelente y muy variada. Estoy seguro que algún día regresaremos. fue una bonita experiencia. Mis hijas no querían dejar el hotel. Muchas gracias por todo.

reviews.author: Isa
reviews.title: Luna de miel en Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Pasamos nuestra luna de miel en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real - Punta Cana y ¡pasamos unos días maravillosos!
Nuestro conserje Ariel Benzo nos recibió muy bien, estuvo atento y super profesional en todo momento con todas las solicitudes y citas! 
Ramon Sanchez de Circle Meliã, un profesional inteligente y muy capaz, ¡super top top!
Wanda Correia en Sun Set Bar, el la piscina, tiene una alegría y energía encantadora con las mejores bebidas y ¡siempre con una sonrisa en su rostro!

reviews.title: Vacaciones

reviews.text: Mi esposa y yo estamos muy contentos de la atención excelente de todo los empleados de el Paradisus palma real. En especial la atención en el bar gabi beach de Yelitza Cedeño. Luis Morel, Arturo Encarnación y de Luis Rosario.

reviews.author: Nicolás Andrés L
reviews.title: Servicio de excelencia
reviews.text: Sinceramente, después de 7 días localizador en el hotel paradisus palma real, la atención constante, amable, familiar y profesional de yiri silvestre, fue lo más rescatable, por cuento, deseo haber mención que yiri es la mejor trabajadora que poseen en este lugar. Cabe hacer mención, que en la totalidad de los servicios, se destacan.

reviews.author: Scott P.
reviews.title: The Perfect Paradise Vacation! Thank You, Eliezer!!
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was unreal. Truly, we couldn’t have dreamt up a more perfect vacation with a more gorgeous location, better service or more impressive amenities. From the open air lobby with the gorgeous view of the Caribbean to the stunning pools and vistas throughout the property that feel like something out of a movie to our rooms to the main plaza… I could go on… the Palma Real is pristine, expansive and constantly impressive. It’s truly everything you want in a Caribbean/paradise vacation. Our stay was made even more enjoyable by our personal consierge Eliezer Sanchez. This was our first time having a personal concierge at a resort and Eliezer went above and beyond. He was amazing and booked excursions for us, a photography session, shopping trips and he also made several reservations for us at restaurants throughout the property. He was incredible and always available to us and a huge asset to us throughout our entire trip. If you’re looking for the highest level of service in the DR and a gorgeous paradise resort on the water with a friendly staff, great food and amazing drinks… this is it :)

reviews.author: Olivia W
reviews.title: Telescope viewing experience was magical!
reviews.text:
This resort surprised us in so many ways! Outstanding service, beach view, and service. The best surprise was that they had huge telescopes on-site as entertainment which was the highlight of our trip. The guys with the telescopes were so knowledgeable about space and were eager to show us the wonders of the sky including the moon, Jupiter, Saturn, and Nebula. We got super lucky that our trip coincided with the longest lunar eclipse of this century, so we had the chance to gaze upon the lunar eclipse through the telescope which was a magical experience. 

The food was amazing and the buffet had many selections. They also have 4 restaurants offering different cuisines and all were pretty great. Food was fresh and safe (didn't have stomach issues). Some of the best food from the buffet were seafood paella, grilled calamari & fish, grilled vegetables, fresh tropical fruits. 

The rooms come with a large jetted hot tub that easily fits 2 people which helped us wind down from the day. Service was outstanding - every staff was super friendly and helpful. COVID testing was also seamless and hassle-free. 

Restaurant ranking:
1. Winery (the best) - you buy a bottle of wine and they serve you steak & salmon
2. Sal (Steakhouse)
3. Vento (Italian)
4. Tokimeku (definitely not authentic Japanese cuisine)

(didn't get to try the other restaurants)

Positives: 
- friendly staff
- tasty food & wide selection
- beautiful resort
- hassle-free transportation
- beautiful garden view from your room

Negatives: 
- slow service (I think this is just the culture)
- lots of people selling you stuff at the beach
- the room is cold and wet 
- open concept washroom (a bit uncomfortable)

reviews.author: Guillermo R
reviews.title: Muy buena experiencia
reviews.text: Buscábamos una vacaciones para descansar y desconectarnos. Donde pudiéramos disfrutar de la playa, de las instalaciones y del servicio de comidas y bebidas. Todo eso se cumplió con creces. Estamos muy felices de haber elegido Paradisus Palma Real The Reserve para nuestras vacaciones. La habitación impecable, amplia, cómoda, siempre limpia y con una muy linda vista al mar y a la piscina. Las comidas de muy buena calidad en los distintos restaurantes a los que fuimos. El servicio de room service que usamos principalmente para el desayuno funcionó siempre de manera excelente. Mención muy especial a nuestra concierge Yesica Reyes quien siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros, nos reservó cada noche en un restaurant distinto y gestionó magníficos detalles como un pastel para mi cumpleaños. También destacar a Pedro y Rafael en el sector de la playa quienes nos entregaron una atención de primer nivel, con gran disposición y siempre con la mejor de las ondas. En resumidas cuentas, es un lugar 100% recomendable y al que nos encantaría volver sin dudas.

reviews.title: Mejor hotel con la mejor gente

My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real from 13nov2021 to 21nov2021 and it was a great experience. A big thanks to Rafael Luis who made our stay special. He treated us as VIPs from the beginning and always had a new drink for us to explore with great Caribbean flavors. 
I also celebrated my birthday my birthday while there and Lissette Carrasco made sure it was a special occasion. The room was setup with balloons, champagne, desserts and the jacuzzi going and ready for use. Thank you Lissette!

The drink selection sucks, lobby bar was only bar that had descent drink selection other 6+ only had well liquors.  Don't pay for premium liquor!! You’ll be disappointed at the selection

reviews.author: Nilsa S
reviews.title: An amazing resort with excellent staff.
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for 6 nights and 7 days at the Adults Only Section ("Reserve"). on a second floor with partial view of the Ocean. The room was excellent and the staff was amazing.  We would like to mentioned some of the amazing staff members that went out of there way to make us feel welcomed and like family.  The chef at NAOS, Juan Cabrera, made my birthday dinner a memorable one. The cuisine was excellent, the staff was amazing, specially Domingo Perdomo and Glenys Villavicencio.  At the Palazzo, Francisco Bautista and Georgi Vargas. At the private pool and beach, no one compares to the friendliness and attention of Pedro Cedeño. His signature drinks were amazing and our spot by the beach was ready before we got up with towels nicely set up and ready to serve.  He is like this with everyone.  He has been there since the hotel opened.  He went out of his way to make my drink experience exquisite. He also found me some delicious fruits. Gladys Dominguez is an amazing masseuse and human being. Beautiful inside and out.  Enmanuel Batista - porter and Maria Aquino - guest services, were also very friendly and always willing to help.  Because of these and others I have not mentioned, my birthday celebration was unforgettable.  Thank you all!  Definitely a place to return to!

reviews.text:
Muy buena 
El servicio y en el hotel ha sido muy bueno en especial de Altagracia Cruz ha sido excelente ella trabaja dando servicio en el bar. Lo único que sugerimos es que vuelvan a tener el mismo servicio de entretenimiento que tenían antes. Un hotel como este necesita tener música en la piscina, y en bar después que se acabe la actividad de alado del bufet. Los refrigeradores de los cuartos no enfrían lo suficiente.

reviews.author: Lisa T
reviews.title: Resort had everything and more!  Exceeded my expecttions
reviews.text: Rated as one of my most favorite resorts and travel trip ever!  Food, excellent, people, excellent, gorgeous property! i will for sure be returning some day.  Robert and Yaniris were the BEST cabana people I have ever had!   They took care of us every day, Reserved the exact cabana we wanted, and our drinks were never empty!  The food and buffet,... typically when you go to an all inclusive, they use the same sauces in different way, NOT HERE!   The food was excellent, not only for an all inclusive, but all around.  The restaurants and bars were out of this world! beaches were so clean, and the beach water was like bath water.  Even with COVID still in effect, the only place you would know is at the pool at the swim up bar.  Slight restrictions there.  One thing I would like to see different would be that their high end, top-shelf liquor to be top shelf high end liquor.  Their idea of  top shelf was Jose Cuervo for Tequila.  You could purchase a bottle of Grey Goose, but who wants to do that, when you have an all inclusive.  The people are absolutely amazing, and do everything under the sun to ensure your safety.  i will easily come back to this resort in the future!
