reviews.author: Psmith1164
reviews.title: Another trip to paradise!!
reviews.text: Just returned from our 5th visit to the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa and can’t wait to return in 2022!! Friends ask us if we ever consider another resort in Punta Cana and the answer is “nope,  we love it here so why try anywhere else”!! We loved seeing Wanda, Pedro and Martin again this trip at the adults only bar and beach, they always take such good care of us! Wanda is the best bartender in the Dominican and Pedro and Martin always had our chairs and towels ready for us each morning. All we had to do was show up! Thanks to the morning  team at the Palazzo restaurant that always greeted us with a smile and great service at breakfast.  All the restaurants were great!!  Also want to give a specia shout-out to our concierge, Edgar Rodriguez, who took care of all of our needs during our trip!  He greeted us each morning and stayed late each evening to make sure we had a wonderful experience. Made all of our dinner and spa reservations and even took the time to set up a special birthday dinner for me at Palazzo, cake and all!!! Definitely ask for Edgar on your next visit, we will!!! Thanks Paradisus for another week in paradise, we can’t wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Randy B
reviews.title: Great vacation!!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort with many amenities. We stayed in the presidential suite. The view from the room was amazing. Spectacular views of the ocean. I would recommend this resort to everyone. The property was in great shape. The rooms were extremely clean and you can tell that they were taking precautions with COVID-19. They had sanitizer stations throughout the property. At the restaurants they would give you gloves to wear if you were going to the buffet. I must say out of all the all inclusive resorts I have stayed at the food here is the best. They have many restaurants and the food was exquisite. I would like to give out a shout out to some of the employees at the Paradisus. Starting with Pedro at the beach services. He was incredible and very accommodating. He had the best personality and he would make my wife and I laughed at the things he said. Each morning Pedro would go out and put towels on our chair and have it set up for us. He was a joy to see first thing in the morning with his positive personality.
Secondly I would like to give a shout out to Sanchez. I can’t pronounce his first name but his last name is Sanchez. He took care of all of our needs from the time we arrived at the resort until we departed. He booked all of our reservations for the restaurants. Also we had a few small minor problems. We notified Sanchez and he took care of all of our needs. Great job Sanchez. Thank you for all of your hard work and your dedication to the resort guest. Lastly I would like to give a shout out to Gabriel. This guy is unbelievable at customer service and so professional. Gabriel followed up on the minor issues that we had. He went above my expectations of resolve. He checked on us frequently throughout our stay to make sure that everything was running smoothly. I’m returning to the resort in November. I was having a issue with golf reservations for our return trip. Gabriel took it upon himself to call the golf course to ensure that we would have reservations in November. I was really blown away by his customer service skills. We were unable to get the golf reservations settled before I left the resort. However, Gabriel assured me he would take care of this after I left the resort to be sure that the golf situation was resolved. Thank you Gabriel Bobadilla for all that you did. I have all the confidence in the world and Gabriel when it comes to resolving issues of resort guest. I’m looking forward to returning in November.

reviews.author: svasten
reviews.title: Had a great time.
reviews.text: Overall our stay was amazing. The resort is spectacular; the design, the people, the restaurants, the bars, the rooms- all were exceptional. My only request would be to have the swim up bar open and to have a little more dinner selection at the buffet as most nights seemed similar. Truly, I expected more seafood would have been offered. But overall, we had a great time at the Paradisus Real.

reviews.text: Family vacation all the employees and workers were extremely nice and helpful. Especially are butler Zenovia Nova, and our beach attendant Martine.  Everything was clean and the pools were wonderful. We enjoyed all the evening shows and the beautiful beach.

reviews.author: Karlene Barry
reviews.title: Concierge of the year!!!
reviews.text:
Yesica Reyes was our concierge for vacation - she was wonderful and accommodating our every wish. She came to check on us to be sure we were happy with everything.

At the spa Alba was great. We enjoyed every day, relaxing at the beach and by the pool.

reviews.author: Theresa D
reviews.title: Best concierge ever!!!  Beautiful resort!!  Will be back for sure
reviews.text: Yesica Reyes, our concierge,  has made the trip the most wonderful vacation I’ve ever experienced. I will not only recommend this resort, good food, good service, but the most extrodinary concierge Yesica.

reviews.author: pinch970
reviews.title: Attention to detail
reviews.text:
This resort checks all the boxes for safety! We were very impressed with the amount of care taken to insure a Covid safe environment. 
The beach is beautiful,clean and the beach waiters were always available.
The food choices at the buffet were plenty and the restaurants we tried were delicious.
We had the luxury of having a butler.
Ariel Benzo is such a kind person. He will do whatever it takes to make your time here stress free. 
Reservations for dining were always as requested. He would find us on the beach to make sure we didn’t need anything. Would definitely recommend this resort and if you get Ariel as your butler you’re set for a stress free time here.

reviews.author: LS
reviews.title: Relax
reviews.text:
Beautiful views, very relaxing.
The beds and pillows are very comfortable with a spacious room including a patio with rockers, loungers, hot tub and beautiful beach views! Sunrise was spectacular. Room 6005.
The adult pool is very quiet with excellent attention being paid to you by Pedro, Wanda and Martin. Always happy and very accommodating.
We had a "butler" Kelvin, who was also excellent in his service and attention. Anything we needed, you text and he makes it happen. It is part of "the reserve" accommodations. 
Along with that reserve reservation there is another pool that is very large and fairly quiet. There arre plenty of lounging areas, with tanning "beds"on the beach and around the pool and lots of cabanas.
José was in charge of our mini bar which was ALWAYS stocked and ready. Again, any attention you needed was paid. Housekeeping was on point and as the rest, excellent.
The Neo's restaurant for buffet lunch was great and a special shout out to Santo for being to kind!
I only had a massage at the spa, and I do recommend pampering yourself there if you can.
There are numerous lounge areas and bars with very lively music and fun at night.
Overall a very relaxing, sun and fun filled trip!

reviews.author: RamFamMP
reviews.title: Expensive and Worth It!
reviews.text:
We just returned from an amazing week at Paradisus Palma Real!

The New Year's Eve Party was over the top - best NYE party I have ever been to, followed by a midnight beach frolic where you could see 3 different sets of fireworks!

Here were the people that made our trip awesome:

Luis Baez - Room Service - he got to know our breakfast order, was always right on time, and even got us a coconut or two from the gardeners upon request!

Chef Mohan Singh - wonderful Indian food in the buffet all the time, and he even went out of his way to make Indian vegetarian food (Paneer) for the vegetarians when our group was at Rare (the steakhouse).

Carolina Franco and Mayloren Reyes were awesome concierges - they helped with making reservations everywhere for our large group, and helped us with changes when necessary.

Domingo Beltre was an amazing Guest Services supervisor!

Ramon and Junior in the buffet were great about packing sandwiches for an excursion for us.

Saldiray was awesome in the photo studio.  He took some great photos of everyone in our group.

Francisca and Gloria in the kids club were always so sweet and welcoming with our children.

Richard Alix and Francisco were excellent fitness instructors for Pilates and Yoga!

Overall - all the staff was amazing in terms of being helpful and friendly.  The view and beach are some of the best in the world - reveling in the memories now!

Cons - 

Keys - the keys did not work many times for many members of our group (we had 10 rooms total).  This resulted in us spending 5 hours the first day going back and forth to the front desk (long walk) with little resolution.  Wilton, at the front desk, was not very helpful with this, and it was frustrating!

We did not have a great experience with Vantaroy, who was a another photographer in the photo studio, and Wendy, who is the manager in the photo studio - generally they were not very customer service oriented.

All in all, a great stay, would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: MAEBC
reviews.title: Spectacular Service and Team!!
reviews.text: Lewis De la Cruz, our concierge, was exceptional!! We also loved the incredible service and knowledge of wines displayed by Jhonathan Acosta at The Winery!! The entire team was incredible but we wanted to specifically mention Lewis and Jhonathan. We can’t wait until we return next year (perhaps with our children and grandchildren :-)!!

reviews.author: lucia s
reviews.text: me encantó la estadía y los tragos son demasiado buenos. el hotel es bonito y la comida es variada. el servicio en gabi beach es amable, especialmente Luis Morel, Alicia Beriguetel y Luis Rosario. La playa y la piscina está cerca.

reviews.author: Ariana S
reviews.title: mis primeras vacaciones
reviews.text:
La atención es demasiado buena al igual que la calidad de los servicios y productos que ofrecen. Ame demasiado el hotel y todo lo que se puede hacer dentro y fuera de este, estoy feliz de haber podido pasar una semana aquí y me gustaría quedarme para siempre.
HappyBoy fue uno de los que hizo que nuestra estadía aquí mejorar un 10000%. Demasiado buena gente y nos hizo sentir bienvenidas

reviews.author: Selma B
reviews.title: Estadía fabulosa.
reviews.text:
Pasamos un tiempo espectacular celebrando el cumpleaño de mi esposo. Quedamos en un Panoramic Junior Suite. La vista a la piscina y el mar fueron de maravilla. El tratamiento desde el primer día hast la ultima fue de la mas alta calidad. Comimos del buffet y en los restaurantes especializados y en eso no hubo quejas ninguna. La piscina y la playa siempre tenían amplios asientos.
Nuestro Majordomo Eliazer Sanchez nos trataba siempre de una manera especial. Siempre estaba pendiente de nuestras necesidades y a cualquiera  hora que teníamos alguna pregunta o alguna necesidad estaba a nuestra disposición. 
Lo que mas me impresiono es que durante este tiempo de la pandemia requirieron mascaras y los tenían disponible  tanto como el gel alcoholizado para las manos. 
 El Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real en Punta Cana se debe visitar.
La familia Smith

reviews.author: Macarena B
reviews.title: Difícil....
reviews.text:
Siempre que llego de vuelta de Paradisus Palma Real escribo para agradecer. Esta vez ha sido difícil, fue difícil viajar, difícil tomar la decisión dada la contingencia sanitaria mundial, difícil después de 2 años sin vacaciones, 2 años de no visitar nuestro amado hotel y mas difícil aun, escuchar a mis hijos pidiéndonos ir a Punta Cana, día tras día, sabían que cuando pasara todo, íbamos a ir, demasiado el amor que sienten por esa tierra, por ese hotel que literalmente los vio nacer, caminar, comer, jugar y bailar; su segunda casa. Ese miedo que me invadía día a día con la disyuntiva si viajar o no, se esfumo, desapareció el primer día de nuestra llegada, a la luz de todos los cuidados que hay tanto para sus huéspedes como para sus empleados. Las medidas de higiene son extremas, por 15 días me sentí muy protegida y me olvide de este virus que ha dado vuelta nuestras vidas. Por eso digo que es difícil para mi escribir esta vez, ya que no hay palabras para agradecer la gentileza como siempre, de todo el staff, en especial su gerenta Adriane que nos hacía sentir seguros, pendientes de nuestras necesidades y la de mis hijos en que claramente expertos en este hotel de las actividades y entretenciones, le pedían a ella cada vez que la veían algo que Adriane no dudaba en mimarlos y ayudarlos, de informarnos de las actividades del hotel, comidas; todo!!!!
Adriane junto Mayte, manager de clientes nos trataron como reyes, y nos hicieron olvidarnos y vivir estas vacaciones como nunca lo habíamos hecho, vivirla de distinta manera, de una manera donde se valoró aún más lo que teníamos a nuestro alrededor, se valoró aún más a su gente donde la sonrisa siempre está en la cara de cada uno, muy agradecidos Adriane y Mayte, nuestro próximo viaje si Dios quiere será … Paradisus Palma Real, no existen más opciones en esta familia, uno simple vuelve donde te tratan bien y ya está más que comprobado, ustedes son especiales y se lo hacen sentir a los huéspedes. Gracias infinitas!

The room was awesome ( reserve beach front room ) food was great and the service was over the top!!  special shout out to all the people at Avenue bar Yisauny, Gustavo de Jesus, Yiny, Jesus our pool waiter and our waiter in a couple of the restaurants Delvin Martinez. reviews.author: carlydunn12
reviews.title: Great vacation spot
reviews.text: Such a great trip! There were a few places closed due to covid but it was still amazing! The staff was so helpful and friendly, the food at the restaurants was delicious (we were worried being an all-inclusive). The buffet was decent but we typically went toward the made in front of you stations rather than true buffet. Drinks were good most of the time & the entertainment each night was awesome!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn P
reviews.title: Can't wait to come back!
reviews.text:
We visited in October 2021, when our vacation at the Melia Braco Village in Jamaica was cancelled due to the resort being closed. We did not have high expectations going into this vacation due to the headache having to rebook a month prior to our planned vacation, and lackluster customer service by the Melia Corporate Office and Melia Braco Village in Jamaica. However, we were blown away by the service we received here. 
 were traveling with a group of 8, and at times, we felt as if we were the only 8 people at the resort! All the staff were friendly, attentive, and accommodating. However, there were some staff members who stood out for exceptional service. 
Nicolas, was our concierge and was absolutely the best of the best! He helped with everything from dinner reservations to ensuring transport was in place four our departure home. He checked in with us every day we were there and truly ensured we had the best time possible.
Wanda was our bartender at the Reserve Pool. She always ensured our drinks were full and cold! When you get there, be sure to find her and ask for the Wanda Special, it was delicious!!  In fact, the entire staff at the Reserve Pool was amazing, I wish we remembered all their names to give them an individual shout out! 
Luis, from the buffet was always attentive and made you feel like family. 

The rooms were spacious and clean. We stayed in the Master Suite which offered a large bedroom with a king size bed, living room with a pullout couch, full kitchen, bathroom with a shower and jacuzzi tub, and a large balcony. Perfect for couples, staying with friends, or families!

The resort was meticulously cleaned and sanitized, We felt very safe during our stay and Covid-19 protocols were in place and abided by. All staff wore masks. Masks and gloves were provided for all guests upon entry to common areas and food areas, especially in the buffet. High traffic areas were constantly being cleaned all hours of the day. 

The food was delicious, especially at Sal's! The staff there always made dinner fun and enjoyable. They even accommodated a last minute reservation for our part of 8. 

The Reserve is definitely worth the price! We had access to more restaurants, a private adults only pool and beach area, and the concierge service, which made the trip. 

We would absolutely and will absolutely return here again and again! Thank you for an amazing trip. We can not wait to come back!

reviews.author: The Sejour Family

The Sejour Family

Yiri makes the best drinks ever! So friendly and welcoming! We love her ♥️♥️♥️

I cannot say enough about Edward our butler. He was amazing and made sure all of our needs were met. We had an every changing dinner schedule and he often would personally meet my husband and I at the restaurant to ensure we got in without a hitch. 

Edward also stayed in touch daily and checked out on throughout the day. Anything that came up, he was on it. While speaking with others at the resort, it sounded like we had the most positive experience compared to others. 

I highly recommend this resort. The food is really good, the rooms are beautiful and the grounds are exceptionally clean and modern. Entertainment was lacking however the resort was just reopened in June and only running at 40% occupancy so we understood why. 

My husband and I eloped while at this resort and we did not have to list a finger. Kudos to the staff that completed all the arrangements  and to our wedding planner, Thaila. She was great and was very supportive throughout the wedding day.

En el buffet Luis y Joaquina nos atendieron un muy bien siempre pedientes de  que no nos faltara nada en la mesa. Jairo y happy boy en animacion siempre tratando de entretenernos. Edison en el lobby bar preparando los mejores tragos. El salvavidas Martinez en la piscina principal siempre muy amable y dispuesto a ayudar. Abrahan en el buffet del desayuno prepara el mejor cafe del día. Todos trabajando muy fuerte para asegurar que nosotros pasáramos unas vacaciones memorables.

reviews.author: David L

Gracias Altagracia Cruz, Lucía días, Yisauri Luis garces. If you are looking for an after dinner drink and great conversation Definitely check out the Avenue!

reviews.author: Stella K
reviews.title: Dias felizes 🥰
reviews.text: O Hotel Meliã Paradisus Palma Real é simplesmente maravilhoso! Tivemos dias maravilhosos aqui. Muito obrigada a todos vocês !!!

reviews.author: Osi T
reviews.title: Maravillosa experiencia recomendable 100% 👌😊

Damos especial agradecimientos a JESSICA JIMÉNEZ , OLVI ALMONTE,  YAFREISI SOLER , JUAN DE AZA,  CLARITZEL OTAÑEZ  Y MAYTE VÁSQUEZ .  Y por  supuesto a todo el personal del lugar .

reviews.author: Stacy S

reviews.author: Gabriela D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus. We did at least one activity a day, and they were all great and totally worth the minutes away from the pool 😜 two of our favorite activities were the wine tasting with Jonathan at the wine cave, and the rum tasting class with Darwin and Alejandro at the Gabi beach bar! reviews.title: Greatest time
reviews.text: My wife and I were happy to see things running so well at The Palma Real on our recent August vacation. Roandel Acosta and Fausta Cabrera were pleasant and attentive at the Buffet. Jeanine Molina was excellent hostess at the restaurant. Juan Carlos Valdez was an awesome chef. reviews.author: Jillian S

reviews.author: Fernanda F
reviews.title: 18th Anniversary get away
reviews.text:
My husband and i stayed at the Melia Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for our 18th anniversary and it was absolutely amazing. We had a concierge the whole stay named Ernesto Guerrero. He was on top of everything, from scheduling our excursions to making reservations for dinner. Not only did he have great customer service but he was a pleasure to have around. Always with a smile and great energy. Everyone there had great energy, they greet you while you walk by making you feel at home. I have to say our waiter Abraham was also amazing, so attentive. At breakfast he would remember how we liked our coffee and always had a different kind of Mamosa for us. 

The actual day of our anniversary while we were on one of our excursions they surprised us with flower petals leading to a warm bubble bath, champagne, dessert and balloons in our room. It was so beautiful and romantic. The last night we were there they also prepared a romantic dinner at the beach. I felt like I was in one of those romantic movies lol. I honestly couldn’t have asked for anything more. We were so happy with our stay that we are already planning our next trip there with our three kids. So many little details that made this trip unforgettable. 

We left with a new family, the Melia Family ❤️

Barron & Jonathan Lucas

reviews.author: Bernadette
reviews.title: Excellent séjour
reviews.text:
Mon séjour au Paradisus Palma Réal était parfait pour une semaine de repos et de farniente.
L’hôtel est magnifique et le personnel était charmant, toujours prêt à m’aider en cas de besoin

Yesica, la concierge qui veillait sur moi était aux petits soins et cherchait tous les moyens à sa disposition pour agrémenter mon séjour.
Maria, la femme de ménage qui s’occupait de ma suite était très discrète : il m’a même été possible de choisir l’heure du ménage ! 
Grâce à Jonathan, mon mini bar était toujours garni.
Ma suite était proche de la plage et de la piscine : j’étais au large (49 mètres carrés !) et j’ai particulièrement apprécié le nespresso avec capsules à volonté dans ma chambre.

Tout le personnel de l’hôtel garde le masque en permanence à l’extérieur comme à l’intérieur, et l’hôtel se charge de faire un test Covid si on le souhaite .
Le site est splendide et la piscine immense et très propre; un coin de la grande piscine est réservé aux adultes et une piscine plus petite aussi.
Les repas délicieux et variés et pour tous les goûts. Je n’ai jamais vu un buffet de petit déjeuner aussi copieux !!
Il est aussi possible d’avoir un repas plus raffiné au Restaurant Palazzio
Mention spéciale pour le Barman de la piscine : ses pinas colada (avec ou sans alcool) sont à tomber par terre.

Un tout petit bémol indépendant de la volonté de l’hôtel : l’hôtel enlève tous les jours les algues qui s’échouent sur le sable, mais il restait quand même quelques algues dans l’eau; cela ne m’a pas empêché de le baigner heureusement.

Je comprends pourquoi cet hôtel est dans le top 10 des hôtels de Puntacana 
J’y retournerai l’année prochaine c’est sûr !!

Paradisus Palma Real has both a beautiful location and EXCELLENT customer service. The team in this resort will go over and beyond to assist you and make your stay a fantastic one. We are very thankful that we’ve hit it out of the park picking this place for our vacation and we will be sure to return as they have won not only mine, but my friend’s and family’s customer loyalty for years to come. ”

reviews.author: Dani
reviews.title: My favorite Resort ever! I literally felt at Paradise!
reviews.text: I fell in love with Paradisus Palma Real on my first visit in 2007. After 12+ years without visiting my homeland and without taking vacations, I didn’t think twice to book Paradisus. We felt in Paradise from the moment we arrived until the moment we left. All the staff made us feel like family. They are very friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Ernesto Guerrero Reyes (Guest concierge PRL) and Jose Ramos (Restaurant Capitan). I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.title: Un lugar de playa para estar relax y y bien atendido
reviews.text:
Nos encanto este Resort , la playa es preciosa, las habitaciones, el
Spa, los desayunos muy buenos pero sobre todo la excelente atención que tuvimos en especial a Ernesto Guerrero Guest concierge y Juan Carlos Santos Gerente atributos. 
Sin duda alguna volveríamos

reviews.author: luis Guillermo Diaz
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Esperiencia increible ,  las mejores atenciones en el bar lobby Edison, walquiria excelente persona . Mi mayordomo Rafi muy servicial y siempre involucrado en las actividades de nosotros . les recomiendo visitar el lobby bar ....recomendando a cualquiera las instalaciones del Paraiso palma Real en su totalidad....100%

reviews.author: Angeles M
reviews.title: Estupendas vacaciones en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Las 3 semanas que pasamos se nos hicieron cortas!!! Tienen unas magníficas infraestructuras y resolvieron, hasta el punto posible, la cuestión de las algas ubicando una barrera de flotadores a unas 200 m de la costa. No obstante, lo más destacable es la amabilidad del personal, en especial del Sr Gabriel Bobadilla. Este señor, Gerente de Atención al socio, nos resolvió todas las incidencias que surgieron.

reviews.author: Manolo Ortíz
reviews.title: La diferencia la sentí desque entre a la puerta turística.!
reviews.text: No cabe duda que la razón por la cual los turistas regresan a República Dominicana a parte de las playas, es ese calor de su gente, super agradecido del señor Edgar Mejía quien desde nuestra llegada hasta el final demostró su profesionalidad y amabilidad, pero no puedo dejar de mencionar a las personas que complementaron me estadía para que me sintiera como en casa, ellos son los que se encargan de que en cada restaurante, usted tenga el mejor de los servicios, ellos son: Adonis, José Ramos, Ismael Lizarazo, Juan De Aza, también las atenciones de Yessica Reyes y los chicos de recepción. Uffff y algo que no puedo dejar de mencionar es el trago de bienvenida del restay Sal, llamado Folklore es lo mejor que he podido probar en mi vida, la verdad es que no quería irme de ese lugar, mil gracias a todos por hacer de mis vacaciones la mejor de mis experiencia

reviews.author: paco m
reviews.title: Excelente vacaciones!!
reviews.text: Buen trato por parte de todo el personal del hotel, pero muy especial el recibido por el señor Gabriel Boadilla gerente de atención al socio. El hotel es muy hermoso y con  muchas posibilidades para pasarlo bien.

reviews.author: Julián P
reviews.title:
Hotel Paradisus Palma real 
Vacaciones de sueños!!!!
reviews.text:
Todo el equipo se hace tu familia, hacen lo mas importante que es dar su calor. 
Volveremos por encontrarnos con ellos y su maravillosa comida además de el hotel más hermoso de la organización.
Los mejores:
Joaquina, yafreisi , Capitan José Ramos, Abraham, Joel, y frank feliz!

Son todos una familia que te abraza cuando llegas!

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
We had a great time at our stay. Jose was our personal concierge and he was truly amazing! Very kind, patient, and always one step ahead of us! Whenever we had questions regarding our dining reservations, excursions, or needs for our suite, Jose responded or showed up immediately. He checked in with us multiple times throughout the day to make sure we were doing okay - always on top of it! He always made sure our best interests and safety came first. 

The resort was really beautiful, clean, and all of the staff we interacted with treated us like family. A really lovely place to escape when you need to relax and reset!

reviews.author: Stay779193
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones en el Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Pasamos una semana toda la familia en este maravilloso hotel. Personal muy atento y detallista, comida del buffet muy rica y variada. Los restaurantes que probamos todos muy buenos. Los niños disfrutaron mucho del Kids Club y de las actividades que allí realizaban con otros niños. Sin duda repetiremos! Gracias por unas súper vacaciones en familia!

reviews.author: Ruestac1
reviews.title: Wine & paint night
reviews.text: The hotel was great! One of my favorite things was the wine and paint night they did! My husband and I enjoyed it very much! It was a small group of people and it appears everyone enjoyed themselves very much.

reviews.author: Osler
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Estamos pasando una excelente vacación en hotel Palma real. También quiero resaltar  el excelente trato de @Soranyi ,@creceida, @edison, con sus huéspedes nos preparo unos muy buenos cócteles tienen un conocimiento muy muy amplio de su trabajo son muy buenos profesionales. Esperemos seguir disfrutando de esta maravillosa estadía.

reviews.author: katterine f
reviews.title: Excelente atención
reviews.text: Realmente recomendado, volvería a visitar este resort, es muy familiar, la cercanía de todos los ambientes es favorable para ir de un lado a otro sin perder mucho tiempo, la vista a la playa es espectacular, la atención de todos los empleados del resort es muy sobresaliente, todos muy amables, quisiera mencionar a Lisett( restaurant igaliano y jugos) Juan y Domingo ( restaurant japonés) , el chef chocolate en el restaurant japones , Cristian (en el lugar de las parrillas y hamburguesas de la playa) , Jesus (en atención en la playa) a todos mi agradecimiento porque hicieron de nuestra estadía la mejor!!!

reviews.author: Ray Gordner
reviews.title: Luis rodriguez amazing service lead to the best vaction of my life!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Hotel is beautiful, amazing pool and service,  the and food and the people will make even the slightest frown turn upside-down.... this has been one of the most greatest vacations  we had and it was soley because of a server we met on our first night at the buffet by the name of Luis Rodriguez! He went above and beyond his job to make sure our experience was hands down the best we ever had!! Soley because of him we have already planned a vacation to come back with the whole family....  Luis has left us with an experience we will never get anywere else and made us feel as we we are family!! We are looking forward to coming back and hope this review has helped with decision on choosing this hotel as your destination of a beautiful vacation!!

reviews.author: Paola A
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel
reviews.text:
El hotel es fantástico, tuvimos una estancia tranquila, muy buena comida, el restaurante de carnes fue mi favorito y el servicio del personal es excelente, siempre atentos y muy dispuestos, en especial Jesus de servicio al cliente y El Gerente Nocturno Andrés.
Recomendado!

reviews.author: Katherine P
reviews.title: Comentario del hotel
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene un servicio de excelente , las habitaciones excelente, la comida esta espectacular 

Este hotel es maravilloso para parejas y niños y principamente para negocios y eventos

Los empleados son muy serviciales principalmente el señor jesus peguero de relaciones publicas y el gerente nocturno andres fuerte

reviews.author: Erica Dominguez
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Everything was clean and kept up with very nicely. Staff and service are exceptional. If i have one negative thing to say is that there is not much to do or activities happening at this resort. So if you’re looking for peace and relaxation this is your spot. But if you’re looking for nightlife and very hyped up resort this is not the place

reviews.author: Haddy R
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
El hotel estuvo increíble, la comida estuvo muy buena, las instalaciones muy limpias, el servicio del personal estuvo excelente. Las playas muy limpias y buena. Pasamos unas vacaciones increíbles. Yo volvería y recomendaría el sitio a cualquier persona que quisiera venir.
Jairo condujo una clase de joya increíble , además el estuvo amenizando la fiesta de la noche , la pasamos increíble. También tuvimos oportunidad de estar con happy boy, ese muchacho dirigió la clase de Ste y zumba muy bien, además estuvo amenizando en la noche, baila increible.  Recomendaría una clase con estos dos michacos. Darling nos atendió increíble, estuvo amenizando la fiesta de la noche, fue muy Cortez y amable. Estos tres muchachos se merecen unas felicitaciones

reviews.author: Farideh S
reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: This hotel is really nice Palma real,the service amazing the staff everyone is very friendly and happy they make sure tha everybody have fun and spend a good moment especially Alejandro (happyboy)from activities he is very nice with  everyone here we really spent a good time with him doing different activities by the pool everyday and night😘😘

reviews.author: Paloma Canales
reviews.title: ¡Increíble!
reviews.text: Es la primera vez que venía a República Dominicana y no hace falta decir que es un país maravilloso, no solo por todos los lugares increíbles, como las playas paradisíacas que hay, también por todas las personas que conoces, tienen un carácter especial. Nos alojamos en Paradisus Palma Real, la mejor elección sin duda. Es más que un hotel, es un lugar precioso que hace que uno se sienta como en casa, además la oferta que tienen, instalaciones, actividades, la gastronomía… un 10! También hay que aclarar que dado el contexto en el que nos encontramos, nos hemos sentido seguros en todo momento. Unos días aquí hacen que te olvides de todo… Pero además del hotel que sin duda repetiré siempre, (porque uno siempre vuelve a aquellos lugares que marcan) también me llevo conmigo a todas las personas que forman parte de Paradisus Palma Real, la atención es excelente. Hacía mucho tiempo que no me impresionaba tanto. En especial, Alejandro Rivera, Happy Boy, esto resume muy bien cómo es. Además de educado, atento y servicial con todos los clientes, es encantador y siempre con una sonrisa (se nota aún con la mascarilla), es de esas personas que hacen que todo el mundo a su alrededor se sienta bien, tiene ese don de transmitir y conectar con todo aquel que le conoce.  Algo fundamental en personas que están todo el día de cara al público. Viajar también es las personas que conoces. Paradisus Palma Real tiene suerte de contar con personas como él dentro del equipo, gente así marca la diferencia. Muchas gracias a Paradisus Palma Real y a todo el staff por estas vacaciones, ha sido un sueño.

reviews.author: Jessica M
reviews.title: Stay at Palma Real
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for a week and it was a wonderful and relaxing time. Our butler Lewis De La Cruz was a huge help with planning dinners and activities and he was always available whenever we needed his assistance. I’m already looking forward to our next visit!

reviews.author: veronica f
reviews.title: Sunset Bar
reviews.text:
Wanda se portó 1000000 puntos, excelente anfitriona, nos tendió a cuerpo de reyes durante toda la estadía! Recomendadisimoooo! 

Si se hospedan en Paradisus palma real este bar es el mejor gracias a la atención de Wanda.

reviews.author: Jose T
reviews.title: Sun set bar
reviews.text:
Wanda realmente es la mejor bar tender del hotel
Excelente calidad de persona muy respetuosa amable y sobre todo con una alegria que nos irradió todos los días de nuestras estadías !! Un placer haberla conocido

reviews.author: Mabel Vasquez
reviews.title: Excelente!!
reviews.text: La experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real fue mágica! Disfrutamos en familia de sus instalaciones en general; en especial de su piscina, y la deliciosa comida. Agradesco a Wally peña y a Gabriel bobadilla por su amabilidad y atenciones. Estamos muy agradecidos! Debo destacar que el restaurant Salt fue mi favorito, el mejor churrasco que he probado! Espero visitarles nuevamente. Mi familia y yo recomendamos este hotel 100%.

reviews.author: Mariaalebell
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones en familia.
reviews.text:
Vacaciones de en sueños junto a la familia después de más de un año de pandemia, protocolos de limpieza excelente.
Jesús Robles del Restaurant Vento un muchacho muy amable,  atento y dedicado en su trabajo, que el éxito te persiga  siempre Jesús

reviews.author: Louise
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The trip was great. Edgar was OUTSTANDING, he took care of EVERYTHING. Even some things he changed twice for the Family.  The service was top notch. I would love to have Edgar and Alejandro Restituyo service in the future.

reviews.author: Jahzeel Neftali A
reviews.title: Extremadamente bueno
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio, buena condición de las áreas y habitación.
Fui en familia y pasamos momentos muy agradables, todo el personal que nos asistía sumamente serviciales, de seguro que volveré pronto para repetir está experiencia inolvidable

reviews.author: Neftali A
reviews.title: TODO UN FIN DE SEMANA DE ENSUEÑO
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y muy buena la calidad de la comida, ya había venido anteriormente y sin dudas han mejorado un montón el nivel de servicio, atenciones y calidad de los alimentos.

Me pase este fin de semana acompañado de mi familia en total 10 personas y todos super satisfechos con el servicio en general, tenemos que mencionar de manera especial el trato de Ismael del restaurante principal y de chocolate del japonés.

reviews.author: Getaway03292601208
reviews.title: BODA PUNTA CANA
reviews.text: Fuimos con poco tiempo para organizar nuestra boda, y nos ayudaron en todo para que saliera todo perfectamente, quiero agradecer a todo el equipo por ayudarnos en un día tan importante. Además el resto de la estancia salió todo muy bien, magnificas instalaciones, limpio, se podía mantener distancia por tema COVID, los restaurantes mantenían buenos protocolos anti-covid. Y las cenas en los Restaurantes estuvo genial, en especial nos gustaron 2 restaurantes el Tokimeku (que me trataron super bien por mi alergia a los mariscos y nos hicieron pasar una velada muy divertida) y el Sal Steak. Muchas gracias por todo. Repetiremos!!!!

reviews.author: Javier M
reviews.title: Gracias Braulio Cedeño
reviews.text: Todo fantástico, sobre todo el servicio de Braulio Cedeño en el restaurante Vento. Un super camarero que sabe atender y dar el mejor servicio que he recibido en toda mi estancia en el Paradisus Palma Real. Espero que Melia cuide a empleados como él.

reviews.author: Adelina J
reviews.title: Addy J
reviews.text: Such a great trip! Our room was gorgeous and the service was great. Rooms were cleaned each day and whatever you wanted would be delivered to the room within the hour. The beach was very nice and the pools were too. Jose, our butler, was amazing! Would recommend and would return any time.

reviews.author: devindrak157
reviews.title: Pleasure Trip
reviews.text: Excellent experience except the foods for lunch and dinner because of there two persons out of twelve are vegan and very hard to get their foods but they were adjusted very well with others. There are four children's and they were enjoyed all the time.

reviews.author: Javier L
reviews.title: Un lugar maravilloso
reviews.text: Excelente trato recibido de todo el personal, desde el staff directivo hasta el servicio de habitaciones, es un lugar con un encanto especial en dónde te hacen sentir como en tu propia casa, la calidad en general es insuperable, en especial la humana.

reviews.author: Bea
reviews.title: Hotel recomendable
reviews.text:
Estamos encantados con las actividades del hotel y con los animadores, que hacen que los días y las noches sean muy entretenidas. Nos gustaría resaltar a Jairo y a Happy Boy por su espectacular trato, son la caña!!!!

También me gustaría mencionar a Luis por su gran atención y buenísimos cocteles que prepara en la piscina.

reviews.author: Cynthia Perez
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real (All- Inclusive)
reviews.text: My family trip to Paradisus Palma Real was beyond incredible. The resort was spectacular and surely exceeded our expectations. The entire staff were so welcoming and the service is everything and more you would like to have while on vacation. Thanks to our personal consierge, Yesica Reyes, we had the most amazing experience. Yesica truly made our family trip come to life. She was the sweetest, friendliest and very professional. She truly went above and beyond to make our experience here at Paradisus Palma Real something my family and I will never forget. Everything we wanted to do in Dominican Republic, Yesica made sure to make it happen. Yesica planned our entire trip while at the resort.  Wow! She is truly a gem. Thank you so much for hosting us. We hope to be back very soon!

reviews.author: Yafreisy Manuel F
reviews.title: Vacaciones Paradisus palma real
reviews.text: Estuve en Paradisus palma real. Unas vacaciones excelente gracias a los chicos de el bar de la piscina me dieron un buen servicio el señor Luis ,gerinaldo,Mario y Luis el capitán muy buena personas la habitación muy bonita gracias por el servicio regresaré pronto

reviews.author: soraya R
reviews.title: Lovee
reviews.text: Muy bien mejor imposible muchas gracias Luis desa genial y la camarera genial muy buen servicio inmejorable walquiria muy maja todo genial son muy amables tamb Rosana y Giovani cocinero del Japones todo encantador

reviews.author: Elisa F
reviews.title: Cena en restaurante Sal steak house.
reviews.text:
El restaurante es maravilloso y el trato de su Personal es increíble . 

Nos han atendido : 
Leury Adames y Gilson , ambos han sido muy profesionales e hicieron que nuestra velada fuese perfecta . 
Los dos hicieron que nos sintiésemos como en casa , aconsejándonos en todo momento y transmitiéndonos su buena energía con una gran sonrisa y su buena actitud en todo momento . 

Sin duda muy recomendable por ello hemos repetido dos veces en tres dias . 

Las costillas y los camarones son una perdición . 
 No olviden el brownie para los más golosos .

reviews.author: Ivonne F
reviews.title: Gabi Beach
reviews.text: Victor Sanchez los mejores tragos Y el señor Luis Morel y Luis Rosario Ingrid Belliard el mejor servicio los mejores haciendo tus tragos favoritos muy amables por ellos regresomos tambien quiero mencionar Yonely Cancu Martinez en Vento Yovany y Joel en Takumeku restaurant japones Y luis garces serviciales en todo momento por ellos tuvimos la mejor estadia en este lugar!

reviews.author: Lavern G
reviews.title: Great!!!!
reviews.text:
The service was exceptional. The hotel and resort was very clean. The food was exceptionally good at the buffet in at all the restaurants.
The whole staff was efficient and very helpful.  The Bar Avenue and Atlagracia Cruz were very professional! Great service!

reviews.author: Shan Q
reviews.title: Quality food and Quality service!!
reviews.text:
Wife and I went here two times on our honeymoon because it was so delicious. Gilson was a great server and Paula was excellent as well. 

The resort has been great and have really enjoyed the pool and beach.

reviews.author: Brantley K
reviews.title: Hotel paradisus
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing. Love Victor and Luis they were the best. They have so much hospitality and perfect. The beach is 😍 beautiful. The Gabi beach at night... they are going to give the experience of your life!........................................................

reviews.author: Vince
reviews.title: Unbeatable Service at Sal
reviews.text: Eat at Sal's. Servers are top notch; Frank, Daris, Gilson, and  Leury provided amazing service on our visits. They were attentive, helpful and friendly. The food delivered was impeccable. It was everything you would expect from a 5 star restaurant.

reviews.author: kasey
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My family really enjoyed our stay here. The staff was all super friendly and helpful the entire time. The ambiance was beautiful and all the food and drinks were amazing. Ismael was an excellent bartender who never failed to make delicious drinks! Overall, it was a beautiful experience which allowed us to relax and have a fun time.

reviews.author: Ardi C
reviews.title: The bar is excellent
reviews.text: Ismael the bartender is very professional, kind and funny. The experience is welcoming and fun. The lobby bar offers the best drinks with a warm atmosphere and an amazing view. I would recommend a trip to Meila.

reviews.author: Jose N
reviews.title: Review para el bartender en el lobby-para Ismael Lizardo
reviews.text: El bartender Ismael lizardo tiene muy buen servicio! Me gusto que es muy agradable y también hace mucha bebidas buenas!  El té puede recomendar bebidas si no sabes cual te guste también.  El trabaja rápido y muy bien.  Lo recomiendo mucho y merece un A+.

reviews.author: unpasaporteparados
reviews.title: ¡Luna de miel de ensueño!
reviews.text:
Y por esa razón, comienzo dando las GRACIAS y en mayúsculas. 

Gracias a todo el equipo humano que hay delante y detrás, ultimando cada mínimo detalle para que tu experiencia paradisus sea siempre la esperada. Y cuando tu experiencia va más allá... ¡superas cualquier expectativa que pudieses tener de tu estancia! Y eso fue exactamente lo que nos pasó... 

Tanto mi marido como yo no queremos olvidarnos de: Laudis Rodríguez, quién atendió todos nuestros desayunos en Palazzo, siempre atenta a nuestros gustos y vicios mañaneros para prepararlos sin tener ni que pedírselo. Edison Alcántara, un gusto las charlas con él en el lobby bar sobre nuestro lujo más preciado, el ron. 

Eso sí, os aseguramos que vivir y saborear el ron a través de Cheytan Baez es una auténtica locura. Su pasión por aquello que hace, provoca que el mínimo lujo de cualquier persona se convierta en un pecado reincidente. 

Y como no, Ralphy Justo... nuestro concierge. ¡Atención impecable y excepcional las 24 horas del día! Santiago, Adriane... ¡me faltan las palabras!

Las vistas de la habitación, insuperables. Solíamos dejar las cortinas entreabiertas para no perdernos ni un amanecer. ¿Un restaurante? ¡Todos! Aunque reconocemos que las comidas en el restaurante Brisas ganaron por goleada al resto, y es que también con el encanto y la atención de Marta era fácil decidir ☺️. 

Un 10 a la organización y los protocolos establecidos dentro del hotel con respecto a la COVID. Todos los restaurantes disponen de mascarillas a su entrada, gel hidroalcohólico y guantes para la zona de buffet.

Recomiendo reservar atributo "The Reserve". ¡Vale mucho la pena 😃! Lounge y restaurantes exclusivos, piscina privada y zona de la playa reservada. 

Ubicado excelente, a primera línea de playa. 

Y es que el lujo, ¡si puede estar al alcance todos!

reviews.author: Jon A
reviews.title: Excepcional trato de Olvi
reviews.text: La atención de Olvi Almonte y José Ramos ha sido excepcional! Da gusto encontrarse con gente así en un viaje tan especial! Además del trato que ha sido lo mejor de este restaurante, la comida también ha estado a la altura de un buen italiano! Muy bien

reviews.author: Paula
reviews.title: Restaurante Sal - Andrea Santana
reviews.text: La comida espectacular desde los entrantes hasta los postres. Además, el personal nos ha dado un trato espléndido, especialmente Andrea Santana que nos ha tratado de la mejor manera posible y ha hecho de nuestra cena una mucho mas divertida.

reviews.author: Alejandra T
reviews.title: Restaurante Sal - Andrea Santana
reviews.text: Un restaurante excelente, tanto por su comida como por su servicio. La comida con muy buena presentación y además buenísima. Sobre el servicio destacar la atención de Andrea Santana, por su implicación en la cena y habernos regalado una velada llena de risas.

reviews.author: Lulu C
reviews.title: Buen servicio
reviews.text: He recibido servicio por Olga Martinez , fue genial , Edisson excelente en coctel , walquiria y alta gracia en el lobby bar todo muy bien . Felicidades muy recomendados me sentí como en casa , recomendación total

reviews.author: Priscila P
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Excellent service! All of the staff was super friendly and always happy to help us. The food was also great! The rooms are really nice with great amenities. The beach is big with lots of space for both relaxing and having fun. Huge shoutout to Yesica Reyes, Susy (from the welcoming team), Tomas Rosario, Sanyo Acosta, Jesús Hazen. Thank you!

reviews.author: Cynthia P
reviews.title: ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ 5 Star Service
reviews.text: The service here is at Paradisus Palma Real is beyond exceptional. Tomas Rosario, Sanyi Acosta, and Jesus Hazen were our amazing hosts who were attentive, professional, and hospitable. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Carolina F
reviews.title: Servicio de bar y camareros en Bar Avenue
reviews.text: Excelente servicio y atención por parte del personal del Bar Avenue, en la Plaza Colonial. Muchas gracias a Margia, Lucia, Jovidania, Altagracia y Yiri Silvestre, por ser tan amables y dispuestas a ayudar, da gusto estar aquí.

reviews.author: The T Couple
reviews.title: Excelente vacaciones
reviews.text: Llegar a este hotel es para nosotros llegar al Paraíso. No importa si está soleado o este lluvioso. Es hermoso, relajante y llena de paz el solo disfrutar las ambiente chic y minimalista de este lugar. Los upgrades que han realizado en el tiempo q estuvo cerrado por la Pandemia hace de que su nombre sea lo se proyecta. Quiero resaltar al Director de atención al socio Gabriel Bobadilla que su manejo en las  atenciones, su profesionalismo y la calidad de ser humano es impresionante. Nos ha hecho sentir q llegamos a casa. Queremos dar las gracias a la administración del hotel por su designación en el cargo q desempeña. También las gracias a la Directora Adrianne por su cuidado de que nuestra estadía fuera inolvidable. También a Mariangel Sánchez, Thalía Paulino por todo su profesionalismo en nuestro encuentro para la organización de la boda de mi hija, haciendo de este encuentro un proceso divertido, hermoso y familiar. Muy muy conocedora de todo lo q mi hija desea para su gran día. Paradisus Palma Real seguirá siendo mi destino preferido para vacacionar. Invito a que lo tomen en cuanta como primera opción para sus vacaciones. Hermoso, usando estrictamente las reglas de seguridad por la pandemia, un staff Excellente, la comida y restaurantes la mejor. Gracias.

reviews.author: Luis Arturo
reviews.title: Servicio
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio en el lobby bar y en hotel general.

Los empleados que nos atendieron fueron
Jessica
Altagracia cruz
Ariel
Erickson
Walkidia
Lillian 

Nos brindaron excelente atención, muy amigables!!

reviews.author: Amy Young
reviews.title: A Fantastic Resort with Amazing Employees
reviews.text:
I am a Corporate Events Manager in the Automotive Industry who is a HUGE FAN of the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.  I hosted an incentive program from 8/2 - 8/8/21 for 75 people....and every single one of my attendees was extremely complimentary about their stay at this resort.  I did not receive any negative feedback other than they wished they could stay longer!

Personally, my favorite part was the wonderful staff that made our stay magical.  Specifically:

Edgar Mejia - If you have the occasion to plan a group trip to the Paradisus Palma Real, please request Edgar.  In the 15 years I have been planning trips, he was hands down the best Group Coordinator I have ever had.  

Karolina Encarnacion - Karolina is the Spa and Wellness Manager.  She took incredible care with my guests and ensured that they had the most wonderful experience at the Spa on property.  Her staff is very friendly and the spa offers top notch treatments in a beautiful, clean, and relaxing environment.

Thalia - Thalia was present at every gathering for my group, making sure it went off without a hitch.  During down time, she stopped by to see if I needed anything and to make sure that all of my guests were happy AND HEALTHY!  Thalia personally escorted one of my guests to the clinic when he was in need of antibiotics after realizing he left his back at home!

Martin Tineo - Martin was our pool & beach concierge at the Adults Only Pool.  The lengths he went to for our group's happiness absolutely need to be called out.  Martin worked tirelessly filling all of the special requests from our attendees.  He did a fantastic job.  Please go see Martin if you are on property!

Wanda - Wanda was our bartender at the Adult's Only Pool.  I wish that I could have bottled Wanda's personality, sense of humor, and work ethic to bring home with me.  She got to know our guests quickly over the 5 days they spent at the Paradisus Palma Real and proactively made sure they were happy and taken care of.  I have had 7 of my attendees email me about how great Wanda was since we returned to the United States!

I am 100% happy and grateful for this beautiful property and the caring people that are employed at this resort.

From the clean rooms, to the wonderful food and restaurants, to the soft sandy beach....I could not have asked for a more perfect experience.

I absolutely recommend the Paradisus Palma Real for a group business or personal / family stay.

reviews.title: Beautiful Place

In the buffet, we always tried to sit in Yanira Sosa's area, as she was very attentive, and was very sweet.  Overall a great experience!

reviews.author: MariaC
reviews.title: Another great trip!
reviews.text:
So this is my 4th trip staying at one of the Paradisus resorts. Super clean! Staff is very friendly.  Thank you Lissette, my concierge for taking care of us.  Also everyone in the kids club for keeping my nephew Cristiano busy! 😊
The spa was great! My massage was super relaxing. 
I would (and have already) recommend any of the Paradius resorts.  The Palma is great because it is directly on the beach. 
Pools are very clean, pool guys spend hours a day cleaning them and constantly testing water.

Food was good, they did have a lot of variety at buffet.
The restaurants were great. Sal was my favorite!! 

They are definitely taking COVID seriously. Everyone should feel safe going there. They took temps of all of us as soon as we arrived and sanitizer/masks were available everywhere on resort. 
Even took temperature of my nephew when he would enter and exit kids club.

We would 100% return to this resort.

reviews.author: Jesus H
reviews.title: Son espectaculares
reviews.text: Si usted viene a Punta Cana puede quedarse en este hotel con confianza. usted va a ser excelentemente atendido. No tengo manera de no estar satisfecha de los operadores de la línea  de atención al cliente. A las muchachas que limpian las habitaciones. A los muchachos que te atienden en los restaurantes. Hasta los que venden la membresía de Melia fueron excelentes con nosotros. Llegue el 2 de agosto y cuando iba a regresar tome la prueba del Covid. Mi esposo y yo dimos positivos. Yo entre en pánico porque mi hijo va a tener un baby pronto y me había dicho que no viajara que después iba a tener que hacer cuarentena. Yo conté los días y vi que me daba tiempo y viaje. Pensé que iba a tener muchos problemas con esta mi nueva condición, pero un éxito total haber puesto todo en manos de este hotel No pueden imaginarse como el sistema que ellos ya tienen planificado funciono a la perfección. No ha fallado nada. No lo podía creer. Hasta las muchachas que me hicieron las pruebas del Covid no pudieron ser más amables y profesionales con nosotros porque no pudieron más. En general me han consentido inclusive cancelando la excursion que tenia al dia siguiente devolviendo todo el dinero. Lastima no pudimos darnos los masajes pero les prometo que cuando acabe esta tormenta de epidemia VOLVERE y muy agradecida con todos.. Aqui todavía estoy en mi cuarto esperando que mi prueba del covid me de negativa. Aqui menciono algunos nombres de los que recuerdo. Roxani del servicio de asistencia a habitaciones.. Juan Carlos encargado de hacer los procedimientos para el covid. Oliver. Juan del buffett. La muchacha que limpio mi habitación 1211 me dijo su nombre y por tener mi cabeza mala con todo esto no recuerdo bien pero esta mañana parásita en la parte de abajo del edificio me oyo hablando por teléfono y me llamo para saber como estaba. La muchacha que limpio la  habitación de mi mamá 3211. También Mario que estaba junto a Juan Carlos para ayudarlo. Tengo muchos nombres más. El que me busco la excursión Bony y Roberto. La encargada de ayudar al manager a buscarnos las reservas en los restaurantes que fue difícil porque eramos un grupo de 20 personas.  Bueno en fin todos en general. Destaco la limpieza de las instalaciones y la preparación y presencia de los alimentos. Los invito a venir a este hotel. Gracias a todos.

reviews.author: Mark Noh
reviews.title: Resort: paradisus Palma real
reviews.text: The trip went very well and our family really enjoyed our stay. Our concierge Ernesto Guerrero was very helpful and kind. Alejandro Rivera also known as happy boy made the activities fun and enjoyable for everyone. His attitude towards the kids and families was amazing.

reviews.author: Luiant
reviews.title: Amazing experience at this resort! Five stars!
reviews.text:
We visited this hotel for a week in June from June 16-June 23. We had the most amazing experience.  We were a large group who came to celebrate my niece’s birthday.  We were about 70 people.  The hotel reservations team was so helpful handling the reservations for such a large group.  The staff there were all so friendly and accommodating.  The check in experience went smoothly thanks to Daniel and Katherine Genao at the Club VIP check in.  

Our concierges Alejandro Restituyo and Zenovia Nova were available 24-7.  They went beyond their call of duty each day to make sure every request and needs from everyone in our group were handled promptly.  They were particularly helpful arranging for our pre-departure Covid tests.  They were both there helping out until the end as we were waiting for our transportation to airport.  I am forever thankful to Alejandro and Zenovia for making our vacation and special occassion so memorable and so smoothly.

The suites were amazing. We took a master double suite by the beach.  Everything was so clean.  The cleaning staff did a great job sanitizing the suite daily.  The fridge was always stocked with full size drinks and snacks.  

The buffet and food options were good.  The buffet was clean and masks and gloves were required.  I felt that the variety of buffet was not great but our concierges Alejandro and Zenovia made sure we always had reservations for restaurants for dinner.  At the buffet, our server Jesus “Chiquito” was amazing.  He was always attentive and came often to check on our group.  If something was not available he would go get it somewhere else.  He treated us like family.

The beach and pool were amazing.  Luis the bartender at the main pool made awesome drinks.  Ask him for his Mambo No. 5 cocktail which had some natural passion fruit.  It was so tasty! 

We will definitely be returning to this hotel.  The highlight was the personal attention and excellent service provided from the staff.  Everyone treated us so nicely.  I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: NAI
reviews.title: Wonderful staff and amazing views.
reviews.text:
I had an amazing time at the resort. I stayed for 7 days for a sisters trip. Pulling up to the resort, we were wowed by how beautiful it was. Our room was in the villa, and came with a washing machine and kitchenette (although we didn't use them). The staff was extremely friendly and very helpful. We had amazing service the whole time we were there. I am both dairy and gluten free and the restaurants were extremely accommodating - the hibachi restaurant even had gluten free soy sauce on hand, and the Italian restaurant had GF pasta. 

Although everyone was great, our experience was definitely made better by a select few of the staff.  Alejandro (Happy boy) and Jairo were OUR FAVORITE people there. Dance lessons with them were super fun and my sisters and I learned a lot. They were really great, especially at night during the parties at Gabi beach - they made sure to try and include everyone and keep the atmosphere lively and exciting. Jairo was also really great in all the water activities. Rosa Perez (the hostess at buffet) was extremely welcoming every morning that we went down for breakfast, and she knew who we were by the second day. Andrea, who was our waitress in Vento and then again at the buffet was bubbly, welcoming, friendly, and ensured we had everything we needed. And finally, if you are a coffee addict, then please go see Criseida Ramirez in the lobby bar. Her coffee was some of the best we had.

reviews.author: Bianca E
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real! 10/10!
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is definitely the place to stay at when you come to Punta Cana. The personnel is extremely kind and welcoming. The best restaurants in my opinion were Sal and Vento! Olio was very tasty as well. I recommend getting a mojito with white Brugal rum, it was refreshing and made with good liquor. Jose Ramos, captain of Olio restaurant, was great! He made sure we felt welcomed at every dinner. Our concierge Claritzel Otaño was great! She made all of our reservations for dinner and even planned a special anniversary dinner for my parents. Regarding COVID-19, I felt extremely safe since they had hand sanitizer stations all around the resort as well as disposable masks. They has security guards passing out masks to those who did not have one. For the buffet, they give you disposable gloves so that you never actually touch the handles or anything. Pedro Reyes, bell boy, was also a great guy! We enjoyed it so much we might make it a family tradition to visit Paradisus Palma Real every year. We can’t wait to come back! Goodbye for now Punta Cana!

The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real is an amazing All inclusive Resort. Its location by the beach and its facilities made our stay unforgettable. The staff, including our butler Eliazar were amazing, always going above and beyond their duties. Their signature restaurants were amazing, we definitely enjoyed dining at Las Brisas where we tasted an amazing Peruvian-Japanese menu that was as close as yin can get without being in Peru. Jesus, a waiter at Vento made a huge impression by partnering with the chef who prepared an amazing selection of especial dishes that made our night. 
Overall, The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real is the best resort we have ever stayed at, in fact, the Dominican Republic is in deed, an amazing and wonderful country worth of coming back for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Lana K
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text:
This resort is absolutely beautiful!

 Things that we liked here:
- Wonderful rooms, clean, spacious, with a gorgeous view and a bracelet-room key is the best invention ever!
- The best buffet! The food was delicious and fresh, and servers worked tirelessly!
- Kids Club - the staff was really great! Kids (ages 12. 9, 8 and 6) all wanted to go back there. So thankful to the Kids Club team for taking care of our kids!
- Face masks and sanitizers were available all the time
- Steak House had the best steaks I've ever tried and the lady at the check in was a sweetheart!
- Kids loved water parks and so did the adults :)
- Transportation service was always on time
- Staff was very courteous, friendly, and welcoming

Things that we didn't like, but it didn't ruin our vacation:
- We were supposed to get a butler service at another hotel in that resort, but due to covid weren't able to and were upgraded to this hotel. Too bad the resort wasn't able to provide this service here.
- Getting a reservation in a few restaurants was nearly impossible, or was available at a very late time. That's where a butler service would've been very useful and appreciated. 
- Food in a few restaurants was rather mediocre, and the service at some of them was very slow. We even saw one couple sitting at the next to us table taking off without getting their food after an hour waiting. Can't blame them when there's a delicious food at the buffet. 
- They didn't offer any evening entertainment except a musician playing outside and a circus show. We stayed at another resort prior to this one, and they had awesome shows(also outside) every evening, so we expected something similar. I understand that it's due to covid, so hopefully next time they will have it as well. 
- For half of our stay, the ac in our friends room wasn't working properly, and even though the staff fixed it once it kept breaking. 

What got us puzzled?
Why was there a full size bed in a women's bedroom? :) I guess we'll never know )))

Overall our stay was wonderful and we would love to come back!

reviews.author: Kt190
reviews.title: Amazing resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: My 4 kids and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for 8 days and it was wonderful.  The transportation from the airport was easy and on time(the hotel recommends Otium and they were great). Check in was easy.  The hotel grounds are gorgeous. Our room was perfect, everything worked, mini bar, safe, AC, tv, etc.  Lots of bottles of water but drinking the water at the restaurants was totally fine as well.  Luis at the pool swim up bar was AMAZING! My youngest who is 10 wanted to check out the kids club and that was great.  They had so many fun things planned for the kids every day.  You could go for an hour or all day, up to your kiddo.  The kids club staff was AMAZING!  Beach was beautiful, nice chairs with shade.  Ocean wasn't great, lots of seaweed but that's not something in the resorts control. We did one excursion through the hotel, ATV tour which was terrible.  Broken down/old equipment, didn't get to see the caves that was the tour, and drove around in circles for hours through a very poor village and ended up being way longer than we were told.  I would not recommend doing the ATV excursion, save your money and time. Food was ok, kinda bland but it's all inclusive so that's not surprising.  The staff at the hotel was so nice, friendly and accommodating. They had nightlife entertain  in the lobby area every night which was very good. This resort is very family friendly, grounds are well groomed, everything was clean, staff was very helpful. They took covid safety very serious at this resort. Masks and gloves in buffet, masks when ordering drinks at bar or if meeting with front desk staff.  Gym was great, pretty good variety of equipment for a hotel gym.  They took temperature and you had to wear a mask. Antigen testing was very easy and quick.  There were no bill surprises. If you can I would upgrade to the reserve room level, mini bar and room service are included in that. Great resort-highly recommend!

reviews.text: This was my first time to Punta Cana for my niece’s wedding.  From the moment we arrived, we were treated like royalty! Eduardo Peguero our butler went above and beyond to accommodate our every need.  All of the employees were extremely friendly, outgoing, and accommodating!  Pedro went above and beyond each morning to be sure we had everything we needed.  Melvin was amazing each day at breakfast to be sure our coffee was just right!!!!! Every single worker did their BEST to be sure we were all tended to and they did an Incredible job!!!! MOST of ALL my niece and nephew wedding was EPIC!!!!! It was truly a FAIRYTALE WEDDING come true!!!!!   The atmosphere throughout the entire day snd night was something that words cannot describe!!!!! It was just BREATHTAKING!!!!!! Our stay here was exactly a week in PARADISE!!!

reviews.author: Sophia A
reviews.title: Our wedding day/wedding week was phenomenal at Palma Real!
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with at Paradisus Palma Real! We would like to talk about outstanding service and from the moment we arrived until the moment we departed. 

My wife and I decided to choose Palma Real as a wedding venue (July 7th- July 14th) and had 40 guests stay on site. MARIANGEL SANCHEZ was our wedding coordinator and helped us every step of the way. She always responded to any request within the party and did a wonderful job accommodating such a big crowd. She was always so calm, organized and reassuring. We loved her! 

EDWARD PEGUERO was our Butler and he made ALL requests happen and seemed to always be present in the area. He was very personable and friendly. 

At Sal Restaurant ABRAHAM TORRES, or as we called him “Mr. Dessert,” was loved by the guests on multiple visits to Sal.

RAUL JIMINEZ, and MARIO DIAZ attended the group with whatever services were needed at the pool area.

The family particularly loved PEDRO’s energy at the beach/Reserve Pool Bar.

WILBER AND YOELLE did a phenomemnal job attending to us during our romantic dinner at the beach. 

JORGE ROA assisted during the wedding night by providing transportation for the bride and I back to the room during the wedding night.     

KAROLINA took care of all of my wife and bridesmaids Spa/Hair needs. She and her team were SOOOO KIND and did a beautiful job on their wedding hair. Ruth, Gladdy and Yeimi took care of all their spa needs and Juana and Maria took care of their hair. Juana did an exceptional job with my wife’s hair. She loved it!

FRANKLIN & GUSTAVO worked at Palazzo. They were both wonderful. Franklin was phenomenal. He went above and beyond with every request that our family had. 

We also loved Jose Dario from the Cigar store. 

The staff that worked our Welcome BBQ and Wedding night include the following individuals: Hector Abreu,  Lloelis Alvarez,   Aberson Nova,  Luis,     Franklin,    Luicia and  Juan Tomas. They were all wonderful!

reviews.author: MPL
reviews.title: The vacation we needed.
reviews.text: My Wife and I stayed here after having checked into a neighboring Punta Cana resort that was a disaster.  The service here exceeded my expectations and made what was potentially going to be a horrible vacation, one to rave upon. The check representative and welcome drink greeted us beautifully.  We were shown our room where they brought our luggage to us.  We then made our way to check the ground.  We were lucky to stay in the Reserve for adults but had access to the full grounds.  The hotel is trendy and appealing to the eye.  We landed in our Reserve area, deciding that we needed to shake off the last 2.5 days at the horror story “other hotel”.  We were greeted by the most professional, charming, intuitive bar staff.  If there was anything that made our vacation special and worth every penny was Pedro, Martin and Wanda!!!  The three of them were a phenomenal team that kept our cups full and truly makes me feel relaxed and at home.  Paradisus- you have a gem in Pedro; truly a treasure!  Our Butler Alvaro was very resourceful and assisted us in reserving our dinners and transportation home-a delight!  We decided to partake in dinner at the Buffett.  The selections were decent-our server was Wilmena-we asked for typical Dominican dishes that were not made available at the buffet.  Wilmena arranged for the cook to fix us a plate of goat and plantains-deeeelish!  Every employee there wants to do everything they can to make your stay tailored to you.  Wilmena is definitely a true professional-gracias!  We tried breakfast at the buffet as well-that left a bit to be desired.  I’m unsure if it’s a staffing issue but the food needed to be hotter and the mangu was disappointing (cebollas blancas!!!!-porque!!!?!?). The wait staff during breakfast tried, but I waited for butter and a spoon for my coffee just too long.  We left without eating the cooled food and went to the Palazzo at The Reserve to have our breakfast.  Traveling during the pandemic has been obviously a concern for all.  The first hotel we checked into had no real protocols in place-one of the turn offs that made us vacate and switch hotels.  At Paradisus, protocols are everywhere-we appreciated the heck out of that!  Gloves at the buffet, all wait staff masked, masks at the bar, etc.  if you don’t appreciate that or can’t abide by that then don’t patron any business that cherishes their employees safety and that of their clients!  Entertainment nightly in the large Colonial Square was cool but ended at 11.  Entertainment staff was friendly and engaging and the bar staff there were lovely-Darlin (super sweet), Olga-who helped my down the steps with drinks when the Colonial Square bar was full (super professional and attentive), and Lucia one of the bar tenders.  Lucia made me a delicious Parcha Mojito on my last night there-sadly, I left yearning for another.  Adriel at Sal was the host with the most-he made our dining experience beyond pleasurable.  There was another gentleman that would pass by all these areas, day and night, all in black.  He’d smile under his mask and ask if everything was alright.  By our last night there, we noticed him again because, “who was that masked man?”  Super professional and seemed to enjoy his job-Hector-Bar Supervisor-kudos to you Sir, your staff is a reflection of the image you portray for Paradisus-great job!  Fausto and Gustavo at the Palazzo restaurant were trie gentlemen and professional….they had a typical mangu made for us sending us home as happy campers!  Thank you all for such a delightful vacation.  We returned to NYC relaxed, re-centered but super ready to go back!
