reviews.author: Rishi C
reviews.title: Great vacation for Club members
reviews.text:
A week at Paradisus Punta Cana to remember!

Full disclosure, we are Club Melia members so we don’t expect much, but this trip exceeded expectations. A really caring and attentive staff made us feel special. Special thanks to our concierge, Wily Mercado, the hostess Niurka Espinada, and the bar guys at the Reserve pool. 

Our lower tier club membership put us in an older building, but it was close to the Reserve pool and the beach. The check in staff described it as partial ocean view, but it had a fantastic ocean view! We were so happily surprised. 

I think the biggest happy surprise was that each and every thing we asked for was happily done — down to the spotty WiFi in our room. Wily had someone come and fix it while we were at the beach — they put a whole new router in the bedroom, and that was such a help when I had to do work calls one morning! I am so thankful to Wily for that. 

The food was surprisingly good — we had hibachi the first night which is a great way to start the trip. We tended to avoid peak hours and go earlier for meals which I think helped. Also the staff wants to help you, just ask them! They’ll do it. 

My only complaint is minor: since this is sort of a collection of resorts, there are places that are “off limits” if you don’t have a certain color bracelet. However, they’re not well defined and the staff is stuck telling you that you can’t get food at one beach bar versus the other. Honestly, we still got our food — but if you’re going to make certain places “exclusive,” be clear about it. 

The Covid protocols seemed appropriate (masks and gloves at buffet stations and when indoors) but the entire staff kept their masks on all over the property. Much appreciated and again shows their dedication. 

Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Kimberly J
reviews.title: Vacation!!
reviews.text: We had the best time!! These guys were the best. Willy the Butler handled everything for us down to bandaids and toothpaste ( you always forget something….right!) Then Raul the swim up bar bartender never let our cups get empty. He even walked around the pool and through the bushes to make sure we were hooked up!! Then Jordan at the Japanese Steak House not only entertained us but  made us laugh and OMG his food was AMAZING! If you are headed here ask for these three guys- you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Adolfo J
reviews.title: Corporate Event
reviews.text:
We just finalized a five days retreat. Overall superb experience. Location, setting, maintenance and all space were clean and ordered. Rooms of great quality. 

But what makes the difference is the warm and direct personal service we received. Alejandro Restituyo made the event to flow perfectly even in early starts, with a professional and warm connection at any time day or night ready to assist in our needs.
 
Yesica Reyes provided a personalize and outstanding support, from scheduling dinners to taking care of transportation and PCR. since 7 am till 10 pm we saw nothing but a smile in her face.

Having the quality of service Alejandro and Yesica provided, offered me the gift  of been connecting with special people.  Thank you all.

reviews.author: Hugo A
reviews.title: Fantastic time!
reviews.text: I am staying at Paradisus Palma Real right now  and I am having an amazing time.  The pool and beach are beyond beautiful.  All restaurants are really good and the buffets are veey impressive.  Gleny, at Naos restaurants is AWESOME.  She cannot be any nicer and has made every dinner fantastic!  We cannot wait to come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Felix P
reviews.title: Fabulous Experience!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a wonderful vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.
Can’t say enough good about this place.
Upon arrival we had a small issue with the room assigned but the front desk team , I want to mention here Jose Vargas, Emely Moran and Wally Pena, immediately took care of our issue.  We were upgraded to another suite, one of the best of the hotel, thank you .
From the minute we stepped onto the property, to the minute we left, everything was wonderful. The ocean front butler / personal concierge  suite in The Reserve section ( Panoramic Building) was comfortable and appointed nicely, and the view from the balcony was breathtaking. Our butler / personal concierge, Ariel Benzo, took great care of us. 
All the staff enjoy conversation and making you feel at home.
We always had comfortable loungers at the pool and the beach, and the pool staff were always there to take care of our every day need .
The hotel is just beautiful - the grounds are so lush, clean and well-kept. The beach was also clean and very inviting with the palapas and cabanas. 
All of the dining venues were great and the servers were pleasant and professional. FYI, our favorite restaurant was Sal the steak house and our favorite server was Adriel !
We loved our stay here.
 I can't wait to come back to this beautiful property!

reviews.author: sabrina a
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: The paradisus real is a beautiful resort! All staff is welcoming and accommodating. I would highly recommend this resort for a vacation stay. Paradisus Real has great entertainment, and delicious food!

reviews.author: Jake G
reviews.title: Paradisa Palma Real vacation
reviews.text:
Really had a great time at the resort. Omar was especially helpful. He was always there for us and  gave us a special tour around the different facilities. Make sure you ask for Omar Hasbun when you are here!  Also, when you stop at the bar, Edison is the best Bartendar and makes incredible drinks. Thanks to our butler Eli and Delhi’s our concierge. 

Pedro, Martin and Wanda at the sunset bar were excellent as well and would highly recommend you spend time in their area.

reviews.author: Delvis M
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus  Palma Real, Punta Cana . Dominican Republic.
reviews.text:
I Went alongside my wife, our two sons and three grand children; son in love, daughter in love and our son in love ‘s mother to Paradisus Palma Real Meliá Punta Cana Dominican Republic and our experience there was just amazing.
What a beautiful resort!. 
Children enjoyed it the most and we all were so happily  that we simply recommend it to everyone.
Truly from a happy guest:

Mr. Delvis Morales

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: Hotel paradisus palma real
reviews.text: Muy bueno excelente las atenciones, las medidas contra el covid-19 todo ordenado higiénico. Desde las personas que cargan con las maletas hasta la gerencia hacen un equipo excelente. Tengo un bebé que le celebramos su primer añito en el restaurant de una vez la silueta de bebé. Waooo son super.

reviews.author: brad
reviews.title: Outstanding service
reviews.text: My wife, daughter and I visited in June. One of the highlights of the trip was visiting with Wanda at the reserve bar. Wanda is a fantastic asset to this property. While her drinks are fantastic, her service is top of the line. We always look forward to reconnect with Wanda when we return to the property.

reviews.author: Voyager312694
reviews.title: Family vacation 2021
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 7 night vacation at Paradisus Palma Real, The Reserve. We really enjoyed the setting which is calm, peaceful and beautiful. We had two rooms, both oceanfront suites. The views were gorgeous. Our concierge Ralphie was awesome. He set our reservations for dinner, made recommendations, helped us with excursions, golf and even sent us the daily activities list and restaurant menus. Anything we needed he was available and always friendly to help. The pool area was large and there were plenty of chairs and cabanas every day. Wanda at Sunset Bar was the best! Gabi  Beach  is a beautiful outdoor area that overlooks the ocean. We enjoyed relaxing here for breakfast or just grabbing a quick drink. 
The food could use a little improvement, but we found a few things we enjoyed and stuck with that most of the week. Beachside burgers, fresh made omelets and room service Mac and cheese were at the top of the list for my teens. The fresh fruits, avocado  toast were my morning go to at the Palazzo. As a family, We enjoyed Sal, the steak restaurant, the hibachi grill and Olio (Italian, fresh made pizza’s). Service was great with most of the staff, but not always. If you don’t speak Spanish communication with some restaurant staff can be very difficult.

reviews.author: Jaime A
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at this resort. Our concierge, Jose S. is the best. From day one, he helped us with literally everything from restaurant RSVP to spa appointment and everything in between. I would highly recommend this resort and Jose. It was beautiful, the grounds were clean, the pools, bars, beach, food was all readily available.

reviews.author: Jim M
reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text: Very good. Jonathan and Darlin were great. The atmosphere was nice. Jonathan was very knowledgeable with the wines. I would recommend the tour and fee wine tasting. The cheese board and meats were good too. Thank you.

reviews.author: Omgitzfern
reviews.title: Avenue Lounge is Amazing
reviews.text: Lucia and the night time crew at Avenue Lounge were super attentive. They knew our drink orders after ONE time ordering, awesome crew! Head there after dinner for a good time. Dancing right in front by the dance crew. It was a blast

reviews.author: nidia b
reviews.title: Excelente attencion
reviews.text: Hector montes muy querido muy amable gusto haverlos conocido nos ayudo mucho muy buena persona. Restaurantes excellente y muy buena attencion la limpiesa muy buena. Restaurantes vento muy buena comida  Restaurantes  mina muy bien. Kao y palazzo  de maravilla!!!!!+

reviews.author: Olivia N
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones!!!
reviews.text: Definitivamente recomendamos este hotel. Pasamos unos dias maravillosos, el servicio fue excelente, el personal del hotel se desvive por atenderte y hacerlo con gusto, desde la Manager Mayte, el concierge Edward que estuvo al tanto de nuestras inquietudes toda la semana, cualquiera de los chicos de servicio, en especial las muchachas de la noche en el bar Avenue de la Plaza (Yobi, Alta Gracia y no recuerdo el nombre de la tercera), la muchacha del bar Gabi Beach frente a la playa en las mañanas, las chicas de limpieza de habitaciones, en fin todos. Los restaurantes especializados lo mismo, una delicia los platos y un servicio espectacular, especialmente el chef del restaurante Japones y el de Brisas que nos prepararon unos platos deliciosos. Vento restaurante tambien muy bueno. El buffet tambien con amplia variedad de comida, frutas, ensaladas, mariscos, carne, etc. Nos comentaron que recien estaban comenzando las actividades nocturnas, pues estaba todo en pausa por el Covid y regulaciones del gobierno del pais y con tan buena suerte todos los dias tuvimos una que otra actividad en la noche: Noche Latina, Noche Dominicana, Fiesta del Silencio con audifonos, Fiesta Neon, entre otras. Es un hotel precioso, con unas areas donde disfrutas al maximo la brisa del caribe. Con gusto repetiriamos la visita, ojala pueda ser pronto!!!

reviews.author: Konata F
reviews.title: Renewal 25th
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here since the resort first opened. The Reserve area we used to is not the same; it was on the Palm Real side instead of the Reserve side. We were charged the Reserve rate but didn’t get the Reserve quality. However, the bartender Wanda and the service of Pedro was simply outstanding. They really need to get the Reserve open. Once you get the true Reserve service, you’ll understand.

reviews.author: Greg A
reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: Ariel Benzo was our liaison and he was EXCELLENT!!!  Ariel went beyond the call of duty to make us feel comfortable! First class all of the way! We can’t eat to come back to the Paradisus Real Resort in Punta Cana!!!

reviews.author: Sandra V
reviews.title: Vacaciones paradisiacas en Paradisus 2021
reviews.text:
Pasamos unos días maravillosos a pesar de toda la situación mundial con el Covid. La manager Mayte, el concierge Edward y el personal de servicio nos ayudaron en cada inquietud o necesidad que tuvimos. Las muchachas del bar de la plaza fueron excepcionales, 
pero en general todos los bartenders estuvieron atendiéndonos constantemente. El chef de Brizas y de Tokimeku para mi fueron de los mejores. La comida deliciosa. El buffet fue muy variado y siempre había distintos panes, frutas y vegetales, carnes cocidas de modo diferente, jamón serrano, dulces sabrosos en fin…el listado es interminable porque tampoco pude probarlo todo o reventaría en el intento 😅.
Era evidente que el hotel se estaba comenzando a reorganizar tras las medidas del covid. Había muchos trabajadores nuevos que a veces no conocían bien los platos pero se notaba el esfuerzo por ayudar siempre al cliente. Justo la semana que llegamos pudieron volver a hacer actividades nocturnas en la Plaza. Nos explicaron que aun no era posible poner música en la piscina por medidas ajenas al hotel relacionadas con el país. Se echaba de menos una musiquita en la piscina pero como cada día están cambiando las cosas imagino que pronto podrán ponerla al igual que abrir el casino. Cada día hacían distintas actividades como yoga, zumba, ejercicios de gimnasia, la animación en general fue buena. En la noche también, un día Party Neon, otro Noche Dominicana, hasta conocía la Fiesta del Silencio que para mi fue toda una novedad (tengo 34 pero aun no conocía eso, creo que ya no estoy al tanto de las tendencias en moda, fue divertido ver a la gente bailando con sus audífonos de colores). 
Una de mis sugerencias sería abrir algún snack/bar que trabaje toda la noche o al menos hasta las 4am y que vuelvan a incluir varios tipos de cerveza, de momento solo habia la Presidente. on respecto a las habitaciones eran espaciosas, nosotros tuvimos una master suite con vista a la piscina y a la playa buenísima, cerca de dos piscinas, del buffet y de 2 restaurantes. Tenia una cocina amplia bastante equipada, aunque no era mi intención usarla con la comida rica que estaba a mi disposición todo el día. 
El hotel es precioso, de hecho creo que es el que tiene la Plaza más linda con respecto a Melia Beach y Gran Cana. Un plus es que te dan servicio de limpieza a la habitación todos los días y digo Plus porque tras el Covid aun muchos hoteles se niegan a ofrecerlo aun cuando el cliente esté dispuesto a que le entren a la habitación. Por lo tanto siempre tuvimos habitaciones higiénicas, organizadas y limpias. 
Los maleteros y el servicio de transporte entre hoteles fue eficiente. Los niños pudieron disfrutar del parque de agua, se divirtieron mucho y los adultos junto con ellos la pasamos bomba. Allí también tienen un restaurancito con un menú variado. 
Por otro lado, el hotel te ayuda con las reservaciones de las excursiones, y te aconsejan sobre los riesgos de hacerlas con agencias privadas separadas del hotel. Yo tomé dos a través del hotel y la experiencia fue positiva. Isla Saona es bien bonita, y también la excursión de los delfines. De cualquier modo Habra otras más de acuerdo con los intereses individuales. 
Muchas gracias por todo, por recibirnos en su paraiso terrenal con seguridad ya regresaremos.

reviews.author: William A
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia!
reviews.text: He tenido una de las mejores experiencias vacacionales en Punta Cana. Definitivamente lo recomendaria. Tuvieron un buen protocolo de seguridad contra el Covid-19, limpieza y sobre un excelente servicio al cliente.

reviews.author: Mailmanmike60
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real June 2021
reviews.text: We visited the hotel June 13 through the 19th , we used optium private transfer company to the hotel and back, Price was $88 round-trip, this was our second trip back to the hotel so we brought a few of our friends along , with Covid there was some restrictions but all the restaurants were open which were excellent highly recommend reservations we use concierge Lewis de la Cruz, We would highly recommend him, we spoke daily and he was on top of everything that was requested, very knowledgeable of the facility and off the grounds, also spoke with Alvaro M Fernandez about excursions off the ship, The grounds were beautiful , the pools also , some small issues with the beach with the sea grass but they did maintain it the best they could , There was some Covid restrictions one being when you went to the Buffet you were given a pair of gloves when entering , The Buffet has a huge selection of items and was a excellent choice for breakfast and lunch daily , also some activities at night but not as much as last time we visited , The pool bar was not open in the pool seating area , But there was enough waiters walking around to order a drink or two, we also spoke to a Rafeal Luis who also was very helpful during our stay , we would highly recommend any of these three for your travel needs, Lewis de la cruz made our week stay enjoyable and memorable and we can’t wait to go visit this excellent hotel in the future, we would highly recommend , oh , Covid test was required and we did it at the hotel 72 hrs prior to leaving , we had our results within 15 minutes, paperwork was given to us for return home

reviews.author: Cristina Soto
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: El servicio excelente, son muy amables todos los que nos atendieron, en la llegada la simpatía de Daniel, luego en la piscina y actividades nos llevamos la alegria de Andy, el buen servicio de Raul en la barra, nuestro mesero estrella que nos brindó el mejor servicio que pudiéramos recibir Jesus Robles. Por supuesto Wily Mercado que nos facilitó la vida en todo momento lo volvería a recomendar, siempre dispuesto para nosotros a toda hora. Todos muy simpáticos, encantada volvería.

reviews.author: Nicole R
reviews.title: Family Vacation!
reviews.text: Andy was great! The yoga is so nice and the entertainment at night was so much fun. He was very attentive and remembered our names and always said hi when he would see see us. And the pool activities were amazing!!

reviews.author: Norma R
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Happy Boy & Andy Arias and their. Few make our trip so much fun, dancing all night long, Zumba, salsa lessons, sunset yoga and the their show at night are awesome,  my second trip with my extended family,  I highly recommend the Melia Resorts.

reviews.author: Germel H
reviews.title: Just like Paradise!!
reviews.text: My family and I recently stayed at the Paradisus Real Palma Golf resort and it was absolutely heaven! The resort was large, beautiful and the rooms were clean and spacious. The food was good and plentiful at the buffet however, a bit bland which is understandable because the have to cook for a lot of people. Making reservations at the restaurants is a must. Of course the best part of the resort is the staff! From entry to exit they all make you feel really welcome with much passion and grace! Special thanks to the bartender Altagracia Cruz for crafting delicious cocktails and beverages! You helped make my birthday very special! Luis Rodriguez at the buffet who is the best server I think I every had. Katty and Ralphy too, thank you! I would highly recommend this resort to anyone that wants to celebrate a special day/occasion with family or has small children. I can't wait to return next year!

reviews.author: Karen S
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Great fabulous I love Lewis!!!! He was extremely helpful. I would want him again next time we come and highly recommend him to others. Made the vacation very enjoyable and stress free. Definitely would come back!

reviews.author: Nabil S
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Louis was very very helpful I would recommend him to anybody he made our stay Super comfortable and he attended to all our needs. He came every day just to make sure everything was OK once in the morning at once in the afternoon and every time I text messaged him he answered very quickly and he made sure everything was A-OK he took care of the dinner reservation for us since we were a group of 17 people. Need to care for a very efficiently and quickly and it’s very professional way

reviews.author: Kelly H
reviews.title: Yoiner at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Yoiner made our trip to Punta Cana!!  He set up all activities and dinners. He even helped us when we wanted to leave the hotel for a meal and souvenir shopping. It took two days to connect with him as the hotel didn’t have our reservation down correctly, but he provided excellent service and really made our trip after the mix up by the hotel. We traveled with friends and our two boys, he went the extra mile to bring them some authentic Dominican foods, like chocolate, plantain chips, fresh fruit and Dominican Oreos!   Thank you Yoiner!

reviews.author: Blake C
reviews.title: Great vayccation
reviews.text: Gurado is the best worker here. He made my stay the best that it could be. He is a great worker and a great friend. He made me and my family feel very welcome and we will be back. He is the best worker in the whole resort

reviews.author: pressd
reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.text:
We loved our time here! 
We were supposed to come here for my brother’s wedding last year, but it had to be cancelled due to COVID. Took a big family trip this year and it was perfect. From the shuttle picking us up to our time at the resort, everything was taken care of & all the staff were wonderful. Jesus Peguero was a huge help in navigating the resort, setting up appts for us and making us feel at ease and Sussy helped with check in and taking care of all our needs with the room. All in all, we would definitely come back and visit.

reviews.author: nanistravels
reviews.title: Punta cana 2021
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice. Originally we booked the level at Melia caribe beach, supposedly was closed so they moved us to the paradisus Palma real. The pool is huge. They have a few pools so you can choose. Make sure you walk around with a mask inside of the hotel. The check in process could be better a few mix ups with the rooms and they separated us so I was not happy about that. We were a big family so we occupied 6 rooms. The service in the rooms could be better. We have to keep calling to get things done. We actually had to be changed from our room because the tv’s didn’t work properly and the sofa in the living room was to old. You couldn’t even sit there. For the money we payed I expected better. They changed my room and we were fine. Not the wow factor we expected.
They assigned us a butler that was amazing!! Edward Peguero he was the star of our trip!! And anything we needed he got it done from reservations to the restaurants to the minimum details to make us comfortable. He simply made sure everything was done for us. He is a very valuable asset to the hotels and very knowledgeable.
The food in the buffet was outstanding we have two servers that were amazing Luis and jesus!! We ate at a few restaurants and the chef jordan was excellent! 
The pools are lacking good bartenders the drinks were not as good as the main bar in the lobby so we starting asking for the ingredients separate and making our own drinks. The days at the pool were awesome. And we had a server by the pool named jesus that took care of us and was simply amazing as well. 
We did parasailing around the beach and we bought some souvenirs that locas were selling. The service by the beach was ok not that great and was not happy that we had to pay 30$ for the cabanas! 
The beach was not that good because it was full of algae they have it blocked but it doesn’t look inviting. 
Overall the experience was really good with the help of Edward. 
We did the 90 minute presentation and love what the new circle Melia has to offer. So we bought!! 
Not much to do around punta cana but the tours away from there were amazing!! 
If you have any questions or need any recommendations inbox me I will be happy to be of service!
Thank you!

reviews.author: Ana Beatriz S
reviews.title: Macrame workshop - very nice!
reviews.text: The workshop we took today was with Yubi. She is very thoughtful and friendly and she taught us to do a keychain. She also has a lot of cute products. We had a lot of fun and it's nice to keep the things we created. I'd do it again! Geraldo, the assistant, is also very friendly and helped us do it all!

reviews.author: Ana Carolina H
reviews.title: Macrame Yubi
reviews.text: The lesson is really nice and it is really easy to learn! The teacher is friendly and careful and gave us all the support we needed. We had lot of fun in this exercise and definitely I’ll try to do it later

reviews.author: Dan E
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
Fun quick macrame activity with Yubi.
The children and the adults really were engaged in the event. Geraldo from event activities was very engaging and upbeat I would definitely do this activity again. Some of the items we were able to make were keychains bookmarks earrings just to name a few.

reviews.author: sofia W
reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: it was so beautiful and i loved it!! The resort was amazing and everyone was so nice. all the entertainment was great! Geraldo Ramirez and Andy Arias were so great and super fun to be around. It was an amazing trip.

reviews.author: Sarah R
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
I have been to more than 5 different resorts in the Dominican- usually around Bavaro, but this was the best. 
Jose Salvador our concierge was amazing- he went out of his way multiple times to give us an unforgettable experience. One night we forgot to book dinner reservations so we tried 2 different places on our own and both were booked, we called him (after he left the resort for the night) and he managed to get us a last minute reservation at the steakhouse, Sal. He texted us good morning, asked us how we are doing, if we need anything, how dinner was the previous night and sent us the list of activities every day. He would periodically find us around the resort during the day just to check up on us and see if we needed anything. We brought a giant inflatable unicorn and he helped us carry him to the pool. Even as we were checking out of the hotel he met us at the lobby and spoke with our airport transportation person to clarify our pick up spot. From beginning to end he really facilitated a stress free trip for us. 

One of our major concerns before going out of country was covid testing. Jose made our appointment, printed out necessary paperwork and sent us an online link to use. The covid testing is on site at the hotel, takes 5 minutes start to finish and was a very simple process- especially with him to schedule it. 

At Sunset bar on the adults only side, which you can go to if you are booked under “the reserve at Paradisus palma real” was the best bartender- Wanda! Wanda was so fun, very welcoming and extremely accommodating. We would go to her for drinks regardless of where we were set up for the day. She made us unique and fun drinks, took amazing pictures for us and was so kind. 

Martin who is also a bartender at sunset would set up a spot for us with towels and a book, bring us drinks and made us feel very welcomed. He was very kind, funny and made us feel at home.

reviews.author: Aderlinda M
reviews.title: Mais melhores vacaciones
reviews.text: Muito lindo adrei muito. Nós Gusto mucho ele hotel Los restaurantes lá comida lá estrutura Pero sobre todo nuestro amigo Jesus muito amoroso gentil ele melhor es serviço Al cliente canta super lindo voz angelical

reviews.author: Madi V
reviews.title: wonderful resort, Jessica our butler was amazing!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here for 4 days. So beautiful and nice! Jessica was an AMAZING butler! Highly recommend! We stayed in the reserve section of the resort and had so much room! We also loved the buffet and hibachi!

reviews.author: Realidades- Erlyn
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente, calidad, servicios. Adonis Mercedez un persona sumamente eficaz y muchas vocación de servicios. El entretenimiento muy bueno y las variedades de las actividad con su popularidad Dominicana.👏👏👏👏👏

reviews.author: Carmen p
reviews.title: Mamajuana tropical
reviews.text:
Una semana maravillosa, no olvideis localizar a Jesus Peguero para que os deleite con su maravillosa voz y una cancion. Un placer de lugar para disfrutar del caribe tropical. 
Wanda y Pedro del Sunrise bar nos han tratado genial!!!

reviews.author: Josefernandezperez
reviews.title: Una semana maravillosa
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado una semana increíble mi mujer y yo. Todo ha sido perfecto, desde la entrada hasta la salida!!!! Muy recomendable para pasar unos días de máxima desconexión y alegria para el cuerpo. 
Graciss  a mi Jesus Peguero que nos ha tratado de escándalo!!!!

reviews.author: Francine S
reviews.title: Férias maravilhosas
reviews.text: Muito boas as férias no hotel paradisus, ambiente agradável, hotel maravilhoso, comida muito boa. Atendimento excelente de todos os funcionários Em especial do Geraldo Ramirez, nos tratou muito bem, muito prestativo e cordial.

reviews.author: jmoriggi
reviews.title: Férias em Punta Cana
reviews.text: Conhecemos muitas pessoas incríveis no Resort Paradisus, uma delas, Geraldo Ramirez. Muito simpático, atencioso e alegre. Nos proporcionou ótimas férias no resort e uma boa amizade. Esperamos voltar e reencontrá-lo novamente.

reviews.author: André Luís E
reviews.title: Just Chillin
reviews.text: Viemos a Punta Cana pela primeira vez, para conhecer o Caribe, fugir um pouco do frio Brasileiro e dar uma descansada do trabalho tbm. Acabamos conhecendo um dominicano muito simpático, conversamos bastante com ele, contamos um pouco da nossa história em Brasil e ele a dele aqui na Republica Dominicana. Nos atendeu muito bem e foi o mais querido de todos. O nome dele era Geraldo Ramirez.

reviews.author: Wilton E
reviews.title: Ótimos momentos
reviews.text:
Passamos ótimos momentos no Paradisus. O resort oferece diversos restaurantes, atividades, bom atendimento, os quartos são muito bons e grandes. 
O serviço tudo incluso nas áreas do resort funcionam muito bem. 
O funcionário Geraldo Ramirez muito prestativo e cativa para as realização das atividades.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
We went here for A family vacation. Our first time traveling since Covid started. The trip couldn’t have been any more wonderful. This resort is all inclusive and offers a beautiful property, great room, and wonderful staff.

The property itself is absolutely huge, and everything about it is wonderful. Beautiful views of the beach, the pools are spectacular, and the grounds are very pretty. Since it is large, You may either need to take a short walk to some areas like the waterpark, or you can easily have them take you on a golf cart. Either way was easy. It’s a wonderful place to go with the kids. Pools are massive and a lot of fun with interesting features. The water park was a huge hit. One of the things that I really liked was there was a large number of beach chairs and ample shade found everywhere.

We got a room with a separate bedroom and fold out couch. I have to be honest, the foldout couch wasn’t super comfortable, but our daughter didn’t notice and I had no problem with it. Otherwise the room was very spacious and extremely pleasant to be in. A television in the bedroom as well as the living room, although we never turned either on. 

The food was average to good. Definitely plenty of it. I thought the fruit was exceptionally delicious. We eat at some of the restaurants in the evening, and those all had a nice atmosphere.

Overall, one of the best things I can say, is how nice every single person who worked here was. They all went above and beyond and everyone was exceptionally kind.

I will say, there were some aspects of the property that were a little bit worn. Nothing that made our stay was pleasant, and all seem like they could be fixed with a bit of TLC.

Our butler was José. He was wonderful. Always checked in with us to make sure everything was good, was very helpful, very kind, and did many things to make our stay perfect. 

This was our second time staying at a Melia resort, and we would definitely come back either here, or to another one of their properties

reviews.author: Asriel G
reviews.title: Quincenara vacation
reviews.text: Venimos a Paradisus Palma Real para celebrar la Quinceañera de nuestra hija.  Por razones fuera del control del resort, las restricciones del gobierno no permitieron el evento como lo queríamos.  El resort intento todo lo posible para que se nos realizara el evento en el resort, pero decidimos mejor hacerlo fuera del resort.  Aun asi, no ayudaron asegurar que el evento fuera todo lo que sonábamos.  La belleza del lugar es inexplicable, y las fotos no pueden captar la grandeza de las vistas.  Para mi, lo mejor fue el desayuno de buffet.  El desayunar afuera con la vista del mar fue una experiencia inolvidable.  Tuvimos dos consierge para nuestro grupo, pero Zenovia se esmero en asegurar que disfrutaramos cada momento al maximo.  Ella nos mandaba las actividades diarios todas las mañanas, hacia reservaciones para el grupo en los mejores restaurantes del resort, y procuro transporte ida y vuelta para el grupo de 50 para el evento fuera del resort.  Recomiendo a este lugar para parejas, familias, y grupos igual.  Lo unico que consejo es que cualquier evento que planifiques en el lugar sea con mucho cuidado hasta que el govierno levanta sus restricciones.  Si deseas musica, baile, etc... tengan aseguransas que se permiten estas cosas antes de cementar los planes.

reviews.title: Always a good time, especially after quarantine
reviews.text:
This was our 3rd time staying here and even though they are still trying to work out the operational kinks of opening back up, it was a good time. They just reopened a few weeks ago and have mostly new staff, so taking all that into consideration, it was a great trip. 

Jose Salvador was our concierge and he did an amazing job. He was attentive but not over bearing. He was always checking in & attended to what we needed. Everything was handled quickly and to our specifications. 

Wanda at the Sunset Bar was one of the highlights of our trip, as always. She's always smiling & is the life of the party 😁. Make sure you order a Wanda Piña Colada from her, they are so so so good. I don't even know how many we drank in our 7 days here. 

Pedro and Martìn did an excellent job with making sure our experience while at the pool was perfect. They greeted us every morning it seemed and they checked on us throughout the day to see if we needed anything. 

Elias made sure we always had a drink while we were poolside. That guy has an amazing attitude. Always happy & willing to help out.

Yelson, one of the servers at Palazzo, did an amazing job also. He really went up and beyond when he was serving us. Very friendly and a pleasure to talk to.

reviews.title: The best vacation ever at Paradisus Palma Real in The Reserve!
reviews.text: The resort is gorgeous and relaxing! The restaurants are delicious, especially the sushi at Brisas and dining at Palazzo. The service and staff are extremely helpful and kind. Gabriel Bobadilla helped us so much with making dinner reservations, extending our stay, and overall made the entire vacation incredible! I had a wonderful stay with my family and would love to visit again!

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Stunning Resort to enjoy a Family Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a gorgeous upscale resort on the beach with many delicious restaurants with gourmet dishes, steakhouse, Italian & Mediterranean cuisine, buffet, room service with breakfast on our balcony, and fantastic sushi at Brisas, top shelf bars and the best Cosmopolitan & pina coladas. The gardens & fabulous architecture make the setting grand but always relaxing and inviting. Best of all is the kindness, warmth, and the way the patient friendly staff are welcoming and attend to your every need. I needed assistance and Gabriel Bobadilla helped us daily (we will miss him) with reservations and extending our stay to 8 beautiful nights in The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. If this is your first time to the Dominican Republic or another adventure, you will be happy and enjoy the Paradisus' beautiful grounds, attentive staff, delicious dining, and the whole feeling of being happy from morning to night. These experiences made it our best vacation ever. We are already missing you DR and your warm Caribbean breeze through the palm trees.

reviews.author: Contessa S
reviews.title: Thank you for a wonderful vacation!
reviews.text: We had an amazing vacation at Paradisus Palma Real! The restaurants were delicious especially Brisas with wonderful ceviche and Palazzo with amazing Octopus! The beautiful beach and resort, housekeeping and the waiters and waitresses, and other kind staff made our stay so wonderful. Gabriel Bobadilla was so helpful from making reservations for dinner, to going out of his way to give us a tour of the resort, and always made sure we were happy. Gabriel truly made our stay wonderful and memorable!

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Flawless Resort
reviews.text: This is a wonderful resort. The restaurants are all delectable. The chefs are talented and accommodating. If you want something, chances are they can make it. On one occasion, I requested the Chef at Olio to make pasta carbonara and it came out perfectly. My favorite restaurant was Palozzo. They had a beautiful menu, every item was fresh and delicious. Every step of the way the resort staff looked out for my comfort and safety. Every day our butler, Gabriel Bobadilla, would check in with us to see where we wanted to eat and when. If something wasn't quite right , he would make it right. The resort treats you like family. I truly felt at home here at Paradisus Palma Real. The pools are enormous and beautiful. The other guests were kind, polite and respectful. This is a lovely place for couples and couples that have children.

reviews.author: Roland A
reviews.title: Amazing Vacations.
reviews.text:
We spend a week at the hotel and it was very good. The food and the service were the best. Jairo Feliz helped us with all we need during our stay, he made our time their worry-free, which is exactly what you need during your time off.
The hotel could improve in the number of activities they do, by the end of the vacation we were a little bored and had to do some excursions. I also see some issues of inaccessibility in the hotel, we had a baby stroller and there were places without ramps and just one elevator to cover a huge number of rooms. Jairo helped us to change our room to the first floor so we don't have to walk an extra 20 mins each time to the elevator to go to the room. 
In general, we enjoyed the hotel and the service was the best. All the servers helped us a lot, Lisset, Jose, and others.

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Great time at Paridisus Palma Real
reviews.text: I am very happy to leave the most positive view for the paridisus palma real and their wonderful staff. This was our first all inclusive experience and the paridisus staff exceeded our expectations in every way. The facility is beautiful and well-equipped. There are plenty if fun and impressive events and entertainment each day and night. The food and drinks are excellent. We never ince felt that we were compromising anything by virtue of the all inclusive  deal. The staff is so friendly, attentive and professional that we felt like VIPs the whole time. The personal concierge anticipates your every need and plans your outings and handles your reservations. Most importantly he manages your Covid test and declaration processes. We were so impressed with our concierge, Juan Castillo, and he was so good at ensuring that we got the most out of our visit- that we bought a membership! We caught the Paridisus right at reopening after a covid imposed shutdown. There were one or two instances where an experience was lacking in some way. In every case the resort found ways to make things right so we remained blown away the while time. We cant wait to return. The weather is amazing- always a cooling Caribbean breeze and sunshine everyday. And the pool is beautiful! This is our new favorite place! Thanks Paridisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: llilberth g
reviews.title: Sun set bar @ the reserve
reviews.text: El trío dinámico  de este bar, Wanda, pedro y Martín excelente servicio gente amable y educada  y el Wanda  special un trago fenomenal. Una experiencia una, y las medidas del.covid todas cumplidas 👌👌👌

reviews.author: Griselda B
reviews.title: Nice vacations
reviews.text: La actidad del service preparado por el chef Leivi Garcia, las excelente  atenciones de Darlin y  Happy boy muy buen trabajo y delciosos platos , Camarones y   Salmon la pasamos reamente bien con los chicos de actividades que nos hicieran pasar las mejorea vacaciones

reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.title: Vacaciones en Punta Cana
reviews.text: Muy bueno el hotel y todos los protocolos de bioseguridad. Excelente servicio, actividades y comida. El hotel opera con aforo reducido, así que te sientes muy tranquilo. El persona muy amable y divertido: Andy, Darlin y Happy Boy. Hicimos el taller de velas con ellos.

reviews.author: Natasha W
reviews.title: Much needed VaCay!
reviews.text: We had the best personal assistant/Conceriege ever. Bladimir was very attentive and accommodating. When he wasn’t available Nicholas stepped in. Abraham also made sure we had everything’ we needed and paid attention to the details. We were celebrating a birthday and they put out all the stops. All the staff took extra food care of us. Even with the minor hiccups we had an amazing time. The resort was top notch and the food was great. After the year we had this was a much needed vacation and I can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Tesha G
reviews.title: Started off rocky but ended amazing.
reviews.text: We came back the day the resort opened back up so it was expected for things to be a little all over the place. We didn’t have hot water for two days but our group of staff was on top of everything & made sure we were taken care of. Bladimir, Nicholas & Abraham were EXCELLENT. We were celebrating a birthday & they made sure it was special. Our trip would not have been them same if it wasn’t for them.

reviews.author: CLAUDIA R
reviews.title: Great family resort
reviews.text:
I cant wait to come back, the perfect place for a family vacation.  book a family concierge they are fantastic.
loved the spa and the children club.  they have great sommelier . fantastic staff. only one thing do not use the picture service they are terrible and expensive.

reviews.author: Sao
reviews.title: Mi primera vez en Punta Cana
reviews.text: The food was great, service superb(very attentive), and the views and ambience were spectacular. Alejandro (Happy Boy) is an outstanding entertainer, funny and very personable. Darlin, is very nice and very knowledgeable and helps the guests feel at home. Jairo is a great concierge and Yoiner is quite an outstanding gentleman and concierge All of the rest of the staff were outstanding and would without reservation recommend this resort to anyone looking for a Caribbean getaway.

reviews.author: Cinthya
reviews.title: June Gateway
reviews.text: The ceviches made by Chef Leivi and brought to us by happy boy and Andy. It was such a wonderful experience. The hotel have excellent food and service. Can’t wait to come back and enjoy another vacation. The different dishes makes every night a wonderful surprise.

reviews.author: Cristian Castro
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Hemos visitado el hotel en su reapertura y cabe destacar que hemos tenido una muy buena experiencia ya que el personal que se encuentra dentro del hotel son súper amable y hacen lo que sea para que la pases bien, lo recomendamos al 100% no podemos pasar sin mencionar algunos de los chicos que higiénico posible esta buena experiencia y entre ellos se en cuentan #1 el señor (Willy Mercado ) #2 Bladimir Rincón #3 Rafael Nuñez el chef de palazzo # Adony Mercedes    #4 Gregorin Arias #5 Nathanael Montilla #6 Jose Arismendy y Omar hasbun maletero y en total todo el equipo que forman parte de el hotel se han portado de maravilla, tanto así que regresaremos el mes próximo.

reviews.author: Compass66158700316
reviews.title: Excelente estancia
reviews.text: Ha sido una excelente estancia para nuestra familia, las atenciones fueron excelentes desde el proceso de reserva, la llegada, la estancia en si, y la salida. Durante las comidas el Sr. Richard, que era el encargado en el buffet y en los restaurantes, fue exquisito, siempre trató de que nos sintiéramos bien. También agradecemos a la dirección del hotel, en la persona de su directora Sra. Romero, que personalmente estuvo pendiente de que todo fuera excelente. También el servicio del Concierge, el Sr. Bladimir, fue una gran experiencia, ya que siempre estuvo pendiente de que no nos faltara nada. En sentido general, repetiríamos!

reviews.author: 09dbvbky2k
reviews.title: Fernando
reviews.text: special thank you to Juan for his attention to details and commitment. friendly staff. Buffet had a lot of choices. Room reserved with ocean view clean and bed very comfortable. Whirlpool tub works great.

reviews.author: Tomas D
reviews.title: Great holiday!
reviews.text: We spent there 10 days during the Christmas 2020 and is was wonderful! Hotel staff was friendly, singing and dancing all the time. Always with a warm smile on their face. Excellent beach with many different types of sunbeds and sofas.

reviews.author: Achrafus S
reviews.title: A great break from life during a pandemic
reviews.text:
Our 5th time here, we loved every minute of it. We felt very safe as extra measures and precautions were taken to assure guests safety from the virus.
Gledys at check-in did an awesome job as it was errors in our reservation and for our upgrade request.
Our butler Bledimir was great.
Thank you to all the employees as this must be a difficult period in their lives.

reviews.author: Ricardo M
reviews.title: Buenas Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Hotel muy limpio e con buenas medidas anti COVID.
No había mucho aglomerado de personas e el servicio tuve muy bien... Andy nuestro Concierge aí echo un muy bueno trabajo e aí sido exemplar durante nuestra estadía.

reviews.author: Juliana C
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO
reviews.text: Tivemos uma estada MARAVILHOSA no Paradisus Palma Real. Felizmente, eu e meus 7 amigos fomos atendidos pelo funcionário ARIEL BENZO. QUE ATENDIMENTO! Ariel, sempre atencioso, se mostrava disponível 24h para nos atender. Solícito e educado, foi o ponto alto da nossa viagem, com certeza! Agradecemos por esse momento tão especial! Além disso, tivemos o prazer de sermos atendidos no bar perto à piscina do The Reserve pela funcionária WANDA! Que felicidade!!!

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Amazing Resort and Better Staff
reviews.text: My Wife and I just got back from out trip to Punta Cana, Paradisus Palma Real from Xmas to New Years.   What an amazing time we had.  From  the time we got there to the time we left we felt the love from the staff.  We stayed in Royal Service and were greeting the second we arrived by the Bell Hop who took us to the VIP Lounge to check in.  At check in we met our Concierge/Butler "Nicolas Maracallo".  Nicolas was on top of EVERYTHING.  From the moment we got there he ensured we had reservations for dinner, excursions, had our favorite spots by the pool set up each day.  Even more so, Nicolas gave us advice on the area as thing to see vs not to see.  Nicolas truly made our experience one of a kind.  We plan on going back in  the future and we will NOT go unless we can be guaranteed to have Nicolas again if he is still there.  Nicolas made us feel at home as though we were long time friends.  We stayed in building 8 with an Ocean View room.  The room was spotless and we were very pleased with the quality of everything in the room.  We always used the pool just outside of our building "Sunset Bar Pool" which is a smaller pool just for the Royal Reserve guests.  The Bartender "Wanda" was amazing.  She made drinks to absolute perfection as well as suggesting Dominican Drinks which i am not hooked on.  She was so friendly and had such an infectious personality.  Our last day Wanda was not working as she was off and the drinks just were not the same.  We also visited the Gabbi Beach Bar to see Victor who again, was amazing.  Very busy bar but he pushes drinks out quick and loves to chat with the guests.  Now for two people who made our night time actives great; Ronil Reyes and Yanna Vasquez.  These two kept the party going at night.  Their interactions with the guest was great.  Ronil would get the guys up and dancing and the little kids loved him.  Yanna had the ladies up and dancing and was a blast to watch.  I myself DO NOT like to dance yet Ronil and Yanna had my Wife and I out there each night dancing until the Bar shut down.  We were honestly sad to say bye to the two of them.  Paradisus is LUCKY to have them.  Any resort on the Island would die to have two employees like them.  My Wife and I renewed our Vows on the Beach while there for our 10 year anniversary.  Natalia oversaw the entire event from start to finish and made it spectacular.  Her attention to detail was second to none.  Natalia guided us through the entire process.  She made my Wife cry in joy with how beautiful everything turned out.  So again, this resort is amazing and will be going back again.  Nicolas, Wanda, Victor, Ronil, Yanna, and Natalia, THANK YOU so much for giving us the best week vacation we've ever had

reviews.author: GabriellaPapaleo
reviews.title: EXCELENTE
reviews.text: Ficamos na categoria The Reserve do Paradisus Palma Real. Nosso grupo era de 8 pessoas e tivemos a felicidade de receber o atendimento do funcionário Ariel Benzo! Ele foi atencioso e se encarregou 24/7 de organizar e planejar nossas atividades (jantares, almoços, passeios e outros). A estrutura do hotel e o atendimento do staff eram impecáveis e, com toda a certeza, fizeram a nossa estada se tornar excelente!

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Great Service, Very CLEAN
reviews.text: We recently celebrated our Honeymoon over Christmas at the Palma Real. Entertainment each night was great. Royal service was fantastic, Nicolas took great care of us, he is the best! The resort is very clean and beautiful. All employees wear masks, gloves and sanitizers are handed out for the buffet, 95% of the resort is outdoors and the occupancy was around 50% if not less. We felt very safe, Highly recommend for anyone looking for an all-inclusive Caribbean getaway.

reviews.author: Danilo C
reviews.title: SENSACIONAL
reviews.text: Chegamos em 4 casais e só temos a agradecer. Quando chegamos o nosso mordomo Ariel Benzo nos recepcionou e tratou de tornar nossa hospedagem a melhor possível até o final da viagem, somos muito gratos! Assim como ele, outros membros do staff também foram extremamente atenciosos com o grupo, sempre com o melhor humor do mundo. Especialmente a Wanda e o Mario do bar the reserve, nosso amigo Pedro concierge da piscina, o Edison no bar do lobby e o mehor garçom Jose!!!!! Fico Muito agradecido por tudo.

reviews.author: Lydia
reviews.title: Vacance en famille
reviews.text: Andy Constante nous a offert le meilleur service de conciergerie. Il était disponible en toute le temps et a répondu rapidement à toutes nos demandes. Merci Andy d'avoir pris soin de nous. Une belle vacance dans un très beau resort.

reviews.author: Radu Cercel
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Andy Constante was a wonderful host, very helpful and always available. He made our stay very pleasant. I will recommend him to anyone, anytime. Thanks Andy for taking good care of us during our stay!

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Palma Real Melia Hotel in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Excellent location. Excellent service. All employees were wonderful. The employee that attended us at the entrance offered to remain in contact during our 8 day stay to help accommodate any need/desire we had. We contacted her every day, various times a day, whenever we needed anything at all organized. She responded each time with the utmost efficiency and friendliness. You are in very good hands if Yesica Reyes is working at the hotel during your visit. I would happily return to Palma Real hotel in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Jennifer A
reviews.title: 28.12-09.01.2021 Room 2115 Reserve
reviews.text:
we had a concierge employee named Juan Castillo who was always there for us, very friendly, very helpful and took care of us very well 100% !! the hotel complex is excellent so many different restaurants are located here , gecko free zone for people like me , don't like animals too much 🙈🙈😂😂super nice pool staff reception everything is just excellent I'll be back.
Mario & Jennifer Minar

reviews.author: Bailey S
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful getaway to the Paradisus Palma Real. Andy Constante was our concierge, and he made sure we had a great experience from assisting with dinner reservations to booking our spa appointments, he made sure every detail was perfect! Thank you Andy!

reviews.author: Bill L
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: What an amazing resort.  The staff is fantastic.   I have been here before.  The staff comes up and talks to you by name.  When you are here you are home.  Juan the restaurant supervisor goes beyond to help.   Vladimer in guest services is fantastic.   I encourage you to stay here

reviews.author: Moema
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!!
reviews.text:
This is my second time at Paradisus Palma Real and I’m so glad  my husband and I return here. Our personal concierge, Andy Constante, was outstanding he was always very attentive and checked on us during the entire trip!  He did an amazing job and made us feel so comfortable and welcome.  
I was very impressed with the implemented safety protocols due to the Covid-19 and that made us feel very safe. 
Special thanks to the pool team Martin and Wanda!! They went above and beyond always sweet and attentive! Also, Gustavo from Palazzo restaurant that made sure I had my favorite dish every day, he was amazing! 
I highly recommend this hotel!! Will be back again for sure!

reviews.author: Diego V
reviews.title: Melhor hotel em Punta Cana
reviews.text: O melhor hotel para se ficar com a família em Punta Cana! Excelente. Voltarei certamente. O staff é muito atencioso e as facilidades de lazer e restaurante superaram minhas expectativas. A enorme piscina e os drinks completam a estadia enquanto se relaxa ao sol do caribe. Não deixe se conhecer o SPA e o restaurante Brisas, com seus deliciosos pratos. É fácil de se comunicar em português e de se locomover no complexo, que é gigante, através dos carrinhos que ligam os prédios de apartamentos.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: Great stay after Xmas
reviews.text: Great beach and service. Food options are adequate and fun entertainment every night. Rooms are not new but very comfortable beds and everything works fine. Great thanks to our concierge Andy Constante for being an excellent host and for helping us 24/7 with anything we needed. He even organized a hard to get cable we forget at home. Looking forward to coming back soon.

reviews.author: KeynaBracken
reviews.title: COVID Getaway
reviews.text:
Stayed Dec 19-26th 2020. The resort did an excellent job wearing masks and doing their absolute best with physical distancing. On arrival the resort was only about 15% occupied as it just recently reopened after being shuttered since March, so the beach chairs and pool side spots were plentiful and the fabulous beach mostly empty. Numbers were picking up by Christmas but still there was plenty of space. Special thanks to Martin our fab Royal service pool attendant, Kelvin the wine steward extraordinaire who set us up with great wines and Ismael Lizardo for his personal attention ensuring our request to dine outside regardless of food offering. A huge shout out to Bladimir Rincon our tireless butler who helped ensure our every request was attended to.
This was our first time staying at this resort despite having stayed at Secrets Cap Cana, Club Med and Bahia Principe in Punta Cana before. We will be back as this resort has the best beach setting by far with polite, attentive, friendly staff.

reviews.author: Vivian P
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: Recomiendo a todos mis amigos q visiten el hotel Palma Real PARADISUS es lo mejor en turismo,  hemos sido atendidos x Yesica Reyes y su servicio es excelente, en todo momento ha estado pendiente de lo q hemos necesitado,  además los cantineros del lobby nos han dado unas atenciones exquisitas ( Victor Feliz y Eric ) también quiero recomendarles a nuestro amigo Ismael el capitán de restaurantes q con sus  atenciones hemos disfrutado de excelentes platos y ricas comidas de la casa, igual para todos los descendientes,  en general a todos los trabajadores x su espwcial servicio.

reviews.author: Alina H
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2020
reviews.text: Súper contenta y agradecida con todo el servicio del hotel, las habitaciones excelentes , súper limpias y muy amable las chicas , el lobby bar , Víctor Felix hace un capuchino espectacular, en el restaurante todos los muchachos súper atentos , Ismael el Capitan de los restaurante súper, súper atento y complaciente y en especial a la señorita Yésica Reyes nuestra coordinadora que en todo momento nos complació .

reviews.author: Kenia L
reviews.title: Vacaciones excelentes
reviews.text: Hemos pasado unas excelentes vacaciones!! Las instalaciones son súper acogedoras las habitaciones súper amplias, modernas y cómodas  , servicios excelentes en bares, restaurantes, Guest Service en especial el de Yésica Reyes  que ha sido bastante atenta en todo momento y simpática, también los chicos de animación , además de Ismael de restaurantes.

reviews.author: PRATT
reviews.title: Best Christmas Trip!
reviews.text:
My wife and I  had a great vacation here in Paradisus. The whole staff was on point on taking the necessary precautions to keep us safe. I would like to express our gratitude to Andy Constante, he was the main contact/concierge that made it his mission to make sure  that we were well attended.  Also would lime to give thanks to Gustavo at Palazzo, as well as Martin and Pedro at the beach. The experience was well above average and most definitely will return!
 
Thank you very much once more!

reviews.author: Yina G
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: El servicio de Yesica Reyes es muy bueno,quedamos encantado y el cheff Sosa es muy bueno lo recomiendo,las instalaciones muy bonitas y las actividades que tiene el hotel muy bueno,el próximo años pensando regresar espero que Yesica nos vuelva a atender.

reviews.author: Reyna B
reviews.title: Divertida
reviews.text: Una experiencia muy divertida, me gustó mucho la parte del servicio de atención al cliente por Yésica Reyes. El Cheff Sosa en la parte de hibachi demasiado bueno!! Y también la playa del hotel es muy bonita. No hay muchas actividades dentro pero lo de afuérela lo recompensa!

reviews.author: Minh0ca
reviews.title: Despit the crazy pandemic times.... ,
reviews.text:
A top vacation!

Kudos to Wiken, our concierge that is worth his weight in gold. Also Wilson is doing a sensational work at the main restaurant. Finally, i need to mention Martin at the pasta station... Actually, all staff is doing a tremendous job making us forget the nightmare caused by the virus.

reviews.author: Dianny S
reviews.title: Celebración de aniversario
reviews.text: Este fue por mucho, la mejor estadía en un resort, hicieron de nuestro aniversario extra especial, con toda la delicadeza y el empeño que pusieron en nosotros, la atención a los detalles de parte de nuestro mayordomo Nathanael fue increíble, sin duda estaremos volviendo para allá cada aniversario, esperando con ansias que Nathanael Montilla sea nuestro mayordomo siempre 💕

reviews.author: Nikolarrain
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Lo hemos pasado increíble estas vacaciones, y hemos gozado el Palma Real.
Los restaurants, incluido el buffet muy ricos y con mucha variedad. Dentro de los a la carta, el Palazzo nos encantó, muy rica la comida y la atención. 
La playa increíble, la atención de Milly fue espectacular y llena de detalles y cariño.
También el team de actividades, muy carismáticos, sociables, atentos, entretenidos, en especial Ronil  Reyes, Yanna Vázquez, Reynaldo, el negrote. Lo pasamos de maravilla y volveremos de todas maneras. Que pena irse....

reviews.author: Antonia
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Me ha encantado las vacaciones en el Paradisus palma real. 
La playa muy rica y espaciosa!! Melbin y Elias están atendiéndonos muy bien ofreciendo ayuda y preocupados que estemos teniendo una estadía cómoda.   
La comida extraordinaria, destacando la agradable atención de los meseros, siempre alegres con una sonrisa , en especial Pedro,  Maria Ortiz.
Los chicos de las actividades Yanna Vasquez ,Ronil Reyes,Nelly y Reynaldo. Haciéndonos actividades muy entretenidas y siempre motivados con una gran sonrisa,realmente hicieron que mis vacaciones familiares fueran las mejores!!!

reviews.author: Blanca
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Saludos, les cuento que vengo llegando de mis vacaciones en en hotel paradisus palma real donde la he pasado increíble, los restaurantes son muy buenos y la comida es riquísima.
Los chicos de las actividades están siempre animándonos y son atentos con nosotros especialmente Yanna, Ronil, Nelly y Reinaldo. 
De seguro volveré otra vez a este mismo hotel.

reviews.author: Jacinta L
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Saludos,
Lo he pasado excelente estas semanas en el paradisus palma real. Los restaurantes y buffet muy ricos y la atención excelente. En especial Maria ortuz y melvin( camarero de la playa) ambos muy atentos y preocupados.
Lo que mas me gusto fue la entretención con los chicos de animacion. Ronil Reyez, Reinaldo, Yanna y Nelly hicieron que la estadïa estuviera muy divertida!!
Seguro volveré!!

reviews.author: Beth Posey 64
reviews.title: Much needed rest
reviews.text:
This place is top notch! The food, staff, bar tenders, facilities are amazing ! Our concierge, Mr. Reynosa kept us abreast of all our reservations at restaurants, and made sure we were comfortable.
We will return every chance we have :)

reviews.author: Martin V
reviews.title: viaje familiar aniversario de mi padre
reviews.text: Exelente experiencia familiar, las instalaciones del hotel,playa y spa preciosos, Hotel festejamos sus 70 años con una atencion encantadora,comida exelente y hermosa habitacion frente al mar quedamos sorprendidos en todos sus detalles. Agradecimiento por su destacada atencion en entrenemiento Miguel de actividades,entrenidisimas y tambien Pedro,Tomas como exelente Director,un viaje de aniversario de exelencia esperamos volver lo mas pronto posible les escribo desde Miami,florida U.S.A saludos coordiales

reviews.author: Patrick M
reviews.title: Une bulle de paradis hors du temps
reviews.text: En cette période compliquée nous étions un peu inquiets de ce voyage booke avant le début de la crise. Rassures. Tout est fait pour que les normes sanitaires soient respectées, les GO portent le masque tout le temps, nous on respire sans, en extérieur. Bravo pour ces adaptations tout en gardant l esprit club. Une mention toute particulière à Mélanie - un 5 étoiles, 6 si il y avait eu 😉- et a Yolanda pour ses cours de yoga, matin et soir face à la mer. Un bonheur .... Welcome to paradis 🌴☀️

reviews.author: AMPGMC_15
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed here at the end of February before all the COVID madness and we had the most wonderful stay! The staff and hotel were exceptional, and the setting is just beautiful. There is a great selection of restaurants and the food it lovely. I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Phoenix Fowler
reviews.title: Lee and Mario made the trip!
reviews.text: Went down with family for a family vacation- had a blast! If you don’t go to the swim up bar and order the “Lee’s Special” you are missing out! Make sure you spend time getting to know the bartenders (Lee and Mario) they are amazing and have great cocktail recipes! So much fun! The activities guys are incredible too! They do a great job making sure you have a great time!

reviews.author: Kristen S
reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text:
Had a great vacation at Paradisus Palma Real 🌴☀️
- Everyone at the beach is super attentive and you’ll never be without a drink in your hand! Gabriel and Rahul are the best servers (!!) and always made sure we had a cold drink to enjoy. 
- Our butler Nathanael was very helpful in sorting out any issues and making reservations. He also helped organize a very sweet Valentine’s Day with champagne and chocolate covered strawberries in the room.
- The restaurants are always delicious - the baked cheese from Aqua is to die for. 
- All the performers and dancers are incredibly talented. They are so much fun and really get the party started 🕺
- Had the best massage of my life at the Yhi spa.

Can’t wait to come back next year!

reviews.author: Mishy0714
reviews.title: Covid-19 Experience
reviews.text:
Our group stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for a March break family reunion.   We were some of the last guest at the hotel durning the Covid-19 Pandemic.   The hotel did such an amazing job durning a stressful time.  Everyone was cleaning all the time.   The services were excellent , the staff did an outstanding job taking care of us.  We only got to enjoy one a la carte  ( the Japanese ) as they had to close to enforce social distancing.  The rest of the stay we ate at the buffet and it was so good !     As every day passed more tourists left but the buffet was still an excellent choice with so many options considering how many guests were at the resort.   All the staff were so good and although we were aware that they  would all be out of work once the hotel shut down you could not tell.  They were all professional and kept smiling through it all and did not give a hint of what they must have been going through.  I regret not taking their name as they all deserve recognition.  Maicol from buffet was our main waiter most days.  Always pleasant and willing to help.  All the bartenders were fantastic.  The ladies that cleaned our rooms were sweet and did such a great job.  Juanily helped when we arrived and also on our departure.  He always had a great smile and always there to assist.  The grounds are well maintained, the resort is very clean.  Perfect beach !   The rooms are nice and the beds are super comfortable.  We  would love to return here!   
Thank you Paradisus Palma Real !!

reviews.author: Sean H
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Edison Abaulauo - Lobby bar - not sure if that’s how you spell his name. It’s in the picture I took. Best bartender ever, makes great drinks, and great jokes he seemed popular with the other vacationers also. One of the best weeks in my life.

reviews.author: PACHOLA-NY-BA
reviews.title: Truly “royal” service!
reviews.text: From the minute we checked in until our last goodbye at checkout,  the care, attentiveness and friendliness of the staff was always present! Special kudos to Angela at the Royal Service Lounge, Edgar our butler, and Martin our beach attendant!  All the servers at Palazzo were wonderful as well.  The hotel rooms and grounds are lovely and the beach view makes the lobby one of the prettiest we’ve ever seen. Hope to return some day!

reviews.author: Fran D
reviews.title: Una semana increible (40s)
reviews.text:
Fuimos a celebrar los 40 cumpleaños de varios amigos con todo incluido con royal service y ha sido increíble, la atención, las instalaciones, el personal, todo perfecto de no ser por un par de días que llovió en los que aprendimos a bailar bachata con HAPPY, conocimos el spa (muy recomendable para relajarse un día de lluvia) y disfrutamos del casino aunque con poca suerte ;). La atención de FELIX ha sido exquisita reservando todas las cenas en los distintos restaurantes y esos jacuzzy antes de la cena. El personal siempre dispuesto a que la estancia fuese de primera, recepcionistas, limpieza, camareros, etc. Ya quedan en el recuerdo esas camas balinesas al lado de la piscina o de la playa infinita, las charlas en los cómodos sofás de las recepciones o bares con esos cocteles, mojitos, caipiriñas, esa comida espectacular. 
Un recuerdo inolvidable que espero volver a repetir, esta vez con mis hijas para que disfruten de las instalaciones para niños que se veían increibles.

reviews.author: Manpreet R
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: Always a great experience! We have been coming back year after year. From the food to the service... always on point! A special thank you to Jendry who went out of his way to make our beach experience perfect. Towels were always laid out and drinks were always on time. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Daisy046
reviews.title: Service, Beauty and Tranquility
reviews.text:
Our 7 day stay, from March 8th to March 15th, 2020 was restful and luxurious. We were in an Ocean Front suite Royal Service but parts of my review will apply to the resort in general.
I would describe the Paradisus Palma Real as very calm, beautiful, clean and compact.  The staff genuinely aimed to please and were a huge factor in our enjoyment of this resort.  We were never bothered by blaring music at the beach, pool (about 5 feet deep) or from anyone’s personnel speaker.
Nothing is far too walk to and there are about 6 bars lounging the front of the resort. 
Our room, #6106, was above the Gabi Beach Bar and our view was breathtaking. See attached photo. Our suite had 27 light switches and 9 outlets (just had to count). So many lighting options. Hot water was never an issue-huge shower with shower heads at each end. Our room was very clean, had maid service twice a day, fridge filled daily, special surprises from our butler Felix Garcia regularly. 
 Thank you, Felix, your excellent service will be remembered.
Food:  Breakfast at the main buffet called Naos was just okay. You could get eggs and omelets made to order but pre-cooked foods tended to be over or under cooked. Lunch at Naos, on the contrary, was excellent. Extremely varied and tasty-you must try the pizza. There was a grill on the beach that offered hot dogs and hamburgers-no fries. For Royal Service, the Palazzo restaurant was open for an a la carte lunch, but we never went.  Dinner at the a la cartes were very good-Aqua was our favorite. House wine was fine. If in Royal Service your butler will make dinner reservations for you. You can also use the buffet at the Reserve. Buffet at Naos for dinner was nothing to write home about but not bad either. 
Bar service and alcohol were top of the line. 
Lilian Aquino at the lobby bar was a real sweetheart. Just a pleasure to sit at her bar and see her smile-excellent coffees and drinks of all kinds-just ask; Chivas, Hennessey, Hendricks, Imperial Rum, Black Label, Grey Goose and the list goes on. 
Jonathan, Pedro and Marvin and the singing bar tender at the Royal Pool Bar were also genuinely a pleasure to get to know. Quick, efficient, always happy. A fun place to sit and have a drink while admiring the beach and ocean. 5th Avenue bar in the Plaza Square had nightly entertainment and a DJ to get you dancing. If the music was not to your liking, the Gabi Bar next door also had a DJ and good music. So many options for a nightcap and all top notch.  For a very quiet/serve yourself area, head to the Royal lounge. We enjoyed discussing baseball with Christian Canton at the lounge.
The Beach: Perfect, white sand, fairly calm sea and the option to go for long walks to the right or left. LOVED the beach beds on the Royal Service side. Double beds with a thick mattress under a huge palapa. I don’t think I’ll be able to go back to a regular lounger. 
Royal Service also gave you access to unlimited towels and your butler could reserve a cabana by the pool for you. 
This is not a party resort. We didn’t see any crazy games at the main pool. However, for a great time, for a restful, luxurious experience and because of the staff, I would recommend.  It met and exceeded all our expectations. I would highly recommend Royal Service.
If you have questions about this resort, please feel free to contact me.

reviews.author: Jeremie D
reviews.title: The most amazing fairytale of a wedding anyone could ask for.....on Leap Day!
reviews.text: This place. I can't even begin to tell you how awesome of an experience it was to book my wedding here. Never in my lifetime did I dream I would have this kind of nearly white-glove service from start to finish from a company, not to mention planning an extraordinary event like this from 4000 miles away and with a language barrier. I am an event planner and I'm glad I had a full year to plan. I had the privilege of working with Patricia, I never thought the communication, planning and clarifying of details would end up so smooth. We had 34 guests & they had the BEST time of their life! This resort is clean, easy to get around and the staff was friendly & professional. Of all my research this place had the most space for lounging by the pool or hanging on the beach. We didn't care for the sushi at Barsis but we were even told that it isn't a popular restaurant. I would not recommend sashimi fish but anything else is a go! The nightly entertainment was wonderful. The lobby bar & Gabi bar were our favorite hang out & meeting place.  We also got to celebrate the Dominican Republic's Independence Day with a catamaran to Soana Island, absolutely stunning. This place looked like what you would see on the cover of a travel magazine but it was REAL! I would recommend this resort in a heartbeat. We love to travel and see the world but I would be safe to say that if we were to come back this is the ONLY resort we would stay at.

 Domenic G. 
Boston, EEUU

reviews.author: spatel2015
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
The resort and property is very beautiful. You will love it. The day we arrived the start was a bit shaky. We had booked a two bedroom unit as well as a junior suite. The first unit assigned to us did not seem to have been renovated and looked very run down. We reached out to the hotel checkin staff and we were moved to a beautifully renovated unit. The first night the resort lost power due to an outside issue. When we reached out to guest services they did an incredible job of making sure that the rest of our stay was perfect.
A very special thanks to Stephanie Bellido from guest services. She was exceptional and went above and beyond and we are so so appreciative. Mariely and Liliana from the Guest services were amazing also. They all made sure that we had the reservations for dinners and anything that came up was addressed with competence and courtesy. Wally Pena and his entire team from reception were exceptional as well. They were courteous and very accommodating. A heartfelt thank you to them as well.
The only feedback for improvement would be regarding food as compared to other locations we found the food in the formal restaurants to be just reasonable. The presentation was classy and exceptional but the taste did not live up to the caliber.  The buffet was really decent as long as you got their when it first started. Though we must mention their Indian Chef Singh. The indian dishes were excellent and authentic. We don't tend to want to eat indian food when traveling and usually are interested in other fare but the quality and taste was excellent and we really enjoyed it a lot.
Overall a wonderful trip with great memories.

reviews.title: A wonderful break from Canadian winter
reviews.text: This resort was everything we hoped for and more.   The food was great for someone with allergies (gluten and dairy free) as they were able to accommodate.  I didn't like their gluten free bread, but there was so much fresh produce and I liked all the live bars at the buffet where food was prepared fresh as you like it.  The a la carte restaurants offered lots of variety.  The pool was beautiful and quiet (no late afternoon loud music and partying as we have experienced at other resorts), although we spent most of our time on the beach, where you can walk for hours without getting to the end of the beach.  We will return.  Staff are great and grounds are beautiful.  Early February weather was great - a good break from Canadian winter without being too hot - high of 28.  We didn't have the extras with Royal Service, Level, etc, and had all we needed or wanted.  Our new favorite spot is the Gabi Beach bar where you can sit and see the beach and relax.  Night entertainment was varied and lots of fun.
