reviews.text:
We checked in on Saturday 2/8 and left on 2/16.  Our stay could not have been more perfect from start to finish.  There were a total of 8 of us in a group (4 couples of various ages) and every single one of us could not come up with one bad thing to say about our time at the Reserve.  Our concierge Yesica Reyes was spot on from the get go with recommendations for dinner and and tending to our various needs.  She even made our Valentine's Night super special by dressing up our room with balloons, rose pedals and a chilled bottle of bubbly as a surprise while we were at dinner.  Other great staff shout outs go to Jendry De Luna, who took care of all our needs and thirsts down by the beach, Nobelly, our Room Attendant for the entire time who kept our room spotless and fresh, Noel Rosario at the buffet for making perfect omelettes each day, Fidel "The Coffee Man", Virginia and Alexander the morning Gabi servers who always had a smile and were quick with the coffee, Ronni, Wander and Jery who were nothing short of perfect barsmen at Gabi, Teobaldo, our server at the pool was never more than a step away when we needed him, Frank Feliz, our fine dining server for at least 3 nights was in perfect charge of making sure our dinners were perfect each time (from steak to seafood), even the maintenance staff was AWESOME!!!  One one occasion, I somehow jammed the deadbolt on the door and it wouldn't lock.  I called reception and told them about it and in less than 1 minute Franklin Santana was there with his tool box, fixed the door and was done in less than 5 minutes.
     This was a vacation I will put at the top of my travel experiences so far.  The resort had every amenity we needed and even a few that we didn't know we needed.  I look forward to going back and I hope to see many of those same faces again when I do.

reviews.author: RNC1962
reviews.title: Felipe Club Melia
reviews.text:
pasando las fiestas navideñas en Club Melia Paradisus Palma Real y todo el equipo de Club Melia tuvo un trato exquisito e hizo nuestra estadia fuera perfecta. 
Por si fuera poco tuvimos toda la atencion personalizada de FELIPE quien nos facilito aun mas las vacaciones ocupandose personalmente de nuestras reservaciones de restaurantes, controlando en todo momento que no fallara nada y estuvieramos disfrutando al maximo de nuestras vacaciones. Un 10 para Felipe!!

reviews.author: jacamach0
reviews.title: Gran experiencia
reviews.text: Muy buenos servicios en todo momento, su personal es muy atento y te ayudan en todo momento, los alimentos son agradables. el ambiente se presta para el descanso y la relajación, sin embargo también hay muchas actividades y diversión

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Maravilhoso, Soberbo nos mínimos detalhes
reviews.text:
Que hotel maravilhoso, com quartos espaçosos num ambiente tranquilo e de paz! Parabéns Palma Real pelo profissionalismo e delicadeza de todos os vossos funcionários, sempre muito educados e simpáticos genuinamente. A praia larga e ampla onde as Palmeiras Real dão um toque idílico no areal. 
A comida é um capítulo à parte com muita variedade e qualidade, sucos naturais e frutas no ponto certo de consumo. Tudo excelente não há nada a apontar, tudo perfeito! 
Todas as bebidas são servidas em copos descartáveis e a água em garrafinhas individuais como também os refrigerantes. 
Limpeza impecável nos quartos e em todo o complexo. 
Ginásio muito bem equipado com toalhas e garrafas de água individuais. 
Muito obrigada a toda equipe do Palma Real por nos proporcionar férias fantásticas e maravilhosas!

reviews.author: Lauren U
reviews.title: Great first time at all inclusive
reviews.text:
This was my first time at an all inclusive and it was great. I typically do cruises and this experience had way better access to chairs, beaches, and pools. While at the beach, we had an awesome guy, Jendry de Luna who took amazing care of our group of 4 friends, setting our chairs up, brining is drinks, making sure we were content.

My only critique is the restaurants. Sal’s, the steak place lost our reservation, one night, seated us an hour late the next, then served our mediocre at best food another hour later. Stick to the buffet or habachi, which are excellent.

reviews.author: 713pierreb
reviews.title: Tout est parfait pour un séjour de St-Valentin !
reviews.text:
Acceuil exceptionnel
Excellents restaurants, latin, méditerranéen, grill, buffets
Lieux très propre
Grande chambre avec lit king, salon, bain à remoux.
Nous allons y revenir en couple et avec nos trois jeunes adultes !

reviews.author: yanetito2
reviews.title: Lo mejor
reviews.text: Un excelente servicio, el personal muy atento y siempre con una sonrisa, la comida es deliciosa, es verdaderamente un hermoso lugar, sus instalaciones impecables, tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia única e inolvidable.

reviews.author: Cara B
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough about how awesome our vacation was! The staff were so kind and made you feel like family!  Edison and Lillian from the lobby bar were amazing and so much fun! I can’t talk enough about their wonderful customer service.  Luis, Jendry, Rauly at the pool bar were amazing! They made sure we had everything we needed. Teudy at the gabby beach bar also provided us great service. I could probably write about each and every employee at the resort as all of them remembered you from day to day and we’re so friendly and provided us with lots of laughter. This was our first time here and it was a great experience we would definitely come back! The rooms are great and very clean. Everything was beautiful! Thank you Punta Cana and Paradisus Palma Real.  Thank you Edison, Lillian, Luis, Jendry,Rauly and Teudy until we meet again!
South Dakota!
Jerry and Cara Beers

reviews.author: Kay S
reviews.title: Edison and Lillian are rock stars and made our trip so enjoyable!
reviews.text: The rooms were amazing and the food was so good! Shame on some of these people giving this place bad reviews as it was awesome! The beach and pools were great also! Luis at pool bar was top notch!  Rauly and Jendry at pool were so attentive and provided great service for fun day at beach.

reviews.author: Lori M
reviews.title: 3rd time was amazing!
reviews.text:
Amazing stay & Beautiful property!
Bartenders: Wander Roa, Ramon Ramirez are truly amazing people our stay wouldn’t be the same without you both. As well as Santos, ranelly, and Juan De La Cruz at Royal service
Entertainment crew:  Jose Cappucino, Naomi, Ronil Reyes, Darleys Nunez you all are amazing. We had the best time with you during the daytimes activities as well as the nighttime. Our vacation wouldn’t be the same w/o all of you making us have the best time. 
Oscar De La Cruz from management, Pedro & Moso activity supervisors thank you for all your help! The restaurants are going through a transition of some of them being closed but bare with the hotel they are doing the most to accommodate everyone. 
Overall it was a beautiful experience

reviews.author: Kris F.
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: Our stay in Paradisus Palma Real was wonderful. Staff members were attentive and timely with our needs 24/7. Felipe, in particularly, was incredibly helpful and made sure to accomodate us as much as he could with everything we asked. Our room was very nice and clean with more than enough space. We were walking distance from the pool and beach which was beautiful. Food was delicious. The resort itself is gorgeous and makes you feel comfortable and safe. Overall it was a great experience considering it was our 3rd time there, and we will surely be back in the near future!

reviews.author: Lise M
reviews.title: Awesome Resort and trip/
reviews.text: Loved this resort - size was great - people were very friendly and helpful.  Would recommend this resort.  A la cartes were good but was always hard to book.  Not much entertainment but was good for us.  Great superbowl.

reviews.author: Ramin B
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: I can’t rate this place highly enough! It’s relaxing, up market, so friendly, the food is sensational and there is so much to do and explore. It’s such a brilliant place to take the children and the staff make the trip. Everyone friendly and willing to help! We had a 2 bedroom swim up and even though we paid a lot. I still though it was excellent value! Beach is amazing, so many different pools, kids club is fun, wide choice of restaurants! All inclusive means all inclusive! Also the app is so useful for booking meals, spa, room service (included). Only downsides,  Some of the fixtures look dated and the sofa in the room is the worlds most uncomfortable sofa! But that’s literally the only things wrong.  Would highly highly recommend it!

reviews.author: digitaljedi2020
reviews.title: Always have a great time at this resort!
reviews.text: Great vacation once again, stayed at this resort a few times, and I think it's my favourite in all of punta cana.  Will definitely go again, and cannot wait to book my next vacation at paradisus palma real

reviews.author: AA16
reviews.title: A mother daughter getaway
reviews.text: I am a Melia member and to say the service I received from Jhorlennys Caldez, Sheila Garcia, and Margarito Moreno have been superb and above all expectations do not cover it I will continue to come back here because the level of service surpasses any expectations

reviews.author: Naiem Q
reviews.title: Trip
reviews.text: What an amazing time I had at the Paradisus_palma_golf_spa_hotel. The beach was amazing! The food was amazing! Most importantly the staff! @Benny Joseph was took care of us like family. If you ever visit the resort, FIND HIM :)

reviews.author: Chris O
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great resort, many restaurants, beautiful beach, great service. Katiuska was a very friendly server and Delgis Castillo was helpful in concierge. There are many golf courses in the area. The 27 hole course adjacent is nice but there are some higher end courses near by.

reviews.author: TrickyManouvre
reviews.title: Amazing hotel, beautiful Beach, beautiful gardens, excelent staff.
reviews.text:
We have been hosted already three times in this hotel. Each experience has been a real pleasure. Fantastic beach ( clean and tidy), nice rooms, very good food and drinks with many different options and the staff really keen to help on any issue!!!
YHI Spa highly recomended, walk around the gardens its a MUST. Night entertainment good.
Special mention to Mr.Daniel Lozano , Mrs. Gara, the Royal Service staff at the beach and to all the staff in general. Thank you for such a beautiful holidays.

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: Spa Experience
reviews.text:
Excellent stay at the resort. A special note of appreciation to the staff and therapists at YHI Spa. Wonderful experience from the moment we arrived. A special thank you to our therapists Joannes and Ysobel Varagas. 
To the management team who (presumably) made inclusion a consideration when hiring therapists (one of our Therapists was visually impaired) you demonstrated how important it is to have places of work reflect our everyday lives. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ann R
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: As a group of 4 Seniors, we can’t say enough about this resort.  The Elegance of the resort and the beauty of the beaches and golf course is only one element that made our vacation wonderful.  The other element was the outstanding service of the resort staff.  The service was outstanding, beginning with checkin and continuing throughout our stay.  We had excellent assistance with dinner and golf reservations, drink service at the bars and beach.  I don’t know the names of all the staff that made our vacation special,  but we do want to give a special recognition to our waiters: Benjamin, Edwin, and Judy; to the entertainment staff: Juan Ortig and others that I do not know their names; to Delgis Casnilo and other reservation desk personnel; and to Danny Santana for his enjoyable hospitality.

reviews.author: Nacho37
reviews.title: January 2020 relaxing vacations
reviews.text: We went to the Reserve in January. The Reserve, although connected to the larger Grand Paradisius hotel via 2-min golf cart shuttle fairs, is really a retreat on its own. The feeling when we enter and go through the hotel is very spa-like and beautiful design. The staff is very accommodating. Lionel our concierge was surely extremely busy with our family! He would take care of our reservations to restaurants at night which are not easy to obtain for a group of 9, and meet any other request we might have with very positive attitudes, even surprising us with a very personalized goodbye present that we surely appreciated. The hotel and rooms are well maintained. Our swim-up suite was absolutely gorgeous and felt more like an appartement than a room, with a big backyard and pool. There is also entertainment at night, very low-key. If you want louder scenery, you can go to the Grand Paradisius. The favorite part of the kids trip was their golf-cart rides around the hotel grounds. Overall very happy.

reviews.author: Almaran
reviews.title: Primer viaje Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Estuve allí una semana la verdad que quedé sorprendida es muy hermosa la vista el servicio de los chicos en la recepción fue exceptional, a pesar de que llegue tarde de la noche me encontraba perdida al día siguiente los chico de club Meliá me ubicaron me ayudaron muchísimo la verdad, la comida muy buena, las persona muy servicial el calor el clima todo perfecto, Gracias al concierge Starlin Tavares siempre con una sonrisa en su su rostro tomo mi contacto siempre me escribió y me buscaba para asegurarse que todo estuviera bien, me llevaba unas ricas frutas y chocolates a mi habitación que alegraban mis tardes cada detalle fue genial, volvería con gusto. 

Recomiendo ir su nombre lo dice Paradisus así es todo.

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.title: GREAT TWO-WEEK VACATION
reviews.text:
Upon returning to the resort after five years, we were very impressed with the renovations and improvements that have been made to the hotel.

The staff is much more efficient and helpful.

Our butler, Starlin Tavarez was extremely helpful in making our dinner reservations daily and was always available to offer his help in a very cheerful and professional manner.  It was a joy to interact with him on a daily basis. We appreciated his congenial personality and he made our stay a very enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Joan Landry
reviews.title: We thoroughly enjoyed our two-week vacation at this resort.
reviews.text:
The room, pool area, beach were all pristine and there was a great variety of restaurants which were all very well run and the food was excellent.  The wait staff were very attentive and helpful.  We were very impressed with the cleanliness and the improvements and upgrades that have been made to the resort.

We were assigned a butler whose name is Starlin Tavarez.  He was extremely helpful, efficient, congenial and always offering to help.  His communication in English was top notch and we enjoyed our conversations with him very much.  He went above and beyond in his role and we would recommend him highly.

We would not hesitate to recommend this resort as a very enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Renato dw Souza
reviews.title: Familia
reviews.text: Fomos muito bem atendidos principalmalmente por José Duarte e Yanna Vasquez, Maria Cardones, Robert Camilo e Lucia Diaz do Avenue Bar e Santo do The Reserve ... muito atenciosos e super prestativos , sempre dispospostos a nos divertir e prestativos

reviews.author: Climber588680
reviews.title: we had a very good vacation experience at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: the property is very well maintained and the staff all very helpful. It was easy to arrange outings with the help of the tours service ex. snorkeling on the catamaran. . The golf course was lovely, and the beach service was excellent. The tennis Pro was exceptional. Meals were very varied, but the taste of the dishes served was only fair to good; not excellent.

reviews.author: Jorge S
reviews.title: Vacaciones cena familiar
reviews.text: Excelente la atención del camarero Deblin del restaurant Sal.El restaurant es muy bueno, excelente menú y el lugar muy agradable.La atención es muy buena y estar en familia es muy bueno.Me pide Tripadvisor mínimo 200 caracteres pero no sé que más decir,no tengo quejas y

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Luis Diaz is the best bartender!
reviews.text: Spent 11 days at this resort in January 2020. Went on recommendations from several friends. Excellent hotel, food was great and service was outstanding. No trouble getting chairs in the shade, by the pool or near the bar. Restaurant reservations were a bit of a challenge but we were able to try all the selections at least once. Luis Diaz at the main pool/swim up bar is fantastic! Really helped make the trip special.

reviews.author: Alejandro I
reviews.title: Sobrepasaron mis espectativas
reviews.text: Visite el hotel con mi familia el motivo fue el cumpleaños de mi hija menor. Los jóvenes Delgis Castillo y Stephanie,sobrepasaron lo imaginable llenando la habitación de globos y le colocaron un pastel. Hicieron este día súper especial.

reviews.author: Juan M
reviews.title: Muy recomendable
reviews.text: Excelente atención recibida. Muy atentos Delgis castillo y carlos mercedes, excelentes personas y totalmente servicial. Recomiendo el hotel y los servicios que son también excelentes ya que nos sentimos como en casa

reviews.author: Mariana Z
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente atención de Carlos Mercedes y Delgis Castillo. Súper atentos en todo momento!!!! Súper recomendable!!! Hermosos días en familia, nos sentimos como en casa en todo momento. Siempre predispuestos a solucionar lo que sea!

reviews.author: Darelys C
reviews.title: El mejor cumpleaños de mi hija menor.
reviews.text: El motivo de nuestro viaje fue el cumpleaños de nuestra Hija menor al hotel Meliá Padarisus Palma Real en Punta Cana. Las atenciones y los detalles de personal fueron fabuosas en especial los jóvenes Feliz y Stephani.Les declararon la habitación con globos y le colocaron un pastel.también le celebraron el cumpleaños en la cena. Y si todo eso no fuera suficiente el no es Club, también le celebraron el cumpleaños. Esos son algunos de los detalles que nos motiva a volver al hotel

reviews.author: eldoctor cotorr... r
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Me gustó mucho la pase súper bien con mis amigos el hotel es genial las personas son muy atentas simpática Yanna Vasquez muy social y hamable los chico de la picina son hatento con el servicios los dj son heselente yeifri la pase bien heselente hotel

reviews.author: MukyT Lukonde
reviews.title: Amazing services
reviews.text: The views where so amazing ... the service where excellent. The food ,,,oh my it was wonderful the people were so kind and caring I'd like to spend my vacation here again  keep up with the excellent services

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort... Great Trip!
reviews.text: The staff were 1st rate... their attentiveness, sincerity and willingness to go above and beyond to provide satisfaction was top notch! The Resort was clean and situated right on the beach, allowing us to split our time from Beach side to Pool side.

reviews.author: Jim D
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Pardisus Punta Cana for 14 years.  Our most recent visit was to a sister resort, the Paradisus Palma Real.  While the differences were subtle, the bottom line is that both of these resorts offer world class quality. The staff were above average, especially, the following:

Rouly Perez Peguero.  He was one of the folks who served our needs at the beach and having spent 15 years in receipt of such a service, we can say, without question, that Rouly was one of the best ever.  He understands his role and is very good at performing his duties while always going above & beyond in whatever he does. 

Gabrielle (our butler who we were asked to call "Gabby") was also exceptional. He seemed to pop up every time we had a question or a particular need and was quick to respond or to do whatever the situation called for.  

While I don't recall all the names of the beach attendants, they all were very pleasant, however, as noted, Rouly was definitely the top of his class.

We also enjoyed SPA services and were very pleased with Sintaya and Risma. They were very professional and made the experience very pleasant.

Last but certainly not least, we want to thank Sandra Cedeno, our long time friend and professional who now works at the Grand Reserve/Circle.  As usual, Sandra, greeted us shortly after our arrival to say "hi" and, once again, made us feel at home.

reviews.author: Amaad R
reviews.title: Most relaxing vacation I have ever had
reviews.text:
As a first time all inclusive participant, but not a first time traveler, this was easily one of most pain free and easy vacations I have ever had. 

From the incredible beaches, to the beautiful pool and to the greatest butler Francis (who filled our mini credits with Diet Coke: my favorite) this was an amazing time.

While we didn’t get to try every restaurant (make sure to book those early) the options were great.

The service alone is worth coming back, which we plan on doing.

reviews.author: Diane G
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: Mauro and Liliana the best concierge ever. The hotel is so beautiful, the services and the food are fabulous. I will recommend. Thanks to Bladimir the best butler in Punta Cana, he helps me every time that I need it.

reviews.author: Mariana Btz
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: A estrutura do resort é maravilhosa, a localização excelente e há grande variedade de comidas e bebidas. Os funcionários são super atenciosos, especialmente o Elias Santana, que nos atendeu com muita presteza e cordialidade em todos os dias que ficamos na praia.

reviews.author: Danilo Souza
reviews.title: He estado en Paradisus Palma Resort
reviews.text: todo muy buen trato del personal en específico, elias santana muy servicial siempre preocupándose por el bienestar de los huéspedes, muy bueno todo de primera calidad, lo único que podría mejorar en las suites sería el sofá, porque esto está un poco desactualizado, aparte de eso toda la estancia fue muy buena y satisfactoria. Lo recomiendo, además del servicio de limpieza impecable, limpian durante el día alrededor de las 11 a.m. y por la noche alrededor de las 8 p.m., muy limpias y organizadas.

reviews.author: Lalit M
reviews.title: Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text:
First time In Paradisus Palma Real Resort  in Punta Cana. We had a amazing time. Alot of food  to eat, was fantastic. Yicel  de la Crüe &Shephanie Belpido  upgraded our room to royalty suit with no extra charge. She called a I T guy to come to set-up our Iptv box for us. Also both ladies went out of their way to make our Anniversary a memorable one. They put a Anniversary banner on the door, also balloons in the room, with a bottle of champagne glasses and a really cute heart shaped cake. Which made our day extra special. We will never forget that day.  Thanks from the bottom of our hearts. We both would like to thank all the staff at the resort  for the excellent  job that they did. 
Lalit & Nicky

reviews.author: Jrpatterson
reviews.title: Lobby Bar
reviews.text: We loved finishing our evening in the lobby bar with Lilian !  She always has an infectious smile and mixes great drinks!!  Thanks for all you do!!  You have made our evenings a wonderful memory!!  The Remy Martin, mama wanna and other concoctions you made were fabulous!!

reviews.author: Jeb B
reviews.title: 50th birthday celebration
reviews.text: We had a total of 8 couples that traveled to Punta Cana to celebrate 50th birthday for 2 of our friends.  We had a wonderful experience.  The staff was wonderful and friendly.  Bartender Lee and Julio were very attentive and fun to visit at the pool bar. Omar, one of the pool concierge, came by often to check on us.  Reynoldo GPS, Jose Bueno, Juan Mini Cooper awesome entertainers and dancers. So glad we came to Punta Cana!!!

reviews.author: Jrpatterson
reviews.title: Awesome violinist!! Lindsey Sterling quality!
reviews.text: This young lady played at the Gabi Bar at the Reserve!  She was fantastic! I hope she comes back for everyone to enjoy!!  She played a variety of music. People young and old loved her!! We all clapped and children danced.  She made our night!

reviews.author: Betsyp
reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.text: This was my first time at an all-inclusive, and I’m glad we chose Paradisus Palma Real. The food was great at the restaurants on the resort, especially Sal and the hibachi restaurant. Our concierge Diana Gustavo made our reservations and answered questions quickly. In the main dining room, Julio Paredes and Juan Motas memorized our drink orders and epitomized pleasant service. I had a wonderful time. The resort is clean and modern. There are lots of options for meals, and beach drink service.

reviews.author: Susie
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
The service is wonderful. I spent most of my time at the pool & ocean. Dancing at night. 
I had an amazing time. Juan Ortiz, Roynaldo gps & Freddy Mota, made sure we had a wonderful time. I thank them for the wonderful service.

reviews.author: OMG9304
reviews.title: Coup de coeur
reviews.text:
Le Palma Real est un des plus beau hôtel que j'ai visité dans les trois dernières décennies. 
Le site est immense et extrêmement bien entretenu.
Le personnel est très courtois la nourriture est excellente. 
Très peu ou pas d'algues sur la plage et le peu qu'il y a est ramassé  à tous les jours. 
Le seul et unique petit point négatif sont les chaises sur la plage.  Elles sont un peu vieilles et devraient être remplacées bientôt.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! The pool is gigantic with tons of seating and the beach is immaculate with even more seating! The rooms look recently updated and are bright, calm, and beautiful. The grounds are up kept wonderfully, everywhere you look is beautiful! The food is good, particularly vento and aqua. Freddy absolutely made my vacation with non stop coco locos by the pool. Every night wasn’t complete with out a night cap of a chocolate martini by Edison in the lobby bar! Paradisus resorts never really disappoint and i would absolutely come back!

reviews.author: Ramon Alejandro L
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: En la estadía que estuve la pasé muy bien la persona muy agradables, en especial a yanna Vázquez de actividades práctica muy bien el airobico el restaurante evento escelente los chow de la noche son bueno me divertí mucho la habitación todo bien el servicio espectacular los chico de la piscina dan buen servicio me encanto el hotel volveré

reviews.author: Franklin C
reviews.title: Vacasiones
reviews.text: LA mejor esperiencia que es tenido en este hotel las persona son agradable LA chica yanna vasquez de actividade es my  simpatica social me encamto LA lecion de meringue my Buena El restaurante evento la Sena eselente Los camarero son atento Los Chico de LA Playa dan un buen servicio me encanto la pases super

reviews.author: Luis German C
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: El hotel es excelente, y se puede disfrutar de la playa y el sol con familia, y la atención es genial, principalmente la de Junior Patrick en piscina y playa, 100% recomendable para disfrutar en familia.

reviews.author: Rodrigo C
reviews.title: Un paraiso !!
reviews.text:
Excelente lugar, las instalaciones muy lindas, comodas, las habitaciones son de primer nivel, cuenta con varios restaurantes que ofrecen todo tipo de comida para todos los gustos!
Ademas el hotel ofrece actividades diarias en la playa, piscina y todos los dias a las 21:00hs shows en el teatro o en la plaza, muy divertidas todas!
 El area de la playa cuenta con sendero y lugar exclusivo para turista que se manejen en silla de ruedas o niños pequeños que usen carritos. La atencion es otro detalle importante, en el sector de playa y piscina fueron muy amables los chicos, ofreciendo siempre algo de beber o comer, retirando las toallas o inclusive ayudarte con tomar fotos, quiero nombrar a 1 especificamente que desde que llegamos al hotel nos trato como reyes,  Junior Patrick!! Gracias por la atencion y cuidar los detalles! 
Recomiendo el hotel y volveria sin lugar a dudas

reviews.author: Sajidia T
reviews.title: Aniversario
reviews.text: La experiencia a sido muy buena vine para mi aniversario  y la es pasado super bien las persona son muy agradables y atentas los restaurantes como el tokimecu me encantó y acua  son buenísimos las actividades de la piscina la lección fe salsa com yanna Vásquez muy divertida los chico  José bueno , Elías Santana y júnior Patrick de la playa son persona social y atentas me encantó volveré

reviews.author: Madcodmother
reviews.title: Excellent bar tender/service - Edison Alcantara
reviews.text: Great rooms, excellent location, beautiful grounds. We spent quite a bit of time at the bar at reception - and wanted to give a huge shout-out to Edison Alcantara - who made us feel so welcomed and was always smiling - even when 50 ppl descended on his bar at once. Amazing customer service and worked every night we were there (6 nights in a row)

reviews.author: lucia f
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: My visit at Paradisus Palma Real was awesome. It was beautiful and the fiod was nice. I had a great time 💃 and the entertainers were great. Jose Bueno and Reynaldo GPS were amazing dancers, they were always very accommodating at the poolside.

reviews.author: Melissa H
reviews.title: Freddy was awesome!

reviews.author: lakshmi s
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL resort!!!
reviews.text:
We were at this resort for 5 days (12/29-1/3)  with 5 families (10 adults, 10 kids/young adults)  to celebrate New Year's Eve and a big birthday. We had a 2 bedroom suite and it was very large and spacious. Perfect for a family with older kids. It was actually 2 connecting bedrooms - each with it's own bathroom and jacuzzi tub and sitting area and balcony!!! When we arrived we had a lovely cake and bottle of champagne in the room since we were celebrating a birthday.
The people at reception were very helpful and nice and the beach is just stunning!

A few words of caution - this is definitely a place to come to relax. There is really not much to do other than chill at the pool and hang out by the beach. Having said that- there are plenty of lovely cabanas and open seating at the beach and we never felt like it was too crowded. Some people in our group went snorkeling and parasailing and had a great experience. This was through some vendors on the beach- not through the resort -and it was safe and fun. The resort advertises a casino but it is very small and has 6 1 cent slot machines a few roulette and blackjack tables!

The spa is lovely- but the massages are very overpriced! We also did hair and nail services and they were more reasonable.

Lastly- the food options are sparse. There is only one buffet - and the food seemed to be the same everyday and not always fresh, You have to make reservations at the restaurants and the timings are not always convenient. We went to Vento one night and they were wonderful. We went to Aqua and it was ok - the service was definitely not great. They don't have any small coffee shops or dessert areas - so if you want something you always have to go to the buffet and it is not 24 hours.

Entertainment- we were there for New year's eve and they put on a fantastic party!!! Every night they had a show or a dance party and the resort staff were fabulous!! They were super friendly and they tried to get everyone involved!!!

A special shout out fo Juan Moto who was our server at the buffet - he was so kind and helpful and made us feel special. Also we were 20 people - all vegetarian - and the Indian chef - Rajinder Singh - went out of his way to make us fresh authentic indian food every day and that was a real TREAT!! Thank you Rajinder!!!

reviews.title: Un room service
reviews.text: Nos alojamos en el hotel paradisus Palma real durante una semana. El hotel es espectacular y los servicios aún mejor. Yo que soy una persona mayor y no puedo bajar mucho al buffet prefería pedir el desayuno a través del room service. reviews.author: Amy L
reviews.title: Peace, tranquility, fabulous food, and making new friends!
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus with our family over the new year. We were expecting the typical all inclusive resort with average food, ok accommodations and such but what we found was an extended family (the staff made us feel at home...just like old friends!), fresh delicious food, stellar beaches, and poolside service like no other!  Our family travels with a large group, we all had different and fun experiences from local activities to resort activities, we all had a blast and highly recommend this resort!  Of our travels, this is by far our favorite of the past 10 years.  We plan to come back next year, thank you to the kind and warm staff for making our stay one we will never forget!

Food: we are foodies and the food was made fresh with the best cuts of meat, fresh fruit and pastries, yum!

Room: everything was in good working order, well maintained, and the house keeping staff was through several times throughout the day to clean, fix beds, turn down beds, and supply fresh linens!  Super impressed with this!

Staff: They seem to love where they work, all staff were very accommodating to all needs, we had 3 birthdays, switched dinner plans 3 times in one week, both on the beach and poolside several staff waited on us bringing us beverages. During activities staff were very personable and friendly, making the day more fun. 

Location: the rooms were located close to the beach for a quick walk. They offered bikes to easily make your way around the resort. Golf carts were readily available for quick access from one place to the other. 

Pools and kids splash pad:
There very numerous pools throughout the facility and a fun splash park with water slide for the kids, everyone was happy!

Spa: peaceful and relaxing.  There were several openings making booking easy.

Golf course: we didn’t use but this was something that was available to us, many of the guests used the course and raves about it!

reviews.author: S B
reviews.title: Great Holiday
reviews.text:
We were looking for a really great family sunshine getaway and this hotel really delivered. As ever,  things were not 100% percent , but in the main really good. 

Hotel - is beautiful.  Sort of a Roman /Greek style. Very modern and feels pretty fresh.  

Rooms- were of a great size and quality was very good but not the best I have stayed in. Very good but not 5* opulent. All rooms face the garden. Nice views. 

Food -really excellent quality. A huge variety of restaurants , mainly all inclusive ,as well as the buffet. The buffet was for breakfast lunch and optional dinner. The buffet selection was vast and a good quality vs many I have had before. WARNING- book restaurants at least a week before for arrive otherwise you may not get in.  

Service - ok but not great. English is not a first language so some speak well, some average and some zero. Occasionally you get a really great waiter but it’s in the main very transactional. 

Pool- amazing pool and pool area. Loads of sun beds. No need to reserve , but if you want specific beds, need to get down at 830 as the towels start going on.  

Beach -  beautiful white powdery sand. There is a lot of seaweed which is only an issue if you want to swim in the sea. 

Entertainment - they make a really great effort for evening entertainment.  It’s not the greatest quality but pretty good. 

Guests - mainly 40% American , 40% Spanish speaking (?), 10% French speaking (?) and balance other. Only one other British family spotted. Really nice mixed guests of families , couples, young /old. A nice clientele. 

The hotel has a Royal Section which is an upgrade. It’s for couples with no kids.  The pool area was literally empty. The beach area had some guests but not many. No idea how much more £ it was , but seemed a waste of money  to me as the normal section had so much space..... and this was Xmas busy season with kids. 

The hotel also has a Reserve section but is away from the beach. Our kids visited as the kids club was up there and they said our main pool was so much nicer. Other than that , can’t comment. 

The biggest negative is being inundated with hotel/excursion reps trying to sell you excursions , massages , pictures with parrots and lots of other stuff. It is painful as they come to your sun beds every 30 minutes. The only way to deal with this is to ignore them , be slightly rude or shoo them away. 

On balance I would highly recommend Paradisus but the hotel management needs to sort out the reps as everyone you speak to says the same thing.

All the staff at the Paradisus Palma Real are sooooo accommodating, warm, friendly and fun to joke around with... even the housekeeping staff will greet you with a genuine smile and hello. We loved our stay here. Balmy breezes, right on the beachfront, gorgeous landscaping (including flamingos!) beautiful architecture from the moment you step into the lobby and the view of the turquoise waters just instantly makes your shoulders drop and relax. Our concierge Cris Sanchez was an absolute dream—such a sweet girl who took great care of us —if we needed help or reservations, she was there—loved her! Bladamir at the front desk was excellent, Erwin, Trazy—-really anyone you talk to—such lovely lovely people. Also appreciated Jose Ramos putting together a special dinner for us on our last night and we had such a nice conversation with him at breakfast that morning. All the staff enjoy conversation and making you feel at home. You’re never hungry...everything is convenient and there are golf carts to get anywhere that might be too far for some guests. They are happy to take you. Great quality of food all around too—-I feel like they cater to a large range of palates. I would suggest that you only attend the information/sales breakfast if you have a true interest in investing in a Melia membership... if not, it will take up a chunk of your day (4 hours)—there is a bit of pressure too even when you’ve declined. Highly Highly recommend the hydrotherapy and massage over at Yhi Spa. What a blissful experience! At the Palms Real, there was a range of ages of guests... if you’re super young and want a party atmosphere, I don’t think this is your place, although they do play fun music at night (but seemed to be a more middle-aged/older crowd for sure)...all the lighting and design is soothing, I’d say... I just felt so relaxed. Five stars for sure and I’m curious to try The Reserve (other hotel on property).... ultimately we liked being steps from the beach

reviews.text:
Wonderful resort....food entertainment facilities but most importantly the staff...especially Reynaldo Monegro aka GPS...people are so giving...full of positive energy ...they make your trip unforgettable...

reviews.author: xoDeafDog2
reviews.title: Relaxing and everything you need on site
reviews.text: Very nice resort. We had a nice apartment style room with a kitchen area, dining table, living room, big comfortable king size bed, large hot-tub style bathtub, nice bathroom with three sinks, shower and separate toilet area. Just a super nice set-up for the room. The balcony with table/chairs was also great for enjoying the cool evenings and morning wake-up time. Staff would come late afternoon and clean very well. Pool was super nice, the ocean was right there and plenty of chairs with umbrellas and towel service to make it all very convenient to use the beach. The Japanese Hibatchi restaurant was a short golf-cart ride and comes highly recommended. The 'Rare' steakhouse is also a 'must do' - Vento was okay for Italiain, but not as fancy as you might think. We ended up with steak at the Italian Vento as the choices for food were very limited. The buffet was decent and what you would expect from a resort. Outdoor 'Gabby' drink lounge was super nice. We found most of the staff to be decent and they mostly left us alone to go about our vacation whilst they went about their daily jobs. The place is seeing some wear/tear and you will notice fountains not working, no elevators for the building we were in, so carrying luggage up to the third floor was a tad tiring, but not a big deal. The only thing we had to have help with was they forgot to give us keys to our room - we had the towel and safe cards, but no room keys, so that was a long trip back to the front desk and being sent to several people to get resolved and then in our room the safe was not working - batteries taped inside, so security came and over-rode the system to let us use it as a regular safe without the key-card. There were things that didn't work, but we never called about because it didn't matter such as the alarm clock, lamp, TV remote - basic things that we didn't need anyway. We have no complaints and really enjoyed our time in the DR. We felt very safe and secure in the setting. We traveled with other couples as part of a larger group, so all was planned for us and it was just an easy vacation. i would definitely come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Aschuck

reviews.author: Jas C
reviews.title: Incredibly Staff, Very good food, Need more night time Activities
reviews.text:
I have been to DR multiple times over the past few years but this was my first time at this specific resort. The resort property itself is beautiful and very well maintained. The beach was constantly being swept for seaweed and any other debris. Rooms were clean but may need some mild updates (Not a big deal at all)

The food was above average, with many restaurants, allowing us to only repeat dinner reservations once! (We loved Sushi at MIZU, with Sosa being the best Hibachi chef). Aqua and Vento were very good as well. 

The staff at this resort was absolutely phenomenal. The best resort staff I have encountered in any of my trips to the DR. Our concierge Starlin was amazing and had all of our reservations organized, with reminders via text on a daily basis. He would check in on us everyday and was able to change/accommodate our reservations as necessary. We also had a very good experience with our private butler, Jendry, who went above and beyond to make our stay amazing. He would check on us regularly and refill any drinks we needed, in addition to making sure we had a nice Cabana ready when we first arrived in the morning. (Take his suggestion and try to Coco Loco, it's delicious). 

Only thing the resort needs to work on is activities at night. Perhaps it was a quieter time of year or since it's more "family friendly" compared to other resorts, but it seemed like there was minimal activities/shows/etc at night. This didn't bother us much but could be something they can work on. 

Overall the resort was great and I would definitely suggest it especially with the friendly helpful staff and overall beautiful property.

reviews.author: siangher
reviews.title: O nome faz jus. É mesmo um paraíso.
reviews.text: A arquitetura é suntuosa, com áreas de convivência bem decoradas e muito agradáveis. Os quartos são bastante espaçosos (o nosso tinha até cozinha, lavadora de roupa, ferro etc) e limpos. A praia é ótima, quase sem ondas e de água quentinha, com muitas cadeiras e quiosques. As piscinas muito lindas e grandes. Além disso, pudemos desfrutar do spa gratuito e outras amenidades com ajuda do concierge Starlin Tavares que, sempre solícito, nos ajudava em tudo que precisávamos e nos mimava deixando tábuas de queijos e frutas no quarto e conseguindo reservas em restaurantes concorridos do hotel. Foi ótimo contar com sua ajuda preciosa. As comidas dos restaurantes são boas, mas o atendimento mau humorado de muitos garçons deixa a desejar, com exceção do restaurante Brisas, onde fomos sempre bem recepcionados e a comida, na nossa opinião, foi a melhor experiência gastronômica do hotel. Foram dias de puro deleite e descanso. Tudo que precisávamos nas nossas tão desejadas e merecidas férias.

reviews.author: CLj
reviews.title: 1st time at an "All Inclusive". Fantastic experience!
reviews.text:
We just got back from 4 nights / 5 days at the Paradisus Palma Real and we had a fantastic experience. Having heard a few horror stories about so-called "all inclusive" resorts, we were more than pleasantly surprised at the quality of the experience. 

First, we have to highlight the staff, specifically Gabino, our concierge. Gabino set the tone even before we left when he reached out via WhatsApp to help plan a special birthday dinner.  Gabino, and really all of the staff, were always smiling and quick with a "Hola" or "Buenos dias". We tend to be rather private, and the staff was warm and professional without being overbearing or intrusive. 

We stayed in a Jr Suite. After a long day of travel, we arrived and checked into our room and were put off by a somewhat musty odor. Gabino immediately escorted us to dinner and had our stuff moved to a new room. (I later surmised that we were given a room that had not been used in a while due to it still being off season.) New room? Perfectly clean and smelled wonderful. Housekeeping each day kept it that way throughout the rest of our stay. Things always go wrong with every business. The way issues are handled makes or breaks the customer experience and this won us over.

The rest of our trip was lovely and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: lsenc903
reviews.title: Amazing get away - truly paradise!
reviews.text:
Went for a 5 day getaway to Punta Cana and stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  Had a wonderful experience!

Pros:
- Gorgeous resort and pools.  It truly looks like a postcard.
- Great entertainment.  During the day, the staff provided individual attention, and kept you up to date on what activities were planned at the resort.  A special shout-out to "Wakanda" who really went above and beyond in making sure we were entertained and had everything we needed.  Also, great shows at night so you never need to leave the resort!
- We upgraded our room and had a private butler.  He also went above and beyond making sure our reservations were made, booking taxis for us, and leaving us special treats in the room including a set-up bubble bath!  Another shout-out to Kelvin, our butler!
- So many food options!  Between the buffet and several restaurants, there was no shortage of food.
- Room was beautiful and clean.  Went with my mom and aunt, and we each had our own full sized beds.  
- There was always someone available to take orders around the pool and beach.

Cons:
- On the beach you get hounded by people selling tours, jewelry, hats, clothes, pictures with animals, etc.  It seems non stop at some points.
-  Though the room was beautiful, it seemed to be more set-up for a couple, with no real door separation between the room and the bathroom.  
- There doesn't seem to be much of a "downtown" area to go to or perhaps the staff wasn't able to find what we were looking for.  Though there was a lot to do at the resort, we did want to venture out, and it didn't seem like there was one main area similar to other vacation spots.  
- Some of the restaurants were closed as it seemed to be off season

Overall, a great trip and will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Typhany
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: The resort was gorgeous and the staff was friendly.  I would love to come here again.  The YHI spa was excellent, the only issue was the direct dial from my room didn't work and on several occassions I tried to book a reservation at the spa reservation table near Naos and there wasn't an attendant. The food was good, nothing that really stood out as far as being excellent.  The bartenders poured the drinks heavy handed, which on vacation, is how I like them :)  The tour guides, and drivers were also extremely friendly and funny.  They made the trip even more memorable.

reviews.author: Louistrc
reviews.title: Great time - Awesome Service - Beautiful Scenery
reviews.text:
My new wife and I are spending a week at the Paradisus Resort in Punta Cana celebrating our honeymoon. When we had a concern, no matter how small, we went and spoke with Mariely Armando. WOW!  What an incredible person and she took matters into her own hands, followed up and made sure we were extremely happy. She left no stone unturned and went over the top. I can’t say enough about her dedication to make the client happy and make sure they enjoy and have fun at their resort.
 
I had the chance to also speak with the Manager, Vladimir Rodriguez who was a great listener and also wanted to make sure we had a great time. They all truly care about the experience that everyone has. 

 The resort is spotless, friendly and incredible views of the water. The beach is pure white soft sand. Every detail is well taken care of. You will certainly believe you are in Paradise from the greeting you receive to your check-in and opening your door to your beautiful room. The pool is probably the largest I’ve seen. And of course the drinks keep flowing. You will be addicted to the burgers they make all day on the beach. 

You can’t go wrong coming to the Paradisus and seeing the beauty unfold before your eyes. Nighttime is fun with music, dance floor and entertainment in the courtyard. Really spectacular.  The people from cleaning your rooms, to keeping the grounds looking beautiful also deserve our thanks. 

My wife and I want to personally thank Mariely for her professionalism, compassion and beautiful surprise for our honeymoon when we can back to our room one night. It was truly special and Mariely certainly made this a spectacular honeymoon and such a memorable experience that we will always love and look back at throughout our life. 

Mariely, thank you from the bottom of our hearts  We love you and appreciate every you have done for us. . Paradisus and everyone that works there we thank you and appreciate making our honeymoon so spectacular. 

Paradisus is a destination that you must make sure is on your bucket list. Punta Cana and Paradisus are incredible. Well worth coming to visit! Thank you! Lou & Dena

reviews.author: hector v
reviews.title: Raúl Jiménez
reviews.text: Muy lindas vacaciones junto a mi pareja! Un genio Raúl nos atendió súper bien en la playa,atento en todo momento a los clientes y su bienestar! Volveríamos sin duda unas vacaciones para repetir !🌴👏🏼

reviews.author: Christophe
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real golf resort Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, super staff available and smiling, very attentive.
 The buffets are excellent, the beach is beautiful, several pools with places for children and others for adults.
 Several great restaurant” a la carte” by reservation but included in the all inclusive.
 The golf is fabulous, an exceptional maintenance.
Special thanks to Vladimir in charge of the customer service.

reviews.author: Clarissa C
reviews.title: Pedido de noivado
reviews.text:
Agradecemos muito a recepção do  Paradissus Palm Beach Resort na nossa hospedagem! 
Fomos muito bem atendidos por todos! 
Mas agradecemos em especial nossa concierge Yocasta, que foi fundamental no momento do nosso pedido de casamento! 
Nunca vamos esquecer o quão especial foi tudo isso!

reviews.author: Day S
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: I had such a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real!! The staff were amazing, especially Presley and Kelvin! They were both so awesome and hospitable. Anything you needed, they were there to help you!! Highly recommended. The food was good as well. Try to get reservations at Aqua if you can! Vento was good as well.

reviews.author: LeonardoTriches
reviews.title: Primer viaje
reviews.text: En nuestro primer viaje en pareja, elegimos el destino de Punta Cana para celebrar nuestro primer año de citas. El hotel de nuestra elección fue el Paradisis Palma Real. A nuestra llegada nos recibió Benny Joseph. El servicio de Benny es un gran diferencial de nuestra experiencia, siempre dispuesto a servirnos de la mejor manera posible, siempre indicando lo mejor y más consistente, Xavier hace un gran servicio en conjunto con los otros empleados. Hasta ahora todo es asombroso. Solo felicitaciones y felicitaciones al hotel y sus empleados.

reviews.author: Patricia Modesto
reviews.title: El mas comodo, elegante y asombroso resort
reviews.text: Este es y sera siempre mi resort favorito, todo en el es bueno desde su comida, hasta su hospitalidad, las actividades que se realizan, las hermosas piscina, todo es cinco estrella, no solo es ub hotel donde puedes disfrutar si no tambien donde puedes descansar, tu habitacion esta equipada con todo lo que se necesita para nunca querer salir de ella, pero el hotel es tan impresionante que no puedes perdertelo, todos son muy buenos profesionales y con buena educacion lo recomiendo

reviews.author: Karla S
reviews.title: Excelente!!
reviews.text:
Muy buen servicio, las habitaciones! El spa es un espectáculo, ofrecen experiencias de calidad! La comida muy buena, el room services vale la pena, es 24 horas y hay bastante variedad de comida. 
Las actividades nocturnas son bastante amenas para compartir con la pareja o en familia. 
El serivicio en el area de la piscina es excelente!

reviews.author: Gladys B
reviews.title: Lo disfrute
reviews.text:
Estuvimos hospedados en El
Área de Royal Service, servicio súper exclusivo, áreas privadas, piscina totalmente tranquila, se presta para relajarse, comida rica en el restaurante Palazzo, show espectacular, áreas de playa para tomar fotos hermosas. Realmente lo disfrutamos y lo recomendamos. Las gracias a Glenys Martínez Gerente de Royal y a nuestro mayordomo Miguel Carpio. La pasamos súper. Volveremos!

reviews.author: Betty M
reviews.title: YHI Spa
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus Palma Real with my family in August 2019.  We were a group of 7, 4 adults and 3kids ages 11,12,14yrs old. We had a great time overall. I treated my parents to a couples massage.  Which we booked with Domi go, who was friendly and very courteous. 
My parents loved the massage and their before treatment amenities. The price was very reasonable.  I highly recommend it as per my parents satisfaction!

reviews.author: Alua A
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma RealResort, Punta Cana
reviews.text:
I have stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real resort in September and I had an excellent experience with friendly helpful staff from the first phone call through to check in, dining and check out. My room was  modern and very accommodating and despite the hotel is at the main road, there was no noise at all. I had a very nice dinner with good choices. I will definitely stay again. Because of good staff and atmosphere. I would like to say thanks Yokasta Nunez for good service and just hospitality. 
I would strongly recommend this hotel for families with children.

reviews.author: Danny G
reviews.title: Awesome time and awesome staff to make your vacation better
reviews.text: I would like to thank Gabriel Polanco and Raul Jimenez, the best pool crew guys that Paradisus Palma Real has to its Club Melia members. These two gentleman went above and beyond to make my family vacation the best. They where attentive to my family always with a great attitude on helping my family and I have a great stay as well a genuine assurance of doing there best.  This is the 6 time I have stayed in this resort and always look forward on meeting them again. Thank you Gabriel and Raul.

reviews.author: Darren
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Wonderful facility on a beautiful beach. The sand is soft and the water is amazing. The staff here are very nice.  Freddy Mota is an extremely friendly and helpful server on the beach. It has really made our stay more enjoyable.

reviews.author: dmal4
reviews.title: Freddy Mota is the best!!
reviews.text: We are loving our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in Pubta Cana. But I want to give a specific shoutout to Freddy Mota, our beach server, because he is fantastic! He takes great care of us...keeping us supplied with water and drinks...he even remembers from day-to-day what we like. He is so friendly and always has a smile for us. Everyone here is lovely, but Freddy is the best! ¡Muchas Gracias!

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.title: Excellent Staff
reviews.text: Excellent staff, safe grounds, most enjoyable vacation! Can't wait to return! I would suggest having more to do for my age group. We looked for a volleyball for 3 days! I asked several staff members where to get a volleyball. I was sent to 3 different people and could never get one! Couldn't find a pool table or any other activity to play.

reviews.author: Macarena B
reviews.title: Como siempre
reviews.text: Lo mejor de la vida son ustedes! Paradisus, su gente su staff hace que año a año volvamos a visitarlos, 5 estrellas es poco... gracias miles a todos por hacernos sentir especiales!! Hasta el proximo si Dios no propone otra cosa

reviews.author: Xiomara D
reviews.title: Vacaciones familiares
reviews.text: Nos encanto todo,  los restaurantes, el servicio,el area de cuidado para los ninos, y el personal muy eficiente,sin lugar a dudas volveremos, nos encanto, excelente lugar para vacacionar.lo recomendamos 100%

reviews.author: Dani R
reviews.title: Il luogo dove tutto è perfetto
reviews.text:
Da oltre 10anni veniamo in questo resort, ora al circle. Facciamo altri viaggi durante l anno ma questo è il posto per eccellenza dove scarichiamo ogni forma di stress. Il clima sempre ottimo, mare sempre caldo con varie sfumature dal blu intenso al turchese. Tutto il personale è molto disponibile e gentile. I miei ringraziamenti vanno in modo particolare a Iseldo Tapia gentilissimo e professionale nel ristorante che più mi piace Amor de mar, a William Solera chef eccezionale che ci ha viziati con deliziosi piatti , e che dire di Felipe Morla, Raul Jimenez che durante le nostre giornate in spiaggia ci hanno fatto sempre sentire “a casa”. E da alcuni anni continuano sempre ad avere un atteggiamento cordiale ed amichevole ma sempre e sopratutto con rispetto e professionalità.
La vacanza termina domenica ma la prossima data è già fissata.
Un grazie di cuore

reviews.author: Josephine M
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation!
reviews.text:
Being in the resort hospitality business and restaurant business for 29 years, I have to say, the staff at the Paradisus is absolutely amazing. I have stayed at Meila properties before, I actually got married at one 15 years ago and just haven’t been back. I will be going back to the Paradisus!  From the front desk staff to housekeeping. Anything you could possibly want or need, they are sure to take care of you! However, when traveling to the Paradisus, make sure you get the opportunity to work with   Vladimir Rodriguez who is in charge of guest services. Vladimir will make sure you and your family are taken care of. Vladimir knowledge of the hotel and all it has to offer exceeded our expectations. His customer service skills are exceptional! He and liliana de león from guest service are an asset to his property! It is so nice to go on a vacation and have the restaurant staff properly trained. From serving wine on the correct side, replacing silver wear, clearing on the correct side, and actually clearing a table properly! Lezette (housekeeping) was so polite and made sure our room was perfect.
I want to thank Vladimir and his exceptional trained staff. Because of him.... we will be back next year. All 6 of us!

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Our trip was very relaxing. The chairs on the beach were great. The buffet was one of the best I've had in the Caribbean. The circus show at night was also fantastic. The only negative we had was getting our luggage to and from our room. That could have been done more timely. Overall a great resort.

reviews.author: sarahrowland201
reviews.title: Pool service at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful family holiday at this resort. 
Jesus Evangelista was our waiter for the entire week and took such good care of us. 
He made sure our kids stayed hydrated, always bringing ice cold water at regular intervals, plus any other drinks that we desired.
Jesus was friendly and attentive and always had a smile on his face.

reviews.author: Yesenia R
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Todo ha Sido maravilloso, mi familia y yo hemos disfrutado bastante, los servicios en general son muy buenos, Luis Bautista happy boy Luis cordero leo Nina y la neon party fue lo mejor  nos ha atendido muy bien.

reviews.author: sandalbo
reviews.title: Hermosa estadía
reviews.text:
El mejor servicio de la playa a cargo de Jesús Evangelista que nos atendió como reyes en  nuestra semana de vaca iones y reuniones en el hotel! Gracias por tu atención Jesús
También tengo que destacar el servicio en las habitaciones,todo impecable todos los días!

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.title: Truly Royal Service
reviews.text: We came to this resort for a wedding and were blown away by the service and amenities provided at the royal service part of the resort. By far and away the best part of our stay was our attentive, kind and very helpful butler Argenis Romero. Our stay was enhanced so much from the way he treated us and it definitely made it all worth while. Thanks Paradisus and Argenis for a great stay!

reviews.author: Luis P
reviews.title: Excelente Atenciones!!!!
reviews.text: Todo muy Bien. Los eventos nocturnos. cada unos del personal que ameniza, en especial al happy boy. Su comida es muy buena y variada. La plaza estuvo bien y el personal que atiende tambien. Los restaurantes y las atenciones muy buenas.

reviews.author: paulavanessa
reviews.title: Muuuuito lindo
reviews.text: Hotel em frente praia paradisiaca.Servico all inclusive com bebidas quarto standard no meu conceito atendeu muito bem.Considerando ser um hotel muito grande.Piscina e arquitetura do predio linda.Equipe do hotel atenciosa representado todos por exemplo Alicia e Jesus .Servico e  piscina do spa excelente.No meu conceito superou expectativas.Levar adaptador de tomadas....Recomendo passeio Juanillo (mais paradisiaco) , danca golfinhos ( 40 minutos) e CocoBongo para conhecer ( só consumir o incluso no ingresso para evitar surpresas)

reviews.author: Camila
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: Mi familia la pasó super bien, todos son muy atentos, en especial gustavo de bares (es el que está al lado del teatro)  muy amable, siempre contento,bebidas en su punto... en el buffet por igual, todo limpio, victor de recepción fue de lo mejor con mi familia....

reviews.author: Olga Mercedes G
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: Una infraestructura de calidad óptima en medio de una naturaleza espectacular. El servicio es excelente en todo momento. La gastronomía es variada y de buenísima calidad. La piscina es hermosa, amplia   incluso para nadar.

reviews.author: J9177PSrobertb
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real punta cana
reviews.text: Had an awesome time at this resort. Staff was amazing and the resort was beautiful! Food was excellent and the night life was incredible! Thanks for an amazing week!!! Look forward to going back again next year!

reviews.author: Neel Das
reviews.title: One of the best resorts I have ever stayed in!!!
reviews.text: When I went to The Reserve at Paradisus Pinta Cana I was offered so many am duties and extra things with out even asking. They made sure that everything we needed was taken care of. I highly recommend you get Family Concierge if you go with family and if you go with only adults you should get Royal Service. There are little extra things that they do for you if you get these things. They assign people to help you with your every need if you get Family Concierge or Royal Service. The restaurants are exquisite and have very many different types of food.  The beaches are beautiful and private only to the resort, you can rent cabanas a and the ocean waters are so turquoise you can all the way to the ocean floor!! I guarantee that if you stay at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana you will have a very pleasant and enjoyful stay.

reviews.author: Mike Egger
reviews.title: Wife and I alone time
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Feb of 2019.  We spent most of our time on the beach and swimming in the ocean.  Beautiful resort that accommodates all of your needs.  A bit confusing on where you can sit while on the beach.

reviews.author: wilbertogonzalez
reviews.title: Excelente estadía!!!
reviews.text:
Todo estuvo de maravillas, playa y piscina  limpia, atención del personal del bar encargados del área de playa y piscina excelente.
Bebidas nacionales e importadas.
El bbq en la playa muy bueno.
Mucha tranquilidad, la pasamos muy bien.
Las habitaciones impecables Y el personal siempre muy atentos.

reviews.author: Jaime C
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text:
Es un resort con todas las comodidades. La comida es de muy buena calidad y es muy variada. Las habitaciones son muy grandes y cómodas. El Spa y el circuíto de aguas es un gran experiencia. El campo de Golf es perfecto para disfrutar con  familia y amigos y está muy bien estructurado y conservado.
La atención de Vladimir en servicio al cliente fue de gran apoyo durante nuestra estadía. Estuvo muy pendiente de nosotros.
Totalmente recomendado para plan en pareja o familiar.

reviews.author: Ratehotels
reviews.title: Amazing resort back for the second time!!
reviews.text: We visited this resort for the second time, this place has it all amazing food, nightlife, immaculate grounds lush garden it’s a large resort but very easy to get around, try the restaurant at the Reserve steaks were amazing, beautiful beach, always something going on in the main foyer, great bars and restaurants.  Rooms are a little outdated but are still very clean and spacious, we had a large suite with a kitchen, perfect for a family of four. This place has it it great food, entertainment, people are super nice and welcoming, will definitely be back to this amazing place.

reviews.author: Aline A
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Many great hotels in the area, but this particular one stands out by its service.  Jendry de Luna at the beach, Ysabel Vargas at the spa, the bartenders, the waiters... and I can go on and on. Service was excellent, staff was polite, respectful, friendly and make the entire experience wonderful! So glad to see that the hotel employs people with disabilities! Five stars!

reviews.text: Not only is the resort beautiful the staff is amazing! I had such a wonderful vacation. Luis Rosario thank you for being so great! The entertainment was also wonderful...thank you Leo, Luis and Oscar. You guys all really work hard all day to make everyone happy.

reviews.text: Property was great, beach clean, and the service from the staff outstanding.  We are ready to go back.  Received the best massage of my life.  Four wheeling and the catamaran I would I recommend to all the vacationers.

reviews.author: ViajeraMadrid90
reviews.title: Para repetir
reviews.text: El personal excelente en general. Happy boy como animador o Jesus nuestro camarero de playa siempre súper atentos. La comida por encima d encuestarás expectativas. La habitación cómoda y siempre al detalle con minibar y accesorios de higiene personal. Para repetir sin duda

reviews.author: u63fdv
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelento hotel, una gran experiencia, buenas habitaciones, buena comida, hermosas playas un lugar al que me encantaria volver nuevamente, la atencion fue muy buena por parte de todo el personal del hotel.

reviews.author: Tash H
reviews.title: Greatest find
reviews.text: If you are looking for a hotel that exceeds your expectations then this is the place for you. From the moment we arrived to the day we left we were treated like royalty. our concierge even followed up with us upon our return to London. very unexpected but a touch of class. The master suites are huge and ooze luxury, so much space, huge living area with sofa beds, a kitchenette, lovely bedroom with 2 queens leading onto a very spacious balcony with spectacular views. The bathroom has a large jacuzzi with separate area housing the toilet and shower. Rooms are cleaned daily and beds turned down. Our concierge surprised the kids each evening with little touches that made them feel special (jacuzzi balloon bubble baths, scented pillows and a whole personalised gift hamper on arrival). The restaurants are fabulous, all booked in advance by our private concierge;  Passion restaurant is a must for the adults (an extra cost) but an experience you will not forget. The resort is huge and the shuttle service frequent to whisk you off to another breathtaking experience, you never feel crowded and the staff are amazing, the beach is just awesome although a lot of seaweed in the water. We were really impressed with the night entertainment at the theatre and main lobby, in our view this was a lot better than the beach bar / disco entertainment. The family concierge go out of their way to ensure you have an all inclusive holiday without any fuss. Beers and bubbles were delivered to our room on ice each night (at no extra cost), a private cabana at the pool was booked for our 10 night stay in advance which was pure bliss. A morning on the beach followed by an afternoon at the pool became the norm. the pool staff were amazing and provided activities each day (foam parties, water aerobics. paddle boarding, painting, candle making, dance classes etc....). A huge thank you to the staff for making our stay so memorable, in particular Sandra (our family concierge) - she is an angel and deserves special praise from her employers. Also a huge congratulations to Thomas who has nailed the superior hospitality that this hotel has to offer. I highly recommend this hotel, book it - you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Karel K
reviews.title: Best vacation 2019
reviews.text: Mis vacaciones en melia Caribe fueron excelentes, el proceso de el check in die inmejorable muy rapido, gracias al departamento de recepcion por todo , me Gusto mucho el mosaico y muoi; la habitacion fue muy comoda,la Playa ESTA en maravillosas condisiones a lo wie de refiere a terminals de limpiza y belleza

reviews.author: Alejandra D
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente atención,las habitaciones excelentes,animación( Rosa ,Palito) y  e instalaciones, los tragos son inferiores a los del palladiun de imbasai que eran con frutas naturales.volveríamos seguramente.

reviews.author: Sherpa03057593014
reviews.title: Excelete
reviews.text: Extraordinaria nuestra experiencia de mi esposo y mia, en cantados locos por volver. Nuestra estadia fue por nuestra luna de miel, nos prepararon todo muy lindo.  Ya estamos organizando otro con los niños. Encantada, enamorada del lugar los servicios AMO MI RD

reviews.author: Marcelle Sinder
reviews.title: Experiência incrível
reviews.text: Quarto maravilhoso, muito confortável, muita bebida, comida deliciosa.. restaurantes ótimos!! Gostaríamos de agradecer especialmente ao Francis, Martin e Omar por tanto cuidado e carinho com a gente! Eles tornaram nossa lua de mel ainda mais especial!

reviews.author: Richard A
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: We enjoyed our trip at the hotel the service was really good it was clean the food was great the beach is really close to the hotel the buffet was also clean and nice And I want to thank Vladimir Rodriguez for an amazing service and excellent help through our journey in the Paradisus hotel . I really recommend these amazing resort.

reviews.author: Maria C
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: mi estancia fue excelente, me encantó el hotel en general, e servicio fue excelente, la playa ,bares , restaurante RARE fue mi favorito. Planificaré volver a este real paraíso.  Todo excelente, habitación, lugar de la habitación, muy buen ambiente, piscina muy limpia, personal muy atento

y de atención al cliente que siempre estuvieron muy atentos Vladimir Rodríguez y Carlos Mercedes,muchas gracias a todo el personal por hacer que nuestras vacaciones fueran tan maravillosa.

reviews.author: Doores O
reviews.title: El paraíso en punta cana
